`runtime/audio/nnaudio.c`:

```c
/* nn::audio device functions: the host's answers to two of the game's imports. The lifted SDK code normally replaces
 * them (nnservices.c install_lifted); they serve a run with SMO_LIFT_INSTALL=0 or SMO_LIFT_SKIP. The sound itself is
 * the AudioRenderer's (smo_audio.c). */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <windows.h>
#include "runtime.h"
#include "hostrt.h"

#define A0 (c->x[0])

static const char g_device_name[] = "AudioTvOutput";

static void audio_GetActiveAudioDeviceName(Ctx *c) {  /* (AudioDeviceName *): char[0x100] */
    memset((void *)(uintptr_t)A0, 0, 0x100);
    memcpy((void *)(uintptr_t)A0, g_device_name, sizeof g_device_name);
}

static void audio_SetAudioDeviceOutputVolume(Ctx *c) {   /* (const AudioDeviceName *, float): traced, not applied */
    trace_printf("nn::audio: SetAudioDeviceOutputVolume(%s, %g)\n", (const char *)(uintptr_t)A0, c->v[0].f[0]);
}

#define AU(n) "_ZN2nn5audio" n
static const ImportDef audio_imports[] = {
    {AU("24GetActiveAudioDeviceNameEPNS0_15AudioDeviceNameE"), audio_GetActiveAudioDeviceName},
    {AU("26SetAudioDeviceOutputVolumeEPKNS0_15AudioDeviceNameEf"), audio_SetAudioDeviceOutputVolume},
};

void register_audio_imports(void) {
    register_imports(audio_imports, (int)(sizeof audio_imports / sizeof audio_imports[0]));
}

```

`runtime/audio/smo_audio.c`:

```c
/* smo_audio.c - the host side of the AudioRenderer.
 *
 * The game's sdk module contains the whole AudioRenderer (NintendoSDK 7.3.2; the base game's 3.5.1 too): the client API (nn::audio::OpenAudioRenderer,
 * RequestUpdateAudioRenderer, ...), the server (nn::audio::server::AudioRendererManagerImpl and below) and the DSP
 * command processing (nn::audio::dsp). tools/lifter/sdklift.py lifts all of it (rules: sdklift_rules.txt), and the
 * game's nn::audio imports are answered by that lifted code (nnservices.c install_lifted). The host supplies only what is
 * below the SDK on a console:
 *
 *   CreateAudioRendererManagerByHipc   [sdk] nn::audio::OpenAudioRenderer / GetAudioRendererWorkBufferSize use it when
 *       AudioRendererParameter +0x2c != 1, i.e. when the renderer is to run in the audio system module (over IPC)
 *       rather than in the application (+0x2c == 1: CreateAudioRendererManagerByDfc, "direct function call"). The
 *       system module runs the same AudioRendererManagerImpl the sdk contains, so the host answers with the in-process
 *       manager: the lifted CreateAudioRendererManagerByDfc, called with the same registers (the sf::SharedPointer
 *       result goes through x8, the indirect-result register, untouched).
 *
 *   THE RENDERING CLOCK (the audio system module's job on a console). The SDK's in-process build has no frame loop:
 *       nothing in it calls AudioRenderSystem::SendCommandToDsp, and nn::audio::dsp::SendCommandBuffer / Start / Wait /
 *       Signal are empty stubs [sdk 0x196514 .. 0x196554]. The host therefore keeps the list of started renderers
 *       (AudioRenderSystem::Start / Stop are cut here: record, then run the lifted function) and, on its own thread,
 *       once per audio frame (sample count / sample rate: 240 / 48000 = 5 ms) calls the lifted SendCommandToDsp of each.
 *       That SDK code generates the frame's command list, hands it to the "DSP" (below) and signals the renderer's
 *       system event, which wakes the game's audio thread (nn::atk) to send its next update.
 *   THE DSP: dsp::SendCommandBuffer(session, address, size, ...) is cut here and runs the SDK's own command list
 *       processor on the CPU, as the SDK's manual-execution path does [sdk 0x188a00]: CommandListProcessor
 *       SetProcessTimeMax(-1), Setup(list, size), Process(), one processor object per session. DSP addresses are CPU
 *       addresses in the in-process build (dsp::MapUserPointer returns its argument [sdk 0x196530]).
 *   NOT YET: the sound itself. The final mix goes to the device sink; where that lands and the host audio output for it
 *       come next, so for now nothing is heard (the frames are processed and timed).
 * Lifted code reached from the frame thread stops with the name of anything it needs (sdklift_rt.c). */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <windows.h>
#include "hostrt.h"
#include "sdklift.h"

static unsigned long long g_mgr_by_hipc;

static void audio_manager_by_hipc(Ctx *c) {
    static ImportFn dfc;
    if (!dfc) dfc = sdk_lifted("_ZN2nn5audio31CreateAudioRendererManagerByDfcEv");
    if (!dfc) guest_trap("smo_audio: CreateAudioRendererManagerByDfc was not lifted (sdklift_rules.txt)", c->x[30] - 4);
    if (g_mgr_by_hipc++ == 0)
        printf("smo_audio: the AudioRenderer manager is the in-process one (CreateAudioRendererManagerByDfc) in place of the audio system module's (IPC)\n");
    dfc(c);
}

#define RS_START "_ZN2nn5audio6server17AudioRenderSystem5StartEv"
#define RS_STOP "_ZN2nn5audio6server17AudioRenderSystem4StopEv"
#define RS_SEND "_ZN2nn5audio6server17AudioRenderSystem16SendCommandToDspEv"
#define RS_RATE "_ZNK2nn5audio6server17AudioRenderSystem13GetSampleRateEv"
#define RS_COUNT "_ZNK2nn5audio6server17AudioRenderSystem14GetSampleCountEv"
#define CLP_TIME "_ZN2nn5audio3dsp20CommandListProcessor17SetProcessTimeMaxEj"
#define CLP_SETUP "_ZN2nn5audio3dsp20CommandListProcessor5SetupEPKvm"
#define CLP_PROCESS "_ZN2nn5audio3dsp20CommandListProcessor7ProcessEv"

#define MAX_SYS 8
static SRWLOCK g_sys_lock = SRWLOCK_INIT;
static uint64_t g_sys[MAX_SYS];                 /* started AudioRenderSystem objects */
static int g_nsys;
static HANDLE g_frame_thread;
static volatile LONG64 g_frames, g_lists, g_commands_bytes;
static uint8_t *g_proc[16];                     /* CommandListProcessor per session (host memory, zeroed) */

static ImportFn lifted(const char *name) {
    ImportFn f = sdk_lifted(name);
    if (!f) { printf("smo_audio: %s was not lifted (sdklift_rules.txt)\n", name); guest_trap("smo_audio: SDK function not lifted", 0); }
    return f;
}
static uint64_t call1(Ctx *c, ImportFn f, uint64_t a0) { c->x[0] = a0; c->x[30] = 0; f(c); return c->x[0]; }

static DWORD WINAPI frame_thread(LPVOID arg) {
    (void)arg;
    static Ctx c;                                /* one frame thread: its own guest context, stack and thread block */
    uint8_t *stack = VirtualAlloc(NULL, 0x40000, MEM_RESERVE | MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE);
    uint8_t *tls = VirtualAlloc(NULL, 0x10000, MEM_RESERVE | MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE);
    static uint8_t thread_type[0x400];
    c.x[31] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(stack + 0x40000);
    c.tpidr = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)tls;
    wr64(c.tpidr + 0x1f8, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)thread_type);   /* Horizon thread block: ThreadType pointer at +0x1f8 */
    SetThreadPriority(GetCurrentThread(), THREAD_PRIORITY_TIME_CRITICAL);
    ImportFn send = lifted(RS_SEND), rate = lifted(RS_RATE), count = lifted(RS_COUNT);
    LARGE_INTEGER fq, t0, now;
    QueryPerformanceFrequency(&fq);
    QueryPerformanceCounter(&t0);
    /* The wait for the next frame boundary sleeps on a high-resolution timer. It used to Sleep(1) until 2 ms before the
     * boundary and then call SwitchToThread in a loop: 2 of every 5 ms busy on a time-critical thread (69% of a core in
     * all, measured), taken from the game's threads when the PC is busy. The output has 120 ms queued, so a frame a
     * fraction of a millisecond late changes nothing; the schedule stays on the performance counter. */
    HANDLE timer = CreateWaitableTimerExW(NULL, NULL, 0x00000002 /* CREATE_WAITABLE_TIMER_HIGH_RESOLUTION */, TIMER_ALL_ACCESS);
    double period = 0;
    long long tick = 0;                          /* frames since t0: the schedule (g_frames only counts) */
    for (;;) {
        uint64_t sys[MAX_SYS];
        int n;
        AcquireSRWLockShared(&g_sys_lock);
        n = g_nsys;
        memcpy(sys, g_sys, sizeof sys);
        ReleaseSRWLockShared(&g_sys_lock);
        if (n && period == 0) {
            uint32_t r = (uint32_t)call1(&c, rate, sys[0]), k = (uint32_t)call1(&c, count, sys[0]);
            period = r ? (double)k / r : 0.005;
            printf("smo_audio: rendering clock: %u samples at %u Hz = %.3f ms per frame\n", k, r, period * 1000.0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) call1(&c, send, sys[i]);
        if (n) InterlockedIncrement64(&g_frames);
        /* the next frame boundary, on the performance counter (no drift); after a stall of more than 10 frames the
         * schedule restarts from now instead of rendering the missed frames in a burst */
        double p = period ? period : 0.005;
        long long frame = ++tick;
        for (;;) {
            QueryPerformanceCounter(&now);
            double t = (double)(now.QuadPart - t0.QuadPart) / (double)fq.QuadPart;
            double due = frame * p;
            if (!n || t >= due) { if (t > due + 10 * p) { t0 = now; tick = 0; } break; }
            double left = due - t;
            LARGE_INTEGER rel;
            rel.QuadPart = -(LONGLONG)(left * 1e7) - 1;              /* relative, 100 ns units */
            if (timer && SetWaitableTimer(timer, &rel, 0, NULL, NULL, FALSE)) WaitForSingleObject(timer, 100);
            else if (left > 0.002) Sleep(1); else SwitchToThread();
        }
        if (!n) Sleep(1);
    }
    return 0;
}

static void rs_Start(Ctx *c) {
    static ImportFn start;
    if (!start) start = lifted(RS_START);
    uint64_t sys = c->x[0];
    start(c);
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_sys_lock);
    int known = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < g_nsys; i++) known |= g_sys[i] == sys;
    if (!known && g_nsys < MAX_SYS) g_sys[g_nsys++] = sys;
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_sys_lock);
    printf("smo_audio: renderer %llx started (%d running)\n", (unsigned long long)sys, g_nsys);
    if (!g_frame_thread) g_frame_thread = CreateThread(NULL, 1 << 20, frame_thread, NULL, 0, NULL);
}
static void rs_Stop(Ctx *c) {
    static ImportFn stop;
    if (!stop) stop = lifted(RS_STOP);
    uint64_t sys = c->x[0];
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_sys_lock);
    for (int i = 0; i < g_nsys; i++) if (g_sys[i] == sys) { g_sys[i] = g_sys[--g_nsys]; break; }
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_sys_lock);
    stop(c);
}
/* ---- THE SOUND: the device sink's channels go to the PC through waveOut (48 kHz, 16-bit, stereo).
 * DeviceSinkCommand [sdk 0x18aab8 GenerateDeviceSinkCommand]: magic 0xcafebabe, u16 size 0x130, u16 type 0xf, +0x10 enabled,
 * +0x14 device name (256), +0x114 session, +0x118 sample buffer (the upsampler's output when the renderer does not run at
 * 48 kHz; 0 otherwise), +0x120 input count, +0x124 mix buffer index per channel (u8, already offset). Mix buffers are int32
 * samples, buffer i at GetMixBuffers() + i * sample count; the device takes them as 16-bit (clamped). Frames of 5 ms are
 * gathered into blocks of 40 ms; 16 blocks in flight at most (the oldest pending audio is dropped and counted if the
 * device falls behind; a block the device finished before the next one was ready is counted as an underrun). */
#include <mmsystem.h>
static float g_dev_volume[3];                    /* defined with its values below (the device layer) */
#define SINK_BLOCK 1920                           /* frames per waveOut block (40 ms at 48 kHz) */
#define SINK_NBLK 16
static HWAVEOUT g_wo;
static WAVEHDR g_wh[SINK_NBLK];
static int16_t g_wbuf[SINK_NBLK][SINK_BLOCK * 2];
static int g_wcur, g_wfill, g_wopen = -1, g_wstarted;
static LONG64 g_sink_frames, g_sink_blocks, g_sink_dropped, g_sink_underruns;
static uint32_t g_sink_peak;
static FILE *g_wav;                               /* SMO_AUDIO_WAV=<file>: what goes to the device, as a WAV file (header completed at exit) */
static uint32_t g_wav_frames;
static void wav_header(void) {
    uint32_t data = g_wav_frames * 4, riff = 36 + data, fmt = 16, rate = 48000, bps = 48000 * 4;
    uint16_t pcm = 1, ch = 2, align = 4, bits = 16;
    fseek(g_wav, 0, SEEK_SET);
    fwrite("RIFF", 1, 4, g_wav); fwrite(&riff, 4, 1, g_wav); fwrite("WAVEfmt ", 1, 8, g_wav); fwrite(&fmt, 4, 1, g_wav);
    fwrite(&pcm, 2, 1, g_wav); fwrite(&ch, 2, 1, g_wav); fwrite(&rate, 4, 1, g_wav); fwrite(&bps, 4, 1, g_wav); fwrite(&align, 2, 1, g_wav); fwrite(&bits, 2, 1, g_wav);
    fwrite("data", 1, 4, g_wav); fwrite(&data, 4, 1, g_wav);
    fseek(g_wav, 0, SEEK_END); fflush(g_wav);
}
static void sink_open(void) {
    if (getenv("SMO_AUDIO_WAV")) { g_wav = fopen(getenv("SMO_AUDIO_WAV"), "wb"); if (g_wav) wav_header(); }
    WAVEFORMATEX f = {WAVE_FORMAT_PCM, 2, 48000, 48000 * 4, 4, 16, 0};
    if (getenv("SMO_AUDIO") && !atoi(getenv("SMO_AUDIO"))) { g_wopen = 0; printf("smo_audio: sound output off (SMO_AUDIO=0)\n"); return; }
    MMRESULT r = waveOutOpen(&g_wo, WAVE_MAPPER, &f, 0, 0, CALLBACK_NULL);
    g_wopen = r == MMSYSERR_NOERROR;
    printf("smo_audio: sound output: %s\n", g_wopen ? "waveOut, 48000 Hz, 16-bit stereo, 40 ms blocks" : "waveOutOpen FAILED: no sound");
    if (g_wopen) {
        waveOutPause(g_wo);
        /* Test copies are silent, as nnaudio.c's AudioOut: only the copies a person plays (smo_native.exe, smo_user.exe)
         * are audible. The device stays open and is fed as with sound, so the timing, the dropped-sample and underrun
         * counts and an SMO_AUDIO_WAV capture are the same. SMO_VOLUME=<0..100> overrides either way. */
        char exe[MAX_PATH] = "";
        GetModuleFileNameA(NULL, exe, sizeof exe);
        const char *base = strrchr(exe, '\\') ? strrchr(exe, '\\') + 1 : exe, *vol = getenv("SMO_VOLUME");
        int percent = vol ? atoi(vol) : (!_stricmp(base, "smo_native.exe") || !_stricmp(base, "smo_user.exe")) ? 100 : 0;
        if (percent < 0) percent = 0;
        if (percent > 100) percent = 100;
        DWORD level = (DWORD)(0xffff * percent / 100);
        waveOutSetVolume(g_wo, level | level << 16);
        printf("smo_audio: host volume %d%%%s\n", percent, percent ? "" : " (test copy: silent; SMO_VOLUME=<0..100> to change)");
    }
}
static void sink_submit(void) {                   /* the block g_wcur is full */
    WAVEHDR *h = &g_wh[g_wcur];
    if (h->dwFlags & WHDR_PREPARED) waveOutUnprepareHeader(g_wo, h, sizeof *h);
    memset(h, 0, sizeof *h);
    h->lpData = (LPSTR)g_wbuf[g_wcur]; h->dwBufferLength = SINK_BLOCK * 4;
    waveOutPrepareHeader(g_wo, h, sizeof *h);
    waveOutWrite(g_wo, h, sizeof *h);
    g_sink_blocks++;
    if (!g_wstarted && g_sink_blocks >= 3) { waveOutRestart(g_wo); g_wstarted = 1; }      /* 120 ms queued before playing */
    else if (g_wstarted) {                       /* everything before this one already played: the device waited for us */
        int busy = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < SINK_NBLK; i++) if (i != g_wcur && (g_wh[i].dwFlags & WHDR_PREPARED) && !(g_wh[i].dwFlags & WHDR_DONE)) busy = 1;
        if (!busy) g_sink_underruns++;
    }
    g_wcur = (g_wcur + 1) % SINK_NBLK; g_wfill = 0;
}
/* The command header and the device sink command, as each SDK writes them:
 *   3.5.1 [sdk 0x18aab8 GenerateDeviceSinkCommand]: {u32 magic 0xcafebabe, u16 size, u16 type (0xf: device sink), u32
 *         estimated time, u32 node}, +0x10 enabled, +0x14 device name, +0x118 sample buffer, +0x120 input count, +0x124
 *         the mix buffer of each channel (u8, already offset).
 *   7.3.2 [sdk 7.3.2 0x9f950 CommandBuffer::GenerateDeviceSinkCommand]: {u32 magic, u8 enabled, u8 type (0x10: device
 *         sink), u16 size, u32 estimated time, u32 node}, +0x20 device name (256), +0x120 session, +0x128 sample buffer,
 *         +0x130 input count, +0x134 the mix buffer of each channel (u16, already offset).
 * SDK_VERSION (image.h, the program NCA's SDK) says which; the SDKs between those two are not known here. */
typedef struct { const char *name; uint32_t inputs; uint64_t sample_buffer; unsigned index[6]; } Sink;
#if SDK_VERSION >= 0x07000000u
#define SINK_TYPE 0x10u
static void cmd_header(const uint8_t *c, unsigned *size, unsigned *type, int *enabled) { *enabled = c[4]; *type = c[5]; *size = c[6] | (unsigned)c[7] << 8; }
static void sink_fields(const uint8_t *c, Sink *s) {
    s->name = (const char *)(c + 0x20);
    memcpy(&s->sample_buffer, c + 0x128, 8); memcpy(&s->inputs, c + 0x130, 4);
    for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) s->index[i] = c[0x134 + 2 * i] | (unsigned)c[0x135 + 2 * i] << 8;
}
#else
#define SINK_TYPE 0xfu
static void cmd_header(const uint8_t *c, unsigned *size, unsigned *type, int *enabled) { *size = c[4] | (unsigned)c[5] << 8; *type = c[6] | (unsigned)c[7] << 8; *enabled = c[0x10]; }
static void sink_fields(const uint8_t *c, Sink *s) {
    s->name = (const char *)(c + 0x14);
    memcpy(&s->sample_buffer, c + 0x118, 8); memcpy(&s->inputs, c + 0x120, 4);
    for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) s->index[i] = c[0x124 + i];
}
#endif
static void audio_sink_out(const Sink *s, uint64_t mb, uint32_t ns) {
    uint32_t nin = s->inputs;
    if (g_wopen < 0) {
        sink_open();
        printf("smo_audio: device sink \"%.32s\": %u channels, mix buffers %u %u %u %u %u %u, %u samples per frame, sample buffer %llx\n",
               s->name, nin, s->index[0], s->index[1], s->index[2], s->index[3], s->index[4], s->index[5], ns, (unsigned long long)s->sample_buffer);
    }
    if (!g_wopen || !mb || !ns || nin == 0 || nin > 6) return;
    if (ns != 240) { static int said; if (!said++) printf("smo_audio: the renderer does not run at 48 kHz (%u samples per 5 ms frame): its upsampler output is NOT IMPLEMENTED, no sound\n", ns); return; }
    /* the sample buffer is always filled ([sdk 0x18ad4c]: the translated upsampler buffer, or the caller's argument): at 48 kHz the sink reads the mix buffers */
    const int32_t *L = (const int32_t *)(uintptr_t)(mb + (uint64_t)s->index[0] * ns * 4), *R = (const int32_t *)(uintptr_t)(mb + (uint64_t)s->index[nin > 1] * ns * 4);
    const int32_t *C = nin >= 6 ? (const int32_t *)(uintptr_t)(mb + (uint64_t)s->index[2] * ns * 4) : NULL;      /* 6 channels: FL FR FC LFE BL BR; FC and the backs folded in */
    const int32_t *BL = nin >= 6 ? (const int32_t *)(uintptr_t)(mb + (uint64_t)s->index[4] * ns * 4) : NULL, *BR = nin >= 6 ? (const int32_t *)(uintptr_t)(mb + (uint64_t)s->index[5] * ns * 4) : NULL;
    float vol = g_dev_volume[0];
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < ns; i++) {
        float l = (float)L[i], r = (float)R[i];
        if (C) { l += 0.707f * (float)C[i] + 0.707f * (float)BL[i]; r += 0.707f * (float)C[i] + 0.707f * (float)BR[i]; }
        l *= vol; r *= vol;
        int32_t li = (int32_t)(l < -32768.f ? -32768.f : l > 32767.f ? 32767.f : l), ri = (int32_t)(r < -32768.f ? -32768.f : r > 32767.f ? 32767.f : r);
        uint32_t a = (uint32_t)(li < 0 ? -li : li); if (a > g_sink_peak) g_sink_peak = a;
        if (g_wfill == 0 && (g_wh[g_wcur].dwFlags & WHDR_PREPARED) && !(g_wh[g_wcur].dwFlags & WHDR_DONE)) { g_sink_dropped += ns - i; return; }    /* all 16 blocks still queued */
        g_wbuf[g_wcur][g_wfill * 2] = (int16_t)li; g_wbuf[g_wcur][g_wfill * 2 + 1] = (int16_t)ri;
        if (g_wav) { int16_t fr[2] = {(int16_t)li, (int16_t)ri}; fwrite(fr, 4, 1, g_wav); g_wav_frames++; }
        if (++g_wfill == SINK_BLOCK) sink_submit();
    }
    g_sink_frames++;
}

/* dsp::SendCommandBuffer(int session, DspAddr list, size_t size, int ?, bool ?, u64 ?) */
static void dsp_SendCommandBuffer(Ctx *c) {
    static ImportFn tmax, setup, process;
    if (!process) { tmax = lifted(CLP_TIME); setup = lifted(CLP_SETUP); process = lifted(CLP_PROCESS); }
    unsigned s = (unsigned)c->x[0] & 15;
    uint64_t list = c->x[1], size = c->x[2], lr = c->x[30];
    if (!g_proc[s]) g_proc[s] = calloc(1, 0x400);
    uint64_t p = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)g_proc[s];
    c->x[0] = p; c->x[1] = 0xffffffffu; tmax(c);
    c->x[0] = p; c->x[1] = list; c->x[2] = size; setup(c);
    c->x[0] = p; process(c);
    {   /* the device sink: skipped by this SDK's processor (jump table [sdk 0x77c38c] entry 0xf -> next command); on a
         * console the audio DSP firmware outputs it. Here: its channels, read from the mix buffers after the list ran. */
        static ImportFn mixbufs, scount;
        if (!scount) { mixbufs = lifted("_ZNK2nn5audio3dsp20CommandListProcessor13GetMixBuffersEv"); scount = lifted("_ZNK2nn5audio3dsp20CommandListProcessor14GetSampleCountEv"); }
        c->x[0] = p; mixbufs(c); uint64_t mb = c->x[0];
        c->x[0] = p; scount(c); uint32_t ns = (uint32_t)c->x[0];
        {   /* SMO_AUDIO_SCAN=<n>: every n lists, the mix buffers that hold a non-zero sample and their peaks */
            static int every = -1;
            static ImportFn bcount;
            if (every < 0) { const char *e = getenv("SMO_AUDIO_SCAN"); every = e ? atoi(e) : 0; }
            if (every > 0 && g_lists % every == 0 && mb && ns) {
                if (!bcount) bcount = lifted("_ZNK2nn5audio3dsp20CommandListProcessor14GetBufferCountEv");
                c->x[0] = p; bcount(c);
                unsigned nb = (unsigned)c->x[0], shown = 0;
                printf("smo_audio: list %lld: %u mix buffers of %u samples at %llx; with signal:", (long long)g_lists, nb, ns, (unsigned long long)mb);
                for (unsigned b = 0; b < nb && b < 256; b++) {
                    const int32_t *s = (const int32_t *)(uintptr_t)(mb + (uint64_t)b * ns * 4);
                    int32_t peak = 0;
                    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < ns; i++) { int32_t v = s[i] < 0 ? -s[i] : s[i]; if (v > peak) peak = v; }
                    if (peak && shown++ < 24) printf(" %u:%d", b, peak);
                }
                printf("%s\n", shown ? "" : " none");
            }
        }
        static int scan_every = -1;                         /* SMO_AUDIO_SCAN: also the commands of the list, by type */
        if (scan_every < 0) { const char *e = getenv("SMO_AUDIO_SCAN"); scan_every = e ? atoi(e) : 0; }
        int scan = scan_every > 0 && g_lists % scan_every == 0;
        unsigned hist[64][2];
        if (scan) memset(hist, 0, sizeof hist);
        for (uint64_t o = 0; o + 0x10 <= size;) {           /* the list: a header, then commands {magic 0xcafebabe, ...} (cmd_header) */
            const uint8_t *cmd = (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)(list + o);
            uint32_t magic;
            unsigned csz, type;
            int enabled;
            memcpy(&magic, cmd, 4);
            if (magic != 0xcafebabeu) { o += 4; continue; }
            cmd_header(cmd, &csz, &type, &enabled);
            if (scan && type < 64) {
                hist[type][enabled != 0]++;
                static long long shown_list = -1;
                const char *dump = getenv("SMO_AUDIO_SCAN_TYPE");            /* per scanned list, the first command of this type: its first 0x100 bytes */
                if (dump && (unsigned)strtoul(dump, NULL, 16) == type && enabled && shown_list != g_lists) {
                    shown_list = g_lists;
                    printf("smo_audio: command type %x, %u bytes:", type, csz);
                    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 0x100 && i < csz; i += 8) { uint64_t q; memcpy(&q, cmd + i, 8); printf("%s%016llx", i % 32 ? " " : "\n  ", (unsigned long long)q); }
                    const char *at = getenv("SMO_AUDIO_SCAN_AT");                /* hex offset in the command of a pointer: 32 bytes it points to */
                    if (at) {
                        uint64_t ptr;
                        memcpy(&ptr, cmd + strtoul(at, NULL, 16), 8);
                        printf("\n  at +%s -> %llx:", at, (unsigned long long)ptr);
                        __try { for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) printf(" %02x", ((const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)ptr)[i]); } __except (1) { printf(" (unreadable)"); }
                    }
                    printf("\n");
                }
            }
            if (type == SINK_TYPE && enabled) { Sink s; sink_fields(cmd, &s); audio_sink_out(&s, mb, ns); }
            if (csz < 0x10) break;
            o += csz;
        }
        if (scan) {
            printf("smo_audio: list %lld: %llu bytes; commands type:enabled/disabled", (long long)g_lists, (unsigned long long)size);
            for (int t = 0; t < 64; t++) if (hist[t][0] || hist[t][1]) printf(" %x:%u/%u", t, hist[t][1], hist[t][0]);
            printf("\n  in order:");
            for (uint64_t o = 0; o + 0x10 <= size;) {
                const uint8_t *cmd = (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)(list + o);
                uint32_t magic; unsigned csz, type; int enabled;
                memcpy(&magic, cmd, 4);
                if (magic != 0xcafebabeu) { o += 4; continue; }
                cmd_header(cmd, &csz, &type, &enabled);
                printf(" %x%s", type, enabled ? "" : "-");
                if (csz < 0x10) break;
                o += csz;
            }
            printf("\n");
        }
    }
    c->x[30] = lr;
    InterlockedIncrement64(&g_lists);
    InterlockedAdd64(&g_commands_bytes, (LONG64)size);
}

/* ---- the audio DEVICE layer: nn::audio::server::detail::* are stubs in the application SDK [sdk 0x193d94 ..
 * 0x193ddc: return 0x4990400 or nothing]; on a console the audio system module answers them. Host model, as for a
 * docked console with a stereo output: [doc] device names as the system reports them (yuzu audio_core
 * audio_device.cpp, switchbrew "Audio services"): AudioTvOutput (active when docked), AudioStereoJackOutput,
 * AudioBuiltInSpeakerOutput; output volume per device, default 1.0; 2 active channels (the PC's stereo output).
 * The device-switch and input/output notification events are real system events (os_threads.c handles) that are
 * never signalled: the output device does not change. AudioDeviceName = 256 bytes. */
static const char *const g_dev_names[] = {"AudioTvOutput", "AudioStereoJackOutput", "AudioBuiltInSpeakerOutput"};
static float g_dev_volume[3] = {1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f};
static uint32_t g_dev_event[3];
uint32_t os_system_event_new(int autoclear, uint64_t *key);    /* os_threads.c */
static int dev_index(uint64_t name) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) if (strncmp((const char *)(uintptr_t)name, g_dev_names[i], 256) == 0) return i;
    return -1;
}
static void dev_ok(Ctx *c) { c->x[0] = 0; }
static void dev_list(Ctx *c) {                  /* (AudioDeviceName *out, int count) -> int written */
    int n = (int)c->x[1] < 3 ? (int)c->x[1] : 3;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { memset((void *)(uintptr_t)(c->x[0] + 256ull * i), 0, 256); strcpy((char *)(uintptr_t)(c->x[0] + 256ull * i), g_dev_names[i]); }
    c->x[0] = n < 0 ? 0 : (uint64_t)n;
}
static void dev_set_volume(Ctx *c) {            /* (const AudioDeviceName*, float volume (s0), aruid) */
    int i = dev_index(c->x[0]);
    if (i >= 0) g_dev_volume[i] = c->v[0].f[0];
    c->x[0] = 0;
}
static void dev_get_volume(Ctx *c) {            /* (const AudioDeviceName*, aruid) -> float (s0) */
    int i = dev_index(c->x[0]);
    float v = i >= 0 ? g_dev_volume[i] : 0.0f;
    vzero(&c->v[0]); c->v[0].f[0] = v;
}
static void dev_get_active(Ctx *c) { memset((void *)(uintptr_t)c->x[0], 0, 256); strcpy((char *)(uintptr_t)c->x[0], g_dev_names[0]); }
static void dev_event(Ctx *c, int which) {     /* (u32 *handle, aruid) -> Result */
    if (!g_dev_event[which]) g_dev_event[which] = os_system_event_new(0, NULL);
    wr32(c->x[0], g_dev_event[which]);
    c->x[0] = 0;
}
static void dev_event_switch(Ctx *c) { dev_event(c, 0); }
static void dev_event_input(Ctx *c) { dev_event(c, 1); }
static void dev_event_output(Ctx *c) { dev_event(c, 2); }
static void dev_channels(Ctx *c) { c->x[0] = 2; }

void smo_audio_counts(long long *frames, long long *dropped, long long *underruns) {      /* smo_nerve.c (SMO_STAGE_LIST): the device sink so far */
    *frames = g_sink_frames; *dropped = g_sink_dropped; *underruns = g_sink_underruns;
}

void smo_audio_report(FILE *out) {
    if (g_wav) { wav_header(); fclose(g_wav); g_wav = NULL; fprintf(out, "audio: %u frames (%.1f s) written to %s\n", g_wav_frames, g_wav_frames / 48000.0, getenv("SMO_AUDIO_WAV")); }
    if (g_mgr_by_hipc) fprintf(out, "audio: renderer manager requests answered in-process: %llu\n", g_mgr_by_hipc);
    fprintf(out, "audio: renderers running %d, frames clocked %lld, command lists processed %lld (%lld bytes)\n",
            g_nsys, (long long)g_frames, (long long)g_lists, (long long)g_commands_bytes);
    fprintf(out, "audio: device sink: %lld frames output, %lld blocks of 40 ms queued, %lld samples dropped (device behind), %lld underruns (device waited), peak level %u of 32767\n",
            (long long)g_sink_frames, (long long)g_sink_blocks, (long long)g_sink_dropped, (long long)g_sink_underruns, g_sink_peak);
}

    sdk_host_override("_ZN2nn5audio32CreateAudioRendererManagerByHipcEv", audio_manager_by_hipc);

    sdk_host_override(RS_STOP, rs_Stop);
```

```c
static Ctx *g_main_ctx;

/* Debug aid: SMO_PROF=<start s>,<duration s> samples the main guest thread's host stack every ~2 ms in that
 * window, unwinds it to guest functions and prints every (caller -> callee) pair seen with its sample count. */
#define PROF_MAX 8192
static struct { uint64_t callee, caller; unsigned n; } g_prof[PROF_MAX];
static int g_prof_used;
static HANDLE g_prof_target;
static DWORD WINAPI profiler(LPVOID arg) {
    int start = 0, dur = 0;
    (void)arg;
    char mode = 's';
    if (sscanf(getenv("SMO_PROF"), "%d,%d,%c", &start, &dur, &mode) < 2 || dur <= 0) return 0;
    Sleep((DWORD)start * 1000);
    ULONGLONG end = GetTickCount64() + (ULONGLONG)dur * 1000;
    unsigned samples = 0;
    if (mode == 'f') {        /* SMO_PROF=<start>,<dur>,f : spin reading c->fn / x30: every function the main thread enters */
        while (GetTickCount64() < end) {
            for (int r = 0; r < 4096; r++) {
                uint64_t callee = g_main_ctx->fn, caller = g_main_ctx->x[30];
                unsigned h = (unsigned)((callee >> 2) * 2654435761u) % PROF_MAX;
                while (g_prof[h].callee && g_prof[h].callee != callee) h = (h + 1) % PROF_MAX;
                if (!g_prof[h].callee) { if (g_prof_used >= PROF_MAX - 16) continue; g_prof[h].callee = callee; g_prof[h].caller = caller; g_prof_used++; }
                g_prof[h].n++;
                samples++;
            }
        }
        printf("\n[prof] %u reads of the main thread's current function (function, first lr seen: reads)\n", samples);
        for (int j = 0; j < PROF_MAX; j++)
            if (g_prof[j].callee)
                printf("[prof] f_%llx lr %llx: %u\n", (unsigned long long)g_prof[j].callee, (unsigned long long)g_prof[j].caller, g_prof[j].n);
        return 0;
    }
    while (GetTickCount64() < end) {
        CONTEXT ctx;
        uint64_t chain[64];
        int k = 0;
        memset(&ctx, 0, sizeof ctx);
        ctx.ContextFlags = CONTEXT_FULL;
        SuspendThread(g_prof_target);
        GetThreadContext(g_prof_target, &ctx);
        for (int depth = 0; depth < 400 && k < 64; depth++) {
            uint64_t g = guest_function_of(ctx.Rip);
            if (g && (k == 0 || chain[k - 1] != g)) chain[k++] = g;
            DWORD64 base;
            RUNTIME_FUNCTION *rf = RtlLookupFunctionEntry(ctx.Rip, &base, NULL);
            if (!rf) break;
            void *hd; DWORD64 est;
            RtlVirtualUnwind(UNW_FLAG_NHANDLER, base, ctx.Rip, rf, &ctx, &hd, &est, NULL);
            if (!ctx.Rip) break;
        }
        ResumeThread(g_prof_target);
        samples++;
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            uint64_t callee = chain[i], caller = i + 1 < k ? chain[i + 1] : 0;
            int j;
            for (j = 0; j < g_prof_used; j++) if (g_prof[j].callee == callee && g_prof[j].caller == caller) break;
            if (j == g_prof_used) { if (g_prof_used == PROF_MAX) continue; g_prof[g_prof_used].callee = callee; g_prof[g_prof_used].caller = caller; g_prof_used++; }
            g_prof[j].n++;
        }
        for (ULONGLONG t0 = GetTickCount64(); GetTickCount64() - t0 < 1;) YieldProcessor();
    }
    printf("\n[prof] %u samples of the main thread (callee <- caller: samples)\n", samples);
    for (int j = 0; j < g_prof_used; j++)
        printf("[prof] f_%llx <- f_%llx: %u\n", (unsigned long long)g_prof[j].callee, (unsigned long long)g_prof[j].caller, g_prof[j].n);
    return 0;
}

static size_t main_stack_size_from_npdm(void) {
    const char *ov = getenv("SMO_MAIN_STACK");
    if (ov && strtoull(ov, NULL, 0) >= 0x10000) return (size_t)(strtoull(ov, NULL, 0) + 0xfff) & ~(size_t)0xfff;
    char path[1024];
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s", g_elf);
    char *sl = strrchr(path, '/'), *bs = strrchr(path, '\\');
    char *cut = sl > bs ? sl : bs;
    snprintf(cut ? cut + 1 : path, sizeof path - (size_t)((cut ? cut + 1 : path) - path), "..\\exefs\\main.npdm");   /* build/dump/update/{elf,exefs} */
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "rb");
    unsigned char h[0x20];
    if (!f || fread(h, 1, sizeof h, f) != sizeof h || memcmp(h, "META", 4)) {
        fprintf(stderr, "missing input: %s (the program's meta data: main thread stack size)\n", path); exit(7);
    }
    fclose(f);
    uint32_t size; memcpy(&size, h + 0x1c, 4);
    printf("main.npdm: main thread stack 0x%x bytes, priority %u, default core %u\n", size, h[0xe], h[0xf]);
    return ((size_t)size + 0xfff) & ~(size_t)0xfff;
}

/* how much of the main guest stack was ever written (pages are zero until used) */
void main_stack_report(void) {
    extern uint64_t g_main_stack_base, g_main_stack_size;
    if (!g_main_stack_base) return;
    const uint64_t *p = (const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)g_main_stack_base, *e = p + g_main_stack_size / 8;
    while (p < e && !*p) p++;
    MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION lo, hi;
    VirtualQuery((void *)(uintptr_t)(g_main_stack_base - 0x1000), &lo, sizeof lo);
    VirtualQuery((void *)(uintptr_t)(g_main_stack_base + g_main_stack_size), &hi, sizeof hi);
    printf("main guest stack: 0x%llx bytes at %llx, deepest use 0x%llx bytes (%.1f%%); page below: %s, page above: %s\n",
           (unsigned long long)g_main_stack_size, (unsigned long long)g_main_stack_base,
           (unsigned long long)((const uint8_t *)e - (const uint8_t *)p), 100.0 * (double)((const uint8_t *)e - (const uint8_t *)p) / (double)g_main_stack_size,
           lo.State == MEM_RESERVE ? "no access" : "ACCESSIBLE", hi.State == MEM_RESERVE ? "no access" : "ACCESSIBLE");
}

static DWORD WINAPI guest_main(LPVOID arg) {
    (void)arg;
    static Ctx c;
    /* the main thread's stack has the size the program's own meta data asks for (main.npdm, META header +0x1c:
     * 0x100000 for this game; read from the file next to the ELF), with no-access pages below and above it, so that an
     * overflow faults as it does on the console instead of running on. Guest frames are the original's (the lifted code
     * moves the guest SP exactly as the ARM code does); the host's own frames live on the host stack and are not
     * guest-visible. SMO_MAIN_STACK=<bytes> overrides (diagnosis only). */
    size_t stack_size = main_stack_size_from_npdm();
    uint8_t *stack_res = VirtualAlloc(NULL, stack_size + 0x20000, MEM_RESERVE, PAGE_NOACCESS);
    uint8_t *stack = stack_res ? VirtualAlloc(stack_res + 0x10000, stack_size, MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE) : NULL;
    if (!stack) { fprintf(stderr, "cannot allocate the main thread's stack (0x%llx bytes)\n", (unsigned long long)stack_size); exit(1); }
    uint8_t *tls = VirtualAlloc(NULL, 0x10000, MEM_RESERVE | MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE);
    c.x[31] = (uint64_t)(stack + stack_size);          /* the initial SP is the top of the stack (16-byte aligned: the size is whole pages) */
    c.tpidr = (uint64_t)tls;
    { uint64_t os_main_thread_type(void); memcpy(tls + 0x1f8, &(uint64_t){os_main_thread_type()}, 8); }   /* [sdk 0x3349dc..e0] nn::os::detail::ThreadManager(): the main thread's ThreadType pointer */
    g_main_ctx = &c;
    { void os_apply_main_sched(void); os_apply_main_sched(); }                  /* os_threads.c: SMO_OS_CONSOLE_CORES=1 */
    { void smo_fast_install(void); smo_fast_install(); }                        /* smo_fast.c: host versions of hot game code (before the game runs) */
    { void hitch_set_main(Ctx *c); hitch_set_main(&c); }      /* hitch.c: SMO_HITCH */
    g_main_stack_base = (uint64_t)stack;
    g_main_stack_size = stack_size;

    { void sdk_run_ctors(Ctx *c); sdk_run_ctors(&c); }       /* selected SDK static constructors (sdklift_rt.c) */
    printf("\n[phase 1] nninitStartup\n");
    trace_printf("=== phase 1: nninitStartup\n");
    call_guest(&c, NNINIT_STARTUP);

    int count = (int)(INIT_ARRAY_SIZE / 8);
    printf("[phase 2] %d static constructors\n", count);
    trace_printf("=== phase 2: static constructors\n");
    for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        uint64_t fn = rd64(INIT_ARRAY + (uint64_t)i * 8);
        if (!fn) continue;
        trace_printf("--- constructor %d at %llx\n", i, (unsigned long long)fn);
        call_guest(&c, fn);
    }

    printf("[phase 3] nnMain\n");
    trace_printf("=== phase 3: nnMain\n");
    call_guest(&c, NN_MAIN);

    printf("\nnnMain returned.\n");
    print_import_summary(stdout);
    return 0;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    g_elf = argc > 1 ? argv[1] : GAME_ELF_DEFAULT;   /* the target's main.elf from the exe's folder (image.h) */
    setvbuf(stdout, NULL, _IONBF, 0);
    {   /* pad tools and their self-test (nnpad_sdl.c): no game is started */
        int nnhid_pad_selftest(void), nnpad_tool(int, char **);
        int tool;
        if (getenv("SMO_PAD_SELFTEST")) return nnhid_pad_selftest() != 0;
        if ((tool = nnpad_tool(argc, argv)) >= 0) return tool;
    }
    /* data symbols the game imports from the SDK module get their real values (build/gen/sdkdata.c, written by gen_tables.py) */
    for (int i = 0; i < sdk_data_count; i++) {
        void *copy = _aligned_malloc(sdk_data[i].size, 16);
        memcpy(copy, sdk_data[i].bytes, sdk_data[i].size);
        import_set_address(sdk_data[i].name, copy);
    }
    cxxrt_install_data();
    runtime_init(g_elf, getenv("SMO_TRACE") ? getenv("SMO_TRACE") : "boot_trace.txt");
    register_imports(base_imports, (int)(sizeof base_imports / sizeof base_imports[0]));
    register_sdk_imports();
    register_cxx_imports();
    register_thread_imports();               /* later registrations replace earlier ones */
    register_nvn_imports();
    register_fs_imports();
    register_clib_imports();                 /* full printf engine replaces the integer-only versions */
    register_time_imports();
    register_hid_imports();
    register_display_imports();
    register_pl_imports();
    register_fontll_imports();
    register_movie_imports();
    register_misc_imports();                 /* only fills names nobody else implements */
    register_audio_imports();
    register_movie_mf_imports();             /* replaces nnmovie.c's failing placeholder unless SMO_MOVIE=0 */
    register_iostream_imports();             /* libc++ stream base classes */
    register_cxxrt_imports();                /* C / C++ runtime: everything still without a handler (keep last) */
    register_unwind_imports();               /* installs the unwinder the C++ runtime calls on a throw */
    register_service_imports();                 /* SDK families (lifted sdk.elf code + offline service answers): fills only; after the C runtime because its self-test needs every handler */
    { void register_smo_imports(void); register_smo_imports(); }   /* smo_nn.c: SDK functions no other table handles */
    if (getenv("SMO_IMPORT_SELFTEST")) { int smo_import_selftest(void); return smo_import_selftest() != 0; }   /* smo_selftest.c */
    { void audit_startup(void); audit_startup(); }   /* hostrt.c: the check of do-nothing handlers (SMO_STRICT) */
    display_init();
    int seconds = argc > 2 ? atoi(argv[2]) : 0;      /* no number = no time limit (a player's launch); tests pass theirs */
    /* the lifted code uses the host stack for every guest call: give it plenty */
    HANDLE t = CreateThread(NULL, (SIZE_T)1 << 30, guest_main, NULL, STACK_SIZE_PARAM_IS_A_RESERVATION, NULL);
    if (getenv("SMO_PROF")) { g_prof_target = t; CloseHandle(CreateThread(NULL, 0, profiler, NULL, 0, NULL)); }
    DWORD wr = WaitForSingleObject(t, seconds > 0 ? (DWORD)seconds * 1000 : INFINITE);
    {   unsigned long long stage_list_started(void);     /* smo_nerve.c: SMO_STAGE_LIST (TEST ONLY): the limit counts from the start of the stage being played */
        for (unsigned long long s; wr == WAIT_TIMEOUT && (s = stage_list_started()) && s + (unsigned long long)seconds * 1000 > GetTickCount64(); )
            wr = WaitForSingleObject(t, (DWORD)(s + (unsigned long long)seconds * 1000 - GetTickCount64()));
    }
    {   unsigned nvn_gl_held_ms(void);                   /* nvn_gl.c: time the presents were held for shader preparation is not run time */
        for (unsigned done = 0, h; wr == WAIT_TIMEOUT && (h = nvn_gl_held_ms()) > done + 50; done = h) wr = WaitForSingleObject(t, h - done);
    }
    if (wr == WAIT_TIMEOUT) {
        printf("\nstill running after %d s with %d guest thread(s) started: stopping here.\n", seconds, guest_thread_count());
        trace_printf("=== stopped by the time limit after %d s\n", seconds);
        main_stack_report();
        if (g_main_ctx) {
            printf("main thread: last function f_%llx  lr=%llx  %s%s (from %llx)\n", (unsigned long long)g_main_ctx->fn,
                   (unsigned long long)g_main_ctx->x[30], g_main_ctx->in_import ? "in " : "",
                   g_main_ctx->in_import ? g_main_ctx->in_import : "guest code", (unsigned long long)g_main_ctx->import_from);
            for (int i = 19; i < 29; i++) printf("  x%d %016llx%s", i, (unsigned long long)g_main_ctx->x[i], i % 3 == 0 ? "\n" : "");
            printf("\n");
            /* where is the main host thread really? sample its instruction pointer and unwind */
            for (int s = 0; s < 3; s++) {
                Sleep(50);
                CONTEXT ctx;
                memset(&ctx, 0, sizeof ctx);
                ctx.ContextFlags = CONTEXT_FULL;
                SuspendThread(t);
                GetThreadContext(t, &ctx);
                printf("  host rip sample %d: rip=%p -> f_%llx |", s, (void *)ctx.Rip, (unsigned long long)guest_function_of(ctx.Rip));
                uint64_t last = 0;
                for (int depth = 0, shown = 0; depth < 200 && shown < 12; depth++) {
                    uint64_t g = guest_function_of(ctx.Rip);
                    if (g && g != last) { printf(" f_%llx", (unsigned long long)g); shown++; last = g; }
                    else if (!g && depth == 0) printf(" [host %p]", (void *)ctx.Rip);
                    DWORD64 base;
                    RUNTIME_FUNCTION *rf = RtlLookupFunctionEntry(ctx.Rip, &base, NULL);
                    if (!rf) break;
                    void *hd; DWORD64 est;
                    RtlVirtualUnwind(UNW_FLAG_NHANDLER, base, ctx.Rip, rf, &ctx, &hd, &est, NULL);
                    if (!ctx.Rip) break;
                }
                printf("\n");
                ResumeThread(t);
            }
            for (int s = 0; s < 8; s++) {            /* is it moving? sample a few times */
                Sleep(37);
                printf("  sample %d: f_%llx lr=%llx x0=%llx x1=%llx x8=%llx x9=%llx x11=%llx x12=%llx\n", s,
                       (unsigned long long)g_main_ctx->fn, (unsigned long long)g_main_ctx->x[30], (unsigned long long)g_main_ctx->x[0],
                       (unsigned long long)g_main_ctx->x[1], (unsigned long long)g_main_ctx->x[8], (unsigned long long)g_main_ctx->x[9],
                       (unsigned long long)g_main_ctx->x[11], (unsigned long long)g_main_ctx->x[12]);
            }
        }
        dump_guest_threads(stdout);
        icall_dump(stdout, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)g_main_ctx);
        if (getenv("SMO_CHAIN")) {
            /* SMO_CHAIN=<fn>:<off>,<off>,...[;<fn>:...] (hex): start from x0 of the first recorded indirect call to fn
             * (needs SMO_ICALLS), follow pointers at the given offsets, print 0x40 bytes at every step */
            char buf[1024];
            snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, "%s", getenv("SMO_CHAIN"));
            for (char *spec = strtok(buf, ";"); spec; spec = strtok(NULL, ";")) {
                char *colon = strchr(spec, ':');
                uint64_t p = icall_first_x0(strtoull(spec, NULL, 16));
                printf("[chain] %s: x0=%llx\n", spec, (unsigned long long)p);
                for (char *o = colon ? colon + 1 : NULL; p; o = o ? strchr(o, ',') : NULL) {
                    MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION mi;
                    if (!VirtualQuery((void *)(uintptr_t)p, &mi, sizeof mi) || mi.State != MEM_COMMIT) { printf("[chain]   %llx not mapped\n", (unsigned long long)p); break; }
                    printf("[chain]   %llx:", (unsigned long long)p);
                    for (int w = 0; w < 0x130; w += 8) printf("%s%016llx", w % 0x40 ? " " : "\n[chain]     ", (unsigned long long)rd64(p + w));
                    printf("\n");
                    if (!o) break;
                    if (*o == ',') o++;
                    uint64_t off = strtoull(o, NULL, 16);
                    p = rd64(p + off);
                    printf("[chain]   [+%llx] = %llx\n", (unsigned long long)off, (unsigned long long)p);
                }
            }
        }
        report_and_exit(0);
    }
    return 0;
}
```

`runtime/core/fpexact.h`:

```h
/* Bit-exact AArch64 behaviour for the few floating-point operations where
 * x86 differs: reciprocal estimates and the sign of generated NaNs.
 * The estimate algorithms follow the pseudocode in the Arm architecture manual. */
#ifndef RECOMP_FPEXACT_H
#define RECOMP_FPEXACT_H

/* x86 produces a negative quiet NaN for invalid operations, AArch64 a positive one. */
static inline float fnan32(float r) {
    uint32_t b;
    memcpy(&b, &r, 4);
    if (b == 0xffc00000u) { b = 0x7fc00000u; memcpy(&r, &b, 4); }
    return r;
}
static inline double fnan64(double r) {
    uint64_t b;
    memcpy(&b, &r, 8);
    if (b == 0xfff8000000000000ull) { b = 0x7ff8000000000000ull; memcpy(&r, &b, 8); }
    return r;
}

static inline uint32_t recip_estimate(uint32_t a) {            /* a in 256..511 */
    a = a * 2 + 1;
    uint32_t b = (1u << 19) / a;
    return (b + 1) / 2;
}
static inline uint32_t recip_sqrt_estimate(uint32_t a) {       /* a in 128..511 */
    if (a < 256) a = a * 2 + 1;
    else { a = (a >> 1) << 1; a = (a + 1) * 2; }
    uint32_t b = 512;
    while ((uint64_t)a * (b + 1) * (b + 1) < (1ull << 28)) b++;
    return (b + 1) / 2;
}

/* Generic implementations on (sign, biased exponent, fraction left-aligned to 52 bits). */
static inline uint64_t fp_recpe_bits(uint64_t bits, int dbl) {
    int ebits = dbl ? 11 : 8, fbits = dbl ? 52 : 23;
    uint64_t sign = bits >> (ebits + fbits);
    int64_t exp = (int64_t)((bits >> fbits) & ((1u << ebits) - 1));
    uint64_t frac = bits & ((1ull << fbits) - 1);
    int64_t emax = (1 << ebits) - 1;
    uint64_t signbit = sign << (ebits + fbits);
    if (exp == emax) {
        if (frac) return bits | (1ull << (fbits - 1));          /* NaN: quieten */
        return signbit;                                         /* infinity -> zero */
    }
    if (exp == 0 && frac == 0) return signbit | ((uint64_t)emax << fbits);       /* zero -> infinity */
    if (exp == 0 && frac < (1ull << (fbits - 2))) return signbit | ((uint64_t)emax << fbits);  /* overflow */
    uint64_t f52 = frac << (52 - fbits);
    if (exp == 0) {
        if ((f52 >> 51) == 0) { exp = -1; f52 = (f52 << 2) & ((1ull << 52) - 1); }
        else f52 = (f52 << 1) & ((1ull << 52) - 1);
    }
    uint32_t scaled = 0x100 | (uint32_t)(f52 >> 44);
    int64_t rexp = (dbl ? 2045 : 253) - exp;
    uint64_t rf = (uint64_t)(recip_estimate(scaled) & 0xff) << 44;
    if (rexp == 0) rf = (1ull << 51) | (rf >> 1);
    else if (rexp == -1) { rf = (1ull << 50) | (rf >> 2); rexp = 0; }
    return signbit | ((uint64_t)rexp << fbits) | (rf >> (52 - fbits));
}
static inline uint64_t fp_rsqrte_bits(uint64_t bits, int dbl) {
    int ebits = dbl ? 11 : 8, fbits = dbl ? 52 : 23;
    uint64_t sign = bits >> (ebits + fbits);
    int64_t exp = (int64_t)((bits >> fbits) & ((1u << ebits) - 1));
    uint64_t frac = bits & ((1ull << fbits) - 1);
    int64_t emax = (1 << ebits) - 1;
    uint64_t default_nan = ((uint64_t)emax << fbits) | (1ull << (fbits - 1));
    if (exp == emax && frac) return bits | (1ull << (fbits - 1));                 /* NaN: quieten */
    if (exp == 0 && frac == 0) return (sign << (ebits + fbits)) | ((uint64_t)emax << fbits);  /* zero -> infinity */
    if (sign) return default_nan;                                                 /* negative -> NaN */
    if (exp == emax) return 0;                                                    /* +infinity -> +0 */
    uint64_t f52 = frac << (52 - fbits);
    if (exp == 0) {
        while ((f52 >> 51) == 0) { f52 = (f52 << 1) & ((1ull << 52) - 1); exp--; }
        f52 = (f52 << 1) & ((1ull << 52) - 1);
    }
    uint32_t scaled = (exp & 1) == 0 ? 0x100 | (uint32_t)(f52 >> 44) : 0x80 | (uint32_t)(f52 >> 45);
    int64_t rexp = ((dbl ? 3068 : 380) - exp) / 2;
    uint64_t est = recip_sqrt_estimate(scaled) & 0xff;
    return ((uint64_t)rexp << fbits) | (est << (fbits - 8));
}

static inline float recpe_f(float x) { uint32_t b; memcpy(&b, &x, 4); b = (uint32_t)fp_recpe_bits(b, 0); memcpy(&x, &b, 4); return x; }
static inline double recpe_d(double x) { uint64_t b; memcpy(&b, &x, 8); b = fp_recpe_bits(b, 1); memcpy(&x, &b, 8); return x; }
static inline float rsqrte_f(float x) { uint32_t b; memcpy(&b, &x, 4); b = (uint32_t)fp_rsqrte_bits(b, 0); memcpy(&x, &b, 4); return x; }
static inline double rsqrte_d(double x) { uint64_t b; memcpy(&b, &x, 8); b = fp_rsqrte_bits(b, 1); memcpy(&x, &b, 8); return x; }

/* FCVT between half precision (IEEE binary16, FPCR.AHP = 0) and single / double: FPConvert of the Arm manual with
 * round-to-nearest-even and FPCR.DN = 0. A NaN keeps its sign and the top bits of its payload and becomes quiet
 * (FPConvertNaN). Done on the bit patterns, so there is one rounding and no dependence on the host's conversions. */
static inline uint16_t fp_to_half_bits(uint64_t bits, int dbl) {
    int ebits = dbl ? 11 : 8, fbits = dbl ? 52 : 23;
    uint16_t sign = (uint16_t)(((bits >> (ebits + fbits)) & 1) << 15);
    int64_t exp = (int64_t)((bits >> fbits) & ((1u << ebits) - 1));
    uint64_t frac = bits & ((1ull << fbits) - 1);
    int64_t emax = (1 << ebits) - 1, bias = emax >> 1;
    if (exp == emax) {
        if (frac) return (uint16_t)(sign | 0x7e00 | ((frac >> (fbits - 10)) & 0x1ff));   /* NaN: quiet, payload bits below the quiet bit */
        return (uint16_t)(sign | 0x7c00);                                                 /* infinity */
    }
    if (exp == 0 && frac == 0) return sign;
    uint64_t m;                                    /* value = m * 2^(e - fbits), bit fbits of m set */
    int64_t e;
    if (exp) { m = frac | (1ull << fbits); e = exp - bias; }
    else { m = frac; e = 1 - bias; while (!(m >> fbits)) { m <<= 1; e--; } }
    if (e > 15) return (uint16_t)(sign | 0x7c00);                                         /* overflow: infinity (round to nearest) */
    int64_t sh = fbits - 10 + (e < -14 ? -14 - e : 0);                                    /* below 2^-14 the result is subnormal */
    if (sh > fbits + 1) return sign;                                                      /* less than half the smallest subnormal */
    uint64_t q = m >> sh, rem = m & ((1ull << sh) - 1), half = 1ull << (sh - 1);
    if (rem > half || (rem == half && (q & 1))) q++;
    uint32_t r = e < -14 ? (uint32_t)q : (uint32_t)(((uint64_t)(e + 15) << 10) + (q - 0x400));   /* a carry out of the fraction moves into the exponent */
    if (r >= 0x7c00) r = 0x7c00;
    return (uint16_t)(sign | r);
}
static inline uint64_t fp_from_half_bits(uint16_t h, int dbl) {
    int ebits = dbl ? 11 : 8, fbits = dbl ? 52 : 23;
    uint64_t sign = (uint64_t)(h >> 15) << (ebits + fbits), frac = h & 0x3ff, emax = (1u << ebits) - 1;
    int64_t exp = (h >> 10) & 31, bias = (int64_t)(emax >> 1), e;
    if (exp == 31) {
        if (frac) return sign | (emax << fbits) | (1ull << (fbits - 1)) | ((frac & 0x1ff) << (fbits - 10));
        return sign | (emax << fbits);
    }
    if (exp == 0) {
        if (!frac) return sign;
        e = -14;
        while (!(frac & 0x400)) { frac <<= 1; e--; }
        frac &= 0x3ff;
    } else e = exp - 15;
    return sign | ((uint64_t)(e + bias) << fbits) | (frac << (fbits - 10));
}
static inline uint16_t f32_to_half(float x) { uint32_t b; memcpy(&b, &x, 4); return fp_to_half_bits(b, 0); }
static inline uint16_t f64_to_half(double x) { uint64_t b; memcpy(&b, &x, 8); return fp_to_half_bits(b, 1); }
static inline float half_to_f32(uint16_t h) { uint32_t b = (uint32_t)fp_from_half_bits(h, 0); float x; memcpy(&x, &b, 4); return x; }
static inline double half_to_f64(uint16_t h) { uint64_t b = fp_from_half_bits(h, 1); double x; memcpy(&x, &b, 8); return x; }

/* FMAX / FMIN / FMAXNM / FMINNM (FPMax, FPMin, FPMaxNum, FPMinNum of the Arm manual, FPCR.DN = 0), on bit patterns.
 * A signalling NaN operand wins (first operand first) and is returned quiet; then a quiet NaN (first operand first),
 * except that the NM forms return the other operand when exactly one operand is a quiet NaN and none is signalling.
 * +0 is greater than -0. The C library's fmax / fmin do neither. */
static inline uint32_t fp_maxmin32_bits(uint32_t a, uint32_t b, int is_min, int num) {
    int na = (a & 0x7fffffffu) > 0x7f800000u, nb = (b & 0x7fffffffu) > 0x7f800000u;
    if (na | nb) {
        int sa = na && !(a & 0x00400000u), sb = nb && !(b & 0x00400000u);
        if (num && !sa && !sb && na != nb) return na ? b : a;
        return (sa ? a : sb ? b : na ? a : b) | 0x00400000u;
    }
    if (((a | b) & 0x7fffffffu) == 0) return is_min ? (a | b) : (a & b);
    float fa, fb;
    memcpy(&fa, &a, 4); memcpy(&fb, &b, 4);
    return (is_min ? fa < fb : fa > fb) ? a : b;
}
static inline uint64_t fp_maxmin64_bits(uint64_t a, uint64_t b, int is_min, int num) {
    int na = (a & 0x7fffffffffffffffull) > 0x7ff0000000000000ull, nb = (b & 0x7fffffffffffffffull) > 0x7ff0000000000000ull;
    if (na | nb) {
        int sa = na && !(a & 0x0008000000000000ull), sb = nb && !(b & 0x0008000000000000ull);
        if (num && !sa && !sb && na != nb) return na ? b : a;
        return (sa ? a : sb ? b : na ? a : b) | 0x0008000000000000ull;
    }
    if (((a | b) & 0x7fffffffffffffffull) == 0) return is_min ? (a | b) : (a & b);
    double fa, fb;
    memcpy(&fa, &a, 8); memcpy(&fb, &b, 8);
    return (is_min ? fa < fb : fa > fb) ? a : b;
}
static inline float fp_maxmin32(float x, float y, int is_min, int num) {
    uint32_t a, b;
    memcpy(&a, &x, 4); memcpy(&b, &y, 4);
    a = fp_maxmin32_bits(a, b, is_min, num);
    memcpy(&x, &a, 4);
    return x;
}
static inline double fp_maxmin64(double x, double y, int is_min, int num) {
    uint64_t a, b;
    memcpy(&a, &x, 8); memcpy(&b, &y, 8);
    a = fp_maxmin64_bits(a, b, is_min, num);
    memcpy(&x, &a, 8);
    return x;
}

#endif
```

`runtime/core/game_shim.c`:

```c
/* Linked into smo_game.dll together with the lifted game code (obj\*.obj).
 *
 * The lifted code is 700+ MB of objects that change only when the lifter changes; keeping it in a
 * DLL means the host runtime (the part edited all day) links in a second or two. The DLL cannot
 * import from the exe, so the six host functions the lifted code calls are forwarded through
 * pointers the exe hands over once at start-up (gamedll.c). */
#include "runtime.h"

typedef struct {
    void (*call_indirect)(Ctx *, uint64_t);
    void (*host_import)(Ctx *, int);
    void (*guest_trap)(const char *, uint64_t);
    void (*guest_unimpl)(uint64_t, uint32_t, const char *);
    void (*guest_svc)(Ctx *, uint32_t);
    void (*stx_diag)(Ctx *, uint64_t, uint64_t, uint64_t, uint64_t, int);
} GameHost;

typedef struct {
    const FnEntry *fn_table;
    const int *fn_table_count;
    const DynSym *dyn_syms;
    const int *dyn_sym_count;
} GameTables;

static GameHost host;

void call_indirect(Ctx *c, uint64_t addr) { host.call_indirect(c, addr); }
void host_import(Ctx *c, int sym) { host.host_import(c, sym); }
void guest_trap(const char *what, uint64_t addr) { host.guest_trap(what, addr); }
void guest_unimpl(uint64_t pc, uint32_t insn, const char *what) { host.guest_unimpl(pc, insn, what); }
void guest_svc(Ctx *c, uint32_t number) { host.guest_svc(c, number); }
void stx_diag(Ctx *c, uint64_t a, uint64_t expected, uint64_t seen, uint64_t v, int bits) { host.stx_diag(c, a, expected, seen, v, bits); }

__declspec(dllexport) void game_bind(const GameHost *h, GameTables *t) {
    host = *h;
    t->fn_table = fn_table;
    t->fn_table_count = &fn_table_count;
    t->dyn_syms = dyn_syms;
    t->dyn_sym_count = &dyn_sym_count;
}
```

`runtime/core/gamedll.c`:

```c
/* Host side of the exe / smo_game.dll split (see game_shim.c).
 *
 * build_exe.py compiles every host file with
 *     -Dfn_table=(*game_fn_table_p) -Dfn_table_count=(*game_fn_table_count_p)
 *     -Ddyn_syms=(*game_dyn_syms_p) -Ddyn_sym_count=(*game_dyn_sym_count_p)
 * so the tables declared in runtime.h become pointers into the DLL, filled in here before main(). */
#include "runtime.h"

typedef struct {
    void (*call_indirect)(Ctx *, uint64_t);
    void (*host_import)(Ctx *, int);
    void (*guest_trap)(const char *, uint64_t);
    void (*guest_unimpl)(uint64_t, uint32_t, const char *);
    void (*guest_svc)(Ctx *, uint32_t);
    void (*stx_diag)(Ctx *, uint64_t, uint64_t, uint64_t, uint64_t, int);
} GameHost;

typedef struct {
    const FnEntry *table;
    const int *table_count;
    const DynSym *syms;
    const int *sym_count;
} GameTables;

__declspec(dllimport) void game_bind(const GameHost *h, GameTables *t);

#undef fn_table
#undef fn_table_count
#undef dyn_syms
#undef dyn_sym_count
const FnEntry (*game_fn_table_p)[];
const int *game_fn_table_count_p;
const DynSym (*game_dyn_syms_p)[];
const int *game_dyn_sym_count_p;

__attribute__((constructor)) static void bind_game(void) {
    GameHost h = {call_indirect, host_import, guest_trap, guest_unimpl, guest_svc, stx_diag};
    GameTables t;
    game_bind(&h, &t);
    game_fn_table_p = (const FnEntry (*)[])t.table;
    game_fn_table_count_p = t.table_count;
    game_dyn_syms_p = (const DynSym (*)[])t.syms;
    game_dyn_sym_count_p = t.sym_count;
}
```
