```h
/* Guest CPU state and the helpers shared by the lifted game code (recomp.py's output) and the host runtime. */
#ifndef RECOMP_RUNTIME_H
#define RECOMP_RUNTIME_H

#include <stdint.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <math.h>

typedef union {
    uint8_t b[16];
    uint16_t h[8];
    uint32_t w[4];
    uint64_t d[2];
    float f[4];
    double df[2];
} V128;

typedef struct {
    uint64_t x[32];          /* x[31] is SP */
    V128 v[32];
    uint32_t N, Z, C, V;
    uint64_t tpidr;
    uint64_t ex_addr, ex_val;    /* exclusive monitor: address and value seen by the last LDXR */
    uint64_t ex_fail;            /* consecutive failed STXR, for diagnostics */
    uint64_t fn;                 /* entry address of the lifted function entered most recently */
    const char *in_import;       /* name of the host import currently executing on this context, or NULL */
    uint64_t import_from;        /* guest return address of that import call */
} Ctx;

void call_indirect(Ctx *c, uint64_t addr);
void host_import(Ctx *c, int sym);          /* call to a symbol another module provides */
typedef struct { uint64_t addr; void (*fn)(Ctx *); } FnEntry;
typedef struct { const char *name; uint64_t value; int defined; } DynSym;
extern const FnEntry fn_table[];
extern const int fn_table_count;
extern const DynSym dyn_syms[];
extern const int dyn_sym_count;
void guest_trap(const char *what, uint64_t addr);
void guest_unimpl(uint64_t pc, uint32_t insn, const char *what);
void guest_svc(Ctx *c, uint32_t number);

/* Guest memory is mapped at its real address: a guest pointer is a host pointer. */
#define DEF_MEM(bits) \
    static inline uint##bits##_t rd##bits(uint64_t a) { uint##bits##_t v; memcpy(&v, (void *)(uintptr_t)a, sizeof v); return v; } \
    static inline void wr##bits(uint64_t a, uint##bits##_t v) { memcpy((void *)(uintptr_t)a, &v, sizeof v); }
DEF_MEM(8) DEF_MEM(16) DEF_MEM(32) DEF_MEM(64)

/* STXR: store only if the location still holds the value the matching LDXR read. Returns 0 on success. */
void stx_diag(Ctx *c, uint64_t a, uint64_t expected, uint64_t seen, uint64_t v, int bits);
#define DEF_STX(bits) \
    static inline uint32_t stx##bits(Ctx *c, uint64_t a, uint##bits##_t v) { \
        if (c->ex_addr != a) { stx_diag(c, a, 0, 0, v, -bits); return 1; } \
        c->ex_addr = ~0ull; \
        if (__sync_bool_compare_and_swap((uint##bits##_t *)(uintptr_t)a, (uint##bits##_t)c->ex_val, v)) { c->ex_fail = 0; return 0; } \
        uint##bits##_t seen; memcpy(&seen, (void *)(uintptr_t)a, sizeof seen); \
        stx_diag(c, a, c->ex_val, seen, v, bits); \
        return 1; \
    }
DEF_STX(8) DEF_STX(16) DEF_STX(32) DEF_STX(64)

static inline V128 rdv(uint64_t a, int n) { V128 v; v.d[0] = 0; v.d[1] = 0; memcpy(&v, (void *)(uintptr_t)a, (size_t)n); return v; }
static inline void wrv(uint64_t a, const V128 *v, int n) { memcpy((void *)(uintptr_t)a, v, (size_t)n); }
static inline void vzero(V128 *v) { v->d[0] = 0; v->d[1] = 0; }

static inline uint64_t adds64(Ctx *c, uint64_t a, uint64_t b, uint32_t cin) {
    uint64_t r = a + b + cin;
    c->N = (uint32_t)(r >> 63);
    c->Z = r == 0;
    c->C = (r < a) || (cin && r == a);
    c->V = (uint32_t)(((a ^ r) & (b ^ r)) >> 63);
    return r;
}
static inline uint32_t adds32(Ctx *c, uint32_t a, uint32_t b, uint32_t cin) {
    uint64_t wide = (uint64_t)a + b + cin;
    uint32_t r = (uint32_t)wide;
    c->N = r >> 31;
    c->Z = r == 0;
    c->C = (uint32_t)(wide >> 32);
    c->V = ((a ^ r) & (b ^ r)) >> 31;
    return r;
}
static inline uint64_t logic64(Ctx *c, uint64_t r) { c->N = (uint32_t)(r >> 63); c->Z = r == 0; c->C = 0; c->V = 0; return r; }
static inline uint32_t logic32(Ctx *c, uint32_t r) { c->N = r >> 31; c->Z = r == 0; c->C = 0; c->V = 0; return r; }
static inline void set_nzcv(Ctx *c, int f) { c->N = (f >> 3) & 1; c->Z = (f >> 2) & 1; c->C = (f >> 1) & 1; c->V = f & 1; }

static inline int cond(const Ctx *c, int cc) {
    int r;
    switch (cc >> 1) {
    case 0: r = c->Z; break;
    case 1: r = c->C; break;
    case 2: r = c->N; break;
    case 3: r = c->V; break;
    case 4: r = c->C && !c->Z; break;
    case 5: r = c->N == c->V; break;
    case 6: r = c->N == c->V && !c->Z; break;
    default: return 1;
    }
    return (cc & 1) ? !r : r;
}

static inline void fcmp(Ctx *c, double a, double b) {
    if (a != a || b != b) set_nzcv(c, 3);
    else if (a == b) set_nzcv(c, 6);
    else if (a < b) set_nzcv(c, 8);
    else set_nzcv(c, 2);
}

static inline uint32_t ror32(uint32_t v, unsigned n) { n &= 31; return n ? (v >> n) | (v << (32 - n)) : v; }
static inline uint64_t ror64(uint64_t v, unsigned n) { n &= 63; return n ? (v >> n) | (v << (64 - n)) : v; }
static inline uint32_t bswap32(uint32_t v) { return __builtin_bswap32(v); }
static inline uint64_t bswap64(uint64_t v) { return __builtin_bswap64(v); }
static inline uint64_t rev32_64(uint64_t v) { return ((uint64_t)bswap32((uint32_t)(v >> 32)) << 32) | bswap32((uint32_t)v); }
static inline uint32_t rev16_32(uint32_t v) { return ((v & 0xff00ff00u) >> 8) | ((v & 0x00ff00ffu) << 8); }
static inline uint64_t rev16_64(uint64_t v) { return ((v & 0xff00ff00ff00ff00ull) >> 8) | ((v & 0x00ff00ff00ff00ffull) << 8); }
static inline uint32_t clz32(uint32_t v) { return v ? (uint32_t)__builtin_clz(v) : 32; }
static inline uint64_t clz64(uint64_t v) { return v ? (uint64_t)__builtin_clzll(v) : 64; }
static inline uint32_t cls32(uint32_t v) { return clz32(((v >> 1) ^ v) & 0x7fffffffu) - 1; }
static inline uint64_t cls64(uint64_t v) { return clz64(((v >> 1) ^ v) & 0x7fffffffffffffffull) - 1; }
static inline uint32_t rbit32(uint32_t v) { uint32_t r = 0; for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) r |= ((v >> i) & 1u) << (31 - i); return r; }
static inline uint64_t rbit64(uint64_t v) { uint64_t r = 0; for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++) r |= ((v >> i) & 1ull) << (63 - i); return r; }
static inline uint64_t umulh(uint64_t a, uint64_t b) { return (uint64_t)(((unsigned __int128)a * b) >> 64); }
static inline uint64_t smulh(uint64_t a, uint64_t b) { return (uint64_t)(((__int128)(int64_t)a * (int64_t)b) >> 64); }
static inline uint32_t sdiv32(uint32_t a, uint32_t b) {
    if (b == 0) return 0;
    if (a == 0x80000000u && b == 0xffffffffu) return a;
    return (uint32_t)((int32_t)a / (int32_t)b);
}
static inline uint64_t sdiv64(uint64_t a, uint64_t b) {
    if (b == 0) return 0;
    if (a == 0x8000000000000000ull && b == ~0ull) return a;
    return (uint64_t)((int64_t)a / (int64_t)b);
}

/* float -> integer with AArch64 saturation semantics */
static inline uint32_t f2s32(double v) { if (v != v) return 0; if (v >= 2147483647.0) return 0x7fffffffu; if (v <= -2147483648.0) return 0x80000000u; return (uint32_t)(int32_t)v; }
static inline uint32_t f2u32(double v) { if (v != v || v <= 0) return 0; if (v >= 4294967295.0) return 0xffffffffu; return (uint32_t)v; }
static inline uint64_t f2s64(double v) { if (v != v) return 0; if (v >= 9223372036854775807.0) return 0x7fffffffffffffffull; if (v <= -9223372036854775808.0) return 0x8000000000000000ull; return (uint64_t)(int64_t)v; }
static inline uint64_t f2u64(double v) { if (v != v || v <= 0) return 0; if (v >= 18446744073709551615.0) return ~0ull; return (uint64_t)v; }

#include "fpexact.h"
#include "neon.h"

#endif

```

`runtime/core/sdklift.h`:

```h
/* Code of the game's SDK module (sdk.elf) lifted to C by sdklift.py, and the image it runs on.
 * See sdklift.py for how calls out of the lifted code are bound, sdklift_rt.c for the loader. */
#ifndef SDKLIFT_H
#define SDKLIFT_H

#include <setjmp.h>
#include "runtime.h"
#include "hostrt.h"

#define SDK_BASE 0x7500000000ULL          /* where the SDK image is mapped (text, rodata, data, bss) */
#define SDK_IMAGE_SIZE SDK_IMAGE_SIZE_GEN     /* build/gen/image.h */

typedef struct { uint64_t addr; void (*fn)(Ctx *); const char *name; } SdkFn;
extern const SdkFn sdk_fns[];             /* sorted by address */
extern const int sdk_fn_count;
extern const char *const sdk_host_names[];
extern const int sdk_host_name_count;
extern const uint64_t sdk_ctors[];        /* SDK static constructors to run before the game starts */
extern const int sdk_ctor_count;
void sdk_run_ctors(Ctx *c);               /* runs them (boot.c, before nninitStartup) */

int sdk_image_ready(void);                /* 1 once sdk.elf is mapped and relocated */
ImportFn sdk_lifted(const char *name);    /* lifted function of that symbol, NULL if it was not lifted */
uint64_t sdk_symbol(const char *name);    /* mapped address of an SDK symbol (function or data), 0 if unknown */
void sdk_host_call(Ctx *c, int index);    /* lifted code -> host handler sdk_host_names[index] */
void sdk_trap_call(Ctx *c, const char *name);
void sdk_dispatch(Ctx *c, uint64_t addr); /* indirect call made by lifted SDK code */
void sdk_host_override(const char *name, ImportFn fn);   /* host handler for a cut SDK-internal callee */
int sdk_install(const char *name);        /* make the lifted code the handler of this import (replaces); 0 if not lifted */
int sdk_missing_host_callees(FILE *out);  /* host callees of lifted code that have no handler (self-test) */
void register_sdklift_imports(void);      /* maps the image; every lifted root that is a handler-less import gets its lifted code */

/* setjmp / longjmp inside lifted SDK code (libjpeg's error exit). The lifted function that contains the
 * `bl setjmp` is an ordinary host function that stays on the host stack until the guest function returns,
 * so the host's own setjmp can be used in place: the macro is expanded inside that function. The guest
 * callee-saved registers and sp are saved next to the host buffer and restored when a longjmp lands. */
typedef struct {
    jmp_buf host;
    uint64_t key;                         /* address of the guest jmp_buf */
    uint64_t x[13];                       /* x19..x30, sp */
    uint64_t d[8];                        /* d8..d15 */
    int value;
    unsigned long long stamp;
} SdkJmpRec;
SdkJmpRec *sdk_jmp_record(Ctx *c);        /* x0 = guest jmp_buf */
void sdk_jmp_restore(Ctx *c, SdkJmpRec *r);
void sdk_longjmp(Ctx *c);                 /* x0 = guest jmp_buf, w1 = value; does not return */
#define SDK_SETJMP(c) do { SdkJmpRec *j_ = sdk_jmp_record(c); if (setjmp(j_->host)) sdk_jmp_restore((c), j_); else (c)->x[0] = 0; } while (0)

#endif

```

`runtime/core/sdklift_rt.c`:

```c
/* Loader and glue for the code lifted out of the real SDK module (sdklift_gen.c, made by sdklift.py).
 *
 * The SDK image (build\dump\update\elf\sdk.elf, converted from the dump by tools/extract) is mapped at
 * SDK_BASE with its three PT_LOAD segments and relocated like the game image, so the lifted functions
 * find the SDK's own tables and globals at the addresses their code computes. The SDK's static
 * constructors are NOT run and no SDK service session exists: only functions that are self-contained
 * (accessors, table getters, codecs, struct setters) are lifted; whatever needs a system service is
 * answered by hand in the nn*.c files.
 *
 * Relocations ([sdk] .rela.dyn 0x541010, .rela.plt 0x5ce118): R_AARCH64_RELATIVE (0x403),
 * GLOB_DAT (0x401), JUMP_SLOT (0x402), ABS64 (0x101). The 13 undefined symbols (malloc, free, calloc,
 * realloc, aligned_alloc, nnMain, ...) are left 0: lifted code never calls through the GOT, sdklift.py
 * binds PLT stubs statically (to lifted code or to the host handler of the same name). */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <windows.h>
#include "sdklift.h"

static int g_ready;
static uint8_t *g_file;                   /* sdk.elf as read from disk */
static size_t g_file_size;
static uint64_t g_symtab, g_strtab, g_nsym;
static ImportFn *g_host_fn;               /* per sdk_host_names entry */

int sdk_image_ready(void) { return g_ready; }

static void die(const char *fmt, ...) {
    va_list ap;
    va_start(ap, fmt);
    printf("\nsdklift: ");
    vprintf(fmt, ap);
    printf("\n");
    va_end(ap);
    report_and_exit(3);
}

static int load_image(void) {
    char path[1024];
    const char *env = getenv("SMO_SDK_ELF");
    const char *g_elf = __argc > 1 ? __argv[1] : NULL;       /* same argument boot.c uses for main.elf */
    if (env && env[0]) snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s", env);
    else {
        snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s", g_elf ? g_elf : GAME_ELF_DEFAULT);
        char *slash = strrchr(path, '\\'), *slash2 = strrchr(path, '/');
        if (slash2 > slash) slash = slash2;
        snprintf(slash ? slash + 1 : path, 16, "sdk.elf");
    }
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "rb");
    if (!f) { printf("sdklift: cannot open %s (set SMO_SDK_ELF): lifted SDK functions are unavailable\n", path); return 0; }
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);
    g_file_size = (size_t)ftell(f);
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);
    g_file = malloc(g_file_size);
    if (fread(g_file, 1, g_file_size, f) != g_file_size || memcmp(g_file, "\x7f" "ELF", 4)) { fclose(f); printf("sdklift: %s is not readable as an ELF\n", path); return 0; }
    fclose(f);
    uint8_t *img = VirtualAlloc((void *)(uintptr_t)SDK_BASE, SDK_IMAGE_SIZE, MEM_RESERVE | MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE);
    if (img != (uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)SDK_BASE) { printf("sdklift: cannot map the SDK image at %llx\n", (unsigned long long)SDK_BASE); return 0; }
    uint64_t phoff = *(uint64_t *)(g_file + 0x20);
    int phnum = *(uint16_t *)(g_file + 0x38);
    uint64_t dynoff = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < phnum; i++) {
        uint8_t *ph = g_file + phoff + (uint64_t)i * 56;
        uint32_t type = *(uint32_t *)ph;
        uint64_t off = *(uint64_t *)(ph + 8), va = *(uint64_t *)(ph + 16), filesz = *(uint64_t *)(ph + 32), memsz = *(uint64_t *)(ph + 40);
        if (type == 1) {
            if (va + memsz > SDK_IMAGE_SIZE || off + filesz > g_file_size) die("segment %d of sdk.elf does not fit", i);
            memcpy(img + va, g_file + off, filesz);
        } else if (type == 2) dynoff = va;
    }
    if (!dynoff) die("sdk.elf has no dynamic section");
    uint64_t rela = 0, relasz = 0, jmprel = 0, pltrelsz = 0, hash = 0;
    for (uint64_t *dp = (uint64_t *)(img + dynoff); dp[0]; dp += 2) {
        switch (dp[0]) {
        case 7: rela = dp[1]; break;
        case 8: relasz = dp[1]; break;
        case 23: jmprel = dp[1]; break;
        case 2: pltrelsz = dp[1]; break;
        case 6: g_symtab = dp[1]; break;
        case 5: g_strtab = dp[1]; break;
        case 4: hash = dp[1]; break;
        }
    }
    g_nsym = hash ? *(uint32_t *)(img + hash + 4) : 0;       /* DT_HASH nchain = number of symbols */
    if (!g_nsym) die("sdk.elf: no DT_HASH");
    uint64_t tables[2][2] = {{rela, relasz}, {jmprel, pltrelsz}};
    long counts[4] = {0, 0, 0, 0};
    for (int t = 0; t < 2; t++)
        for (uint64_t i = 0; i < tables[t][1] / 24; i++) {
            uint64_t *r = (uint64_t *)(img + tables[t][0] + i * 24);
            uint64_t off = r[0], info = r[1], addend = r[2];
            uint32_t type = (uint32_t)info, sym = (uint32_t)(info >> 32);
            if (off + 8 > SDK_IMAGE_SIZE) die("relocation outside the image");
            if (type == 0x403) { wr64(SDK_BASE + off, SDK_BASE + addend); counts[0]++; continue; }
            if (type != 0x401 && type != 0x402 && type != 0x101) die("unknown relocation type %x", type);
            uint8_t *s = img + g_symtab + (uint64_t)sym * 24;
            uint16_t shndx = *(uint16_t *)(s + 6);
            uint64_t value = *(uint64_t *)(s + 8);
            if (shndx) { wr64(SDK_BASE + off, SDK_BASE + value + (type == 0x101 ? addend : 0)); counts[1]++; }
            else { wr64(SDK_BASE + off, 0); counts[2]++; }
        }
    trace_printf("sdklift: SDK image mapped at %llx (%lu relative, %lu symbolic, %lu undefined relocations)\n",
                 (unsigned long long)SDK_BASE, counts[0], counts[1], counts[2]);
    return 1;
}

uint64_t sdk_symbol(const char *name) {
    if (!g_ready) return 0;
    uint8_t *img = (uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)SDK_BASE;
    for (uint64_t i = 0; i < g_nsym; i++) {
        uint8_t *s = img + g_symtab + i * 24;
        if (*(uint16_t *)(s + 6) && strcmp((const char *)img + g_strtab + *(uint32_t *)s, name) == 0) return SDK_BASE + *(uint64_t *)(s + 8);
    }
    return 0;
}

static const SdkFn *find_fn(uint64_t addr) {
    int lo = 0, hi = sdk_fn_count - 1;
    while (lo <= hi) {
        int mid = (lo + hi) / 2;
        if (sdk_fns[mid].addr == addr) return &sdk_fns[mid];
        if (sdk_fns[mid].addr < addr) lo = mid + 1; else hi = mid - 1;
    }
    return NULL;
}

ImportFn sdk_lifted(const char *name) {
    if (!g_ready) return NULL;
    uint64_t a = sdk_symbol(name);
    const SdkFn *f = a ? find_fn(a) : NULL;
    return f ? f->fn : NULL;
}

/* Name of the SDK symbol that contains `addr`, for diagnostics. */
static const char *sdk_name_of(uint64_t addr, uint64_t *offset) {
    uint8_t *img = (uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)SDK_BASE;
    const char *best = "?";
    uint64_t best_off = ~0ull;
    for (uint64_t i = 0; i < g_nsym; i++) {
        uint8_t *s = img + g_symtab + i * 24;
        uint64_t v = SDK_BASE + *(uint64_t *)(s + 8);
        if (*(uint16_t *)(s + 6) && v <= addr && addr - v < best_off) { best_off = addr - v; best = (const char *)img + g_strtab + *(uint32_t *)s; }
    }
    *offset = best_off;
    return best;
}

void sdk_dispatch(Ctx *c, uint64_t addr) {
    if (addr >= SDK_BASE && addr < SDK_BASE + SDK_IMAGE_SIZE) {
        const SdkFn *f = find_fn(addr);
        if (!f) {
            uint64_t off;
            const char *n = sdk_name_of(addr, &off);
            printf("\nsdklift: lifted SDK code (f_%llx) calls SDK address %llx (%s+0x%llx) through a pointer, and that function was not lifted.\n"
                   "Add `addr %llx` to sdklift_roots.txt and run `python sdklift.py gen`.\n",
                   (unsigned long long)c->fn, (unsigned long long)(addr - SDK_BASE), n, (unsigned long long)off, (unsigned long long)(addr - SDK_BASE));
            guest_trap("indirect call to an SDK function that was not lifted", addr);
        }
        f->fn(c);
        return;
    }
    call_indirect(c, addr);
}

/* Host handlers for SDK-internal callees that are cut (`cut <name>` in sdklift_roots.txt) and are not
 * imports of the game: a service call inside otherwise pure SDK code. */
static struct { const char *name; ImportFn fn; } g_override[256];
static int g_override_count;
void sdk_host_override(const char *name, ImportFn fn) {
    if (g_override_count >= 256) { printf("sdklift: too many host overrides (g_override)\n"); report_and_exit(3); }
    g_override[g_override_count].name = name; g_override[g_override_count].fn = fn; g_override_count++;
    for (int i = 0; g_host_fn && i < sdk_host_name_count; i++) if (strcmp(sdk_host_names[i], name) == 0) g_host_fn[i] = fn;
}

/* Address of a function the game itself defines (the SDK module imports malloc, free, calloc, realloc and
 * aligned_alloc from the application). */
static uint64_t game_symbol(const char *name) {
    for (int i = 0; i < dyn_sym_count; i++)
        if (dyn_syms[i].defined && strcmp(dyn_syms[i].name, name) == 0) return GUEST_BASE + dyn_syms[i].value;
    return 0;
}

void sdk_host_call(Ctx *c, int index) {
    ImportFn f = g_host_fn[index];
    if (!f) {
        const char *name = sdk_host_names[index];
        for (int i = 0; i < g_override_count && !f; i++) if (strcmp(g_override[i].name, name) == 0) f = g_override[i].fn;
        if (!f) f = import_lookup(name);
        if (!f) {                                           /* malloc & co: functions the GAME defines and the SDK imports */
            uint64_t g = game_symbol(name);
            if (g) { call_indirect(c, g); return; }
        }
        if (!f) {
            printf("\nsdklift: lifted SDK code (f_%llx) calls %s, which has no host handler.\n", (unsigned long long)c->fn, name);
            guest_trap("lifted SDK code called a function without a host handler", c->x[30] - 4);
        }
        g_host_fn[index] = f;
    }
    f(c);
}

/* the SDK static constructors sdklift.py selected (`ctors` rules), in .init_array order, on the main guest
 * thread before nninitStartup: where the console's loader runs the SDK module's constructors. */
void sdk_run_ctors(Ctx *c) {
    if (!sdk_image_ready()) { if (sdk_ctor_count) printf("sdklift: sdk.elf not mapped: %d SDK static constructor(s) NOT run\n", sdk_ctor_count); return; }
    for (int i = 0; i < sdk_ctor_count; i++) {
        uint64_t saved_lr = c->x[30];
        c->x[30] = 0;
        sdk_dispatch(c, sdk_ctors[i]);
        c->x[30] = saved_lr;
    }
    if (sdk_ctor_count) printf("sdklift: %d SDK static constructor(s) run\n", sdk_ctor_count);
}

void sdk_trap_call(Ctx *c, const char *name) {
    printf("\nsdklift: lifted SDK code (f_%llx, called from guest %llx) reached %s: an abort path or a cut service boundary.\n",
           (unsigned long long)c->fn, (unsigned long long)c->x[30] - 4, name);
    trace_printf("sdklift: lifted SDK code f_%llx reached %s\n", (unsigned long long)c->fn, name);
    guest_trap("lifted SDK code reached an abort path", c->x[30] - 4);
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- setjmp / longjmp (see sdklift.h) */
#define SDK_JMP_SLOTS 8
static __declspec(thread) SdkJmpRec *t_jmp;
static __declspec(thread) unsigned long long t_jmp_stamp;

SdkJmpRec *sdk_jmp_record(Ctx *c) {
    if (!t_jmp) t_jmp = _aligned_malloc(sizeof(SdkJmpRec) * SDK_JMP_SLOTS, 16), memset(t_jmp, 0, sizeof(SdkJmpRec) * SDK_JMP_SLOTS);
    uint64_t key = c->x[0];
    SdkJmpRec *r = NULL;
    for (int i = 0; i < SDK_JMP_SLOTS; i++) if (t_jmp[i].key == key) r = &t_jmp[i];
    if (!r) {                                               /* the least recently set record is the one to reuse */
        r = &t_jmp[0];
        for (int i = 1; i < SDK_JMP_SLOTS; i++) if (t_jmp[i].stamp < r->stamp) r = &t_jmp[i];
    }
    r->key = key;
    r->stamp = ++t_jmp_stamp;
    for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) r->x[i] = c->x[19 + i];
    r->x[12] = c->x[31];
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) r->d[i] = c->v[8 + i].d[0];
    return r;
}
void sdk_jmp_restore(Ctx *c, SdkJmpRec *r) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) c->x[19 + i] = r->x[i];
    c->x[31] = r->x[12];
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) { c->v[8 + i].d[0] = r->d[i]; c->v[8 + i].d[1] = 0; }
    c->x[0] = (uint64_t)(r->value ? r->value : 1);
}
void sdk_longjmp(Ctx *c) {
    SdkJmpRec *r = NULL;
    for (int i = 0; t_jmp && i < SDK_JMP_SLOTS; i++) if (t_jmp[i].key == c->x[0] && t_jmp[i].stamp) r = &t_jmp[i];
    if (!r) {
        printf("\nsdklift: longjmp to a jmp_buf (%llx) no lifted setjmp filled on this thread\n", (unsigned long long)c->x[0]);
        guest_trap("lifted SDK longjmp without setjmp", c->x[30] - 4);
    }
    r->value = (int)c->x[1];
    longjmp(r->host, 1);
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- registration
 * Every import of the game that still has no handler and whose SDK implementation was lifted gets the
 * lifted code as its handler (looked up by symbol, so aliases such as C1/C2 work). Handlers that
 * already exist are only replaced where an nn*.c file asks for it with sdk_install(). */
int sdk_install(const char *name) {
    ImportFn f = sdk_lifted(name);
    if (!f || !import_data(name)) return 0;
    ImportDef d = {name, f};
    register_imports(&d, 1);
    return 1;
}

int sdk_missing_host_callees(FILE *out) {
    int missing = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < sdk_host_name_count; i++) {
        int found = import_lookup(sdk_host_names[i]) != NULL || game_symbol(sdk_host_names[i]) != 0;
        for (int k = 0; k < g_override_count; k++) if (strcmp(g_override[k].name, sdk_host_names[i]) == 0) found = 1;
        if (!found) { if (out) fprintf(out, "  lifted SDK code needs a host handler for %s\n", sdk_host_names[i]); missing++; }
    }
    return missing;
}

void register_sdklift_imports(void) {
    g_host_fn = calloc((size_t)sdk_host_name_count + 1, sizeof *g_host_fn);
    g_ready = load_image();
    if (!g_ready) return;
    {   /* the SDK's .eh_frame_hdr (through its MOD0 header at +8) is given to the exception runtime, so a
         * throw that starts in lifted SDK code (libc++'s __throw_length_error ...) is walked through the SDK's frames with
         * their own CFI up to the game's frames. Clean-up pads of SDK frames have no resume entry: nnunwind.c skips them. */
        int eh_register_image(uint64_t base, uint64_t size, uint64_t eh_frame_hdr);
        if (!eh_register_image(SDK_BASE, SDK_IMAGE_SIZE, 0)) trace_printf("sdklift: the exception tables of the SDK image were not found\n");
    }
    int installed = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < dyn_sym_count; i++) {
        const char *name = dyn_syms[i].name;
        if (dyn_syms[i].defined || !name[0] || import_lookup(name)) continue;
        if (strncmp(name, "_ZN2nn", 6) && strncmp(name, "_ZNK2nn", 7) && strncmp(name, "nn", 2)) continue;
        installed += sdk_install(name);
    }
    trace_printf("sdklift: %d SDK functions lifted, %d installed as import handlers, %d host callees\n", sdk_fn_count, installed, sdk_host_name_count);
}

```

`runtime/fs/nnfs.c`:

```c
/* nn::fs on host directories, plus the minimal nn::account and nn::nifm
 * answers the game needs to start: one local user, no network.
 *
 * MOUNT TABLE. A path is "name:/dir/file"; the name must have been mounted, as in the SDK's own mount table
 * ([sdk 0x1f4960] MountTable::Find: an unknown name is fs NotMounted 0x35f202; mounting a name twice is
 * MountNameAlreadyExists 0x7802). Mount kinds and their host folders:
 *   MountRom           -> %SMO_ROMFS% or ..\romfs                  (the game's extracted romfs, update applied; read-only)
 *   MountSaveData      -> <userdata>\save                           (journaled, see below)
 *   MountCacheStorage  -> <userdata>\cache                          (journaled like save data)
 * <userdata> is %SMO_USERDATA% or ..\userdata (tests point SMO_USERDATA at a copy of the user's save).
 *
 * SAVE DATA JOURNAL. On the console, writes to save data are not permanent until nn::fs::Commit: they go to a journal,
 * Commit applies all of them together, and uncommitted writes are gone at the next mount. Here:
 *   - <userdata>\save is the COMMITTED state and is never written outside Commit.
 *   - Mounting creates the working folder <userdata>\save.work.<pid>. A file is copied into it the first time it is
 *     opened for writing (copy-on-write) or created there; deletions are recorded (tombstones); every read, existence
 *     test and directory listing sees the working folder over the committed one, minus the tombstones.
 *   - Commit ([sdk 0x1f4490] FileSystemAccessor::Commit: fails with 0x327202 while a file of the mount is open with the
 *     write mode) is two-phase: (1) the changed files are flushed and the list of changes is written to
 *     <userdata>\save.journal.<pid>, flushed, and renamed to <userdata>\save.commit -- from this rename on the commit
 *     is decided; (2) the changes are applied (files moved over the committed ones, deletions done) and the marker is
 *     removed. A process killed in phase 1 leaves the committed state untouched; one killed in phase 2 leaves the
 *     marker, and the next mount finishes the apply (roll forward) before anything is read.
 *   - Unmount, or a later mount by any process, discards the working folder of a process that no longer runs.
 * Not reproduced: the console's limit on the journal SIZE (a Commit is needed before the journal fills; the game's own
 * save code already commits within it). */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <windows.h>
#include "runtime.h"
#include "hostrt.h"

#define A0 (c->x[0])
#define A1 (c->x[1])
#define A2 (c->x[2])
#define A3 (c->x[3])
#define A4 (c->x[4])
#define RET(v) (c->x[0] = (uint64_t)(v))
#define STR(n) ((const char *)(uintptr_t)c->x[n])

/* nn::fs results (module 2), value = description << 9 | 2. Descriptions as published (switchbrew "Error codes",
 * the same numbers the suyu reference uses in file_sys/errors.h): 1 PathNotFound, 2 PathAlreadyExists,
 * 1002 TargetNotFound (no such save data), 3005 OutOfRange (read past the end of the file),
 * 6201 FileExtensionWithoutOpenModeAllowAppend (write past the end of a file opened without the append mode),
 * 6202 ReadNotPermitted, 6203 WriteNotPermitted (the handle was opened without that mode).
 * Read in sdk.elf: 60 MountNameAlreadyExists, 6905 NotMounted [0x1f498c], 6457 "a file is still open for writing" [0x1f44f4].
 * 7 DirectoryNotEmpty, 6400 PermissionDenied (suyu file_sys/errors.h; write to the read-only rom). */
#define RESULT_PATH_NOT_FOUND 0x202u
#define RESULT_PATH_ALREADY_EXISTS 0x402u
#define RESULT_MOUNT_NAME_EXISTS 0x7802u
#define RESULT_TARGET_NOT_FOUND 0x7d402u
#define RESULT_OUT_OF_RANGE 0x177a02u
#define RESULT_NO_APPEND 0x307202u
#define RESULT_READ_NOT_PERMITTED 0x307402u
#define RESULT_WRITE_NOT_PERMITTED 0x307602u
#define RESULT_PERMISSION_DENIED 0x320002u
#define RESULT_WRITE_FILE_OPEN 0x327202u
#define RESULT_NOT_MOUNTED 0x35f202u
#define RESULT_GENERIC_FAILURE 0x3e802u      /* a Windows failure with no console counterpart (disk error, sharing violation) */

enum { MK_ROM = 1, MK_SAVE, MK_CACHE, MK_PLAIN /* self-tests: a writable host folder without a journal */ };
typedef struct {
    char name[16];
    int kind;
    char root[MAX_PATH];                     /* committed state (or the rom folder) */
    char work[MAX_PATH];                     /* journal working folder ("" for the rom) */
    char **tomb;                             /* relative paths deleted since the last commit, '\\' separators */
    int tomb_n;
} Mount;
#define MOUNT_MAX 8
static Mount g_mounts[MOUNT_MAX];
static char g_rom_root[MAX_PATH], g_user_root[MAX_PATH];
static volatile LONG g_open_log;
static CRITICAL_SECTION g_fs_lock;
static volatile LONG g_fs_lock_ready;

static void fs_lock(void) {
    if (InterlockedCompareExchange(&g_fs_lock_ready, 1, 0) == 0) { InitializeCriticalSection(&g_fs_lock); g_fs_lock_ready = 2; }
    while (g_fs_lock_ready != 2) SwitchToThread();
    EnterCriticalSection(&g_fs_lock);
}
static void fs_unlock(void) { LeaveCriticalSection(&g_fs_lock); }

static void fs_roots(void) {
    if (g_rom_root[0]) return;
    const char *env = getenv("SMO_ROMFS"), *user = getenv("SMO_USERDATA");
    strncpy(g_rom_root, env && env[0] ? env : "..\\romfs", MAX_PATH - 1);
    strncpy(g_user_root, user && user[0] ? user : "..\\userdata", MAX_PATH - 1);
    CreateDirectoryA(g_user_root, NULL);
}
const char *fs_user_root(void) { fs_roots(); return g_user_root; }
const char *fs_rom_root(void) { fs_roots(); return g_rom_root; }           /* smo_ui.c: the game's own files for the host menus */

static int is_dir(const char *p) { DWORD a = GetFileAttributesA(p); return a != INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES && (a & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY); }
static int exists(const char *p) { return GetFileAttributesA(p) != INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES; }
static void make_parents(const char *path) {             /* creates every missing folder above `path` */
    char tmp[MAX_PATH];
    snprintf(tmp, sizeof tmp, "%s", path);
    for (char *p = tmp + 3; *p; p++) if (*p == '\\') { *p = 0; CreateDirectoryA(tmp, NULL); *p = '\\'; }
}
static void remove_tree(const char *dir) {
    char pat[MAX_PATH], sub[MAX_PATH];
    WIN32_FIND_DATAA fd;
    snprintf(pat, sizeof pat, "%s\\*", dir);
    HANDLE h = FindFirstFileA(pat, &fd);
    if (h != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
        do {
            if (!strcmp(fd.cFileName, ".") || !strcmp(fd.cFileName, "..")) continue;
            snprintf(sub, sizeof sub, "%s\\%s", dir, fd.cFileName);
            if (fd.dwFileAttributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY) remove_tree(sub);
            else { SetFileAttributesA(sub, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL); DeleteFileA(sub); }
        } while (FindNextFileA(h, &fd));
        FindClose(h);
    }
    RemoveDirectoryA(dir);
}

/* ---- tombstones */
static int tomb_find(Mount *m, const char *rel) {
    for (int i = 0; i < m->tomb_n; i++) if (_stricmp(m->tomb[i], rel) == 0) return i;
    return -1;
}
static int tomb_hides(Mount *m, const char *rel) {       /* rel itself or one of its parent folders was deleted */
    for (int i = 0; i < m->tomb_n; i++) {
        size_t n = strlen(m->tomb[i]);
        if (_strnicmp(m->tomb[i], rel, n) == 0 && (rel[n] == 0 || rel[n] == '\\')) return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}
static void tomb_add(Mount *m, const char *rel) {
    if (tomb_find(m, rel) >= 0) return;
    m->tomb = realloc(m->tomb, sizeof(char *) * (size_t)(m->tomb_n + 1));
    m->tomb[m->tomb_n++] = _strdup(rel);
}
static void tomb_clear(Mount *m) { for (int i = 0; i < m->tomb_n; i++) free(m->tomb[i]); free(m->tomb); m->tomb = NULL; m->tomb_n = 0; }

/* ---- path resolution */
static Mount *mount_find(const char *name, size_t n) {
    for (int i = 0; i < MOUNT_MAX; i++) if (g_mounts[i].kind && strlen(g_mounts[i].name) == n && strncmp(g_mounts[i].name, name, n) == 0) return &g_mounts[i];
    return NULL;
}
/* "mount:/dir/file" -> mount and relative path with '\\' separators (no leading or trailing separator). Result code. */
static uint32_t split_path(const char *guest, Mount **mount, char *rel) {
    const char *colon = guest ? strchr(guest, ':') : NULL;
    if (!colon) return RESULT_NOT_MOUNTED;
    fs_roots();
    Mount *m = mount_find(guest, (size_t)(colon - guest));
    if (!m) return RESULT_NOT_MOUNTED;
    const char *rest = colon + 1;
    while (*rest == '/' || *rest == '\\') rest++;
    snprintf(rel, MAX_PATH, "%s", rest);
    for (char *p = rel; *p; p++) if (*p == '/') *p = '\\';
    size_t len = strlen(rel);
    while (len > 0 && rel[len - 1] == '\\') rel[--len] = 0;
    *mount = m;
    return 0;
}
static void join(char *out, const char *root, const char *rel) { if (rel[0]) snprintf(out, MAX_PATH, "%s\\%s", root, rel); else snprintf(out, MAX_PATH, "%s", root); }
/* The host path that currently holds `rel` in the mount's view; returns 0 when it does not exist in the view. */
static int view_path(Mount *m, const char *rel, char *out) {
    if (m->work[0]) {
        if (tomb_hides(m, rel)) { join(out, m->work, rel); return exists(out); }      /* re-created after a deletion: only the working copy counts */
        join(out, m->work, rel);
        if (exists(out)) return 1;
    }
    join(out, m->root, rel);
    return exists(out);
}
static int view_parent_is_dir(Mount *m, const char *rel) {
    char parent[MAX_PATH], host[MAX_PATH];
    snprintf(parent, sizeof parent, "%s", rel);
    char *s = strrchr(parent, '\\');
    if (!s) return 1;                                     /* directly under the root */
    *s = 0;
    return view_path(m, parent, host) && is_dir(host);
}
/* (nnmovie_mf.c) the host file that holds guest path "mount:/dir/file" in its mount's view; 0 if none. On the
 * console the movie library's Extractor::SetDataSource(const char*) opens such a path through nn::fs itself. */
int fs_host_path(const char *guest, char *out, size_t n) {
    Mount *m; char rel[MAX_PATH], host[MAX_PATH];
    int ok = 0;
    fs_lock();
    if (!split_path(guest, &m, rel) && view_path(m, rel, host) && !is_dir(host)) { snprintf(out, n, "%s", host); ok = 1; }
    fs_unlock();
    return ok;
}
/* Used by nnfsdir.c: the host folders to list for a guest directory (working folder first), 0 = no such directory. */
int fs_dir_roots(const char *guest, char roots[2][MAX_PATH], uint32_t *result) {
    Mount *m; char rel[MAX_PATH], host[MAX_PATH];
    int n = 0;
    fs_lock();
    *result = split_path(guest, &m, rel);
    if (!*result) {
        if (!view_path(m, rel, host) || !is_dir(host)) *result = RESULT_PATH_NOT_FOUND;
        else {
            if (m->work[0]) { join(roots[n], m->work, rel); if (is_dir(roots[n])) n++; }
            if (!m->work[0] || !tomb_hides(m, rel)) { join(roots[n], m->root, rel); if (is_dir(roots[n])) n++; }
        }
    }
    fs_unlock();
    return n;
}
int fs_dir_hidden(const char *guest_dir, const char *name) {      /* 1 = this entry of the committed folder was deleted in the working state */
    Mount *m; char rel[MAX_PATH], full[MAX_PATH];
    int hidden = 0;
    fs_lock();
    if (!split_path(guest_dir, &m, rel) && m->work[0]) { join(full, rel, name); hidden = tomb_hides(m, rel[0] ? full : name); }
    fs_unlock();
    return hidden;
}

/* Open files: nn::fs::FileHandle is the Windows handle itself; the open mode (1 read, 2 write, 4 allow append) and the
 * mount are kept here so reads, writes, growth and Commit behave exactly as the mode says. */
#define OPEN_MAX 1024
static struct { HANDLE h; int mode; Mount *mount; } g_open[OPEN_MAX];
static void open_remember(HANDLE h, int mode, Mount *m) {
    fs_lock();
    for (int i = 0; i < OPEN_MAX; i++) if (!g_open[i].h) { g_open[i].h = h; g_open[i].mode = mode; g_open[i].mount = m; break; }
    fs_unlock();
}
static int open_mode(HANDLE h, int forget) {             /* mode of an open handle, 7 (everything) if unknown */
    int mode = 7;
    fs_lock();
    for (int i = 0; i < OPEN_MAX; i++) if (g_open[i].h == h) { mode = g_open[i].mode; if (forget) g_open[i].h = NULL; break; }
    fs_unlock();
    return mode;
}

/* ---- journal: commit and recovery */
static HANDLE commit_mutex(void) {
    HANDLE mx = CreateMutexA(NULL, FALSE, "smo_native_save_commit");
    if (mx) WaitForSingleObject(mx, INFINITE);
    return mx;
}
static void commit_done(HANDLE mx) { if (mx) { ReleaseMutex(mx); CloseHandle(mx); } }
static void journal_list(FILE *j, const char *work, const char *rel) {     /* every file of the working folder, depth first */
    char dir[MAX_PATH], pat[MAX_PATH], sub[MAX_PATH];
    WIN32_FIND_DATAA fd;
    join(dir, work, rel);
    snprintf(pat, sizeof pat, "%s\\*", dir);
    HANDLE h = FindFirstFileA(pat, &fd);
    if (h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return;
    do {
        if (!strcmp(fd.cFileName, ".") || !strcmp(fd.cFileName, "..")) continue;
        if (rel[0]) snprintf(sub, sizeof sub, "%s\\%s", rel, fd.cFileName); else snprintf(sub, sizeof sub, "%s", fd.cFileName);
        if (fd.dwFileAttributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY) { fprintf(j, "M\t%s\n", sub); journal_list(j, work, sub); }
        else {
            char full[MAX_PATH];
            join(full, work, sub);
            HANDLE f = CreateFileA(full, GENERIC_WRITE, FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE | FILE_SHARE_DELETE, NULL, OPEN_EXISTING, 0, NULL);
            if (f != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) { FlushFileBuffers(f); CloseHandle(f); }
            fprintf(j, "F\t%s\n", sub);
        }
    } while (FindNextFileA(h, &fd));
    FindClose(h);
}
/* Applies a decided commit: marker lines are "W <working folder>", "R <committed folder>", then "D rel" (delete),
 * "M rel" (make folder), "F rel" (move file). Every step can be repeated, so a commit interrupted here is finished by
 * running it again. */
static int journal_apply(const char *marker) {
    char line[MAX_PATH + 8], work[MAX_PATH] = "", root[MAX_PATH] = "", a[MAX_PATH], b[MAX_PATH];
    FILE *j = fopen(marker, "r");
    int n = 0;
    if (!j) return -1;
    while (fgets(line, sizeof line, j)) {
        size_t len = strlen(line);
        while (len && (line[len - 1] == '\n' || line[len - 1] == '\r')) line[--len] = 0;
        if (len < 3) continue;
        const char *arg = line + 2;
        if (line[0] == 'W') snprintf(work, sizeof work, "%s", arg);
        else if (line[0] == 'R') snprintf(root, sizeof root, "%s", arg);
        else if (!root[0] || !work[0]) continue;
        else if (line[0] == 'D') { join(a, root, arg); if (is_dir(a)) remove_tree(a); else DeleteFileA(a); n++; }
        else if (line[0] == 'M') { join(a, root, arg); make_parents(a); CreateDirectoryA(a, NULL); }
        else if (line[0] == 'F') {
            join(a, work, arg); join(b, root, arg);
            if (exists(a)) { make_parents(b); if (!MoveFileExA(a, b, MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING | MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH)) { fclose(j); return -2; } }
            n++;
        }
    }
    fclose(j);
    DeleteFileA(marker);
    return n;
}
static int pid_alive(DWORD pid) {
    HANDLE p = OpenProcess(SYNCHRONIZE, FALSE, pid);
    if (!p) return GetLastError() == ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED;
    int alive = WaitForSingleObject(p, 0) == WAIT_TIMEOUT;
    CloseHandle(p);
    return alive;
}
/* Before a save-type folder is mounted: finish a commit that was decided but not applied, and drop the working
 * folders and half-written journals of processes that no longer run. */
static void journal_recover(const char *root) {
    char marker[MAX_PATH], pat[MAX_PATH], path[MAX_PATH];
    WIN32_FIND_DATAA fd;
    HANDLE mx = commit_mutex();
    snprintf(marker, sizeof marker, "%s.commit", root);
    if (exists(marker)) {
        int n = journal_apply(marker);
        printf("nn::fs: a commit of %s was interrupted after it was decided: finished now (%d changes)\n", root, n);
        trace_printf("     fs journal: interrupted commit of %s rolled forward (%d changes)\n", root, n);
    }
    snprintf(pat, sizeof pat, "%s.*", root);
    HANDLE h = FindFirstFileA(pat, &fd);
    if (h != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
        do {
            const char *ext = strrchr(fd.cFileName, '.');
            const char *kind = ext && ext - 5 >= fd.cFileName && !strncmp(ext - 5, ".work", 5) ? "work" : ext && ext - 8 >= fd.cFileName && !strncmp(ext - 8, ".journal", 8) ? "journal" : NULL;
            if (!kind) continue;
            DWORD pid = (DWORD)strtoul(ext + 1, NULL, 10);
            if (!pid || pid == GetCurrentProcessId() || pid_alive(pid)) continue;
            snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s\\..\\%s", root, fd.cFileName);
            if (fd.dwFileAttributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY) remove_tree(path); else DeleteFileA(path);
            trace_printf("     fs journal: uncommitted %s of process %lu discarded (%s)\n", kind, (unsigned long)pid, fd.cFileName);
        } while (FindNextFileA(h, &fd));
        FindClose(h);
    }
    commit_done(mx);
}
static uint32_t mount_add(const char *name, int kind, const char *root) {
    Mount *m = NULL;
    size_t n = name ? strlen(name) : 0;
    if (!n || n >= sizeof m->name) return RESULT_GENERIC_FAILURE;
    fs_lock();
    if (mount_find(name, n)) { fs_unlock(); return RESULT_MOUNT_NAME_EXISTS; }
    for (int i = 0; i < MOUNT_MAX && !m; i++) if (!g_mounts[i].kind) m = &g_mounts[i];
    if (!m) { fs_unlock(); return RESULT_GENERIC_FAILURE; }
    memset(m, 0, sizeof *m);
    strcpy(m->name, name);
    snprintf(m->root, MAX_PATH, "%s", root);
    if (kind != MK_ROM) {
        snprintf(m->work, MAX_PATH, "%s.work.%lu", root, (unsigned long)GetCurrentProcessId());
        remove_tree(m->work);                              /* a second mount in this process starts from the committed state */
        CreateDirectoryA(m->work, NULL);
    }
    m->kind = kind;
    fs_unlock();
    return 0;
}

static void save_dir(char *dir, const char *leaf) { fs_roots(); snprintf(dir, MAX_PATH, "%s\\%s", g_user_root, leaf); }
/* Save data of the one local user lives in <userdata>\save. It exists once EnsureSaveData has created it;
 * MountSaveData of save data that does not exist fails as on the console. */
static int save_exists(void) { char dir[MAX_PATH]; save_dir(dir, "save"); return is_dir(dir); }
static void fs_MountRom(Ctx *c) {                        /* (name, cache buffer, cache size): the buffer holds the RomFS metadata cache of the SDK's reader; the host reads the extracted tree */
    fs_roots();
    uint32_t r = mount_add(STR(0), MK_ROM, g_rom_root);
    trace_printf("     fs mount rom \"%s\" -> %s (%x)\n", STR(0), g_rom_root, r);
    RET(r);
}
static void fs_MountSaveData(Ctx *c) {                   /* (const char *name, const Uid &) */
    char dir[MAX_PATH];
    save_dir(dir, "save");
    if (!save_exists()) { trace_printf("     fs mount save data \"%s\": no save data (EnsureSaveData was not called)\n", STR(0)); RET(RESULT_TARGET_NOT_FOUND); return; }
    journal_recover(dir);
    uint32_t r = mount_add(STR(0), MK_SAVE, dir);
    trace_printf("     fs mount save data \"%s\" -> %s, journal working folder %s.work.%lu (%x)\n", STR(0), dir, dir, (unsigned long)GetCurrentProcessId(), r);
    RET(r);
}
static void fs_Unmount(Ctx *c) {                         /* (const char *name): uncommitted changes are dropped */
    const char *name = STR(0);
    fs_lock();
    Mount *m = name ? mount_find(name, strlen(name)) : NULL;
    if (m) {
        for (int i = 0; i < OPEN_MAX; i++) if (g_open[i].h && g_open[i].mount == m) { CloseHandle(g_open[i].h); g_open[i].h = NULL; }   /* [sdk 0x1f4870] the accessor closes what is left open */
        if (m->work[0]) remove_tree(m->work);
        tomb_clear(m);
        trace_printf("     fs unmount \"%s\"\n", name);
        m->kind = 0;
    } else trace_printf("     fs unmount \"%s\": not mounted\n", name ? name : "(null)");
    fs_unlock();
}
static void fs_EnsureSaveData(Ctx *c) {                  /* (const Uid &): creates the user's save data if there is none */
    char dir[MAX_PATH];
    save_dir(dir, "save");
    RET(CreateDirectoryA(dir, NULL) || GetLastError() == ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS ? 0 : RESULT_GENERIC_FAILURE);
}
static void fs_Commit(Ctx *c) {                          /* (const char *mount name) */
    const char *name = STR(0);
    char journal[MAX_PATH], marker[MAX_PATH];
    fs_lock();
    Mount *m = name ? mount_find(name, strlen(name)) : NULL;
    if (!m) { fs_unlock(); RET(RESULT_NOT_MOUNTED); return; }
    if (m->kind == MK_ROM) { fs_unlock(); RET(0); return; }                 /* nothing to commit on a read-only file system */
    for (int i = 0; i < OPEN_MAX; i++)
        if (g_open[i].h && g_open[i].mount == m && (g_open[i].mode & 2)) { fs_unlock(); trace_printf("     fs commit \"%s\": refused, a file is open for writing\n", name); RET(RESULT_WRITE_FILE_OPEN); return; }
    HANDLE mx = commit_mutex();
    snprintf(journal, sizeof journal, "%s.journal.%lu", m->root, (unsigned long)GetCurrentProcessId());
    snprintf(marker, sizeof marker, "%s.commit", m->root);
    FILE *j = fopen(journal, "w");
    int ok = j != NULL, changes = -1;
    if (ok) {
        fprintf(j, "W\t%s\nR\t%s\n", m->work, m->root);
        for (int i = 0; i < m->tomb_n; i++) fprintf(j, "D\t%s\n", m->tomb[i]);
        journal_list(j, m->work, "");
        ok = fflush(j) == 0 && FlushFileBuffers((HANDLE)_get_osfhandle(_fileno(j)));
        fclose(j);
    }
    if (ok) ok = MoveFileExA(journal, marker, MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING | MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH);      /* the commit is decided here */
    if (ok) { changes = journal_apply(marker); ok = changes >= 0; }
    if (ok) tomb_clear(m);
    commit_done(mx);
    fs_unlock();
    trace_printf("     fs commit \"%s\": %s (%d changes)\n", name, ok ? "ok" : "FAILED", changes);
    if (!ok) printf("nn::fs::Commit(\"%s\") failed on the host (Windows error %lu); the committed save data is unchanged or will be completed at the next mount\n", name, GetLastError());
    RET(ok ? 0 : RESULT_GENERIC_FAILURE);
}
static void fs_ok(Ctx *c) { RET(0); }

/* [sdk 0x2175e0] QueryMountRomCacheSize asks the RomFS reader for the working memory its metadata needs: the sizes of the
 * four tables of the RomFS image (directory hash table, directory entries, file hash table, file entries). The image
 * itself is not on this machine (only the extracted tree is), so the tables are rebuilt from the tree with the format's
 * rules: a directory entry is 0x18 bytes + its name padded to 4, a file entry 0x20 + name padded to 4, a hash table has
 * 4 bytes per bucket and the bucket count the RomFS builder derives from the entry count. NOT VERIFIED against the
 * image's own header (it would need the original romfs image). */
static uint32_t romfs_buckets(uint32_t n) {
    if (n < 3) return 3;
    if (n < 19) return n | 1;
    while (n % 2 == 0 || n % 3 == 0 || n % 5 == 0 || n % 7 == 0 || n % 11 == 0 || n % 13 == 0 || n % 17 == 0) n++;
    return n;
}
static void romfs_walk(const char *dir, uint32_t *dirs, uint32_t *files, uint64_t *dir_bytes, uint64_t *file_bytes) {
    wchar_t wpat[MAX_PATH + 4];
    char pat[MAX_PATH + 4], sub[MAX_PATH], utf8[1024];
    WIN32_FIND_DATAW fd;
    snprintf(pat, sizeof pat, "%s\\*", dir);
    MultiByteToWideChar(CP_ACP, 0, pat, -1, wpat, MAX_PATH + 4);
    HANDLE h = FindFirstFileW(wpat, &fd);
    if (h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return;
    do {
        if (!wcscmp(fd.cFileName, L".") || !wcscmp(fd.cFileName, L"..")) continue;
        int len = WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, fd.cFileName, -1, utf8, sizeof utf8, NULL, NULL) - 1;
        if (len < 0) len = 0;
        if (fd.dwFileAttributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY) {
            (*dirs)++; *dir_bytes += 0x18 + (uint64_t)((len + 3) & ~3);
            WideCharToMultiByte(CP_ACP, 0, fd.cFileName, -1, utf8, sizeof utf8, NULL, NULL);
            snprintf(sub, sizeof sub, "%s\\%s", dir, utf8);
            romfs_walk(sub, dirs, files, dir_bytes, file_bytes);
        } else { (*files)++; *file_bytes += 0x20 + (uint64_t)((len + 3) & ~3); }
    } while (FindNextFileW(h, &fd));
    FindClose(h);
}
static void fs_QueryMountRomCacheSize(Ctx *c) {          /* (size_t *out) */
    uint32_t dirs = 1, files = 0;
    uint64_t dir_bytes = 0x18, file_bytes = 0;
    fs_roots();
    romfs_walk(g_rom_root, &dirs, &files, &dir_bytes, &file_bytes);
    uint64_t size = 4ull * romfs_buckets(dirs) + dir_bytes + 4ull * romfs_buckets(files) + file_bytes;
    trace_printf("     fs QueryMountRomCacheSize: %u directories, %u files -> %llu bytes\n", dirs, files, (unsigned long long)size);
    wr64(A0, size);
    RET(0);
}

static void fs_OpenFile(Ctx *c) {                     /* (FileHandle *out, const char *path, int mode) */
    char rel[MAX_PATH], path[MAX_PATH];
    Mount *m = NULL;
    HANDLE h = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
    int write = (A2 & 2) != 0;
    fs_lock();
    uint32_t r = split_path(STR(1), &m, rel);
    if (!r && write && m->kind == MK_ROM) r = RESULT_PERMISSION_DENIED;
    if (!r) {
        int found = view_path(m, rel, path) && !is_dir(path);
        if (!found) r = RESULT_PATH_NOT_FOUND;
        else if (write && m->work[0]) {                    /* copy-on-write: the committed file is never opened for writing */
            char w[MAX_PATH];
            join(w, m->work, rel);
            if (_stricmp(w, path) != 0) { make_parents(w); if (!CopyFileA(path, w, TRUE)) r = RESULT_GENERIC_FAILURE; }
            strcpy(path, w);
        }
    }
    fs_unlock();
    if (!r) {
        h = CreateFileA(path, GENERIC_READ | (write ? GENERIC_WRITE : 0), FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE | FILE_SHARE_DELETE, NULL, OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, NULL);
        if (h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) r = RESULT_PATH_NOT_FOUND;
    }
    if (InterlockedIncrement(&g_open_log) <= 200 || r)     /* D2: every failed open is logged, not only the first 200 */
        trace_printf("     fs open \"%s\" mode %d -> %s\n", STR(1), (int)A2, r == RESULT_NOT_MOUNTED ? "NOT MOUNTED" : r ? "NOT FOUND" : "ok");
    {   static int on = -1; if (on < 0) on = getenv("SMO_FSLOG") != NULL;       /* D2 debug: every open on stdout */
        if (on) printf("fslog: open \"%s\" mode %d -> %s\n", STR(1), (int)A2, r ? "NOT FOUND" : "ok"); }
    if (r) { wr64(A0, 0); RET(r); return; }
    open_remember(h, (int)(A2 & 7), m);
    wr64(A0, (uint64_t)h);
    RET(0);
}
static void fs_CloseFile(Ctx *c) { if (A0) { open_mode((HANDLE)A0, 1); CloseHandle((HANDLE)A0); } }
extern int g_hitch_ms; void hitch_note(const char *s);      /* hitch.c: SMO_HITCH */
static uint64_t read_at(HANDLE h, int64_t offset, void *buf, uint64_t size) {
    uint64_t total = 0;
    if (g_hitch_ms) { char note[80]; snprintf(note, sizeof note, "read of %llu KB", (unsigned long long)(size >> 10)); hitch_note(note); }
    while (total < size) {
        OVERLAPPED ov = {0};
        uint64_t pos = (uint64_t)offset + total;
        ov.Offset = (DWORD)pos;
        ov.OffsetHigh = (DWORD)(pos >> 32);
        DWORD chunk = size - total > 0x40000000 ? 0x40000000 : (DWORD)(size - total), got = 0;
        if (!ReadFile(h, (char *)buf + total, chunk, &got, &ov) || got == 0) break;
        total += got;
    }
    if (g_hitch_ms) hitch_note(NULL);
    return total;
}
static void fs_ReadFileCount(Ctx *c) {                /* (size_t *outRead, handle, offset, buffer, size) */
    uint64_t got = read_at((HANDLE)A1, (int64_t)A2, (void *)(uintptr_t)A3, A4);
    wr64(A0, got);
    if (got != A4 && getenv("SMO_FSLOG")) printf("fslog: ReadFile(count) SHORT handle %llx offset %llx size %llx got %llx from=%llx\n", (unsigned long long)A1, (unsigned long long)A2, (unsigned long long)A4, (unsigned long long)got, (unsigned long long)c->x[30] - 4);   /* D2 debug */
    RET(0);
}
static void fs_WriteFile(Ctx *c) {                    /* (handle, offset, buffer, size, option) */
    OVERLAPPED ov = {0};
    ov.Offset = (DWORD)A1;
    ov.OffsetHigh = (DWORD)(A1 >> 32);
    DWORD put = 0;
    int mode = open_mode((HANDLE)A0, 0);
    LARGE_INTEGER size;
    if (!(mode & 2)) { RET(RESULT_WRITE_NOT_PERMITTED); return; }
    if (!(mode & 4) && GetFileSizeEx((HANDLE)A0, &size) && (int64_t)(A1 + A3) > size.QuadPart) { RET(RESULT_NO_APPEND); return; }   /* a file only grows in append mode */
    if (A3 && !WriteFile((HANDLE)A0, (void *)(uintptr_t)A2, (DWORD)A3, &put, &ov)) { RET(RESULT_GENERIC_FAILURE); return; }
    if (A4 && (rd32(A4) & 1)) FlushFileBuffers((HANDLE)A0);                  /* WriteOption::Flush */
    RET(0);
}
static void fs_GetFileSize(Ctx *c) {                  /* (s64 *out, handle) */
    LARGE_INTEGER size;
    if (!GetFileSizeEx((HANDLE)A1, &size)) { RET(RESULT_GENERIC_FAILURE); return; }
    wr64(A0, (uint64_t)size.QuadPart);
    RET(0);
}
/* SetFileSize (handle, size): the file grows (zero-filled) or is cut to `size`; only on a handle opened for
 * writing (on a journaled mount that is the working copy, committed with the rest). sead::NinFileDeviceBase::doOpen_
 * calls it when it opens a file to write it new. FlushFile (handle): what was written reaches the disk. */
static void fs_SetFileSize(Ctx *c) {
    LARGE_INTEGER pos;
    if (!(open_mode((HANDLE)A0, 0) & 2)) { RET(RESULT_WRITE_NOT_PERMITTED); return; }
    if ((int64_t)A1 < 0) { RET(RESULT_OUT_OF_RANGE); return; }
    pos.QuadPart = (LONGLONG)A1;
    if (!SetFilePointerEx((HANDLE)A0, pos, NULL, FILE_BEGIN) || !SetEndOfFile((HANDLE)A0)) { RET(RESULT_GENERIC_FAILURE); return; }
    RET(0);
}
static void fs_FlushFile(Ctx *c) { if (open_mode((HANDLE)A0, 0) & 2) FlushFileBuffers((HANDLE)A0); RET(0); }
/* Where a new entry goes: the working folder of a journaled mount. Result code; `path` = host path to create. */
static uint32_t create_target(const char *guest, Mount **mount, char *rel, char *path) {
    char host[MAX_PATH];
    uint32_t r = split_path(guest, mount, rel);
    if (r) return r;
    if ((*mount)->kind == MK_ROM) return RESULT_PERMISSION_DENIED;
    if (!rel[0] || view_path(*mount, rel, host)) return RESULT_PATH_ALREADY_EXISTS;
    if (!view_parent_is_dir(*mount, rel)) return RESULT_PATH_NOT_FOUND;
    join(path, (*mount)->work, rel);
    make_parents(path);
    return 0;
}
static void fs_CreateFile(Ctx *c) {                   /* (path, size) */
    char rel[MAX_PATH], path[MAX_PATH];
    Mount *m;
    fs_lock();
    uint32_t r = create_target(STR(0), &m, rel, path);
    if (!r) {
        HANDLE h = CreateFileA(path, GENERIC_WRITE, 0, NULL, CREATE_ALWAYS, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, NULL);
        if (h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) r = RESULT_GENERIC_FAILURE;
        else {
            LARGE_INTEGER size;
            size.QuadPart = (LONGLONG)A1;
            SetFilePointerEx(h, size, NULL, FILE_BEGIN);
            SetEndOfFile(h);
            CloseHandle(h);
            /* the deletion of an older file of this name stays recorded: the commit deletes it, then moves the new one in */
        }
    }
    fs_unlock();
    RET(r);
}
static void fs_DeleteFile(Ctx *c) {
    char rel[MAX_PATH], path[MAX_PATH], w[MAX_PATH], cm[MAX_PATH];
    Mount *m;
    fs_lock();
    uint32_t r = split_path(STR(0), &m, rel);
    if (!r && m->kind == MK_ROM) r = RESULT_PERMISSION_DENIED;
    if (!r && (!view_path(m, rel, path) || is_dir(path))) r = RESULT_PATH_NOT_FOUND;
    if (!r) {
        join(w, m->work, rel); join(cm, m->root, rel);
        if (exists(w)) DeleteFileA(w);
        if (exists(cm)) tomb_add(m, rel);
    }
    fs_unlock();
    RET(r);
}
static void fs_CreateDirectory(Ctx *c) {
    char rel[MAX_PATH], path[MAX_PATH];
    Mount *m;
    fs_lock();
    uint32_t r = create_target(STR(0), &m, rel, path);
    if (!r && !CreateDirectoryA(path, NULL) && GetLastError() != ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS) r = RESULT_GENERIC_FAILURE;
    fs_unlock();
    RET(r);
}
static void fs_GetEntryType(Ctx *c) {                 /* (DirectoryEntryType *out, path): 0 directory, 1 file */
    char rel[MAX_PATH], path[MAX_PATH];
    Mount *m;
    fs_lock();
    uint32_t r = split_path(STR(1), &m, rel);
    if (!r && !view_path(m, rel, path)) r = RESULT_PATH_NOT_FOUND;
    fs_unlock();
    {   static int on = -1; if (on < 0) on = getenv("SMO_FSLOG") != NULL;       /* SMO debug: every entry-type query on stdout */
        if (on) printf("fslog: entry type \"%s\" -> %s\n", STR(1), r ? "NOT FOUND" : is_dir(path) ? "directory" : "file"); }
    if (r) { RET(r); return; }
    wr32(A0, is_dir(path) ? 0 : 1);
    RET(0);
}
static void fs_OpenDirectory(Ctx *c) { wr64(A0, 0); RET(RESULT_PATH_NOT_FOUND); }   /* replaced by nnfsdir.c */

/* ---- self-test of the mount table and of the save data journal, in a scratch folder under %TEMP% (SMO_SDK_SELFTEST) */
uint32_t fs_mount_plain(const char *name, const char *host_dir) { fs_roots(); return mount_add(name, MK_PLAIN, host_dir); }
static int st_host_is(const char *path, const char *text) {
    char buf[64] = "";
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "rb");
    if (!f) return text == NULL;
    size_t n = fread(buf, 1, sizeof buf - 1, f);
    fclose(f);
    buf[n] = 0;
    return text && strcmp(buf, text) == 0;
}
static uint32_t st_write(Ctx *c, const char *guest, const char *text, uint64_t *keep_open) {
    uint64_t h = 0;
    uint32_t option = 1;
    c->x[0] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)&h; c->x[1] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)guest; c->x[2] = 7; fs_OpenFile(c);
    if (c->x[0]) return (uint32_t)c->x[0];
    c->x[0] = h; c->x[1] = 0; c->x[2] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)text; c->x[3] = strlen(text); c->x[4] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)&option; fs_WriteFile(c);
    uint32_t r = (uint32_t)c->x[0];
    if (keep_open) *keep_open = h; else { c->x[0] = h; fs_CloseFile(c); }
    return r;
}
static int st_read_is(Ctx *c, const char *guest, const char *text) {
    uint64_t h = 0, got = 0;
    char buf[64] = "";
    c->x[0] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)&h; c->x[1] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)guest; c->x[2] = 1; fs_OpenFile(c);
    if (c->x[0]) return text == NULL;
    c->x[0] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)&got; c->x[1] = h; c->x[2] = 0; c->x[3] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)buf; c->x[4] = sizeof buf - 1; fs_ReadFileCount(c);
    c->x[0] = h; fs_CloseFile(c);
    buf[got] = 0;
    return text && strcmp(buf, text) == 0;
}
int nnfs_selftest(Ctx *c) {
    char saved_root[MAX_PATH], t[MAX_PATH], save[MAX_PATH], a[MAX_PATH], n[MAX_PATH], work[MAX_PATH], marker[MAX_PATH], journal[MAX_PATH];
    int bad = 0;
    uint64_t uid[2] = {1, 0}, h = 0;
    #define FSCHECK(cond, text) do { if (!(cond)) { printf("  FAIL fs journal: %s\n", text); bad++; } } while (0)
    fs_roots();
    strcpy(saved_root, g_user_root);
    GetTempPathA(MAX_PATH - 64, t);
    snprintf(t + strlen(t), 64, "smo_fs_selftest_%lu", (unsigned long)GetCurrentProcessId());
    remove_tree(t);
    CreateDirectoryA(t, NULL);
    strcpy(g_user_root, t);
    snprintf(save, sizeof save, "%s\\save", t); CreateDirectoryA(save, NULL);
    snprintf(a, sizeof a, "%s\\a.bin", save); snprintf(n, sizeof n, "%s\\sub\\new.bin", save);
    snprintf(work, sizeof work, "%s.work.%lu", save, (unsigned long)GetCurrentProcessId());
    snprintf(marker, sizeof marker, "%s.commit", save); snprintf(journal, sizeof journal, "%s.journal.%lu", save, (unsigned long)GetCurrentProcessId());
    FILE *f = fopen(a, "wb"); if (f) { fputs("committed", f); fclose(f); }

    c->x[0] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)"nosuch:/a.bin"; c->x[1] = 0; fs_CreateFile(c);
    FSCHECK(c->x[0] == RESULT_NOT_MOUNTED, "a path with an unmounted name is not NotMounted");
    c->x[0] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)"st"; c->x[1] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)uid; fs_MountSaveData(c);
    FSCHECK(c->x[0] == 0, "MountSaveData failed");
    c->x[0] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)"st"; c->x[1] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)uid; fs_MountSaveData(c);
    FSCHECK(c->x[0] == RESULT_MOUNT_NAME_EXISTS, "mounting the same name twice is not MountNameAlreadyExists");
    /* 1. a write is visible to the game and NOT in the committed folder */
    FSCHECK(st_write(c, "st:/a.bin", "CHANGED!!", NULL) == 0, "write failed");
    FSCHECK(st_read_is(c, "st:/a.bin", "CHANGED!!"), "the game does not read back what it wrote");
    FSCHECK(st_host_is(a, "committed"), "an uncommitted write reached the committed folder");
    c->x[0] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)"st:/sub"; fs_CreateDirectory(c);
    c->x[0] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)"st:/sub/new.bin"; c->x[1] = 0; fs_CreateFile(c);
    FSCHECK(c->x[0] == 0 && !exists(n), "a new file went straight to the committed folder");
    /* 2. unmount without commit: everything is rolled back */
    c->x[0] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)"st"; fs_Unmount(c);
    FSCHECK(!exists(work), "the working folder survived Unmount");
    c->x[0] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)"st"; c->x[1] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)uid; fs_MountSaveData(c);
    FSCHECK(st_read_is(c, "st:/a.bin", "committed") && st_read_is(c, "st:/sub/new.bin", NULL), "uncommitted changes survived a remount");
    /* 3. commit is refused while a file is open for writing, then applies everything */
    FSCHECK(st_write(c, "st:/a.bin", "SECOND!!!", &h) == 0, "write failed");
    c->x[0] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)"st"; fs_Commit(c);
    FSCHECK(c->x[0] == RESULT_WRITE_FILE_OPEN && st_host_is(a, "committed"), "Commit with a file open for writing was not refused");
    c->x[0] = h; fs_CloseFile(c);
    c->x[0] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)"st:/sub"; fs_CreateDirectory(c);
    c->x[0] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)"st:/sub/new.bin"; c->x[1] = 0; fs_CreateFile(c);
    FSCHECK(st_write(c, "st:/sub/new.bin", "", NULL) == 0, "open of a created file failed");
    c->x[0] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)"st"; fs_Commit(c);
    FSCHECK(c->x[0] == 0 && st_host_is(a, "SECOND!!!") && exists(n) && !exists(marker), "Commit did not apply the changes");
    FSCHECK(st_read_is(c, "st:/a.bin", "SECOND!!!"), "the committed file is not read back after Commit");
    /* 4. deletion: hidden at once, done on the host at Commit */
    c->x[0] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)"st:/sub/new.bin"; fs_DeleteFile(c);
    FSCHECK(c->x[0] == 0 && exists(n) && st_read_is(c, "st:/sub/new.bin", NULL), "DeleteFile is not journaled");
    c->x[0] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)"st:/sub/new.bin"; fs_DeleteFile(c);
    FSCHECK(c->x[0] == RESULT_PATH_NOT_FOUND, "deleting a deleted file is not PathNotFound");
    c->x[0] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)"st"; fs_Commit(c);
    FSCHECK(c->x[0] == 0 && !exists(n), "a committed deletion did not reach the host");
    /* 5. a process killed after the commit was decided: the next mount finishes it */
    FSCHECK(st_write(c, "st:/a.bin", "THIRD!!!!", NULL) == 0, "write failed");
    f = fopen(journal, "w");
    if (f) { fprintf(f, "W\t%s\nR\t%s\n", work, save); journal_list(f, work, ""); fclose(f); }
    MoveFileExA(journal, marker, MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING);
    FSCHECK(st_host_is(a, "SECOND!!!") && exists(marker), "test setup: decided commit");
    journal_recover(save);
    FSCHECK(st_host_is(a, "THIRD!!!!") && !exists(marker), "a decided commit was not rolled forward at the next mount");
    /* 6. a process killed before the commit was decided: its working folder is dropped (pid 4 is the System process: use a dead pid) */
    {
        char dead[MAX_PATH];
        snprintf(dead, sizeof dead, "%s.work.4294967294", save);
        CreateDirectoryA(dead, NULL);
        snprintf(dead + strlen(dead), 32, "\\a.bin");
        f = fopen(dead, "wb"); if (f) { fputs("LOST", f); fclose(f); }
        journal_recover(save);
        dead[strlen(dead) - 6] = 0;
        FSCHECK(!exists(dead) && st_host_is(a, "THIRD!!!!"), "the working folder of a dead process was not discarded");
    }
    c->x[0] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)"st"; fs_Unmount(c);
    remove_tree(t);
    strcpy(g_user_root, saved_root);
    printf("  fs: mount table (NotMounted, MountNameAlreadyExists) and save data journal (copy-on-write, rollback at Unmount, Commit refused with a\n"
           "      writer open, two-phase Commit, journaled deletion, roll-forward of a decided commit, discard of a dead process's work): %s\n", bad ? "FAILED" : "ok");
    #undef FSCHECK
    return bad;
}

/* ---- nn::account: one local user with a fixed id */
static void acc_GetUserId(Ctx *c) { wr64(A0, 1); wr64(A0 + 8, 0); RET(0); }
/* [doc] OpenPreselectedUser(UserHandle*): the user chosen at start-up, opened (the SDK aborts if there is none; here
 * there always is the one local user {1, 0}). CloseUser(UserHandle&) closes it. GetLastOpenedUser(Uid*): the user
 * opened most recently on the console = {1, 0}. */
static void acc_OpenPreselectedUser(Ctx *c) { wr64(A0, 1); wr64(A0 + 8, 0); wr64(A0 + 16, 0); RET(1); }
static void acc_CloseUser(Ctx *c) { (void)c; }
static void acc_GetLastOpenedUser(Ctx *c) { wr64(A0, 1); wr64(A0 + 8, 0); RET(0); }
/* The nickname of the console user is the name of the Windows user (SMO_NICKNAME overrides): UTF-8, at most 32
 * bytes, NUL-terminated, in the 33-byte Nickname. */
static void acc_GetNickname(Ctx *c) {
    static char name[33];
    static volatile LONG ready;
    if (InterlockedCompareExchange(&ready, 1, 0) == 0) {
        const char *env = getenv("SMO_NICKNAME");
        char utf8[512] = "";
        if (env && env[0]) snprintf(utf8, sizeof utf8, "%s", env);
        else {
            wchar_t wname[257] = L"";
            DWORD n = 257;
            if (GetUserNameW(wname, &n)) WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, wname, -1, utf8, sizeof utf8, NULL, NULL);
        }
        if (!utf8[0]) strcpy(utf8, "Player");
        size_t len = strlen(utf8);
        if (len > 32) { len = 32; while (len > 0 && ((unsigned char)utf8[len] & 0xc0) == 0x80) len--; }   /* cut between characters */
        memcpy(name, utf8, len);
        name[len] = 0;
        ready = 2;
    }
    while (ready != 2) SwitchToThread();
    memset((void *)(uintptr_t)A0, 0, 33);
    strcpy((char *)(uintptr_t)A0, name);
    RET(0);
}
static void acc_out_true(Ctx *c) { wr8(A0, 1); RET(0); }
static void acc_out_false(Ctx *c) { wr8(A0, 0); RET(0); }
```

`runtime/fs/nnfsdir.c`:

```c
/* nn::fs directory functions on host folders: OpenDirectory, ReadDirectory, CloseDirectory.
 *
 * nnfs.c has OpenDirectory as "path not found" and not the other two. A directory that is never found is wrong for
 * save data the game has written itself, so OpenDirectory is REPLACED here (this file registers after nnfs.c) and
 * the rest added.
 * The mount-name mapping is the one documented at the top of nnfs.c and must stay identical to it:
 *   rom   -> %SMO_ROMFS% or ..\romfs,   any other mount -> ..\userdata\<mount name>
 *
 * [game] 0x71037c4360: OpenDirectory(&handle, path, 3); GetDirectoryEntryCount(&count, handle);
 * allocates count * 0x310 bytes; ReadDirectory(&read, entries, handle, count); so DirectoryHandle is one
 * 8-byte value passed in a register and sizeof(DirectoryEntry) = 0x310.
 * [doc] nnheaders nn/fs: DirectoryEntry { char name[0x301]; char pad[3]; s8 type @0x304 (0 directory,
 * 1 file); s64 fileSize @0x308 }; OpenDirectoryMode 1 = directories, 2 = files, 3 = all.
 * Results (module 2): [doc] switchbrew: PathNotFound 2002-0001 (0x202) when the folder is missing; the generic
 * failure nnfs.c uses (0x3e802) for a handle that is not an open directory. */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <windows.h>
#include "sdklift.h"

#define A0 (c->x[0])
#define A1 (c->x[1])
#define A2 (c->x[2])
#define A3 (c->x[3])
#define RET(v) (c->x[0] = (uint64_t)(v))
#define P(v) ((uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(v))

#define RESULT_PATH_NOT_FOUND 0x202u
#define RESULT_GENERIC_FAILURE 0x3e802u
#define ENTRY_SIZE 0x310
#define DIR_MAGIC 0x52494453u                             /* "SDIR" */

typedef struct { char name[0x301]; int is_file; int64_t size; } HostEntry;
typedef struct { uint32_t magic; int count, pos; HostEntry *entries; } HostDir;

int fs_dir_roots(const char *guest, char roots[2][MAX_PATH], uint32_t *result);   /* nnfs.c: mount table + save data journal view */
int fs_dir_hidden(const char *guest_dir, const char *name);

static void fs_OpenDirectory(Ctx *c) {                    /* (DirectoryHandle *out, const char *path, int mode) -> Result */
    uint64_t out = A0;
    int mode = (int)A2;
    char roots[2][MAX_PATH], pattern[MAX_PATH + 4];
    uint32_t result = 0;
    if (out) wr64(out, 0);
    /* the folders that make up this directory: for journaled save data the working folder, then the committed one */
    int nroots = fs_dir_roots((const char *)(uintptr_t)A1, roots, &result);
    if (result) { RET(result); return; }
    HostDir *d = calloc(1, sizeof *d);
    int cap = 0;
    d->magic = DIR_MAGIC;
    for (int r = 0; r < nroots; r++) {
        snprintf(pattern, sizeof pattern, "%s\\*", roots[r]);
        WIN32_FIND_DATAW fd;
        wchar_t wpattern[MAX_PATH + 4];
        MultiByteToWideChar(CP_ACP, 0, pattern, -1, wpattern, MAX_PATH + 4);
        HANDLE h = FindFirstFileW(wpattern, &fd);
        if (h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) continue;
        do {
            if (!wcscmp(fd.cFileName, L".") || !wcscmp(fd.cFileName, L"..")) continue;
            int is_dir = (fd.dwFileAttributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY) != 0, dup = 0;
            char name[0x301];
            memset(name, 0, sizeof name);
            if (!WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, fd.cFileName, -1, name, 0x300, NULL, NULL)) continue;
            if (r == nroots - 1 && nroots == 2) {            /* committed folder under a working folder: skip what the working state replaced or deleted */
                char ansi[MAX_PATH];
                WideCharToMultiByte(CP_ACP, 0, fd.cFileName, -1, ansi, sizeof ansi, NULL, NULL);
                if (fs_dir_hidden((const char *)(uintptr_t)A1, ansi)) continue;
            }
            for (int k = 0; k < d->count && !dup; k++) dup = _stricmp(d->entries[k].name, name) == 0;
            if (dup) continue;
            if (is_dir ? !(mode & 1) : !(mode & 2)) {
                if (nroots < 2) continue;                    /* still remembered (below) so the committed twin is not listed either */
            }
            if (d->count == cap) { cap = cap ? cap * 2 : 32; d->entries = realloc(d->entries, sizeof(HostEntry) * (size_t)cap); }
            HostEntry *e = &d->entries[d->count];
            memset(e, 0, sizeof *e);
            memcpy(e->name, name, sizeof e->name);
            e->is_file = !is_dir;
            e->size = is_dir ? 0 : (int64_t)(((uint64_t)fd.nFileSizeHigh << 32) | fd.nFileSizeLow);
            d->count++;
        } while (FindNextFileW(h, &fd));
        FindClose(h);
    }
    if (nroots == 2) {                                       /* drop the entries the open mode does not ask for */
        int n = 0;
        for (int k = 0; k < d->count; k++) if (d->entries[k].is_file ? (mode & 2) : (mode & 1)) d->entries[n++] = d->entries[k];
        d->count = n;
    }

    trace_printf("     fs OpenDirectory \"%s\" mode %d -> %d entries\n", (const char *)(uintptr_t)A1, mode, d->count);
    wr64(out, P(d));
    RET(0);
}
static HostDir *dir_of(uint64_t handle) {
    HostDir *d = (HostDir *)(uintptr_t)handle;
    return handle > 0x10000 && d->magic == DIR_MAGIC ? d : NULL;
}
static void fs_ReadDirectory(Ctx *c) {                    /* (int64_t *outCount, DirectoryEntry *entries, DirectoryHandle, int64_t max) -> Result */
    HostDir *d = dir_of(A2);
    uint64_t out = A1;
    int64_t max = (int64_t)A3, n = 0;
    if (!d) { if (A0) wr64(A0, 0); RET(RESULT_GENERIC_FAILURE); return; }
    while (n < max && d->pos < d->count) {
        HostEntry *e = &d->entries[d->pos++];
        uint8_t *g = (uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)(out + (uint64_t)n * ENTRY_SIZE);
        memset(g, 0, ENTRY_SIZE);
        memcpy(g, e->name, 0x301);
        g[0x304] = (uint8_t)e->is_file;
        memcpy(g + 0x308, &e->size, 8);
        n++;
    }
    if (A0) wr64(A0, (uint64_t)n);
    RET(0);
}
static void fs_CloseDirectory(Ctx *c) {                   /* (DirectoryHandle) */
    HostDir *d = dir_of(A0);
    if (d) { d->magic = 0; free(d->entries); free(d); }
}

#define FS(n) "_ZN2nn2fs" n
static const ImportDef fsdir_imports[] = {
    {FS("13OpenDirectoryEPNS0_15DirectoryHandleEPKci"), fs_OpenDirectory},
    {FS("13ReadDirectoryEPlPNS0_14DirectoryEntryENS0_15DirectoryHandleEl"), fs_ReadDirectory},
    {FS("14CloseDirectoryENS0_15DirectoryHandleE"), fs_CloseDirectory},
};
void register_nnfsdir_imports(void) {
    int n = (int)(sizeof fsdir_imports / sizeof fsdir_imports[0]);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        if (!import_data(fsdir_imports[i].name)) printf("nnfsdir: \"%s\" is not an import of the game (a typo, or a function it never calls)\n", fsdir_imports[i].name);
    register_imports(fsdir_imports, n);
}

int nnfsdir_selftest(Ctx *c) {
    /* a scratch mount under %TEMP% (never the user's save data): two files and one folder, listed with each mode */
    int ok = 1;
    char base[MAX_PATH], p[MAX_PATH];
    uint32_t fs_mount_plain(const char *name, const char *host_dir);
    GetTempPathA(MAX_PATH - 64, base);
    snprintf(base + strlen(base), 64, "smo_fsdir_selftest_%lu", (unsigned long)GetCurrentProcessId());
    CreateDirectoryA(base, NULL);
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s\\d", base); CreateDirectoryA(p, NULL);
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s\\d\\sub", base); CreateDirectoryA(p, NULL);
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s\\d\\a.bin", base);
    FILE *f = fopen(p, "wb"); if (f) { fwrite("12345", 1, 5, f); fclose(f); }
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s\\d\\b.bin", base);
    f = fopen(p, "wb"); if (f) fclose(f);
    ok = fs_mount_plain("sdkselftest", base) == 0;
    static const int expect[4] = {0, 1, 2, 3};
    for (int mode = 1; mode <= 3; mode++) {
        uint64_t handle = 0;
        int64_t got = -1;
        uint8_t *entries = malloc(4 * ENTRY_SIZE + 16);
        memset(entries, 0xee, 4 * ENTRY_SIZE + 16);
        c->x[0] = P(&handle); c->x[1] = P("sdkselftest:/d"); c->x[2] = (uint64_t)mode; fs_OpenDirectory(c);
        ok = ok && c->x[0] == 0 && handle;
        c->x[0] = P(&got); c->x[1] = P(entries); c->x[2] = handle; c->x[3] = 4; fs_ReadDirectory(c);
        ok = ok && c->x[0] == 0 && got == expect[mode];
        for (int i = 0; i < got && ok; i++) {
            const char *name = (const char *)entries + i * ENTRY_SIZE;
            int is_file = entries[i * ENTRY_SIZE + 0x304];
            int64_t size;
            memcpy(&size, entries + i * ENTRY_SIZE + 0x308, 8);
            if (!strcmp(name, "a.bin")) ok = is_file == 1 && size == 5;
            else if (!strcmp(name, "b.bin")) ok = is_file == 1 && size == 0;
            else if (!strcmp(name, "sub")) ok = is_file == 0;
            else ok = 0;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) if (entries[got * ENTRY_SIZE + i] != 0xee) ok = 0;
        c->x[0] = P(&got); c->x[1] = P(entries); c->x[2] = handle; c->x[3] = 4; fs_ReadDirectory(c);
        ok = ok && got == 0;                               /* the listing is consumed */
        c->x[0] = handle; fs_CloseDirectory(c);
        free(entries);
    }
    uint64_t handle = 1;
    c->x[0] = P(&handle); c->x[1] = P("sdkselftest:/missing"); c->x[2] = 3; fs_OpenDirectory(c);
    ok = ok && c->x[0] == RESULT_PATH_NOT_FOUND && handle == 0;
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s\\d\\a.bin", base); DeleteFileA(p);
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s\\d\\b.bin", base); DeleteFileA(p);
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s\\d\\sub", base); RemoveDirectoryA(p);
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s\\d", base); RemoveDirectoryA(p);
    RemoveDirectoryA(base);
    printf("  fs: OpenDirectory / ReadDirectory (modes 1, 2, 3; 0x310-byte entries): %s\n", ok ? "ok" : "FAILED");
    return !ok;
}
```
