`runtime/game/smo_amiibo.c`:

```c
/* smo_amiibo.c - the amiibo menu.
 *
 * On the console amiibo are read by the controller's NFC reader: the player holds right on the +Control Pad (the game's
 * amiibo mode) or answers the amiibo NPC, and taps a figure to the reader. Here a key (F1 by default) or a button
 * combination of a pad (both stick buttons by default; controllers.ini [hotkeys]) opens a menu drawn like the game's own
 * pause menu, from the game's own layout textures, fonts and messages (smo_ui.c), listing every amiibo the game has a name
 * for, in its language. The game is held while the menu is open: nvn_gl.c queue_present calls amiibo_menu_run after a
 * presented frame, and display.c stops signalling the game's vsync event (it would count the refreshes and run ahead to
 * catch up). Up / down (stick, +Control Pad, keyboard) select, L / R or ZL / ZR move by a page, A puts the amiibo on the
 * reader (nnapplet.c nfp_place_amiibo), B or the key again closes the menu.
 *
 * Then the game reads the amiibo the next time it looks for one. If it was looking for one already, i.e. its amiibo mode
 * (HelpAmiiboDirector) or the amiibo NPC's touch prompt (EventFlowNodeAmiiboTouchLayout) was waiting for → in the frames
 * after the menu closed, right is held for the player (nnhid.c) until the game has read the amiibo, as a player would hold
 * it while tapping the figure; otherwise the amiibo stays on the reader until the player holds right in the game.
 *
 * The list: the labels of AmiiboName.msbt name every amiibo the game knows, id_0xGGCCVV (game, character, variant) or
 * id_0xGGCCVV_NNN (and the model number, for the three Wedding amiibo), in the order of the file; to them the Gold Mario
 * amiibo is added (model number 60, which the Gold Mario Suit asks for: ItemCloth.byml), named after Mario and that
 * suit. The tag's identification block: GG CC VV 00 (figure), the model number big-endian, series 0, 02.
 *
 * Look (measured on the game's own pause menu, 1600x900 captures; layout units of 1280 x 720, y up): the list turned 3
 * degrees about (-590, -19), rows 54 apart; the chosen row in a white bar 484 x 56 with rounded corners and a soft shadow,
 * the cap cursor (CmCursor00) 37 units into it, its name in TitleFont60, dark grey; the other rows white with a soft
 * shadow; the logo top left (the game's "x amiibo" logo of its amiibo guide, CmTitleLogoxAmiibo, where that guide puts it);
 * the footer: white, 58 high, a gold line (186, 160, 0) on top, the guide text right-aligned at x 580 in MessageFont38
 * with the button pictures of DeviceFont80, gold. On the right, where the pause menu shows Mario and Cappy: the figure
 * the game shows in its amiibo guide for Mario and the three Wedding amiibo, the amiibo symbol for the others. */
#include <math.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <windows.h>
#include "smo_ui.h"

void nfp_place_amiibo(const uint8_t *id);                 /* nnapplet.c */
long nfp_amiibo_reads(void);
const char *oe_language(void);                           /* nnmisc.c: the game's language, "en-US" ... */
int nerve_watch_set(const char *a, const char *b);       /* smo_nerve.c */
long long nerve_watch_last(void);
long long nvn_front_frame_next(void);                    /* nvn_gl.c */
int nvn_menu_job(UiMenuJob *m);
uint64_t hid_menu_buttons(void);                         /* nnhid.c */
void hid_menu_closed(void);
void hid_amiibo_hold_after(long long frame, long reads);
int hid_menu_key(int which);
void display_menu_hold(int on);                          /* display.c */
void display_menu_wait(void);
int display_closing(void);

enum { B_A = 0, B_B = 1, B_L = 6, B_R = 7, B_ZL = 8, B_ZR = 9, B_UP = 13, B_DOWN = 15, B_SL_UP = 17, B_SL_DOWN = 19 };   /* nnhid.c button bits */
#define BIT(b) (1ull << (b))

typedef struct { uint16_t name[64]; uint8_t id[8]; int title_font, picture; } Amiibo;
enum { PIC_ICON, PIC_MARIO, PIC_MARIO_W, PIC_PEACH_W, PIC_KOOPA_W, PIC_N };
static const char *const g_pic_tex[PIC_N] = {"MyIconAmiibo^w", "MyImageAmiibo^w", "MyImageAmiiboMario^w", "MyImageAmiiboPeach^w", "MyImageAmiiboKoopa^w"};

static struct {
    int tried, ok;
    Amiibo *list; int n;
    UiFont *title, *msg, *dev;
    UiImage cursor, corner, corner_sh, logo, arrow, circle, pic[PIC_N];
    uint16_t footer[256];
    float sel_scale, row_scale, msg_scale, msg_per_title; /* layout units per font pixel */
    UiImage bg, frame;
    int sel, top;
} M;
static volatile LONG g_request;

#define VIS 7                                             /* rows shown */
#define ROW_STEP 54.0f
#define ROW0 135.0f                                       /* local y of the first row shown */
#define LIST_X (-590.0f)
#define LIST_Y (-19.0f)
#define ITEM_X 4.0f

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- the game's files */
static const char *lang_folder(void) {
    static const struct { const char *code, *dir; } map[] = {
        {"ja", "JPja"}, {"en-US", "USen"}, {"en-GB", "EUen"}, {"fr", "EUfr"}, {"fr-CA", "USfr"}, {"de", "EUde"}, {"it", "EUit"},
        {"es", "EUes"}, {"es-419", "USes"}, {"zh-Hans", "CNzh"}, {"zh-Hant", "TWzh"}, {"nl", "EUnl"}, {"ru", "EUru"}};
    const char *code = oe_language();
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof map / sizeof map[0]; i++) if (code && !strcmp(code, map[i].code)) return map[i].dir;
    return "USen";
}
static uint8_t *lang_arc(const char *sub, size_t *n) {     /* LocalizedData/<lang>/<sub>, the US English one if missing */
    char p[160];
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "LocalizedData/%s/%s", lang_folder(), sub);
    uint8_t *b = ui_arc(p, n);
    if (!b) { snprintf(p, sizeof p, "LocalizedData/USen/%s", sub); b = ui_arc(p, n); }
    return b;
}
static int layout_tex(const char *layout, const char *name, UiImage *out) {
    char p[96];
    size_t n = 0, ln = 0, bn = 0;
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "LayoutData/%s.szs", layout);
    uint8_t *arc = ui_arc(p, &n);
    const uint8_t *ly = arc ? ui_sarc(arc, n, "layout.lyarc", &ln) : NULL, *bntx = ly ? ui_sarc(ly, ln, "timg/__Combined.bntx", &bn) : NULL;
    int ok = bntx && ui_bntx(bntx, bn, name, out);
    if (!ok) printf("amiibo menu: texture %s of %s not found\n", name, p);
    free(arc);
    return ok;
}
static UiFont *font_of(const uint8_t *fonts, size_t n, const char *name) {
    size_t m = 0;
    const uint8_t *b = ui_sarc(fonts, n, name, &m);
    UiFont *f = b ? ui_font(b, m) : NULL;
    if (!f) printf("amiibo menu: font %s not usable\n", name);
    return f;
}
static int has_glyphs(const UiFont *f, const uint16_t *s) {    /* every character of s drawn by f (measured one by one) */
    for (; *s; s++) { uint16_t one[2] = {*s, 0}; if (*s != ' ' && ui_text(NULL, ui_xf_move(0, 0), f, NULL, one, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0) <= 0) return 0; }
    return 1;
}
static void u16cpy(uint16_t *d, const uint16_t *s, int cap) { int i = 0; for (; s && s[i] && i < cap - 1; i++) d[i] = s[i]; d[i] = 0; }
static void u16cat(uint16_t *d, const uint16_t *s, int cap) { int i = 0; while (d[i]) i++; u16cpy(d + i, s, cap - i); }
static void u16cat_a(uint16_t *d, const char *s, int cap) { int i = 0; while (d[i]) i++; for (; *s && i < cap - 1; s++) d[i++] = (uint8_t)*s; d[i] = 0; }

static void add_amiibo(int gg, int cc, int vv, int num, const uint16_t *name, const uint16_t *extra) {
    Amiibo *a = realloc(M.list, sizeof *M.list * (size_t)(M.n + 1));
    if (!a) return;
    M.list = a;
    a = &M.list[M.n++];
    memset(a, 0, sizeof *a);
    u16cpy(a->name, name, 64);
    if (extra) { u16cat_a(a->name, " (", 64); u16cat(a->name, extra, 64); u16cat_a(a->name, ")", 64); }
    int same = 1;                                          /* the game names some variants alike (two Yoshi, two Rosalina): numbered */
    for (int i = 0; i < M.n - 1; i++) {
        int k = 0;
        while (M.list[i].name[k] && M.list[i].name[k] == name[k]) k++;
        same += !extra && M.list[i].name[k] == 0 && name[k] == 0 ? 1 : 0;
        if (!extra && name[k] == 0 && M.list[i].name[k] == ' ' && M.list[i].name[k + 1] == '(' && M.list[i].name[k + 2] >= '2' && M.list[i].name[k + 2] <= '9') same++;
    }
    if (same > 1) { char num[8]; snprintf(num, sizeof num, " (%d)", same); u16cat_a(a->name, num, 64); }
    a->id[0] = (uint8_t)gg; a->id[1] = (uint8_t)cc; a->id[2] = (uint8_t)vv; a->id[3] = 0;
    a->id[4] = (uint8_t)(num >> 8); a->id[5] = (uint8_t)num; a->id[6] = 0; a->id[7] = 2;
    int mario = gg == 0 && cc == 0 && vv == 0;
    a->picture = mario && num == 881 ? PIC_MARIO_W : gg == 0 && cc == 2 && num == 882 ? PIC_PEACH_W : gg == 0 && cc == 5 && num == 883 ? PIC_KOOPA_W : mario ? PIC_MARIO : PIC_ICON;
}

static int menu_load(void) {
    if (M.tried) return M.ok;
    M.tried = 1;
    size_t sn = 0, fn = 0;
    uint8_t *sys = lang_arc("MessageData/SystemMessage.szs", &sn), *fonts = lang_arc("LayoutData/FontData.szs", &fn);
    size_t an = 0, foot_n = 0, cn = 0;
    const uint8_t *names = sys ? ui_sarc(sys, sn, "AmiiboName.msbt", &an) : NULL, *foot = sys ? ui_sarc(sys, sn, "Footer.msbt", &foot_n) : NULL,
                  *cloth = sys ? ui_sarc(sys, sn, "ItemCloth.msbt", &cn) : NULL;
    UiMsbt *mn = names ? ui_msbt(names, an) : NULL, *mf = foot ? ui_msbt(foot, foot_n) : NULL, *mc = cloth ? ui_msbt(cloth, cn) : NULL;
    if (fonts) { M.title = font_of(fonts, fn, "TitleFont60.bffnt"); M.msg = font_of(fonts, fn, "MessageFont38.bffnt"); M.dev = font_of(fonts, fn, "DeviceFont80.bffnt"); }
    const uint16_t *mario = NULL;
    for (int i = 0; i < ui_msbt_count(mn); i++) {
        const char *l = ui_msbt_label(mn, i);
        unsigned id = 0; int num = 0;
        if (sscanf(l, "id_0x%6x_%d", &id, &num) < 1 || strncmp(l, "id_0x", 5) || strlen(l) < 11) continue;
        add_amiibo((int)(id >> 16), (int)(id >> 8) & 255, (int)id & 255, num, ui_msbt_text_at(mn, i), NULL);
        if (id == 0 && num == 0) mario = ui_msbt_text_at(mn, i);
    }
    const uint16_t *gold = ui_msbt_text(mc, "MarioColorGold");
    if (mario && gold) add_amiibo(0, 0, 0, 60, mario, gold);
    u16cpy(M.footer, ui_msbt_text(mf, "Choice_Back_Decide"), 256);
    M.ok = M.n > 0 && M.title && M.msg && M.dev &&
           layout_tex("CursorParts", "CmCursor00^w", &M.cursor) && layout_tex("SelectMenuParts", "CmSelectCorner^s", &M.corner) &&
           layout_tex("SelectMenuParts", "CmSelectCornerSh^s", &M.corner_sh) && layout_tex("ControllerGuideAmiibo", "CmTitleLogoxAmiibo^w", &M.logo) &&
           layout_tex("CursorArrowParts", "CmArrow^s", &M.arrow) && layout_tex("CursorArrowParts", "CmCircle24^s", &M.circle) &&
           layout_tex("AmiiboModeParts", g_pic_tex[PIC_ICON], &M.pic[PIC_ICON]);
    for (int p = 1; M.ok && p < PIC_N; p++) if (!layout_tex("ControllerGuideAmiibo", g_pic_tex[p], &M.pic[p])) M.pic[p] = M.pic[PIC_ICON];
    if (M.ok) {
        UiFontInfo t, s;
        ui_font_info(M.title, &t); ui_font_info(M.msg, &s);
        /* the pause menu's sizes, measured on its captures: capitals 29.3 units high in the chosen row, 21.3 in the others
         * (TitleFont60's are 46 pixels), the footer's 16.8 (MessageFont38's 32); a name the title font cannot draw is
         * written in MessageFont38 at the same cell height */
        M.sel_scale = 29.3f / 46.0f;
        M.row_scale = 21.3f / 46.0f;
        M.msg_scale = 16.8f / 32.0f;
        M.msg_per_title = (float)t.cell_h / (float)s.cell_h;
        for (int i = 0; i < M.n; i++) M.list[i].title_font = has_glyphs(M.title, M.list[i].name);
    }
    printf("amiibo menu: %s; %d amiibo (language folder %s)\n", M.ok ? "ready" : "NOT available (files of the game missing, see above)", M.n, lang_folder());
    ui_msbt_free(mn); ui_msbt_free(mf); ui_msbt_free(mc);
    free(sys); free(fonts);
    return M.ok;
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- the picture */
/* The game's frame, blurred as the pause menu shows it: box-averaged down 4 times, three passes of a 7-tap box blur each way
 * (about a Gaussian of 14 pixels at 1600 x 900), stretched back with bilinear filtering. */
#define BG_DOWN 4
static void menu_background(const uint8_t *src, int w, int h) {
    int sw = (w + BG_DOWN - 1) / BG_DOWN, sh = (h + BG_DOWN - 1) / BG_DOWN;
    float *s = calloc((size_t)sw * sh * 3, sizeof *s), *t = calloc((size_t)sw * sh * 3, sizeof *t);
    ui_image_free(&M.bg);
    M.bg.w = w; M.bg.h = h; M.bg.ch = 4; M.bg.px = malloc((size_t)w * h * 4);
    if (!s || !t || !M.bg.px) { free(s); free(t); return; }
    for (int y = 0; y < sh; y++) for (int x = 0; x < sw; x++) {
        float acc[3] = {0, 0, 0}; int k = 0;
        for (int dy = 0; dy < BG_DOWN && y * BG_DOWN + dy < h; dy++) for (int dx = 0; dx < BG_DOWN && x * BG_DOWN + dx < w; dx++, k++) {
            const uint8_t *p = src + ((size_t)(y * BG_DOWN + dy) * w + x * BG_DOWN + dx) * 4;
            acc[0] += p[0]; acc[1] += p[1]; acc[2] += p[2];
        }
        for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) s[((size_t)y * sw + x) * 3 + c] = k ? acc[c] / (float)k : 0;
    }
    for (int pass = 0; pass < 6; pass++) {
        int horiz = !(pass & 1);
        for (int y = 0; y < sh; y++) for (int x = 0; x < sw; x++) for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) {
            float acc = 0;
            for (int d = -3; d <= 3; d++) {
                int xx = horiz ? x + d : x, yy = horiz ? y : y + d;
                if (xx < 0) xx = 0; if (yy < 0) yy = 0; if (xx >= sw) xx = sw - 1; if (yy >= sh) yy = sh - 1;
                acc += s[((size_t)yy * sw + xx) * 3 + c];
            }
            t[((size_t)y * sw + x) * 3 + c] = acc / 7.0f;
        }
        float *u = s; s = t; t = u;
    }
    for (int y = 0; y < h; y++) {
        float fy = ((float)y + 0.5f) / (float)BG_DOWN - 0.5f;
        int y0 = (int)floorf(fy); float ay = fy - (float)y0;
        int y1 = y0 + 1; if (y0 < 0) y0 = 0; if (y1 < 0) y1 = 0; if (y0 >= sh) y0 = sh - 1; if (y1 >= sh) y1 = sh - 1;
        for (int x = 0; x < w; x++) {
            float fx = ((float)x + 0.5f) / (float)BG_DOWN - 0.5f;
            int x0 = (int)floorf(fx); float ax = fx - (float)x0;
            int x1 = x0 + 1; if (x0 < 0) x0 = 0; if (x1 < 0) x1 = 0; if (x0 >= sw) x0 = sw - 1; if (x1 >= sw) x1 = sw - 1;
            uint8_t *q = M.bg.px + ((size_t)y * w + x) * 4;
            for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) {
                float v = (s[((size_t)y0 * sw + x0) * 3 + c] * (1 - ax) + s[((size_t)y0 * sw + x1) * 3 + c] * ax) * (1 - ay) +
                          (s[((size_t)y1 * sw + x0) * 3 + c] * (1 - ax) + s[((size_t)y1 * sw + x1) * 3 + c] * ax) * ay;
                q[c] = (uint8_t)(v * 0.92f + 0.5f);            /* a little darker, as the pause menu's own picture */
            }
            q[3] = 255;
        }
    }
    free(s); free(t);
}

/* A window of the layout: the corner texture (its top left corner) at the four corners, mirrored, the edges stretched from
 * its last row / column, the inside filled. */
static void window(UiImage *dst, UiXf xf, float x0, float y0, float x1, float y1, const UiImage *corner, float c, uint32_t rgba) {
    float tw = (float)corner->w, th = (float)corner->h;
    enum { L = UI_EDGE_LEFT, R = UI_EDGE_RIGHT, B = UI_EDGE_BOTTOM, T = UI_EDGE_TOP };
    ui_draw_edges(dst, xf, x0, y1 - c, x0 + c, y1, corner, 0, 0, tw, th, rgba, L | T);                 /* top left */
    ui_draw_edges(dst, xf, x1 - c, y1 - c, x1, y1, corner, tw, 0, 0, th, rgba, R | T);                 /* top right: mirrored */
    ui_draw_edges(dst, xf, x0, y0, x0 + c, y0 + c, corner, 0, th, tw, 0, rgba, L | B);                 /* bottom left: flipped */
    ui_draw_edges(dst, xf, x1 - c, y0, x1, y0 + c, corner, tw, th, 0, 0, rgba, R | B);                 /* bottom right */
    ui_draw_edges(dst, xf, x0 + c, y1 - c, x1 - c, y1, corner, tw - 0.5f, 0, tw - 0.5f, th, rgba, T);   /* top edge */
    ui_draw_edges(dst, xf, x0 + c, y0, x1 - c, y0 + c, corner, tw - 0.5f, th, tw - 0.5f, 0, rgba, B);   /* bottom edge */
    ui_draw_edges(dst, xf, x0, y0 + c, x0 + c, y1 - c, corner, 0, th - 0.5f, tw, th - 0.5f, rgba, L);   /* left edge */
    ui_draw_edges(dst, xf, x1 - c, y0 + c, x1, y1 - c, corner, tw, th - 0.5f, 0, th - 0.5f, rgba, R);   /* right edge */
    ui_draw_edges(dst, xf, x0 + c, y0 + c, x1 - c, y1 - c, NULL, 0, 0, 0, 0, rgba, 0);                  /* inside */
}

/* text with the soft shadow of the pause menu's white captions */
static void shadow_text(UiImage *dst, UiXf xf, const UiFont *f, const UiFont *icons, const uint16_t *s, float x, float y, float scale, uint32_t rgba) {
    static const float off[5][2] = {{1.5f, -2.0f}, {0.8f, -1.5f}, {2.2f, -2.5f}, {1.5f, -1.2f}, {1.5f, -2.8f}};
    for (int k = 0; k < 5; k++) ui_text(dst, xf, f, icons, s, -1, x + off[k][0], y + off[k][1], scale, 0x0000001e);
    ui_text(dst, xf, f, icons, s, -1, x, y, scale, rgba);
}

static void menu_draw(void) {
    UiImage *d = &M.frame;
    if (d->w != M.bg.w || d->h != M.bg.h || !d->px) { ui_image_free(d); d->w = M.bg.w; d->h = M.bg.h; d->ch = 4; d->px = malloc((size_t)d->w * d->h * 4); }
    if (!d->px || !M.bg.px) return;
    memcpy(d->px, M.bg.px, (size_t)d->w * d->h * 4);
    UiXf scr = ui_xf_screen(d->w, d->h);
    /* the logo, as the game's amiibo guide places it (left edge -606, centre 276, 0.7 of 660 x 176) */
    ui_draw(d, scr, -606.0f, 276.0f - 61.6f, -606.0f + 462.0f, 276.0f + 61.6f, &M.logo, 0, 0, (float)M.logo.w, (float)M.logo.h, 0xffffffff);
    /* the picture on the right */
    const Amiibo *cur = &M.list[M.sel];
    const UiImage *pic = &M.pic[cur->picture];
    if (cur->picture == PIC_ICON) ui_draw(d, scr, 340.0f - 150.0f, -30.0f - 150.0f, 340.0f + 150.0f, -30.0f + 150.0f, pic, 0, 0, (float)pic->w, (float)pic->h, 0xffffffff);
    else {                                                 /* the figure without the arrow under it (the bottom fifth of the picture) */
        float vh = (float)pic->h * 0.8f, k = 470.0f / vh, pw = (float)pic->w * k;
        ui_draw(d, scr, 330.0f - pw * 0.5f, -265.0f, 330.0f + pw * 0.5f, -265.0f + vh * k, pic, 0, 0, (float)pic->w, vh, 0xffffffff);
    }
    /* the list */
    UiXf lx = ui_xf_mul(scr, ui_xf_mul(ui_xf_move(LIST_X, LIST_Y), ui_xf_rotate(3.0f)));
    for (int r = 0; r < VIS && M.top + r < M.n; r++) {
        const Amiibo *a = &M.list[M.top + r];
        int chosen = M.top + r == M.sel;
        float cy = ROW0 - ROW_STEP * (float)r, sc = chosen ? M.sel_scale : M.row_scale;
        const UiFont *f = a->title_font ? M.title : M.msg;
        if (!a->title_font) sc *= M.msg_per_title;
        UiFontInfo fi; ui_font_info(f, &fi);
        /* the capitals (about 0.65 of the ascent) centred 4 units above the middle of the row, as in the pause menu; a name
         * wider than the bar's text box (400 units from x 74) is narrowed to fit it */
        float base = cy + 4.0f - (float)fi.ascent * 0.33f * sc, tx = ITEM_X + 74.0f, tw = ui_text(NULL, lx, f, NULL, a->name, -1, 0, 0, sc, 0);
        UiXf txf = lx;
        if (tw > 400.0f) txf = ui_xf_mul(lx, ui_xf_mul(ui_xf_move(tx, 0), ui_xf_mul(ui_xf_scale(400.0f / tw, 1.0f), ui_xf_move(-tx, 0))));
        if (chosen) {
            window(d, lx, ITEM_X + 2.0f, cy - 28.0f - 5.0f, ITEM_X + 484.0f + 3.0f, cy + 28.0f - 3.0f, &M.corner_sh, 12.0f, 0x00000050);
            window(d, lx, ITEM_X, cy - 28.0f, ITEM_X + 484.0f, cy + 28.0f, &M.corner, 6.0f, 0xffffffff);
            float cw = (float)M.cursor.w * 0.7f, ch = (float)M.cursor.h * 0.7f, ccx = ITEM_X + 37.0f, ccy = cy - 2.0f;
            ui_draw(d, lx, ccx - cw * 0.5f + 1.5f, ccy - ch * 0.5f - 2.0f, ccx + cw * 0.5f + 1.5f, ccy + ch * 0.5f - 2.0f, &M.cursor, 0, 0, (float)M.cursor.w, (float)M.cursor.h, 0x00000030);
            ui_draw(d, lx, ccx - cw * 0.5f, ccy - ch * 0.5f, ccx + cw * 0.5f, ccy + ch * 0.5f, &M.cursor, 0, 0, (float)M.cursor.w, (float)M.cursor.h, 0xffffffff);
            ui_text(d, txf, f, NULL, a->name, -1, tx, base, sc, 0x4d4241ff);
        } else shadow_text(d, txf, f, NULL, a->name, tx, base, sc, 0xffffffff);
    }
    /* more above / below: the game's list arrow buttons (CursorArrowParts: a white circle of four mirrored quarters, its
     * shadow, the arrow), turned to point up or down */
    for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
        if (k == 0 ? M.top == 0 : M.top + VIS >= M.n) continue;
        float ax = ITEM_X + 74.0f + 150.0f, ay = k == 0 ? ROW0 + 42.0f : ROW0 - ROW_STEP * (float)(VIS - 1) - 42.0f, rr = 16.0f;
        float cw = (float)M.circle.w, ch = (float)M.circle.h;
        for (int pass = 0; pass < 2; pass++) {
            float ox = pass ? 0 : 1.0f, oy = pass ? 0 : -2.5f;
            uint32_t col = pass ? 0xffffffff : 0x00000048;
            ui_draw_edges(d, lx, ax - rr + ox, ay + oy, ax + ox, ay + rr + oy, &M.circle, 0, 0, cw, ch, col, UI_EDGE_LEFT | UI_EDGE_TOP);
            ui_draw_edges(d, lx, ax + ox, ay + oy, ax + rr + ox, ay + rr + oy, &M.circle, cw, 0, 0, ch, col, UI_EDGE_RIGHT | UI_EDGE_TOP);
            ui_draw_edges(d, lx, ax - rr + ox, ay - rr + oy, ax + ox, ay + oy, &M.circle, 0, ch, cw, 0, col, UI_EDGE_LEFT | UI_EDGE_BOTTOM);
            ui_draw_edges(d, lx, ax + ox, ay - rr + oy, ax + rr + ox, ay + oy, &M.circle, cw, ch, 0, 0, col, UI_EDGE_RIGHT | UI_EDGE_BOTTOM);
        }
        UiXf ax_xf = ui_xf_mul(lx, ui_xf_mul(ui_xf_move(ax, ay), ui_xf_rotate(k == 0 ? 90.0f : -90.0f)));
        ui_draw(d, ax_xf, -10.0f, -10.0f, 10.0f, 10.0f, &M.arrow, 0, 0, (float)M.arrow.w, (float)M.arrow.h, 0x4d4241ff);
    }
    /* the footer: the device icon of a Pro Controller on the left, the guide on the right, in the footer's gold */
    ui_draw(d, scr, -640.0f, -360.0f, 640.0f, -302.0f, NULL, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0xffffffff);
    ui_draw(d, scr, -640.0f, -306.0f, 640.0f, -302.0f, NULL, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0xbaa000ff);
    static const uint16_t pro[2] = {0xe12c, 0};
    ui_text(d, scr, M.dev, NULL, pro, 1, -592.0f, -344.0f, 0.45f, 0xbaa000ff);
    float fw = ui_text(NULL, scr, M.msg, M.dev, M.footer, -1, 0, 0, M.msg_scale, 0);
    ui_text(d, scr, M.msg, M.dev, M.footer, -1, 578.0f - fw, -339.0f, M.msg_scale, 0xbaa000ff);
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- the menu */
void amiibo_menu_request(void) { InterlockedExchange(&g_request, 1); }
int amiibo_menu_wanted(void) { return g_request != 0; }
int amiibo_menu_take_request(void) { return InterlockedExchange(&g_request, 0) != 0; }      /* tests: asked for since the last call */

static void keep_visible(void) {                          /* the chosen row at least two rows from the edges of the window, but at the ends */
    if (M.sel < 0) M.sel = 0;
    if (M.sel >= M.n) M.sel = M.n - 1;
    if (M.sel - 2 < M.top) M.top = M.sel - 2;
    if (M.sel + 2 >= M.top + VIS) M.top = M.sel + 3 - VIS;
    if (M.top > M.n - VIS) M.top = M.n - VIS > 0 ? M.n - VIS : 0;
    if (M.top < 0) M.top = 0;
}

/* tests and the offline check: one frame of the menu over the picture rgba (w x h), with entry `sel` chosen, into out */
int amiibo_menu_compose(const uint8_t *rgba, int w, int h, int sel, uint8_t *out) {
    if (!menu_load()) return 0;
    menu_background(rgba, w, h);
    M.sel = sel; keep_visible();
    menu_draw();
    if (!M.frame.px) return 0;
    memcpy(out, M.frame.px, (size_t)w * h * 4);
    return 1;
}
int amiibo_menu_count(void) { return menu_load() ? M.n : 0; }
/* tests: entry i, its identification block and its name (ASCII, '?' for other characters); 0 = no such entry */
int amiibo_menu_entry(int i, uint8_t id[8], char *name, int cap) {
    if (!menu_load() || i < 0 || i >= M.n) return 0;
    memcpy(id, M.list[i].id, 8);
    int k = 0;
    for (; M.list[i].name[k] && k < cap - 1; k++) name[k] = M.list[i].name[k] < 128 ? (char)M.list[i].name[k] : '?';
    name[k] = 0;
    return 1;
}

/* TEST AID, SMO_AMIIBO_SHOT_DIR=<folder>: the first three different pictures of each opening of the menu as PNG files */
int tex_write_png(const char *path, const uint8_t *rgba, int w, int h);
static void save_shot(int opening, int k) {
    char p[400];
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s\\amiibo_menu_%d_%d.png", getenv("SMO_AMIIBO_SHOT_DIR"), opening, k);
    if (tex_write_png(p, M.frame.px, M.frame.w, M.frame.h) == 0) printf("amiibo menu: picture saved to %s\n", p);
}

/* nvn_gl.c queue_present, the game's main thread, after a presented frame: the menu, until it is closed. pj = that frame. */
void amiibo_menu_run(void *pj) {
    InterlockedExchange(&g_request, 0);
    LARGE_INTEGER t0, t1, fq;
    QueryPerformanceCounter(&t0);
    UiMenuJob job;
    memset(&job, 0, sizeof job);
    job.present = pj;
    job.op = UI_MENU_READ;
    if (!menu_load()) return;
    if (!nvn_menu_job(&job) || !job.out) { printf("amiibo menu: the frame could not be read back (the menu needs the Vulkan renderer)\n"); return; }
    if (!nerve_watch_set("HelpAmiiboDirectorNrvWait", "EventFlowNodeAmiiboTouchLayoutNrvWaitTouchTrigger"))
        printf("amiibo menu: the game's amiibo states are not known (function list): right will not be held for the game\n");
    menu_background(job.out, job.out_w, job.out_h);
    free(job.out);
    keep_visible();
    display_menu_hold(1);
    menu_draw();
    QueryPerformanceCounter(&t1); QueryPerformanceFrequency(&fq);
    printf("amiibo menu: open at frame %lld (%.0f ms from the request to the first picture)\n", nvn_front_frame_next(), (double)(t1.QuadPart - t0.QuadPart) * 1000.0 / (double)fq.QuadPart);
    uint64_t prev = hid_menu_buttons();                    /* what is held when it opens counts only once let go */
    hid_menu_key(0); hid_menu_key(1);
    int held = 0, repeat = 0, changed = 1, dirty = 0, picked = -1, shots_left = getenv("SMO_AMIIBO_SHOT_DIR") ? 3 : 0;
    static int opened;
    opened++;
    for (;;) {
        if (display_closing()) break;                      /* the window is being closed: the game has to run to answer it */
        uint64_t b = hid_menu_buttons(), press = b & ~prev;
        prev = b;
        int up = (b & (BIT(B_UP) | BIT(B_SL_UP))) != 0, down = (b & (BIT(B_DOWN) | BIT(B_SL_DOWN))) != 0, dir = up ? -1 : down ? 1 : 0;
        int step = 0;
        if (dir && (press & (BIT(B_UP) | BIT(B_SL_UP) | BIT(B_DOWN) | BIT(B_SL_DOWN)))) { step = dir; held = 0; repeat = 0; }
        else if (dir && ++held >= 30 && ++repeat % 5 == 1) step = dir;       /* the pause menu's key repeat: after 30 frames, every 5 */
        if (!dir) held = repeat = 0;
        if (press & (BIT(B_L) | BIT(B_ZL))) step = -VIS;
        if (press & (BIT(B_R) | BIT(B_ZR))) step = VIS;
        if (step) {
            int old = M.sel;
            M.sel += step;
            if (abs(step) == 1 && held == 0) { if (M.sel < 0) M.sel = M.n - 1; if (M.sel >= M.n) M.sel = 0; }   /* a press wraps round, a held direction stops at the end */
            keep_visible();
            if (M.sel != old) changed = dirty = 1;
        }
        if (press & BIT(B_A) || hid_menu_key(1)) { picked = M.sel; break; }
        if (press & BIT(B_B) || hid_menu_key(0) || g_request) { InterlockedExchange(&g_request, 0); break; }
        if (dirty) { menu_draw(); dirty = 0; }
        if (changed && shots_left > 0) save_shot(opened, 3 - shots_left--);
        job.op = UI_MENU_SHOW; job.rgba = M.frame.px; job.w = M.frame.w; job.h = M.frame.h; job.changed = changed;
        if (!nvn_menu_job(&job)) { printf("amiibo menu: the picture could not be shown; closed\n"); break; }
        changed = 0;
        display_menu_wait();
    }
    job.op = UI_MENU_END;
    nvn_menu_job(&job);
    display_menu_hold(0);
    hid_menu_closed();
    long long frame = nvn_front_frame_next();
    if (picked >= 0) {
        const Amiibo *a = &M.list[picked];
        char name[64];
        int k = 0;
        for (; a->name[k] && k < 63; k++) name[k] = a->name[k] < 128 ? (char)a->name[k] : '?';
        name[k] = 0;
        long reads = nfp_amiibo_reads();
        nfp_place_amiibo(a->id);
        hid_amiibo_hold_after(frame, reads);
        printf("amiibo menu: closed at frame %lld, amiibo \"%s\" put on the reader\n", frame, name);
    } else printf("amiibo menu: closed at frame %lld without a choice\n", frame);
}

```

`runtime/game/smo_fast.c`:

```c
/* smo_fast.c - host versions of hot game code, put into the loaded game DLL at start-up.
 *
 * THE SAMPLER LIST SORT. agl::driver::NVNMgr::registerSampler_ [main] adds a sampler to the manager's list and then
 * sorts the WHOLE list again by its 16-bit key with sead::PtrArrayImpl::sort, a cocktail-shaker sort that calls the
 * comparator (agl::driver::NVNMgr::compareSamplerKey_) through a function pointer for every pair it looks at: at least
 * one pass over the list per new sampler. At Cascade Kingdom's first checkpoint the game registers about a dozen
 * samplers a frame (and releases as many): 85 million comparator calls in 30 s on the main thread (SMO_ICALLS), each
 * an indirect call into lifted code. That was 1-2 ms of the main thread a frame, and 8-10 ms in the frames where the
 * registrations bunch up, enough to miss the refresh (SMO_HITCH: the main thread inside compareSamplerKey_). Here the
 * call in registerSampler_ goes to the same algorithm in host code with the comparison inlined, so the list ends in
 * the same order, swap for swap; a call with any other comparator goes on to the lifted sort.
 *
 * HOW. Lifted functions call each other with direct calls (`f_<address>(c);`, compiled at -O1 without inlining to a
 * `call rel32` to the callee's entry). The one call to the sort in
 * the lifted registerSampler_ is found inside that function's code (its range from the unwind table) by its target,
 * and its rel32 is pointed at a stub within 2 GB that jumps to the host function. Nothing else in the DLL changes, and
 * nothing at all when the call is not found exactly once (said in the log).
 *
 * SMO_FAST=0 leaves the game's code alone. SMO_FAST_CHECK=1 also runs the lifted sort on the same list and stops the
 * game if the two orders ever differ (counts at exit). */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <windows.h>
#include "runtime.h"
#include "hostrt.h"

#define SYM_SORT GAME_SYM__ZN4sead12PtrArrayImpl4sortEPFiPKvS2_E
#define SYM_REGISTER GAME_SYM__ZN3agl6driver6NVNMgr16registerSampler_EiPK10NVNsamplerj
#define SYM_KEYCMP GAME_SYM__ZN3agl6driver6NVNMgr18compareSamplerKey_EPKNS1_10SamplerKeyES4_

static void (*g_lifted_sort)(Ctx *);
static int g_check;
static LONG64 g_sorts, g_items, g_swaps, g_other, g_checked;

static void (*host_fn_of(uint64_t guest))(Ctx *) {          /* the lifted function at a guest address (fn_table is sorted) */
    int lo = 0, hi = fn_table_count - 1;
    while (lo <= hi) {
        int mid = (lo + hi) / 2;
        if (fn_table[mid].addr == guest) return fn_table[mid].fn;
        if (fn_table[mid].addr < guest) lo = mid + 1; else hi = mid - 1;
    }
    return NULL;
}

/* compareSamplerKey_(a, b) [main]: the 16-bit key at offset 0x62 of a minus that of b */
static inline int key_cmp(uint64_t a, uint64_t b) { return (int)rd16(a + 0x62) - (int)rd16(b + 0x62); }

/* sead::PtrArrayImpl::sort [main], step for step: a forward pass over [lo, hi) swaps where cmp(p[k], p[k+1]) >= 1, a
 * backward pass from the forward pass's last swap down to lo swaps where cmp(p[k], p[k-1]) < 0; the next passes are
 * bounded by those last swaps; it ends when a pass's last swap is where it started. */
static LONG64 shaker_sort_keys(uint64_t *p, int n) {
    int lo = 0, hi = n - 1;
    LONG64 swaps = 0;
    for (;;) {
        int last = lo;
        for (int k = lo; k < hi; k++)
            if (key_cmp(p[k], p[k + 1]) >= 1) { uint64_t t = p[k]; p[k] = p[k + 1]; p[k + 1] = t; last = k; swaps++; }
        if (lo == last) return swaps;
        int first = last;
        for (int k = last; k > lo; k--)
            if (key_cmp(p[k], p[k - 1]) < 0) { uint64_t t = p[k]; p[k] = p[k - 1]; p[k - 1] = t; first = k; swaps++; }
        hi = last;
        if (first == last) return swaps;
        lo = first;
    }
}

/* Reached from the call in registerSampler_ (through the stub): sead::PtrArrayImpl::sort(this = x0, cmp = x1). The
 * registers the lifted sort would leave behind are only ones a callee may change (x0..x18, flags), and nothing the
 * caller reads after the call; the callee-saved ones are not touched. */
static void sampler_sort(Ctx *c) {
    if (c->x[1] != SYM_KEYCMP) { g_other++; g_lifted_sort(c); return; }
    int n = (int)rd32(c->x[0]);                  /* PtrArrayImpl: +0 count (int), +8 the pointers */
    if (n < 2) return;
    uint64_t *p = (uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)rd64(c->x[0] + 8);      /* guest addresses are host addresses */
    g_sorts++; g_items += n;
    if (!g_check) { g_swaps += shaker_sort_keys(p, n); return; }
    uint64_t *before = malloc((size_t)n * 8), *mine = malloc((size_t)n * 8);
    if (!before || !mine) guest_trap("smo_fast: out of host memory for SMO_FAST_CHECK", c->x[30]);
    memcpy(before, p, (size_t)n * 8);
    g_swaps += shaker_sort_keys(p, n);
    memcpy(mine, p, (size_t)n * 8);
    memcpy(p, before, (size_t)n * 8);
    g_lifted_sort(c);                            /* the game's own sort of the same list, as the call would have run */
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        if (p[i] != mine[i]) {
            printf("smo_fast: CHECK FAILED: sampler list sort #%lld of %d entries differs from the game's at index %d (%llx, game %llx)\n",
                   (long long)g_sorts, n, i, (unsigned long long)mine[i], (unsigned long long)p[i]);
            fflush(stdout);
            guest_trap("smo_fast: the host sampler list sort differs from the game's (SMO_FAST_CHECK)", c->x[30]);
        }
    g_checked++;
    free(before); free(mine);
}

/* A page within 2 GB of `site` for the jump stub (a rel32 must reach it). */
static uint8_t *alloc_near(uint8_t *site) {
    uintptr_t base = (uintptr_t)site & ~(uintptr_t)0xffff;
    for (uintptr_t d = 0x10000; d < 0x7ff00000; d += 0x10000) {
        for (int s = 0; s < 2; s++) {
            uintptr_t a = s ? base + d : base - d;
            if (!s && base < d) continue;
            void *m = VirtualAlloc((void *)a, 0x1000, MEM_RESERVE | MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE);
            if (m) return m;
        }
    }
    return NULL;
}

void smo_fast_install(void) {
    const char *e = getenv("SMO_FAST");
    if (e && !atoi(e)) { printf("smo_fast: off (SMO_FAST=0): the game's sampler list sort runs as lifted\n"); return; }
    if (!SYM_SORT || !SYM_REGISTER || !SYM_KEYCMP) {   /* gen_tables.py: not in this main.elf (a stripped update) */
        printf("smo_fast: off: the game's sampler list functions are not known; its sort runs as lifted\n");
        return;
    }
    g_check = getenv("SMO_FAST_CHECK") && atoi(getenv("SMO_FAST_CHECK"));
    g_lifted_sort = host_fn_of(SYM_SORT);
    uint8_t *caller = (uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)host_fn_of(SYM_REGISTER);
    DWORD64 img = 0;
    PRUNTIME_FUNCTION rf = caller ? RtlLookupFunctionEntry((DWORD64)(uintptr_t)caller, &img, NULL) : NULL;
    if (!g_lifted_sort || !rf || (uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)(img + rf->BeginAddress) != caller) {
        printf("smo_fast: NOT installed: the lifted registerSampler_ or sead::PtrArrayImpl::sort was not found, or has no unwind entry\n");
        return;
    }
    uint8_t *end = (uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)(img + rf->EndAddress), *at = NULL;
    int found = 0;
    for (uint8_t *q = caller; q + 5 <= end; q++) {        /* call rel32 whose target is the lifted sort */
        int32_t rel;
        memcpy(&rel, q + 1, 4);
        if (q[0] == 0xE8 && q + 5 + rel == (uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)g_lifted_sort) { at = q; found++; }
    }
    if (found != 1) { printf("smo_fast: NOT installed: %d calls of the sort in the lifted registerSampler_ (%d bytes of code), expected exactly 1\n", found, (int)(end - caller)); return; }
    uint8_t *stub = alloc_near(at);
    if (!stub) { printf("smo_fast: NOT installed: no page within 2 GB of the game's code for the jump\n"); return; }
    void (*target)(Ctx *) = sampler_sort;
    static const uint8_t jmp_abs[6] = {0xFF, 0x25, 0, 0, 0, 0};      /* jmp [rip + 0], then the 8-byte address */
    memcpy(stub, jmp_abs, 6); memcpy(stub + 6, &target, 8);
    DWORD old;
    VirtualProtect(stub, 0x1000, PAGE_EXECUTE_READ, &old);
    int64_t rel64 = stub - (at + 5);
    if (rel64 != (int32_t)rel64) { printf("smo_fast: NOT installed: the stub is out of rel32 range\n"); return; }
    int32_t rel = (int32_t)rel64;
    if (!VirtualProtect(at + 1, 4, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE, &old)) { printf("smo_fast: NOT installed: the game's code cannot be written (error %lu)\n", GetLastError()); return; }
    memcpy(at + 1, &rel, 4);
    VirtualProtect(at + 1, 4, old, &old);
    FlushInstructionCache(GetCurrentProcess(), at, 5);
    printf("smo_fast: agl::driver::NVNMgr::registerSampler_ sorts its sampler list in host code (SMO_FAST=0: the game's own code%s)\n",
           g_check ? "; SMO_FAST_CHECK=1: every sort compared with the game's" : ", SMO_FAST_CHECK=1: compare with it");
}

void smo_fast_report(FILE *out) {
    if (!g_sorts && !g_other) return;
    fprintf(out, "smo_fast: sampler list sorts in host code: %lld (%lld entries in all, %lld swaps); calls with another comparator, passed to the game's sort: %lld\n",
            (long long)g_sorts, (long long)g_items, (long long)g_swaps, (long long)g_other);
    if (g_check) fprintf(out, "smo_fast: SMO_FAST_CHECK: %lld sorts compared with the game's sort of the same list, all equal\n", (long long)g_checked);
}

```

`runtime/game/smo_guide.c`:

```c
/* smo_guide.c - the console's offline web applet (the game's Help, its Action Guide) INSIDE the game window.
 *
 * On the console nn::web::ShowOfflineHtmlPage starts the browser applet, which shows the game's HTML manual over the game,
 * and the calling thread waits until the player closes it. Here the same page (the extracted manual, made ready by
 * nnapplet.c web_open_offline: <page>_pc.html, which loads nx_pc.js, the console browser's window.nx) is shown by
 * Microsoft Edge WebView2 in the game window, covering it, while the calling guest thread waits:
 *   - the window thread (display.c, an STA with a message loop) owns the WebView2 objects. The first opening creates the
 *     environment and the controller (both asynchronously, on that thread); later ones navigate and show the page again.
 *     Closing only hides it, so the next opening is quick.
 *   - the page closes itself through window.nx.endApplet (nx_pc.js posts "endApplet" and calls window.close()).
 *   - keys go to the page itself (it has the keyboard focus): nx_pc.js turns Escape / Backspace into B, Q / E / Page Up /
 *     Page Down into L / R; the page has its own arrow keys. Pads are read by the runtime on the waiting thread
 *     (hid_menu_pad_buttons: the game's own pad layer and mappings) and handed to the page as footer presses (A B L R) and
 *     arrow keys through window.__smo_pad; nx_pc.js then leaves the browser's Gamepad API alone.
 *   - while it is open the game is held as for the amiibo menu (display_menu_hold: the refreshes are not counted, so the
 *     game does not run ahead afterwards, and the freeze watchdog stays quiet); buttons still held when it closes are
 *     kept from the game until let go (hid_menu_closed).
 *   - WebView2Loader.dll (from the WebView2 SDK, copied next to the exe by the build) is loaded on first use, and the
 *     WebView2 Runtime is part of Windows 11. When either is missing, guide_show returns 0 and nnapplet.c opens the page
 *     in the PC's web browser instead (said in the log).
 * Test aid: SMO_GUIDE_SHOT=<file.png> writes the page as shown 1.5 s after it has loaded, and 0.8 s after each pad action as
 * <file>_2.png, _3.png, ... (at most 8 pictures a run; the game's own screenshots do not see the page: the renderer does not
 * draw it). */
#define COBJMACROS
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <windows.h>
#include <shlwapi.h>
#include "WebView2.h"

void display_menu_hold(int on);                     /* display.c */
int display_closing(void);
void display_toggle_fullscreen(void);
void *display_hwnd(void);
uint64_t hid_menu_pad_buttons(void);                 /* nnhid.c */
void hid_menu_closed(void);

#define WM_SMO_GUIDE (WM_APP + 0x47)
enum { GUIDE_OPEN = 1, GUIDE_PAD, GUIDE_CLOSE };
enum { ST_IDLE, ST_OPENING, ST_OPEN, ST_CLOSED, ST_FAILED };
/* button bits of hid_menu_pad_buttons (nnhid.c: nn::hid NpadButton order; the left stick as the BTN_SL_* bits) */
#define BTN(n) (1ull << (n))
enum { B_A = 0, B_B = 1, B_L = 6, B_R = 7, B_ZL = 8, B_ZR = 9, B_LEFT = 12, B_UP = 13, B_RIGHT = 14, B_DOWN = 15,
       B_SL_LEFT = 16, B_SL_UP = 17, B_SL_RIGHT = 18, B_SL_DOWN = 19 };

static HWND g_parent;
static ICoreWebView2Environment *g_env;
static ICoreWebView2Controller *g_ctl;
static ICoreWebView2 *g_wv;
static volatile LONG g_state;                         /* ST_*: written by the window thread, waited for by the guest thread */
static int g_creating, g_shot_n;
static char g_shot_path[MAX_PATH];
static wchar_t g_url[4096];
static HMODULE g_loader;
typedef HRESULT (STDAPICALLTYPE *CreateEnvFn)(PCWSTR, PCWSTR, ICoreWebView2EnvironmentOptions *, ICoreWebView2CreateCoreWebView2EnvironmentCompletedHandler *);

/* The interface ids of the handlers below ([doc] WebView2.h of the WebView2 SDK; the header only declares them). */
static const IID k_iid_unknown = {0x00000000, 0x0000, 0x0000, {0xc0, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x46}};
static const IID k_iid_env_done = {0x4e8a3389, 0xc9d8, 0x4bd2, {0xb6, 0xb5, 0x12, 0x4f, 0xee, 0x6c, 0xc1, 0x4d}};
static const IID k_iid_ctl_done = {0x6c4819f3, 0xc9b7, 0x4260, {0x81, 0x27, 0xc9, 0xf5, 0xbd, 0xe7, 0xf6, 0x8c}};
static const IID k_iid_message = {0x57213f19, 0x00e6, 0x49fa, {0x8e, 0x07, 0x89, 0x8e, 0xa0, 0x1e, 0xcb, 0xd2}};
static const IID k_iid_close = {0x5c19e9e0, 0x092f, 0x486b, {0xaf, 0xfa, 0xca, 0x82, 0x31, 0x91, 0x30, 0x39}};
static const IID k_iid_navigated = {0xd33a35bf, 0x1c49, 0x4f98, {0x93, 0xab, 0x00, 0x6e, 0x05, 0x33, 0xfe, 0x1c}};
static const IID k_iid_key = {0xb29c7e28, 0xfa79, 0x41a8, {0x8e, 0x44, 0x65, 0x81, 0x1c, 0x76, 0xdc, 0xb2}};
static const IID k_iid_shot = {0x697e05e9, 0x3d8f, 0x45fa, {0x96, 0xf4, 0x8f, 0xfe, 0x1e, 0xde, 0xda, 0xf5}};
static const IID k_iid_script = {0x49511172, 0xcc67, 0x4bca, {0x99, 0x23, 0x13, 0x71, 0x12, 0xf4, 0xc4, 0xcc}};

/* COM objects for the callbacks: one static instance of each, no reference counting (they live as long as the process). */
#define HANDLER(T, iid, invoke_args)                                                                                     \
    static HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE T##_qi(T *This, REFIID riid, void **pp) {                                         \
        if (IsEqualIID(riid, &k_iid_unknown) || IsEqualIID(riid, &iid)) { *pp = This; return S_OK; }                      \
        *pp = NULL; return E_NOINTERFACE;                                                                                \
    }                                                                                                                    \
    static ULONG STDMETHODCALLTYPE T##_ref(T *This) { (void)This; return 1; }                                           \
    static HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE T##_invoke invoke_args;
HANDLER(ICoreWebView2CreateCoreWebView2EnvironmentCompletedHandler, k_iid_env_done,
        (ICoreWebView2CreateCoreWebView2EnvironmentCompletedHandler *This, HRESULT hr, ICoreWebView2Environment *env))

        (ICoreWebView2CreateCoreWebView2ControllerCompletedHandler *This, HRESULT hr, ICoreWebView2Controller *ctl))

        (ICoreWebView2WebMessageReceivedEventHandler *This, ICoreWebView2 *wv, ICoreWebView2WebMessageReceivedEventArgs *args))
HANDLER(ICoreWebView2WindowCloseRequestedEventHandler, k_iid_close,
        (ICoreWebView2WindowCloseRequestedEventHandler *This, ICoreWebView2 *wv, IUnknown *args))
HANDLER(ICoreWebView2NavigationCompletedEventHandler, k_iid_navigated,

HANDLER(ICoreWebView2ExecuteScriptCompletedHandler, k_iid_script, (ICoreWebView2ExecuteScriptCompletedHandler *This, HRESULT hr, LPCWSTR result))
#define VTBL(T) static T##Vtbl T##_vt = {T##_qi, T##_ref, T##_ref, T##_invoke}; static T T##_obj = {&T##_vt};
VTBL(ICoreWebView2CreateCoreWebView2EnvironmentCompletedHandler)
VTBL(ICoreWebView2CreateCoreWebView2ControllerCompletedHandler)
VTBL(ICoreWebView2WebMessageReceivedEventHandler)
VTBL(ICoreWebView2WindowCloseRequestedEventHandler)

static void fail_open(const char *what, HRESULT hr) {
    printf("guide: %s failed (0x%08lx): the page goes to the web browser instead\n", what, (unsigned long)hr);
    fflush(stdout);
    g_creating = 0;
    InterlockedExchange(&g_state, ST_FAILED);
}
static void fit(void) {
    RECT rc;
    if (g_ctl && GetClientRect(g_parent, &rc)) ICoreWebView2Controller_put_Bounds(g_ctl, rc);
}
static void show_page(void) {
    fit();
    ICoreWebView2Controller_put_IsVisible(g_ctl, TRUE);
    HRESULT hr = ICoreWebView2_Navigate(g_wv, g_url);
    if (FAILED(hr)) { fail_open("ICoreWebView2::Navigate", hr); ICoreWebView2Controller_put_IsVisible(g_ctl, FALSE); return; }
    ICoreWebView2Controller_MoveFocus(g_ctl, COREWEBVIEW2_MOVE_FOCUS_REASON_PROGRAMMATIC);
    InterlockedExchange(&g_state, ST_OPEN);
}
static void hide_page(int state) {
    if (g_ctl) ICoreWebView2Controller_put_IsVisible(g_ctl, FALSE);
    if (g_wv) ICoreWebView2_Navigate(g_wv, L"about:blank");             /* stops the page's timers and its videos */
    SetFocus(g_parent);
    InterlockedExchange(&g_state, state);
}

static HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE ICoreWebView2CreateCoreWebView2EnvironmentCompletedHandler_invoke(
        ICoreWebView2CreateCoreWebView2EnvironmentCompletedHandler *This, HRESULT hr, ICoreWebView2Environment *env) {
    (void)This;
    if (FAILED(hr) || !env) { fail_open("creating the WebView2 environment (is the WebView2 Runtime installed?)", hr); return S_OK; }
    g_env = env;
    ICoreWebView2Environment_AddRef(env);
    hr = ICoreWebView2Environment_CreateCoreWebView2Controller(env, g_parent, &ICoreWebView2CreateCoreWebView2ControllerCompletedHandler_obj);
    if (FAILED(hr)) fail_open("ICoreWebView2Environment::CreateCoreWebView2Controller", hr);
    return S_OK;
}
static HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE ICoreWebView2CreateCoreWebView2ControllerCompletedHandler_invoke(
        ICoreWebView2CreateCoreWebView2ControllerCompletedHandler *This, HRESULT hr, ICoreWebView2Controller *ctl) {
    (void)This;
    if (FAILED(hr) || !ctl) { fail_open("creating the WebView2 controller", hr); return S_OK; }
    g_ctl = ctl;
    ICoreWebView2Controller_AddRef(ctl);
    if (FAILED(ICoreWebView2Controller_get_CoreWebView2(ctl, &g_wv)) || !g_wv) { fail_open("ICoreWebView2Controller::get_CoreWebView2", E_FAIL); return S_OK; }
    ICoreWebView2Settings *s = NULL;
    if (SUCCEEDED(ICoreWebView2_get_Settings(g_wv, &s)) && s) {        /* an applet, not a browser: no menus, zoom, dev tools */
        ICoreWebView2Settings_put_AreDefaultContextMenusEnabled(s, FALSE);
        ICoreWebView2Settings_put_AreDevToolsEnabled(s, FALSE);
        ICoreWebView2Settings_put_IsZoomControlEnabled(s, FALSE);
        ICoreWebView2Settings_put_IsStatusBarEnabled(s, FALSE);
        ICoreWebView2Settings_Release(s);
    }
    EventRegistrationToken tok;
    ICoreWebView2_add_WebMessageReceived(g_wv, &ICoreWebView2WebMessageReceivedEventHandler_obj, &tok);
    ICoreWebView2_add_WindowCloseRequested(g_wv, &ICoreWebView2WindowCloseRequestedEventHandler_obj, &tok);
    ICoreWebView2_add_NavigationCompleted(g_wv, &ICoreWebView2NavigationCompletedEventHandler_obj, &tok);
    ICoreWebView2Controller_add_AcceleratorKeyPressed(ctl, &ICoreWebView2AcceleratorKeyPressedEventHandler_obj, &tok);
    g_creating = 0;
    printf("guide: WebView2 ready in the game window\n");
    show_page();
    return S_OK;
}
static HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE ICoreWebView2WebMessageReceivedEventHandler_invoke(
        ICoreWebView2WebMessageReceivedEventHandler *This, ICoreWebView2 *wv, ICoreWebView2WebMessageReceivedEventArgs *args) {
    (void)This; (void)wv;
    LPWSTR msg = NULL;
    if (SUCCEEDED(ICoreWebView2WebMessageReceivedEventArgs_TryGetWebMessageAsString(args, &msg)) && msg) {
        if (!wcscmp(msg, L"endApplet") && g_state == ST_OPEN) hide_page(ST_CLOSED);
        CoTaskMemFree(msg);
    }
    return S_OK;
}
static HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE ICoreWebView2WindowCloseRequestedEventHandler_invoke(
        ICoreWebView2WindowCloseRequestedEventHandler *This, ICoreWebView2 *wv, IUnknown *args) {
    (void)This; (void)wv; (void)args;
    if (g_state == ST_OPEN) hide_page(ST_CLOSED);
    return S_OK;
}
static IStream *g_shot_stream;
static HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE ICoreWebView2CapturePreviewCompletedHandler_invoke(ICoreWebView2CapturePreviewCompletedHandler *This, HRESULT hr) {
    (void)This;
    if (g_shot_stream) { IStream_Release(g_shot_stream); g_shot_stream = NULL; }     /* closes the file */
    printf("guide: SMO_GUIDE_SHOT: the page %s %s\n", SUCCEEDED(hr) ? "written to" : "NOT written to", g_shot_path);

    return S_OK;
}
static void CALLBACK shot_timer(HWND h, UINT m, UINT_PTR id, DWORD t) {    /* SMO_GUIDE_SHOT: after loading, after a pad action */
    (void)m; (void)t;
    KillTimer(h, id);
    wchar_t w[MAX_PATH];
    const char *base = getenv("SMO_GUIDE_SHOT"), *dot = strrchr(base, '.');
    if (!g_wv || g_state != ST_OPEN || g_shot_stream || g_shot_n >= 8) return;
    if (++g_shot_n == 1) snprintf(g_shot_path, sizeof g_shot_path, "%s", base);
    else snprintf(g_shot_path, sizeof g_shot_path, "%.*s_%d%s", dot ? (int)(dot - base) : (int)strlen(base), base, g_shot_n, dot ? dot : "");
    MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, g_shot_path, -1, w, MAX_PATH);
    if (SUCCEEDED(SHCreateStreamOnFileEx(w, STGM_CREATE | STGM_WRITE, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, TRUE, NULL, &g_shot_stream)))
        ICoreWebView2_CapturePreview(g_wv, COREWEBVIEW2_CAPTURE_PREVIEW_IMAGE_FORMAT_PNG, g_shot_stream, &ICoreWebView2CapturePreviewCompletedHandler_obj);
}
static HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE ICoreWebView2NavigationCompletedEventHandler_invoke(
        ICoreWebView2NavigationCompletedEventHandler *This, ICoreWebView2 *wv, ICoreWebView2NavigationCompletedEventArgs *args) {
    (void)This; (void)wv;
    BOOL ok = FALSE;
    ICoreWebView2NavigationCompletedEventArgs_get_IsSuccess(args, &ok);
    if (g_state != ST_OPEN) return S_OK;                                 /* about:blank after closing */
    printf("guide: the page %s\n", ok ? "has loaded" : "did NOT load");
    fflush(stdout);
    if (ok && getenv("SMO_GUIDE_SHOT")) SetTimer(g_parent, 0x4755, 1500, shot_timer);
    return S_OK;
}
static HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE ICoreWebView2AcceleratorKeyPressedEventHandler_invoke(
        ICoreWebView2AcceleratorKeyPressedEventHandler *This, ICoreWebView2Controller *ctl, ICoreWebView2AcceleratorKeyPressedEventArgs *args) {
    (void)This; (void)ctl;
    COREWEBVIEW2_KEY_EVENT_KIND kind;

        ICoreWebView2AcceleratorKeyPressedEventArgs_put_Handled(args, TRUE);

    (void)This; (void)hr; (void)result;
```
