```c
static void cmd_clear_texture(Ctx *c) {                 /* (cmdbuf, texture, view, region, color, mask); the i / ui variants pass integers */
    uint64_t view = A2, region = A3, color = A4, mask = A5;
    const char *name = hostfn_current_name();
    int kind = strstr(name, "Textureui") ? 2 : strstr(name, "Texturei") ? 1 : 0;
    Tex *t = hobj(A1, K_TEX);
    Cmd *m = rec(c, OP_CLEARTEX, 64);
    m->a[0] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)t; m->a[4] = mask; m->a[5] = (uint64_t)kind;
    memset(BLOB(m), 0, 64);
    if (view) memcpy(BLOB(m), P(view), sizeof(View));
    if (region) memcpy(BLOB(m) + 24, P(region), 24); else m->a[6] = 1;
    if (color) memcpy(BLOB(m) + 48, P(color), 16);
}
static void cmd_downsample_view(Ctx *c) {               /* (cmdbuf, src, srcView, dst, dstView) */
    uint64_t sv = A2, dv = A4;
    Tex *s = hobj(A1, K_TEX), *d = hobj(A3, K_TEX);
    Cmd *m = rec(c, OP_DOWNSAMPLE_VIEW, 48);
    m->a[0] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)s; m->a[1] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)d;
    memset(BLOB(m), 0, 48);
    if (sv) memcpy(BLOB(m), P(sv), sizeof(View));
    if (dv) memcpy(BLOB(m) + 24, P(dv), sizeof(View));
}
static void cmd_draw_arrays_indirect(Ctx *c) { Cmd *m = rec(c, OP_DRAW_INDIRECT, 0); m->a[6] = 0; m->a[4] = 1; m->a[5] = 0; m->a[3] = m->a[1]; m->a[1] = 0; m->a[2] = 0; }      /* (cmdbuf, mode, indirect) */
static void cmd_draw_elements_indirect(Ctx *c) { Cmd *m = rec(c, OP_DRAW_INDIRECT, 0); m->a[6] = 1; m->a[4] = 1; m->a[5] = 0; }   /* (cmdbuf, mode, type, indexBuffer, indirect) */
static void cmd_multi_draw_arrays_indirect(Ctx *c) {    /* (cmdbuf, mode, indirect, parameter, maxDrawCount, stride) */
    uint64_t indirect = A2, param = A3, maxn = A4, stride = A5;
    Cmd *m = rec(c, OP_DRAW_INDIRECT, 8);
    m->a[1] = 0; m->a[2] = 0; m->a[3] = indirect; m->a[4] = maxn; m->a[5] = stride; m->a[6] = 2;
    memcpy(BLOB(m), &param, 8);
}
static void cmd_multi_draw_elements_indirect(Ctx *c) {  /* (cmdbuf, mode, type, indexBuffer, indirect, parameter, maxDrawCount, stride) */
    uint64_t indirect = A4, param = A5, maxn = A6, stride = A7, index = A3;
    Cmd *m = rec(c, OP_DRAW_INDIRECT, 8);
    m->a[2] = index; m->a[3] = indirect; m->a[4] = maxn; m->a[5] = stride; m->a[6] = 3;
    memcpy(BLOB(m), &param, 8);
}
static void cmd_dispatch_indirect(Ctx *c) { cb_get(A0)->dispatches++; rec(c, OP_DISPATCH_INDIRECT, 0); }       /* (cmdbuf, address of three group counts) */
static void cmd_render_enable(Ctx *c) { Cmd *m = rec(c, OP_RENDER_ENABLE, 0); m->a[1] = 0; m->a[2] = 0; }                      /* (cmdbuf, enable) */
static void cmd_render_enable_cond(Ctx *c) { Cmd *m = rec(c, OP_RENDER_ENABLE, 0); m->a[2] = m->a[1]; m->a[1] = m->a[0] + 1; }   /* (cmdbuf, mode, counter address) */
static void cmd_reset_counter(Ctx *c) { rec(c, OP_COUNTER_RESET, 0); }
static void cmd_report_counter(Ctx *c) { rec(c, OP_COUNTER_REPORT, 0); }
static void cmd_report_value(Ctx *c) { rec(c, OP_REPORT_VALUE, 0); }
static void cmd_fence_sync(Ctx *c) { SyncObj *o = hobj(A1, K_SYNC); rec(c, OP_FENCE, 0)->a[0] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)o; }      /* (cmdbuf, sync, condition, flags) */
static void cmd_wait_sync(Ctx *c) { SyncObj *o = hobj(A1, K_SYNC); rec(c, OP_WAITSYNC, 0)->a[0] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)o; }
static void cmd_signal_event(Ctx *c) { uint64_t a = A1 ? rd64(A1 + 16) : 0; rec(c, OP_EVENT_SIGNAL, 0)->a[0] = a; }            /* (cmdbuf, event, mode, location, flags, value) */
static void cmd_wait_event(Ctx *c) { uint64_t a = A1 ? rd64(A1 + 16) : 0; rec(c, OP_EVENT_WAIT, 0)->a[0] = a; }                /* (cmdbuf, event, waitMode, value) */
/* nvnCommandBufferDrawTexture(cmdbuf, textureHandle, dstRegion, srcRegion) [sdk 0x438210]: see nvn_misc.c. The handle is the one
 * nvnDeviceGetTextureHandle gives (texture ID | sampler ID << 20, bit 32 set). An empty destination records nothing, as the
 * real encoder writes nothing [0x43827c]. */
static void cmd_draw_texture(Ctx *c) {
    uint64_t h = A1, dst = A2, src = A3;
    float d[4], s[4];
    NvnDrawTexture w;
    memcpy(d, P(dst), 16); memcpy(s, P(src), 16);
    if (!nvn_misc_draw_texture_words(d, s, &w)) return;
    w.src_texture = (uint32_t)h & 0xfffff; w.src_sampler = (uint32_t)h >> 20;   /* [sdk 0x4382f0, 0x4382f4] */
    Cmd *m = rec(c, OP_DRAW_TEXTURE, sizeof w);
    m->a[0] = h;
    memcpy(BLOB(m), &w, sizeof w);
}
static void cmd_covmod_table(Ctx *c) { uint64_t src = A1; Cmd *m = rec(c, OP_COVMODTABLE, 64); m->a[0] = src != 0; if (src) memcpy(BLOB(m), P(src), 64); }
static void rec_debug(Ctx *c, int kind, uint64_t id, uint64_t text) {
    size_t n = text ? strnlen(P(text), 255) : 0;
    Cmd *m = rec(c, OP_DEBUG, n + 1);
    m->a[0] = (uint64_t)kind; m->a[1] = id;
    if (n) memcpy(BLOB(m), P(text), n);
    BLOB(m)[n] = 0;
}
static void cmd_push_group(Ctx *c) { rec_debug(c, 0, A1, A2); }               /* (cmdbuf, domain, description) */
static void cmd_pop_group(Ctx *c) { rec_debug(c, 1, 0, 0); }
static void cmd_marker(Ctx *c) { rec_debug(c, 2, 0, A1); }                    /* (cmdbuf, description) */
static void cmd_marker_id(Ctx *c) { rec_debug(c, 2, A1, A2); }                /* (cmdbuf, domain, description) */
static void cmd_set_label(Ctx *c) { cb_get(A0); any_set_label(c); }

static void job_finalize_handle(void *arg) {
    uint64_t h = *(uint64_t *)arg;
    uint32_t i = (uint32_t)h - 1;
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_list_lock);
    if (h && i < (uint32_t)g_list_count && g_lists[i].data && (g_lists[i].gen & 0x7fffffff) == (uint32_t)(h >> 32)) g_lists[i].finalized = 1;
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_list_lock);
}
static void dev_finalize_command_handle(Ctx *c) {       /* (device, handle): the recorded commands of that handle are released (by the render thread, at the next present) */
    uint64_t h = A1;
    if (gl_async_on() && g_async_pending) gl_post(job_finalize_handle, &h, sizeof h);      /* after the submits already queued, which may still use it */
    else job_finalize_handle(&h);
}
/* ================================================================ the render thread's jobs in Vulkan mode
 * Every job the entry points above hand to the render thread arrives here when
 * the renderer is Vulkan (the default). A job nvn_vk.c implements is done there; one it does not implement is reported once with the name
 * of the NVN operation, counted and skipped (nvn_vk_missing; SMO_VK_MISSING=exit: the game stops there). A job that is not one
 * of this file's (nvn_vk.c's own, through nvn_render_run) runs as it is. */
void nvn_render_run(void (*fn)(void *), void *arg) { gl_run(fn, arg); }
/* the OpenGL back end as an RBackend (nvn_front.h); rb_vk is in nvn_vk_draw.c. */
static void rb_gl_idle(void) { gl_housekeeping(); }
const RBackend rb_gl = {"gl", job_submit, job_submit_async, job_present, job_fence, job_sync_wait, job_server_wait, job_sync_drop, job_flush, job_finish,
                        job_write_texels, job_read_texels, job_housekeeping, job_reset_status, job_grid, rb_gl_idle};

/* ---- front-end services for the Vulkan back end (nvn_front.h). They are thin doors to
 * the statics above; nothing here calls OpenGL. Render thread only, except where the callee has its own lock. */
int nvn_front_fmt(int nvn_format, Fmt *f) { return fmt_get(nvn_format, f); }
uint8_t *nvn_front_list(uint64_t handle, size_t *len) { return list_lookup(handle, len); }
/* debug aid: why a command handle has no list */
void nvn_front_list_stale(void) { InterlockedIncrement64(&g_st.stale); }      /* the Vulkan back end met an unknown handle */
const char *nvn_front_list_why(uint64_t h) {
    static char b[160];
    uint32_t i = (uint32_t)h - 1;
    AcquireSRWLockShared(&g_list_lock);
    if (!h || i >= (uint32_t)g_list_count) snprintf(b, sizeof b, "index %u never registered (%d lists)", i, g_list_count);
    else if ((g_lists[i].gen & 0x7fffffff) != (uint32_t)(h >> 32)) snprintf(b, sizeof b, "slot %u reused (handle generation %u, slot now %u, %s)", i, (uint32_t)(h >> 32), g_lists[i].gen & 0x7fffffff, g_lists[i].data ? "holding another list" : "empty");
    else snprintf(b, sizeof b, "slot %u dropped (finalized %d, created frame %lld, last used %lld, now %lld)", i, g_lists[i].finalized, (long long)g_lists[i].created, (long long)g_lists[i].used, (long long)g_st.frames);
    ReleaseSRWLockShared(&g_list_lock);
    return b;
}
/* step-aligned comparison of the two renderers: with SMO_SHOT_STEPS=1 the scripted input (nnhid.c)
 * asks for a screenshot when a key step of SMO_SEQ begins; the next presented frame is saved as step_<n>.bmp in
 * SMO_SHOT_DIR by whichever back end runs. Counted in input polls, so both renderers save the same game frame. */
static volatile LONG g_step_shot;
void nvn_front_shot_step(int step) { static int on = -1; if (on < 0) on = getenv("SMO_SHOT_STEPS") != NULL; if (on) InterlockedExchange(&g_step_shot, step + 1); }
int nvn_front_take_step_shot(void) { return g_step_shot ? (int)InterlockedExchange(&g_step_shot, 0) : 0; }
void nvn_front_batch_begin(void) { g_serial++; }
void nvn_front_barrier_texmem(void) { g_serial++; }
int nvn_front_tex_layers(const Tex *t) { return tex_layers(&t->b); }
int nvn_front_tex_levels(const Tex *t) {
    const TexBuilder *b = &t->b;
    int w = b->width > 0 ? b->width : 1, h = b->height > 0 ? b->height : 1, d = b->depth > 0 ? b->depth : 1, levels = b->levels > 0 ? b->levels : 1, maxdim = w > h ? w : h, maxl = 1;
    if (b->target == 2 && d > maxdim) maxdim = d;
    while ((maxdim >> maxl) > 0) maxl++;
    return b->samples > 1 ? 1 : levels > maxl ? maxl : levels;
}
/* The decision of tex_sync without its OpenGL calls (the same rule, the same fields of Tex). */
/* the back end wrote the texture's own texels into its pool memory (nvnTextureInvalidateTexels in nvn_vk_draw.c):
 * the hash is taken again so that this is not seen as a change by the game, exactly as job_read_texels does for OpenGL. */
void nvn_front_tex_rehash(Tex *t) { if (t && t->mem) t->hash = mem_hash(t->mem, t->data_size, t->ww_hashed || (t->b.flags & 0x10) != 0); }
int nvn_front_tex_changed(Tex *t) {
    Fmt f;
    if (t->checked == g_serial) return 0;
    t->checked = g_serial;
    const uint8_t *src = t->b.packaged ? P(t->b.packaged) : t->mem;
    if (t->gpu_written || !src || t->b.samples > 1 || !fmt_get(t->b.format, &f) || (f.kind >= 1 && f.kind <= 3)) return 0;
    if (!t->b.packaged && t->limit && src + t->data_size > t->limit) return 0;
    if (t->b.packaged && t->uploaded) return 0;
    /* NVN memory pool flags: the CPU cannot write a CPU_NO_ACCESS pool (1), and what it writes into a CPU_CACHED pool (4)
     * reaches the GPU only after nvnMemoryPoolFlushMappedRange / nvnBufferFlushMappedRange, which mark the textures there
     * dirty (nvn_gl_memory_written). So a texture there that was read once is read again only when it is dirty. Only
     * CPU_UNCACHED pools (2: writes are seen without a flush) need the check below. SMO's heap is a section view (smo_nn.c),
     * which write watch cannot follow, so before this every texture bound in a batch was hashed again (369 a frame in
     * Cascade Kingdom, all unchanged). SMO_TEXHASH_ALL=1: as before. */
    static int hash_all = -1;
    if (hash_all < 0) hash_all = getenv("SMO_TEXHASH_ALL") && atoi(getenv("SMO_TEXHASH_ALL"));
    if (!hash_all && t->uploaded && !t->dirty && (t->pool_flags & 1 || (t->pool_flags & 6) == 4)) { g_th_skip++; return 0; }
    LONG64 pf0 = pf_now();
    uint64_t newest = ww_newest(src, t->data_size);
    if (newest) {
        if (t->uploaded && !t->dirty && t->ww_hashed && newest <= t->ww_seen) { g_ww_clean++; pf_add(PF_TEXHASH, pf0); return 0; }
        t->ww_seen = newest;
        g_ww_dirty++;
    } else g_ww_unwatched++;
    int why = !t->uploaded ? 0 : t->dirty ? 1 : newest ? 2 : 3;      /* nvn_texhash line: first look, flushed by the game, pages written, memory not watched */
    uint64_t h = mem_hash(src, t->data_size, newest != 0 || (t->b.flags & 0x10) != 0);
    int same = t->uploaded && !t->dirty && h == t->hash && (!newest || t->ww_hashed);
    g_th_n[why]++; g_th_bytes[why] += (LONG64)t->data_size; if (t->uploaded && h == t->hash) g_th_same[why]++;
    t->ww_hashed = newest != 0;
    pf_add(PF_TEXHASH, pf0); g_pf_hash_bytes += (LONG64)t->data_size;
    if (same) return 0;
    t->hash = h; t->uploaded = 1; t->dirty = 0;
    g_st.tex_uploads++;
    return 1;
}
/* tex_upload_memory with the texels handed to the caller instead of glTexSubImage. */
int nvn_front_tex_read(Tex *t, int decode, nvn_front_put_fn *put) {
    static uint8_t *tmp;
    static size_t tmp_cap;
    Fmt f;
    TexBuilder *b = &t->b;
    const uint8_t *src = b->packaged ? P(b->packaged) : t->mem;
    if (!src || !fmt_get(b->format, &f)) return 0;
    if (b->flags & 0x10) {                         /* linear: plain rows with a stride */
        int64_t stride = b->stride ? b->stride : (int64_t)b->width * f.bpb;
        if (f.kind == 4) return 0;
        put(t, 0, 0, b->width, b->height, 1, src, (size_t)stride * (size_t)b->height, 0, stride);
        g_st.tex_bytes += stride * b->height;
        return 1;
    }
    TexLayout L;
    tex_lay(b, &L);
    int levels = nvn_front_tex_levels(t);
    for (int layer = 0; layer < L.layers; layer++) {
        for (int l = 0; l < levels && l < L.levels; l++) {
            const uint8_t *p = tex_level_ptr(&L, src, l, layer);
            size_t lin = L.lvl_linear_size[l], need = lin + (decode ? (size_t)L.lvl_w[l] * L.lvl_h[l] * 4 : 0);
            if (!b->packaged && t->limit && p + L.lvl_size[l] > t->limit) return 0;
            if (need > tmp_cap) { tmp_cap = need * 2; tmp = realloc(tmp, tmp_cap); }
            tex_deswizzle_level(&L, l, p, tmp);
            if (decode) {
                tex_decode_rgba8(b->format, tmp, L.lvl_w[l], L.lvl_h[l], tmp + lin);
                put(t, l, layer, L.lvl_w[l], L.lvl_h[l], 1, tmp + lin, (size_t)L.lvl_w[l] * L.lvl_h[l] * 4, 1, 0);
            } else put(t, l, layer, L.lvl_w[l], L.lvl_h[l], L.lvl_d[l], tmp, lin, 0, 0);
            g_st.tex_bytes += (LONG64)lin;
        }
    }
    return 1;
}
int nvn_front_handle(TexPool *tp, SamplerPool *sp, uint64_t nh, Tex **t, View *v, SamplerParams *p) {
    uint32_t tid = (uint32_t)nh & 0xfffff, sid = (uint32_t)(nh >> 20) & 0xfff;
    int r = 0;
    *t = NULL;
    if (!nh || !tp) return 0;
    AcquireSRWLockShared(&g_pool_lock);
    if (tid < (uint32_t)tp->count) { *t = tp->e[tid].tex; *v = tp->e[tid].view; }
    if (sp && sid < (uint32_t)sp->count && sp->used[sid]) { *p = sp->e[sid]; r |= 2; }
    ReleaseSRWLockShared(&g_pool_lock);
    if (*t && !(*t)->dead) r |= 1; else *t = NULL;
    return r;
}
/* debug aid: why nvn_front_handle found no texture for a handle (text for the bind log of SMO_VK_PASSSHOT). */
const char *nvn_front_handle_why(TexPool *tp, uint64_t nh) {
    static char b[256];
    uint32_t tid = (uint32_t)nh & 0xfffff;
    Tex *t = NULL;
    if (!tp) return "no texture pool bound";
    AcquireSRWLockShared(&g_pool_lock);
    int count = tp->count;
    if (tid < (uint32_t)count) t = tp->e[tid].tex;
    ReleaseSRWLockShared(&g_pool_lock);
    if (tid >= (uint32_t)count) { snprintf(b, sizeof b, "slot %u outside the pool (%d slots%s)", tid, count, count ? "" : ": pool finalized"); return b; }
    if (!t) { snprintf(b, sizeof b, "slot %u never registered", tid); return b; }
    Tex *now = t->guest ? hobj(t->guest, K_TEX) : NULL;
    snprintf(b, sizeof b, "slot %u holds a DEAD texture (guest %llx, %dx%d format 0x%x); live texture at that address now: %s%s", tid,
             (unsigned long long)t->guest, t->b.width, t->b.height, t->b.format, now && !now->dead ? "yes" : "no",
             now && !now->dead && now->mem == t->mem ? " (same memory)" : "");
    return b;
}
long long nvn_front_frame_next(void) { return (long long)g_st.frames + 1; }
/* compute outputs of the two back ends compared offline. SMO_COMPUTE_CMP=<folder>: every
 * dispatch is named by a hash of what it reads from guest memory (machine code, group counts, every bound uniform buffer,
 * every bound storage buffer it does not write; of the written ones the size); when what it wrote has landed in guest memory
 * the written ranges go to <folder>/<hash>_<storage index>.bin (the first SMO_COMPUTE_CMP_N distinct hashes, default 600).
 * Two runs (vk, gl) that met the same inputs wrote files of the same name. Render thread only. */
static struct { uint64_t h, addr, size; int n; } g_ccmp_pend[512];
static int g_ccmp_npend, g_ccmp_on = -1, g_ccmp_left;
static uint64_t g_ccmp_seen[4096];
static const char *g_ccmp_dir;
static uint64_t ccmp_hash(uint64_t h, const void *p, size_t n) {
    const uint8_t *b = p;
    size_t i = 0;
    for (; i + 8 <= n; i += 8) { uint64_t w; memcpy(&w, b + i, 8); h = (h ^ w) * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ULL; h ^= h >> 29; }
    for (; i < n; i++) h = (h ^ b[i]) * 0x100000001B3ULL;
    return h;
}
void nvn_front_ccmp_dispatch(const Range *ubo, const Range *ssbo, uint32_t written, const uint8_t *code, int code_len, unsigned gx, unsigned gy, unsigned gz) {
    if (g_ccmp_on < 0) { g_ccmp_dir = getenv("SMO_COMPUTE_CMP"); g_ccmp_on = g_ccmp_dir != NULL; g_ccmp_left = getenv("SMO_COMPUTE_CMP_N") ? atoi(getenv("SMO_COMPUTE_CMP_N")) : 600; if (g_ccmp_on) CreateDirectoryA(g_ccmp_dir, NULL); }
    if (!g_ccmp_on || g_ccmp_left <= 0 || !code || code_len <= 0) return;
    uint32_t g[3] = {gx, gy, gz};
    uint64_t h = ccmp_hash(0xcbf29ce484222325ULL, code, (size_t)code_len);
    h = ccmp_hash(h, g, sizeof g);
    for (int n = 0; n < 16; n++) if (ubo[n].addr && ubo[n].size) { h = ccmp_hash(h ^ (uint64_t)(n + 1), P(ubo[n].addr), (size_t)ubo[n].size); }
    for (int n = 0; n < 32; n++) {
        if (!ssbo[n].addr || !ssbo[n].size) continue;
        /* SMO_COMPUTE_CMP_MODE=1: storage buffers enter by SIZE only, written or not. Needed for skinning program #16: its
         * assembly text (OpenGL) declares storage 2 written, the translated machine code (Vulkan) 0, 1 and 2, so the
         * default naming never matches between the two. A false match (same sizes, other contents) shows as a difference. */
        static int mode = -1;
        if (mode < 0) mode = getenv("SMO_COMPUTE_CMP_MODE") ? atoi(getenv("SMO_COMPUTE_CMP_MODE")) : 0;
        if (mode == 1 || (written >> n & 1)) h = ccmp_hash(h ^ (uint64_t)(n + 101), &ssbo[n].size, 8);
        else h = ccmp_hash(h ^ (uint64_t)(n + 201), P(ssbo[n].addr), (size_t)ssbo[n].size);
    }
    unsigned slot = (unsigned)(h >> 17) & 4095;
    if (g_ccmp_seen[slot] == h) return;
    g_ccmp_seen[slot] = h;
    g_ccmp_left--;
    for (int n = 0; n < 32; n++) if ((written >> n & 1) && ssbo[n].addr && ssbo[n].size && g_ccmp_npend < 512) { g_ccmp_pend[g_ccmp_npend].h = h; g_ccmp_pend[g_ccmp_npend].addr = ssbo[n].addr; g_ccmp_pend[g_ccmp_npend].size = ssbo[n].size; g_ccmp_pend[g_ccmp_npend++].n = n; }
}
void nvn_front_ccmp_landed(void) {
    for (int i = 0; i < g_ccmp_npend; i++) {
        char path[400];
        snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/%016llx_%d.bin", g_ccmp_dir, (unsigned long long)g_ccmp_pend[i].h, g_ccmp_pend[i].n);
        FILE *fp = fopen(path, "wb");
        if (fp) { fwrite(P(g_ccmp_pend[i].addr), 1, (size_t)g_ccmp_pend[i].size, fp); fclose(fp); }
    }
    g_ccmp_npend = 0;
}
long long nvn_front_frame_end(long long draws, long long skipped, long long clears) {
    LONG64 frame = g_st.frames + 1;
    pf_frame_mark(frame);
    g_joblog_cur = frame;
    g_st.frames = frame;
    tl_frame_end(frame);
    if (frame <= 3 || frame % 600 == 0 || draws != 0 && g_logn < 40 && (g_logn++, 1))
        printf("nvn_vk: frame %lld: %lld draws (%lld skipped), %lld clears | totals: %lld lists, %lld textures, %lld uploads (%lld MB)\n", (long long)frame, draws, skipped, clears,
               (long long)g_st.lists, (long long)g_st.tex_created, (long long)g_st.tex_uploads, (long long)(g_st.tex_bytes >> 20));
    {   static ULONGLONG t0;
        static LONG64 d0;
        if (frame % 300 == 0) {
            ULONGLONG now = GetTickCount64();
            if (t0 && now > t0) printf("nvn_vk: frames %lld..%lld: %.1f fps, %lld draws per frame\n", (long long)frame - 300, (long long)frame, 300000.0 / (double)(now - t0), (long long)(g_st.draws - d0) / 300);
            t0 = now; d0 = g_st.draws;
        }
    }
    fflush(stdout);
    g_prev_frame_draws = draws;
    input_frame_draws((int)draws);
    list_collect();
    return (long long)frame;
}
void nvn_front_take_dead(void (*drop)(int kind, void *host)) {
    if (!g_dead_n) return;
    EnterCriticalSection(&g_dead_lock);
    for (int i = 0; i < g_dead_n; i++) {
        drop(g_dead[i].kind, g_dead[i].p);
        if (g_dead[i].kind == K_PROG) { Prog *p = g_dead[i].p; for (int s = 0; s < 6; s++) { free(p->st[s].text); memset(&p->st[s], 0, sizeof p->st[s]); } }
    }
    g_dead_n = 0;
    LeaveCriticalSection(&g_dead_lock);
}
void nvn_front_count(int what, long long n) {
    switch (what) { case 0: g_st.draws += n; break; case 1: g_st.draws_skipped += n; break; case 2: g_st.clears += n; break; case 3: g_st.submits += n; break; case 5: g_st.tex_created += n; break; }
}
int nvn_front_clip_modes(void) { return g_origin_mode | g_depth_mode << 8; }
const char *nvn_front_op_name(unsigned op) { return k_op_name[op < OP_COUNT ? op : 0]; }
void *nvn_front_hwnd(void) { return g_hwnd; }
static void job_vk_shutdown(void *arg) { (void)arg; nvn_vk_shutdown(); }
/* At exit (nvn_gl_report): the render thread destroys the Vulkan objects. It is given 3 s: a render thread that is held
 * in a job at that moment is left alone (the process is ending) and that is said. */
static void vk_shutdown_at_exit(void) {
    static Job j;
    if (GetCurrentThreadId() == g_render_tid) { nvn_vk_shutdown(); return; }
    j.fn = job_vk_shutdown; j.arg = NULL; j.next = NULL; j.done = CreateEventA(NULL, FALSE, FALSE, NULL);
    EnterCriticalSection(&g_job_lock);
    if (g_job_tail) g_job_tail->next = &j; else g_job_head = &j;
    g_job_tail = &j;
    LeaveCriticalSection(&g_job_lock);
    SetEvent(g_job_event);
    if (WaitForSingleObject(j.done, 3000) != WAIT_OBJECT_0) { printf("nvn_vk: shutdown NOT run: the render thread did not take the job within 3 s\n"); fflush(stdout); }
}

/* nvnBufferFlushMappedRange / nvnMemoryPoolFlushMappedRange (nvn_stub.c): the CPU wrote this memory. Textures stored there are read again. */
Tex *nvn_front_tex_first(void) { return g_all_tex; }
void nvn_gl_memory_written(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size) {
    if (!size) return;
    AcquireSRWLockShared(&g_tp_lock);
    if (g_tp_cap)
        for (uint64_t pg = addr >> TP_SHIFT, last = (addr + size - 1) >> TP_SHIFT; pg <= last; pg++) {
            const TexPage *p = tp_find(pg);
            if (p) for (int i = 0; i < p->n; i++) {
                Tex *t = p->t[i];
                if (!t->dead && (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)t->mem < addr + size && addr < (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)t->mem + t->storage) t->dirty = 1;
            }
        }
    ReleaseSRWLockShared(&g_tp_lock);
}

    {"nvnTextureGetZCullStorageSize", n_zero},

/* The host function for an NVN entry point, or NULL when this backend does not implement it. */
ImportFn nvn_gl_pick(const char *name) {
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof k_nvn / sizeof k_nvn[0]; i++) if (strcmp(name, k_nvn[i].name) == 0) return k_nvn[i].fn;
    return NULL;
}
```

`runtime/gfx/nvn_handles.c`:

```c
/* NVN: self-test of the guest-visible handle values.
 *
 * The game stores and passes on the handle values the driver makes, so they are the driver's own encodings. The real
 * functions (in the NVN driver of Super Smash Bros. Ultimate 13.0.4's SDK module, read by ssbu-recomp):
 *   nvnDeviceGetTextureHandle         [sdk 0x41bc80]  orr w8, w1, w2, lsl #20; sxtw x8, w8; orr x0, x8, #0x100000000
 *   nvnDeviceGetTexelFetchHandle      [sdk 0x41bc70]  sxtw x8, w1; orr x0, x8, #0x100000000
 *   nvnDeviceGetImageHandle           [sdk 0x41bc00]  sxtw x0, w1
 *   nvnDeviceGetSeparateTextureHandle [sdk 0x41bc60]  sxtw x8, w1; orr x0, x8, #0x100000000
 *   nvnDeviceGetSeparateSamplerHandle [sdk 0x41bc50]  sbfiz x0, x1, #20, #32
 * The table below is what those five functions return when run in the Unicorn emulator (upper halves of the argument
 * registers filled with garbage).
 * What Smash Ultimate does with the value (Ghidra, its main 13.0.4): FUN_71038037d0 and its five siblings (pointer kept at 0x710593f938)
 * and FUN_71000333b0 (pointer through 0x71052a2500) pass it unchanged to the next NVN call (nvnCommandBufferBindTexture);
 * no arithmetic on it was found at those call sites.
 */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include "runtime.h"
#include "nvn_handles.h"

int nvn_handles_selftest(Ctx *c) {
    static const struct { uint32_t tex, smp; uint64_t want[5]; } t[] = {      /* want: texture, texel fetch, image, separate texture, separate sampler */
        {0x0u, 0x0u, {0x0000000100000000ull, 0x0000000100000000ull, 0x0000000000000000ull, 0x0000000100000000ull, 0x0000000000000000ull}},
        {0x1u, 0x0u, {0x0000000100000001ull, 0x0000000100000001ull, 0x0000000000000001ull, 0x0000000100000001ull, 0x0000000000000000ull}},
        {0x7u, 0x5u, {0x0000000100500007ull, 0x0000000100000007ull, 0x0000000000000007ull, 0x0000000100000007ull, 0x0000000000500000ull}},
        {0x123u, 0x45u, {0x0000000104500123ull, 0x0000000100000123ull, 0x0000000000000123ull, 0x0000000100000123ull, 0x0000000004500000ull}},
        {0xfffffu, 0xfffu, {0xffffffffffffffffull, 0x00000001000fffffull, 0x00000000000fffffull, 0x00000001000fffffull, 0x00000000fff00000ull}},
        {0x100000u, 0x1u, {0x0000000100100000ull, 0x0000000100100000ull, 0x0000000000100000ull, 0x0000000100100000ull, 0x0000000000100000ull}},
        {0x80000u, 0x800u, {0xffffffff80080000ull, 0x0000000100080000ull, 0x0000000000080000ull, 0x0000000100080000ull, 0x0000000080000000ull}},
        {0x100u, 0x100u, {0x0000000110000100ull, 0x0000000100000100ull, 0x0000000000000100ull, 0x0000000100000100ull, 0x0000000010000000ull}},
        {0x7fffffffu, 0x0u, {0x000000017fffffffull, 0x000000017fffffffull, 0x000000007fffffffull, 0x000000017fffffffull, 0x0000000000000000ull}},
        {0x80000000u, 0x0u, {0xffffffff80000000ull, 0xffffffff80000000ull, 0xffffffff80000000ull, 0xffffffff80000000ull, 0x0000000000000000ull}},
        {0x7ffu, 0x7ffu, {0x000000017ff007ffull, 0x00000001000007ffull, 0x00000000000007ffull, 0x00000001000007ffull, 0x000000007ff00000ull}},
        {0x12345u, 0xfffu, {0xfffffffffff12345ull, 0x0000000100012345ull, 0x0000000000012345ull, 0x0000000100012345ull, 0x00000000fff00000ull}},
    };
    static const char *const name[5] = {"nvnDeviceGetTextureHandle", "nvnDeviceGetTexelFetchHandle", "nvnDeviceGetImageHandle", "nvnDeviceGetSeparateTextureHandle", "nvnDeviceGetSeparateSamplerHandle"};
    int bad = 0, n = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof t / sizeof t[0]; i++) for (int k = 0; k < 5; k++) {
        ImportFn fn = nvn_gl_pick(name[k]);
        uint64_t got = 0;
        n++;
        if (fn) {
            c->x[0] = 0x1000;                                           /* the device: not read by any of the five */
            c->x[1] = 0xabcdef0000000000ull | (k == 4 ? t[i].smp : t[i].tex);
            c->x[2] = 0xabcdef0000000000ull | t[i].smp;
            fn(c);
            got = c->x[0];
        }
        if (!fn || got != t[i].want[k]) { bad++; printf("  FAIL %s(texture 0x%x, sampler 0x%x) = 0x%llx, the SDK's code gives 0x%llx\n", name[k], t[i].tex, t[i].smp, (unsigned long long)got, (unsigned long long)t[i].want[k]); }
    }
    printf("  nvn_handles: %d handle cases, %d failed\n", n, bad);
    return bad;
}
```

`runtime/gfx/nvn_layout.c`:

```c
/* nvn_layout.c - the NVN texture-storage answers of nvn_sdk.h (size, alignment, block height, mip offsets), computed.
 *
 * The game's SDK module does not contain the NVN driver: it defines three NVN symbols (nvnBootstrapLoader,
 * nvnDevtoolsBootstrap, nvnBootstrapLoaderInternal) and the console supplies the driver. So there is no driver code to
 * lift, and the answers come from the layout engine of tex_decode.c (tex_layout).
 *
 * Verified (tests/bntx_layout_check.py): for every texture in the game's RomFS (20,203 in 4,666 archives) the storage
 * size, the block height and the offset of every mip level computed here are equal to the values Nintendo's tools
 * stored in the BNTX texture records. What that check does NOT cover, and how it is answered:
 *   - alignment: BNTX stores 512 for every texture (the container's data alignment), so it is no reference. The value
 *     here is tex_layout's rule, 512 << (block height log2 + block depth log2): one block of level 0, as ssbu-recomp read
 *     it in the NVN driver of Super Smash Bros. Ultimate 13.0.4. It is always a multiple of 512.
 *   - multisample: size x samples (ssbu-recomp's rule); not checked against this game.
 *   - linear (pitch) textures: stride x height (same source); not checked against this game.
 *   - buffer textures (target 10): size = width x bytes per element, alignment = bytes per element with 12 counted as 4
 *     (ssbu-recomp's reading of the same driver at [sdk 0x4278d8 / 0x427fe8]); not checked against this game.
 *   - storage class: 0x100 for every texture; why that cannot be misused is at nvn_sdk_texture_storage_class below.
 *   - raw storage class, sparse tile layout: NOT ANSWERED. A call stops the program with the function's name (no
 *     reference for this game's driver version; a guess could misplace textures in memory pools silently). */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <windows.h>
#include "hostrt.h"
#include "nvn_sdk.h"
#include "tex_decode.h"

int nvn_sdk_format_known(uint32_t format) { return tex_format((int)format) != NULL; }

static uint64_t buffer_bpe(uint32_t format) {
    const TexFormat *f = tex_format((int)format);
    return f ? (uint64_t)f->bpb : 4;
}

uint64_t nvn_sdk_texture_storage_size(Ctx *c, const NvnSdkTexBuilder *b) {
    (void)c;
    if (b->target == 10) return (uint64_t)(b->width ? b->width : 1) * buffer_bpe(b->format);
    if (b->flags & 0x10) {                                     /* NVN_TEXTURE_FLAGS_LINEAR */
        uint64_t row = b->stride ? b->stride : (uint64_t)(b->width ? b->width : 1) * buffer_bpe(b->format);
        return row * (b->height ? b->height : 1);
    }
    TexLayout L;
    tex_layout(&L, (int)b->target, (int)b->format, (int)b->width, (int)b->height, (int)b->depth, (int)b->levels,
               (int)(b->flags & ~0x50u), 0, b->has_layout && (b->layout & 0xff) <= 4 ? (int)(b->layout & 0xff) : -1);
    return (uint64_t)L.size * (b->samples > 1 ? b->samples : 1);
}

uint64_t nvn_sdk_texture_storage_alignment(Ctx *c, const NvnSdkTexBuilder *b) {
    (void)c;
    if (b->target == 10) { uint64_t e = buffer_bpe(b->format); return e == 12 ? 4 : e; }
    TexLayout L;
    tex_layout(&L, (int)b->target, (int)b->format, (int)b->width, (int)b->height, (int)b->depth, (int)b->levels,
               (int)b->flags, b->stride, b->has_layout && (b->layout & 0xff) <= 4 ? (int)(b->layout & 0xff) : -1);
    return (uint64_t)L.alignment;
}

static void not_answered(Ctx *c, const char *what) {
    printf("\nnvn: %s has no SMO answer yet (no reference for SMO's NVN driver version): stopping (see runtime/nvn_layout.c)\n", what);
    guest_trap("NVN storage query without an SMO answer", c ? c->x[30] - 4 : 0);
}
/* Storage class = 0x100 | GPU memory kind (ssbu-recomp's reading of Super Smash Bros. Ultimate 13.0.4's NVN driver). Its only consumer in NVN is
 * nvnMemoryPoolMapVirtual (a mapping request carries it; the driver passes class & ~0x100 to the GPU address-space remap,
 * nvn_stub.c), and the runtime's nvnMemoryPoolMapVirtual has no GPU memory kind to apply: it only prints the class.
 * The game reads the value in agl::detail::Surface::calcSizeAndAlignment (base game: [game 0x7b703c]) and stores it at
 * Surface +0x18; no agl function loads it back (a scan of all 3,382 agl functions of the base game, which has symbols).
 * The answer is therefore 0x100 (the
 * class with kind 0, which the driver gives linear textures) for every texture: a value that cannot be misused here. */
uint32_t nvn_sdk_texture_storage_class(Ctx *c, const NvnSdkTexBuilder *b) { (void)c; (void)b; return 0x100; }
uint32_t nvn_sdk_texture_raw_storage_class(Ctx *c, const NvnSdkTexBuilder *b) { (void)b; not_answered(c, "nvnTextureBuilderGetRawStorageClass"); return 0; }
void nvn_sdk_texture_sparse_layout(Ctx *c, const NvnSdkTexBuilder *b, uint32_t out[4]) { (void)b; (void)out; not_answered(c, "nvnTextureBuilderGetSparseTileLayout"); }
int nvn_sdk_tex_storage_class(Ctx *c, const NvnSdkTexBuilder *b, uint32_t *out) { *out = nvn_sdk_texture_storage_class(c, b); return 1; }
int nvn_sdk_tex_raw_storage_class(Ctx *c, const NvnSdkTexBuilder *b, uint32_t *out) { (void)b; (void)out; not_answered(c, "nvnTextureGetRawStorageClass"); return 0; }
int nvn_sdk_tex_sparse_layout(Ctx *c, const NvnSdkTexBuilder *b, uint32_t out[4]) { (void)b; (void)out; not_answered(c, "nvnTextureGetSparseTileLayout"); return 0; }
int nvn_sdk_tex_storage_size(Ctx *c, const NvnSdkTexBuilder *b, uint32_t *out) { *out = (uint32_t)nvn_sdk_texture_storage_size(c, b); return 1; }

int nvn_sdk_selftest(Ctx *c) {
    (void)c;
    printf("  nvn storage: computed for SMO (no lifted driver); verified offline by tests/bntx_layout_check.py\n");
    return 0;
}
```

`runtime/gfx/nvn_misc.c`:

```c
/* NVN entry points whose code does not need nvn_gl.c's state.
 *
 * nvnCommandBufferDrawTexture(cmdbuf, textureHandle, const NVNdrawTextureRegion *dst, const NVNdrawTextureRegion *src)  [sdk 0x438210]
 *   NVNdrawTextureRegion = four floats {x0, y0, x1, y1} (read with `ldp d0, d1, [x2]` and `ldp s3, s4, [x3]` / `ldp s1, s2, [x3, #8]`).
 *   The encoder computes twelve words and gives them to GPU method 0x420 (count 12) = suyu maxwell_3d.h Regs::DrawTexture
 *   (byte offset 0x1080): dst_x0, dst_y0, dst_width, dst_height (20.12 fixed), dx_du, dy_dv (32.32 fixed, texels per pixel),
 *   src_sampler, src_texture, src_x0, src_y0 (20.12 fixed, texels). Arithmetic, as in the code:
 *     q(v)      = floor(double(v) * 256 + 0.5) * 16                       [0x438234 .. 0x43826c; constant 256.0 = 0x4070000000000000]
 *     dst_x0/y0 = q(dst x0 / y0); dst_width / height = q(x1) - q(x0), q(y1) - q(y0) as 32-bit; nothing at all is written when
 *                 either is 0                                               [0x438270 .. 0x438284]
 *     dx_du     = floor(double(float(src x1 - src x0)) / (dst_width * 2^-12) * 2^32 + 0.5)   [0x438288 .. 0x4382cc; constants at
 *                 0xa12fe0 = 2^-12, 0xa12d10 = 2^32]; dy_dv the same with y  [0x4382d0 .. 0x4382ec]
 *     src_x0/y0 = q(src x0 / y0) (32-bit conversion)                        [0x4383d4 .. 0x438434; constant at 0xa13138 = 256.0]
 *     sampler / texture = bits 20..31 / 0..19 of the handle                 [0x4382f0, 0x4382f4]
 *   Around the method the encoder switches the shadow RAM to pass-through, writes depth_test_enable = 0 (0x4b3),
 *   stencil_enable = 0 (0x4e0), depth_bounds_enable = 0 (0x66f), const_color_rendering = 0 (0x3d0), vertex program B off
 *   (0x810 = 0x10), a driver fragment program on (0x850 = 0x51, 0x851 = its offset: device +0x94c plus [device +0x1ab0] +0x120),
 *   viewport 0 = full (0x300), tir_mode = 0 (0x3ed), multisample_coverage_to_color = 0 (0x47e), and afterwards replays the
 *   shadowed values (0x49 = 3) (decoded from the command words the real encoder writes when run in the Unicorn emulator).
 *   So: depth, stencil and depth bounds tests are off for this one operation, the game's shaders are not used, everything
 *   else (scissor, blending, colour mask, render targets) applies.
 * What the GPU does with the twelve words: suyu video_core/engines/draw_manager.cpp DrawTexture (destination rectangle =
 *   x0, y0, x0 + width, y0 + height in pixels; source = src_x0, src_y0, src_x0 + dx_du * width, src_y0 + dy_dv * height in
 *   texels) and renderer_opengl/gl_rasterizer.cpp DrawTexture: glDrawTextureNV(texture, sampler, destination, 0, source divided
 *   by the texture size). The same call is used here; unlike suyu the destination keeps its fraction (suyu truncates to int).
 *   UNVERIFIED: the driver's fragment program was not read (it is taken to be a plain texture fetch, as the reference does);
 *   the alpha test is applied with fixed function when the game has one set (the encoder does not turn it off).
 */
#include <math.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <windows.h>
#include <GL/gl.h>
#include "nvn_misc.h"

/* AArch64 conversions used by the encoder */
static int64_t fcvtzs64(double v) {                 /* double -> int64, toward zero, saturating, NaN -> 0 */
    if (v != v) return 0;
    if (v >= 9223372036854775808.0) return INT64_MAX;
    if (v <= -9223372036854775808.0) return INT64_MIN;
    return (int64_t)v;
}
static int32_t fcvtzs32(double v) {
    if (v != v) return 0;
    if (v >= 2147483648.0) return INT32_MAX;
    if (v <= -2147483648.0) return INT32_MIN;
    return (int32_t)v;
}
static double q256(float v) { return floor((double)v * 256.0 + 0.5); }

int nvn_misc_draw_texture_words(const float dst[4], const float src[4], NvnDrawTexture *o) {
    int32_t x0 = (int32_t)(uint32_t)(uint64_t)fcvtzs64(q256(dst[0]) * 16.0), y0 = (int32_t)(uint32_t)(uint64_t)fcvtzs64(q256(dst[1]) * 16.0);
    int32_t x1 = (int32_t)(uint32_t)(uint64_t)fcvtzs64(q256(dst[2]) * 16.0), y1 = (int32_t)(uint32_t)(uint64_t)fcvtzs64(q256(dst[3]) * 16.0);
    int32_t w = (int32_t)((uint32_t)x1 - (uint32_t)x0), h = (int32_t)((uint32_t)y1 - (uint32_t)y0);
    memset(o, 0, sizeof *o);
    if (w == 0 || h == 0) return 0;
    float du = src[2] - src[0], dv = src[3] - src[1];
    o->dst_x0 = x0; o->dst_y0 = y0; o->dst_width = w; o->dst_height = h;
    o->dx_du = fcvtzs64(floor((double)du / ((double)w * 0.000244140625) * 4294967296.0 + 0.5));
    o->dy_dv = fcvtzs64(floor((double)dv / ((double)h * 0.000244140625) * 4294967296.0 + 0.5));
    o->src_x0 = fcvtzs32(q256(src[0]) * 16.0);
    o->src_y0 = fcvtzs32(q256(src[1]) * 16.0);
    return 1;
}

void nvn_misc_draw_texture_rect(const NvnDrawTexture *w, float out[8]) {       /* suyu draw_manager.cpp DrawTexture */
    float dw = (float)w->dst_width / 4096.f, dh = (float)w->dst_height / 4096.f;
    out[0] = (float)w->dst_x0 / 4096.f; out[1] = (float)w->dst_y0 / 4096.f;
    out[2] = out[0] + dw; out[3] = out[1] + dh;
    out[4] = (float)w->src_x0 / 4096.f; out[5] = (float)w->src_y0 / 4096.f;
    out[6] = ((float)w->dx_du / 4294967296.f) * dw + out[4];
    out[7] = ((float)w->dy_dv / 4294967296.f) * dh + out[5];
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- OpenGL (render thread) */
static void (APIENTRY *p_DrawTextureNV)(GLuint, GLuint, GLfloat, GLfloat, GLfloat, GLfloat, GLfloat, GLfloat, GLfloat, GLfloat, GLfloat);
static void (APIENTRY *p_GetTextureParameteriv)(GLuint, GLenum, GLint *);
static void (APIENTRY *p_GetTextureLevelParameteriv)(GLuint, GLint, GLenum, GLint *);
static int g_gl_loaded;
static void gl_load(void) {
    if (g_gl_loaded) return;
    g_gl_loaded = 1;
    p_DrawTextureNV = (void *)wglGetProcAddress("glDrawTextureNV");
    p_GetTextureParameteriv = (void *)wglGetProcAddress("glGetTextureParameteriv");
    p_GetTextureLevelParameteriv = (void *)wglGetProcAddress("glGetTextureLevelParameteriv");
}

int nvn_misc_draw_texture_gl(unsigned tex, unsigned smp, const NvnDrawTexture *w, int alpha_func, float alpha_ref) {
    float r[8];
    GLint target = 0, tw = 0, th = 0, base = 0;
    gl_load();
    if (!p_DrawTextureNV || !p_GetTextureParameteriv || !p_GetTextureLevelParameteriv) {
        printf("nvn: stopping: nvnCommandBufferDrawTexture needs GL_NV_draw_texture and OpenGL 4.5, which this driver lacks\n");
        fflush(stdout);
        ExitProcess(6);
    }
    p_GetTextureParameteriv(tex, 0x1006 /* TEXTURE_TARGET */, &target);
    if (target != GL_TEXTURE_2D && target != 0x84F5 /* TEXTURE_RECTANGLE */) return 0;
    p_GetTextureParameteriv(tex, 0x813C /* TEXTURE_BASE_LEVEL */, &base);
    p_GetTextureLevelParameteriv(tex, base, GL_TEXTURE_WIDTH, &tw);
    p_GetTextureLevelParameteriv(tex, base, GL_TEXTURE_HEIGHT, &th);
    if (tw <= 0 || th <= 0) return 0;
    nvn_misc_draw_texture_rect(w, r);
    GLboolean depth = glIsEnabled(GL_DEPTH_TEST), stencil = glIsEnabled(GL_STENCIL_TEST), bounds = glIsEnabled(0x8890 /* DEPTH_BOUNDS_TEST_EXT */);
    GLboolean alpha = glIsEnabled(GL_ALPHA_TEST);
    GLint afunc = GL_ALWAYS; GLfloat aref = 0;
    glGetIntegerv(GL_ALPHA_TEST_FUNC, &afunc); glGetFloatv(GL_ALPHA_TEST_REF, &aref);
    if (depth) glDisable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);
    if (stencil) glDisable(GL_STENCIL_TEST);
    if (bounds) glDisable(0x8890);
    if (alpha_func >= 1 && alpha_func <= 7) { glAlphaFunc(GL_NEVER + (GLenum)(alpha_func - 1), alpha_ref); glEnable(GL_ALPHA_TEST); }   /* NVN compare functions 1..8 = NEVER..ALWAYS */
    else if (alpha) glDisable(GL_ALPHA_TEST);
    if (target == GL_TEXTURE_2D) p_DrawTextureNV(tex, smp, r[0], r[1], r[2], r[3], 0.f, r[4] / (float)tw, r[5] / (float)th, r[6] / (float)tw, r[7] / (float)th);
    else p_DrawTextureNV(tex, smp, r[0], r[1], r[2], r[3], 0.f, r[4], r[5], r[6], r[7]);                                          /* rectangle textures take texels */
    glAlphaFunc((GLenum)afunc, aref);
    if (alpha) glEnable(GL_ALPHA_TEST); else glDisable(GL_ALPHA_TEST);
    if (bounds) glEnable(0x8890);
    if (stencil) glEnable(GL_STENCIL_TEST);
    if (depth) glEnable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);
    return 1;
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- self-tests */
int nvn_misc_selftest(void) {
    /* the command words of the real encoder [sdk 0x438210], run in
     * the Unicorn emulator; handle 0x00500007 (sampler 5, texture 7) */
    static const struct { float dst[4], src[4]; int written; uint32_t w[12]; } t[] = {
        {{10.0f, 20.0f, 110.0f, 70.0f}, {0.0f, 0.0f, 64.0f, 32.0f}, 1, {0x0000a000, 0x00014000, 0x00064000, 0x00032000, 0xa3d70a3d, 0x00000000, 0xa3d70a3d, 0x00000000, 0x00000005, 0x00000007, 0x00000000, 0x00000000}},
        {{0.5f, 0.25f, 3.75f, 9.126f}, {1.5f, 2.25f, 7.0f, 3.0f}, 1, {0x00000800, 0x00000400, 0x00003400, 0x00008e00, 0xb13b13b1, 0x00000001, 0x15a240e7, 0x00000000, 0x00000005, 0x00000007, 0x00001800, 0x00002400}},
        {{100.0f, 50.0f, 20.0f, 10.0f}, {0.0f, 0.0f, 16.0f, 16.0f}, 1, {0x00064000, 0x00032000, 0xfffb0000, 0xfffd8000, 0xcccccccd, 0xffffffff, 0x9999999a, 0xffffffff, 0x00000005, 0x00000007, 0x00000000, 0x00000000}},
        {{-8.3f, -2.7f, 40.1f, 33.3f}, {5.0f, 6.0f, 1.0f, 2.0f}, 1, {0xffff7b30, 0xffffd4d0, 0x00030670, 0x00024000, 0xead8105d, 0xffffffff, 0xe38e38e4, 0xffffffff, 0x00000005, 0x00000007, 0x00005000, 0x00006000}},
        {{0.0f, 0.0f, 1280.0f, 720.0f}, {0.0f, 0.0f, 1920.0f, 1080.0f}, 1, {0x00000000, 0x00000000, 0x00500000, 0x002d0000, 0x80000000, 0x00000001, 0x80000000, 0x00000001, 0x00000005, 0x00000007, 0x00000000, 0x00000000}},
        {{3.0f, 3.0f, 3.001f, 9.0f}, {0.0f, 0.0f, 4.0f, 4.0f}, 0, {0x00000000, 0x00000000, 0x00000000, 0x00000000, 0x00000000, 0x00000000, 0x00000000, 0x00000000, 0x00000000, 0x00000000, 0x00000000, 0x00000000}},
        {{3.0f, 3.0f, 3.002f, 9.0f}, {0.0f, 0.0f, 4.0f, 4.0f}, 1, {0x00003000, 0x00003000, 0x00000010, 0x00006000, 0x00000000, 0x00000400, 0xaaaaaaab, 0x00000000, 0x00000005, 0x00000007, 0x00000000, 0x00000000}},
        {{7.0f, 9.0f, 7.0f, 30.0f}, {0.0f, 0.0f, 4.0f, 4.0f}, 0, {0x00000000, 0x00000000, 0x00000000, 0x00000000, 0x00000000, 0x00000000, 0x00000000, 0x00000000, 0x00000000, 0x00000000, 0x00000000, 0x00000000}},
        {{7.0f, 9.0f, 30.0f, 9.0f}, {0.0f, 0.0f, 4.0f, 4.0f}, 0, {0x00000000, 0x00000000, 0x00000000, 0x00000000, 0x00000000, 0x00000000, 0x00000000, 0x00000000, 0x00000000, 0x00000000, 0x00000000, 0x00000000}},
        {{1.998f, 0.002f, 600.37f, 4000.49f}, {0.1f, 0.9f, 1023.7f, 511.2f}, 1, {0x00001ff0, 0x00000010, 0x00256600, 0x00fa07c0, 0xb5ec0bc4, 0x00000001, 0x20a7be42, 0x00000000, 0x00000005, 0x00000007, 0x000001a0, 0x00000e60}},
        {{16.0f, 16.0f, 48.0f, 80.0f}, {64.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f, 128.0f}, 1, {0x00010000, 0x00010000, 0x00020000, 0x00040000, 0x00000000, 0xfffffffe, 0x00000000, 0x00000002, 0x00000005, 0x00000007, 0x00040000, 0x00000000}},
    };
    int bad = 0, n = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof t / sizeof t[0]; i++) {
        NvnDrawTexture w;
        uint32_t g[12];
        int wr = nvn_misc_draw_texture_words(t[i].dst, t[i].src, &w);
        w.src_sampler = 5; w.src_texture = 7;
        g[0] = (uint32_t)w.dst_x0; g[1] = (uint32_t)w.dst_y0; g[2] = (uint32_t)w.dst_width; g[3] = (uint32_t)w.dst_height;
        g[4] = (uint32_t)w.dx_du; g[5] = (uint32_t)((uint64_t)w.dx_du >> 32); g[6] = (uint32_t)w.dy_dv; g[7] = (uint32_t)((uint64_t)w.dy_dv >> 32);
        g[8] = w.src_sampler; g[9] = w.src_texture; g[10] = (uint32_t)w.src_x0; g[11] = (uint32_t)w.src_y0;
        n++;
        if (wr != t[i].written || (wr && memcmp(g, t[i].w, sizeof g))) {
            bad++;
            printf("  FAIL nvn DrawTexture words, case %d: written %d (emulator %d):", (int)i, wr, t[i].written);
            for (int k = 0; k < 12; k++) printf(" %08x%s", g[k], g[k] == t[i].w[k] ? "" : "!");
            printf("\n");
        }
    }
    {   /* suyu's rectangle from the first case: destination (10,20)-(110,70), source (0,0)-(64,32) */
        NvnDrawTexture w;
        float r[8];
        static const float want[8] = {10, 20, 110, 70, 0, 0, 64, 32};
        nvn_misc_draw_texture_words(t[0].dst, t[0].src, &w);
        nvn_misc_draw_texture_rect(&w, r);
        n++;
        for (int k = 0; k < 8; k++) if (fabsf(r[k] - want[k]) > 1e-4f) { bad++; printf("  FAIL nvn DrawTexture rectangle word %d: %f, expected %f\n", k, r[k], want[k]); break; }
    }
    printf("  nvn_misc: %d DrawTexture encoder cases, %d failed\n", n, bad);
    return bad;
}

/* OpenGL self-test (SMO_NVN_GLTEST=1, run by the render thread once the context exists): draws a 4x2 texture with
 * nvn_misc_draw_texture_gl into a 16x16 target and reads the pixels back. */
static void (APIENTRY *p_GenFramebuffers)(GLsizei, GLuint *);
static void (APIENTRY *p_BindFramebuffer)(GLenum, GLuint);
static void (APIENTRY *p_FramebufferTexture)(GLenum, GLenum, GLuint, GLint);
static GLenum (APIENTRY *p_CheckFramebufferStatus)(GLenum);
static void (APIENTRY *p_TexStorage2D)(GLenum, GLsizei, GLenum, GLsizei, GLsizei);
static void (APIENTRY *p_GenSamplers)(GLsizei, GLuint *);
static void (APIENTRY *p_SamplerParameteri)(GLuint, GLenum, GLint);

static int gltest_case(const char *name, GLuint tex, GLuint smp, const float dst[4], const float src[4], const uint8_t texels[2][4][4], int flip_x, int flip_y) {
    static uint8_t px[16 * 16 * 4];
    NvnDrawTexture w;
    int bad = 0;
    glClearColor(0, 0, 0, 0);
    glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT | GL_DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT | GL_STENCIL_BUFFER_BIT);
    if (!nvn_misc_draw_texture_words(dst, src, &w)) { printf("  FAIL %s: the encoder wrote nothing\n", name); return 1; }
    if (!nvn_misc_draw_texture_gl(tex, smp, &w, 0, 0.f)) { printf("  FAIL %s: not drawn\n", name); return 1; }
    glReadPixels(0, 0, 16, 16, GL_RGBA, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, px);
    for (int y = 0; y < 16; y++) for (int x = 0; x < 16; x++) {
        uint8_t want[4] = {0, 0, 0, 0};
        if (x >= 4 && x < 12 && y >= 2 && y < 6) {
            int tx = (x - 4) / 2, ty = (y - 2) / 2;
            memcpy(want, texels[flip_y ? 1 - ty : ty][flip_x ? 3 - tx : tx], 4);
        }
        if (memcmp(want, px + (y * 16 + x) * 4, 4)) {
            if (bad < 4) printf("  FAIL %s: pixel (%d,%d) = %02x %02x %02x %02x, expected %02x %02x %02x %02x\n", name, x, y, px[(y * 16 + x) * 4], px[(y * 16 + x) * 4 + 1],
                                px[(y * 16 + x) * 4 + 2], px[(y * 16 + x) * 4 + 3], want[0], want[1], want[2], want[3]);
            bad++;
        }
    }
    return bad != 0;
}
void nvn_misc_gl_selftest_hook(void) {
    if (!getenv("SMO_NVN_GLTEST")) return;
    static const uint8_t texels[2][4][4] = {{{255, 0, 0, 255}, {0, 255, 0, 255}, {0, 0, 255, 255}, {255, 255, 0, 255}}, {{0, 255, 255, 255}, {255, 0, 255, 255}, {64, 128, 192, 255}, {255, 255, 255, 255}}};
    static const float dst[4] = {4, 2, 12, 6}, src[4] = {0, 0, 4, 2}, src_fx[4] = {4, 0, 0, 2}, src_fy[4] = {0, 2, 4, 0};
    GLuint tex, target, depth, fbo, smp;
    int bad = 0, n = 0;
    gl_load();
    p_GenFramebuffers = (void *)wglGetProcAddress("glGenFramebuffers"); p_BindFramebuffer = (void *)wglGetProcAddress("glBindFramebuffer");
    p_FramebufferTexture = (void *)wglGetProcAddress("glFramebufferTexture"); p_CheckFramebufferStatus = (void *)wglGetProcAddress("glCheckFramebufferStatus");
    p_TexStorage2D = (void *)wglGetProcAddress("glTexStorage2D"); p_GenSamplers = (void *)wglGetProcAddress("glGenSamplers"); p_SamplerParameteri = (void *)wglGetProcAddress("glSamplerParameteri");
    printf("NVN OpenGL self-test: GL_NV_draw_texture %s\n", p_DrawTextureNV ? "present" : "MISSING");
    if (!p_DrawTextureNV) { fflush(stdout); ExitProcess(1); }
    glGenTextures(1, &tex); glBindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_2D, tex); p_TexStorage2D(GL_TEXTURE_2D, 1, 0x8058 /* RGBA8 */, 4, 2);
    glPixelStorei(GL_UNPACK_ALIGNMENT, 1); glPixelStorei(GL_PACK_ALIGNMENT, 1);
    glTexSubImage2D(GL_TEXTURE_2D, 0, 0, 0, 4, 2, GL_RGBA, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, texels);
    glGenTextures(1, &target); glBindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_2D, target); p_TexStorage2D(GL_TEXTURE_2D, 1, 0x8058, 16, 16);
    glGenTextures(1, &depth); glBindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_2D, depth); p_TexStorage2D(GL_TEXTURE_2D, 1, 0x88F0 /* DEPTH24_STENCIL8 */, 16, 16);
    glBindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_2D, 0);
    p_GenSamplers(1, &smp);
    p_SamplerParameteri(smp, GL_TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, GL_NEAREST); p_SamplerParameteri(smp, GL_TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, GL_NEAREST);
    p_SamplerParameteri(smp, GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_S, 0x812F /* CLAMP_TO_EDGE */); p_SamplerParameteri(smp, GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_T, 0x812F);
    p_GenFramebuffers(1, &fbo); p_BindFramebuffer(0x8D40, fbo);
    p_FramebufferTexture(0x8D40, 0x8CE0 /* COLOR_ATTACHMENT0 */, target, 0); p_FramebufferTexture(0x8D40, 0x821A /* DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT */, depth, 0);
    if (p_CheckFramebufferStatus(0x8D40) != 0x8CD5) { printf("  FAIL framebuffer incomplete\n"); fflush(stdout); ExitProcess(1); }
    glViewport(0, 0, 16, 16);
    n++; bad += gltest_case("each texel -> 2x2 pixels, destination (4,2)-(12,6), row 0 of the texture at the lower window y", tex, smp, dst, src, texels, 0, 0);
    n++; bad += gltest_case("source x reversed", tex, smp, dst, src_fx, texels, 1, 0);
    n++; bad += gltest_case("source y reversed", tex, smp, dst, src_fy, texels, 0, 1);
    /* depth and stencil tests that would reject every fragment: the operation turns them off [sdk: methods 0x4b3, 0x4e0 = 0] and puts them back */
    glEnable(GL_DEPTH_TEST); glDepthFunc(GL_NEVER); glEnable(GL_STENCIL_TEST); glStencilFunc(GL_NEVER, 0, 0xff);
    n++; bad += gltest_case("depth func NEVER and stencil func NEVER do not apply", tex, smp, dst, src, texels, 0, 0);
    n++; if (!glIsEnabled(GL_DEPTH_TEST) || !glIsEnabled(GL_STENCIL_TEST)) { bad++; printf("  FAIL depth / stencil enables were not restored\n"); }
    glDisable(GL_DEPTH_TEST); glDepthFunc(GL_LESS); glDisable(GL_STENCIL_TEST); glStencilFunc(GL_ALWAYS, 0, 0xff);
    {   /* scissor applies: only x < 8 may be written */
        static uint8_t px[16 * 16 * 4];
        NvnDrawTexture w;
        int wrong = 0;
        glDisable(GL_SCISSOR_TEST); glClearColor(0, 0, 0, 0); glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);
        glEnable(GL_SCISSOR_TEST); glScissor(0, 0, 8, 16);
        nvn_misc_draw_texture_words(dst, src, &w); nvn_misc_draw_texture_gl(tex, smp, &w, 0, 0.f);
        glScissor(0, 0, 16384, 16384);
        glReadPixels(0, 0, 16, 16, GL_RGBA, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, px);
        for (int y = 0; y < 16; y++) for (int x = 0; x < 16; x++) { int in = x >= 4 && x < 8 && y >= 2 && y < 6; if ((px[(y * 16 + x) * 4 + 3] != 0) != in) wrong++; }
        n++; if (wrong) { bad++; printf("  FAIL scissor: %d pixels wrong\n", wrong); }
    }
    {   /* alpha test (fixed function) with the NVN function 5 = GREATER, reference 2.0: nothing passes; state restored */
        static uint8_t px[16 * 16 * 4];
        NvnDrawTexture w;
        int written = 0;
        glClearColor(0, 0, 0, 0); glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);
        nvn_misc_draw_texture_words(dst, src, &w); nvn_misc_draw_texture_gl(tex, smp, &w, 5, 2.0f);
        glReadPixels(0, 0, 16, 16, GL_RGBA, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, px);
        for (int i = 0; i < 16 * 16; i++) if (px[i * 4 + 3]) written++;
        n++; if (written || glIsEnabled(GL_ALPHA_TEST)) { bad++; printf("  FAIL alpha test GREATER 2.0: %d pixels written, alpha test left %s\n", written, glIsEnabled(GL_ALPHA_TEST) ? "on" : "off"); }
    }
    GLenum err = glGetError();
    n++; if (err) { bad++; printf("  FAIL OpenGL error 0x%x\n", err); }
    printf("NVN OpenGL self-test: %d cases, %d failure(s)\n", n, bad);
    fflush(stdout);
    ExitProcess((UINT)bad);
}
```

`runtime/gfx/nvn_misc.h`:

```h
/* NVN functions that do not need nvn_gl.c's state: see nvn_misc.c. */
#ifndef NVN_MISC_H
#define NVN_MISC_H
#include <stdint.h>

/* The twelve words nvnCommandBufferDrawTexture gives to GPU method 0x420 (suyu maxwell_3d.h Regs::DrawTexture, byte 0x1080). */
typedef struct {
    int32_t dst_x0, dst_y0, dst_width, dst_height;     /* 20.12 fixed point */
    int64_t dx_du, dy_dv;                              /* 32.32 fixed point: texels per pixel */
    uint32_t src_sampler, src_texture;
    int32_t src_x0, src_y0;                            /* 20.12 fixed point, texels */
} NvnDrawTexture;

/* dst / src = NVNdrawTextureRegion {x0, y0, x1, y1} (floats). Returns 0 when the encoder writes nothing (empty destination). */
int nvn_misc_draw_texture_words(const float dst[4], const float src[4], NvnDrawTexture *o);
/* Destination rectangle (pixels) and source rectangle (texels) the GPU derives from the words: out = dx0, dy0, dx1, dy1, sx0, sy0, sx1, sy1. */
void nvn_misc_draw_texture_rect(const NvnDrawTexture *w, float out[8]);
/* Render thread: draw with GL_NV_draw_texture into the bound framebuffer. alpha_func = NVN compare function (0 / 8 = no test).
 * Returns 0 if the texture is not a 2D or rectangle texture (nothing drawn). */
int nvn_misc_draw_texture_gl(unsigned tex, unsigned smp, const NvnDrawTexture *w, int alpha_func, float alpha_ref);
/* Render thread, after the context is ready: with SMO_NVN_GLTEST set, run the OpenGL self-test and exit (exit code = failures). */
void nvn_misc_gl_selftest_hook(void);
/* Part of the SDK self-test (no OpenGL): the encoder arithmetic against words produced by the emulator on sdk.elf. */
int nvn_misc_selftest(void);
#endif
```

`runtime/gfx/nvn_stub.c`:

```c
/* Graphics entry points: hands out a host function for every NVN name the game asks for.
 * Device information, memory pools and buffers are here; everything else is in nvn_gl.c (OpenGL).
 * A name that neither implements is MISSING: it is announced when the game fetches it, and calling it stops the game with
 * the function's name (SMO_NVN_MISSING=warn: report the call, answer 0 and go on, for exploration). */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <windows.h>
#include "runtime.h"
#include "hostrt.h"

#define A0 (c->x[0])
#define A1 (c->x[1])
#define A2 (c->x[2])
#define RET(v) (c->x[0] = (uint64_t)(v))

static void log_call(Ctx *c) {
    if (hostfn_current_calls() <= 3)
        trace_printf("     nvn %s  x0=%llx x1=%llx x2=%llx x3=%llx  from=%llx\n", hostfn_current_name(),
                     (unsigned long long)c->x[0], (unsigned long long)c->x[1], (unsigned long long)c->x[2],
                     (unsigned long long)c->x[3], (unsigned long long)c->x[30] - 4);
}
/* An entry point with no implementation. */
static int missing_warn_only(void) {
    static int mode = -1;
    if (mode < 0) { const char *e = getenv("SMO_NVN_MISSING"); mode = e && !strcmp(e, "warn"); }
    return mode;
}
static void nvn_generic(Ctx *c) {
    log_call(c);
    printf("nvn: MISSING function %s was called (x0=%llx x1=%llx x2=%llx x3=%llx)%c", hostfn_current_name(), (unsigned long long)c->x[0], (unsigned long long)c->x[1],
           (unsigned long long)c->x[2], (unsigned long long)c->x[3], 10);
    fflush(stdout);
    if (!missing_warn_only()) {
        printf("nvn: stopping: %s has no implementation (SMO_NVN_MISSING=warn to continue with a zero answer)%c", hostfn_current_name(), 10);
        fflush(stdout);
        report_and_exit(6);
    }
    RET(0);
}
/* nvnDeviceGetInteger(device, pname, int *out): device capabilities.
 * Only the values the boot has been seen to depend on are filled in; everything else
 * answers 0 and is counted, so the list of parameters the game really queries is known.
 * The numbers are provisional and must be checked against a reference implementation. */
/* NVNdeviceInfo values of a real Switch, indexed by pname (enum order from the SDK's nvn.h
 * as published in the BotW decomp; values from an NVN device-info dump of a development unit). */
static const int g_devinfo[0x62] = {
    53, 312, 14, 65536, 256, 8, 16, 4, 16, 32, 16, 4, 4, 4, 16, 32,             /* 0x00..0x0f */
    32, 256, 256, 4, 8, 512, 256, 2, 256, 4096, 131072, 16, 1536, 1024, 64, 1536, /* 0x10..0x1f */
    65535, 65535, 65535, 8, 1048576, 4096, 16, 4096, 1, 1, 1, 262144, 15, 2048, 1, 1, /* 0x20..0x2f */
    15, 5, 1, 8, 8, 4, 32, 128, 32, 128, 65536, 1, 4, 16384, 134217728, 2048,  /* 0x30..0x3f */
    16384, 16384, 1, 1, 1, 1, 5, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 16, 1024, 32,                /* 0x40..0x4f */
    4096, 65536, 65536, 256, 16384, 262144, 4096, 1, 4, 2, 1, 4096, 16384, 4096, 128, 32, /* 0x50..0x5f */
    65535, 1,                                                                    /* 0x60..0x61 */
};
static volatile LONG g_devinfo_queries[256];
static void nvn_get_integer(Ctx *c) {
    uint32_t pname = (uint32_t)A1;
    int value = pname < 0x62 ? g_devinfo[pname] : 0;
    if (pname < 256 && InterlockedIncrement(&g_devinfo_queries[pname]) == 1)
        trace_printf("     nvnDeviceGetInteger pname=0x%x -> %d  from=%llx\n", pname, value, (unsigned long long)c->x[30] - 4);
    if (A2) wr32(A2, (uint32_t)value);
}
void print_devinfo_summary(FILE *out) {
    fprintf(out, "\nnvnDeviceGetInteger parameters queried (pname:count):");
    for (int i = 0; i < 256; i++) if (g_devinfo_queries[i]) fprintf(out, " %x:%ld", i, (long)g_devinfo_queries[i]);
    fprintf(out, "\n");
}

/* ---- memory pools and buffers: the game supplies the memory, so mapping must work for real.
 * Guest objects are opaque; what each one refers to is kept in a side table keyed by address. */
typedef struct NvnObj { uint64_t key, memory, size, pool, offset, flags; struct NvnObj *next; } NvnObj;
static NvnObj *g_objs[4096];
static SRWLOCK g_objs_lock = SRWLOCK_INIT;
static NvnObj *nobj(uint64_t key) {
    unsigned h = (unsigned)((key >> 3) * 2654435761u) & 4095;
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_objs_lock);
    NvnObj *o = g_objs[h];
    while (o && o->key != key) o = o->next;
    if (!o) { o = calloc(1, sizeof *o); o->key = key; o->next = g_objs[h]; g_objs[h] = o; }
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_objs_lock);
    return o;
}
static void nobj_drop(uint64_t key) {                                   /* the object is finalized: forget what it referred to */
    unsigned h = (unsigned)((key >> 3) * 2654435761u) & 4095;
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_objs_lock);
    for (NvnObj **pp = &g_objs[h]; *pp; pp = &(*pp)->next)
        if ((*pp)->key == key) { NvnObj *o = *pp; *pp = o->next; free(o); break; }
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_objs_lock);
}
void nvn_label_set(uint64_t obj, const char *text);                    /* nvn_gl.c */
void nvn_label_drop(uint64_t obj);
void nvn_gl_memory_written(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size);
static uint64_t g_device;
static void builder_defaults(Ctx *c) { NvnObj *b = nobj(A0); b->memory = b->size = b->pool = b->offset = b->flags = 0; }      /* nvnMemoryPoolBuilderSetDefaults / nvnBufferBuilderSetDefaults */
static void builder_set_device(Ctx *c) { if (A1) g_device = A1; }      /* (builder, device): there is one device */
static void builder_get_device(Ctx *c) { RET(g_device); }
static void pool_builder_get_memory(Ctx *c) { RET(nobj(A0)->memory); }
static void pool_builder_get_size(Ctx *c) { RET(nobj(A0)->size); }
static void pool_builder_get_flags(Ctx *c) { RET(nobj(A0)->flags); }
static void pool_finalize(Ctx *c) { nvn_label_drop(A0); nobj_drop(A0); }
static void obj_set_label(Ctx *c) { nvn_label_set(A0, A1 ? (const char *)(uintptr_t)A1 : ""); }
/* FlushMappedRange(object, offset, size): the CPU wrote this range and the GPU must see it. Pool memory is ordinary host memory here,
 * so what has to be told is the backend, which keeps copies of textures. */
static void obj_flush_range(Ctx *c) { NvnObj *o = nobj(A0); if (o->memory) nvn_gl_memory_written(o->memory + A1, A2); }
static void buffer_builder_get_pool(Ctx *c) { RET(nobj(A0)->pool); }
static void buffer_builder_get_offset(Ctx *c) { RET(nobj(A0)->offset); }
static void buffer_builder_get_size(Ctx *c) { RET(nobj(A0)->size); }
static void buffer_get_pool(Ctx *c) { RET(nobj(A0)->pool); }
static void buffer_get_offset(Ctx *c) { RET(nobj(A0)->offset); }
static void buffer_finalize(Ctx *c) { nvn_label_drop(A0); nobj_drop(A0); }
static void obj_debug_id(Ctx *c) { RET(A0); }
static void pool_builder_storage(Ctx *c) { log_call(c); NvnObj *b = nobj(A0); b->memory = A1; b->size = A2; }   /* (builder, memory, size) */
static void pool_builder_flags(Ctx *c) { nobj(A0)->flags = A1; }                                               /* (builder, flags) */
static void pool_virtual_init(Ctx *c, NvnObj *p);            /* below */
static void pool_initialize(Ctx *c) {
    log_call(c);
    NvnObj *p = nobj(A0), *b = nobj(A1);
    p->memory = b->memory; p->size = b->size; p->flags = b->flags;
    if (p->flags & 0x200) { pool_virtual_init(c, p); RET(1); return; }   /* NVN_MEMORY_POOL_FLAGS_VIRTUAL */
    RET(1);
}
static void pool_flags(Ctx *c) { RET(nobj(A0)->flags); }
/* nvnMemoryPoolMapVirtual(pool, numRequests, const NVNmappingRequest *requests) [sdk 0x41ec70]: takes the NVN lock and calls the
 * pool's method +0x60. Which class a pool is, is decided at nvnMemoryPoolInitialize by flag bit 9 (0x200, "virtual")
 * [0x41eae0 .. 0x41eb00 -> 0x41eda0]:
 *   ordinary pool (class [0xc13f30]): method +0x60 = [0x42acd0] = `return 0`: that is the whole function there.
 *   virtual pool (class [0xc13fc0]): [0x42b490] turns each 0x28-byte request {+0 physical pool, +8 offset in it, +0x10 offset in
 *     this pool, +0x18 size, +0x20 storage class} into an entry {nvmap handle of the physical pool (its method +0x50), class &
 *     ~0x100, both offsets and the size in pages of the device's page size} and gives them, at most (pool +0x50) at a time, to
 *     NvRmGpuAddressSpaceAllocationRemap: the GPU address range of the virtual pool then shows the physical pool's pages
 *     (a request without a pool unmaps). 1 when every batch succeeded.
 * NOT IMPLEMENTED for a virtual pool: here a pool is the game's own host memory and every texture reads its texels through one
 * contiguous pointer (nvn_gl.c Tex.mem); a virtual pool has no memory of its own (its builder must pass none [0x42b208]) and its
 * pages alias pages of other pools, which needs either operating-system aliasing of memory the game allocated (not possible
 * for memory that was not created as a section) or a page table consulted by every texture read / write-back in nvn_gl.c.
 * So the name stays without a handler (MISSING: a call stops with the function's name), also for ordinary pools, where the
 * answer would be 0. */
/* ---- VIRTUAL memory pools (flag 0x200) and nvnMemoryPoolMapVirtual.
 * SMO maps pages of physical pools into a virtual pool (agl::detail::PrivateResource, at start-up), so the note above no
 * longer holds for this game. Implementation: the game's memory heap is a view of a pagefile-backed section (smo_nn.c),
 * and pools hold memory the game took from that heap. A virtual pool gets a reserved PLACEHOLDER range of its size as its
 * "memory"; each mapping request {+0 physical pool, +8 offset in it, +0x10 offset in the virtual pool, +0x18 size,
 * +0x20 storage class} replaces the placeholder part with a view of the same section pages (MapViewOfFile3), so both
 * addresses show the same bytes, as the GPU address space does on the console. A request without a physical pool turns
 * the range back into a placeholder. The storage class is the GPU memory kind; the host has none to apply.
 * Stops with the request printed (never maps approximately) when: the physical memory is not in the heap, an offset or
 * size is not a multiple of 64 KB (the host's mapping granularity), or a Windows call fails. */
#define VP_GRAN 0x10000ull
#define VP_MAXSEG 4096
typedef struct { uint64_t start, size; int mapped; uint64_t sec_off; } VpSeg;     /* start: offset in the virtual pool */
/* used: the pool's memory address was handed out (pool map / buffer / texture) before any mapping;
 * direct: the pool IS a physical pool's range (see pool_map_virtual: whole-pool request that views cannot express) */
typedef struct VPool { uint64_t key, base, size; int nseg, used, direct; VpSeg seg[VP_MAXSEG]; struct VPool *next; } VPool;
static VPool *g_vpools;
static SRWLOCK g_vp_lock = SRWLOCK_INIT;
static unsigned long long g_vp_maps, g_vp_unmaps;
typedef PVOID (WINAPI *VirtualAlloc2Fn)(HANDLE, PVOID, SIZE_T, ULONG, ULONG, void *, ULONG);
typedef PVOID (WINAPI *MapViewOfFile3Fn)(HANDLE, HANDLE, PVOID, ULONG64, SIZE_T, ULONG, ULONG, void *, ULONG);
typedef BOOL (WINAPI *UnmapViewOfFile2Fn)(HANDLE, PVOID, ULONG);
static VirtualAlloc2Fn p_VirtualAlloc2;
static MapViewOfFile3Fn p_MapViewOfFile3;
static UnmapViewOfFile2Fn p_UnmapViewOfFile2;
#ifndef MEM_RESERVE_PLACEHOLDER
#define MEM_RESERVE_PLACEHOLDER 0x00040000
#define MEM_REPLACE_PLACEHOLDER 0x00004000
#define MEM_PRESERVE_PLACEHOLDER 0x00000002
#define MEM_COALESCE_PLACEHOLDERS 0x00000001
#endif
int smo_heap_section_offset(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size, HANDLE *section, uint64_t *offset);     /* smo_nn.c */
static void vp_fail(Ctx *c, const char *what, uint64_t a, uint64_t b) {
    printf("\nnvn: virtual memory pool: %s (0x%llx, 0x%llx; Windows error %lu)\n", what, (unsigned long long)a, (unsigned long long)b, GetLastError());
    guest_trap("nvnMemoryPoolMapVirtual: request that cannot be mapped exactly", c ? c->x[30] - 4 : 0);
}
static void vp_load(Ctx *c) {
    if (p_MapViewOfFile3) return;
    HMODULE k = GetModuleHandleA("kernelbase.dll");
    p_VirtualAlloc2 = (VirtualAlloc2Fn)(void *)GetProcAddress(k, "VirtualAlloc2");
    p_MapViewOfFile3 = (MapViewOfFile3Fn)(void *)GetProcAddress(k, "MapViewOfFile3");
    p_UnmapViewOfFile2 = (UnmapViewOfFile2Fn)(void *)GetProcAddress(k, "UnmapViewOfFile2");
    if (!p_VirtualAlloc2 || !p_MapViewOfFile3 || !p_UnmapViewOfFile2) vp_fail(c, "placeholder API missing (Windows 10 1803 or newer is needed)", 0, 0);
}
static VPool *vp_find(uint64_t key) { VPool *v = g_vpools; while (v && v->key != key) v = v->next; return v; }
/* Make segment boundaries at off (splits the segment containing it). Views are split by unmapping and mapping the two
 * halves again; placeholders by VirtualFree(MEM_PRESERVE_PLACEHOLDER). */
static int vp_map_view(Ctx *c, VPool *v, VpSeg *s);
static void vp_split(Ctx *c, VPool *v, uint64_t off) {
    for (int i = 0; i < v->nseg; i++) {
        VpSeg *s = &v->seg[i];
        if (off <= s->start || off >= s->start + s->size) continue;
        if (v->nseg >= VP_MAXSEG) vp_fail(c, "too many segments", v->size, off);
        memmove(&v->seg[i + 2], &v->seg[i + 1], sizeof(VpSeg) * (size_t)(v->nseg - i - 1));
        VpSeg left = *s, right = *s;
        left.size = off - s->start;
        right.start = off; right.size = s->start + s->size - off; right.sec_off = s->sec_off + left.size;
        if (s->mapped) {
            if (!p_UnmapViewOfFile2(GetCurrentProcess(), (PVOID)(uintptr_t)(v->base + s->start), MEM_PRESERVE_PLACEHOLDER)) vp_fail(c, "unmap for a split", v->base + s->start, s->size);
        }
        if (!VirtualFree((PVOID)(uintptr_t)(v->base + left.start), (SIZE_T)left.size, MEM_RELEASE | MEM_PRESERVE_PLACEHOLDER)) vp_fail(c, "placeholder split", v->base + left.start, left.size);
        v->seg[i] = left; v->seg[i + 1] = right; v->nseg++;
        if (left.mapped) { vp_map_view(c, v, &v->seg[i]); vp_map_view(c, v, &v->seg[i + 1]); }
        return;
    }
}
int smo_heap_section_handle(HANDLE *h);                       /* smo_nn.c */
static int vp_map_view(Ctx *c, VPool *v, VpSeg *s) {
    HANDLE sec;
    if (!smo_heap_section_handle(&sec)) vp_fail(c, "no heap section", 0, 0);
    PVOID r = p_MapViewOfFile3(sec, GetCurrentProcess(), (PVOID)(uintptr_t)(v->base + s->start), s->sec_off, (SIZE_T)s->size,
                               MEM_REPLACE_PLACEHOLDER, PAGE_READWRITE, NULL, 0);
    if (r != (PVOID)(uintptr_t)(v->base + s->start)) vp_fail(c, "MapViewOfFile3", v->base + s->start, s->size);
    return 1;
}
static void pool_virtual_init(Ctx *c, NvnObj *p) {
    vp_load(c);
    if (p->memory) vp_fail(c, "a virtual pool was given memory of its own", p->memory, p->size);
    if (!p->size || p->size % VP_GRAN) vp_fail(c, "virtual pool size is not a multiple of 64 KB", p->size, 0);
    PVOID base = p_VirtualAlloc2(GetCurrentProcess(), NULL, (SIZE_T)p->size, MEM_RESERVE | MEM_RESERVE_PLACEHOLDER, PAGE_NOACCESS, NULL, 0);
    if (!base) vp_fail(c, "placeholder reservation", p->size, 0);
    VPool *v = calloc(1, sizeof *v);
    v->key = p->key; v->base = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)base; v->size = p->size;
    v->nseg = 1; v->seg[0].start = 0; v->seg[0].size = p->size;
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_vp_lock); v->next = g_vpools; g_vpools = v; ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_vp_lock);
    p->memory = v->base;
    printf("nvn: virtual memory pool %llx: 0x%llx bytes at %llx (placeholder)\n", (unsigned long long)p->key, (unsigned long long)p->size, (unsigned long long)v->base);
}
static void pool_map_virtual(Ctx *c) {
    log_call(c);
    uint64_t pool = A0, n = A1, req = A2;
    vp_load(c);
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_vp_lock);
    VPool *v = vp_find(pool);
    if (!v) { ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_vp_lock); vp_fail(c, "nvnMemoryPoolMapVirtual on a pool that is not virtual", pool, 0); }
    for (uint64_t k = 0; k < n; k++) {
        uint64_t r = req + k * 0x28, phys = rd64(r), poff = rd64(r + 8), voff = rd64(r + 0x10), size = rd64(r + 0x18);
        uint32_t cls = rd32(r + 0x20);
        if (hostfn_current_calls() <= 2 && k < 4)
            printf("nvn: MapVirtual pool %llx request %llu: physical pool %llx +0x%llx -> +0x%llx, 0x%llx bytes, storage class 0x%x\n",
                   (unsigned long long)pool, (unsigned long long)k, (unsigned long long)phys, (unsigned long long)poff, (unsigned long long)voff, (unsigned long long)size, cls);
        if (voff % VP_GRAN || size % VP_GRAN || !size || voff + size > v->size) vp_fail(c, "request offset / size (64 KB granularity, inside the pool)", voff, size);
        uint64_t sec_off = 0;
        HANDLE sec;
        if (v->direct) vp_fail(c, "a pool that is a direct alias of physical memory is mapped again", voff, size);
        if (phys) {
            NvnObj *pp = nobj(phys);
            if (vp_find(phys)) vp_fail(c, "the physical pool of a request is itself virtual", phys, 0);
            int in_heap = smo_heap_section_offset(pp->memory + poff, size, &sec, &sec_off);
            if (!in_heap || sec_off % VP_GRAN) {
                /* A view cannot express this (memory outside the heap, or a heap offset that is only 4 KB aligned: NVN pool
                 * memory needs 4 KB alignment, host views 64 KB). Exact only in one case: ONE request mapping the WHOLE,
                 * still unmapped and unused virtual pool from one contiguous physical range. Then the virtual pool's
                 * memory IS that range: its address becomes the physical address, which aliases exactly. */
                if (n != 1 || voff != 0 || size != v->size || v->nseg != 1 || v->seg[0].mapped || v->used)
                    vp_fail(c, in_heap ? "physical offset in the heap is not a multiple of 64 KB, and the request is not a whole-pool mapping of an unused pool"
                                       : "physical memory is not inside the memory heap, and the request is not a whole-pool mapping of an unused pool", pp->memory + poff, size);
                if (!VirtualFree((PVOID)(uintptr_t)v->base, 0, MEM_RELEASE)) vp_fail(c, "placeholder release", v->base, v->size);
                v->direct = 1;
                v->base = pp->memory + poff;
                nobj(pool)->memory = v->base;
                g_vp_maps++;
                printf("nvn: virtual memory pool %llx is a direct alias of physical pool %llx +0x%llx (0x%llx bytes at %llx): heap offset 0x%llx is not 64 KB aligned\n",
                       (unsigned long long)pool, (unsigned long long)phys, (unsigned long long)poff, (unsigned long long)size,
                       (unsigned long long)v->base, (unsigned long long)sec_off);
                continue;
            }
        }
        vp_split(c, v, voff);
        vp_split(c, v, voff + size);
        /* unmap every view inside [voff, voff+size), then make the range one placeholder */
        int first = -1, last = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < v->nseg; i++) {
            VpSeg *s = &v->seg[i];
            if (s->start < voff || s->start >= voff + size) continue;
            if (first < 0) first = i;
            last = i;
            if (s->mapped) {
                if (!p_UnmapViewOfFile2(GetCurrentProcess(), (PVOID)(uintptr_t)(v->base + s->start), MEM_PRESERVE_PLACEHOLDER)) vp_fail(c, "unmap", v->base + s->start, s->size);
                s->mapped = 0; g_vp_unmaps++;
            }
        }
        if (last > first) {
            if (!VirtualFree((PVOID)(uintptr_t)(v->base + voff), (SIZE_T)size, MEM_RELEASE | MEM_COALESCE_PLACEHOLDERS)) vp_fail(c, "placeholder coalesce", v->base + voff, size);
            memmove(&v->seg[first + 1], &v->seg[last + 1], sizeof(VpSeg) * (size_t)(v->nseg - last - 1));
            v->nseg -= last - first;
        }
        VpSeg *s = &v->seg[first];
        s->start = voff; s->size = size; s->mapped = 0;
        if (phys) { s->sec_off = sec_off; vp_map_view(c, v, s); s->mapped = 1; g_vp_maps++; }
    }
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_vp_lock);
    RET(1);
}
void nvn_virtual_pool_report(FILE *out) {
    int n = 0; for (VPool *v = g_vpools; v; v = v->next) n++;
    if (n) fprintf(out, "nvn: virtual memory pools: %d, %llu ranges mapped, %llu unmapped\n", n, g_vp_maps, g_vp_unmaps);
}

/* For nvn_gl.c: where a memory pool's storage is. */
/* a virtual pool whose address was handed out cannot later become a direct alias (pool_map_virtual) */
static void vp_note_use(uint64_t pool) {
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_vp_lock);
    VPool *v = vp_find(pool);
    if (v && !v->direct) v->used = 1;
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_vp_lock);
}
int nvn_pool_range(uint64_t pool, uint64_t *mem, uint64_t *size) {
    NvnObj *p = nobj(pool);
    vp_note_use(pool);
    *mem = p->memory; *size = p->size;
    return p->memory != 0;
}
int nvn_pool_flags(uint64_t pool) { return pool ? (int)nobj(pool)->flags : 0; }      /* for nvn_gl.c */
static void pool_map(Ctx *c) { log_call(c); vp_note_use(A0); RET(nobj(A0)->memory); }
static void pool_size(Ctx *c) { log_call(c); RET(nobj(A0)->size); }
static void buffer_builder_storage(Ctx *c) {                         /* (builder, pool, offset, size) */
    log_call(c);
    NvnObj *b = nobj(A0);
    b->pool = A1; b->offset = A2; b->size = c->x[3];
}
static void buffer_initialize(Ctx *c) {                              /* (buffer, builder) */
    log_call(c);
    NvnObj *buf = nobj(A0), *b = nobj(A1);
    vp_note_use(b->pool);
    buf->memory = nobj(b->pool)->memory + b->offset;
    buf->size = b->size; buf->pool = b->pool; buf->offset = b->offset;
    RET(1);
}
static void buffer_map(Ctx *c) { log_call(c); RET(nobj(A0)->memory); }
static void buffer_address(Ctx *c) { log_call(c); RET(nobj(A0)->memory); }   /* GPU address: the same value for now */
static void buffer_size(Ctx *c) { log_call(c); RET(nobj(A0)->size); }

ImportFn nvn_gl_pick(const char *name);     /* nvn_gl.c: the OpenGL backend */

static void nvn_bootstrap(Ctx *c) {                                  /* nvnBootstrapLoader(const char *name) */

}

static ImportFn pick(const char *name) {
    size_t n = strlen(name);
    if (strcmp(name, "nvnDeviceGetProcAddress") == 0) return nvn_get_proc;
    if (strcmp(name, "nvnDeviceGetInteger") == 0) return nvn_get_integer;
    static const struct { const char *name; ImportFn fn; } special[] = {
        {"nvnMemoryPoolBuilderSetStorage", pool_builder_storage}, {"nvnMemoryPoolInitialize", pool_initialize},
        {"nvnMemoryPoolMapVirtual", pool_map_virtual},       /* virtual pools (see above) */
        {"nvnMemoryPoolMap", pool_map}, {"nvnMemoryPoolGetSize", pool_size},
        {"nvnBufferBuilderSetStorage", buffer_builder_storage}, {"nvnBufferInitialize", buffer_initialize},
        {"nvnBufferMap", buffer_map}, {"nvnBufferGetAddress", buffer_address}, {"nvnBufferGetSize", buffer_size},
        {"nvnMemoryPoolGetBufferAddress", pool_map},         /* GPU address of the pool: same as its memory for now */
        {"nvnMemoryPoolBuilderSetFlags", pool_builder_flags}, {"nvnMemoryPoolGetFlags", pool_flags},
        {"nvnMemoryPoolBuilderSetDefaults", builder_defaults}, {"nvnMemoryPoolBuilderSetDevice", builder_set_device}, {"nvnMemoryPoolBuilderGetDevice", builder_get_device},
        {"nvnMemoryPoolBuilderGetMemory", pool_builder_get_memory}, {"nvnMemoryPoolBuilderGetSize", pool_builder_get_size}, {"nvnMemoryPoolBuilderGetFlags", pool_builder_get_flags},
        {"nvnMemoryPoolFinalize", pool_finalize}, {"nvnMemoryPoolSetDebugLabel", obj_set_label}, {"nvnMemoryPoolFlushMappedRange", obj_flush_range},
        {"nvnBufferBuilderSetDefaults", builder_defaults}, {"nvnBufferBuilderSetDevice", builder_set_device}, {"nvnBufferBuilderGetDevice", builder_get_device},
        {"nvnBufferBuilderGetMemoryPool", buffer_builder_get_pool}, {"nvnBufferBuilderGetMemoryOffset", buffer_builder_get_offset}, {"nvnBufferBuilderGetSize", buffer_builder_get_size},
        {"nvnBufferGetMemoryPool", buffer_get_pool}, {"nvnBufferGetMemoryOffset", buffer_get_offset}, {"nvnBufferFinalize", buffer_finalize},
        {"nvnBufferSetDebugLabel", obj_set_label}, {"nvnBufferFlushMappedRange", obj_flush_range}, {"nvnBufferGetDebugID", obj_debug_id},
    };
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof special / sizeof special[0]; i++)
        if (strcmp(name, special[i].name) == 0) return special[i].fn;
    ImportFn gl = nvn_gl_pick(name);
    if (gl) return gl;
    (void)n;
    printf("nvn: MISSING at fetch: the game obtained %s, which has no implementation (calling it stops the game)%c", name, 10);
    fflush(stdout);
    return nvn_generic;
}

static void keep(Ctx *c) { (void)c; }
static const ImportDef nvn_imports[] = {
    {"nvnBootstrapLoader", nvn_bootstrap},
    {"_ZN2nv20SetGraphicsAllocatorEPFPvmmS0_EPFvS0_S0_EPFS0_S0_mS0_ES0_", keep},
    {"_ZN2nv28SetGraphicsDevtoolsAllocatorEPFPvmmS0_EPFvS0_S0_EPFS0_S0_mS0_ES0_", keep},
    {"_ZN2nv18InitializeGraphicsEPvm", keep},
};

    register_imports(nvn_imports, (int)(sizeof nvn_imports / sizeof nvn_imports[0]));
}
```
