```c
    if (i < width && (s[i] | 0x20) == (hex ? 'p' : 'e')) {
        int j = i + 1;
        if (j < width && (s[j] == '+' || s[j] == '-')) j++;
        if (j < width && isdigit(s[j])) {
            while (i < j) TAKE();
            while (i < width && isdigit(s[i])) TAKE();
        }
    }
#undef TAKE
    tok[n] = 0;
    return i;
}

static int guest_scan(const char *input, const char *fmt, Args *a) {
    const unsigned char *s = (const unsigned char *)input, *s0 = s;
    const unsigned char *p = (const unsigned char *)fmt;
    int matches = 0, input_failure = 0;
    for (; *p; p++) {
        if (isspace(*p)) {
            while (isspace(p[1])) p++;
            while (isspace(*s)) s++;
            continue;
        }
        if (*p != '%' || p[1] == '%') {
            if (*p == '%') { p++; while (isspace(*s)) s++; }
            if (!*s) { input_failure = 1; break; }
            if (*s != *p) break;
            s++;
            continue;
        }
        p++;
        int suppress = 0, width = 0, have_width = 0, size = 0;       /* size: -2 hh, -1 h, 0, 1 l, 2 ll/j/z/t, 3 L */
        if (*p == '*') { suppress = 1; p++; }
        while (isdigit(*p)) { width = width * 10 + (*p - '0'); have_width = 1; p++; }
        if (*p == 'm') p++;                                          /* allocating conversions are not supported: treated as plain */
        for (;; p++) {
            if (*p == 'h') size = size == -1 ? -2 : -1;
            else if (*p == 'l') size = size == 1 ? 2 : 1;
            else if (*p == 'j' || *p == 'z' || *p == 't') size = 2;
            else if (*p == 'L') size = 3;
            else break;
        }
        int conv = *p;
        if (!conv) break;
        if (conv == 'n') {
            if (!suppress) {
                uint64_t dst = arg_int(a);
                int64_t v = (int64_t)(s - s0);
                if (size == -2) wr8(dst, (uint8_t)v); else if (size == -1) wr16(dst, (uint16_t)v);
                else if (size >= 1) wr64(dst, (uint64_t)v); else wr32(dst, (uint32_t)v);
            }
            continue;
        }
        if (conv != 'c' && conv != '[') while (isspace(*s)) s++;
        if (!*s) { input_failure = 1; break; }
        if (!have_width) width = conv == 'c' ? 1 : 0x7fffffff;
        if (conv == 'c' || conv == 's' || conv == '[') {
            unsigned char set[256];
            if (conv == 'c') memset(set, 1, sizeof set);
            else if (conv == 's') { memset(set, 1, sizeof set); set[' '] = 0; for (int ch = 9; ch <= 13; ch++) set[ch] = 0; }
            else {
                int invert = 0;
                p++;
                if (*p == '^') { invert = 1; p++; }
                memset(set, invert, sizeof set);
                if (*p == ']') { set[']'] = (unsigned char)!invert; p++; }
                else if (*p == '-') { set['-'] = (unsigned char)!invert; p++; }
                for (; *p && *p != ']'; p++) {
                    if (*p == '-' && p[1] && p[1] != ']') {
                        for (int ch = p[-1]; ch <= p[1]; ch++) set[ch] = (unsigned char)!invert;
                        p++;
                    } else set[*p] = (unsigned char)!invert;
                }
                if (!*p) return matches ? matches : -1;                 /* malformed set */
            }
            set[0] = 0;
            uint64_t dst = suppress ? 0 : arg_int(a);
            int n = 0;
            if (conv == 'c') {                                         /* exactly `width` characters, no terminator */
                int avail = 0;
                while (avail < width && s[avail]) avail++;
                if (avail < width) { input_failure = 1; break; }
                if (dst) memcpy((void *)(uintptr_t)dst, s, (size_t)width);
                s += width;
            } else {
                while (n < width && set[s[n]]) n++;
                if (n == 0) break;                                     /* matching failure */
                if (dst) { memcpy((void *)(uintptr_t)dst, s, (size_t)n); wr8(dst + (uint64_t)n, 0); }
                s += n;
            }
            if (!suppress) matches++;
            continue;
        }
        if (strchr("diouxXp", conv)) {
            int base = conv == 'd' || conv == 'u' ? 10 : conv == 'o' ? 8 : conv == 'i' ? 0 : 16;
            int i = 0, neg = 0, digits = 0;
            uint64_t v = 0;
            int overflow = 0;
            if (i < width && (s[i] == '+' || s[i] == '-')) { neg = s[i] == '-'; i++; }
            if ((base == 0 || base == 16) && i < width && s[i] == '0') {
                if (i + 1 < width && (s[i + 1] | 0x20) == 'x') {
                    if (i + 2 < width && isxdigit(s[i + 2])) { i += 2; base = 16; }
                    else { i++; digits = 1; base = base ? base : 8; s += i; goto int_done; }   /* "0x" alone reads the 0 */
                } else if (base == 0) base = 8;
            }
            if (base == 0) base = 10;
            for (; i < width; i++) {
                int ch = s[i], d = isdigit(ch) ? ch - '0' : isalpha(ch) ? (ch | 0x20) - 'a' + 10 : 99;
                if (d >= base) break;
                if (v > (~0ull - (uint64_t)d) / (uint64_t)base) overflow = 1; else v = v * (uint64_t)base + (uint64_t)d;
                digits++;
            }
            if (!digits) break;                                        /* matching failure */
            s += i;
        int_done:
            if (overflow) v = ~0ull;
            else if (neg) v = (uint64_t)(-(int64_t)v);
            if (!suppress) {
                uint64_t dst = arg_int(a);
                if (conv == 'p' || size >= 1) wr64(dst, v);
                else if (size == -2) wr8(dst, (uint8_t)v);
                else if (size == -1) wr16(dst, (uint16_t)v);
                else wr32(dst, (uint32_t)v);
                matches++;
            }
            continue;
        }
        if (strchr("aAeEfFgG", conv)) {
            char tok[512];
            int len = scan_float_token(s, width, tok, (int)sizeof tok);
            if (!len) break;
            s += len;
            if (!suppress) {
                uint64_t dst = arg_int(a);
                if (size == 0 || size < 0) { float f = strtof(tok, NULL); memcpy((void *)(uintptr_t)dst, &f, 4); }
                else if (size == 3) { uint64_t q[2]; quad_from_double(strtod(tok, NULL), q); memcpy((void *)(uintptr_t)dst, q, 16); }
                else { double d = strtod(tok, NULL); memcpy((void *)(uintptr_t)dst, &d, 8); }
                matches++;
            }
            continue;
        }
        break;                                                         /* unknown conversion */
    }
    return matches == 0 && input_failure ? -1 : matches;
}
static void c_sscanf(Ctx *c) { Args a; args_direct(&a, c, 2); RET((int64_t)guest_scan(STR(0), STR(1), &a)); }
/* host-side entry for self-tests: scans with the variadic arguments taken from c exactly as a guest call would pass them */
int clib_guest_sscanf(Ctx *c) { c_sscanf(c); return (int)(int32_t)c->x[0]; }

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- searching and sorting
 * The comparator is guest code: int (*)(const void *, const void *). */
static __declspec(thread) Ctx *t_cmp_ctx;
static __declspec(thread) uint64_t t_cmp_fn;
static int guest_compare(const void *a, const void *b) {
    Ctx *c = t_cmp_ctx;
    c->x[0] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)a;
    c->x[1] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)b;
    call_guest(c, t_cmp_fn);
    return (int)(int32_t)c->x[0];
}
static void c_bsearch(Ctx *c) {                           /* (key, base, nmemb, size, compar) */
    uint64_t key = A0, base = A1, count = A2, size = A3, saved_lr = c->x[30], saved_sp = c->x[31];
    Ctx *prev_ctx = t_cmp_ctx;
    uint64_t prev_fn = t_cmp_fn;
    t_cmp_ctx = c; t_cmp_fn = A4;
    uint64_t lo = 0, hi = count, found = 0;
    while (lo < hi) {
        uint64_t mid = lo + (hi - lo) / 2, elem = base + mid * size;
        int r = guest_compare((void *)(uintptr_t)key, (void *)(uintptr_t)elem);
        if (r == 0) { found = elem; break; }
        if (r < 0) hi = mid; else lo = mid + 1;
    }
    t_cmp_ctx = prev_ctx; t_cmp_fn = prev_fn;
    c->x[30] = saved_lr; c->x[31] = saved_sp;
    RET(found);
}
static void c_qsort(Ctx *c) {                             /* (base, nmemb, size, compar) */
    uint64_t saved_lr = c->x[30], saved_sp = c->x[31];
    void *base = (void *)(uintptr_t)A0;
    size_t count = (size_t)A1, size = (size_t)A2;
    Ctx *prev_ctx = t_cmp_ctx;
    uint64_t prev_fn = t_cmp_fn;
    t_cmp_ctx = c; t_cmp_fn = A3;
    qsort(base, count, size, guest_compare);
    t_cmp_ctx = prev_ctx; t_cmp_fn = prev_fn;
    c->x[30] = saved_lr; c->x[31] = saved_sp;
}
```

`runtime/libc/eh_runtime.h`:

```h
/* C++ exception RUNTIME (implemented in nncxxrt.c). STABLE INTERFACE for the unwinder (nnunwind.c).
 *
 * Division of work
 *   runtime (this header): exception objects, the per-context throw state, the throw (eh_throw, for host code that
 *       throws on behalf of the C++ library), the table of loaded images with their .eh_frame_hdr, and the
 *       PERSONALITY as a query: "for this call-site pc and this exception, is there a landing pad, which selector,
 *       clean-up or handler?". The game imports none of the Itanium ABI's throw / catch entry points (__cxa_throw,
 *       __cxa_rethrow, __cxa_begin_catch, __cxa_end_catch, _Unwind_Resume): the runtime has no handlers for them.
 *   unwinder (not here): finds the guest frames, restores the guest registers of the frame that owns the pad and
 *       transfers control to the pad (resume entries of the lifted code).
 *
 * Flow
 *   1. The guest calls a libc++ __throw_* helper (libcxx.c), or a stream operation throws (nniostream.c). The runtime
 *      fills the exception header, makes it the exception IN FLIGHT of that Ctx and calls the registered raise
 *      function: raise(c, EH_RAISE_THROW).
 *   2. The unwinder walks the guest frames from the innermost one. For each frame with return address `ret` it asks
 *          eh_personality(c, ret - 4, eh_in_flight(c), &pad)
 *      (any pc inside the call instruction works). EH_NONE: go to the caller's frame. EH_CLEANUP / EH_HANDLER:
 *      restore that frame's registers (sp, x19..x29, d8..d15: the callee-saved state at the call), then
 *          eh_enter_pad(c, &pad)          sets c->x[0] = unwind header, c->x[1] = selector, clears "in flight"
 *      and continue execution at pad.landing_pad.
 *      eh_personality is a pure query, so a search phase (is there an EH_HANDLER anywhere up the stack?) can be run
 *      before any clean-up pad is entered, as the console's two-phase unwinder does; if there is none the console
 *      calls std::terminate WITHOUT unwinding: call eh_terminate(c, "no handler").
 *   3. A clean-up pad ends with `bl _Unwind_Resume` (x0 = the unwind header it was entered with). The runtime puts
 *      the exception in flight again and calls raise(c, EH_RAISE_RESUME): continue the walk from the frame that
 *      called _Unwind_Resume (its return address is c->x[30]; that call site may itself have a pad).
 *   4. A handler pad calls __cxa_begin_catch(x0) (returns the adjusted object pointer) and later __cxa_end_catch,
 *      or __cxa_rethrow (step 1 again). Pads of noexcept functions call __clang_call_terminate -> std::terminate,
 *      which reports and stops the process.
 *   raise() is expected not to return (it transfers control to a pad). If it returns and the exception is still in
 *   flight, or if no raise function is registered, the runtime calls eh_terminate (report: type, what(), guest call
 *   stack; exit code 3).
 *
 * Register convention at pad entry [sdk: __cxa_begin_catch 0x4c9fb8, __cxa_get_exception_ptr 0x4c9fb0,
 * __cxa_throw 0x4c9ea0]: x0 = _Unwind_Exception * = thrown object - 0x20, x1 = selector (int): 0 for a clean-up,
 * > 0 the type filter of the matching catch clause, < 0 a violated exception specification. Nothing else is set.
 * The header in front of the thrown object has libc++abi's layout (0x80 bytes: reference count at -0x80, type at
 * -0x78, destructor at -0x70, handler count at -0x50, adjusted pointer at -0x30, unwind header at -0x20).
 *
 * State is kept PER Ctx (not per host thread): every guest thread and every guest fiber has its own Ctx
 * (os_threads.c new_ctx), and fibers of one host thread share its thread-local storage. All functions may be called
 * from any host thread; a given Ctx must only be used by the thread currently running it. */
#ifndef RECOMP_EH_RUNTIME_H
#define RECOMP_EH_RUNTIME_H

#include "runtime.h"

/* ---- loaded images
 * base: load address; size: image size in bytes; eh_frame_hdr: guest address of .eh_frame_hdr, or 0 to take it from
 * the image's MOD0 header (u32 at base+4 = offset of "MOD0"; its field at +0x10 is the offset of .eh_frame_hdr
 * relative to MOD0). Call after the image is mapped AND relocated (type tables hold relocated pointers).
 * main is registered by the runtime itself at start-up. Returns 0 if the image has no usable table. */
int eh_register_image(uint64_t base, uint64_t size, uint64_t eh_frame_hdr);
void eh_unregister_image(uint64_t base);

/* Function containing pc according to .eh_frame; lsda is 0 when the function has no exception table.
 * Returns 0 when pc is in no registered image or no FDE covers it. */
typedef struct {
    uint64_t image_base;
    uint64_t start, end;             /* guest addresses of the function ([start, end)) */
    uint64_t lsda;                   /* guest address of its LSDA, or 0 */
    uint64_t fde;                    /* guest address of its FDE (CFI for those who want to unwind registers) */
} EhFunction;
int eh_find_function(uint64_t pc, EhFunction *out);

/* ---- personality */
enum { EH_NONE = 0, EH_CLEANUP = 1, EH_HANDLER = 2 };
typedef struct {
    int kind;                        /* EH_NONE: no pad for this call site and this exception */
    uint64_t landing_pad;            /* guest address to continue at */
    int64_t selector;                /* value for x1 */
    uint64_t exception;              /* the exception the answer is for (thrown object pointer) */
    uint64_t adjusted;               /* what __cxa_begin_catch will return if this handler is entered */
    EhFunction function;
} EhPad;
/* call_pc: an address inside the call instruction of the frame (return address - 4).
 * exception: the thrown object pointer (eh_in_flight(c)). Returns out->kind. Changes no state. */
int eh_personality(Ctx *c, uint64_t call_pc, uint64_t exception, EhPad *out);

/* ---- throw state of a context */
uint64_t eh_in_flight(Ctx *c);       /* thrown object pointer of the exception being propagated, or 0 */
const char *eh_type_name(uint64_t exception);        /* mangled type name, e.g. "St12out_of_range" */
/* Commit to a pad returned by eh_personality: sets x0 and x1, records the adjusted pointer for __cxa_begin_catch,
 * clears the in-flight state. The caller then restores the frame's registers and jumps to pad->landing_pad. */
void eh_enter_pad(Ctx *c, const EhPad *pad);

/* ---- the unwinder's entry point */
enum { EH_RAISE_THROW = 0, EH_RAISE_RESUME = 1 };
typedef void (*EhRaiseFn)(Ctx *c, int reason);
void eh_set_unwinder(EhRaiseFn raise);

/* std::terminate as the console would end here: prints `why`, the type and what() of the exception in flight (or
 * being handled), the guest call stack, and exits the process with code 3. Never returns. */
void eh_terminate(Ctx *c, const char *why);

/* ---- resume entries of MAIN (added after the first version of this header; everything above is unchanged)
 * When the game DLL was generated with landing-pad resume entries (`RECOMP_EH=1 python recomp.py full gen_eh`, same
 * scheme as the modules: `u_<fn>(c, landing pad)`, and `nro_catch_call(c, u_<fn>)` for functions with a real catch
 * handler), this returns the entry to call for a landing pad of main, exactly like a module's resume table does;
 * NULL when the pad is not in main or the DLL in use has no resume entries (the default build today). */
typedef void (*EhResumeFn)(Ctx *c, uint64_t landing_pad);
EhResumeFn eh_main_resume_entry(uint64_t landing_pad);

/* ---- for host code that throws on behalf of the library (libc++ helpers and the like) */
uint64_t eh_allocate(size_t size);                                   /* = __cxa_allocate_exception */
void eh_throw(Ctx *c, uint64_t exception, uint64_t type_info, uint64_t destructor);   /* = __cxa_throw */

#endif
```

`runtime/libc/libcxx.c`:

```c
/* Host implementations of the libc++ (std::__1) functions the game imports
 * from the system module. Objects live in guest memory, so the layouts below
 * must match libc++ on AArch64 exactly.
 *
 * std::string (24 bytes, little endian, default ABI):
 *   short: byte 0 = size << 1, characters from byte 1 (up to 22 + NUL)
 *   long : u64 capacity | 1 at +0, u64 size at +8, char* data at +16
 */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <malloc.h>
#include <windows.h>
#include "runtime.h"
#include "hostrt.h"

#define A0 (c->x[0])
#define A1 (c->x[1])
#define A2 (c->x[2])
#define RET(v) (c->x[0] = (uint64_t)(v))
#define P(n) ((void *)(uintptr_t)c->x[n])

typedef uint8_t Str;                                     /* pointer to a guest std::string */

/* String buffers must come from the game's own allocator: most std::string code is inlined in
 * the game and allocates/frees through f_710392dce0(align, size) / f_710392e590(ptr) directly,
 * so a buffer created here can be freed there and vice versa. The stored capacity is the
 * allocation size (libc++ keeps "size | 1"), rounded up to 16 as the inlined code does. */
#define GAME_MEMALIGN GAME_SYM_aligned_alloc   /* the game's own allocator, by symbol */
#define GAME_FREE GAME_SYM_free
static __declspec(thread) Ctx *t_ctx;                     /* context of the string op in progress */
static char *sbuf_alloc(size_t alloc) {
    Ctx *c = t_ctx;
    uint64_t save[4] = {c->x[0], c->x[1], c->x[2], c->x[30]};
    c->x[0] = 16; c->x[1] = alloc;
    call_guest(c, GAME_MEMALIGN);
    char *p = (char *)(uintptr_t)c->x[0];
    c->x[0] = save[0]; c->x[1] = save[1]; c->x[2] = save[2]; c->x[30] = save[3];
    if (!p) guest_trap("game allocator returned null for a string buffer", alloc);
    return p;
}
static void sbuf_free(char *p, const char *where) {
    (void)where;
    Ctx *c = t_ctx;
    uint64_t save[4] = {c->x[0], c->x[1], c->x[2], c->x[30]};
    c->x[0] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)p;
    call_guest(c, GAME_FREE);
    c->x[0] = save[0]; c->x[1] = save[1]; c->x[2] = save[2]; c->x[30] = save[3];
}

static int s_long(const Str *s) { return s[0] & 1; }
static char *s_data(Str *s) { return s_long(s) ? (char *)(uintptr_t)rd64((uint64_t)s + 16) : (char *)s + 1; }
static size_t s_size(const Str *s) { return s_long(s) ? (size_t)rd64((uint64_t)s + 8) : (size_t)(s[0] >> 1); }
static size_t s_cap(const Str *s) { return s_long(s) ? (size_t)(rd64((uint64_t)s) & ~1ull) - 1 : 22; }
static void s_set_size(Str *s, size_t n) { if (s_long(s)) wr64((uint64_t)s + 8, n); else s[0] = (uint8_t)(n << 1); }

static void s_reserve(Str *s, size_t need) {
    size_t cap = s_cap(s);
    if (need <= cap) return;
    size_t want = need > 2 * cap ? need : 2 * cap;
    size_t alloc = (want + 16) & ~(size_t)15;
    size_t size = s_size(s);
    char *p = sbuf_alloc(alloc);
    memcpy(p, s_data(s), size + 1);
    if (s_long(s)) sbuf_free(s_data(s), "reserve");
    wr64((uint64_t)s, alloc | 1);
    wr64((uint64_t)s + 8, size);
    wr64((uint64_t)s + 16, (uint64_t)p);
}
static void s_assign(Str *s, const char *p, size_t n) {
    char *copy = NULL;
    char *d = s_data(s);
    if (p >= d && p <= d + s_size(s)) { copy = malloc(n + 1); memcpy(copy, p, n); p = copy; }   /* self-assignment */
    s_reserve(s, n);
    d = s_data(s);
    memmove(d, p, n);
    d[n] = 0;
    s_set_size(s, n);
    free(copy);
}
static void s_append(Str *s, const char *p, size_t n) {
    char *copy = NULL;
    char *d = s_data(s);
    size_t size = s_size(s);
    if (p >= d && p <= d + size) { copy = malloc(n + 1); memcpy(copy, p, n); p = copy; }
    s_reserve(s, size + n);
    d = s_data(s);
    memcpy(d + size, p, n);
    d[size + n] = 0;
    s_set_size(s, size + n);
    free(copy);
}
static void s_init(Str *s, const char *p, size_t n) { memset(s, 0, 24); s_assign(s, p, n); }

/* For the other C++ runtime files (nncxxrt.c, nncxxlib.c): build / read guest std::string objects and
 * free buffers the game's inlined container code allocated. */
void cxx_string_init(Ctx *c, uint64_t str, const char *p, size_t n) { Ctx *prev = t_ctx; t_ctx = c; s_init((Str *)(uintptr_t)str, p, n); t_ctx = prev; }
void cxx_game_free(Ctx *c, uint64_t p) { Ctx *prev = t_ctx; t_ctx = c; sbuf_free((char *)(uintptr_t)p, "runtime"); t_ctx = prev; }

static void str_assign_cstr(Ctx *c) { t_ctx = c; s_assign(P(0), P(1), strlen(P(1))); }
static void str_assign_n(Ctx *c) { t_ctx = c; s_assign(P(0), P(1), (size_t)A2); }
static void str_push_back(Ctx *c) { t_ctx = c; char ch = (char)A1; s_append(P(0), &ch, 1); }
static void str_copy_ctor(Ctx *c) { t_ctx = c; Str *o = P(1); s_init(P(0), s_data(o), s_size(o)); }
static void str_dtor(Ctx *c) { t_ctx = c; Str *s = P(0); if (s_long(s)) sbuf_free(s_data(s), "dtor"); }
static void str_resize(Ctx *c) { t_ctx = c;
    Str *s = P(0);
    size_t n = (size_t)A1, size = s_size(s);
    if (n > size) { s_reserve(s, n); memset(s_data(s) + size, (int)A2, n - size); }
    s_data(s)[n] = 0;
    s_set_size(s, n);
}

/* ---- hashing support */
static void next_prime(Ctx *c) {
    uint64_t n = A0;
    if (n <= 2) { RET(2); return; }
    n |= 1;
    for (;; n += 2) {
        int prime = 1;
        for (uint64_t d = 3; d * d <= n; d += 2) if (n % d == 0) { prime = 0; break; }
        if (prime) { RET(n); return; }
    }
}

static void throw_trap(Ctx *c) { guest_trap("libc++ threw length_error / out_of_range", c->x[30] - 4); }

/* ---- std::locale: there is only the classic "C" locale */
static void locale_dtor(Ctx *c) { (void)c; }
/* locale::use_facet is in nncxxlib.c (ctype<char> and numpunct<char> facets of the classic locale) */

#define STR "NSt3__112basic_stringIcNS_11char_traitsIcEENS_9allocatorIcEEE"
static const ImportDef cxx_imports[] = {
    {"_Z" STR "6assignEPKc", str_assign_cstr}, {"_Z" STR "6assignEPKcm", str_assign_n},
    {"_Z" STR "9push_backEc", str_push_back},
    {"_Z" STR "C1ERKS5_", str_copy_ctor},
    {"_Z" STR "D1Ev", str_dtor} /* SMO imports the complete-object form: the same for a string */,
    {"_Z" STR "6resizeEmc", str_resize},
    {"_ZNSt3__112__next_primeEm", next_prime},
    {"_ZNKSt3__120__vector_base_commonILb1EE20__throw_length_errorEv", throw_trap},
    {"_ZNKSt3__120__vector_base_commonILb1EE20__throw_out_of_rangeEv", throw_trap},
    {"_ZNKSt3__121__basic_string_commonILb1EE20__throw_length_errorEv", throw_trap},
    {"_ZNSt3__16localeD1Ev", locale_dtor},
};

void register_cxx_imports(void) {
    register_imports(cxx_imports, (int)(sizeof cxx_imports / sizeof cxx_imports[0]));
}
```

```c
/* libc++ (std::__1) pieces beyond libcxx.c / nniostream.c: locale facets, stream vtables.
 * Layouts marked [sdk] were read from the real SDK module (Super Smash Bros. Ultimate 13.0.4's, by ssbu-recomp).
 *
 * Locale facets [sdk]: ctype<char> = { vptr, refs, const unsigned short *table, bool del }, classic table copied from
 * the SDK (mask bits: 0x1 blank, 0x2 cntrl, 0x4 punct, 0x100 upper, 0x200 lower, 0x400 alpha, 0x800 digit,
 * 0x1000 xdigit, 0x2000 space, 0x4000 print); numpunct<char> = { vptr, refs, char '.', char ',', string grouping "" }.

/* a short std::string (at most 22 characters) written in place: no allocation */
static void short_string(uint64_t s, const char *text) {
    size_t n = strlen(text);
    memset((void *)(uintptr_t)s, 0, 24);
    wr8(s, (uint8_t)(n << 1));
    memcpy((void *)(uintptr_t)(s + 1), text, n);
}

static int lower(int ch) { return ch >= 'a' && ch <= 'z'; }

static void ct_narrow(Ctx *c) { RET((int8_t)A1 >= 0 ? (uint8_t)A1 : (uint8_t)A2); }                                          /* [sdk] non-ASCII -> default */
static void ct_narrow_range(Ctx *c) {                   /* (low, high, dfault, dest) */

    for (const int8_t *p = (const int8_t *)(uintptr_t)A1; P64(p) < A2; p++) *d++ = *p >= 0 ? (uint8_t)*p : (uint8_t)A3;
    RET(A2);
}
static void np_decimal_point(Ctx *c) { RET(rd8(A0 + 0x10)); }

    if (id == P64(g_id_ctype)) { RET(g_ctype); return; }
    if (id == P64(g_id_numpunct)) { RET(g_numpunct); return; }
    printf("\nC++ RUNTIME: std::locale::use_facet for an id at 0x%llx that is neither ctype<char> nor numpunct<char> (std::bad_cast); guest caller 0x%llx\n",
           (unsigned long long)id, (unsigned long long)c->x[30] - 4);
    cxxrt_throw_report(c, "throw by std::locale::use_facet", 0, 0);

/* ================================================================ basic_ostream / basic_istream vtables
 * [sdk] _ZTVNSt3__113basic_ostreamIcNS_11char_traitsIcEEEE: { vbase offset 8, 0, typeinfo, D1, D0,
 *   vcall offset -8, offset-to-top -8, typeinfo, virtual thunk D1, virtual thunk D0 } (istream: 0x10 / -0x10).
 *
 * Destructors, re-implemented from the SDK's code:
 *   [sdk 0x464d38] ios_base::~ios_base: vptr = ios_base vtable; for i = event_size-1 .. 0: fn[i](erase_event = 0, *this, index[i])
 *       (fn array +0x38, index array +0x40, event_size +0x48); ~locale() on +0x30; free(+0x38), free(+0x40), free(+0x58), free(+0x70)
 *       with the C `free` the SDK module imports from the game.
 *   [sdk 0x464dc0] basic_ios::~basic_ios (D2) = tail call to it.
 *   [sdk 0x46bd10] ostream D1: `add x0, x0, #8; b ios_base D1`; [sdk 0x46bd30] D0: the same, then operator delete(this).
 *       istream ([sdk] _ZNSt3__113basic_istream...D1Ev): its basic_ios part is at +0x10.
 *   [sdk 0x4656c0] basic_streambuf D2: vptr = basic_streambuf vtable; ~locale() on +8.
 *   [sdk 0x46be38] ostream::sentry::~sentry: if rdbuf && state == good && (flags & unitbuf) && !uncaught_exception():
 *       rdbuf->pubsync() == -1 -> setstate(badbit).
 * The vptr written is the SDK image's own vtable (mapped by sdklift_rt.c), as on the console. */
uint64_t sdk_symbol(const char *name);                    /* sdklift_rt.c */
static uint64_t g_vt_ostream[10], g_vt_istream[10], g_ti_ostream[2], g_ti_istream[2];
static void call_handler(Ctx *c, const char *name) {
    ImportFn f = import_lookup(name);
    if (!f) { printf("nncxxlib: no handler for %s\n", name); guest_trap("missing C++ library handler", c->x[30] - 4); }
    f(c);
}
static void ios_base_destroy(Ctx *c, uint64_t ios) {
    uint64_t vt = sdk_symbol("_ZTVNSt3__18ios_baseE");
    if (vt) wr64(ios, vt + 0x10);
    for (uint64_t n = rd64(ios + 0x48); n-- > 0;) {
        uint64_t fn = rd64(rd64(ios + 0x38) + n * 8);
        c->x[2] = rd32(rd64(ios + 0x40) + n * 4);
        c->x[0] = 0; c->x[1] = ios;
        call_guest(c, fn);
    }
    c->x[0] = ios + 0x30; call_handler(c, "_ZNSt3__16localeD1Ev");
    static const int arrays[4] = {0x38, 0x40, 0x58, 0x70};
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) { c->x[0] = rd64(ios + (uint64_t)arrays[i]); if (c->x[0]) call_guest(c, GAME_SYM_free); }   /* free(NULL) does nothing */
}
static void ios_dtor(Ctx *c) { uint64_t self = A0; ios_base_destroy(c, self); RET(self); }
static void sbuf_dtor(Ctx *c) {
    uint64_t self = A0, vt = sdk_symbol("_ZTVNSt3__115basic_streambufIcNS_11char_traitsIcEEEE");
    if (vt) wr64(self, vt + 0x10);
    c->x[0] = self + 8; call_handler(c, "_ZNSt3__16localeD1Ev");
    RET(self);
}
static void sentry_dtor(Ctx *c) {
    uint64_t s = A0, os = rd64(s + 8), ios = os + rd64(rd64(os) - 0x18);
    if (rd64(ios + 0x28) && rd32(ios + 0x20) == 0 && (rd8(ios + 9) & 0x20)) {
        int cxxrt_uncaught(Ctx *c);                                                 /* nncxxrt.c: std::uncaught_exception() */
        if (!cxxrt_uncaught(c)) {
            ios = rd64(s + 8) + rd64(rd64(rd64(s + 8)) - 0x18);
            uint64_t sb = rd64(ios + 0x28);
            c->x[0] = sb;
            call_guest(c, rd64(rd64(sb) + 0x30));                                   /* pubsync -> virtual sync() */
            if ((uint32_t)c->x[0] == 0xffffffffu) {
                ios = rd64(s + 8) + rd64(rd64(rd64(s + 8)) - 0x18);
                c->x[0] = ios; c->x[1] = rd32(ios + 0x20) | 1;
                call_handler(c, "_ZNSt3__18ios_base5clearEj");
            }
        }
    }
    RET(s);
}
/* complete-object destructors: `this` is the stream; its basic_ios part is at +8 (ostream) or +0x10 (istream) = vtable[-3] */
static void stream_dtor(Ctx *c) { uint64_t self = A0; ios_base_destroy(c, self + rd64(rd64(self) - 0x18)); RET(self); }
static void ostream_d1(Ctx *c) { uint64_t self = A0; ios_base_destroy(c, self + 8); RET(self); }
static void istream_d1(Ctx *c) { uint64_t self = A0; ios_base_destroy(c, self + 0x10); RET(self); }
static void ostream_d0(Ctx *c) { uint64_t self = A0; ios_base_destroy(c, self + 8); cxxrt_guest_delete(c, self); }
static void istream_d0(Ctx *c) { uint64_t self = A0; ios_base_destroy(c, self + 0x10); cxxrt_guest_delete(c, self); }
static void stream_dtor_delete(Ctx *c) { uint64_t self = A0; ios_base_destroy(c, self + rd64(rd64(self) - 0x18)); cxxrt_guest_delete(c, self); }
/* virtual thunks: `this` is the basic_ios part; this += vcall offset (vtable[-3] of the ios vptr) gives the stream */
static void stream_thunk_dtor(Ctx *c) { uint64_t ios = A0, self = ios + rd64(rd64(ios) - 0x18); ios_base_destroy(c, ios); RET(self); }
static void stream_thunk_dtor_delete(Ctx *c) { uint64_t ios = A0, self = ios + rd64(rd64(ios) - 0x18); ios_base_destroy(c, ios); cxxrt_guest_delete(c, self); }

static void make_stream_vtable(uint64_t *vt, uint64_t *ti, const char *cls, int64_t ios_offset) {
    char name[72];
    vt[0] = (uint64_t)ios_offset; vt[1] = 0; vt[2] = P64(ti);
    snprintf(name, sizeof name, "std::%s::~%s [D1]", cls, cls); vt[3] = hostfn_address(name, stream_dtor);
    snprintf(name, sizeof name, "std::%s::~%s [D0]", cls, cls); vt[4] = hostfn_address(name, stream_dtor_delete);
    vt[5] = (uint64_t)-ios_offset; vt[6] = (uint64_t)-ios_offset; vt[7] = P64(ti);
    snprintf(name, sizeof name, "virtual thunk to std::%s::~%s [D1]", cls, cls); vt[8] = hostfn_address(name, stream_thunk_dtor);
    snprintf(name, sizeof name, "virtual thunk to std::%s::~%s [D0]", cls, cls); vt[9] = hostfn_address(name, stream_thunk_dtor_delete);
}
```

`runtime/libc/nncxxrt.c`:

```c
/* C++ ABI runtime (libc++abi's role): exceptions, guard variables, RTTI support, the exception classes of
 * <exception>/<stdexcept>/<new>/<typeinfo>, and the DATA symbols the game imports from the C++ runtime
 * (vtables and typeinfo objects), built as host tables laid out per the Itanium C++ ABI.
 *
 * Sources of each layout: [sdk] = read from the real SDK module (Super Smash Bros. Ultimate 13.0.4's, by ssbu-recomp).
 *
 * EXCEPTIONS -- measured by ssbu-recomp on Super Smash Bros. Ultimate 13.0.4's main:
 *   295 call sites of __cxa_throw (91 std::bad_function_call, 68 std::exception-derived game types, 63 std::out_of_range,
 *   47 std::bad_alloc, 17 std::length_error, 9 boost exceptions), 17 of __cxa_rethrow, and about 10,400 calls of
 *   libc++'s __throw_length_error / __throw_out_of_range helpers (libcxx.c).
 *   .eh_frame (found through MOD0) has 110,842 FDEs, 1,040 with an LSDA: 10,346 call-site records, 7,291 with a landing
 *   pad: 3,668 clean-up only, 40 exception-specification filters, 3,583 with a catch clause = 3,540 distinct pads:
 *     3,456 go straight to __clang_call_terminate (noexcept boundaries), 66 are clean-ups that end there,
 *     14 are `catch (...) { clean up; throw; }` (they rethrow),
 *     1 is `catch (std::ios_base::failure &)` at 0x7103839de8 (only the stream library could throw that; ours never does),
 *     4 are `catch (...) { }` that SWALLOW the exception: 0x710382d0a0 and 0x710382d1cc in f_7103828300,
 *       0x7103847670 and 0x710384779c in f_7103841d10 (two text parsers; the protected calls are
 *       f_7103835e60 / f_7103836070 / f_7103836150 / f_7103836230 / f_71038368e0, i.e. tokenising and boost::lexical_cast).
 *   So on the console every throw ends in std::terminate, except a throw inside those four protected regions.
 *
 * What is implemented here: the exception RUNTIME (interface and flow in eh_runtime.h): exception objects with
 * libc++abi's header layout, per-context throw state, the throw of the library helpers the game imports, the
 * personality as a query over the guest's own LSDA tables (catch clauses with base-class matching, catch (...),
 * exception specifications, clean-ups), and the table of loaded images. Of the C++ ABI the game imports only
 * __cxa_guard_acquire / __cxa_guard_release and __cxa_pure_virtual.
 * Transferring control to a landing pad is the unwinder's job (nnunwind.c, installed with eh_set_unwinder). Without an
 * unwinder every throw ends as std::terminate does: a report (type, what(), guest call stack) and exit code 3.
 */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <malloc.h>
#include <windows.h>
#include "runtime.h"
#include "hostrt.h"
#include "eh_runtime.h"

#define A0 (c->x[0])
#define A1 (c->x[1])
#define A2 (c->x[2])
#define A3 (c->x[3])
#define RET(v) (c->x[0] = (uint64_t)(v))
#define P64(p) ((uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(p))

void libc2_install_data(void);           /* nnlibc2.c */
void register_libc2_imports(void);
void cxxlib_install_data(void);          /* nncxxlib.c */
void register_cxxlib_imports(void);
uint64_t import_address(int sym);       /* hostrt.c */
void cxx_string_init(Ctx *c, uint64_t str, const char *p, size_t n);     /* libcxx.c */

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- small helpers shared with nncxxlib.c */
uint64_t cxxrt_main_symbol(const char *name) {           /* address of a function the game itself defines and exports */
    for (int i = 0; i < dyn_sym_count; i++)
        if (dyn_syms[i].defined && strcmp(dyn_syms[i].name, name) == 0) return GUEST_BASE + dyn_syms[i].value;
    return 0;
}
/* Whether [p, p + n) is committed, accessible memory: one VirtualQuery. */
static volatile LONG64 g_rd_asked;
void cxxrt_readable_report(FILE *out) { fprintf(out, "nncxxrt: readable checks: %lld answered by VirtualQuery\n", (long long)g_rd_asked); }
int cxxrt_readable(uint64_t p, size_t n) {
    MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION mi;
    if (p < 0x10000) return 0;
    g_rd_asked++;
    if (!VirtualQuery((void *)(uintptr_t)p, &mi, sizeof mi)) return 0;
    if (mi.State != MEM_COMMIT || (mi.Protect & (PAGE_NOACCESS | PAGE_GUARD))) return 0;
    return p + n <= (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)mi.BaseAddress + mi.RegionSize;
}
/* Calls guest (or host-table) code at addr with up to three arguments; returns x0. */
uint64_t cxxrt_call(Ctx *c, uint64_t addr, uint64_t a0, uint64_t a1, uint64_t a2) {
    uint64_t lr = c->x[30];
    c->x[0] = a0; c->x[1] = a1; c->x[2] = a2;
    call_guest(c, addr);
    c->x[30] = lr;
    return c->x[0];
}
void cxxrt_guest_delete(Ctx *c, uint64_t p) {            /* the game's own operator delete (it defines and exports it) */
    static uint64_t del;
    if (!del) del = cxxrt_main_symbol("_ZdlPv");
    if (!p) return;
    if (!del) { printf("\nnncxxrt: the game does not export operator delete\n"); report_and_exit(3); }
    uint64_t x0 = c->x[0];
    cxxrt_call(c, del, p, 0, 0);
    c->x[0] = x0;
}
void cxxrt_print_guest_stack(void) {
    CONTEXT ctx;
    RtlCaptureContext(&ctx);
    printf("guest call stack (innermost first):\n");
    uint64_t last = 0;
    for (int depth = 0, shown = 0; depth < 600 && shown < 48; depth++) {
        uint64_t g = guest_function_of(ctx.Rip);
        if (g && g != last) { printf("  f_%llx\n", (unsigned long long)g); trace_printf("  f_%llx\n", (unsigned long long)g); shown++; last = g; }
        DWORD64 base;
        RUNTIME_FUNCTION *rf = RtlLookupFunctionEntry(ctx.Rip, &base, NULL);
        if (!rf) break;
        void *hd; DWORD64 est;
        RtlVirtualUnwind(UNW_FLAG_NHANDLER, base, ctx.Rip, rf, &ctx, &hd, &est, NULL);
        if (!ctx.Rip) break;
    }
}
static void fatal(Ctx *c, const char *fmt, ...) {
    char msg[768];
    va_list ap;
    va_start(ap, fmt);
    vsnprintf(msg, sizeof msg, fmt, ap);
    va_end(ap);
    printf("\nC++ RUNTIME: %s (guest caller 0x%llx, in f_%llx)\n", msg, (unsigned long long)c->x[30] - 4, (unsigned long long)c->fn);
    trace_printf("C++ RUNTIME: %s (guest caller 0x%llx)\n", msg, (unsigned long long)c->x[30] - 4);
    cxxrt_print_guest_stack();
    report_and_exit(3);
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- RTTI
 * [sdk] typeinfo objects: { vptr = <kind table> + 0x10, const char *name } ; __si_class_type_info adds { base } ;
 * __vmi_class_type_info adds { u32 flags, u32 base_count, { base, long offset_flags }[] } with offset = offset_flags >> 8,
 * bit 0 = virtual (then the offset indexes the vtable), bit 1 = public. The kind is recognised by the vptr, so each
 * imported __cxxabiv1 table has its own address; their virtual functions are never called by the game. */
static uint64_t g_vt_class[12], g_vt_si[12], g_vt_vmi[12], g_vt_fund[12], g_vt_ptr[12];
enum { TI_OTHER, TI_CLASS, TI_SI, TI_VMI };
static int ti_kind(uint64_t ti) {
    if (!cxxrt_readable(ti, 16)) return TI_OTHER;
    uint64_t v = rd64(ti);
    return v == P64(&g_vt_class[2]) ? TI_CLASS : v == P64(&g_vt_si[2]) ? TI_SI : v == P64(&g_vt_vmi[2]) ? TI_VMI : TI_OTHER;
}
const char *cxxrt_type_name(uint64_t ti) {
    if (!cxxrt_readable(ti, 16)) return "?";
    uint64_t n = rd64(ti + 8) & 0x7fffffffffffffffull;       /* the top bit marks a non-unique name */
    return cxxrt_readable(n, 2) ? (const char *)(uintptr_t)n : "?";
}
static int ti_same(uint64_t a, uint64_t b) { return a == b || (a && b && strcmp(cxxrt_type_name(a), cxxrt_type_name(b)) == 0); }
/* Collects the addresses of every `target` sub-object inside the object of dynamic type `ti` at `addr`. */
static void ti_collect(uint64_t ti, uint64_t addr, uint64_t target, uint64_t *out, int *n, int max, int depth) {
    if (depth > 16) return;
    if (ti_same(ti, target)) {
        for (int i = 0; i < *n; i++) if (out[i] == addr) return;      /* a shared virtual base is one sub-object */
        if (*n < max) out[(*n)++] = addr;
        return;
    }
    int kind = ti_kind(ti);
    if (kind == TI_SI) ti_collect(rd64(ti + 16), addr, target, out, n, max, depth + 1);
    else if (kind == TI_VMI) {
        uint32_t count = rd32(ti + 20);
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < count && i < 64; i++) {
            uint64_t base = rd64(ti + 24 + 16ull * i);
            int64_t of = (int64_t)rd64(ti + 32 + 16ull * i), off = of >> 8;
            if (of & 1) {                                              /* virtual base: its offset is in the vtable */
                if (!cxxrt_readable(addr, 8) || !cxxrt_readable(rd64(addr) + (uint64_t)off, 8)) continue;
                off = (int64_t)rd64(rd64(addr) + (uint64_t)off);
            }
            ti_collect(base, addr + (uint64_t)off, target, out, n, max, depth + 1);
        }
    }
}
/* Address of the unique `target` base of an object, or 0. */
static uint64_t ti_upcast(uint64_t ti, uint64_t obj, uint64_t target) {
    uint64_t found[8];
    int n = 0;
    ti_collect(ti, obj, target, found, &n, 8, 0);
    return n == 1 ? found[0] : 0;
}
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- exception objects and the EH runtime (eh_runtime.h)
 * [sdk __cxa_throw 0x4c9ea0, __cxa_begin_catch 0x4c9fb8] the header in front of a thrown object is libc++abi's
 * __cxa_exception, 0x80 bytes; the fields the SDK code touches are at the same offsets here. The two handler
 * pointers libc++abi keeps there are not used by anything, so their slots hold our magic and the object size. */
typedef struct {
    volatile LONG64 refs;            /* -0x80 */
    uint64_t type, dtor;             /* -0x78 std::type_info *, -0x70 void (*)(void *) */
    uint64_t magic, size;            /* -0x68, -0x60 */
    uint64_t next;                   /* -0x58 next older caught exception of the context (thrown object pointer) */
    int32_t handlers, selector;      /* -0x50 handler count (negative while rethrown), -0x4c */
    uint64_t action, lsda, catch_temp;
    uint64_t adjusted;               /* -0x30 what __cxa_begin_catch returns */
    uint64_t primary;                /* -0x28 dependent exception (std::rethrow_exception): the real object; else 0 */
    uint64_t uw_class, uw_cleanup, uw_private[2];        /* -0x20 _Unwind_Exception */
} ExcHeader;
#define EXC_MAGIC 0x43584345584e4e21ull
#define UW_CLASS 0x434c4e47432b2b00ull                   /* "CLNGC++\0"; +1 for a dependent exception */
static ExcHeader *exc_header(uint64_t obj) {
    if (!obj) return NULL;
    ExcHeader *h = (ExcHeader *)(uintptr_t)(obj - sizeof(ExcHeader));
    return cxxrt_readable(P64(h), sizeof *h) && h->magic == EXC_MAGIC ? h : NULL;
}
static uint64_t exc_object(uint64_t obj) { ExcHeader *h = exc_header(obj); return h && h->primary ? h->primary : obj; }   /* the C++ object */
uint64_t cxxrt_allocate_exception(size_t size) {
    ExcHeader *h = _aligned_malloc(sizeof *h + (size ? size : 1), 16);
    if (!h) { printf("\nC++ RUNTIME: out of memory allocating an exception of %llu bytes\n", (unsigned long long)size); report_and_exit(3); }
    memset(h, 0, sizeof *h + size);
    h->magic = EXC_MAGIC;
    h->size = size;
    h->uw_class = UW_CLASS;
    return P64(h + 1);
}
uint64_t eh_allocate(size_t size) { return cxxrt_allocate_exception(size); }
const char *eh_type_name(uint64_t exception) { ExcHeader *h = exc_header(exception); return h ? cxxrt_type_name(h->type) : "?"; }

/* ---- per-context state: each guest thread and each guest fiber has its own Ctx */
typedef struct { Ctx *c; uint64_t in_flight, caught; int uncaught; } EhState;
#define EH_STATES 4096
static EhState g_eh_state[EH_STATES];
static SRWLOCK g_eh_state_lock = SRWLOCK_INIT;
static EhState *eh_state(Ctx *c) {
    unsigned h = (unsigned)((P64(c) >> 6) * 2654435761u) % EH_STATES;
    for (int probe = 0; probe < EH_STATES; probe++, h = (h + 1) % EH_STATES) {       /* entries are never removed */
        Ctx *seen = g_eh_state[h].c;
        if (seen == c) return &g_eh_state[h];
        if (!seen) break;
    }
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_eh_state_lock);
    for (;; h = (h + 1) % EH_STATES) {
        if (g_eh_state[h].c == c) break;
        if (!g_eh_state[h].c) { g_eh_state[h].c = c; break; }
    }
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_eh_state_lock);
    return &g_eh_state[h];
}
uint64_t eh_in_flight(Ctx *c) { return eh_state(c)->in_flight; }

/* ---- loaded images */
typedef struct { uint64_t base, size, hdr, table; uint32_t count; } EhImage;
#define EH_IMAGES 256
static EhImage g_eh_image[EH_IMAGES];
static SRWLOCK g_eh_image_lock = SRWLOCK_INIT;

static uint64_t rd_uleb(uint64_t *p) { uint64_t r = 0; int s = 0; for (;;) { uint8_t b = rd8((*p)++); r |= (uint64_t)(b & 0x7f) << s; s += 7; if (!(b & 0x80)) return r; } }
static int64_t rd_sleb(uint64_t *p) {
    uint64_t r = 0; int s = 0;
    for (;;) { uint8_t b = rd8((*p)++); r |= (uint64_t)(b & 0x7f) << s; s += 7; if (!(b & 0x80)) { if ((b & 0x40) && s < 64) r |= ~0ull << s; return (int64_t)r; } }
}
/* DW_EH_PE encoded value at *p (guest memory, already relocated). A stored zero means "none". */
static uint64_t rd_enc(uint64_t *p, int enc, uint64_t datarel) {
    uint64_t at = *p, v;
    if (enc == 0xff) return 0;
    switch (enc & 0x0f) {
    case 0x00: case 0x04: case 0x0c: v = rd64(at); *p += 8; break;
    case 0x01: v = rd_uleb(p); break;
    case 0x09: v = (uint64_t)rd_sleb(p); break;
    case 0x02: v = rd16(at); *p += 2; break;
    case 0x0a: v = (uint64_t)(int64_t)(int16_t)rd16(at); *p += 2; break;
    case 0x03: v = rd32(at); *p += 4; break;
    case 0x0b: v = (uint64_t)(int64_t)(int32_t)rd32(at); *p += 4; break;
    default: return 0;
    }
    if (!v) return 0;
    if ((enc & 0x70) == 0x10) v += at;
    else if ((enc & 0x70) == 0x30) v += datarel;
    if (enc & 0x80) v = cxxrt_readable(v, 8) ? rd64(v) : 0;
    return v;
}
int eh_register_image(uint64_t base, uint64_t size, uint64_t hdr) {
    if (!hdr) {
        if (!cxxrt_readable(base, 16)) return 0;
        uint64_t mod0 = base + rd32(base + 4);
        if (!cxxrt_readable(mod0, 0x18) || rd32(mod0) != 0x30444f4d) return 0;       /* "MOD0" */
        hdr = mod0 + (uint64_t)(int64_t)(int32_t)rd32(mod0 + 0x10);
    }
    if (!cxxrt_readable(hdr, 12) || rd8(hdr) != 1 || rd8(hdr + 3) != 0x3b) return 0;      /* version 1, table of datarel sdata4 pairs */
    uint64_t p = hdr + 4;
    (void)rd_enc(&p, rd8(hdr + 1), hdr);                                              /* .eh_frame itself: not needed */
    uint64_t count = rd_enc(&p, rd8(hdr + 2), hdr);
    if (!count) return 0;
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_eh_image_lock);
    int slot = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < EH_IMAGES; i++) {
        if (g_eh_image[i].base == base && g_eh_image[i].size) { slot = i; break; }
        if (slot < 0 && !g_eh_image[i].size) slot = i;
    }
    if (slot >= 0) { EhImage im = {base, size, hdr, p, (uint32_t)count}; g_eh_image[slot] = im; }
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_eh_image_lock);
    return slot >= 0;
}
/* Resume entries of main: only a game DLL lifted with resume entries exports game_eh_bind. This build lifts the game
 * without them, so the table stays empty (see nnunwind.c). */
typedef struct { uint64_t lp; void (*fn)(Ctx *, uint64_t); } MainResume;
static const MainResume *g_main_resume;
static int g_main_resume_n;
void nro_catch_call(Ctx *c, void (*body)(Ctx *, uint64_t));               /* nnunwind.c */
static void eh_bind_main(void) {
    HMODULE dll = NULL;
    typedef void (*BindFn)(void (*)(Ctx *, void (*)(Ctx *, uint64_t)), const MainResume **, int *);
    if (!GetModuleHandleExA(GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_FROM_ADDRESS | GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_UNCHANGED_REFCOUNT, (LPCSTR)&fn_table[0], &dll)) return;
    BindFn bind = (BindFn)(void *)GetProcAddress(dll, "game_eh_bind");
    if (bind) bind(nro_catch_call, &g_main_resume, &g_main_resume_n);
    trace_printf("nncxxrt: main %s\n", bind ? "has landing-pad resume entries" : "was lifted without resume entries (exceptions cannot be handled in main code)");
}
EhResumeFn eh_main_resume_entry(uint64_t lp) {
    int lo = 0, hi = g_main_resume_n - 1;
    while (lo <= hi) {
        int mid = (lo + hi) / 2;
        if (g_main_resume[mid].lp == lp) return g_main_resume[mid].fn;
        if (g_main_resume[mid].lp < lp) lo = mid + 1; else hi = mid - 1;
    }
    return NULL;
}
void eh_unregister_image(uint64_t base) {
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_eh_image_lock);
    for (int i = 0; i < EH_IMAGES; i++) if (g_eh_image[i].base == base) memset(&g_eh_image[i], 0, sizeof g_eh_image[i]);
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_eh_image_lock);
}
int eh_find_function(uint64_t pc, EhFunction *out) {
    EhImage im = {0};
    memset(out, 0, sizeof *out);
    AcquireSRWLockShared(&g_eh_image_lock);
    for (int i = 0; i < EH_IMAGES; i++)
        if (g_eh_image[i].size && pc >= g_eh_image[i].base && pc - g_eh_image[i].base < g_eh_image[i].size) { im = g_eh_image[i]; break; }
    ReleaseSRWLockShared(&g_eh_image_lock);
    if (!im.size) return 0;
    /* binary search table: { s32 initial location, s32 FDE address }, both relative to the header, sorted */
    int64_t rel = (int64_t)(pc - im.hdr);
    uint32_t lo = 0, hi = im.count;
    while (hi - lo > 1) { uint32_t mid = lo + (hi - lo) / 2; if ((int32_t)rd32(im.table + 8ull * mid) <= rel) lo = mid; else hi = mid; }
    if ((int32_t)rd32(im.table + 8ull * lo) > rel) return 0;
    uint64_t fde = im.hdr + (uint64_t)(int64_t)(int32_t)rd32(im.table + 8ull * lo + 4);
    uint64_t cie = fde + 4 - rd32(fde + 4);
    /* CIE: length, id, version, augmentation string, code/data alignment, return register, augmentation data */
    int lsda_enc = 0xff, fde_enc = 0, has_z = 0;
    uint64_t p = cie + 8;
    int version = rd8(p++);
    uint64_t aug = p;
    while (rd8(p)) p++;
    p++;
    (void)rd_uleb(&p); (void)rd_sleb(&p);
    if (version == 1) p++; else (void)rd_uleb(&p);
    if (rd8(aug) == 'z') {
        has_z = 1;
        (void)rd_uleb(&p);
        for (uint64_t a = aug + 1; rd8(a); a++) {
            if (rd8(a) == 'L') lsda_enc = rd8(p++);
            else if (rd8(a) == 'R') fde_enc = rd8(p++);
            else if (rd8(a) == 'P') { int e = rd8(p++); (void)rd_enc(&p, e & 0x7f, 0); }
        }
    }
    p = fde + 8;
    uint64_t start = rd_enc(&p, fde_enc, im.hdr), range = rd_enc(&p, fde_enc & 0x0f, 0);
    if (pc < start || pc - start >= range) return 0;
    out->image_base = im.base; out->start = start; out->end = start + range; out->fde = fde;
    if (has_z) { (void)rd_uleb(&p); if (lsda_enc != 0xff) out->lsda = rd_enc(&p, lsda_enc, im.hdr); }
    return 1;
}

/* ---- personality: the LSDA of the function, read as libc++abi's __gxx_personality_v0 reads it */
static int type_catches(uint64_t catch_ti, uint64_t thrown_ti, uint64_t obj, uint64_t *adjusted) {
    *adjusted = obj;
    if (!catch_ti || ti_same(catch_ti, thrown_ti)) return 1;                          /* catch (...) or the same type */
    uint64_t base = ti_upcast(thrown_ti, obj, catch_ti);                              /* a unique base class */
    if (base) { *adjusted = base; return 1; }
    return 0;
}
int eh_personality(Ctx *c, uint64_t call_pc, uint64_t exception, EhPad *out) {
    ExcHeader *h = exc_header(exception);
    (void)c;
    memset(out, 0, sizeof *out);
    out->exception = exception;
    if (!eh_find_function(call_pc, &out->function) || !out->function.lsda) return EH_NONE;
    uint64_t p = out->function.lsda, func = out->function.start;
    int lp_enc = rd8(p++);
    uint64_t lp_start = lp_enc != 0xff ? rd_enc(&p, lp_enc, 0) : func;
    int tt_enc = rd8(p++);
    uint64_t tt_base = 0;
    if (tt_enc != 0xff) { uint64_t off = rd_uleb(&p); tt_base = p + off; }
    int cs_enc = rd8(p++);
    uint64_t cs_len = rd_uleb(&p), cs_end = p + cs_len, lp = 0, action = 0;
    int found = 0;
    while (p < cs_end) {
        uint64_t s = rd_enc(&p, cs_enc & 0x0f, 0), l = rd_enc(&p, cs_enc & 0x0f, 0), pad = rd_enc(&p, cs_enc & 0x0f, 0), act = rd_uleb(&p);
        if (call_pc - func >= s && call_pc - func < s + l) { lp = pad; action = act; found = 1; break; }
        if (call_pc - func < s) break;
    }
    if (!found || !lp) return EH_NONE;
    out->landing_pad = lp_start + lp;
    out->adjusted = exc_object(exception);
    if (!action) { out->kind = EH_CLEANUP; return EH_CLEANUP; }
    uint64_t thrown = h ? h->type : 0, obj = exc_object(exception);
    int tt_size = (tt_enc & 0x0f) == 0x03 || (tt_enc & 0x0f) == 0x0b ? 4 : (tt_enc & 0x0f) == 0x02 || (tt_enc & 0x0f) == 0x0a ? 2 : 8;
    int cleanup = 0;
    for (uint64_t a = cs_end + action - 1;;) {
        uint64_t q = a;
        int64_t filter = rd_sleb(&q);
        uint64_t next_at = q;
        int64_t next = rd_sleb(&q);
        if (filter > 0) {                                                             /* catch clause */
            uint64_t tp = tt_base - (uint64_t)filter * (uint64_t)tt_size;
            uint64_t catch_ti = rd_enc(&tp, tt_enc, 0);
            if (!h && catch_ti) { /* an exception of unknown origin only matches catch (...) */ }
            else if (type_catches(catch_ti, thrown, obj, &out->adjusted)) { out->selector = filter; out->kind = EH_HANDLER; return EH_HANDLER; }
        } else if (filter < 0) {                                                      /* exception specification: a list of allowed types */
            uint64_t list = tt_base + (uint64_t)(-filter - 1), adj;
            int allowed = 0;
            for (;;) {
                uint64_t index = rd_uleb(&list);
                if (!index) break;
                uint64_t tp = tt_base - index * (uint64_t)tt_size;
                if (type_catches(rd_enc(&tp, tt_enc, 0), thrown, obj, &adj)) { allowed = 1; break; }
            }
            if (!allowed) { out->selector = filter; out->adjusted = obj; out->kind = EH_HANDLER; return EH_HANDLER; }
        } else cleanup = 1;
        if (!next) break;
        a = next_at + (uint64_t)next;
    }
    if (cleanup) { out->kind = EH_CLEANUP; return EH_CLEANUP; }
    out->landing_pad = 0;
    return EH_NONE;
}
void eh_enter_pad(Ctx *c, const EhPad *pad) {
    ExcHeader *h = exc_header(pad->exception);
    if (h) { h->adjusted = pad->adjusted; h->selector = (int32_t)pad->selector; h->lsda = pad->function.lsda; }
    eh_state(c)->in_flight = 0;
    c->x[0] = pad->exception - 0x20;
    c->x[1] = (uint64_t)pad->selector;
}

/* ---- terminate and raise */
static uint64_t g_ti_exception[2];
void eh_terminate(Ctx *c, const char *why) {
    EhState *st = eh_state(c);
    uint64_t exc = st->in_flight ? st->in_flight : st->caught;
    ExcHeader *h = exc_header(exc);
    uint64_t obj = exc_object(exc), type = h ? h->type : 0;
    st->in_flight = 0;
    printf("\nstd::terminate: %s (guest caller 0x%llx, last function f_%llx)\n", why, (unsigned long long)c->x[30] - 4, (unsigned long long)c->fn);
    trace_printf("std::terminate: %s (guest caller 0x%llx)\n", why, (unsigned long long)c->x[30] - 4);
    if (h) {
        const char *what = NULL;
        char extra[160] = "";
        printf("  exception type: %s\n", cxxrt_type_name(type));
        trace_printf("  exception type: %s\n", cxxrt_type_name(type));
        uint64_t base = ti_upcast(type, obj, P64(g_ti_exception));
        if (base && cxxrt_readable(base, 8) && cxxrt_readable(rd64(base), 0x18)) {
            uint64_t w = cxxrt_call(c, rd64(rd64(base) + 0x10), base, 0, 0);          /* virtual const char *what() const */
            if (cxxrt_readable(w, 1)) what = (const char *)(uintptr_t)w;
        } else {
            int n = snprintf(extra, sizeof extra, "  object (%llu bytes):", (unsigned long long)h->size);
            for (uint64_t i = 0; i + 8 <= h->size && i < 32; i += 8) n += snprintf(extra + n, sizeof extra - (size_t)n, " %016llx", (unsigned long long)rd64(obj + i));
            if (h->size < 8 && h->size >= 4) snprintf(extra + n, sizeof extra - (size_t)n, " %08x", rd32(obj));
        }
        if (what) { printf("  what(): %s\n", what); trace_printf("  what(): %s\n", what); }
        else if (extra[0]) { printf("%s (not derived from std::exception)\n", extra); trace_printf("%s\n", extra); }
    }
    cxxrt_print_guest_stack();
    report_and_exit(3);
}
static EhRaiseFn g_eh_raise;
void eh_set_unwinder(EhRaiseFn raise) { g_eh_raise = raise; }
static void eh_raise(Ctx *c, uint64_t exc, int reason, const char *how) {
    EhState *st = eh_state(c);
    st->in_flight = exc;
    if (g_eh_raise) g_eh_raise(c, reason);
    if (st->in_flight) {
        char why[160];
        snprintf(why, sizeof why, g_eh_raise ? "%s: no handler was found" : "%s: no unwinder is installed in this build, so no handler can run", how);
        eh_terminate(c, why);
    }
}
void eh_throw(Ctx *c, uint64_t exception, uint64_t type, uint64_t dtor) {
    ExcHeader *h = exc_header(exception);
    if (!h) { printf("\nC++ RUNTIME: throw of an object at 0x%llx that __cxa_allocate_exception did not create\n", (unsigned long long)exception); cxxrt_print_guest_stack(); report_and_exit(3); }
    h->type = type; h->dtor = dtor; h->refs = 1; h->handlers = 0; h->primary = 0; h->uw_class = UW_CLASS;
    eh_state(c)->uncaught++;
    eh_raise(c, exception, EH_RAISE_THROW, "uncaught exception");
}
/* Used by nncxxlib.c: throw an exception object prepared with cxxrt_exception_init, or stop when there is none. */
void cxxrt_throw_report(Ctx *c, const char *how, uint64_t obj, uint64_t type) {
    ExcHeader *h = exc_header(obj);
    if (h) eh_throw(c, obj, type, h->dtor);
    else eh_terminate(c, how);
}

static void abi_pure_virtual(Ctx *c) { fatal(c, "pure virtual function called"); }
static uint64_t g_ti_bad_typeid[3], g_ti_bad_cast[3], g_vt_bad_cast[5], g_vt_bad_typeid[5], g_vt_length_error[5], g_vt_out_of_range[5],
                g_ti_length_error[3], g_ti_out_of_range[3];
uint64_t cxxrt_refstring_new(const char *s, size_t n);
static void throw_logic(Ctx *c, uint64_t *vt, uint64_t *ti, const char *msg) {      /* { vptr, refstring } */
    uint64_t obj = cxxrt_allocate_exception(16);
    wr64(obj, P64(&vt[2]));
    wr64(obj + 8, cxxrt_refstring_new(msg, strlen(msg)));
    eh_throw(c, obj, P64(ti), vt[2]);
}
static uint64_t g_vt_ios_failure[5], g_ti_ios_failure[3], g_ti_error_category_rt[2], g_vt_iostream_category[9], g_iostream_category[1];
/* std::ios_base::failure = system_error = { runtime_error { vptr, refstring }, error_code { int, const error_category * } };
 * libc++ throws it with make_error_code(io_errc::stream) = { 1, iostream_category() } */
void cxxrt_throw_ios_failure(Ctx *c, const char *msg) {
    char text[160];
    snprintf(text, sizeof text, "%s: unspecified iostream_category error", msg);
    uint64_t obj = cxxrt_allocate_exception(0x20);
    wr64(obj, P64(&g_vt_ios_failure[2]));
    wr64(obj + 8, cxxrt_refstring_new(text, strlen(text)));
    wr64(obj + 0x10, 1);
    wr64(obj + 0x18, P64(g_iostream_category));
    eh_throw(c, obj, P64(g_ti_ios_failure), g_vt_ios_failure[2]);
}
static void iocat_name(Ctx *c) { RET("iostream"); }
static void iocat_ret_this(Ctx *c) { RET(A0); }
static void iocat_condition(Ctx *c) { uint64_t self = A0; RET((uint32_t)A1); c->x[1] = self; }
static void iocat_equivalent_cond(Ctx *c) { RET(rd32(A2) == (uint32_t)A1 && rd64(A2 + 8) == A0); }
static void iocat_equivalent_code(Ctx *c) { RET(rd64(A1 + 8) == A0 && rd32(A1) == (uint32_t)A2); }
static void iocat_message(Ctx *c) { const char *m = (int32_t)A1 == 1 ? "unspecified iostream_category error" : "unspecified generic_category error"; cxx_string_init(c, c->x[8], m, strlen(m)); }
/* libc++ __vector_base_common / __basic_string_common ::__throw_length_error / __throw_out_of_range */
static void throw_vector_length(Ctx *c) { throw_logic(c, g_vt_length_error, g_ti_length_error, "vector"); }
static void throw_vector_range(Ctx *c) { throw_logic(c, g_vt_out_of_range, g_ti_out_of_range, "vector"); }
static void throw_string_length(Ctx *c) { throw_logic(c, g_vt_length_error, g_ti_length_error, "basic_string"); }
int cxxrt_uncaught(Ctx *c) { return eh_state(c)->uncaught > 0; }                   /* nncxxlib.c: the ostream sentry asks it directly */

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- guard variables (thread-safe static initialisation)
 * Itanium ABI: the first byte of the 64-bit guard is 1 once the object is initialised (the game tests it inline).
 * As in libc++abi the second byte marks "initialisation in progress" and the upper half records the initialising
 * thread, so other threads wait and a recursive initialisation is reported instead of deadlocking. */
static CRITICAL_SECTION g_guard_lock;
static CONDITION_VARIABLE g_guard_cv;
static INIT_ONCE g_guard_once = INIT_ONCE_STATIC_INIT;
static BOOL CALLBACK guard_init(PINIT_ONCE once, PVOID arg, PVOID *ctx) {
    (void)once; (void)arg; (void)ctx;
    InitializeCriticalSection(&g_guard_lock);
    InitializeConditionVariable(&g_guard_cv);
    return TRUE;
}
static void abi_guard_acquire(Ctx *c) {
    uint64_t g = A0;
    int r;
    InitOnceExecuteOnce(&g_guard_once, guard_init, NULL, NULL);
    EnterCriticalSection(&g_guard_lock);
    for (;;) {
        if (rd8(g)) { r = 0; break; }
        if (!rd8(g + 1)) { wr8(g + 1, 1); wr32(g + 4, GetCurrentThreadId()); r = 1; break; }
        if (rd32(g + 4) == GetCurrentThreadId()) {
            LeaveCriticalSection(&g_guard_lock);
            fatal(c, "recursive initialisation of the static object guarded at 0x%llx", (unsigned long long)g);
        }
        SleepConditionVariableCS(&g_guard_cv, &g_guard_lock, INFINITE);
    }
    LeaveCriticalSection(&g_guard_lock);
    RET(r);
}
static void guard_finish(uint64_t g, int done) {
    InitOnceExecuteOnce(&g_guard_once, guard_init, NULL, NULL);
    EnterCriticalSection(&g_guard_lock);
    wr32(g + 4, 0);
    wr8(g + 1, 0);
    if (done) { MemoryBarrier(); wr8(g, 1); }
    WakeAllConditionVariable(&g_guard_cv);
    LeaveCriticalSection(&g_guard_lock);
}
static void abi_guard_release(Ctx *c) { guard_finish(A0, 1); }

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- standard exception classes
 * [sdk] std::exception = { vptr }; vtable: ~D1, ~D0, what. std::logic_error / runtime_error = { vptr, __libcpp_refstring }
 * where the refstring is a pointer to the characters, preceded by { size_t len, size_t cap, int count } (count = extra
 * references; the destructor frees the block at chars - 0x18 when the atomic decrement goes negative). */
static uint64_t g_vt_exception[5], g_vt_bad_alloc[5], g_vt_bad_cast[5], g_vt_bad_typeid[5], g_vt_logic_error[5],
                g_vt_out_of_range[5], g_vt_length_error[5], g_vt_invalid_argument[5], g_vt_runtime_error[5];
static uint64_t g_ti_logic_error[3], g_ti_runtime_error[3], g_ti_out_of_range[3], g_ti_length_error[3], g_ti_invalid_argument[3],
                g_ti_bad_alloc[3], g_ti_system_error[3], g_ti_ios_failure[3], g_ti_streambuf[2], g_ti_shared_count[2],
                g_ti_shared_weak_count[5], g_ti_bool[2], g_ti_float[2], g_ti_int[2], g_ti_uint[2];
uint64_t cxxrt_ti_exception(void) { return P64(g_ti_exception); }
uint64_t cxxrt_vt_logic_error(void) { return P64(&g_vt_logic_error[2]); }
uint64_t cxxrt_class_ti_vptr(int kind) { return kind == TI_SI ? P64(&g_vt_si[2]) : kind == TI_VMI ? P64(&g_vt_vmi[2]) : P64(&g_vt_class[2]); }

uint64_t cxxrt_refstring_new(const char *s, size_t n) {
    uint64_t *rep = malloc(0x18 + n + 1);
    rep[0] = n; rep[1] = n; rep[2] = 0;
    memcpy(rep + 3, s, n);
    ((char *)(rep + 3))[n] = 0;
    return P64(rep + 3);
}
static void refstring_release(uint64_t s) { if (s && InterlockedDecrement((volatile LONG *)(uintptr_t)(s - 8)) < 0) free((void *)(uintptr_t)(s - 0x18)); }

static void exc_dtor(Ctx *c) { RET(A0); }                                      /* ~exception, ~bad_alloc, ~bad_cast (D1/D2) */
static void exc_dtor_delete(Ctx *c) { cxxrt_guest_delete(c, A0); }             /* D0 */
static void exc_what(Ctx *c) { RET("std::exception"); }
static void bad_alloc_what(Ctx *c) { RET("std::bad_alloc"); }
static void bad_cast_what(Ctx *c) { RET("std::bad_cast"); }
static void bad_typeid_what(Ctx *c) { RET("std::bad_typeid"); }
static void logic_dtor(Ctx *c) { uint64_t self = A0; refstring_release(rd64(self + 8)); wr64(self + 8, 0); RET(self); }
static void logic_dtor_delete(Ctx *c) { uint64_t self = A0; refstring_release(rd64(self + 8)); cxxrt_guest_delete(c, self); }
static void logic_what(Ctx *c) { RET(rd64(A0 + 8)); }
static void ti_virtual_trap(Ctx *c) { fatal(c, "a virtual function of a std::type_info object was called (%s)", hostfn_current_name()); }

static void make_vtable(uint64_t *vt, uint64_t *ti, const char *cls, ImportFn d1, ImportFn d0, ImportFn what) {
    char name[72];
    vt[0] = 0;
    vt[1] = P64(ti);
    snprintf(name, sizeof name, "%s::~%s [D1]", cls, cls); vt[2] = hostfn_address(name, d1);
    snprintf(name, sizeof name, "%s::~%s [D0]", cls, cls); vt[3] = hostfn_address(name, d0);
    snprintf(name, sizeof name, "%s::what", cls); vt[4] = hostfn_address(name, what);
}
static void make_ti(uint64_t *ti, int kind, const char *name, uint64_t *base) {
    ti[0] = kind == TI_SI ? P64(&g_vt_si[2]) : kind == TI_VMI ? P64(&g_vt_vmi[2]) : kind == TI_CLASS ? P64(&g_vt_class[2]) : P64(&g_vt_fund[2]);
    ti[1] = P64(name);
    if (kind == TI_SI) ti[2] = P64(base);
}

void cxxrt_install_data(void) {
    static const struct { uint64_t *vt; const char *name; } kinds[] = {
        {g_vt_class, "__class_type_info"}, {g_vt_si, "__si_class_type_info"}, {g_vt_vmi, "__vmi_class_type_info"},
        {g_vt_fund, "__fundamental_type_info"}, {g_vt_ptr, "__pointer_type_info"},
    };
    for (int k = 0; k < 5; k++)
        for (int i = 2; i < 12; i++) {
            char name[72];
            snprintf(name, sizeof name, "%s virtual #%d", kinds[k].name, i - 2);
            kinds[k].vt[i] = hostfn_address(name, ti_virtual_trap);
        }
    import_set_address("_ZTVN10__cxxabiv117__class_type_infoE", g_vt_class);
    import_set_address("_ZTVN10__cxxabiv120__si_class_type_infoE", g_vt_si);
    import_set_address("_ZTVN10__cxxabiv121__vmi_class_type_infoE", g_vt_vmi);
    import_set_address("_ZTVN10__cxxabiv123__fundamental_type_infoE", g_vt_fund);
    import_set_address("_ZTVN10__cxxabiv119__pointer_type_infoE", g_vt_ptr);

    /* [sdk] the hierarchy and the name strings are those of the SDK's typeinfo objects */
    make_ti(g_ti_exception, TI_CLASS, "St9exception", NULL);
    make_ti(g_ti_logic_error, TI_SI, "St11logic_error", g_ti_exception);
    make_ti(g_ti_runtime_error, TI_SI, "St13runtime_error", g_ti_exception);
    make_ti(g_ti_out_of_range, TI_SI, "St12out_of_range", g_ti_logic_error);
    make_ti(g_ti_length_error, TI_SI, "St12length_error", g_ti_logic_error);
    make_ti(g_ti_invalid_argument, TI_SI, "St16invalid_argument", g_ti_logic_error);
    make_ti(g_ti_bad_alloc, TI_SI, "St9bad_alloc", g_ti_exception);
    make_ti(g_ti_bad_cast, TI_SI, "St8bad_cast", g_ti_exception);
    make_ti(g_ti_bad_typeid, TI_SI, "St10bad_typeid", g_ti_exception);
    make_ti(g_ti_system_error, TI_SI, "NSt3__112system_errorE", g_ti_runtime_error);
    make_ti(g_ti_ios_failure, TI_SI, "NSt3__18ios_base7failureE", g_ti_system_error);
    make_ti(g_ti_streambuf, TI_CLASS, "NSt3__115basic_streambufIcNS_11char_traitsIcEEEE", NULL);
    make_ti(g_ti_shared_count, TI_CLASS, "NSt3__114__shared_countE", NULL);
    make_ti(g_ti_shared_weak_count, TI_VMI, "NSt3__119__shared_weak_countE", NULL);
    g_ti_shared_weak_count[2] = 0x0000000100000000ull;                 /* flags 0, one base */
    g_ti_shared_weak_count[3] = P64(g_ti_shared_count);
    g_ti_shared_weak_count[4] = 0;                                     /* offset 0, not public, not virtual */
    make_ti(g_ti_bool, TI_OTHER, "b", NULL); make_ti(g_ti_float, TI_OTHER, "f", NULL);
    make_ti(g_ti_int, TI_OTHER, "i", NULL); make_ti(g_ti_uint, TI_OTHER, "j", NULL);
    import_set_address("_ZTISt9exception", g_ti_exception);

        if (!import_lookup(cxxrt_fill[i].name)) register_imports(&cxxrt_fill[i], 1);
    register_cxxlib_imports();
    register_libc2_imports();
    if (!eh_register_image(GUEST_BASE, 0x7500000ull, 0)) printf("nncxxrt: the exception tables of main were not found\n");
    eh_bind_main();
    const char *path = getenv("SMO_DUMP_UNREG_FINAL");      /* every import that has no handler after ALL registrations */
    if (path && path[0]) {
        FILE *f = fopen(path, "w");
        for (int i = 0; f && i < dyn_sym_count; i++)
            if (!dyn_syms[i].defined && dyn_syms[i].name[0] && !import_lookup(dyn_syms[i].name)) fprintf(f, "%d %s\n", (int)(import_address(i) != IMPORT_BASE + (uint64_t)i * IMPORT_SLOT), dyn_syms[i].name);
        if (f) fclose(f);
    }
    if (getenv("SMO_CXXRT_SELFTEST")) cxxrt_selftest();
}
```

```c
/* libc++ iostreams: the base classes the game imports from the SDK's C++ library.
 *
 * The game has its own stream classes (std::ostringstream / istringstream with their stringbuf are
 * compiled into the game) but takes the base-class pieces from the SDK: ios_base::init, the
 * basic_streambuf constructor and default virtuals, ostream::sentry, ios_base::clear / getloc and the stream
 * destructors. Layouts are libc++'s on AArch64 (the stringbuf fields the game
 * reads in f_7102d099c0 -- pbase +0x28, pptr +0x30, high mark +0x58, mode +0x60 -- agree with them):
 *
 *   basic_streambuf: +0 vtable, +8 locale, +0x10 eback, +0x18 gptr, +0x20 egptr, +0x28 pbase, +0x30 pptr, +0x38 epptr
 *     vtable: +0x10 imbue, +0x18 setbuf, +0x20 seekoff, +0x28 seekpos, +0x30 sync, +0x38 showmanyc, +0x40 xsgetn,
 *             +0x48 underflow, +0x50 uflow, +0x58 pbackfail, +0x60 xsputn, +0x68 overflow
 *   ios_base: +0 vtable, +8 fmtflags (u32), +0x10 precision, +0x18 width, +0x20 rdstate (u32), +0x24 exceptions (u32),
 *             +0x28 rdbuf, +0x30 locale, +0x38.. callback and iword/pword arrays (to +0x88); basic_ios: +0x88 tie, +0x90 fill
 *   a stream object reaches its basic_ios part through the offset stored at vtable[-3]
 *   ostream::sentry: +0 bool ok, +8 ostream *
 *
 * Only the classic locale exists (see libcxx.c). Exceptions are never thrown: errors only set state bits. */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <windows.h>
#include "runtime.h"
#include "hostrt.h"

#define A0 (c->x[0])
#define A1 (c->x[1])
#define A2 (c->x[2])
#define RET(v) (c->x[0] = (uint64_t)(v))

enum { SB_EBACK = 0x10, SB_GPTR = 0x18, SB_EGPTR = 0x20, SB_PBASE = 0x28, SB_PPTR = 0x30, SB_EPPTR = 0x38 };
enum { VT_XSGETN = 0x40, VT_UNDERFLOW = 0x48, VT_UFLOW = 0x50, VT_XSPUTN = 0x60, VT_OVERFLOW = 0x68 };
enum { IOS_FLAGS = 8, IOS_PRECISION = 0x10, IOS_WIDTH = 0x18, IOS_STATE = 0x20, IOS_EXCEPTIONS = 0x24, IOS_RDBUF = 0x28, IOS_LOCALE = 0x30, IOS_FILL = 0x90 };
enum { F_DEC = 2, F_HEX = 8, F_LEFT = 0x20, F_OCT = 0x40, F_SHOWBASE = 0x200, F_SHOWPOS = 0x800, F_SKIPWS = 0x1000, F_UPPERCASE = 0x4000 };
enum { BADBIT = 1, EOFBIT = 2, FAILBIT = 4 };
#define EOF_INT 0xffffffffu

static uint8_t g_locale_impl[64];                      /* stands for the classic locale, like libcxx.c's */

/* Calls a virtual function of a guest object with up to two more arguments; returns x0. */
static uint64_t vcall(Ctx *c, uint64_t obj, int slot, uint64_t a1, uint64_t a2) {
    c->x[0] = obj;
    c->x[1] = a1;
    c->x[2] = a2;
    call_guest(c, rd64(rd64(obj) + (uint64_t)slot));
    return c->x[0];
}

static uint64_t ios_of(uint64_t stream) { return stream + rd64(rd64(stream) - 0x18); }
void cxxrt_throw_ios_failure(Ctx *c, const char *msg);          /* nncxxrt.c: throws std::ios_base::failure */
/* ---- basic_streambuf */
static void sb_ctor(Ctx *c) {
    uint64_t sb = A0;
    wr64(sb + 8, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)g_locale_impl);
    for (int off = SB_EBACK; off <= SB_EPPTR; off += 8) wr64(sb + (uint64_t)off, 0);
    RET(sb);
}
static void sb_dtor(Ctx *c) { RET(A0); }
static void sb_sync(Ctx *c) { RET(0); }
static void sb_imbue(Ctx *c) { (void)c; }
static void sb_setbuf(Ctx *c) { RET(A0); }
static void sb_showmanyc(Ctx *c) { RET(0); }
static void sb_uflow(Ctx *c) {
    uint64_t sb = A0;
    if ((uint32_t)vcall(c, sb, VT_UNDERFLOW, 0, 0) == EOF_INT) { RET(EOF_INT); return; }
    uint64_t g = rd64(sb + SB_GPTR);
    wr64(sb + SB_GPTR, g + 1);
    RET(*(uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)g);
}
static void sb_xsgetn(Ctx *c) {                                       /* (this, char *s, streamsize n) */
    uint64_t sb = A0, s = A1;
    int64_t n = (int64_t)A2, done = 0;
    while (done < n) {
        uint64_t g = rd64(sb + SB_GPTR), e = rd64(sb + SB_EGPTR);
        if (g < e) {
            int64_t k = (int64_t)(e - g) < n - done ? (int64_t)(e - g) : n - done;
            memcpy((void *)(uintptr_t)(s + (uint64_t)done), (void *)(uintptr_t)g, (size_t)k);
            wr64(sb + SB_GPTR, g + (uint64_t)k);
            done += k;
        } else {
            uint32_t ch = (uint32_t)vcall(c, sb, VT_UFLOW, 0, 0);
            if (ch == EOF_INT) break;
            *(uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)(s + (uint64_t)done++) = (uint8_t)ch;
        }
    }
    RET(done);
}
static int64_t put_chars(Ctx *c, uint64_t sb, const char *s, int64_t n) {
    int64_t done = 0;
    while (done < n) {
        uint64_t p = rd64(sb + SB_PPTR), e = rd64(sb + SB_EPPTR);
        if (p < e) {
            int64_t k = (int64_t)(e - p) < n - done ? (int64_t)(e - p) : n - done;
            memcpy((void *)(uintptr_t)p, s + done, (size_t)k);
            wr64(sb + SB_PPTR, p + (uint64_t)k);
            done += k;
        } else {
            if ((uint32_t)vcall(c, sb, VT_OVERFLOW, (uint8_t)s[done], 0) == EOF_INT) break;
            done++;
        }
    }
    return done;
}
static void sb_xsputn(Ctx *c) {                                       /* (this, const char *s, streamsize n) */
    int64_t n = (int64_t)A2;
    char *copy = malloc(n > 0 ? (size_t)n : 1);                       /* the guest call below may clobber what s points into */
    if (n > 0) memcpy(copy, (void *)(uintptr_t)A1, (size_t)n);
    int64_t done = put_chars(c, A0, copy, n);
    free(copy);
    RET(done);
}

/* ---- ios_base / basic_ios */
static void ios_init(Ctx *c) {                                        /* ios_base::init(void *rdbuf) */
    uint64_t ios = A0, sb = A1;
    memset((void *)(uintptr_t)(ios + 8), 0, 0x88 - 8);
    wr32(ios + IOS_FLAGS, F_SKIPWS | F_DEC);
    wr64(ios + IOS_PRECISION, 6);
    wr32(ios + IOS_STATE, sb ? 0 : BADBIT);
    wr64(ios + IOS_RDBUF, sb);
    wr64(ios + IOS_LOCALE, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)g_locale_impl);
}
static void ios_clear(Ctx *c) {                                       /* ios_base::clear(iostate): throws when an enabled bit is set */
    uint64_t ios = A0;
    uint32_t state = rd64(ios + IOS_RDBUF) ? (uint32_t)A1 : (uint32_t)A1 | BADBIT;
    wr32(ios + IOS_STATE, state);
    if (state & rd32(ios + IOS_EXCEPTIONS)) cxxrt_throw_ios_failure(c, "ios_base::clear");
}
static void ios_getloc(Ctx *c) { wr64(c->x[8], (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)g_locale_impl); }   /* returns a locale by value */
static void nothing(Ctx *c) { (void)c; }
static void ret_this(Ctx *c) { RET(A0); }

/* ---- basic_ostream */
static void os_sentry_ctor(Ctx *c) {                                  /* (sentry *, ostream &) */
    uint64_t s = A0, os = A1;
    wr64(s, 0);
    wr64(s + 8, os);
    *(uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)s = rd32(ios_of(os) + IOS_STATE) == 0;
    RET(s);
}

#define SBUF "_ZNSt3__115basic_streambufIcNS_11char_traitsIcEEE"
#define OSTR "_ZNSt3__113basic_ostreamIcNS_11char_traitsIcEEE"
#define ISTR "_ZNSt3__113basic_istreamIcNS_11char_traitsIcEEE"
#define IOSTR "_ZNSt3__114basic_iostreamIcNS_11char_traitsIcEEE"
static const ImportDef iostream_imports[] = {
    {SBUF "C2Ev", sb_ctor}, {SBUF "D2Ev", sb_dtor}, {SBUF "4syncEv", sb_sync}, {SBUF "5imbueERKNS_6localeE", sb_imbue},
    {SBUF "6setbufEPcl", sb_setbuf}, {SBUF "9showmanycEv", sb_showmanyc}, {SBUF "6xsgetnEPcl", sb_xsgetn},
    {SBUF "5uflowEv", sb_uflow}, {SBUF "6xsputnEPKcl", sb_xsputn},
    {"_ZNSt3__18ios_base4initEPv", ios_init}, {"_ZNSt3__18ios_base5clearEj", ios_clear}, {"_ZNKSt3__18ios_base6getlocEv", ios_getloc},
    {"_ZNSt3__19basic_iosIcNS_11char_traitsIcEEED2Ev", ret_this},
```
