`runtime/libc/nnlibc2.c`:

```c
/* C library additions: conversions between binary128 (long double on AArch64) and double, the standard streams with
 * fclose / feof / ferror, and gmtime.
 *
 * Only names that have no handler yet are installed (see register_libc2_imports). */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <malloc.h>
#include <windows.h>
#include "runtime.h"
#include "hostrt.h"

#define A0 (c->x[0])
#define RET(v) (c->x[0] = (uint64_t)(v))

/* ================================================================ binary128 <-> double
 * long double is IEEE binary128 on AArch64: clib.c reads it for printf's %Lf and writes it for sscanf's %Lf.
 * Narrowing rounds to nearest even. */
typedef unsigned __int128 u128;
#define Q_BIAS 16383
#define Q_FRAC_MASK ((((u128)1) << 112) - 1)
#define Q_IMPLICIT (((u128)1) << 112)
#define Q_INF ((u128)0x7fff << 112)
#define Q_SIGN ((u128)1 << 127)

static int q_is_nan(u128 a) { return (a & ~Q_SIGN) > Q_INF; }
static int q_is_inf(u128 a) { return (a & ~Q_SIGN) == Q_INF; }
static int q_is_zero(u128 a) { return (a & ~Q_SIGN) == 0; }
static int clz128(u128 v) { uint64_t hi = (uint64_t)(v >> 64); return hi ? __builtin_clzll(hi) : 64 + (v ? __builtin_clzll((uint64_t)v) : 64); }

/* Splits a finite non-zero value into exponent and a significand with the leading one at bit 112. */
static void q_unpack(u128 a, int *exp, u128 *sig) {
    int e = (int)((a >> 112) & 0x7fff);
    u128 m = a & Q_FRAC_MASK;
    if (e == 0) { int sh = clz128(m) - 15; m <<= sh; e = 1 - sh; }
    else m |= Q_IMPLICIT;
    *exp = e; *sig = m;
}

u128 q_from_f64(double d) {
    uint64_t bits;
    memcpy(&bits, &d, 8);
    int sign = (int)(bits >> 63), e = (int)((bits >> 52) & 0x7ff);
    uint64_t f = bits & 0xfffffffffffffull;
    if (e == 0x7ff) return ((u128)sign << 127) | Q_INF | (f ? ((u128)1 << 111) | ((u128)f << 60) : 0);
    if (e == 0) {
        if (!f) return (u128)sign << 127;
        int sh = __builtin_clzll(f) - 11;
        f <<= sh; e = 1 - sh; f &= 0xfffffffffffffull;
    }
    return ((u128)sign << 127) | ((u128)(e - 1023 + Q_BIAS) << 112) | ((u128)f << 60);
}
/* Narrowing: rounds the 113-bit significand to `bits` (53 for a double) with the target's exponent range. */
static uint64_t q_narrow(u128 a, int bits, int ebits) {
    int sign = (int)(a >> 127), emax = (1 << ebits) - 1, bias = emax >> 1;
    uint64_t s = (uint64_t)sign << (bits - 1 + ebits);
    if (q_is_nan(a)) return s | ((uint64_t)emax << (bits - 1)) | (1ull << (bits - 2)) | (uint64_t)((a & Q_FRAC_MASK) >> (113 - bits));
    if (q_is_inf(a)) return s | ((uint64_t)emax << (bits - 1));
    if (q_is_zero(a)) return s;
    int e;
    u128 m;
    q_unpack(a, &e, &m);
    e = e - Q_BIAS + bias;
    /* keep bits+3 bits: leading one at bit (bits+2), then guard/round/sticky */
    int shift = 113 - (bits + 3);
    u128 lost = m & (((u128)1 << shift) - 1);
    uint64_t sig = (uint64_t)(m >> shift) | (lost != 0);
    if (e <= 0) {
        int sh = 1 - e;
        if (sh > bits + 3) sig = sig != 0;
        else { uint64_t l = sig & ((1ull << sh) - 1); sig = (sig >> sh) | (l != 0); }
        e = 0;
    }
    unsigned grs = (unsigned)sig & 7;
    sig >>= 3;
    if (grs > 4 || (grs == 4 && (sig & 1))) sig++;
    if (e == 0) { if (sig >> (bits - 1)) e = 1; }
    else if (sig >> bits) { sig >>= 1; e++; }
    if (e >= emax) return s | ((uint64_t)emax << (bits - 1));
    return s | ((uint64_t)e << (bits - 1)) | (sig & ((1ull << (bits - 1)) - 1));
}
double q_to_f64(u128 a) { uint64_t b = q_narrow(a, 53, 11); double d; memcpy(&d, &b, 8); return d; }
void quad_from_double(double d, uint64_t out[2]) { u128 q = q_from_f64(d); out[0] = (uint64_t)q; out[1] = (uint64_t)(q >> 64); }
double quad_to_double(const uint64_t in[2]) { return q_to_f64(((u128)in[1] << 64) | in[0]); }

/* ================================================================ the standard streams
 * The game imports the variables stdin, stdout and stderr and the functions fclose, feof and ferror, but nothing that
 * opens a file: a guest FILE * is one of the three host objects below (the game only passes it back). */
typedef struct {
    uint32_t magic;                  /* 'FILE' */
    int kind;                        /* 1 stdin, 2 stdout, 3 stderr */
    int eof, err, open;
} GFile;
#define GFILE_MAGIC 0x454c4946u
static GFile g_std[3] = {{GFILE_MAGIC, 1, 0, 0, 1}, {GFILE_MAGIC, 2, 0, 0, 1}, {GFILE_MAGIC, 3, 0, 0, 1}};
static uint64_t g_std_ptr[3];        /* the objects behind the imported `stdin`, `stdout`, `stderr` (FILE * variables) */

static GFile *gfile(uint64_t p) {
    GFile *f = (GFile *)(uintptr_t)p;
    return f && f->magic == GFILE_MAGIC ? f : NULL;
}
static void c_fclose(Ctx *c) {
    GFile *f = gfile(A0);
    if (!f) { RET(-1); return; }
    f->open = 0;
    RET(0);
}
static void c_feof(Ctx *c) { GFile *f = gfile(A0); RET(f ? f->eof : 0); }
static void c_ferror(Ctx *c) { GFile *f = gfile(A0); RET(f ? f->err : 0); }

/* ================================================================ gmtime
 * musl struct tm: nine ints (sec, min, hour, mday, mon, year, wday, yday, isdst), long gmtoff at +40, const char *zone at +48. */
int libc2_gmtime(int64_t t, int32_t tm[9]) {
    int64_t days = t / 86400, rem = t % 86400;
    if (rem < 0) { rem += 86400; days--; }
    if (days < -1000000000ll || days > 1000000000ll) return 0;        /* year would overflow an int */
    tm[2] = (int32_t)(rem / 3600); tm[1] = (int32_t)(rem % 3600 / 60); tm[0] = (int32_t)(rem % 60);
    int64_t wd = (days + 4) % 7;                                      /* 1970-01-01 was a Thursday */
    tm[6] = (int32_t)(wd < 0 ? wd + 7 : wd);
    /* civil date from day count (proleptic Gregorian), era-based */
    int64_t z = days + 719468, era = (z >= 0 ? z : z - 146096) / 146097;
    int64_t doe = z - era * 146097, yoe = (doe - doe / 1460 + doe / 36524 - doe / 146096) / 365;
    int64_t y = yoe + era * 400, doy = doe - (365 * yoe + yoe / 4 - yoe / 100), mp = (5 * doy + 2) / 153;
    int64_t d = doy - (153 * mp + 2) / 5 + 1, m = mp < 10 ? mp + 3 : mp - 9;
    if (m <= 2) y++;
    int leap = (y % 4 == 0 && y % 100 != 0) || y % 400 == 0;
    static const int cum[12] = {0, 31, 59, 90, 120, 151, 181, 212, 243, 273, 304, 334};
    tm[3] = (int32_t)d; tm[4] = (int32_t)(m - 1); tm[5] = (int32_t)(y - 1900);
    tm[7] = cum[m - 1] + (int32_t)d - 1 + (leap && m > 2);
    tm[8] = 0;
    return 1;
}
static void tm_store(uint64_t dst, const int32_t tm[9]) {
    static const char utc[] = "UTC";
    memcpy((void *)(uintptr_t)dst, tm, 36);
    wr32(dst + 36, 0);
    wr64(dst + 40, 0);
    wr64(dst + 48, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)utc);
}
static void c_gmtime(Ctx *c) {
    static __declspec(thread) uint8_t buf[56];
    int32_t tm[9];
    if (!libc2_gmtime((int64_t)rd64(A0), tm)) { RET(0); return; }
    tm_store((uint64_t)(uintptr_t)buf, tm);
    RET(buf);
}

static const ImportDef libc2_imports[] = {
    {"fclose", c_fclose},
    {"feof", c_feof}, {"ferror", c_ferror},
    {"gmtime", c_gmtime},
};

/* Called before runtime_init (from cxxrt_install_data): the imported FILE * variables. */
void libc2_install_data(void) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) g_std_ptr[i] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)&g_std[i];
    import_set_address("stdin", &g_std_ptr[0]);
    import_set_address("stdout", &g_std_ptr[1]);
    import_set_address("stderr", &g_std_ptr[2]);
}

void register_libc2_imports(void) {
    int n = (int)(sizeof libc2_imports / sizeof libc2_imports[0]);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        if (!import_lookup(libc2_imports[i].name)) register_imports(&libc2_imports[i], 1);
}

```

`runtime/libc/nnunwind.c`:

```c
/* C++ exception unwinding for lifted code: a throw finds its handler through the game's own unwind tables, as on the
 * console.
 *
 * How it works
 *   - nncxxrt.c (eh_runtime.h) owns the exception objects and the personality (LSDA lookup and type matching); it calls
 *     raise() here for every throw.
 *   - The guest stack is real: lifted code keeps x29/x30 and the callee-saved registers exactly where the original
 *     code does, and the .eh_frame tables are mapped with the image. raise() walks the GUEST frames with the CFI of
 *     each function (CFA and saved x19..x30, d8..d15) and asks the personality about every call site. A throw first
 *     searches for a handler without touching anything (no handler = std::terminate, as on the console); then, and
 *     on every _Unwind_Resume, it enters the nearest pad.
 *   - A landing pad is code in the middle of a lifted function. Entering it needs a second entry
 *     `u_<fn>(c, landing pad)` of every function with landing pads, listed in a resume table (game_eh_bind,
 *     nncxxrt.c); raise() sets the frame's registers (sp, x19..x29, d8..d15 from the CFI; x0/x1 by
 *     eh_enter_pad) and calls it.
 *       clean-up pad: runs destructors and calls _Unwind_Resume -> raise() again, nested on the host stack;
 *       handler pad:  runs the handler and the REST of that function, then returns here; the host stack is then
 *                     cut back (longjmp) to the frame nro_catch_call() made when that function was entered (the
 *                     lifter routes every function whose LSDA has a catch clause through it), so the host caller
 *                     continues as if the function had returned normally. Records are keyed by the frame's CFA.
 *   - Everything lives on the guest stack and on the host stack of the thread or fiber that threw, so fibers need
 *     nothing special. The walk ends where a return address has no unwind tables (thread / fiber entry, or a host
 *     function that called back into the guest): no handler before that point = terminate.
 *   - Frames of the main executable are walked like any other but cannot be resumed: main is lifted without resume
 *     entries. A clean-up pad there is skipped with a warning; a handler there stops with a report.
 * Environment: SMO_UNWIND_LOG=1 prints every frame of every throw (the first 3 throws are always summarised). */
#include <windows.h>
#include <setjmp.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "runtime.h"
#include "hostrt.h"
#include "eh_runtime.h"

int cxxrt_readable(uint64_t p, size_t n);               /* nncxxrt.c */

static int g_log;
static volatile LONG g_throws, g_cleanups, g_skipped;

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- DWARF readers */
static uint64_t uleb(const uint8_t **p) { uint64_t r = 0; int s = 0; uint8_t b; do { b = *(*p)++; r |= (uint64_t)(b & 0x7f) << s; s += 7; } while (b & 0x80); return r; }
static int64_t sleb(const uint8_t **p) { int64_t r = 0; int s = 0; uint8_t b; do { b = *(*p)++; r |= (int64_t)(b & 0x7f) << s; s += 7; } while (b & 0x80); if (s < 64 && (b & 0x40)) r |= -((int64_t)1 << s); return r; }

/* DW_EH_PE value; datarel = base for 0x30. Returns 0 for "omitted" and for a null value. */
static uint64_t read_enc(const uint8_t **p, unsigned enc, uint64_t datarel) {
    if (enc == 0xff) return 0;
    const uint8_t *start = *p;
    uint64_t v;
    switch (enc & 0x0f) {
    case 0x00: case 0x04: case 0x0c: memcpy(&v, *p, 8); *p += 8; break;
    case 0x01: v = uleb(p); break;
    case 0x02: { uint16_t t; memcpy(&t, *p, 2); *p += 2; v = t; break; }
    case 0x03: { uint32_t t; memcpy(&t, *p, 4); *p += 4; v = t; break; }
    case 0x09: v = (uint64_t)sleb(p); break;
    case 0x0a: { int16_t t; memcpy(&t, *p, 2); *p += 2; v = (uint64_t)(int64_t)t; break; }
    case 0x0b: { int32_t t; memcpy(&t, *p, 4); *p += 4; v = (uint64_t)(int64_t)t; break; }
    default: return 0;
    }
    if (!v) return 0;
    if ((enc & 0x70) == 0x10) v += (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)start;
    else if ((enc & 0x70) == 0x30) v += datarel;
    if (enc & 0x80) v = cxxrt_readable(v, 8) ? rd64(v) : 0;        /* indirect: the (relocated) slot holds the value */
    return v;
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- frames */
typedef struct { uint64_t x[32]; uint64_t d[8]; uint64_t pc; } Regs;      /* x[19..30], x[31] = sp, d8..d15; pc = return address */
typedef struct { uint64_t start, end, lsda; const uint8_t *insns, *insns_end, *cie_insns, *cie_end; uint64_t code_align; int64_t data_align; unsigned ra; } Fde;

/* CIE and FDE at guest address `at` (EhFunction.fde). */
static int parse_fde(uint64_t at, Fde *f) {
    const uint8_t *fde = (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)at;
    uint32_t len, cid; memcpy(&len, fde, 4); memcpy(&cid, fde + 4, 4);
    if (len == 0 || len == 0xffffffffu || cid == 0) return 0;
    const uint8_t *cie = fde + 4 - (int32_t)cid;
    uint32_t clen; memcpy(&clen, cie, 4);
    const uint8_t *p = cie + 9;
    unsigned version = cie[8];
    const char *aug = (const char *)p;
    p += strlen(aug) + 1;
    f->code_align = uleb(&p);
    f->data_align = sleb(&p);
    f->ra = version == 1 ? *p++ : (unsigned)uleb(&p);
    unsigned lsda_enc = 0xff, fde_enc = 0;
    if (aug[0] == 'z') {
        uint64_t alen = uleb(&p);
        const uint8_t *q = p;
        for (const char *a = aug + 1; *a; a++) {
            if (*a == 'L') lsda_enc = *q++;
            else if (*a == 'R') fde_enc = *q++;
            else if (*a == 'P') { unsigned e = *q++; read_enc(&q, e & 0x7f, 0); }
            else if (*a == 'S') { }
            else return 0;
        }
        p += alen;
    } else if (aug[0]) return 0;
    f->cie_insns = p; f->cie_end = cie + 4 + clen;
    p = fde + 8;
    f->start = read_enc(&p, fde_enc, 0);
    f->end = f->start + read_enc(&p, fde_enc & 0x0f, 0);
    f->lsda = 0;
    if (aug[0] == 'z') { uint64_t alen = uleb(&p); const uint8_t *q = p; if (lsda_enc != 0xff) f->lsda = read_enc(&q, lsda_enc, 0); p += alen; }
    f->insns = p; f->insns_end = fde + 4 + len;
    return 1;
}

enum { R_SAME = 0, R_OFFSET, R_UNDEF, R_REG };
typedef struct { int cfa_reg; int64_t cfa_off; uint8_t rule[96]; int64_t val[96]; } Row;

static int run_cfi(const uint8_t *p, const uint8_t *end, const Fde *f, uint64_t *loc, uint64_t target, Row *row, const Row *init) {
    Row stack[8]; int sp = 0;
    while (p < end && *loc <= target) {
        uint8_t op = *p++;
        unsigned hi = op & 0xc0, lowbits = op & 0x3f;
        if (hi == 0x40) { *loc += lowbits * f->code_align; continue; }
        if (hi == 0x80) { uint64_t o = uleb(&p); if (lowbits < 96) { row->rule[lowbits] = R_OFFSET; row->val[lowbits] = (int64_t)o * f->data_align; } continue; }
        if (hi == 0xc0) { if (lowbits < 96 && init) { row->rule[lowbits] = init->rule[lowbits]; row->val[lowbits] = init->val[lowbits]; } continue; }
        uint64_t r, o;
        switch (op) {
        case 0x00: break;
        case 0x02: *loc += *p++ * f->code_align; break;
        case 0x03: { uint16_t d; memcpy(&d, p, 2); p += 2; *loc += d * f->code_align; break; }
        case 0x04: { uint32_t d; memcpy(&d, p, 4); p += 4; *loc += d * f->code_align; break; }
        case 0x05: r = uleb(&p); o = uleb(&p); if (r < 96) { row->rule[r] = R_OFFSET; row->val[r] = (int64_t)o * f->data_align; } break;
        case 0x06: r = uleb(&p); if (r < 96 && init) { row->rule[r] = init->rule[r]; row->val[r] = init->val[r]; } break;
        case 0x07: r = uleb(&p); if (r < 96) row->rule[r] = R_UNDEF; break;
        case 0x08: r = uleb(&p); if (r < 96) row->rule[r] = R_SAME; break;
        case 0x09: r = uleb(&p); o = uleb(&p); if (r < 96) { row->rule[r] = R_REG; row->val[r] = (int64_t)o; } break;
        case 0x0a: if (sp >= 8) return 0; stack[sp++] = *row; break;
        case 0x0b: if (sp <= 0) return 0; *row = stack[--sp]; break;
        case 0x0c: row->cfa_reg = (int)uleb(&p); row->cfa_off = (int64_t)uleb(&p); break;
        case 0x0d: row->cfa_reg = (int)uleb(&p); break;
        case 0x0e: row->cfa_off = (int64_t)uleb(&p); break;
        case 0x11: r = uleb(&p); { int64_t so = sleb(&p); if (r < 96) { row->rule[r] = R_OFFSET; row->val[r] = so * f->data_align; } } break;
        case 0x12: row->cfa_reg = (int)uleb(&p); row->cfa_off = sleb(&p) * f->data_align; break;
        case 0x13: row->cfa_off = sleb(&p) * f->data_align; break;
        case 0x2d: break;                                 /* AArch64 negate_ra_state: no pointer authentication here */
        case 0x2e: uleb(&p); break;                       /* GNU_args_size */
        default: return 0;                                /* expressions and anything else: not used by this compiler's output */
        }
    }
    return 1;
}

/* Registers of the caller of the frame `r` (pc inside FDE f). Also returns this frame's CFA. */
static int step(const Fde *f, Regs *r, uint64_t *cfa_out) {
    Row init, row;
    memset(&init, 0, sizeof init);
    init.cfa_reg = 31;
    uint64_t loc = f->start;
    uint64_t no_limit = ~(uint64_t)0 - 1;
    if (!run_cfi(f->cie_insns, f->cie_end, f, &loc, no_limit, &init, NULL)) return 0;
    row = init;
    loc = f->start;
    if (!run_cfi(f->insns, f->insns_end, f, &loc, r->pc - 1, &row, &init)) return 0;
    if (row.cfa_reg < 19 || row.cfa_reg > 31) return 0;
    uint64_t cfa = r->x[row.cfa_reg] + (uint64_t)row.cfa_off;
    Regs n = *r;
    for (int i = 19; i <= 30; i++) {
        if (row.rule[i] == R_OFFSET) { if (!cxxrt_readable(cfa + (uint64_t)row.val[i], 8)) return 0; n.x[i] = rd64(cfa + (uint64_t)row.val[i]); }
        else if (row.rule[i] == R_REG && row.val[i] >= 19 && row.val[i] <= 30) n.x[i] = r->x[row.val[i]];
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) if (row.rule[72 + i] == R_OFFSET) n.d[i] = rd64(cfa + (uint64_t)row.val[72 + i]);
    n.x[31] = cfa;
    n.pc = n.x[f->ra < 32 ? f->ra : 30];
    *cfa_out = cfa;
    *r = n;
    return 1;
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- host frames to come back to */
typedef struct { uint64_t cfa; jmp_buf *jb; } CatchSlot;
#define CATCH_SLOTS 8192
static CatchSlot g_catch[CATCH_SLOTS];
static SRWLOCK g_catch_lock = SRWLOCK_INIT;

static void catch_put(uint64_t cfa, jmp_buf *jb) {
    unsigned h = (unsigned)((cfa >> 4) * 2654435761u) & (CATCH_SLOTS - 1), first_free = CATCH_SLOTS;
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_catch_lock);
    for (unsigned n = 0; n < 64; n++) {
        unsigned i = (h + n) & (CATCH_SLOTS - 1);
        if (g_catch[i].cfa == cfa) { first_free = i; break; }                 /* a frame at the same guest stack address replaces a stale one */
        if (g_catch[i].cfa <= 1 && first_free == CATCH_SLOTS) first_free = i;
        if (g_catch[i].cfa == 0) break;
    }
    if (first_free == CATCH_SLOTS) first_free = h;                            /* crowded by records of abandoned stacks: reuse */
    g_catch[first_free].cfa = cfa; g_catch[first_free].jb = jb;
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_catch_lock);
}
static jmp_buf *catch_take(uint64_t cfa, jmp_buf *only) {                     /* removes the record; only != NULL: remove if it is that one */
    unsigned h = (unsigned)((cfa >> 4) * 2654435761u) & (CATCH_SLOTS - 1);
    jmp_buf *jb = NULL;
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_catch_lock);
    for (unsigned n = 0; n < 64; n++) {
        unsigned i = (h + n) & (CATCH_SLOTS - 1);
        if (g_catch[i].cfa == cfa) { if (!only || g_catch[i].jb == only) { jb = g_catch[i].jb; g_catch[i].cfa = 1; g_catch[i].jb = NULL; } break; }
        if (g_catch[i].cfa == 0) break;
    }
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_catch_lock);
    return jb;
}

/* Entry of every lifted function whose LSDA has a catch clause (generated code: `nro_catch_call(c, u_<fn>)`). */
void nro_catch_call(Ctx *c, void (*body)(Ctx *, uint64_t)) {
    Ctx *volatile cc = c;
    jmp_buf jb;
    volatile uint64_t cfa = c->x[31];                     /* the CFA of an AArch64 frame is the stack pointer at entry */
    const char *volatile in_import = c->in_import;
    volatile uint64_t import_from = c->import_from;
    catch_put(cfa, &jb);
    if (setjmp(jb) == 0) {
        body(c, 0);
        catch_take(cfa, &jb);
    } else {                                              /* a handler of this function ran it to its end (the unwinder removed the record) */
        cc->in_import = in_import;
        cc->import_from = import_from;
    }
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- the unwinder (eh_runtime.h: EhRaiseFn) */
static void (*resume_entry(uint64_t lp, const char **name))(Ctx *, uint64_t) {
    *name = "main";
    return eh_main_resume_entry(lp);                      /* NULL: the game is lifted without resume entries */
}

static void regs_from(Ctx *c, Regs *r) {
    memset(r, 0, sizeof *r);
    for (int i = 19; i <= 31; i++) r->x[i] = c->x[i];
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) r->d[i] = c->v[8 + i].d[0];
    r->pc = c->x[30];                                     /* return address of the call that threw */
}

/* One frame: what its call site does with the exception, then the caller's registers. Returns 0 at the end of the
 * chain (no unwind information for the return address: a thread or fiber entry, or a host callback boundary). */
static int frame(Ctx *c, uint64_t exc, Regs *cur, EhPad *pad, uint64_t *cfa, const char **stop) {
    EhFunction fn;
    Fde f;
    if (!cur->pc || !eh_find_function(cur->pc - 4, &fn)) { *stop = "the call chain leaves the code with unwind tables (thread, fiber or host callback entry)"; return 0; }
    if (!parse_fde(fn.fde, &f)) { *stop = "FDE not understood"; return 0; }
    eh_personality(c, cur->pc - 4, exc, pad);
    pad->function = fn;
    uint64_t pc = cur->pc;
    if (!step(&f, cur, cfa)) { *stop = "CFI of a frame not understood"; return 0; }
    if (g_log) printf("unwind:   f_%llx call at %llx cfa %llx: %s\n", (unsigned long long)fn.start, (unsigned long long)pc - 4, (unsigned long long)*cfa,
                      pad->kind == EH_HANDLER ? "HANDLER" : pad->kind == EH_CLEANUP ? "cleanup" : "-");
    return 1;
}

static void eh_raise(Ctx *c, int reason) {
    uint64_t exc = eh_in_flight(c);
    Regs cur;
    EhPad pad;
    uint64_t cfa = 0;
    const char *stop = "frame limit";
    const char *owner = "?";
    if (reason == EH_RAISE_THROW) {                       /* phase 1: is there a handler at all? (the console terminates without unwinding if not) */
        LONG seq = InterlockedIncrement(&g_throws);
        int found = 0, depth = 0;
        regs_from(c, &cur);
        for (; depth < 4096; depth++) {
            if (!frame(c, exc, &cur, &pad, &cfa, &stop)) break;
            if (pad.kind == EH_HANDLER) { found = 1; break; }
        }
        if (found && !resume_entry(pad.landing_pad, &owner)) {
            printf("\nunwind: %s thrown at 0x%llx has its handler at %llx in %s, which has no resume entry (the game is lifted without them)\n",
                   eh_type_name(exc), (unsigned long long)c->x[30] - 4, (unsigned long long)pad.landing_pad, owner);
            eh_terminate(c, "the handler cannot be entered");
        }
        if (!found) {
            printf("\nunwind: %s thrown at 0x%llx: no handler in %d frames (%s)\n", eh_type_name(exc), (unsigned long long)c->x[30] - 4, depth, stop);
            eh_terminate(c, "no handler");
        }
        if (g_log || seq <= 3)
            printf("unwind: throw #%ld of %s at 0x%llx: handler in %s f_%llx (landing pad %llx), %d frames up\n", (long)seq, eh_type_name(exc),
                   (unsigned long long)c->x[30] - 4, owner, (unsigned long long)pad.function.start, (unsigned long long)pad.landing_pad, depth);
    }
    /* phase 2: the nearest pad from here */
    regs_from(c, &cur);
    for (int depth = 0; depth < 4096; depth++) {
        Regs at = cur;                                    /* registers of this frame at its call */
        if (!frame(c, exc, &cur, &pad, &cfa, &stop)) break;
        if (pad.kind == EH_NONE) continue;
        void (*fn)(Ctx *, uint64_t) = resume_entry(pad.landing_pad, &owner);
        if (!fn) {
            if (pad.kind == EH_HANDLER) eh_terminate(c, "the handler is in code without resume entries");
            if (InterlockedIncrement(&g_skipped) <= 8) printf("unwind: clean-up pad %llx in %s skipped (no resume entry)\n", (unsigned long long)pad.landing_pad, owner);
            continue;
        }
        for (int i = 19; i <= 29; i++) c->x[i] = at.x[i];
        c->x[31] = at.x[31];
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) { c->v[8 + i].d[0] = at.d[i]; c->v[8 + i].d[1] = 0; }
        eh_enter_pad(c, &pad);                            /* x0, x1; the exception is no longer "in flight" */
        c->in_import = NULL;
        if (pad.kind == EH_CLEANUP) InterlockedIncrement(&g_cleanups);
        fn(c, pad.landing_pad);
        /* A clean-up pad does not come back (it ends in _Unwind_Resume, which re-enters raise()). Coming back means a
         * handler ran and the function that contains it returned to ITS caller: cut the host stack back to the frame
         * nro_catch_call() made when that function was entered. */
        jmp_buf *jb = catch_take(cfa, NULL);
        if (!jb) {
            printf("\nunwind: f_%llx handled an exception but was not entered through nro_catch_call (frame %llx)\n", (unsigned long long)pad.function.start, (unsigned long long)cfa);
            eh_terminate(c, "no host frame to return to");
        }
        longjmp(*jb, 1);
    }
    printf("\nunwind: ran out of frames while unwinding (%s)\n", stop);
    eh_terminate(c, "unwinding ran past the last frame");
}

void unwind_report(FILE *out) {
    if (g_throws) fprintf(out, "unwind: %ld exceptions thrown, %ld clean-up pads run, %ld skipped\n", (long)g_throws, (long)g_cleanups, (long)g_skipped);
}

void register_unwind_imports(void) {
    g_log = getenv("SMO_UNWIND_LOG") != NULL;
    eh_set_unwinder(eh_raise);
}

```

`runtime/os/nnmisc.c`:

```c
/* Small SDK services: nn::oe notifications, focus and language, nn::prepo, nn::err, nn::crypto hashes, the C-linkage
 * nnos* wrappers, and "offline console" answers for the network-facing services (friends, account, socket byte order).
 *
 * Where a behaviour or layout is stated here it was read from one of:
 *   [sdk]   the real SDK module (Super Smash Bros. Ultimate 13.0.4's, read by ssbu-recomp), disassembled by symbol name;
 *   [game]  the game's own code at the quoted address;
 *   [doc]   public documentation (switchbrew / open-ead nnheaders), not checked against code.
 * Everything else only returns "success", "nothing" or "not available" and touches no
 * guest structure.
 *
 * Registration never replaces a handler another file already installed, except for the names of replace_imports
 * (below). */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

#define A0 (c->x[0])
#define A1 (c->x[1])
#define A2 (c->x[2])
#define A3 (c->x[3])
#define A4 (c->x[4])
#define RET(v) (c->x[0] = (uint64_t)(v))
#define STR(n) ((const char *)(uintptr_t)c->x[n])

/* Some non-zero nn::Result. The SDK's real "not available" codes differ per service and are
 * not established; the game only tests these for failure. Same value as nnsdk.c. */
#define RESULT_UNAVAILABLE 0x3e87aull

void os_init_event(uint64_t key, int autoclear);          /* os_threads.c */
void os_signal_event(uint64_t key);

static void keep(Ctx *c) { (void)c; }                     /* void function, or returns `this` */
static void ret0(Ctx *c) { RET(0); }                      /* Result success / false / 0 / null */
static void ret1(Ctx *c) { RET(1); }
static void unavailable(Ctx *c) { RET(RESULT_UNAVAILABLE); }
/* nn::account network-service-account functions on a machine without a linked account: see nnfs.c ([sdk] 0x4b3a8,
 * account results 124-0200..0269 mean "no usable network service account"). */
static void acc_nsa_unavailable(Ctx *c) { RET(0x1907cull); }

static void fatal(Ctx *c, const char *fmt, ...) {
    char msg[512];
    va_list ap;
    va_start(ap, fmt);
    vsnprintf(msg, sizeof msg, fmt, ap);
    va_end(ap);
    printf("\n%s (guest caller 0x%llx)\n", msg, (unsigned long long)c->x[30] - 4);
    trace_printf("%s (guest caller 0x%llx)\n", msg, (unsigned long long)c->x[30] - 4);
    report_and_exit(3);
}
static const char *safe_str(uint64_t p) { return p > 0x10000 ? (const char *)(uintptr_t)p : "(null)"; }

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- C-linkage nn::os wrappers
 * [sdk] every nnosXxx is a tail jump to the C++ function with the same arguments, so each one
 * forwards to whatever handler is registered for the C++ name (looked up on first use; also when the game
 * does not import the C++ name itself). */
static ImportFn forward_target(Ctx *c, const char *name) {
    ImportFn f = import_lookup(name);
    if (!f) f = handler_by_name(name);
    if (!f) fatal(c, "nnmisc: no handler for %s, needed by a C wrapper", name);
    return f;
}
#define FWD(fn, target) static void fn(Ctx *c) { static ImportFn f; if (!f) f = forward_target(c, target); f(c); }
#define OS(n) "_ZN2nn2os" n
FWD(nnos_GetCurrentThread, OS("16GetCurrentThreadEv"))
FWD(nnos_CreateThread, OS("12CreateThreadEPNS0_10ThreadTypeEPFvPvES3_S3_mi"))
FWD(nnos_StartThread, OS("11StartThreadEPNS0_10ThreadTypeE"))
FWD(nnos_WaitThread, OS("10WaitThreadEPNS0_10ThreadTypeE"))
FWD(nnos_DestroyThread, OS("13DestroyThreadEPNS0_10ThreadTypeE"))
FWD(nnos_GetThreadPriority, OS("17GetThreadPriorityEPKNS0_10ThreadTypeE"))
FWD(nnos_GetThreadCoreMask, OS("17GetThreadCoreMaskEPiPmPKNS0_10ThreadTypeE"))
FWD(nnos_SetThreadCoreMask, OS("17SetThreadCoreMaskEPNS0_10ThreadTypeEim"))
FWD(nnos_SetThreadName, OS("13SetThreadNameEPNS0_10ThreadTypeEPKc"))      /* the host keeps a copy either way */
FWD(nnos_SleepThread, OS("11SleepThreadENS_8TimeSpanE"))
FWD(nnos_InitializeMutex, OS("15InitializeMutexEPNS0_9MutexTypeEbi"))
FWD(nnos_FinalizeMutex, OS("13FinalizeMutexEPNS0_9MutexTypeE"))
FWD(nnos_LockMutex, OS("9LockMutexEPNS0_9MutexTypeE"))
FWD(nnos_UnlockMutex, OS("11UnlockMutexEPNS0_9MutexTypeE"))
FWD(nnos_InitializeEvent, OS("15InitializeEventEPNS0_9EventTypeEbNS0_14EventClearModeE"))
FWD(nnos_FinalizeEvent, OS("13FinalizeEventEPNS0_9EventTypeE"))
FWD(nnos_SignalEvent, OS("11SignalEventEPNS0_9EventTypeE"))
FWD(nnos_WaitEvent, OS("9WaitEventEPNS0_9EventTypeE"))
FWD(nnos_GetSystemTick, OS("13GetSystemTickEv"))

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- abort helpers (never return on the console) */
static void diag_AbortImpl(Ctx *c) {                      /* (condition, function, file, line) */
    printf("\nnn::diag abort: %s  in %s  (%s:%d)\n", safe_str(A0), safe_str(A1), safe_str(A2), (int)A3);
    trace_printf("nn::diag abort: %s  in %s  (%s:%d)\n", safe_str(A0), safe_str(A1), safe_str(A2), (int)A3);
    guest_trap("guest called nn::diag::detail::AbortImpl", c->x[30] - 4);
}
static void diag_AbortFormatImpl(Ctx *c) {                /* (condition, function, file, line, format, ...) */
    printf("\nnn::diag abort: %s  in %s  (%s:%d)  format \"%s\"\n", safe_str(A0), safe_str(A1), safe_str(A2), (int)A3, safe_str(A4));
    trace_printf("nn::diag abort: %s  in %s  (%s:%d)  format \"%s\"\n", safe_str(A0), safe_str(A1), safe_str(A2), (int)A3, safe_str(A4));
    guest_trap("guest called nndetailDiagAbortFormatImpl", c->x[30] - 4);
}
static void diag_UnexpectedDefault(Ctx *c) {              /* (function, file, line) */
    printf("\nnn unexpected default: %s  (%s:%d)\n", safe_str(A0), safe_str(A1), (int)A2);
    trace_printf("nn unexpected default: %s  (%s:%d)\n", safe_str(A0), safe_str(A1), (int)A2);
    guest_trap("guest called nn::detail::UnexpectedDefaultImpl", c->x[30] - 4);
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- nn::oe */
static LARGE_INTEGER g_start;
/* Notification messages. On the console the system posts a message when the application's focus state changes
 * (HOME menu, an overlay), when the console is docked or undocked, and when it asks the application to exit; the
 * application reads them with TryPopNotificationMessage and may wait on the event GetNotificationMessageEvent
 * returns, which is signalled while messages are pending.
 * Here: the focus state follows the game window. When the window stops being the foreground window the state
 * becomes OutOfFocus (2) and MessageFocusStateChanged (15) is posted; back in the foreground: InFocus (1) and the
 * message again. [sdk] 0x32c3d0: SetFocusHandlingMode passes "notify focus changes" = true for the modes 1
 * (NoSuspend) and 2 (SuspendHomeSleepNotify) only, so the message is posted only in those modes.
 * The operation mode never changes on a PC (always the TV mode), so MessageOperationModeChanged (30) and
 * MessagePerformanceModeChanged (31) never occur; the enable flags are kept as the game sets them.
 * (the state now follows the applet manager's table, see oe_track_focus: not in focus = 2 only while the window is
 * visible; minimised = 3 for a NoSuspend application and no change at all in the suspending modes.)
 * Differences from the console, stated: (1) in the suspending modes (0, 2, 3) the console also FREEZES the application
 * while it is in the background (mode 3: also while obscured); the runtime does not freeze the game's threads: a minimised
 * game keeps running. (2) A window
 * that has never been in the foreground (the automated tests keep theirs off screen) is treated as in focus.
 * (3) Closing the window is the exit request: see oe_exit_request below.
 * SMO_FOCUS_NOTIFY=0 turns the focus tracking off. */
#define OE_MSG_FOCUS_STATE_CHANGED 15u
static uint8_t g_oe_event[0x40];
static uint32_t g_oe_queue[16];
static int g_oe_count, g_oe_event_ready, g_oe_focus_state = 1, g_oe_focus_mode = 0, g_oe_was_foreground;
static int g_oe_opmode_notify, g_oe_resume_notify, g_oe_focus_pending, g_oe_focus_recheck;
static HWND g_oe_window;
static CRITICAL_SECTION g_oe_lock;
static void oe_event_setup(void) {
    if (!g_oe_event_ready) { os_init_event((uint64_t)(uintptr_t)g_oe_event, 0); g_oe_event_ready = 1; }
}
static void oe_push(uint32_t message) {
    EnterCriticalSection(&g_oe_lock);
    oe_event_setup();
    if (g_oe_count < 16) g_oe_queue[g_oe_count++] = message;
    os_signal_event((uint64_t)(uintptr_t)g_oe_event);
    LeaveCriticalSection(&g_oe_lock);
}
/* Suspension. The applet manager suspends the application's process while it is not runnable (suyu am/applet.cpp
 * UpdateSuspensionStateLocked, am/lifecycle_manager.cpp IsRunnable): in the background unless the handling mode is NoSuspend,
 * obscured only in AlwaysSuspend; never while an exit request is pending. A message "Resume" (16) is queued at that moment when
 * the application enabled it (RequestResumeNotification). Here a watcher thread applies the rule to the window every 20 ms and
 * sets hostrt.c's g_guest_frozen: every guest thread then stops at its next SDK call or return (hostrt.c host_import).
 * SMO_FREEZE_TEST=<start s>,<seconds> minimises and restores the window by itself (test; the log line counts the polls of the
 * game's main loop during the freeze). */
extern volatile LONG g_guest_frozen;
static volatile LONG g_oe_poll_count;
static int g_oe_exit_requested;                           /* defined with the exit request code below */
#define OE_MSG_RESUME 16u
static BOOL CALLBACK oe_find_window(HWND w, LPARAM out) {
    DWORD pid = 0;
    if (GetWindowThreadProcessId(w, &pid) && pid == GetCurrentProcessId() && IsWindowVisible(w) && !GetWindow(w, GW_OWNER)) { *(HWND *)out = w; return FALSE; }
    return TRUE;
}
static DWORD WINAPI oe_watch(LPVOID unused) {
    const char *test = getenv("SMO_FREEZE_TEST");
    double t_start = 0, t_len = 0;
    int test_phase = 0;
    ULONGLONG t0 = GetTickCount64(), frozen_at = 0;
    LONG polls_at = 0;
    if (test) sscanf(test, "%lf,%lf", &t_start, &t_len);
    for (;;) {
        Sleep(20);
        double t = (double)(GetTickCount64() - t0) / 1000.0;
        if (test && test_phase == 0 && t >= t_start) {
            HWND w = NULL;
            EnumWindows(oe_find_window, (LPARAM)&w);
            if (w) { g_oe_window = w; g_oe_was_foreground = 1; ShowWindow(w, SW_SHOWMINNOACTIVE); test_phase = 1; printf("nn::oe: freeze test: window minimised (handling mode %d)\n", g_oe_focus_mode); fflush(stdout); }
        } else if (test_phase == 1 && t >= t_start + t_len) {
            ShowWindow(g_oe_window, SW_SHOWNOACTIVATE);
            test_phase = 2;
        }
        DWORD pid = 0;
        HWND fg = GetForegroundWindow();
        int ours = fg && GetWindowThreadProcessId(fg, &pid) && pid == GetCurrentProcessId();
        if (ours) { g_oe_was_foreground = 1; g_oe_window = fg; }
        if (!g_oe_was_foreground) continue;
        int minimised = g_oe_window && IsIconic(g_oe_window);
        int runnable = ours || g_oe_exit_requested || (minimised ? g_oe_focus_mode == 1 : g_oe_focus_mode != 3);
        if (!runnable && !g_guest_frozen) {
            if (g_oe_resume_notify) oe_push(OE_MSG_RESUME);
            frozen_at = GetTickCount64(); polls_at = g_oe_poll_count;
            InterlockedExchange(&g_guest_frozen, 1);
            trace_printf("     nn::oe: application suspended (%s, handling mode %d)\n", minimised ? "background" : "obscured", g_oe_focus_mode);
        } else if (runnable && g_guest_frozen) {
            LONG polls = g_oe_poll_count - polls_at;
            InterlockedExchange(&g_guest_frozen, 0);
            printf("nn::oe: application resumed after %llu ms of suspension; main-loop polls during it: %ld\n", (unsigned long long)(GetTickCount64() - frozen_at), (long)polls);
            fflush(stdout);
            trace_printf("     nn::oe: application resumed after %llu ms\n", (unsigned long long)(GetTickCount64() - frozen_at));
        }
        if (test_phase == 2 && !g_guest_frozen) { g_oe_was_foreground = 0; test_phase = 3; }      /* the test window was never the foreground window: back to "in focus" */
    }
    return 0;
}
static void oe_track_focus(void) {
    static int enabled = -1;
    static ULONGLONG last;
    static volatile LONG watcher;
    ULONGLONG now = GetTickCount64();
    if (enabled < 0) { const char *e = getenv("SMO_FOCUS_NOTIFY"); enabled = !(e && e[0] == '0'); }
    if (enabled && InterlockedCompareExchange(&watcher, 1, 0) == 0) CloseHandle(CreateThread(NULL, 0, oe_watch, NULL, 0, NULL));
    if (!enabled || (now - last < 30 && !g_oe_focus_recheck)) return;
    last = now;
    g_oe_focus_recheck = 0;
    DWORD pid = 0;
    HWND fg = GetForegroundWindow();
    int ours = fg && GetWindowThreadProcessId(fg, &pid) && pid == GetCurrentProcessId();
    if (ours) { g_oe_was_foreground = 1; g_oe_window = fg; }
    if (!g_oe_was_foreground) return;
    /* the applet manager's rule (suyu am/lifecycle_manager.cpp UpdateRequestedFocusState, GetFocusStateWhile*), with
     * the window as the activity state: foreground = ForegroundVisible; visible but not the foreground window = ForegroundObscured
     * (something else has the input, as under an overlay or a library applet); minimised = Background (as behind the HOME menu).
     * The handling mode is what [sdk 0x32c3d0, table 0xa7ff70] sends for the oe mode: 0 = (notify 0, suspend 1), 1 = (notify 1,
     * suspend 0) NoSuspend, 2 = (notify 1, suspend 1), 3 = (notify 0, suspend 1) + SetOutOfFocusSuspendingEnabled(1) AlwaysSuspend. */
    int minimised = g_oe_window && IsIconic(g_oe_window);
    int state = ours ? 1                                                    /* InFocus */
              : g_oe_focus_mode == 3 ? 1                                    /* AlwaysSuspend: the application never learns it */
              : !minimised ? 2                                              /* obscured: NotInFocus in the other three modes */
              : g_oe_focus_mode == 1 ? 3 : 1;                               /* background: Background (3) for a NoSuspend application, else unchanged */
    if (state != g_oe_focus_state) {
        g_oe_focus_state = state;
        g_oe_focus_pending = 1;                                             /* m_has_focus_state_changed */
        trace_printf("     nn::oe: focus state -> %d (%s; handling mode %d)\n", state, state == 1 ? "in focus" : state == 2 ? "not in focus" : "background", g_oe_focus_mode);
    }
    if (g_oe_focus_pending && (g_oe_focus_mode == 1 || g_oe_focus_mode == 2)) { g_oe_focus_pending = 0; oe_push(OE_MSG_FOCUS_STATE_CHANGED); }   /* delivered only while notification is enabled */
}
/* Exit request. [sdk 0x32cc20 / 0x32cca0] Enter / LeaveExitRequestHandlingSection keep a nesting count under a mutex and call the
 * applet manager's ISelfController LockExit when the count goes 0 -> 1 and UnlockExit when it goes 1 -> 0. The applet manager is a
 * system module (not in the dump); its rule, from the reference implementation (suyu am/service/self_controller.cpp LockExit /
 * UnlockExit, application_accessor.cpp RequestExit):
 *   exit requested while the exit is locked   -> the application is NOT ended; it gets MessageExitRequest (4) and keeps running
 *   exit requested while it is not locked     -> the process is terminated at once
 *   LockExit after an exit request            -> terminated at once
 *   UnlockExit after an exit request          -> terminated
 * Here the exit request is the user closing the game window (display.c WM_CLOSE calls oe_exit_request). */
#define OE_MSG_EXIT_REQUEST 4u
static int g_oe_exit_locked, g_oe_exit_requested;
int oe_exit_request(void) {                              /* display.c, window thread. Returns 1 when the game keeps running until it leaves its section */
    int locked;
    EnterCriticalSection(&g_oe_lock);
    locked = g_oe_exit_locked;
    if (locked) g_oe_exit_requested = 1;
    LeaveCriticalSection(&g_oe_lock);
    if (!locked) return 0;
    trace_printf("     nn::oe: exit requested inside an exit-request handling section: MessageExitRequest posted\n");
    oe_push(OE_MSG_EXIT_REQUEST);
    return 1;
}
static void oe_TryPopNotificationMessage(Ctx *c) {       /* (uint32_t *out) -> bool */
    uint64_t out = A0;
    int got = 0;
    InterlockedIncrement(&g_oe_poll_count);
    oe_track_focus();
    EnterCriticalSection(&g_oe_lock);
    if (g_oe_count > 0) {
        if (out) wr32(out, g_oe_queue[0]);
        memmove(g_oe_queue, g_oe_queue + 1, (size_t)(--g_oe_count) * sizeof g_oe_queue[0]);
        got = 1;
        if (g_oe_count == 0 && g_oe_event_ready) os_init_event((uint64_t)(uintptr_t)g_oe_event, 0);   /* nothing pending: event cleared */
    }
    LeaveCriticalSection(&g_oe_lock);
    RET(got);
}
static void oe_GetCurrentFocusState(Ctx *c) { oe_track_focus(); RET(g_oe_focus_state); }
static void oe_SetFocusHandlingMode(Ctx *c) { g_oe_focus_mode = (int)(uint32_t)A0; g_oe_focus_recheck = 1; oe_track_focus(); }               /* 0 SuspendHomeSleep, 1 NoSuspend, 2 SuspendHomeSleepNotify, 3 AlwaysSuspend */
static void oe_SetOperationModeChangedNotificationEnabled(Ctx *c) { g_oe_opmode_notify = (int)(A0 & 1); }

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- nn::settings
 * [doc] nn::settings::Language values and their codes (switchbrew "Settings services"); the
 * order agrees with what nnsdk.c already uses (4 = "it"). LanguageCode is 8 chars, returned in x0. */
static const char *const g_language_codes[] = {"ja", "en-US", "fr", "de", "it", "es", "zh-CN", "ko", "nl", "pt", "ru",
                                               "zh-TW", "en-GB", "fr-CA", "es-419", "zh-Hans", "zh-Hant", "pt-BR"};
static uint64_t language_code(uint32_t lang) {
    uint64_t v = 0;
    if (lang < sizeof g_language_codes / sizeof g_language_codes[0]) memcpy(&v, g_language_codes[lang], strlen(g_language_codes[lang]));
    return v;
}
static void settings_LanguageEqualsCode(Ctx *c) {         /* operator==(const Language&, const LanguageCode&) */
    char a[9] = {0}, b[9] = {0};
    uint64_t v = language_code(rd32(A0));
    memcpy(a, &v, 8);
    memcpy(b, (void *)(uintptr_t)A1, 8);
    RET(v != 0 && strcmp(a, b) == 0);
}
static void settings_CodeEqualsLanguage(Ctx *c) {         /* operator==(const LanguageCode&, const Language&): the same comparison, arguments swapped */
    uint64_t t = c->x[0];
    c->x[0] = c->x[1];
    c->x[1] = t;
    settings_LanguageEqualsCode(c);
}
/* nn::oe::GetDesiredLanguage: the language the application should use = the system language when the application
 * supports it, otherwise the system's choice among the supported ones. The system language here is the Windows
 * display language of the user. Languages this game ships (its message files): ja, en-US, en-GB, fr, fr-CA, de, it,
 * es, es-419, zh-Hans, zh-Hant, ko, nl, ru; anything else gives en-US (NOT VERIFIED: the console decides from the
 * supported-language mask of the application's control data, which was not read here).
 * SMO_LANGUAGE=<code> overrides (for example SMO_LANGUAGE=en-US). */
static uint64_t desired_language(void) {
    static uint64_t cached;
    static const char *const supported[] = {"ja", "en-US", "en-GB", "fr", "fr-CA", "de", "it", "es", "es-419", "zh-Hans", "zh-Hant", "ko", "nl", "ru"};
    if (cached) return cached;
    char name[LOCALE_NAME_MAX_LENGTH * 3] = "", pick[16] = "en-US";
    const char *env = getenv("SMO_LANGUAGE");
    wchar_t wname[LOCALE_NAME_MAX_LENGTH] = L"";
    ULONG count = 0, size = 0;
    if (env && env[0]) snprintf(name, sizeof name, "%s", env);
    else {
        /* the display language of the user interface, not the regional format */
        wchar_t list[512];
        size = 512;
        if (GetUserPreferredUILanguages(MUI_LANGUAGE_NAME, &count, list, &size) && count > 0) wcsncpy(wname, list, LOCALE_NAME_MAX_LENGTH - 1);
        else GetUserDefaultLocaleName(wname, LOCALE_NAME_MAX_LENGTH);
        WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, wname, -1, name, sizeof name, NULL, NULL);
    }
    int exact = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof supported / sizeof supported[0]; i++) if (!_stricmp(name, supported[i])) { strcpy(pick, supported[i]); exact = 1; }
    if (!exact) {
        if (!_strnicmp(name, "zh", 2)) strcpy(pick, strstr(name, "TW") || strstr(name, "HK") || strstr(name, "MO") || strstr(name, "Hant") ? "zh-Hant" : "zh-Hans");
        else if (!_strnicmp(name, "en", 2)) strcpy(pick, !_stricmp(name, "en-US") || !_stricmp(name, "en-CA") ? "en-US" : "en-GB");
        else if (!_strnicmp(name, "fr", 2)) strcpy(pick, !_stricmp(name, "fr-CA") ? "fr-CA" : "fr");
        else if (!_strnicmp(name, "es", 2)) strcpy(pick, !_stricmp(name, "es-ES") || !_stricmp(name, "es") ? "es" : "es-419");
        else {
            char two[3] = {name[0], name[1], 0};
            for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof supported / sizeof supported[0]; i++) if (!_stricmp(two, supported[i])) strcpy(pick, supported[i]);
        }
    }
    uint64_t v = 0;
    memcpy(&v, pick, strlen(pick));
    printf("nn::oe::GetDesiredLanguage: Windows display language \"%s\" -> \"%s\"\n", name, pick);
    cached = v;
    return v;
}
static void oe_GetDesiredLanguage(Ctx *c) { RET(desired_language()); }   /* LanguageCode (8 chars) by value in x0 */
/* smo_amiibo.c: the same language as text ("en-US", ...), for the game's message files of the host menus */
const char *oe_language(void) { static char code[9]; uint64_t v = desired_language(); memcpy(code, &v, 8); code[8] = 0; return code; }

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- nn::err
 * The console's error viewer shows "Error Code: 2MMM-DDDD" (2000 + module, description) in a dialog and returns when
 * the user closes it. Here it is a Windows message box on the calling thread, which blocks the same way. Scripted
 * runs (SMO_SEQ / SMO_PLAY / SMO_PRESS / SMO_SCRIPT) and SMO_ERROR_DIALOG=0 only log, so tests never hang. */
static void err_dialog(unsigned category, unsigned number) {
    const char *off = getenv("SMO_ERROR_DIALOG");
    char text[160];
    if ((off && off[0] == '0') || getenv("SMO_SEQ") || getenv("SMO_PLAY") || getenv("SMO_PRESS") || getenv("SMO_SCRIPT")) return;
    snprintf(text, sizeof text, "Error Code: %04u-%04u\n\nAn error has occurred.", category, number);
    MessageBoxA(NULL, text, "Error", MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR | MB_SETFOREGROUND | MB_TASKMODAL);
}
static void err_ShowErrorResult(Ctx *c) {                 /* (Result): the console shows the error applet */
    uint32_t r = (uint32_t)A0;
    err_dialog(2000 + (r & 0x1ff), (r >> 9) & 0x1fff);
    printf("nn::err::ShowError: result 0x%x (module %u, description %u), caller 0x%llx\n", r, r & 0x1ff, (r >> 9) & 0x1fff,
           (unsigned long long)c->x[30] - 4);
    trace_printf("     nn::err::ShowError result 0x%x (module %u, description %u)\n", r, r & 0x1ff, (r >> 9) & 0x1fff);
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- nn::util */
static HCRYPTPROV crypt_provider(void) {
    static HCRYPTPROV prov;
    static volatile LONG lock;
    while (InterlockedExchange(&lock, 1)) SwitchToThread();
    if (!prov && !CryptAcquireContextA(&prov, NULL, NULL, PROV_RSA_AES, CRYPT_VERIFYCONTEXT)) prov = 0;
    InterlockedExchange(&lock, 0);
    return prov;
}
/* [sdk] BinaryFileHeader checks (layout in nnsdk.c): signature = first 8 bytes; alignment shift u8 @0xe;
 * byte-order mark i16 @0xc, reversed when it reads 0xFFFE. */
static void util_BinaryFileHeader_IsSignatureValid(Ctx *c) { RET(rd64(A0) == A1); }
static void util_BinaryFileHeader_IsAlignmentValid(Ctx *c) { RET((A0 & ~(~0ull << (rd8(A0 + 0xe) & 63))) == 0); }
static void util_BinaryFileHeader_IsEndianReverse(Ctx *c) { RET(rd16(A0 + 0xc) == 0xfffe); }

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- nn::crypto (Windows CryptoAPI) */
static void crypto_Sha1(Ctx *c) {                         /* (void *out, size_t outSize, const void *data, size_t size) */
    HCRYPTHASH h = 0;
    uint8_t digest[20] = {0};
    DWORD len = sizeof digest;
    if (crypt_provider() && CryptCreateHash(crypt_provider(), CALG_SHA1, 0, 0, &h)) {
        CryptHashData(h, (const BYTE *)(uintptr_t)A2, (DWORD)A3, 0);
        CryptGetHashParam(h, HP_HASHVAL, digest, &len, 0);
        CryptDestroyHash(h);
    }
    memcpy((void *)(uintptr_t)A0, digest, A1 < sizeof digest ? (size_t)A1 : sizeof digest);
}
/* Md5Impl: the guest object is not touched; the running hash is kept on the host, keyed by its address. */
static struct { uint64_t key; HCRYPTHASH h; } g_md5[64];
static CRITICAL_SECTION g_md5_lock;
static HCRYPTHASH *md5_slot(uint64_t key, int create) {
    HCRYPTHASH *found = NULL;
    EnterCriticalSection(&g_md5_lock);
    for (int i = 0; i < 64 && !found; i++) if (g_md5[i].key == key) found = &g_md5[i].h;
    for (int i = 0; i < 64 && !found && create; i++) if (!g_md5[i].key) { g_md5[i].key = key; g_md5[i].h = 0; found = &g_md5[i].h; }
    LeaveCriticalSection(&g_md5_lock);
    return found;
}
static void md5_drop(uint64_t key) {
    EnterCriticalSection(&g_md5_lock);
    for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++) if (g_md5[i].key == key) { if (g_md5[i].h) CryptDestroyHash(g_md5[i].h); g_md5[i].key = 0; g_md5[i].h = 0; }
    LeaveCriticalSection(&g_md5_lock);
}
static void crypto_Md5_Initialize(Ctx *c) {
    md5_drop(A0);
    HCRYPTHASH *h = md5_slot(A0, 1);
    if (!h) fatal(c, "nn::crypto Md5Impl: more than 64 hashes in progress");
    if (!crypt_provider() || !CryptCreateHash(crypt_provider(), CALG_MD5, 0, 0, h)) *h = 0;
}
static void crypto_Md5_Update(Ctx *c) { HCRYPTHASH *h = md5_slot(A0, 0); if (h && *h) CryptHashData(*h, (const BYTE *)(uintptr_t)A1, (DWORD)A2, 0); }
static void crypto_Md5_GetHash(Ctx *c) {                  /* (this, void *out, size_t outSize) */
    HCRYPTHASH *h = md5_slot(A0, 0);
    uint8_t digest[16] = {0};
    DWORD len = sizeof digest;
    if (h && *h) CryptGetHashParam(*h, HP_HASHVAL, digest, &len, 0);
    memcpy((void *)(uintptr_t)A1, digest, A2 < sizeof digest ? (size_t)A2 : sizeof digest);
}
static void crypto_Md5_dtor(Ctx *c) { md5_drop(A0); }

static void async_GetSystemEvent(Ctx *c) { os_init_event(A1, 0); os_signal_event(A1); RET(0); }   /* (this, SystemEvent *out) */

/* SMO_DUMP_UNREG=<file>: write the names of all imports that still have no handler. */
static void dump_unregistered(void) {
    const char *path = getenv("SMO_DUMP_UNREG");
    if (!path || !path[0]) return;
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "w");
    if (!f) return;
    for (int i = 0; i < dyn_sym_count; i++)
        if (!dyn_syms[i].defined && dyn_syms[i].name[0] && !import_lookup(dyn_syms[i].name)) fprintf(f, "%s\n", dyn_syms[i].name);
    fclose(f);
}

/* self-test: the image's text is read-only, its data writable (hostrt.c runtime_init). */
int image_protect_selftest(Ctx *c) {
    int bad = 0, n = 0;
    (void)c;
    if (!getenv("SMO_NO_PROTECT")) {
        n += 3;
        if (!IsBadWritePtr((void *)(uintptr_t)GUEST_BASE, 1)) { bad++; printf("  image protection: the first text page is writable\n"); }
        if (!IsBadWritePtr((void *)(uintptr_t)(GUEST_BASE + GUEST_RO_END - 1), 1)) { bad++; printf("  image protection: the last read-only data byte is writable\n"); }
        if (IsBadWritePtr((void *)(uintptr_t)(GUEST_BASE + GUEST_RO_END), 1) || IsBadReadPtr((void *)(uintptr_t)GUEST_BASE, 16)) { bad++; printf("  image protection: data segment not writable or text not readable\n"); }
    }
    printf("  image protection: %d cases, %d failed\n", n, bad);
    return bad;
}

void register_misc_imports(void) {
    QueryPerformanceCounter(&g_start);
    InitializeCriticalSection(&g_oe_lock);
    InitializeCriticalSection(&g_md5_lock);
    register_imports(replace_imports, (int)(sizeof replace_imports / sizeof replace_imports[0]));
    int n = (int)(sizeof fill_imports / sizeof fill_imports[0]), added = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (!import_data(fill_imports[i].name)) { printf("nnmisc: \"%s\" is not an import of the game (a typo, or a function it never calls)\n", fill_imports[i].name); continue; }
        if (!import_lookup(fill_imports[i].name)) { register_imports(&fill_imports[i], 1); added++; }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)(sizeof replace_imports / sizeof replace_imports[0]); i++)
        if (!import_data(replace_imports[i].name)) printf("nnmisc: \"%s\" is not an import of the game (a typo, or a function it never calls)\n", replace_imports[i].name);
    trace_printf("nnmisc: %d of %d functions installed (the rest are provided elsewhere or not imported)\n", added, n);
    dump_unregistered();
    (void)ret1;
}
```

```c
/* ---- nn::os: time. The Switch system tick runs at 19.2 MHz. */
#define TICK_HZ 19200000ULL
/* Test aid SMO_TICK_CALLERS=1: every distinct return address of a caller of the clock functions is printed once (to find
 * what seeds the game's random numbers). */
void host_clock_caller(const char *what, uint64_t lr) {
    static int on = -1, n;
    static uint64_t seen[512];
    if (on < 0) on = getenv("SMO_TICK_CALLERS") != NULL;
    if (!on) return;
    for (int i = 0; i < n && i < 512; i++) if (seen[i] == lr) return;
    if (n < 512) { seen[n++] = lr; printf("clock caller: %s from %llx\n", what, (unsigned long long)lr); }
}
static void os_GetSystemTick(Ctx *c) {
    LARGE_INTEGER now, freq;
    host_clock_caller("GetSystemTick", c->x[30]);
    QueryPerformanceCounter(&now);
    QueryPerformanceFrequency(&freq);
    RET((uint64_t)((double)now.QuadPart * (double)TICK_HZ / (double)freq.QuadPart));
}

/* True when a printf format has a floating-point conversion (looks only at conversion
 * specifiers, so letters in literal text such as "uTexture%d" are ignored). */
static int format_has_float(const char *fmt) {
    for (const char *p = fmt; *p; p++) {
        if (*p != '%') continue;
        p++;
        if (*p == '%') continue;
        while (*p && strchr("-+ #0123456789.*hlLqjzt", *p)) p++;
        if (*p && strchr("fFeEgGaA", *p)) return 1;
        if (!*p) break;
    }
    return 0;
}

/* ---- nn::util: NintendoWare binary files (BNSH shader archives and similar).
 * BinaryFileHeader (0x20): sig[8] @0, version u32 @8, BOM u16 @0xc, alignment(log2) u8 @0xe,
 * targetAddrSize u8 @0xf, nameOffset u32 @0x10, flags u16 @0x14 (bit0 = relocated),
 * firstBlockOffset u16 @0x16, relocationTableOffset u32 @0x18, fileSize u32 @0x1c.
 * RelocationTable: "_RLT" @0, position u32 @4, sectionCount u32 @8, pad @0xc; sections (0x18 each):
 * base u64, position u32, size u32, entryIndex u32, entryCount u32; entries (8 each):
 * position u32, structCount u16, offsetCount u8, padding u8. Relocation adds the section base
 * (the file address when 0) to each 8-byte pointer: structCount groups of offsetCount pointers,
 * skipping padding*8 bytes between groups. */
static void util_BinaryFileHeader_GetAlignment(Ctx *c) { RET(1u << rd8(A0 + 0xe)); }
static void util_BinaryFileHeader_IsRelocated(Ctx *c) { RET(rd16(A0 + 0x14) & 1); }
static void util_BinaryFileHeader_GetFirstBlock(Ctx *c) { uint32_t off = rd16(A0 + 0x16); RET(off ? A0 + off : 0); }
static void util_BinaryFileHeader_GetRelocationTable(Ctx *c) { uint32_t off = rd32(A0 + 0x18); RET(off ? A0 + off : 0); }
static void util_BinaryBlockHeader_GetBlockSize(Ctx *c) { RET(rd32(A0 + 0x8)); }
static void util_RelocationTable_Relocate(Ctx *c) {
    uint64_t rlt = A0;
    uint64_t file = rlt - rd32(rlt + 4);                                  /* table position is file-relative */
    uint32_t nsec = rd32(rlt + 8);
    uint64_t sections = rlt + 0x10, entries = sections + (uint64_t)nsec * 0x18;
    unsigned long long fixed = 0;
    for (uint32_t s = 0; s < nsec; s++) {
        uint64_t sec = sections + (uint64_t)s * 0x18;
        uint64_t base = rd64(sec);
        uint32_t first = rd32(sec + 0x10), count = rd32(sec + 0x14);
        if (base == 0) base = file;
        for (uint32_t e = first; e < first + count; e++) {
            uint64_t ent = entries + (uint64_t)e * 8;
            uint64_t p = file + rd32(ent);
            uint32_t structs = rd16(ent + 4), ptrs = rd8(ent + 6), pad = rd8(ent + 7);
            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < structs; k++) {
                for (uint32_t j = 0; j < ptrs; j++) {
                    uint64_t v = rd64(p);
                    if (v) { wr64(p, v + base); fixed++; }
                    p += 8;
                }
                p += (uint64_t)pad * 8;
            }
        }
    }
    wr16(file + 0x14, rd16(file + 0x14) | 1);                             /* mark relocated */
    trace_printf("     util relocate file %llx: %u sections, %llu pointers rebased\n", (unsigned long long)file, nsec, fixed);
}
static void util_ReferSymbol(Ctx *c) { (void)c; }                                      /* returns its argument */

/* ---- C formatting: integer/pointer arguments arrive in x2..x7 (variadic AArch64 ABI).
 * Formats with floating-point conversions would need v0..v7 and are refused loudly. */
static void c_sprintf(Ctx *c) {
    const char *fmt = (const char *)(uintptr_t)A1;
    if (format_has_float(fmt)) guest_trap("sprintf with a floating-point conversion is not supported", c->x[30] - 4);
    int n = snprintf((char *)(uintptr_t)A0, 4096, fmt, (unsigned long long)A2, (unsigned long long)A3,
                     (unsigned long long)A4, (unsigned long long)c->x[5], (unsigned long long)c->x[6], (unsigned long long)c->x[7]);
    RET((int64_t)n);
}
static void c_snprintf(Ctx *c) {
    const char *fmt = (const char *)(uintptr_t)A2;
    if (format_has_float(fmt)) guest_trap("snprintf with a floating-point conversion is not supported", c->x[30] - 4);
    int n = snprintf((char *)(uintptr_t)A0, (size_t)A1, fmt, (unsigned long long)A3, (unsigned long long)A4,
                     (unsigned long long)c->x[5], (unsigned long long)c->x[6], (unsigned long long)c->x[7]);
    RET((int64_t)n);
}

/* ---- nn::lmem frame heap: bump allocation over a caller-supplied region. The HeapHead lives at
 * the start of the region and is opaque to the game (it only passes it back). A negative alignment
 * would allocate from the tail; the game uses positive alignments only. */
typedef struct { uint64_t start, head, tail, end; } FrameHeap;
static void lmem_CreateFrameHeap(Ctx *c) {               /* (void *region, size_t size, int option) -> HeapHead* */
    FrameHeap *h = P(0);
    uint64_t start = A0, size = A1;
    if (!start || size < sizeof *h) { RET(0); return; }
    h->start = start;
    h->head = (start + sizeof *h + 15) & ~15ull;
    h->end = h->tail = start + size;
    RET(h);
}
static void lmem_AllocateFromFrameHeap(Ctx *c) {         /* (HeapHead *, size_t size, int alignment) -> void* */
    FrameHeap *h = P(0);
    uint64_t size = A1;
    int64_t align = (int64_t)(int32_t)A2;
    if (!h) { RET(0); return; }
    if (align < 0) {                                     /* from the tail */
        uint64_t a = (uint64_t)-align, p = (h->tail - size) & ~(a - 1);
        if (p < h->head) { RET(0); return; }
        h->tail = p;
        RET(p);
        return;
    }
    uint64_t a = align ? (uint64_t)align : 4, p = (h->head + a - 1) & ~(a - 1);
    if (p + size > h->tail) { RET(0); return; }
    h->head = p + size;
    RET(p);
}
static void lmem_DestroyFrameHeap(Ctx *c) { (void)c; }

/* ---- nn::Result helpers: value 0 is success; module = low 9 bits, description = next 13. */
static void result_IsFailure(Ctx *c) { RET((uint32_t)A0 != 0); }
static void result_IsSuccess(Ctx *c) { RET((uint32_t)A0 == 0); }
static void result_GetModule(Ctx *c) { RET((uint32_t)A0 & 0x1ff); }
static void result_GetDescription(Ctx *c) { RET(((uint32_t)A0 >> 9) & 0x1fff); }
#define RESULT_UNAVAILABLE 0x3e87aull                     /* some non-zero nn::Result; exact code not established */

/* ---- nn::bcat delivery cache, client side as in sdk.elf; the bcat system module is not in the dump.
 * [sdk] 0xc1dd0 MountDeliveryCacheStorage -> 0xc5380 ShimLibraryGlobal::MountDeliveryCacheStorage: a storage
 *   service already held (global +0x10) gives 0x87a (module 122, description 4); otherwise the Result of
 *   CreateDeliveryCacheStorageService, and the service is kept. [doc] suyu bcat/service_creator.cpp: the module
 *   answers success with the application's delivery cache directory, which is empty when nothing was ever
 *   delivered (a console that was never online).
 * [sdk] 0xc54c0 Unmount: aborts when no storage is held or a file / directory is still open, else releases it.
 * [sdk] 0xc5770 Enumerate: aborts when no storage is held; asks the service (command 10) for the names.
 *   [doc] suyu delivery_cache_storage_service.cpp: count = directories present = 0.
 * [sdk] 0xc2110 RequestSyncDeliveryCache(progress): aborts when the storage is mounted; when
 *   nn::nifm::IsAnyInternetRequestAccepted(GetClientId()) is false it returns 0x107a (module 122, description 8)
 *   WITHOUT asking the bcat module. No network request is ever accepted here (nifm: no network).
 * [sdk] 0xc1be0 DirectoryName::IsValid: 1..31 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 _ - (nnonline.inc opens directories). */
#define BCAT_ALREADY_MOUNTED 0x87au
#define BCAT_INTERNET_REQUEST_NOT_ACCEPTED 0x107au
volatile LONG g_bcat_mounted;                             /* also read by nnonline.inc (DeliveryCacheDirectory / File Open) */
static void bcat_Mount(Ctx *c) {
    if (InterlockedCompareExchange(&g_bcat_mounted, 1, 0) != 0) { RET(BCAT_ALREADY_MOUNTED); return; }
    trace_printf("     nn::bcat::MountDeliveryCacheStorage -> mounted (empty delivery cache)\n");
    RET(0);
}
static void bcat_Unmount(Ctx *c) {
    if (InterlockedCompareExchange(&g_bcat_mounted, 0, 1) != 1)
        guest_trap("nn::bcat::UnmountDeliveryCacheStorage without a mounted storage (the SDK aborts, sdk 0xc5514)", c->x[30] - 4);
}
static void bcat_Enumerate(Ctx *c) {                         /* (int *outCount, DirectoryName *names, int max) */
    if (!g_bcat_mounted)
        guest_trap("nn::bcat::EnumerateDeliveryCacheDirectory without a mounted storage (the SDK aborts, sdk 0xc5800)", c->x[30] - 4);
    wr32(A0, 0);
    RET(0);
}
int bcat_dirname_valid(const char *s) {              /* [sdk] 0xc1be0 on the 32-byte copy */
    int n = 0;
    for (; n < 32 && s[n]; n++) {
        unsigned char ch = (unsigned char)s[n];
        if (!((ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') || (ch >= 'A' && ch <= 'Z') || (ch >= 'a' && ch <= 'z') || ch == '_' || ch == '-')) return 0;
    }
    return n != 0 && n != 32;
}

    static const struct { const char *name; int valid; } t[] = {
        {"", 0}, {"a", 1}, {"spirits_event-01", 1}, {"with space", 0}, {"dot.name", 0},

    printf("  bcat: directory name rule of sdk 0xc1be0 (7 names): %s\n", ok ? "ok" : "FAILED");
    {

        int ok2 = 1;
        uint64_t lr = c->x[30];
        bcat_RequestSync(c); ok2 &= (uint32_t)c->x[0] == BCAT_INTERNET_REQUEST_NOT_ACCEPTED;
        bcat_Mount(c); ok2 &= (uint32_t)c->x[0] == 0;
        bcat_Mount(c); ok2 &= (uint32_t)c->x[0] == BCAT_ALREADY_MOUNTED;

        bcat_Unmount(c); ok2 &= g_bcat_mounted == 0;

static void util_SNPrintf(Ctx *c) {                       /* (char *buf, size_t size, const char *fmt, ...) */
    const char *fmt = (const char *)(uintptr_t)A2;
    /* SMO_SNPRINTF_LOG=1: how often the game formats and what one call costs. A line per 2,000 calls:
     * the frame, the time those calls took, the slowest one with its format and caller. */
    static int lg = -1; static LONG64 n_calls, tk_sum, tk_max; static char max_fmt[64]; static uint64_t max_ra;
    if (lg < 0) lg = getenv("SMO_SNPRINTF_LOG") && atoi(getenv("SMO_SNPRINTF_LOG"));
    LARGE_INTEGER q0, q1;
    if (lg) QueryPerformanceCounter(&q0);
    if (format_has_float(fmt)) guest_trap("nn::util::SNPrintf with a floating-point conversion is not supported", c->x[30] - 4);
    int n = snprintf((char *)(uintptr_t)A0, (size_t)A1, fmt, (unsigned long long)A3, (unsigned long long)A4,
                     (unsigned long long)c->x[5], (unsigned long long)c->x[6], (unsigned long long)c->x[7]);
    if (lg) {
        extern long long nvn_front_frame_next(void);
        QueryPerformanceCounter(&q1);
        LONG64 d = q1.QuadPart - q0.QuadPart;
        tk_sum += d;
        if (d > tk_max) { tk_max = d; max_ra = c->x[30]; snprintf(max_fmt, sizeof max_fmt, "%.60s", fmt); }
        {   static LONG nslow; LARGE_INTEGER fq; QueryPerformanceFrequency(&fq);
            if (d * 5000 > fq.QuadPart && InterlockedIncrement(&nslow) <= 300)      /* one call over 0.2 ms */
                printf("snprintf_log: SLOW call, frame %lld: %.3f ms, format \"%.60s\" (%llu characters), buffer size %llu, result %d, called from %llx\n", nvn_front_frame_next(), (double)d * 1000.0 / (double)fq.QuadPart, fmt, (unsigned long long)strlen(fmt), (unsigned long long)A1, n, (unsigned long long)c->x[30]);
        }
        if (++n_calls % 2000 == 0) {
            LARGE_INTEGER fq; QueryPerformanceFrequency(&fq);
            printf("snprintf_log: frame %lld: %lld calls so far, the last 2000 took %.2f ms, slowest %.3f ms (format \"%s\", buffer size %llu, called from %llx); this one: \"%.40s\" size %llu from %llx\n", nvn_front_frame_next(), (long long)n_calls,
                   (double)tk_sum * 1000.0 / (double)fq.QuadPart, (double)tk_max * 1000.0 / (double)fq.QuadPart, max_fmt, (unsigned long long)A1, (unsigned long long)max_ra, fmt, (unsigned long long)A1, (unsigned long long)c->x[30]);
            tk_sum = tk_max = 0;
        }
    }
    RET((int64_t)n);
}
static void util_ConvertCharacterUtf8ToUtf32(Ctx *c) {    /* (uint32_t *out, const char *s) -> bytes consumed, or 0 */
    const uint8_t *s = (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)A1;
    uint32_t cp; int n;
    if (s[0] < 0x80) { cp = s[0]; n = 1; }
    else if ((s[0] & 0xe0) == 0xc0) { cp = ((s[0] & 0x1f) << 6) | (s[1] & 0x3f); n = 2; }
    else if ((s[0] & 0xf0) == 0xe0) { cp = ((s[0] & 0x0f) << 12) | ((s[1] & 0x3f) << 6) | (s[2] & 0x3f); n = 3; }
    else if ((s[0] & 0xf8) == 0xf0) { cp = ((s[0] & 0x07) << 18) | ((s[1] & 0x3f) << 12) | ((s[2] & 0x3f) << 6) | (s[3] & 0x3f); n = 4; }
    else { RET(0); return; }
    wr32(A0, cp);
    RET(n);
}
static void util_PickOutCharacterFromUtf8String(Ctx *c) { /* (char out[4], const char **cursor) -> bytes, advances cursor */
    const uint8_t *s = (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)rd64(A1);
    int n = s[0] < 0x80 ? 1 : (s[0] & 0xe0) == 0xc0 ? 2 : (s[0] & 0xf0) == 0xe0 ? 3 : (s[0] & 0xf8) == 0xf0 ? 4 : 0;
    if (!n) { RET(0); return; }
    memcpy((void *)(uintptr_t)A0, s, (size_t)n);
    wr64(A1, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(s + n));
    RET(n);
}
```
