```c
/* nn::time on the host clock.
 * PosixTime { int64 seconds }. CalendarTime { int16 year; int8 month, day, hour, minute, second; }.
 * CalendarAdditionalInfo { int32 dayOfWeek (0 = Sunday); int32 yearDay;
 *                          char zoneName[8]; bool isDst; int32 utcOffsetSeconds; }. */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <windows.h>
#include <shlwapi.h>
#include "runtime.h"
#include "hostrt.h"

#define A0 (c->x[0])
#define A1 (c->x[1])
#define A2 (c->x[2])
#define RET(v) (c->x[0] = (uint64_t)(v))

static int64_t now_posix(void) { return (int64_t)_time64(NULL); }

static void read_calendar(uint64_t in, struct tm *t) {
    memset(t, 0, sizeof *t);
    t->tm_year = (int16_t)rd16(in) - 1900;
    t->tm_mon = (int8_t)rd8(in + 2) - 1;
    t->tm_mday = (int8_t)rd8(in + 3);
    t->tm_hour = (int8_t)rd8(in + 4);
    t->tm_min = (int8_t)rd8(in + 5);
    t->tm_sec = (int8_t)rd8(in + 6);
    t->tm_isdst = -1;
}

void host_clock_caller(const char *what, uint64_t lr);       /* nnsdk.c: SMO_TICK_CALLERS */
static void time_GetCurrentTime(Ctx *c) { host_clock_caller("GetCurrentTime", c->x[30]); wr64(A0, (uint64_t)now_posix()); RET(0); }
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Time zone rule.
 * On the console: [sdk 0x391820] ToCalendarTime(out, info, posix) = ITimeZoneService slot +0x60 (ToCalendarTimeWithMyRule);
 * it answers 0x74 when nn::time is not initialised. The time module (not in
 * the dump) keeps "my rule": the TZif file of the device's location, from the TimeZoneBinary system archive, parsed into
 * the 0x4000-byte rule below (suyu externals/tz/tz/tz.h Rule; glue/time/time_zone.cpp; psc/time/time_zone.cpp), and
 * converts with the public tz code (localsub). The archive is not in ..\sysdata, so the rule is BUILT here, in the same
 * format, from what Windows knows about the zone: registry "Time Zones\<key>" TZI + "Dynamic DST" year entries (the data
 * behind GetDynamicTimeZoneInformation), one transition list for 1970..2037 as a compiled zone file has. Windows has no
 * abbreviations and only a short history (measured: W. Europe equals the tz database from 1996 on, not
 * before), so when the zone's file of the public tz database is found (%SMO_TZDIR%, ..\sysdata\zoneinfo,
 * C:\msys64\usr\share\zoneinfo) its own transitions, types and names are the rule's past (what the console's archive is
 * compiled from) and Windows' transitions continue it after the file's last explicit one; the names of Windows' types
 * come from the file (same offset) or its footer, e.g. "CET-1CEST,M3.5.0,M10.5.0/3". Without the file: Windows' data
 * alone and the tz database's numeric name form ("+01", "+0530"). */
typedef struct { int32_t utoff; uint8_t isdst, p0[3]; int32_t desigidx; uint8_t ttisstd, ttisut, p1[2]; } TzType;
typedef struct {
    int32_t timecnt, typecnt, charcnt; uint8_t goback, goahead, pad0[2];
    int64_t ats[1000]; uint8_t types[1000]; TzType ttis[128]; char chars[512]; int32_t defaulttype; uint8_t pad1[0x12c4];
} TzRule;
_Static_assert(sizeof(TzRule) == 0x4000 && sizeof(TzType) == 0x10, "time zone rule layout");
typedef struct { int year, mon, mday, hour, min, sec, wday, yday, isdst, utoff; char zone[16]; } TzTm;
typedef struct { LONG Bias, StandardBias, DaylightBias; SYSTEMTIME StandardDate, DaylightDate; } RegTzi;
typedef struct { RegTzi base; int first, last; RegTzi dyn[160]; uint8_t have[160]; } WinZone;
#define TZ_OVERFLOW 0x19274u            /* module 116, description 201 */
#define TZ_OUT_OF_RANGE 0x70c74u        /* 902 */

static int64_t days_from_civil(int64_t y, int m, int d) {
    y -= m <= 2;
    int64_t era = (y >= 0 ? y : y - 399) / 400;
    int64_t yoe = y - era * 400, doy = (153 * (m + (m > 2 ? -3 : 9)) + 2) / 5 + d - 1;
    return era * 146097 + yoe * 365 + yoe / 4 - yoe / 100 + doy - 719468;
}
static void civil_from_days(int64_t z, int64_t *y, int *m, int *d) {
    z += 719468;
    int64_t era = (z >= 0 ? z : z - 146096) / 146097, doe = z - era * 146097;
    int64_t yoe = (doe - doe / 1460 + doe / 36524 - doe / 146096) / 365, doy = doe - (365 * yoe + yoe / 4 - yoe / 100);
    int64_t mp = (5 * doy + 2) / 153;
    *d = (int)(doy - (153 * mp + 2) / 5 + 1);
    *m = (int)(mp < 10 ? mp + 3 : mp - 9);
    *y = yoe + era * 400 + (*m <= 2);
}
static int tz_split(int64_t t, int32_t utoff, TzTm *o) {                   /* tz timesub: UTC seconds + offset -> fields */
    if (t > 67767976233532799LL || t < -67768040609740800LL) return -1;       /* the year would not fit 32 bits */
    int64_t local = t + utoff, days = local / 86400, rem = local % 86400, y;
    if (rem < 0) { rem += 86400; days--; }
    civil_from_days(days, &y, &o->mon, &o->mday);
    o->year = (int)y;
    o->hour = (int)(rem / 3600); o->min = (int)(rem / 60 % 60); o->sec = (int)(rem % 60);
    o->wday = (int)(((days % 7) + 11) % 7);                                   /* 1970-01-01 was a Thursday */
    o->yday = (int)(days - days_from_civil(y, 1, 1));
    o->utoff = utoff;
    return 0;
}
static int tz_local(const TzRule *r, int64_t t, TzTm *o) {                 /* tz localsub (suyu externals/tz/tz/tz.cpp line 525..) */
    int i;
    if (r->timecnt > 0 && ((r->goback && t < r->ats[0]) || (r->goahead && t > r->ats[r->timecnt - 1]))) {
        const int64_t repeat = 146097LL * 86400;
        int64_t seconds = (t < r->ats[0] ? r->ats[0] - t : t - r->ats[r->timecnt - 1]) - 1;
        int64_t years = seconds / repeat * 400, newt;
        seconds = years * (repeat / 400);
        years += 400;
        newt = t < r->ats[0] ? t + seconds + repeat : t - seconds - repeat;
        if (newt < r->ats[0] || newt > r->ats[r->timecnt - 1]) return -1;
        if (tz_local(r, newt, o)) return -1;
        int64_t newy = (int64_t)o->year + (t < r->ats[0] ? -years : years);
        if (newy < INT32_MIN || newy > INT32_MAX) return -1;
        o->year = (int)newy;
        return 0;
    }
    if (r->timecnt == 0 || t < r->ats[0]) i = r->defaulttype;
    else {
        int lo = 1, hi = r->timecnt;
        while (lo < hi) { int mid = (lo + hi) >> 1; if (t < r->ats[mid]) hi = mid; else lo = mid + 1; }
        i = r->types[lo - 1];
    }
    if (i < 0 || i >= 128) return -1;
    if (tz_split(t, r->ttis[i].utoff, o)) return -1;
    o->isdst = r->ttis[i].isdst;
    memset(o->zone, 0, sizeof o->zone);
    if (r->ttis[i].desigidx >= 0 && r->ttis[i].desigidx < (int)sizeof r->chars) strncpy(o->zone, r->chars + r->ttis[i].desigidx, sizeof o->zone - 1);
    return 0;
}
static int tz_validate(const TzRule *r) {                                   /* suyu psc/time/time_zone.cpp ValidateRule */
    if (r->typecnt > 128 || r->timecnt > 1000 || r->charcnt > 50 || r->typecnt < 0 || r->timecnt < 0) return -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < r->timecnt; i++) if (r->types[i] >= r->typecnt) return -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < r->typecnt; i++) if (r->ttis[i].desigidx >= (int)sizeof r->chars) return -1;
    return 0;
}

static int winzone_load(const wchar_t *key, WinZone *z) {
    wchar_t path[256];
    DWORD size = sizeof z->base, type = 0, v = 0;
    memset(z, 0, sizeof *z);
    _snwprintf(path, 255, L"SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Time Zones\\%ls", key); path[255] = 0;
    if (SHGetValueW(HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, path, L"TZI", &type, &z->base, &size) != ERROR_SUCCESS || size != sizeof z->base) return -1;
    wcscat(path, L"\\Dynamic DST");
    size = sizeof v;
    if (SHGetValueW(HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, path, L"FirstEntry", &type, &v, &size) != ERROR_SUCCESS) return 0;
    z->first = (int)v;
    size = sizeof v;
    if (SHGetValueW(HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, path, L"LastEntry", &type, &v, &size) != ERROR_SUCCESS) { z->first = 0; return 0; }
    z->last = (int)v;
    if (z->last < z->first || z->last - z->first >= 160) { z->first = z->last = 0; return 0; }
    for (int y = z->first; y <= z->last; y++) {
        wchar_t name[16];
        _snwprintf(name, 15, L"%d", y);
        size = sizeof z->base;
        z->have[y - z->first] = SHGetValueW(HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, path, name, &type, &z->dyn[y - z->first], &size) == ERROR_SUCCESS && size == sizeof z->base;
    }
    return 0;
}
static const RegTzi *winzone_year(const WinZone *z, int year) {             /* a year outside the entries uses the nearest one */
    if (!z->first) return &z->base;
    int y = year < z->first ? z->first : year > z->last ? z->last : year;
    return z->have[y - z->first] ? &z->dyn[y - z->first] : &z->base;
}
static int winzone_date(const SYSTEMTIME *st, int year, int64_t *local) {  /* local wall-clock second of a TZI transition date */
    static const int mdays[12] = {31, 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31};
    int d;
    if (st->wMonth < 1 || st->wMonth > 12) return 0;
    if (st->wYear) { if (st->wYear != year) return 0; d = st->wDay; }      /* absolute date */
    else if (st->wMonth == 1 && st->wDay == 1 && !st->wHour && !st->wMinute && !st->wSecond && !st->wMilliseconds) d = 1;   /* Windows' form of "at the start of the year" (measured: Central Brazilian Standard Time before 2004) */
    else {                                                                  /* wDay-th wDayOfWeek of the month, 5 = last */
        int len = mdays[st->wMonth - 1] + (st->wMonth == 2 && ((year % 4 == 0 && year % 100 != 0) || year % 400 == 0));
        int64_t first = days_from_civil(year, st->wMonth, 1);
        int wd = (int)(((first % 7) + 11) % 7);
        d = 1 + (st->wDayOfWeek - wd + 7) % 7 + 7 * (st->wDay - 1);
        while (d > len) d -= 7;
    }
    *local = days_from_civil(year, st->wMonth, d) * 86400 + st->wHour * 3600 + st->wMinute * 60 + st->wSecond + (st->wMilliseconds >= 500);
    return 1;
}
static int tzrule_type(TzRule *r, int32_t utoff, int isdst) {
    for (int i = 0; i < r->typecnt; i++) if (r->ttis[i].utoff == utoff && r->ttis[i].isdst == isdst) return i;
    if (r->typecnt >= 128) return 0;
    r->ttis[r->typecnt].utoff = utoff; r->ttis[r->typecnt].isdst = (uint8_t)isdst;
    return r->typecnt++;
}
static void tzrule_at(TzRule *r, int64_t at, int type, int *cur) {
    if (type == *cur) return;
    if (r->timecnt && at <= r->ats[r->timecnt - 1]) {                       /* two changes at one instant: the later rule wins */
        r->types[r->timecnt - 1] = (uint8_t)type; *cur = type;
        if (r->timecnt >= 2 ? r->types[r->timecnt - 2] == type : r->defaulttype == type) r->timecnt--;
        return;
    }
    if (r->timecnt >= 1000) return;
    r->ats[r->timecnt] = at; r->types[r->timecnt++] = (uint8_t)type; *cur = type;
}
/* A zone file (TZif) of the public tz database: version 2+ body into the rule, exactly as stored (64-bit transition times,
 * type indices, {offset, isdst, name index} records, names), and the footer's names: std name, offset, optional dst name
 * and offset. Returns 0 when the file was found and read. */
static uint32_t be32(const uint8_t *p) { return ((uint32_t)p[0] << 24) | ((uint32_t)p[1] << 16) | ((uint32_t)p[2] << 8) | p[3]; }
static int tzdb_load(const char *iana, TzRule *r, char *std_name, int32_t *std_off, char *dst_name, int32_t *dst_off) {
    const char *dirs[3] = {getenv("SMO_TZDIR"), "..\\sysdata\\zoneinfo", "C:\\msys64\\usr\\share\\zoneinfo"};
    std_name[0] = dst_name[0] = 0;
    if (!iana || !iana[0] || strstr(iana, "..") || strchr(iana, ':') || iana[0] == '/' || iana[0] == '\\') return -1;
    for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
        char path[MAX_PATH];
        static uint8_t buf[256 * 1024];
        if (!dirs[k] || !dirs[k][0]) continue;
        snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s\\%s", dirs[k], iana);
        for (char *p = path; *p; p++) if (*p == '/') *p = '\\';
        FILE *f = fopen(path, "rb");
        if (!f) continue;
        size_t n = fread(buf, 1, sizeof buf - 1, f);
        fclose(f);
        if (n < 44 * 2 || memcmp(buf, "TZif", 4) || buf[4] < '2' || buf[n - 1] != '\n') continue;
        /* skip the 32-bit block: counts are isut, isstd, leap, time, type, char */
        size_t v1 = (size_t)be32(buf + 32) * 5 + (size_t)be32(buf + 36) * 6 + be32(buf + 40) + (size_t)be32(buf + 28) * 8 + be32(buf + 24) + be32(buf + 20);
        const uint8_t *h = buf + 44 + v1;
        if (44 + v1 + 44 > n || memcmp(h, "TZif", 4)) continue;
        uint32_t isut = be32(h + 20), isstd = be32(h + 24), leap = be32(h + 28), timecnt = be32(h + 32), typecnt = be32(h + 36), charcnt = be32(h + 40);
        const uint8_t *p8 = h + 44;
        size_t body = (size_t)timecnt * 9 + (size_t)typecnt * 6 + charcnt + (size_t)leap * 12 + isstd + isut;
        if (timecnt > 1000 || typecnt == 0 || typecnt > 128 || charcnt > 50 || (size_t)(p8 - buf) + body + 2 > n) continue;
        memset(r, 0, sizeof *r);
        r->timecnt = (int32_t)timecnt; r->typecnt = (int32_t)typecnt; r->charcnt = (int32_t)charcnt;
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < timecnt; i++) r->ats[i] = (int64_t)(((uint64_t)be32(p8 + i * 8) << 32) | be32(p8 + i * 8 + 4));
        p8 += (size_t)timecnt * 8;
        int ok = 1;
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < timecnt; i++) { r->types[i] = p8[i]; if (p8[i] >= typecnt) ok = 0; }
        p8 += timecnt;
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < typecnt; i++, p8 += 6) {
            r->ttis[i].utoff = (int32_t)be32(p8); r->ttis[i].isdst = p8[4] != 0; r->ttis[i].desigidx = p8[5];
            if (p8[5] >= charcnt) ok = 0;
        }
        memcpy(r->chars, p8, charcnt);
        p8 += charcnt + (size_t)leap * 12;
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < isstd && i < typecnt; i++) r->ttis[i].ttisstd = p8[i] != 0;
        p8 += isstd;
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < isut && i < typecnt; i++) r->ttis[i].ttisut = p8[i] != 0;
        if (!ok) continue;
        {                                                                   /* tz code: the type for times before the first transition */
            int i;
            for (i = 0; i < r->timecnt; i++) if (r->types[i] == 0) break;
            i = i < r->timecnt ? -1 : 0;
            if (i < 0 && r->timecnt > 0 && r->ttis[r->types[0]].isdst) { i = r->types[0]; while (--i >= 0) if (!r->ttis[i].isdst) break; }
            if (i < 0) { i = 0; while (r->ttis[i].isdst) if (++i >= r->typecnt) { i = 0; break; } }
            r->defaulttype = i;
        }
        size_t e = n - 1, s = e;
        while (s > 0 && buf[s - 1] != '\n') s--;
        buf[e] = 0;
        const char *p = (const char *)buf + s;
        for (int which = 0; which < 2; which++) {
            char *name = which ? dst_name : std_name;
            int len = 0, sign = 1, v[3] = {0, 0, 0}, got = 0;
            if (*p == '<') { for (p++; *p && *p != '>' && len < 15; p++) name[len++] = *p; if (*p == '>') p++; }
            else while (((*p >= 'A' && *p <= 'Z') || (*p >= 'a' && *p <= 'z')) && len < 15) name[len++] = *p++;
            name[len] = 0;
            if (!len) break;
            if (*p == '-') { sign = -1; p++; } else if (*p == '+') p++;
            for (int part = 0; part < 3 && *p >= '0' && *p <= '9'; part++) {
                while (*p >= '0' && *p <= '9') v[part] = v[part] * 10 + (*p++ - '0');
                got = 1;
                if (*p != ':') break;
                p++;
            }
            int32_t off = -sign * (v[0] * 3600 + v[1] * 60 + v[2]);        /* POSIX counts west of Greenwich as positive */
            if (which == 0) { if (!got) { std_name[0] = 0; break; } *std_off = off; }
            else *dst_off = got ? off : *std_off + 3600;
            if (*p == ',' || !*p) break;
        }
        return 0;
    }
    return -1;
}
static int tzrule_name(TzRule *r, const char *name) {                       /* index of a name in the rule's name block */
    for (int p = 0; p < r->charcnt; p += (int)strlen(r->chars + p) + 1) if (!strcmp(r->chars + p, name)) return p;
    if (r->charcnt + (int)strlen(name) + 1 > 50) return 0;
    int at = r->charcnt;
    strcpy(r->chars + at, name);
    r->charcnt += (int)strlen(name) + 1;
    return at;
}
/* w = the transitions Windows' data gives for 1970..2037 (types without names). */
static void winrule_build(TzRule *w, const WinZone *z, int fixed, LONG fixed_bias) {
    int cur = -1;
    memset(w, 0, sizeof *w);
    for (int year = 1970; year <= 2037; year++) {
        const RegTzi *t = winzone_year(z, year);
        int64_t to_dst = 0, to_std = 0;
        int32_t std_off = -(t->Bias + t->StandardBias) * 60, dst_off = -(t->Bias + t->DaylightBias) * 60;
        int both = !fixed && winzone_date(&t->DaylightDate, year, &to_dst) && winzone_date(&t->StandardDate, year, &to_std);
        if (fixed) std_off = -fixed_bias * 60;
        int std_type = tzrule_type(w, std_off, 0), dst_type = both ? tzrule_type(w, dst_off, 1) : std_type;
        to_dst -= std_off; to_std -= dst_off;                               /* the dates are in the wall clock before the change */
        int start = both && to_std < to_dst ? dst_type : std_type;          /* southern pattern: the year begins in daylight time */
        if (cur < 0) { w->defaulttype = cur = start; }
        else if (cur != start) tzrule_at(w, days_from_civil(year, 1, 1) * 86400, start, &cur);       /* Windows changes the year's entry at 00:00 UTC (measured) */
        if (!both) continue;
        if (to_dst < to_std) { tzrule_at(w, to_dst, dst_type, &cur); tzrule_at(w, to_std, std_type, &cur); }
        else { tzrule_at(w, to_std, std_type, &cur); tzrule_at(w, to_dst, dst_type, &cur); }
    }
}
/* The rule of a location. With the zone's tz database file: the file's own transitions (the zone's history, as the
 * console's archive has it), continued after the file's last explicit transition by the transitions Windows' data gives
 * (a compiled zone file continues with the rule in its footer; Windows' current entry is that rule, kept up to date by
 * Windows Update). Without the file (iana NULL or not found): Windows' data for all of 1970..2037, numeric names. */
static void tzrule_build(TzRule *r, const WinZone *z, const char *iana, int fixed, LONG fixed_bias) {
    static TzRule w;
    static SRWLOCK lock = SRWLOCK_INIT;                                     /* w and the file buffer are shared */
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
    char std_name[16], dst_name[16];
    int32_t n_std = 0, n_dst = 0;
    int map[128], cur, have_file = iana && tzdb_load(iana, r, std_name, &n_std, dst_name, &n_dst) == 0;
    int64_t last = INT64_MIN;
    winrule_build(&w, z, fixed, fixed_bias);
    if (!have_file) { memset(r, 0, sizeof *r); std_name[0] = dst_name[0] = 0; cur = -1; }
    else { cur = r->timecnt ? r->types[r->timecnt - 1] : r->defaulttype; if (r->timecnt) last = r->ats[r->timecnt - 1]; }
    for (int i = 0; i < w.typecnt; i++) {                                   /* Windows' types in the rule: the newest file type with the same offset, else a new one */
        char name[16];
        int32_t off = w.ttis[i].utoff, a = off < 0 ? -off : off;
        map[i] = -1;
        for (int k = r->typecnt - 1; k >= 0 && map[i] < 0; k--) if (r->ttis[k].utoff == off && r->ttis[k].isdst == w.ttis[i].isdst) map[i] = k;
        if (map[i] >= 0 || r->typecnt >= 128) { if (map[i] < 0) map[i] = 0; continue; }
        if (!w.ttis[i].isdst && std_name[0] && off == n_std) strcpy(name, std_name);
        else if (w.ttis[i].isdst && dst_name[0] && off == n_dst) strcpy(name, dst_name);
        else if (a % 3600 == 0) snprintf(name, sizeof name, "%c%02d", off < 0 ? '-' : '+', a / 3600);
        else snprintf(name, sizeof name, "%c%02d%02d", off < 0 ? '-' : '+', a / 3600, a / 60 % 60);
        map[i] = r->typecnt;
        r->ttis[r->typecnt].utoff = off; r->ttis[r->typecnt].isdst = w.ttis[i].isdst; r->ttis[r->typecnt].desigidx = tzrule_name(r, name);
        r->typecnt++;
    }
    if (cur < 0) r->defaulttype = cur = map[w.defaulttype];
    for (int k = 0; k < w.timecnt; k++) {
        int type = map[w.types[k]];
        if (w.ats[k] <= last) continue;
        if (type == cur || r->timecnt >= 1000) continue;
        r->ats[r->timecnt] = w.ats[k]; r->types[r->timecnt++] = (uint8_t)type; cur = type;
    }
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
}
static void location_name(char out[0x24]);
static TzRule *my_rule(void) {                                              /* the rule of the Windows time zone, built once */
    static TzRule rule;
    static volatile LONG ready;
    if (InterlockedCompareExchange(&ready, 1, 0) == 0) {
        DYNAMIC_TIME_ZONE_INFORMATION d;
        static WinZone z;
        char iana[0x24];
        memset(&d, 0, sizeof d);
        GetDynamicTimeZoneInformation(&d);
        location_name(iana);
        if (winzone_load(d.TimeZoneKeyName, &z)) {                          /* a zone without a registry key: what the API gave */
            memset(&z, 0, sizeof z);
            z.base.Bias = d.Bias; z.base.StandardBias = d.StandardBias; z.base.DaylightBias = d.DaylightBias;
            z.base.StandardDate = d.StandardDate; z.base.DaylightDate = d.DaylightDate;
        }
        tzrule_build(&rule, &z, iana, d.DynamicDaylightTimeDisabled != 0, d.Bias + d.StandardBias);   /* "adjust for daylight saving time" off */
        ready = 2;
    }
    while (ready != 2) SwitchToThread();
    return &rule;
}
static void calendar_out(Ctx *c, const TzRule *r) {
    TzTm t;
    if (tz_validate(r)) { RET(TZ_OUT_OF_RANGE); return; }
    if (tz_local(r, (int64_t)rd64(A2), &t)) { RET(TZ_OVERFLOW); return; }
    if (A0) {
        wr16(A0, (uint16_t)(int16_t)t.year); wr8(A0 + 2, (uint8_t)t.mon); wr8(A0 + 3, (uint8_t)t.mday);
        wr8(A0 + 4, (uint8_t)t.hour); wr8(A0 + 5, (uint8_t)t.min); wr8(A0 + 6, (uint8_t)t.sec); wr8(A0 + 7, 0);
    }
    if (A1) {                                                               /* [sdk 0x3918a8..0x3918c0] the four parts the SDK copies out */
        wr32(A1, (uint32_t)t.wday);
        wr32(A1 + 4, (uint32_t)t.yday);
        memcpy((void *)(uintptr_t)(A1 + 8), t.zone, 8);
        wr8(A1 + 15, 0);
        wr32(A1 + 16, 0);
        wr8(A1 + 16, (uint8_t)(t.isdst != 0));
        wr32(A1 + 20, (uint32_t)t.utoff);
    }
    RET(0);
}
static void time_ToCalendarTime(Ctx *c) { calendar_out(c, my_rule()); }    /* (CalendarTime *out, CalendarAdditionalInfo *info, const PosixTime &t) */
static void time_ToPosixTimeFromUtc(Ctx *c) { struct tm t; read_calendar(A0, &t); t.tm_isdst = 0; RET((int64_t)_mkgmtime64(&t)); }
/* The location name: the IANA name of the Windows time zone (ICU, Windows 10 1903+; "UTC" if ICU is absent). */
static void location_name(char out[0x24]) {
    static char name[0x24];
    static volatile LONG ready;
    if (InterlockedCompareExchange(&ready, 1, 0) == 0) {
        strcpy(name, "UTC");
        HMODULE icu = LoadLibraryA("icu.dll");
        typedef int (__cdecl *GetTz)(unsigned short *, int, int *);
        GetTz get = icu ? (GetTz)GetProcAddress(icu, "ucal_getDefaultTimeZone") : NULL;
        if (get) {
            unsigned short w[64];
            int err = 0, n = get(w, 64, &err);
            if (err <= 0 && n > 0 && n < 0x24) { for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) name[i] = (char)w[i]; name[n] = 0; }
        }
        ready = 2;
    }
    while (ready != 2) SwitchToThread();
    memset(out, 0, 0x24);
    strcpy(out, name);
}
static void time_ToCalendarTime(Ctx *c);
static void ret0(Ctx *c) { RET(0); }
static void ret1(Ctx *c) { RET(1); }

#define T(n) "_ZN2nn4time" n
static const ImportDef time_imports[] = {
    {T("13IsInitializedEv"), ret1}, {T("10InitializeEv"), ret0}, {T("8FinalizeEv"), ret0},
    {T("23StandardUserSystemClock14GetCurrentTimeEPNS0_9PosixTimeE"), time_GetCurrentTime},
    {T("14ToCalendarTimeEPNS0_12CalendarTimeEPNS0_22CalendarAdditionalInfoERKNS0_9PosixTimeE"), time_ToCalendarTime},
    {T("18ToPosixTimeFromUtcERKNS0_12CalendarTimeE"), time_ToPosixTimeFromUtc},
};

void register_time_imports(void) {
    register_imports(time_imports, (int)(sizeof time_imports / sizeof time_imports[0]));
}

/* Self-test (SMO_SDK_SELFTEST): the rule built from the registry against Windows' own conversion
 * (SystemTimeToTzSpecificLocalTimeEx with the zone's dynamic information) for EVERY Windows time zone: every half hour of
 * the current year, every 2 h 59 min of 1990..2037; then the handlers on the PC's own zone. */
#define GP(p) ((uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(p))
int nntime_selftest(Ctx *c) {
    typedef BOOL (WINAPI *ToLocal)(const DYNAMIC_TIME_ZONE_INFORMATION *, const SYSTEMTIME *, SYSTEMTIME *);
    typedef DWORD (WINAPI *EnumTz)(DWORD, DYNAMIC_TIME_ZONE_INFORMATION *);
    ToLocal to_local = (ToLocal)GetProcAddress(GetModuleHandleA("kernel32.dll"), "SystemTimeToTzSpecificLocalTimeEx");
    EnumTz enum_tz = (EnumTz)GetProcAddress(LoadLibraryA("advapi32.dll"), "EnumDynamicTimeZoneInformation");
    static TzRule r;
    static WinZone z;
    static uint8_t cal[8], info[0x18];
    static int64_t posix;
    static char loc[0x24];
    int bad = 0, zones = 0, zones_now = 0, zones_other = 0;
    long long cases = 0, diff_now = 0, diff_other = 0, edge = 0;
    SYSTEMTIME st;
    GetSystemTime(&st);
    int this_year = st.wYear;
    int64_t y0 = days_from_civil(this_year, 1, 1) * 86400, y1 = days_from_civil(this_year + 1, 1, 1) * 86400;
    if (!to_local || !enum_tz) { printf("  time zone: Windows conversion functions not found\n"); return 1; }
    for (DWORD i = 0; ; i++) {
        DYNAMIC_TIME_ZONE_INFORMATION d;
        long long dn = 0, dother = 0;
        int64_t first_bad = 0;
        if (enum_tz(i, &d) != ERROR_SUCCESS) break;
        if (winzone_load(d.TimeZoneKeyName, &z)) { printf("  time zone: no registry data for %ls\n", d.TimeZoneKeyName); bad++; continue; }
        tzrule_build(&r, &z, NULL, 0, 0);
        zones++;
        for (int pass = 0; pass < 2; pass++) {
            int64_t from = pass ? days_from_civil(1990, 1, 1) * 86400 : y0, to = pass ? days_from_civil(2038, 1, 1) * 86400 : y1, step = pass ? 10740 : 1800;
            for (int64_t t = from; t < to; t += step) {
                TzTm u, l;
                SYSTEMTIME su, sl;
                tz_split(t, 0, &u);
                memset(&su, 0, sizeof su);
                su.wYear = (WORD)u.year; su.wMonth = (WORD)u.mon; su.wDay = (WORD)u.mday; su.wHour = (WORD)u.hour; su.wMinute = (WORD)u.min; su.wSecond = (WORD)u.sec;
                if (!to_local(&d, &su, &sl) || tz_local(&r, t, &l)) { bad++; break; }
                cases++;
                if (sl.wYear != l.year || sl.wMonth != l.mon || sl.wDay != l.mday || sl.wHour != l.hour || sl.wMinute != l.min || sl.wSecond != l.sec) {
                    int64_t into_year = t - days_from_civil(u.year, 1, 1) * 86400, to_next = days_from_civil(u.year + 1, 1, 1) * 86400 - t;
                    if (pass && (into_year < 86400 || to_next <= 86400)) { edge++; continue; }   /* within a day of 1 January: which year's entry Windows applies there */
                    if (pass) dother++; else dn++;
                    if (!first_bad) first_bad = t;
                }
            }
        }
        if (dn) zones_now++;
        if (dother) zones_other++;
        diff_now += dn; diff_other += dother;
        if ((dn || dother) && zones_now + zones_other <= 12) printf("  time zone: %ls: %lld differences in %d, %lld in 1990..2037 (first at posix %lld); %d transitions\n", d.TimeZoneKeyName, dn, this_year, dother, (long long)first_bad, r.timecnt);
    }
    printf("  time zone: %d Windows zones, %lld conversions compared with SystemTimeToTzSpecificLocalTimeEx: %lld different in %d (%d zones), %lld different in 1990..2037 (%d zones), plus %lld within one day of a 1 January where the registry entry changes (not failures: Windows picks the year's entry differently there, and the tz database has the real instants)\n",
           zones, cases, diff_now, this_year, zones_now, diff_other, zones_other, edge);
    bad += zones_now + zones_other;
    #define TCHECK(cond, text) do { if (!(cond)) { bad++; printf("  FAIL time zone: %s\n", text); } } while (0)
    /* the PC's own zone through the import handlers */
    const TzRule *mine = my_rule();
    long long own = 0, own_bad = 0;
    location_name(loc);
    if (getenv("SMO_TZ_DUMP")) {                                   /* the transitions as text, to compare with the tz database */
        FILE *f = fopen(getenv("SMO_TZ_DUMP"), "w");
        if (f) {
            fprintf(f, "%s default %d %d %s\n", loc, mine->ttis[mine->defaulttype].utoff, mine->ttis[mine->defaulttype].isdst, mine->chars + mine->ttis[mine->defaulttype].desigidx);
            for (int k = 0; k < mine->timecnt; k++) fprintf(f, "%lld %d %d %s\n", (long long)mine->ats[k], mine->ttis[mine->types[k]].utoff, mine->ttis[mine->types[k]].isdst, mine->chars + mine->ttis[mine->types[k]].desigidx);
            fclose(f);
        }
    }
    for (int64_t t = y0; t < y1; t += 1800) {
        struct tm lt;
        __time64_t tt = (__time64_t)t;
        posix = t;
        c->x[0] = GP(cal); c->x[1] = GP(info); c->x[2] = GP(&posix);
        time_ToCalendarTime(c);
        own++;
        if (c->x[0] || _localtime64_s(&lt, &tt) || rd16(GP(cal)) != lt.tm_year + 1900 || cal[2] != lt.tm_mon + 1 || cal[3] != lt.tm_mday || cal[4] != lt.tm_hour || cal[5] != lt.tm_min || cal[6] != lt.tm_sec
            || (int)rd32(GP(info)) != lt.tm_wday || (int)rd32(GP(info) + 4) != lt.tm_yday || info[16] != (lt.tm_isdst > 0)) own_bad++;
    }
    TCHECK(own_bad == 0, "ToCalendarTime of the PC's zone differs from the C runtime's localtime");
    posix = (int64_t)_time64(NULL);
    c->x[0] = GP(cal); c->x[1] = GP(info); c->x[2] = GP(&posix);
    time_ToCalendarTime(c);
    TCHECK(strcmp((char *)info + 8, "LOC") != 0 && info[8] != 0, "zone abbreviation");
    printf("  time zone: location %s, now %04d-%02d-%02d %02d:%02d:%02d %s (UTC%+d s, dst %d); rule: %d transitions, %d types, names", loc,
           rd16(GP(cal)), cal[2], cal[3], cal[4], cal[5], cal[6], (char *)info + 8, (int)rd32(GP(info) + 20), info[16], mine->timecnt, mine->typecnt);
    for (int p = 0; p < mine->charcnt; p += (int)strlen(mine->chars + p) + 1) printf(" %s", mine->chars + p);
    printf("; %lld half hours of %d equal to localtime\n", own, this_year);
    #undef TCHECK
    return bad;
}

```

`runtime/os/os_threads.c`:

```c
/* nn::os threading and synchronisation on top of Win32.
 *
 * Guest synchronisation objects (MutexType, EventType, ...) are opaque here:
 * each one is identified by its guest address and backed by a host object
 * kept in a side table, so the guest layout never has to be known. */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <malloc.h>
#include <windows.h>
#include "runtime.h"
#include "hostrt.h"

#define A0 (c->x[0])
#define A1 (c->x[1])
#define A2 (c->x[2])
#define A3 (c->x[3])
#define A4 (c->x[4])
#define RET(v) (c->x[0] = (uint64_t)(v))
#define TICK_HZ 19200000ULL

typedef struct Obj {
    uint64_t key;
    struct Obj *next;
    CRITICAL_SECTION cs;
    CONDITION_VARIABLE cv;
    int signaled, autoclear;                 /* events */
    uint64_t *buf, cap, len, head;           /* message queues */
    HANDLE thread;                           /* threads */
    uint64_t fn, arg, stack, stack_size, name;
    int priority, finished;
    int ideal_core, core_set;                /* threads: nn::os ideal core and affinity mask as the game set them */
    uint64_t core_mask;
    struct Obj *alias;                       /* system event attached by handle: the event object it shares */
    uint32_t rhandle, whandle;               /* kernel-style handles of a system event created here */
} Obj;

#define BUCKETS 65536
static Obj *g_table[BUCKETS];
static SRWLOCK g_table_lock = SRWLOCK_INIT;

static Obj *obj(uint64_t key) {
    unsigned h = (unsigned)((key >> 3) * 2654435761u) & (BUCKETS - 1);
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_table_lock);
    Obj *o = g_table[h];
    while (o && o->key != key) o = o->next;
    if (!o) {
        o = calloc(1, sizeof *o);
        o->key = key;
        InitializeCriticalSection(&o->cs);
        InitializeConditionVariable(&o->cv);
        o->next = g_table[h];
        g_table[h] = o;
    }
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_table_lock);
    return o->alias ? o->alias : o;            /* a system event attached by handle shares its event */
}
/* the object itself, without following an alias (its own clear mode) */
static Obj *obj_raw(uint64_t key) {
    Obj *o = obj(key);
    unsigned h = (unsigned)((key >> 3) * 2654435761u) & (BUCKETS - 1);
    AcquireSRWLockShared(&g_table_lock);
    Obj *r = g_table[h];
    while (r && r->key != key) r = r->next;
    ReleaseSRWLockShared(&g_table_lock);
    return r ? r : o;
}
/* Forget an object so a new one created at the same address starts clean. */
static void obj_reset(uint64_t key) {
    Obj *o = obj(key);
    EnterCriticalSection(&o->cs);
    o->signaled = o->autoclear = 0;
    o->len = o->head = 0;
    LeaveCriticalSection(&o->cs);
}

static DWORD ns_to_ms(int64_t ns) { return ns <= 0 ? 0 : (DWORD)((ns + 999999) / 1000000); }

/* nn::os::SleepThread takes nanoseconds and the console's timer is good to a few microseconds. Sleep() counts whole
 * milliseconds on a 1 ms (or 15.6 ms) grid, so the wait runs on a high-resolution waitable timer (100 ns units,
 * Windows 10 1803 and later); Sleep() is only the fallback. A zero or negative span yields, as on the console. */
static void sleep_ns(int64_t ns) {
    static __declspec(thread) HANDLE timer;
    static __declspec(thread) int no_timer;
    LARGE_INTEGER due;
    if (ns <= 0) { SwitchToThread(); return; }
    if (!timer && !no_timer) {
        timer = CreateWaitableTimerExW(NULL, NULL, 0x00000002 /* CREATE_WAITABLE_TIMER_HIGH_RESOLUTION */, TIMER_ALL_ACCESS);
        if (!timer) no_timer = 1;
    }
    due.QuadPart = -((ns + 99) / 100);
    /* SMO_SLEEP_LOG=1: a line for every sleep that lasted 2 ms longer than asked (first 200). */
    static int lg = -1; static LONG nl;
    if (lg < 0) lg = getenv("SMO_SLEEP_LOG") && atoi(getenv("SMO_SLEEP_LOG"));
    LARGE_INTEGER q0, q1, fq;
    if (lg) QueryPerformanceCounter(&q0);
    if (!timer || !SetWaitableTimer(timer, &due, 0, NULL, NULL, FALSE)) Sleep(ns_to_ms(ns));
    else WaitForSingleObject(timer, INFINITE);
    if (lg) {
        extern long long nvn_front_frame_next(void);
        QueryPerformanceCounter(&q1); QueryPerformanceFrequency(&fq);
        double ms = (double)(q1.QuadPart - q0.QuadPart) * 1000.0 / (double)fq.QuadPart, asked = (double)ns / 1e6;
        {   /* per thread and frame: how many sleeps, asked and slept in all; a line when a frame after 1900 had over 8 ms of them */
            static __declspec(thread) long long fr0, cnt; static __declspec(thread) double a_sum, s_sum, a_max; static LONG nf;
            long long fr = nvn_front_frame_next();
            if (fr != fr0) {
                if (fr0 > 1900 && s_sum > 8.0 && InterlockedIncrement(&nf) <= 300) printf("sleep_log: frame %lld, thread %lu: %lld sleeps in the frame, asked %.3f ms in all (longest asked %.3f), slept %.3f ms\n", fr0, GetCurrentThreadId(), cnt, a_sum, a_max, s_sum);
                fr0 = fr; cnt = 0; a_sum = s_sum = a_max = 0;
            }
            cnt++; a_sum += asked; s_sum += ms; if (asked > a_max) a_max = asked;
        }
        if (ms > asked + 2.0 && InterlockedIncrement(&nl) <= 600) { printf("sleep_log: frame %lld, thread %lu: asked %.3f ms, slept %.3f ms (%s)\n", nvn_front_frame_next(), GetCurrentThreadId(), asked, ms, timer ? "high-resolution timer" : "Sleep"); fflush(stdout); }
    }
}

/* nn::os thread priorities run from 0 (highest) to 31 (lowest), 16 is the default; the application's main thread
 * starts at the priority of its NPDM (44 - 28 = 16 in nn::os terms). Windows has seven levels per process class:
 * the order is kept, the spacing is not. */
#define OS_DEFAULT_PRIORITY 16
#define OS_DEFAULT_CORE 0                    /* main.npdm: default core id 0 */
/* Console scheduling model (on by default; SMO_OS_CONSOLE_CORES=0 turns it off). The game creates its threads on one
 * core of the console's three (mask 1, 2 or 4) or on all three (os_thread_report lists them at the end of every run),
 * and the console runs on each core only the highest-priority ready thread of that core. With the model:
 *   - three host processors stand for the console's cores 0..2 and every guest thread's affinity is its nn::os core mask
 *     mapped onto them (set at StartThread and at every SetThreadCoreMask), so two threads the console keeps on one core
 *     never run at the same time here either;
 *   - six priority levels (<= 4, 5..8, 9..15, 16, 17, 18..31), Windows' dynamic priority boost off: the game
 *     uses 0, 7, 8, 15, 16, 17, 18, 19, 20 and
 *     22; what must stay apart is 17 against 18 on core 2: the model draw buffer update (描画バッファ更新, 17) that every
 *     scene starts at the end of a frame and waits for at the start of the next, and the archive decompression
 *     (DecompThread, 18) busy while a stage loads. At one level the update waited behind the decompression for a whole
 *     time slice, long enough for the scene being left to be deleted under it (HakoniwaStateDeleteScene runs a frame or
 *     two after the scene's last frame): "pure virtual function called" in the update's list of actors on entering a
 *     stage from the title menu, 2 times in 91 runs of the stage stress test (tests/stress_stages.py, two games on the
 *     same three processors); with 18..31 a level lower, 0 times in 276 runs of it. 17 is the last level above
 *     Windows' lowest;
 *   - GetCurrentCoreNumber / GetCurrentProcessorNumber answer the core the thread is really on.
 * NOT the console's scheduler all the same: Windows time-slices equal priorities, other processes of the PC take the
 * three processors too, and host-side threads (graphics driver, audio device, movie decoding) are not part of it.
 * ON BY DEFAULT (SMO_OS_CONSOLE_CORES=0 turns it off). Measured on 20 s boots, 6 runs each: with free
 * scheduling 4 of 6 runs failed in sead heap code on the loading path (sead::ExpHeap::tryAlloc failing inside
 * ParallelSZSDecompressor, or a sead::Heap destructor reading address -1); with the console core model 0 of 6 failed.
 * SMO depends on its threads being scheduled the console's way, so that is the default.
 * The three processors are taken from the top of a slot of six (three cores with their second hardware threads): every
 * game running at once on the PC takes the first slot no other game holds (a named mutex per slot, held while the
 * process lives), so games side by side (tests, or a test beside the copy being played) do not share processors. One
 * game alone takes slot 0, the top of the affinity mask: the processors it always had. Before the slots, four test
 * games at once all ran their console cores on the same three processors. SMO_OS_HOST_CPUS=<hexadecimal mask> chooses
 * from those processors instead (and takes no slot). */
static int g_cc = -1;
static DWORD_PTR g_cc_core[3];
static DWORD_PTR core_slot(DWORD_PTR proc) {           /* the first free slot of six processors from the top of proc */
    int bits[64], nb = 0;
    for (int b = (int)(sizeof(DWORD_PTR) * 8) - 1; b >= 0; b--) if (proc >> b & 1) bits[nb++] = b;
    for (int k = 0; k < nb / 6; k++) {
        char name[64];
        snprintf(name, sizeof name, "Local\\smo_console_cores_%d", k);
        HANDLE m = CreateMutexA(NULL, FALSE, name);     /* kept open: the slot is this process's until it ends */
        if (!m) break;
        if (GetLastError() == ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS) { CloseHandle(m); continue; }
        DWORD_PTR mask = 0;
        for (int i = 6 * k; i < 6 * k + 6; i++) mask |= (DWORD_PTR)1 << bits[i];
        printf("nn::os: console cores in processor slot %d of %d (mask %llx; other games running at once take other slots)\n", k, nb / 6, (unsigned long long)mask);
        return mask;
    }
    printf("nn::os: every processor slot is held by other games: sharing the top of the mask\n");
    return proc;
}
static int console_cores(void) {
    if (g_cc < 0) {
        int n = 0, on = 0;
        const char *cc = getenv("SMO_OS_CONSOLE_CORES"), *cpus = getenv("SMO_OS_HOST_CPUS");
        if (!cc || atoi(cc) != 0) {
            DWORD_PTR proc = 0, sys = 0;
            GetProcessAffinityMask(GetCurrentProcess(), &proc, &sys);
            if (cpus && cpus[0]) {
                DWORD_PTR want = (DWORD_PTR)_strtoui64(cpus, NULL, 16);
                printf("nn::os: SMO_OS_HOST_CPUS=%s: the console's cores on these processors only (%llx of %llx)\n", cpus, (unsigned long long)(want & proc), (unsigned long long)proc);
                if (want & proc) proc &= want;
            } else proc = core_slot(proc);
            for (int b = (int)(sizeof(DWORD_PTR) * 8) - 1; b >= 0 && n < 3; b--)      /* from the top, every second processor: not two hardware threads of one core */
                if (proc >> b & 1) { g_cc_core[n++] = (DWORD_PTR)1 << b; b--; }
            on = n == 3;
            printf("nn::os: console core model %s (SMO_OS_CONSOLE_CORES): host processor masks %llx %llx %llx for cores 0 1 2\n", on ? "ON" : "NOT possible (fewer than 3 usable processors)",
                   (unsigned long long)g_cc_core[0], (unsigned long long)g_cc_core[1], (unsigned long long)g_cc_core[2]);
        }
        g_cc = on;
    }
    return g_cc;
}
static void apply_sched(HANDLE h, uint64_t core_mask) {
    DWORD_PTR m = 0;
    if (!console_cores() || !h) return;
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) if (core_mask >> i & 1) m |= g_cc_core[i];
    SetThreadAffinityMask(h, m ? m : g_cc_core[0]);
    SetThreadPriorityBoost(h, TRUE);
}
static int host_priority(int prio) {
    static int split = -1;                                     /* TEST ONLY, SMO_OS_PRIO17=0: 17 shares its level with 18..27 again */
    if (split < 0) { const char *e = getenv("SMO_OS_PRIO17"); split = !e || atoi(e) != 0; }
    if (console_cores()) {
        if (prio <= 4) return THREAD_PRIORITY_TIME_CRITICAL;
        if (prio <= 8) return THREAD_PRIORITY_HIGHEST;
        if (prio >= 18 && (split || prio >= 28)) return THREAD_PRIORITY_LOWEST;     /* below the draw buffer update (17), see above */
    }
    if (prio <= 4) return THREAD_PRIORITY_HIGHEST;
    if (prio <= 15) return THREAD_PRIORITY_ABOVE_NORMAL;
    if (prio == 16) return THREAD_PRIORITY_NORMAL;
    if (prio <= 27) return THREAD_PRIORITY_BELOW_NORMAL;
    return THREAD_PRIORITY_LOWEST;
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- threads */
static __declspec(thread) uint64_t t_thread;          /* guest ThreadType* of the running thread */
static __declspec(thread) uint64_t t_tls[64];
static uint64_t g_tls_dtor[64];                       /* guest destructor of each slot, 0 = none */
static volatile LONG g_tls_used[64];
static void tls_run_destructors(Ctx *c);
static uint8_t g_main_thread[0x400];
uint64_t os_main_thread_type(void) { return (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)g_main_thread; }   /* boot.c: stored at thread block +0x1f8, as [sdk 0x3349dc] does */
uint64_t g_main_stack_base, g_main_stack_size;        /* set by boot.c */
static volatile LONG g_thread_count;

static Ctx *new_ctx(uint64_t stack_top) {
    Ctx *c = _aligned_malloc(sizeof *c, 16);
    memset(c, 0, sizeof *c);
    c->x[31] = stack_top & ~15ull;
    c->tpidr = (uint64_t)VirtualAlloc(NULL, 0x10000, MEM_RESERVE | MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE);
    return c;
}

/* Every guest thread's context, so a report can say where each one is. */
static struct { Obj *o; Ctx *c; } g_threads[256];
static volatile LONG g_threads_n;

void dump_guest_threads(FILE *out) {
    fprintf(out, "\nguest threads (last function entered, link register):\n");
    for (int i = 0; i < g_threads_n && i < 256; i++) {
        Obj *o = g_threads[i].o;
        Ctx *c = g_threads[i].c;
        fprintf(out, "  %-20s %s  f_%llx  lr=%llx  %s%s (from %llx)\n", o->name ? (const char *)(uintptr_t)o->name : "?",
                o->finished ? "finished" : "running ", (unsigned long long)c->fn, (unsigned long long)c->x[30],
                c->in_import ? "in " : "", c->in_import ? c->in_import : "guest code", (unsigned long long)c->import_from);
    }
}

/* hitch.c (SMO_HITCH): guest thread i -> context, name, host handle; 0 past the end. */
int guest_thread_info(int i, Ctx **c, const char **name, HANDLE *h) {
    if (i < 0 || i >= g_threads_n || i >= 256 || !g_threads[i].o || !g_threads[i].c) return 0;
    *c = g_threads[i].c; *name = g_threads[i].o->name ? (const char *)(uintptr_t)g_threads[i].o->name : NULL; *h = g_threads[i].o->finished ? NULL : g_threads[i].o->thread;
    return 1;
}
/* Name of the guest thread running on host thread `tid`, or NULL (nvn_gl.c: CPU time per thread). */
const char *guest_thread_name_of(DWORD tid) {
    for (int i = 0; i < g_threads_n && i < 256; i++) {
        Obj *o = g_threads[i].o;
        if (o && o->thread && GetThreadId(o->thread) == tid) return o->name ? (const char *)(uintptr_t)o->name : "?";
    }
    return NULL;
}

static DWORD WINAPI thread_main(LPVOID arg) {
    Obj *o = arg;
    t_thread = o->key;
    Ctx *c = new_ctx(o->stack + o->stack_size);
    wr64(c->tpidr + 0x1f8, o->key);                   /* Horizon thread-local region: the ThreadType pointer lives at +0x1f8 */
    LONG slot = InterlockedIncrement(&g_threads_n) - 1;
    if (slot < 256) { g_threads[slot].o = o; g_threads[slot].c = c; }
    c->x[0] = o->arg;
    trace_printf("--- thread %llx started (entry %llx, name %s)\n", (unsigned long long)o->key, (unsigned long long)o->fn,
                 o->name ? (const char *)(uintptr_t)o->name : "?");
    call_guest(c, o->fn);
    tls_run_destructors(c);
    trace_printf("--- thread %llx finished\n", (unsigned long long)o->key);
    EnterCriticalSection(&o->cs);
    o->finished = 1;
    WakeAllConditionVariable(&o->cv);
    LeaveCriticalSection(&o->cs);
    return 0;
}

/* the fields of nn::os::ThreadType (SDK 3.5.1) that the game reads itself. [sdk 0x8a680]
 * detail::ThreadManager::CreateThread(this, ThreadType *t, fn, arg, stack, size, priority, core) stores priority at +0x44,
 * the stack at +0x48, the stack the thread RUNS on at +0x50 (a mapped alias of +0x48 made by CreateAliasStackUnsafe; here
 * the thread runs on the stack it was given, so the same address), the size at +0x58, arg at +0x60 and fn at +0x68.
 * sead::MemUtil::isStack (main 0xb5dad0) compares a pointer with [+0x50, +0x50 + size) of every sead thread:
 * al::createStringIfInStack (main 0x815f84) copies a string to the heap only when that says "on a stack" (the opening
 * demo's DemoActionList::initSerial keeps its action names this way). */
static void thread_type_fill(uint64_t t, uint64_t fn, uint64_t arg, uint64_t stack, uint64_t size, int priority) {
    if (!t) return;
    wr32(t + 0x44, (uint32_t)priority);
    wr64(t + 0x48, stack); wr64(t + 0x50, stack); wr64(t + 0x58, size);
    wr64(t + 0x60, arg); wr64(t + 0x68, fn);
}
static void os_CreateThread(Ctx *c) {                 /* (ThreadType*, fn, arg, stack, stackSize, priority[, core]) */
    thread_type_fill(A0, A1, A2, A3, A4, (int)c->x[5]);
    Obj *o = obj(A0);
    o->fn = A1; o->arg = A2; o->stack = A3; o->stack_size = A4; o->priority = (int)c->x[5];
    o->finished = 0; o->thread = NULL; o->name = 0;
    o->ideal_core = OS_DEFAULT_CORE; o->core_mask = 1ull << OS_DEFAULT_CORE; o->core_set = 1;
    RET(0);
}
static void os_CreateThreadOnCore(Ctx *c) {           /* (ThreadType*, fn, arg, stack, stackSize, priority, idealCore) */
    uint64_t t = A0;
    int core = (int)c->x[6];
    os_CreateThread(c);
    if (core >= 0 && core < 64) { Obj *o = obj(t); o->ideal_core = core; o->core_mask = 1ull << core; }
}
/* The thread log: every thread the game
 * starts, with the nn::os arguments it was given, and every later change of priority or core mask. Printed at the end
 * of a run by os_thread_report (hostrt.c report_and_exit). */
static char g_oslog[24000];
static volatile LONG g_oslog_n, g_oslog_lock;
static void oslog(const char *fmt, ...) {
    char line[320];
    va_list ap;
    va_start(ap, fmt);
    int n = vsnprintf(line, sizeof line, fmt, ap);
    va_end(ap);
    if (n <= 0) return;
    if (n >= (int)sizeof line) n = (int)sizeof line - 1;
    while (InterlockedCompareExchange(&g_oslog_lock, 1, 0)) YieldProcessor();
    if (g_oslog_n + n < (LONG)sizeof g_oslog - 1) { memcpy(g_oslog + g_oslog_n, line, (size_t)n); g_oslog_n += n; }
    g_oslog_lock = 0;
}
void os_thread_report(FILE *out) {
    if (!g_oslog_n) return;
    fprintf(out, "nn::os threads of this run (priority 0 highest .. 31 lowest; cores 0..2 exist on the console):\n%.*s", (int)g_oslog_n, g_oslog);
}
static void os_StartThread(Ctx *c) {
    Obj *o = obj(A0);
    oslog("  start  %-28s entry %llx priority %2d ideal core %d mask %llx stack 0x%llx (called from %llx)\n", o->name ? (const char *)(uintptr_t)o->name : "?",
          (unsigned long long)o->fn, o->priority, o->ideal_core, (unsigned long long)o->core_mask, (unsigned long long)o->stack_size, (unsigned long long)c->x[30]);
    InterlockedIncrement(&g_thread_count);
    o->thread = CreateThread(NULL, (SIZE_T)256 << 20, thread_main, o, STACK_SIZE_PARAM_IS_A_RESERVATION | CREATE_SUSPENDED, NULL);
    if (o->thread) { SetThreadPriority(o->thread, host_priority(o->priority)); apply_sched(o->thread, o->core_mask); ResumeThread(o->thread); }
}
/* The process runs in the ABOVE_NORMAL priority class (SMO_PRIORITY_CLASS=normal: the NORMAL class, as before). With the
 * console core model every guest thread may run on one host processor only, and the game's helpers at nn::os priority
 * 17..27 (view update, clipping, draw buffer update: the main thread waits for them every frame) are BELOW_NORMAL
 * threads: in the NORMAL class any normal thread of another program on one of those three processors comes first. One
 * class up every level of the mapping is two higher (the six levels stay apart: 8 9 10 11 12 15), above the normal
 * threads of other programs (8); HIGH would put HIGHEST and TIME_CRITICAL together. Measured at Cascade Kingdom's first
 * checkpoint: with up to 8 busy programs (11 of 32 processors busy) Windows keeps them off those three processors and
 * the class changes nothing; with every processor busy (30 busy programs) the game in the NORMAL class got 44% of one
 * processor and had not reached play after 120 s, in ABOVE_NORMAL it played at 38-39 fps. */
static void process_priority(void) {
    const char *e = getenv("SMO_PRIORITY_CLASS");
    if (e && !_stricmp(e, "normal")) { printf("nn::os: process priority class NORMAL (SMO_PRIORITY_CLASS=normal)\n"); return; }
    BOOL ok = SetPriorityClass(GetCurrentProcess(), ABOVE_NORMAL_PRIORITY_CLASS);
    printf("nn::os: process priority class ABOVE_NORMAL%s (SMO_PRIORITY_CLASS=normal for the NORMAL class)\n", ok ? "" : ": REFUSED");
}
/* boot.c, on the main guest thread before the game starts: main.npdm gives it core 0 and priority 44 - 28 = 16 */
void os_apply_main_sched(void) {
    process_priority();
    if (!console_cores()) return;
    apply_sched(GetCurrentThread(), 1ull << OS_DEFAULT_CORE);
    SetThreadPriority(GetCurrentThread(), host_priority(OS_DEFAULT_PRIORITY));
}
static void os_WaitThread(Ctx *c) { Obj *o = obj(A0); if (o->thread) WaitForSingleObject(o->thread, INFINITE); }
static void os_DestroyThread(Ctx *c) { Obj *o = obj(A0); if (o->thread) { CloseHandle(o->thread); o->thread = NULL; } }
static void os_SetThreadName(Ctx *c) {               /* the guest string may be a temporary: keep a copy */
    char *copy = _strdup((const char *)(uintptr_t)A1);
    obj(A0)->name = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)copy;
}
static void os_GetCurrentThread(Ctx *c) {
    if (!t_thread && !rd64((uint64_t)(uintptr_t)g_main_thread + 0x50) && g_main_stack_base)      /* the main thread's ThreadType, once its stack is known (boot.c) */
        thread_type_fill((uint64_t)(uintptr_t)g_main_thread, 0, 0, g_main_stack_base, g_main_stack_size, OS_DEFAULT_PRIORITY);
    RET(t_thread ? t_thread : (uint64_t)g_main_thread);
}
static Obj *thread_obj(uint64_t key);
static void os_GetThreadPriority(Ctx *c) { RET((int64_t)thread_obj(A0 == (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)g_main_thread ? 0 : A0)->priority); }
static void os_ChangeThreadPriority(Ctx *c) {
    Obj *o = obj(A0);
    int old = o->priority;
    oslog("  change priority of %s: %d -> %d (called from %llx)\n", A0 == (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)g_main_thread ? "the main thread" : o->name ? (const char *)(uintptr_t)o->name : "?", old, (int)A1, (unsigned long long)c->x[30]);
    o->priority = (int)A1;
    if (o->thread) SetThreadPriority(o->thread, host_priority(o->priority));
    else if (A0 == (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)g_main_thread || A0 == t_thread) SetThreadPriority(GetCurrentThread(), host_priority(o->priority));
    RET((int64_t)old);

/* Core numbers and affinity masks. The console runs the application on cores 0..2 (GetThreadAvailableCoreMask = 7);
 * a thread is created on one core (the NPDM default core 0, or the one given to CreateThread) and stays there until
 * SetThreadCoreMask widens its mask. The values are kept per thread and returned as set; the Windows scheduler is
 * not told to pin anything (a PC has more than three cores and the game's threads would pile up on host CPU 0). */
static Obj *thread_obj(uint64_t key) {
    Obj *o = obj(key ? key : (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)g_main_thread);
    if (!o->core_set) { o->core_set = 1; o->ideal_core = OS_DEFAULT_CORE; o->core_mask = 1ull << OS_DEFAULT_CORE; if (!o->priority) o->priority = OS_DEFAULT_PRIORITY; }
    return o;
}
static void os_SetThreadCoreMask(Ctx *c) {            /* (ThreadType*, int idealCore, Bit64 affinityMask) */
    Obj *o = thread_obj(A0);
    int ideal = (int)A1;
    uint64_t mask = A2;
    oslog("  core mask of %s: ideal %d mask %llx (was ideal %d mask %llx; %s; called from %llx)\n", A0 == (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)g_main_thread || !A0 ? "the main thread" : o->name ? (const char *)(uintptr_t)o->name : "?",
          ideal, (unsigned long long)mask, o->ideal_core, (unsigned long long)o->core_mask, o->thread ? "running" : "not started", (unsigned long long)c->x[30]);
    int is_self = t_thread ? A0 == t_thread : (!A0 || A0 == (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)g_main_thread);      /* the calling thread names itself */
    HANDLE h = o->thread ? o->thread : is_self ? GetCurrentThread() : NULL;                             /* NULL: not started yet (applied at StartThread) */
    if (ideal == -2) { o->ideal_core = OS_DEFAULT_CORE; o->core_mask = 1ull << OS_DEFAULT_CORE; apply_sched(h, o->core_mask); return; }   /* IdealCoreUseDefaultValue: mask is ignored */
    if (ideal == -3) { o->core_mask = mask; apply_sched(h, o->core_mask); return; }                           /* IdealCoreNoUpdate */
    o->core_mask = mask;
    if (ideal == -1) { if (!(mask >> (o->ideal_core & 63) & 1)) o->ideal_core = mask ? (int)__builtin_ctzll(mask) : OS_DEFAULT_CORE; }   /* IdealCoreDontCare */
    else o->ideal_core = ideal;
    apply_sched(h, o->core_mask);
}
static void os_GetThreadCoreMask(Ctx *c) {            /* (int *outIdealCore, Bit64 *outMask, const ThreadType*) */

    if (A1) wr64(A1, o->core_mask);
}

/* ---- system events shared through kernel handles.
 * [doc] A SystemEvent is a kernel event: CreateSystemEvent makes it with a readable and a writable handle; another
 * SystemEventType (in this or another process) can be attached to those handles, and a signal through one is seen by
 * every waiter on the event. SMO's audio server (lifted SDK code) creates the renderer's event and the client attaches
 * the game's SystemEvent to its readable handle. Model: handles name host event objects (g_handles); an attached
 * SystemEventType resolves to the event it shares (Obj.alias, followed by obj()). Each SystemEventType keeps ITS OWN
 * clear mode for its waits (AutoClear = a successful wait clears the shared event), as on the console. */
#define MAX_HANDLES 1024
static Obj *g_handles[MAX_HANDLES];
static LONG g_handle_next = 1;
static uint32_t handle_new(Obj *o) {
    LONG i = InterlockedIncrement(&g_handle_next) - 1;
    if (i >= MAX_HANDLES) guest_trap("os: too many system event handles (os_threads.c MAX_HANDLES)", 0);
    g_handles[i] = o;
    return 0x50000u + (uint32_t)i;
}
static Obj *handle_obj(uint32_t h) { uint32_t i = h - 0x50000u; return i < MAX_HANDLES ? g_handles[i] : NULL; }
static int sev_wait(uint64_t key, DWORD ms) {
    Obj *raw = obj_raw(key), *o = obj(key);
    int ok = 1;
    EnterCriticalSection(&o->cs);
    while (!o->signaled) {
        if (!SleepConditionVariableCS(&o->cv, &o->cs, ms)) { ok = o->signaled; break; }
    }
    if (ok && raw->autoclear) o->signaled = 0;
    LeaveCriticalSection(&o->cs);
    return ok;
}
static void sev_create(Ctx *c) {               /* (SystemEventType*, EventClearMode, bool interprocess) -> Result */
    Obj *raw = obj_raw(A0);
    raw->alias = NULL;
    obj_reset(A0);
    raw->autoclear = A1 == 1;
    raw->rhandle = handle_new(raw);
    raw->whandle = handle_new(raw);
    RET(0);
}
static void sev_attach_readable(Ctx *c) {      /* (SystemEventType*, Handle, bool managed, EventClearMode) */
    Obj *raw = obj_raw(A0), *t = handle_obj((uint32_t)A1);
    if (!t) guest_trap("os: AttachReadableHandleToSystemEvent with a handle no event of this process has", c->x[30] - 4);
    raw->alias = t == raw ? NULL : t;
    raw->autoclear = A3 == 1;
}
/* Host side: a new system event with a handle (as a system module would create one and pass its readable handle);
 * returns the handle, *key receives a host key to signal it with os_signal_event. */
uint32_t os_system_event_new(int autoclear, uint64_t *key) {
    uint64_t k = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)calloc(1, 64);            /* a unique key no guest object has */
    obj_reset(k);
    Obj *o = obj_raw(k);
    o->autoclear = autoclear;
    o->rhandle = handle_new(o);
    o->whandle = handle_new(o);
    if (key) *key = k;
    return o->rhandle;
}
static void sev_get_readable(Ctx *c) { Obj *o = obj(A0); if (!o->rhandle) o->rhandle = handle_new(o); RET(o->rhandle); }

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- message queues (of 64-bit values) */
static void mq_init(Ctx *c) {                         /* (queue, buffer, count): host-side storage is used */
    obj_reset(A0);
    Obj *o = obj(A0);
    free(o->buf);
    o->cap = A2 ? A2 : 1;
    o->buf = calloc((size_t)o->cap, 8);
}
static int mq_put(Obj *o, uint64_t v, int front, DWORD ms) {
    int ok = 1;
    EnterCriticalSection(&o->cs);
    while (o->len == o->cap) {
        if (!SleepConditionVariableCS(&o->cv, &o->cs, ms)) { ok = o->len < o->cap; break; }
    }
    if (ok) {
        if (front) { o->head = (o->head + o->cap - 1) % o->cap; o->buf[o->head] = v; }
        else o->buf[(o->head + o->len) % o->cap] = v;
        o->len++;
        WakeAllConditionVariable(&o->cv);
    }
    LeaveCriticalSection(&o->cs);
    return ok;
}
static int mq_get(Obj *o, uint64_t out, DWORD ms) {
    int ok = 1;
    EnterCriticalSection(&o->cs);
    while (o->len == 0) {
        if (!SleepConditionVariableCS(&o->cv, &o->cs, ms)) { ok = o->len > 0; break; }
    }
    if (ok) {
        wr64(out, o->buf[o->head]);
        o->head = (o->head + 1) % o->cap;
        o->len--;
        WakeAllConditionVariable(&o->cv);
    }
    LeaveCriticalSection(&o->cs);
    return ok;
}

/* The console fills the buffer from a generator seeded with kernel entropy: unpredictable bytes. Same here, from the
 * system generator (RtlGenRandom). */
BOOLEAN NTAPI SystemFunction036(PVOID buffer, ULONG length);
/* Test switch SMO_FIXED_SEED=<n>: the bytes come from a splitmix64 stream seeded with n instead, so
 * that a scripted run sees the same random choices in every run. Each call is logged (first 16). */
int host_fixed_random(void *buffer, uint64_t size, const char *who, uint64_t lr) {
    static int mode = -1;
    static volatile LONG lock, calls;
    static uint64_t state;
    if (mode < 0) { const char *e = getenv("SMO_FIXED_SEED"); if (e && *e) { state = strtoull(e, NULL, 0) * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull + 1; mode = 1; } else mode = 0; }
    if (!mode) return 0;
    while (InterlockedExchange(&lock, 1)) YieldProcessor();
    for (uint64_t i = 0; i < size; i += 8) {
        uint64_t z = (state += 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull);
        z = (z ^ (z >> 30)) * 0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9ull; z = (z ^ (z >> 27)) * 0x94D049BB133111EBull; z ^= z >> 31;
        memcpy((uint8_t *)buffer + i, &z, size - i < 8 ? (size_t)(size - i) : 8);
    }
    LONG n = ++calls;
    InterlockedExchange(&lock, 0);
    if (n <= 16) printf("fixed seed: %s call %ld, %llu bytes, caller %llx\n", who, n, (unsigned long long)size, (unsigned long long)lr);
    return 1;
}
static void os_GenerateRandomBytes(Ctx *c) {
    uint8_t *p = (uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)A0;
    if (host_fixed_random(p, A1, "nn::os::GenerateRandomBytes", c->x[30] - 4)) return;
    for (uint64_t done = 0; done < A1;) {
        ULONG n = A1 - done > 0x10000000 ? 0x10000000 : (ULONG)(A1 - done);
        if (!SystemFunction036(p + done, n)) guest_trap("nn::os::GenerateRandomBytes: the system random generator failed", c->x[30] - 4);
        done += n;
    }
}
```
