```c
/* smo_nn.c - SDK functions of the game's imports that no other table handles.
 *
 * Each handler states its source. Tags: [doc] public SDK documentation / switchbrew; [game] read in SMO's main;
 * [sdk] read in the base game's sdk module (NintendoSDK 3.5.1); [sdk 7.3.2] in the game's. Registered by boot.c after every other table (register_smo_imports): these
 * names have no other handler, so nothing is replaced.
 *
 * ---- nn::os memory heap (sead's heaps sit on it)
 *   SetMemoryHeapSize(size)            [doc] size is a multiple of MemoryHeapUnitSize (2 MB); the heap is one range
 *                                      whose base does not move when it is resized. Result 0 on success.
 *   AllocateMemoryBlock(&addr, size)   [doc] size is a multiple of MemoryBlockUnitSize (2 MB); the block comes out of
 *                                      the heap set above. Failure: 0x1003 = os OutOfMemory (the value of the
 *                                      SDK's own allocator for the same failure, nnservices.c).
 *   FreeMemoryBlock(addr, size)        [doc] gives the block back to the heap.
 * Host: one region of HEAP_RESERVE bytes is RESERVED once; SetMemoryHeapSize commits [0, size). Blocks are handed out
 * first-fit on 2 MB granules from a bitmap. Fresh pages are zero (as the kernel's heap pages are when first mapped).
 * The region is a VIEW OF A PAGEFILE-BACKED SECTION (SEC_RESERVE), not plain VirtualAlloc memory, so that the same
 * physical pages can be shown at a second address: NVN virtual memory pools (nvnMemoryPoolMapVirtual, nvn_stub.c) map
 * views of it, the way the console's GPU address space maps physical pool pages. smo_heap_section_offset() tells
 * whether an address lies in the heap and where.
 *
 * ---- nn::oe
 *   EnableGamePlayRecording(buffer, size)   [doc] lets the system record gameplay video into the buffer the game gives.
 *                                      The runtime has no video capture: the call does nothing. It is a DO-NOTHING
 *                                      handler on purpose and stays listed as such by the strict audit. */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <windows.h>
#include "hostrt.h"
#include "sdklift.h"

#define UNIT 0x200000ull                       /* MemoryHeapUnitSize = MemoryBlockUnitSize */
#define HEAP_RESERVE (16ull << 30)             /* address space reserved for the heap: more than the console has */
#define RESULT_OUT_OF_MEMORY 0x1003u

static SRWLOCK g_heap_lock = SRWLOCK_INIT;
static HANDLE g_heap_section;                  /* pagefile-backed section the heap is a view of */
static uint8_t *g_heap;                        /* base, fixed once reserved */
static uint64_t g_heap_size;                   /* committed size (the heap size the game set) */
static uint8_t g_used[HEAP_RESERVE / UNIT];    /* 1 = granule belongs to an allocated block */
static unsigned long long g_alloc_calls, g_alloc_fail, g_peak;

int smo_heap_section_handle(HANDLE *h) { *h = g_heap_section; return g_heap_section != NULL; }

/* The heap's section and the offset of [addr, addr+size) in it; 0 if the range is not inside the committed heap. */
int smo_heap_section_offset(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size, HANDLE *section, uint64_t *offset) {
    uint64_t base = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)g_heap;
    if (!g_heap || addr < base || addr + size > base + g_heap_size || addr + size < addr) return 0;
    *section = g_heap_section;
    *offset = addr - base;
    return 1;
}

static void os_SetMemoryHeapSize(Ctx *c) {
    uint64_t size = c->x[0];
    uint32_t r = 0;
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_heap_lock);
    if (size % UNIT || size > HEAP_RESERVE) r = RESULT_OUT_OF_MEMORY;
    else {
        if (!g_heap) {
            g_heap_section = CreateFileMappingA(INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE, NULL, PAGE_READWRITE | SEC_RESERVE,
                                                (DWORD)(HEAP_RESERVE >> 32), (DWORD)HEAP_RESERVE, NULL);
            if (g_heap_section) g_heap = MapViewOfFile(g_heap_section, FILE_MAP_ALL_ACCESS, 0, 0, (SIZE_T)HEAP_RESERVE);
            if (!g_heap) printf("nn::os::SetMemoryHeapSize: cannot create the heap section (error %lu)\n", GetLastError());
        }
        if (!g_heap) r = RESULT_OUT_OF_MEMORY;
        else if (size > g_heap_size) {
            if (!VirtualAlloc(g_heap + g_heap_size, size - g_heap_size, MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE)) r = RESULT_OUT_OF_MEMORY;
        } else if (size < g_heap_size) {
            for (uint64_t g = size / UNIT; g < g_heap_size / UNIT; g++) if (g_used[g]) r = RESULT_OUT_OF_MEMORY;   /* blocks still live above */
            /* pages of a section view cannot be decommitted (VirtualFree MEM_DECOMMIT fails on mapped views): they stay
             * committed; the heap's size shrinks as on the console, only host memory is not given back */
        }
        if (!r) g_heap_size = size;
    }
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_heap_lock);
    if (!r && g_heap) { void smo_watch_arm(uint8_t *heap, uint64_t heap_size); smo_watch_arm(g_heap, g_heap_size); }      /* hostrt.c, debug aid SMO_WATCH */
    printf("nn::os::SetMemoryHeapSize(0x%llx): %s, heap at %p\n", (unsigned long long)size, r ? "FAILED" : "ok", (void *)g_heap);
    c->x[0] = r;
}

static void os_AllocateMemoryBlock(Ctx *c) {
    uint64_t out = c->x[0], size = c->x[1];
    uint64_t n = (size + UNIT - 1) / UNIT, total = g_heap_size / UNIT, run = 0, at = 0;
    int found = 0;
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_heap_lock);
    g_alloc_calls++;
    if (size && size % UNIT == 0)
        for (uint64_t g = 0; g < total; g++) {
            run = g_used[g] ? 0 : run + 1;
            if (run == n) { at = g + 1 - n; found = 1; break; }
        }
    if (found) {
        memset(g_used + at, 1, (size_t)n);
        uint64_t top = (at + n) * UNIT;
        if (top > g_peak) g_peak = top;
    } else g_alloc_fail++;
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_heap_lock);
    if (found) { wr64(out, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(g_heap + at * UNIT)); c->x[0] = 0; }
    else {
        printf("nn::os::AllocateMemoryBlock(0x%llx): out of memory (heap 0x%llx)\n", (unsigned long long)size, (unsigned long long)g_heap_size);
        c->x[0] = RESULT_OUT_OF_MEMORY;
    }
}

/* ---- nn::diag / nn::os: debugger, user exception handler, abort observers.
 *   IsDebuggerAttached()       [doc] false: no debugger is attached to the program (true of a retail run).
 *   SetUserExceptionHandler(handler, stack, size, info)  [doc] the kernel calls the handler on a CPU exception. The runtime
 *                              reports host exceptions itself (hostrt.c crash report) and does NOT call the game's
 *                              handler: recorded only (SIMPLIFIED; the strict audit lists it).
 *   InitializeAbortObserverHolder(holder, fn) / RegisterAbortObserver(holder)  [doc] fn is called with the abort's
 *                              details when the program aborts. Recorded; the runtime's abort path (guest_trap) does NOT
 *                              call them (SIMPLIFIED). */
static uint64_t g_user_exception_handler, g_abort_observer[8];
static int g_abort_observers;
static void diag_IsDebuggerAttached(Ctx *c) { c->x[0] = 0; }
static void diag_NotNullImpl(Ctx *c) { c->x[0] = c->x[0] != 0; }      /* [sdk] 0x43f58: cmp x0, #0; cset w0, ne */
static void os_SetUserExceptionHandler(Ctx *c) { g_user_exception_handler = c->x[0]; }
static void diag_InitializeAbortObserverHolder(Ctx *c) { wr64(c->x[0], c->x[1]); }      /* holder +0: the function */
static void diag_RegisterAbortObserver(Ctx *c) { if (g_abort_observers < 8) g_abort_observer[g_abort_observers++] = c->x[0]; }

/* ---- nn::hid debug pad [doc]: a retail console has none. InitializeDebugPad does nothing visible;
 * GetDebugPadState(DebugPadState*) gives a state whose attributes say "not connected" (all zero). */
static void hid_InitializeDebugPad(Ctx *c) { (void)c; }
static void hid_GetDebugPadState(Ctx *c) { memset((void *)(uintptr_t)c->x[0], 0, 0x20); }   /* s64 sampling number, u32 attributes, u32 buttons, two sticks of 2 x s32 = 0x20 bytes */

/* ---- nn::oe performance mode [doc]: PerformanceMode Normal = 0 (handheld), Boost = 1 (docked); the console is docked
 * here (graphics.ini console_mode, the same source nnsdk.c's GetOperationMode uses).
 * GetPerformanceConfiguration(mode): the clock configuration of that mode. SMO decodes the answer in
 * al::setGpuPerformance [game 0xa28468]: 0x00020003 / 0x00020004 / 0x92220008 -> tier 0, 0x00010001 -> tier 1, others
 * -> tier 2. Answered: Boost 0x00020003, Normal 0x00010001 (values from the set the game knows; WHICH one a console
 * reports by default is NOT VERIFIED). SetPerformanceConfiguration / the two notification switches are recorded only
 * (the host has no clocks to set and sends no resume / mode-change notifications: SIMPLIFIED). */
#include "gfx_options.h"
static int docked(void) { return !gfx_options()->handheld; }   /* graphics.ini console_mode, as nnsdk.c GetOperationMode */
static uint32_t g_perf_config[2] = {0x00010001u, 0x00020003u};
static int g_resume_notify, g_perfmode_notify;
static void oe_GetPerformanceMode(Ctx *c) { c->x[0] = docked() ? 1 : 0; }
static void oe_GetPerformanceConfiguration(Ctx *c) { c->x[0] = g_perf_config[(uint32_t)c->x[0] == 1]; }
static void oe_SetPerformanceConfiguration(Ctx *c) { g_perf_config[(uint32_t)c->x[0] == 1] = (uint32_t)c->x[1]; }
static void oe_SetResumeNotificationEnabled(Ctx *c) { g_resume_notify = (int)(c->x[0] & 1); }
static void oe_SetPerformanceModeChangedNotificationEnabled(Ctx *c) { g_perfmode_notify = (int)(c->x[0] & 1); }

/* ---- nn::prepo::PlayReport(const char *event_id): the default constructor (nnmisc.c: byte @0 = 0, three 8-byte fields
 * @0x20..0x37 = 0) followed by SetEventId; play reports are accepted and discarded offline, as in nnmisc.c. */
static void prepo_PlayReport_ctor_id(Ctx *c) { wr8(c->x[0], 0); wr64(c->x[0] + 0x20, 0); wr64(c->x[0] + 0x28, 0); wr64(c->x[0] + 0x30, 0); }

/* ---- nn::vi::SetLayerScalingMode(Layer*, ScalingMode) [doc]: how the system scales the layer to the screen. The host
 * window scales the presented image itself (display.c): recorded only, Result 0 (SIMPLIFIED). */
static uint32_t g_layer_scaling_mode;
static void vi_SetLayerScalingMode(Ctx *c) { g_layer_scaling_mode = (uint32_t)c->x[1]; c->x[0] = 0; }

/* ---- nn::os transfer memory, below the SDK's own nn::os::CreateTransferMemory & co (cut in sdklift_rules.txt at
 * nn::os::detail::TransferMemoryImplByHorizon, the layer that makes the kernel calls). [doc] A transfer memory lends a
 * range of the owner's memory to another process, which maps it; while it is lent, the owner's access is restricted to
 * the given permission. Here the borrower is the in-process audio server (smo_audio.c), so "mapping" is the range
 * itself: Map returns the original address. NOT modelled: the owner's permission change (the client does not touch the
 * lent buffer meanwhile; SIMPLIFIED). Results: 0, or 0xca01 (os InvalidHandle, NOT VERIFIED) for an unknown handle. */
#define TM_MAX 64
static struct { uint64_t addr, size; int used; } g_tm[TM_MAX];
static SRWLOCK g_tm_lock = SRWLOCK_INIT;
static void tm_Create(Ctx *c) {                 /* (u32 *handle, void *addr, size_t size, MemoryPermission) */
    int h = -1;
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_tm_lock);
    for (int i = 1; i < TM_MAX; i++) if (!g_tm[i].used) { g_tm[i].used = 1; g_tm[i].addr = c->x[1]; g_tm[i].size = c->x[2]; h = i; break; }
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_tm_lock);
    if (h < 0) guest_trap("transfer memory: too many at once (smo_nn.c TM_MAX)", c->x[30] - 4);
    wr32(c->x[0], 0xf000u + (uint32_t)h);
    c->x[0] = 0;
}
static int tm_index(uint32_t handle) { int i = (int)handle - 0xf000; return i > 0 && i < TM_MAX && g_tm[i].used ? i : -1; }
static void tm_Close(Ctx *c) {                  /* (u32 handle) */
    int i = tm_index((uint32_t)c->x[0]);
    if (i >= 0) g_tm[i].used = 0;
}
static void tm_Map(Ctx *c) {                    /* (void **out, u32 handle, void *hint, size_t size, MemoryPermission) */
    int i = tm_index((uint32_t)c->x[1]);
    if (i < 0) { c->x[0] = 0xca01; return; }
    if (c->x[3] && c->x[3] != g_tm[i].size) guest_trap("transfer memory: mapped with another size", c->x[30] - 4);
    wr64(c->x[0], g_tm[i].addr);
    c->x[0] = 0;
}
/* nn::os::MapTransferMemory first takes an address range from the AddressSpaceAllocator (AllocateSpace(this, size,
 * align): a free range found with svc QueryMemory), maps there, then checks that the guard pages around the mapping are
 * free (CheckGuardSpace(this, addr, size, guard)) and retries elsewhere if not [sdk 0x89a40]. With in-process aliasing
 * (tm_Map returns the lent range itself) the hint is not used and there are no guard pages: AllocateSpace answers a
 * fixed non-zero, page-aligned hint and CheckGuardSpace answers true. */
static void as_AllocateSpace(Ctx *c) { c->x[0] = 0x10000000ull; }
static void as_CheckGuardSpace(Ctx *c) { c->x[0] = 1; }
static void tm_Unmap(Ctx *c) { c->x[0] = tm_index((uint32_t)c->x[0]) >= 0 ? 0 : 0xca01; }   /* (u32 handle, void *addr, size_t size) */

void smo_heap_report(FILE *out) {
    if (!g_heap) return;
    fprintf(out, "memory heap: 0x%llx bytes set, %llu block allocations (%llu failed), highest use 0x%llx\n",
            (unsigned long long)g_heap_size, g_alloc_calls, g_alloc_fail, (unsigned long long)g_peak);
}

/* ---- nn::diag, the forms SMO imports that had no handler (a call returned 0 and the game went on) [doc]:
 *   AbortImpl(condition, function, file, line, const Result *, format, ...)  the program stops with that message.
 *   OnAssertionFailure(type, condition, function, file, line)  an SDK assertion failed: the program stops.
 *   LogImpl(meta, format, ...) / PutImpl(meta, text, length)  the program's debug log (NN_LOG; sead's print goes to
 *     PutImpl): written to the run log here (the first 500 lines, then counted).
 *   GetBacktrace(addresses, max) -> count  the return addresses of the calling frames: the caller's, then the guest
 *     frame-pointer chain (frame record: previous frame, return address).
 *   GetSymbolName(out, size, address) -> start of the symbol, or 0; GetSymbolSize(address) -> its size, or 0: the
 *     function that contains the address and the game's own dynamic symbol for it (a function without one: not found).
 *   GetRequiredBufferSizeForGetAllModuleInfo() / GetAllModuleInfo(out, buffer, size) -> count: the module list; the runtime
 *     reports none (SIMPLIFIED). sead calls these only to print an exception report, which the runtime writes itself
 *     (hostrt.c crash report). */
int clib_format_call(Ctx *c, int fmt_reg, char *out, size_t size);      /* clib.c */
static const char *sstr(uint64_t p) { return p ? (const char *)(uintptr_t)p : "(null)"; }
static void diag_AbortImpl_result(Ctx *c) {
    char msg[1024];
    clib_format_call(c, 5, msg, sizeof msg);
    printf("\nnn::diag abort: %s  in %s  (%s:%d), result 0x%x: %s\n", sstr(c->x[0]), sstr(c->x[1]), sstr(c->x[2]), (int)c->x[3],
           c->x[4] ? rd32(c->x[4]) : 0u, msg);
    fflush(stdout);
    guest_trap("guest called nn::diag::detail::AbortImpl", c->x[30] - 4);
}
static void diag_OnAssertionFailure(Ctx *c) {
    printf("\nnn::diag assertion failed (type %d): %s  in %s  (%s:%d)\n", (int)c->x[0], sstr(c->x[1]), sstr(c->x[2]), sstr(c->x[3]), (int)c->x[4]);
    fflush(stdout);
    guest_trap("guest called nn::diag::detail::OnAssertionFailure", c->x[30] - 4);
}
static volatile LONG g_diag_log_lines;
static void diag_log_line(const char *s, size_t n) {
    LONG k = InterlockedIncrement(&g_diag_log_lines);
    if (k > 500) { if (k == 501) printf("nn::diag log: more lines are not printed\n"); return; }
    while (n && (s[n - 1] == '\n' || s[n - 1] == '\r')) n--;
    printf("nn::diag log: %.*s\n", (int)n, s);
}
static void diag_LogImpl(Ctx *c) { char msg[1024]; int n = clib_format_call(c, 1, msg, sizeof msg); diag_log_line(msg, n < 0 ? 0 : (size_t)n < sizeof msg ? (size_t)n : sizeof msg - 1); }
static void diag_PutImpl(Ctx *c) { if (c->x[1]) diag_log_line((const char *)(uintptr_t)c->x[1], (size_t)c->x[2]); }
static int readable(uint64_t p, size_t n) {
    MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION mb;
    if (!p || VirtualQuery((void *)(uintptr_t)p, &mb, sizeof mb) != sizeof mb || mb.State != MEM_COMMIT) return 0;
    if (mb.Protect & (PAGE_NOACCESS | PAGE_GUARD)) return 0;
    return p + n <= (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)mb.BaseAddress + mb.RegionSize;
}
static void diag_GetBacktrace(Ctx *c) {
    uint64_t out = c->x[0], fp = c->x[29];
    int max = (int)c->x[1], n = 0;
    if (n < max && c->x[30]) wr64(out + 8 * (uint64_t)n++, c->x[30]);
    while (n < max && !(fp & 7) && readable(fp, 16)) {
        uint64_t next = rd64(fp), lr = rd64(fp + 8);
        if (!lr) break;
        wr64(out + 8 * (uint64_t)n++, lr);
        if (next <= fp) break;                       /* frames go up the stack */
        fp = next;
    }
    c->x[0] = (uint64_t)n;
}
static int fn_index(uint64_t addr) {                 /* the lifted function that contains a guest address, or -1 */
    int lo = 0, hi = fn_table_count - 1, best = -1;
    while (lo <= hi) { int mid = (lo + hi) / 2; if (fn_table[mid].addr <= addr) { best = mid; lo = mid + 1; } else hi = mid - 1; }
    return best;
}
static const char *sym_at(uint64_t start) {           /* the game's dynamic symbol at a function start */
    static uint64_t *addr;
    static const char **name;
    static int n = -1;
    if (n < 0) {
        n = 0;
        addr = malloc(sizeof *addr * (size_t)dyn_sym_count); name = malloc(sizeof *name * (size_t)dyn_sym_count);
        for (int i = 0; addr && name && i < dyn_sym_count; i++)
            if (dyn_syms[i].defined && dyn_syms[i].value) {      /* insertion into the sorted array would be slow: append, then sort */
                addr[n] = GUEST_BASE + dyn_syms[i].value; name[n] = dyn_syms[i].name; n++;
            }
        for (int gap = n / 2; gap > 0; gap /= 2)          /* shell sort by address, the names along */
            for (int i = gap; i < n; i++)
                for (int j = i; j >= gap && addr[j - gap] > addr[j]; j -= gap) {
                    uint64_t t = addr[j]; addr[j] = addr[j - gap]; addr[j - gap] = t;
                    const char *s = name[j]; name[j] = name[j - gap]; name[j - gap] = s;
                }
    }
    int lo = 0, hi = n - 1;
    while (lo <= hi) { int mid = (lo + hi) / 2; if (addr[mid] == start) return name[mid]; if (addr[mid] < start) lo = mid + 1; else hi = mid - 1; }
    return NULL;
}
static void diag_GetSymbolName(Ctx *c) {             /* (char *out, size_t size, uintptr_t address) -> uintptr_t */
    int i = fn_index(c->x[2]);
    const char *s = i >= 0 ? sym_at(fn_table[i].addr) : NULL;
    if (c->x[1]) { size_t n = s ? strlen(s) : 0; if (n >= c->x[1]) n = (size_t)c->x[1] - 1; if (n) memcpy((void *)(uintptr_t)c->x[0], s, n); wr8(c->x[0] + n, 0); }
    c->x[0] = s ? fn_table[i].addr : 0;
}
static void diag_GetSymbolSize(Ctx *c) {             /* (uintptr_t address) -> size_t */
    int i = fn_index(c->x[0]);
    c->x[0] = i >= 0 && i + 1 < fn_table_count && sym_at(fn_table[i].addr) ? fn_table[i + 1].addr - fn_table[i].addr : 0;
}
static void diag_GetRequiredBufferSizeForGetAllModuleInfo(Ctx *c) { c->x[0] = 0; }
static void diag_GetAllModuleInfo(Ctx *c) { if (c->x[0]) wr64(c->x[0], 0); c->x[0] = 0; }

/* ---- nn::time library state [doc]: IsInitialized() is true between Initialize() and Finalize() (it used to answer
 * false always; sead::DateTime then initializes again, which was harmless). Replaces nnsdk.c's ret0 handlers. */
static volatile LONG g_time_init;
static void time_Initialize(Ctx *c) { InterlockedExchange(&g_time_init, 1); c->x[0] = 0; }
static void time_IsInitialized(Ctx *c) { c->x[0] = g_time_init != 0; }
static void time_Finalize(Ctx *c) { InterlockedExchange(&g_time_init, 0); c->x[0] = 0; }

/* ---- nn::oe [doc]
 *   SetScreenShotImageOrientation(orientation)  the orientation of screenshots taken from now on (0 normal, 1 rotated
 *     by 90, 2 by 180, 3 by 270 degrees): SMO's snapshot mode sets it when the camera is turned. Kept for the screenshot
 *     of the capture button (smo_screenshot_orientation).
 *   SetUserInactivityDetectionTimeExtended(on) / IsUserInactivityDetectionTimeExtended()  while on, the console waits
 *     much longer before it dims the screen (SMO turns it on for the ending): here the display is kept on meanwhile
 *     (a power request of its own, apart from the auto-sleep sections of nnmisc.c). */
static volatile LONG g_shot_orientation;
int smo_screenshot_orientation(void) { return (int)g_shot_orientation; }
static void oe_SetScreenShotImageOrientation(Ctx *c) { InterlockedExchange(&g_shot_orientation, (LONG)(c->x[0] & 3)); }
static HANDLE g_inact_req;
static int g_inact_ext;
static void oe_SetUserInactivityDetectionTimeExtended(Ctx *c) {
    int on = (int)(c->x[0] & 1);
    if (!g_inact_req) {
        REASON_CONTEXT rc;
        memset(&rc, 0, sizeof rc);
        rc.Version = POWER_REQUEST_CONTEXT_VERSION; rc.Flags = POWER_REQUEST_CONTEXT_SIMPLE_STRING;
        rc.Reason.SimpleReasonString = L"Super Mario Odyssey (smo-recomp): the game asked for a longer time before the screen dims";
        g_inact_req = PowerCreateRequest(&rc);
        if (g_inact_req == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) g_inact_req = NULL;
    }
    if (g_inact_req && on != g_inact_ext) { if (on) PowerSetRequest(g_inact_req, PowerRequestDisplayRequired); else PowerClearRequest(g_inact_req, PowerRequestDisplayRequired); }
    g_inact_ext = on;
}
static void oe_IsUserInactivityDetectionTimeExtended(Ctx *c) { c->x[0] = (uint64_t)g_inact_ext; }

/* ---- nn::nifm, offline [doc]: HandleNetworkRequestResult() shows the console's error screen for a network request
 * that failed and returns what the player did; the game ([game] al::NexNetworkStateHolder::exeConnectToInternet) takes
 * 0 as "connected now", the Result 0x17c6e (nifm 190: the error was shown and dealt with) as "not connected, stop", and
 * anything else as an error. This console has no network, so: 0x17c6e (it used to answer 0 and the game went on to its
 * account check as if connected). SetLocalNetworkMode(bool): local communication only; nothing to set. */
static void nifm_HandleNetworkRequestResult(Ctx *c) { c->x[0] = 0x17c6e; }

/* ---- Labo VR, as the game drives it ([game] 0x7b4c80: pl::BeginVrMode, and only when it succeeds
 * BeginBlockingHomeButton + DisableRecording; 0x7b4cc0: EndVrMode, EndBlockingHomeButton, EnableRecording):
 *   oe::BeginBlockingHomeButton / EndBlockingHomeButton [sdk 7.3.2 0x3218c0 / 0x321920]: one request each to the
 *       application functions (abort on failure). The PC has no HOME button to block: nothing to do.
 *   oe::EnableRecording [0x323640]: the same, to allow the video capture again; there is no video capture here (see
 *       EnableGamePlayRecording above; DisableRecording does nothing either, nnsdk.c).
 * Stereo vision (parental controls), as the game checks it before VR ([game] 0x568fe0 / 0x569050): it shows an
 * error and gives up if ConfirmStereoVisionRestrictionConfigurable fails; else, when GetStereoVisionRestriction differs
```

`runtime/services/nnalbum.c`:

```c
/* The album: pictures of the Capture button, kept in <userdata>\album (<userdata> = %SMO_USERDATA% or ..\userdata) as
 * <date>_<time>_<nn>.bmp (32-bit BMP; a console stores JPEG). The game imports no nn::album function. */
#include <windows.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

const char *fs_user_root(void);                           /* nnfs.c: %SMO_USERDATA% or ..\userdata */
static char g_album_dir[MAX_PATH];
static const char *album_dir(void) {
    if (!g_album_dir[0]) snprintf(g_album_dir, sizeof g_album_dir, "%s\\album", fs_user_root());
    return g_album_dir;
}
static volatile LONG g_shot_counter;

/* Writes a top-down RGBA8 picture as a 32-bit BMP (BGRA, bottom-up). Returns 0 on success. */
static int write_bmp(const char *path, const uint8_t *rgba, int w, int h) {
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "wb");
    if (!f) return 1;
    BITMAPFILEHEADER fh;
    BITMAPINFOHEADER ih;
    memset(&fh, 0, sizeof fh);
    memset(&ih, 0, sizeof ih);
    fh.bfType = 0x4d42;
    fh.bfOffBits = sizeof fh + sizeof ih;
    fh.bfSize = fh.bfOffBits + (DWORD)w * (DWORD)h * 4;
    ih.biSize = sizeof ih; ih.biWidth = w; ih.biHeight = h; ih.biPlanes = 1; ih.biBitCount = 32; ih.biCompression = BI_RGB;
    fwrite(&fh, sizeof fh, 1, f);
    fwrite(&ih, sizeof ih, 1, f);
    uint8_t *row = malloc((size_t)w * 4);
    for (int y = h - 1; y >= 0; y--) {
        const uint8_t *s = rgba + (size_t)y * w * 4;
        for (int x = 0; x < w; x++) { row[x * 4] = s[x * 4 + 2]; row[x * 4 + 1] = s[x * 4 + 1]; row[x * 4 + 2] = s[x * 4]; row[x * 4 + 3] = s[x * 4 + 3]; }
        fwrite(row, 4, (size_t)w, f);
    }
    free(row);
    int bad = ferror(f);
    fclose(f);
    return bad;
}
/* a picture of the Capture button (nvn_vk_draw.c capture_vk): the presented frame, w x h opaque 8-bit RGBA,
 * saved as <album>\<date>_<time>_<n>.bmp and turned as the game last asked with
 * nn::oe::SetScreenShotImageOrientation (smo_nn.c): 1 = 90, 2 = 180, 3 = 270 degrees clockwise (NOT VERIFIED on a
 * console: the direction of the turn). */
int smo_screenshot_orientation(void);                     /* smo_nn.c */
int album_save_capture(const uint8_t *rgba, int w, int h, char *out_path, size_t out_cap) {
    int o = smo_screenshot_orientation() & 3, ow = (o & 1) ? h : w, oh = (o & 1) ? w : h;
    uint8_t *turned = NULL;
    const uint8_t *pix = rgba;
    if (o) {
        turned = malloc((size_t)w * h * 4);
        if (!turned) return 1;
        for (int y = 0; y < h; y++)
            for (int x = 0; x < w; x++) {
                int nx = o == 1 ? h - 1 - y : o == 2 ? w - 1 - x : y, ny = o == 1 ? x : o == 2 ? h - 1 - y : w - 1 - x;
                memcpy(turned + ((size_t)ny * ow + nx) * 4, rgba + ((size_t)y * w + x) * 4, 4);
            }
        pix = turned;
    }
    SYSTEMTIME t;
    char path[MAX_PATH];
    GetLocalTime(&t);
    CreateDirectoryA(album_dir(), NULL);
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s\\%04d%02d%02d_%02d%02d%02d_%02ld.bmp", album_dir(), t.wYear, t.wMonth, t.wDay, t.wHour, t.wMinute, t.wSecond,
             InterlockedIncrement(&g_shot_counter) % 100);
    int bad = write_bmp(path, pix, ow, oh);
    if (out_path && out_cap) snprintf(out_path, out_cap, "%s", path);
    if (bad) printf("capture: cannot write %s\n", path);
    else printf("capture: %dx%d picture%s saved to %s\n", ow, oh, o ? " (turned as the game asked)" : "", path);
    free(turned);
    return bad;
}
```

`runtime/services/nnapplet.c`:

```c
/* Library applets and small device services, as an OFFLINE console answers them:
 * nn::web::ShowOfflineHtmlPage, nn::swkbd::ShowKeyboard, nn::nfp (an NFC reader to which the amiibo menu holds amiibo),
 * nn::oe volume balance.
 *
 * Everything that only fills a caller structure (nn::web *Arg constructors and setters, *ReturnValue
 * constructors and getters, nn::swkbd MakePreset / Set*Text / SetInitialText / SetTextCheckCallback /
 * GetRequired*Size, InitializeKeyboardConfig) is NOT here: it is the SDK's own code, lifted (sdklift_gen.c).
 *
 * Tags: [sdk] address in Super Smash Bros. Ultimate 13.0.4's SDK module (read by ssbu-recomp); [game] address in a main module:
 * 0x71xxxxxxxx = Super Smash Bros. Ultimate 13.0.4's (ssbu-recomp), a module offset = this game's; [doc] suyu source / public headers.
 *
 * ---- nn::web
 * [sdk] 0x3bd330 ShowOfflineHtmlPage: creates library applet 0x17, pushes the argument, waits for it, then
 * pops 0x1010 bytes into the OfflineHtmlPageReturnValue; Result 0 when that storage exists, 0x2d2 (module
 * 210, description 1) when the applet ended without one. Layout ([sdk] 0x3be5a0 constructor, [doc] suyu
 * WebCommonReturnValue): u32 exitReason @0 (constructor: 0x14 = "none"), char lastUrl[0x1000] @8,
 * u64 lastUrlSize @0x1008.
 * [doc] suyu WebExitReason: 0 EndButtonPressed, 1 BackButtonPressed, 2 ExitRequested, 3 CallbackURL,
 * 4 WindowClosed, 7 ErrorDialog.
 * What happens here: ShowOfflineHtmlPage shows the game's own document when it can (web_open_offline below), then
 * answers what the applet returns when the user closes the page: exit reason 0 (EndButtonPressed), last URL
 * "http://localhost/" (what suyu's applet without a browser frontend reports). [game] 0x710375535c ignores the
 * Result and the value of ShowOfflineHtmlPage.
 *
 * ---- nn::swkbd::ShowKeyboard(String *out, const ShowKeyboardArg &arg)
 * [sdk] 0x38a390. ShowKeyboardArg: KeyboardConfig (0x4d0 bytes) @0; work buffer @0x4d0, size @0x4d8;
 * text-check work buffer @0x4e0 (the applet's dialog message goes back from there, 0x7d4 bytes); a
 * second buffer @0x4f0 / size @0x4f8 (user dictionary). KeyboardConfig fields used here ([sdk] MakePreset
 * 0x38a810, SetInitialText 0x38b130, SetTextCheckCallback 0x38b340, [doc] nnheaders swkbd): header text
 * (char16[65]) @0x24, sub text (char16[129]) @0xa6, guide text (char16[257]) @0x1a8, textMaxLength @0x3ac,
 * textMinLength @0x3b0, passwordMode @0x3b4, isUseUtf8 @0x3bd, initial text offset in the work buffer
 * @0x3c0 and length in characters @0x3c4, text-check enabled @0x3d0, callback @0x3d8.
 * String: pointer @0, buffer size in bytes @8.
 * Results: 0 with the text (UTF-16, or UTF-8 when isUseUtf8) when confirmed; 0x29f (module 159,
 * description 1) when cancelled ([sdk] 0x38a75c; [game] 0x7103300584 compares with 0x29f).
 * Text check ([sdk] 0x389e40): the callback is called as cb(textCheckWorkBuf, size_t *outMessageSize,
 * String *text) with text->bufSize temporarily set to the size of the entered text; it returns
 * [doc] TextCheckResult 0 Success, 1 ShowFailureDialog, 2 ShowConfirmDialog, with the message in
 * textCheckWorkBuf.
 * Here the applet is a small Win32 dialog (edit box, OK, Cancel) run on the calling guest thread, which
 * blocks exactly like on the console. Scripted runs must not block: SMO_SWKBD=cancel answers "cancelled",
 * SMO_SWKBD=text:<utf-8 text> answers that text, SMO_SWKBD=dialog forces the dialog; without the
 * variable the dialog is used unless an input script (SMO_SEQ / SMO_PRESS / SMO_SCRIPT) is active.
 *
 * ---- nn::nfp
 * Console modelled: the player-1 controller has an NFC reader (as a Pro Controller / right Joy-Con does).
 * An amiibo is held to it only by the amiibo menu (smo_amiibo.c, nfp_place_amiibo): the reader then finds
 * it the next time the game searches, the game mounts it and reads its tag and model information, and the
 * amiibo is taken away again once the game has read it (one touch). [sdk] 0x309a84 GetDeviceState: 5 before
 * Initialize. [doc] suyu nfc_types.h DeviceState 0 Initialized, 1 SearchingForTag, 2 TagFound,
 * 3 TagRemoved, 4 TagMounted, 5 Unavailable; nfp_result.h (module 115): DeviceNotFound 64,
 * InvalidArgument 65, WrongDeviceState 73, TagRemoved 97.
 * The transitions are suyu's (core/hle/service/nfc/common/device.cpp): StartDetection from Initialized or
 * TagRemoved to SearchingForTag; a tag in the field: TagFound, the deactivate event cleared and the
 * activate event signalled; Mount: TagFound -> TagMounted; Unmount: back to TagFound; the tag leaving the
 * field: TagRemoved (unmounted first), the activate event cleared and the deactivate event signalled;
 * StopDetection: the tag closed if there is one, then Initialized.
 * The events are attached as AutoClear ([smo sdk.elf] 0x12e220: AttachReadableHandleToSystemEvent with
 * clear mode 1). How the game uses the reader (al::NfpControllerThread, [game] 0x95efa8): AttachEvent,
 * then StartDetection; TagDetect polls GetDeviceState and waits 100 us on the activate event every 60 ms;
 * Mount(handle, ModelType 0, MountTarget 1); TagRead: GetTagInfo and GetModelInfo; Deactive: Unmount,
 * then GetDeviceState every 60 ms while it says TagFound, and StartDetection again once the tag is gone.
 * TagInfo ([doc] suyu nfc_types.h, 0x58 bytes): uuid[10] @0, uuid length @0xa, protocol u32 @0x20
 * (1 = type A), tag type u32 @0x24 (2 = type 2: an amiibo is an NTAG215). ModelInfo (0x40 bytes) as
 * the game reads it ([game] 0x960478 al::isEqualCharacterId, 0x960530 al::isEqualNumberingId): the
 * amiibo's identification block as stored on the tag, bytes 0 and 1 (game and character), 2 (variant),
 * 3 (type), the model number at 4 as a little-endian u16 (big-endian on the tag), 6 (series).
 * NOT VERIFIED on a console: the DeviceHandle value (8 bytes; the npad id 0 is used), and the Result of
 * calls made before Initialize (WrongDeviceState is returned). */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <windows.h>
#include "sdklift.h"

#define A0 (c->x[0])
#define A1 (c->x[1])
#define A2 (c->x[2])
#define A3 (c->x[3])
#define A4 (c->x[4])
#define RET(v) (c->x[0] = (uint64_t)(v))
#define P(v) ((uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(v))

void os_init_event(uint64_t key, int autoclear);          /* os_threads.c */
void os_signal_event(uint64_t key);
void os_clear_event(uint64_t key);

/* ================================================================ nn::web */
#define WEB_RESULT_TERMINATED 0x2d2u
#define WEB_EXIT_END_BUTTON 0u
static const char g_last_url[] = "http://localhost/";

/* Input TLVs of a Show*Arg ([doc] switchbrew "Internet Browser": header u16 count, u16 pad, u32 shim kind; entries
 * u16 type, u16 size, u32 pad; type 1 initial URL, 6 document path). Only used to say in the log what was asked. */
static const char *web_arg_string(uint64_t arg, int type) {
    uint32_t count = rd16(arg), off = 8;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < count && off + 8 < 0x2000; i++) {
        uint32_t t = rd16(arg + off), size = rd16(arg + off + 2);
        if ((int)t == type) return (const char *)(uintptr_t)(arg + off + 8);
        off += size + 8;
    }
    return NULL;
}
static void web_log(Ctx *c, const char *what, uint64_t arg) {
    const char *url = web_arg_string(arg, 1), *doc = web_arg_string(arg, 6);
    printf("%s: \"%.200s\" cannot be shown here; answered as closed by the user (caller 0x%llx)\n", what, doc ? doc : url ? url : "",
           (unsigned long long)c->x[30] - 4);
    trace_printf("     %s \"%.200s\" -> closed (EndButtonPressed)\n", what, doc ? doc : url ? url : "");
}
static void web_fill_common(uint64_t ret) {                /* 0x1010 bytes */
    memset((void *)(uintptr_t)ret, 0, 0x1010);
    wr32(ret, WEB_EXIT_END_BUTTON);
    memcpy((void *)(uintptr_t)(ret + 8), g_last_url, sizeof g_last_url);
    wr64(ret + 0x1008, sizeof g_last_url - 1);
}
/* ShowOfflineHtmlPage with the game's own offline document: SMO's Help, its Action Guide (al::HtmlViewer::call
 * asks for "htmlcontents.htdocs/html/<region and language>/index.html<query>"). On the console the browser applet shows
 * the page full screen and the game waits until the player closes it. Here the page, from the extracted document
 * (scripts/setup.py step `manual` -> build\manual, read as ..\manual from the exe's folder, or SMO_MANUAL=<folder>), is
 * shown INSIDE the game window by smo_guide.c (Microsoft Edge WebView2) and the call returns when the player has closed
 * it; only when WebView2 cannot be used does it open in the PC's web browser, and the call then returns at once.
 * The page's script uses the console browser's window.nx (footer buttons L / R / B, endApplet, play reports) before
 * anything else and stops without it; so it is shown from a copy next to it (<name>_pc.html, written once) that first
 * loads nx_pc.js (written into the document's js folder): the footer buttons answer to the keyboard (Q / E or Page Up /
 * Page Down for L / R, Escape or Backspace for B; the page's own arrow keys stay); pads come from the runtime in the game
 * window (window.__smo_pad, smo_guide.c) and through the browser's Gamepad API in a PC browser (shoulder buttons L / R,
 * bottom face button B, right face button A, D-pad = arrow keys); endApplet closes the page (in a PC browser: the tab),
 * play reports do nothing. A file URL with a query cannot be opened by name in a PC browser, so a small page in %TEMP%
 * forwards to it. Without the document the page is answered as closed, as before. */
static const char g_nx_pc_js[] =
    "/* smo-recomp: window.nx of the console's browser applet, for SMO's Help in the game window or a PC browser (written by the runtime) */\n"
    "(function () {\n"
    "  var keys = {};\n"
    "  var host = window.chrome && window.chrome.webview;   /* inside the game window: pads come from the runtime */\n"
    "  function press(b) { if (keys[b]) keys[b](); }\n"
    "  function arrow(code) { if (document.onkeydown) document.onkeydown({ keyCode: code, preventDefault: function () {} }); }\n"
    "  /* the page moves the focus with up / down only from an item that has it; the console's stick pointer gives the first */\n"
    "  function nothingFocused() { var e = document.activeElement; return !e || e === document.body || e === document.documentElement; }\n"
    "  function focusFirst() {\n"
    "    var a = document.querySelectorAll('a[onfocus], a[id], button');\n"
    "    for (var i = 0; i < a.length; i++) { var r = a[i].getBoundingClientRect(); if (r.width > 0 && r.height > 0) { a[i].focus(); return; } }\n"
    "  }\n"
    "  window.__smo_pad = function (b) {\n"
    "    if (b === 'B' || b === 'L' || b === 'R') press(b);\n"
    "    else if (b === 'A') { if (!nothingFocused() && document.activeElement.click) document.activeElement.click(); }\n"
    "    else if ((b === 'U' || b === 'D') && nothingFocused()) focusFirst();\n"
    "    else if (b === 'U') arrow(38); else if (b === 'D') arrow(40); else if (b === 'Lf') arrow(37); else if (b === 'Rt') arrow(39);\n"
    "  };\n"
    "  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {\n"
    "    var k = e.key;\n"
    "    if (k === 'Escape' || k === 'Backspace') { e.preventDefault(); press('B'); }\n"
    "    else if (k === 'q' || k === 'Q' || k === 'PageUp') { e.preventDefault(); press('L'); }\n"
    "    else if (k === 'e' || k === 'E' || k === 'PageDown') { e.preventDefault(); press('R'); }\n"
    "    else if ((k === 'ArrowUp' || k === 'ArrowDown') && nothingFocused()) { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); focusFirst(); }\n"
    "  }, true);\n"
    "  var was = [];\n"
    "  function poll() {\n"
    "    var pads = navigator.getGamepads ? navigator.getGamepads() : [];\n"
    "    for (var i = 0; i < pads.length; i++) {\n"
    "      var p = pads[i];\n"
    "      if (!p || p.mapping !== 'standard') continue;\n"
    "      var w = was[i] || [];\n"
    "      for (var b = 0; b < p.buttons.length && b < 16; b++) {\n"
    "        var on = p.buttons[b].pressed;\n"
    "        if (on && !w[b]) {\n"
    "          if (b === 0) press('B'); else if (b === 4) press('L'); else if (b === 5) press('R');\n"
    "          else if (b === 1 && document.activeElement && document.activeElement.click) document.activeElement.click();\n"
    "          else if (b === 12) arrow(38); else if (b === 13) arrow(40); else if (b === 14) arrow(37); else if (b === 15) arrow(39);\n"
    "        }\n"
    "        w[b] = on;\n"
    "      }\n"
    "      was[i] = w;\n"
    "    }\n"
    "    requestAnimationFrame(poll);\n"
    "  }\n"
    "  if (!host) requestAnimationFrame(poll);\n"
    "  window.nx = {\n"
    "    footer: { setAssign: function (b, label, fn) { keys[b] = fn; }, unsetAssign: function (b) { delete keys[b]; } },\n"
    "    playReport: { setCounterSetIdentifier: function () {}, incrementCounter: function () {} },\n"
    "    endApplet: function () {\n"
    "      if (host) host.postMessage('endApplet');\n"
    "      window.close();\n"
    "      setTimeout(function () { document.body.innerHTML = '<p style=\"color:#fff;font:20px sans-serif;padding:2em\">Close this tab to return to the game.</p>'; }, 300);\n"
    "    }\n"
    "  };\n"
    "})();\n";
static int write_if_differs(const char *path, const char *data, size_t n) {
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "rb");
    if (f) {
        char *old = malloc(n + 1);
        size_t got = old ? fread(old, 1, n + 1, f) : 0;
        fclose(f);
        int same = old && got == n && !memcmp(old, data, n);
        free(old);
        if (same) return 1;
    }
    f = fopen(path, "wb");
    if (!f) return 0;
    int ok = fwrite(data, 1, n, f) == n;
    return fclose(f) == 0 && ok;
}
static void url_append(char *url, size_t cap, const char *s) {      /* a path as a file URL: forward slashes, %XX escapes */
    size_t n = strlen(url);
    for (; *s && n + 4 < cap; s++) {
        unsigned char ch = (unsigned char)*s;
        if (ch == '\\') url[n++] = '/';
        else if ((ch >= 'a' && ch <= 'z') || (ch >= 'A' && ch <= 'Z') || (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') || strchr("/:._-~", ch)) url[n++] = (char)ch;
        else n += (size_t)snprintf(url + n, cap - n, "%%%02X", ch);
    }
    url[n] = 0;
}
static int web_open_offline(const char *doc) {
    char root[MAX_PATH], path[MAX_PATH], full[MAX_PATH], pc[MAX_PATH], js[MAX_PATH];
    const char *env = getenv("SMO_MANUAL"), *q = strpbrk(doc, "?#");
    size_t plen = q ? (size_t)(q - doc) : strlen(doc);
    snprintf(root, sizeof root, "%s", env && env[0] ? env : "..\\manual");
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s\\html-document\\%.*s", root, (int)plen, doc);
    for (char *p = path; *p; p++) if (*p == '/') *p = '\\';
    if (!GetFullPathNameA(path, sizeof full, full, NULL) || GetFileAttributesA(full) == INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES) {
        printf("nn::web::ShowOfflineHtmlPage: %s not found (run scripts\\setup.py --only manual)\n", full);
        return 0;
    }
    /* nx_pc.js: <document root>\htmlcontents.htdocs\js\nx_pc.js, the page's own js folder when the path has that form */
    char *html = strstr(full, "\\html\\");
    snprintf(js, sizeof js, "%.*s\\js\\nx_pc.js", html ? (int)(html - full) : 0, full);
    if (!html || !write_if_differs(js, g_nx_pc_js, sizeof g_nx_pc_js - 1)) { printf("nn::web::ShowOfflineHtmlPage: cannot write %s\n", js); return 0; }
    /* <name>_pc.html: the page with nx_pc.js loaded first */
    FILE *f = fopen(full, "rb");
    if (!f) return 0;
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);
    long size = ftell(f);
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);
    char *src = malloc((size_t)size + 1), *out = malloc((size_t)size + 256);
    if (!src || !out || fread(src, 1, (size_t)size, f) != (size_t)size) { fclose(f); free(src); free(out); return 0; }
    fclose(f);
    src[size] = 0;
    const char *tag = "<script src=\"../../js/nx_pc.js\"></script>";
    char *head = NULL;
    for (char *p = src; *p && !head; p++) if (!_strnicmp(p, "<head", 5)) head = strchr(p, '>');
    size_t at = head ? (size_t)(head + 1 - src) : 0, n = 0;
    memcpy(out, src, at); n = at;
    n += (size_t)sprintf(out + n, "%s", tag);
    memcpy(out + n, src + at, (size_t)size - at); n += (size_t)size - at;
    snprintf(pc, sizeof pc, "%.*s_pc.html", (int)(strlen(full) - 5), full);       /* ...\index.html -> ...\index_pc.html */
    int ok = strlen(full) > 5 && !_stricmp(full + strlen(full) - 5, ".html") && write_if_differs(pc, out, n);
    free(src); free(out);
    if (!ok) { printf("nn::web::ShowOfflineHtmlPage: cannot write %s\n", pc); return 0; }
    /* the forwarding page, then the default browser */
    char url[4096] = "file:///", fwd[MAX_PATH], tmp[MAX_PATH], page[8192];
    url_append(url, sizeof url, pc);
    if (q) snprintf(url + strlen(url), sizeof url - strlen(url), "%s", q);
    if (!GetTempPathA(sizeof tmp, tmp)) return 0;
    snprintf(fwd, sizeof fwd, "%ssmo-recomp-help.html", tmp);
    int pn = snprintf(page, sizeof page, "<!doctype html><meta charset=\"utf-8\"><meta http-equiv=\"refresh\" content=\"0; url=%s\">"
                      "<title>Super Mario Odyssey - Help</title><a href=\"%s\">Help</a>\n", url, url);
    if (pn <= 0 || !write_if_differs(fwd, page, (size_t)pn)) return 0;
    if (getenv("SMO_WEB_NOOPEN")) { printf("nn::web::ShowOfflineHtmlPage: \"%s\" ready as %s (not opened: SMO_WEB_NOOPEN)\n", doc, url); return 1; }    /* self-test */
    int guide_show(const char *url);                    /* smo_guide.c: in the game window, back when the player has closed it */
    if (guide_show(url)) return 1;
    HINSTANCE r = ShellExecuteA(NULL, "open", fwd, NULL, NULL, SW_SHOWNORMAL);
    printf("nn::web::ShowOfflineHtmlPage: \"%s\" opened in the web browser (%s)%s\n", doc, url, (INT_PTR)r > 32 ? "" : ": FAILED");
    return (INT_PTR)r > 32;
}
static void web_ShowOfflineHtmlPage(Ctx *c) {
    uint64_t ret = A0;
    const char *doc = web_arg_string(A1, 6);
    if (!doc || !web_open_offline(doc)) web_log(c, "nn::web::ShowOfflineHtmlPage", A1);
    web_fill_common(ret);
    RET(0);
}

/* ================================================================ nn::oe volume balance
 * [sdk] 0x32c5b0 SetExpectedVolumeBalance(float mainApplet, float libraryApplet): one request to the applet
 * manager's audio controller (object from 0x5368a0, slot +0x20 = command 0 SetExpectedMasterVolume); a failure
 * aborts. [sdk] 0x32c620 GetExpectedVolumeBalance(float *mainApplet, float *libraryApplet): two requests
 * (slot +0x28 = command 1 GetMainAppletExpectedMasterVolume, slot +0x30 = command 2
 * GetLibraryAppletExpectedMasterVolume), each failure aborts. Nothing else happens on the SDK side.
 * The applet manager's side (not in the dump), after [doc] suyu am/service/audio_controller.cpp/.h: it keeps
 * the two values clamped to [0, 1]; initial values main 0.25, library 1.0; the reference does nothing else
 * with them. What the console's applet manager does to the SOUND with them while a library applet is in front
 * is not in any source available here: NOT implemented, NOT verified. [game] 0x71037552fc saves them around
 * the offline HTML page and restores them afterwards. */
static float g_volume_main = 0.25f, g_volume_library = 1.0f;
static float clamp01(float v) { return v < 0.0f ? 0.0f : v > 1.0f ? 1.0f : v; }
static void oe_GetExpectedVolumeBalance(Ctx *c) {
    memcpy((void *)(uintptr_t)A0, &g_volume_main, 4);
    memcpy((void *)(uintptr_t)A1, &g_volume_library, 4);
}
static void oe_SetExpectedVolumeBalance(Ctx *c) { g_volume_main = clamp01(c->v[0].f[0]); g_volume_library = clamp01(c->v[1].f[0]); }

/* ================================================================ nn::swkbd::ShowKeyboard */
#define SWKBD_RESULT_CANCELED 0x29fu
#define KC_HEADER 0x24
#define KC_SUB 0xa6
#define KC_GUIDE 0x1a8
#define KC_MAXLEN 0x3ac
#define KC_MINLEN 0x3b0
#define KC_PASSWORD 0x3b4
#define KC_UTF8 0x3bd
#define KC_INITIAL_OFFSET 0x3c0
#define KC_INITIAL_LENGTH 0x3c4
#define KC_CHECK_ENABLED 0x3d0
#define KC_CHECK_CALLBACK 0x3d8
#define ARG_WORKBUF 0x4d0
#define ARG_CHECKBUF 0x4e0
#define SWKBD_MAX_CHARS 500                               /* [sdk] 0x38b150: SetInitialText stops at 0x1f4 characters */

typedef struct {
    const wchar_t *header, *sub, *guide, *initial;
    int max_len, min_len, password;
    wchar_t text[SWKBD_MAX_CHARS + 2];
} KbdDialog;

#define IDC_EDIT 1001
#define IDC_INFO 1002
static INT_PTR CALLBACK kbd_proc(HWND dlg, UINT msg, WPARAM wp, LPARAM lp) {
    KbdDialog *k = (KbdDialog *)GetWindowLongPtrW(dlg, GWLP_USERDATA);
    switch (msg) {
    case WM_INITDIALOG: {
        k = (KbdDialog *)lp;
        SetWindowLongPtrW(dlg, GWLP_USERDATA, (LONG_PTR)k);
        wchar_t info[600];
        _snwprintf(info, 599, L"%ls%ls%ls%ls%ls", k->header, k->header[0] && k->sub[0] ? L"\r\n" : L"", k->sub,
                   (k->header[0] || k->sub[0]) && k->guide[0] ? L"\r\n" : L"", k->guide);
        info[599] = 0;
        SetDlgItemTextW(dlg, IDC_INFO, info[0] ? info : L"Enter text");
        SendDlgItemMessageW(dlg, IDC_EDIT, EM_SETLIMITTEXT, (WPARAM)k->max_len, 0);
        if (k->password) SendDlgItemMessageW(dlg, IDC_EDIT, EM_SETPASSWORDCHAR, (WPARAM)L'*', 0);
        SetDlgItemTextW(dlg, IDC_EDIT, k->initial);
        SendDlgItemMessageW(dlg, IDC_EDIT, EM_SETSEL, 0, -1);
        SetForegroundWindow(dlg);
        SetFocus(GetDlgItem(dlg, IDC_EDIT));
        return FALSE;
    }
    case WM_COMMAND:
        if (LOWORD(wp) == IDOK) {
            GetDlgItemTextW(dlg, IDC_EDIT, k->text, SWKBD_MAX_CHARS + 1);
            if ((int)wcslen(k->text) < k->min_len) { MessageBeep(MB_ICONWARNING); return TRUE; }
            EndDialog(dlg, 1);
            return TRUE;
        }
        if (LOWORD(wp) == IDCANCEL) { EndDialog(dlg, 0); return TRUE; }
        break;
    case WM_CLOSE: EndDialog(dlg, 0); return TRUE;
    }
    return FALSE;
}
static uint8_t *tmpl_align(uint8_t *p, int a) { while ((uintptr_t)p & (uintptr_t)(a - 1)) *p++ = 0; return p; }
static uint8_t *tmpl_wstr(uint8_t *p, const wchar_t *s) { size_t n = (wcslen(s) + 1) * sizeof(wchar_t); memcpy(p, s, n); return p + n; }
static uint8_t *tmpl_item(uint8_t *p, DWORD style, int x, int y, int w, int h, int id, WORD cls, const wchar_t *text) {
    p = tmpl_align(p, 4);
    DLGITEMTEMPLATE it = {style | WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE, 0, (short)x, (short)y, (short)w, (short)h, (WORD)id};
    memcpy(p, &it, sizeof it); p += sizeof it;
    WORD cl[2] = {0xffff, cls};
    memcpy(p, cl, 4); p += 4;
    p = tmpl_wstr(p, text);
    *p++ = 0; *p++ = 0;                                   /* no creation data */
    return p;
}
static int kbd_run_dialog(KbdDialog *k) {
    uint8_t buf[1024], *p = buf;
    memset(buf, 0, sizeof buf);
    DLGTEMPLATE dt = {DS_MODALFRAME | DS_CENTER | DS_SETFONT | WS_POPUP | WS_CAPTION | WS_SYSMENU | DS_SETFOREGROUND, WS_EX_TOPMOST, 4, 0, 0, 260, 96};
    memcpy(p, &dt, sizeof dt); p += sizeof dt;
    *p++ = 0; *p++ = 0; *p++ = 0; *p++ = 0;               /* no menu, default class */
    p = tmpl_wstr(p, L"Software keyboard (smo-recomp)");
    *p++ = 9; *p++ = 0;
    p = tmpl_wstr(p, L"Segoe UI");
    p = tmpl_item(p, SS_LEFT, 8, 6, 244, 34, IDC_INFO, 0x0082, L"");
    p = tmpl_item(p, ES_AUTOHSCROLL | WS_BORDER | WS_TABSTOP, 8, 44, 244, 14, IDC_EDIT, 0x0081, L"");
    p = tmpl_item(p, BS_DEFPUSHBUTTON | WS_TABSTOP, 144, 72, 50, 16, IDOK, 0x0080, L"OK");
    p = tmpl_item(p, BS_PUSHBUTTON | WS_TABSTOP, 202, 72, 50, 16, IDCANCEL, 0x0080, L"Cancel");
    INT_PTR r = DialogBoxIndirectParamW(GetModuleHandleW(NULL), (DLGTEMPLATE *)buf, NULL, kbd_proc, (LPARAM)k);
    if (r == -1) { printf("nn::swkbd: the text dialog could not be created (error %lu); answered as cancelled\n", GetLastError()); return 0; }
    return (int)r;
}
static void copy_w(wchar_t *dst, uint64_t src, int max) {
    int i = 0;
    for (; i < max; i++) { uint16_t ch = rd16(src + (uint64_t)i * 2); if (!ch) break; dst[i] = ch; }
    dst[i] = 0;
}
/* How this call is answered: 0 dialog, 1 cancel, 2 fixed text. */
static int kbd_mode(wchar_t *fixed) {
    const char *v = getenv("SMO_SWKBD");
    if (v && strncmp(v, "text:", 5) == 0) { MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, v + 5, -1, fixed, SWKBD_MAX_CHARS + 1); fixed[SWKBD_MAX_CHARS] = 0; return 2; }
    if (v && strcmp(v, "cancel") == 0) return 1;
    if (v && strcmp(v, "dialog") == 0) return 0;
    if (getenv("SMO_SEQ") || getenv("SMO_PRESS") || getenv("SMO_SCRIPT")) return 1;
    return 0;
}
/* Writes `text` into the caller's String the way the applet's storage is copied ([sdk] 0x389ff4):
 * at most bufSize bytes, always terminated. Returns the number of bytes used including the terminator. */
static uint64_t kbd_store(uint64_t string, const wchar_t *text, int utf8) {
    uint64_t ptr = rd64(string), cap = rd64(string + 8);
    if (!ptr || !cap) return 0;
    if (utf8) {
        char tmp[SWKBD_MAX_CHARS * 4 + 4];
        int n = WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, text, -1, tmp, (int)sizeof tmp, NULL, NULL);
        if (n <= 0) { n = 1; tmp[0] = 0; }
        while ((uint64_t)n > cap) { n--; while (n > 1 && ((uint8_t)tmp[n - 1] & 0xc0) == 0x80) n--; if (n > 0) n--; tmp[n] = 0; n++; }
        memcpy((void *)(uintptr_t)ptr, tmp, (size_t)n);
        return (uint64_t)n;
    }
    uint64_t chars = wcslen(text);
    if ((chars + 1) * 2 > cap) chars = cap / 2 ? cap / 2 - 1 : 0;
    if (cap < 2) return 0;
    for (uint64_t i = 0; i < chars; i++) wr16(ptr + i * 2, (uint16_t)text[i]);
    wr16(ptr + chars * 2, 0);
    return (chars + 1) * 2;
}
static void swkbd_ShowKeyboard(Ctx *c) {
    uint64_t string = A0, arg = A1;
    static KbdDialog k;                                    /* one keyboard at a time, as on the console */
    static volatile LONG busy;
    static wchar_t header[70], sub[140], guide[260], initial[SWKBD_MAX_CHARS + 2], fixed[SWKBD_MAX_CHARS + 2];
    if (InterlockedExchange(&busy, 1)) { RET(SWKBD_RESULT_CANCELED); return; }
    copy_w(header, arg + KC_HEADER, 64);
    copy_w(sub, arg + KC_SUB, 128);
    copy_w(guide, arg + KC_GUIDE, 256);
    initial[0] = 0;
    uint64_t work = rd64(arg + ARG_WORKBUF);
    int init_len = (int)rd32(arg + KC_INITIAL_LENGTH), init_off = (int)rd32(arg + KC_INITIAL_OFFSET);
    if (work && init_len > 0 && init_len <= SWKBD_MAX_CHARS && init_off >= 0) copy_w(initial, work + (uint64_t)init_off, init_len);
    int utf8 = rd8(arg + KC_UTF8) != 0;
    int max_len = (int)rd32(arg + KC_MAXLEN), min_len = (int)rd32(arg + KC_MINLEN);
    if (max_len <= 0 || max_len > SWKBD_MAX_CHARS) max_len = SWKBD_MAX_CHARS;
    if (min_len < 0 || min_len > max_len) min_len = 0;
    uint64_t callback = rd8(arg + KC_CHECK_ENABLED) ? rd64(arg + KC_CHECK_CALLBACK) : 0, check_buf = rd64(arg + ARG_CHECKBUF);
    int mode = kbd_mode(fixed);
    uint32_t result = SWKBD_RESULT_CANCELED;
    trace_printf("     nn::swkbd::ShowKeyboard header \"%ls\" guide \"%ls\" max %d min %d%s\n", header, guide, max_len, min_len, callback ? " (text check)" : "");
    for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 16; attempt++) {
        int confirmed;
        if (mode == 1) confirmed = 0;
        else if (mode == 2) { wcsncpy(k.text, fixed, (size_t)max_len); k.text[max_len] = 0; confirmed = attempt == 0; }
        else {
            k.header = header; k.sub = sub; k.guide = guide; k.initial = initial;
            k.max_len = max_len; k.min_len = min_len; k.password = rd32(arg + KC_PASSWORD) == 1;
            confirmed = kbd_run_dialog(&k);
        }
        if (!confirmed) break;
        uint64_t bytes = kbd_store(string, k.text, utf8);
        int verdict = 0;
        if (callback && check_buf) {                       /* [sdk] 0x389ed8..0x389ef8 */
            uint64_t message_size = 0, saved_cap = rd64(string + 8), saved[12];
            for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) saved[i] = c->x[19 + i];
            wr64(string + 8, bytes);
            c->x[0] = check_buf; c->x[1] = P(&message_size); c->x[2] = string;
            call_guest(c, callback);
            verdict = (int)(uint32_t)c->x[0];
            for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) c->x[19 + i] = saved[i];
            wr64(string + 8, saved_cap);
            if (verdict) {
                wchar_t message[1024];
                if (utf8) { MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, (const char *)(uintptr_t)check_buf, -1, message, 1023); message[1023] = 0; }
                else copy_w(message, check_buf, 1000);
                trace_printf("     nn::swkbd text check -> %d \"%ls\"\n", verdict, message);
                if (mode != 0) break;                      /* a scripted answer that is refused counts as cancelled */
                if (verdict == 2 && MessageBoxW(NULL, message, L"Software keyboard", MB_YESNO | MB_ICONQUESTION | MB_TOPMOST) == IDYES) verdict = 0;
                else if (verdict != 2) MessageBoxW(NULL, message, L"Software keyboard", MB_OK | MB_ICONWARNING | MB_TOPMOST);
                if (verdict) { wcsncpy(initial, k.text, SWKBD_MAX_CHARS); initial[SWKBD_MAX_CHARS] = 0; continue; }
            }
        }
        result = 0;
        break;
    }
    if (result) trace_printf("     nn::swkbd::ShowKeyboard -> cancelled\n");
    else trace_printf("     nn::swkbd::ShowKeyboard -> \"%ls\"\n", k.text);
    InterlockedExchange(&busy, 0);
    RET(result);
}

/* ================================================================ nn::nfp */
#define NFP_RESULT(desc) ((uint32_t)(115 | ((desc) << 9)))
#define NFP_WRONG_STATE NFP_RESULT(73)
#define NFP_INVALID_ARGUMENT NFP_RESULT(65)
#define NFP_TAG_REMOVED NFP_RESULT(97)
enum { NFP_INITIALIZED, NFP_SEARCHING, NFP_FOUND, NFP_REMOVED, NFP_MOUNTED, NFP_UNAVAILABLE };
/* The reader. Its calls come from the game's NFC thread, the amiibo from the amiibo menu on the game's main thread. */
static SRWLOCK g_nfp_lock = SRWLOCK_INIT;
static int g_nfp_init, g_nfp_state = NFP_UNAVAILABLE;
static uint64_t g_nfp_ev_on, g_nfp_ev_off;                 /* the game's activate / deactivate SystemEventType, 0 = not attached */
static struct { int held, read; uint8_t id[8], uid[7]; } g_tag;   /* the amiibo held to the reader; read = the game has its model information */
static volatile LONG g_nfp_reads;                          /* amiibo the game has read (smo_amiibo.c shows it) */
static void nfp_lock(void) { AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_nfp_lock); }
static void nfp_unlock(void) { ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_nfp_lock); }
static void nfp_tag_arrives(void) {                       /* lock held, state SearchingForTag, an amiibo held */
    g_nfp_state = NFP_FOUND;
    if (g_nfp_ev_off) os_clear_event(g_nfp_ev_off);
    if (g_nfp_ev_on) os_signal_event(g_nfp_ev_on);
    printf("nfp: amiibo %02x%02x%02x%02x %02x%02x%02x%02x found by the reader\n", g_tag.id[0], g_tag.id[1], g_tag.id[2], g_tag.id[3], g_tag.id[4], g_tag.id[5], g_tag.id[6], g_tag.id[7]);
}
static void nfp_tag_leaves(void) {                        /* lock held, state TagFound or TagMounted */
    g_nfp_state = NFP_REMOVED;
    if (g_nfp_ev_on) os_clear_event(g_nfp_ev_on);
    if (g_nfp_ev_off) os_signal_event(g_nfp_ev_off);
    if (g_tag.read) { g_tag.held = 0; printf("nfp: amiibo taken away from the reader after the game read it\n"); }
}
/* smo_amiibo.c: hold an amiibo (its 8-byte identification block) to the reader, in place of the one there; NULL takes it away. */
void nfp_place_amiibo(const uint8_t *id) {
    nfp_lock();
    if (g_nfp_state == NFP_FOUND || g_nfp_state == NFP_MOUNTED) nfp_tag_leaves();        /* the one there is taken away first */
    memset(&g_tag, 0, sizeof g_tag);
    if (id) {
        uint32_t h = 2166136261u;                          /* a serial number of its own per kind of amiibo: 0x04 (NXP) + 6 bytes */
        g_tag.held = 1;
        memcpy(g_tag.id, id, 8);
        g_tag.uid[0] = 0x04;
        for (int i = 1; i < 7; i++) { for (int k = 0; k < 8; k++) h = (h ^ id[k]) * 16777619u; h = (h ^ (uint32_t)i) * 16777619u; g_tag.uid[i] = (uint8_t)(h >> 13); }
        printf("nfp: amiibo %02x%02x%02x%02x %02x%02x%02x%02x held to the reader (reader %s)\n", id[0], id[1], id[2], id[3], id[4], id[5], id[6], id[7],
               g_nfp_state == NFP_SEARCHING ? "searching" : g_nfp_init ? "not searching: found at the next search" : "not initialised");
        if (g_nfp_state == NFP_SEARCHING) nfp_tag_arrives();
    }
    nfp_unlock();
}
/* smo_amiibo.c: is an amiibo held that the game has not read yet; how many the game has read so far */
int nfp_amiibo_waiting(void) { nfp_lock(); int w = g_tag.held && !g_tag.read; nfp_unlock(); return w; }
long nfp_amiibo_reads(void) { return g_nfp_reads; }

static void nfp_Initialize(Ctx *c) { (void)c; nfp_lock(); g_nfp_init = 1; g_nfp_state = NFP_INITIALIZED; nfp_unlock(); }
static void nfp_Finalize(Ctx *c) {
    (void)c;
    nfp_lock();
    if (g_nfp_state == NFP_FOUND || g_nfp_state == NFP_MOUNTED) nfp_tag_leaves();
    g_nfp_init = 0; g_nfp_state = NFP_UNAVAILABLE;
    nfp_unlock();
}
static void nfp_GetDeviceState(Ctx *c) { RET(g_nfp_state); }
static void nfp_ListDevices(Ctx *c) {                      /* (DeviceHandle *out, int *outCount, int max) */
    if (A1) wr32(A1, 0);
    if (!g_nfp_init) { RET(NFP_WRONG_STATE); return; }
    if (!A0 || (int)A2 < 1) { RET(NFP_INVALID_ARGUMENT); return; }
    wr64(A0, 0);                                           /* the reader of npad 0 */
    if (A1) wr32(A1, 1);
    RET(0);
}
static void nfp_GetNpadId(Ctx *c) { if (!g_nfp_init) { RET(NFP_WRONG_STATE); return; } wr32(A0, 0); RET(0); }   /* (uint32_t *out, handle) */
static void nfp_attach(Ctx *c, uint64_t *slot) {           /* (SystemEventType *out, handle) */
    nfp_lock();
    os_init_event(A0, 1);
    *slot = A0;
    if (slot == &g_nfp_ev_on ? g_nfp_state == NFP_FOUND || g_nfp_state == NFP_MOUNTED : g_nfp_state == NFP_REMOVED) os_signal_event(A0);
    RET(g_nfp_init ? 0 : NFP_WRONG_STATE);
    nfp_unlock();
}
static void nfp_AttachEvent(Ctx *c) { nfp_attach(c, &g_nfp_ev_on); }                  /* AttachActivateEvent */
static void nfp_AttachDeactivateEvent(Ctx *c) { nfp_attach(c, &g_nfp_ev_off); }
static void nfp_StartDetection(Ctx *c) {
    nfp_lock();
    if (!g_nfp_init || (g_nfp_state != NFP_INITIALIZED && g_nfp_state != NFP_REMOVED)) RET(NFP_WRONG_STATE);
    else {
        g_nfp_state = NFP_SEARCHING;
        if (g_tag.held && !g_tag.read) nfp_tag_arrives();
        RET(0);
    }
    nfp_unlock();
}
static void nfp_StopDetection(Ctx *c) {
    nfp_lock();
    if (g_nfp_state == NFP_FOUND || g_nfp_state == NFP_MOUNTED) nfp_tag_leaves();
    if (g_nfp_state == NFP_INITIALIZED) RET(0);
    else if (g_nfp_state == NFP_SEARCHING || g_nfp_state == NFP_REMOVED) { g_nfp_state = NFP_INITIALIZED; RET(0); }
    else RET(NFP_WRONG_STATE);
    nfp_unlock();
}
static void nfp_Mount(Ctx *c) {                            /* (handle, ModelType, MountTarget) */
    nfp_lock();
    if (A1 != 0) RET(NFP_INVALID_ARGUMENT);                /* ModelType 0 = amiibo, the only one */
    else if (g_nfp_state != NFP_FOUND) RET(g_nfp_state == NFP_REMOVED ? NFP_TAG_REMOVED : NFP_WRONG_STATE);
    else { g_nfp_state = NFP_MOUNTED; RET(0); }
    nfp_unlock();
}
static void nfp_Unmount(Ctx *c) {
    nfp_lock();
    if (g_nfp_state != NFP_MOUNTED) RET(g_nfp_state == NFP_REMOVED ? NFP_TAG_REMOVED : NFP_WRONG_STATE);
    else {
        g_nfp_state = NFP_FOUND;
        if (g_tag.read) nfp_tag_leaves();                  /* one touch: the amiibo is taken away once the game has read it */
        RET(0);
    }
    nfp_unlock();
}
static void nfp_GetTagInfo(Ctx *c) {                       /* (TagInfo *out, handle) */
    nfp_lock();
    if (g_nfp_state != NFP_FOUND && g_nfp_state != NFP_MOUNTED) RET(g_nfp_state == NFP_REMOVED ? NFP_TAG_REMOVED : NFP_WRONG_STATE);
    else {
        uint8_t *t = (uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)A0;
        memset(t, 0, 0x58);
        memcpy(t, g_tag.uid, 7);
        t[0xa] = 7;
        wr32(A0 + 0x20, 1);                                /* NfcProtocol TypeA */
        wr32(A0 + 0x24, 2);                                /* TagType Type2 */
        RET(0);
    }
    nfp_unlock();
}
static void nfp_GetModelInfo(Ctx *c) {                     /* (ModelInfo *out, handle) */
    nfp_lock();
    if (g_nfp_state != NFP_MOUNTED) RET(g_nfp_state == NFP_REMOVED ? NFP_TAG_REMOVED : NFP_WRONG_STATE);
    else {
        uint8_t *m = (uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)A0;
        memset(m, 0, 0x40);
        m[0] = g_tag.id[0]; m[1] = g_tag.id[1]; m[2] = g_tag.id[2]; m[3] = g_tag.id[3];
        m[4] = g_tag.id[5]; m[5] = g_tag.id[4];            /* the model number, big-endian on the tag */
        m[6] = g_tag.id[6];
        if (!g_tag.read) { g_tag.read = 1; InterlockedIncrement(&g_nfp_reads); printf("nfp: the game read the amiibo's model information\n"); }
        RET(0);
    }
    nfp_unlock();
}

void register_nnapplet_imports(void) {
    int n = (int)(sizeof applet_imports / sizeof applet_imports[0]);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        if (!import_data(applet_imports[i].name)) printf("nnapplet: \"%s\" is not an import of the game (a typo, or a function it never calls)\n", applet_imports[i].name);
    register_imports(applet_imports, n);
}

/* ================================================================ self-test */
static ImportFn h(const char *name) {
    ImportFn f = import_lookup(name);
    if (!f) { printf("  no handler registered for %s\n", name); report_and_exit(3); }
    return f;
}
static int guard_ok(const uint8_t *p, size_t from, size_t to, uint8_t v) { for (size_t i = from; i < to; i++) if (p[i] != v) return 0; return 1; }
static volatile int g_kbd_test_initial_seen;
static DWORD WINAPI kbd_test_driver(LPVOID arg) {
    (void)arg;
    for (int round = 0; round < 2; round++) {
        HWND w = NULL;
        for (int i = 0; i < 500 && !w; i++) { Sleep(10); w = FindWindowW(NULL, L"Software keyboard (smo-recomp)"); }
        if (!w) return 1;
        Sleep(100);
        if (round == 0) {
            wchar_t now[64] = L"";
            GetDlgItemTextW(w, IDC_EDIT, now, 63);
            g_kbd_test_initial_seen = wcscmp(now, L"Mario") == 0;
            static const wchar_t typed[] = {'Z', 0x30bc, 0};
            SetDlgItemTextW(w, IDC_EDIT, typed);
            PostMessageW(w, WM_COMMAND, IDOK, 0);
        } else PostMessageW(w, WM_COMMAND, IDCANCEL, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < 500 && IsWindow(w); i++) Sleep(10);
    }
    return 0;
}
/* An amiibo held to the reader, in the order the game's NFC thread asks ([game] 0x95efa8): found at StartDetection with the
 * activate event signalled; Mount; TagInfo / ModelInfo; Unmount takes it away (deactivate event); searching again finds
 * nothing. Run by both self-tests (SMO_SDK_SELFTEST in nnapplet_selftest, SMO_IMPORT_SELFTEST in smo_selftest.c). */
int nfp_amiibo_selftest(Ctx *c) {
    static const uint8_t peach_wedding[8] = {0x00, 0x02, 0x00, 0x00, 0x03, 0x72, 0x09, 0x02};
    uint64_t handle = 0, on[8], off[8];
    uint8_t tag[0x60], model[0x48];
    int ok;
    memset(tag, 0xee, sizeof tag); memset(model, 0xee, sizeof model);
    long reads = nfp_amiibo_reads();
    nfp_Initialize(c);
    c->x[0] = P(on); c->x[1] = P(&handle); nfp_AttachEvent(c); ok = c->x[0] == 0;
    c->x[0] = P(off); c->x[1] = P(&handle); nfp_AttachDeactivateEvent(c); ok = ok && c->x[0] == 0;
    nfp_place_amiibo(peach_wedding);
    ok = ok && nfp_amiibo_waiting();
    c->x[0] = P(&handle); nfp_GetDeviceState(c); ok = ok && c->x[0] == NFP_INITIALIZED;        /* not searching: nothing found yet */
    c->x[0] = P(&handle); nfp_StartDetection(c); ok = ok && c->x[0] == 0;
    c->x[0] = P(&handle); nfp_GetDeviceState(c); ok = ok && c->x[0] == NFP_FOUND;
    c->x[0] = P(on); h("_ZN2nn2os18TryWaitSystemEventEPNS0_15SystemEventTypeE")(c); ok = ok && (c->x[0] & 1);
    c->x[0] = P(on); h("_ZN2nn2os18TryWaitSystemEventEPNS0_15SystemEventTypeE")(c); ok = ok && !(c->x[0] & 1);   /* AutoClear */
    c->x[0] = P(&handle); c->x[1] = 1; c->x[2] = 1; nfp_Mount(c); ok = ok && c->x[0] == NFP_INVALID_ARGUMENT;        /* ModelType 1 */
    c->x[0] = P(&handle); c->x[1] = 0; c->x[2] = 1; nfp_Mount(c); ok = ok && c->x[0] == 0;
    c->x[0] = P(&handle); nfp_GetDeviceState(c); ok = ok && c->x[0] == NFP_MOUNTED;
    c->x[0] = P(tag); c->x[1] = P(&handle); nfp_GetTagInfo(c);
    ok = ok && c->x[0] == 0 && tag[0] == 0x04 && tag[0xa] == 7 && rd32(P(tag) + 0x20) == 1 && rd32(P(tag) + 0x24) == 2 && guard_ok(tag, 0x58, sizeof tag, 0xee);
    c->x[0] = P(model); c->x[1] = P(&handle); nfp_GetModelInfo(c);
    ok = ok && c->x[0] == 0 && model[0] == 0x00 && model[1] == 0x02 && model[2] == 0x00 && rd16(P(model) + 4) == 882 && model[6] == 0x09 && guard_ok(model, 0x40, sizeof model, 0xee);
    ok = ok && nfp_amiibo_reads() == reads + 1 && !nfp_amiibo_waiting();
    c->x[0] = P(&handle); nfp_Unmount(c); ok = ok && c->x[0] == 0;
    c->x[0] = P(&handle); nfp_GetDeviceState(c); ok = ok && c->x[0] == NFP_REMOVED;
    c->x[0] = P(off); h("_ZN2nn2os18TryWaitSystemEventEPNS0_15SystemEventTypeE")(c); ok = ok && (c->x[0] & 1);
    c->x[0] = P(tag); c->x[1] = P(&handle); nfp_GetTagInfo(c); ok = ok && c->x[0] == NFP_TAG_REMOVED;
    c->x[0] = P(&handle); nfp_StartDetection(c); ok = ok && c->x[0] == 0;
    c->x[0] = P(&handle); nfp_GetDeviceState(c); ok = ok && c->x[0] == NFP_SEARCHING;             /* read once: not found again */
    c->x[0] = P(&handle); nfp_StopDetection(c); ok = ok && c->x[0] == 0;
    nfp_place_amiibo(NULL);
    nfp_Finalize(c);
    printf("  nfp: an amiibo held to the reader: found at StartDetection (activate event, AutoClear), Mount, TagInfo (type A, type 2, 7-byte serial), ModelInfo (0x000200 #882 series 9), taken away at Unmount (deactivate event, TagRemoved): %s\n", ok ? "ok" : "FAILED");
    return !ok;
}
```
