```inc
static void online_pl_EndVrMode(Ctx *c) { InterlockedExchange(&g_vr_mode, 0); RET(0); }

static const ImportDef online_defs[] = {
    {"_ZN2nn7account12AsyncContextC1Ev", online_acc_Async_ctor},
    {"_ZN2nn7account12AsyncContextD1Ev", online_acc_Async_dtor},
    {"_ZN2nn7account12AsyncContext7HasDoneEPb", online_acc_Async_HasDone}, {"_ZN2nn7account12AsyncContext9GetResultEv", online_acc_Async_GetResult},
    {"_ZN2nn7account12AsyncContext6CancelEv", online_acc_Async_Cancel},
    {"_ZN2nn7account12AsyncContext14GetSystemEventEPNS_2os11SystemEventE", online_acc_Async_GetSystemEvent},
    {"_ZN2nn7account36EnsureNetworkServiceAccountAvailableERKNS0_10UserHandleE", online_acc_EnsureAvailable},
    {"_ZN2nn7account44EnsureNetworkServiceAccountIdTokenCacheAsyncEPNS0_12AsyncContextERKNS0_10UserHandleE", online_acc_EnsureIdTokenCacheAsync},
    {"_ZN2nn7account26GetNetworkServiceAccountIdEPNS0_23NetworkServiceAccountIdERKNS0_10UserHandleE", online_acc_nsa_unavailable},
    {"_ZN2nn7account37LoadNetworkServiceAccountIdTokenCacheEPmPcmRKNS0_10UserHandleE", online_acc_nsa_unavailable},
    {"_ZN2nn7friends12AsyncContext14GetSystemEventEPNS_2os11SystemEventE", online_fr_Async_GetSystemEvent},
    {"_ZN2nn7friends12AsyncContextD1Ev", online_fr_Async_dtor}, {"_ZNK2nn7friends12AsyncContext9GetResultEv", online_fr_Async_GetResult},
    {"_ZN2nn4bcat22DeliveryCacheDirectory4OpenERKNS0_13DirectoryNameE", online_bcat_Dir_Open},
    {"_ZN2nn4bcat22DeliveryCacheDirectory4ReadEPiPNS0_27DeliveryCacheDirectoryEntryEi", online_bcat_Dir_Read},
    {"_ZN2nn4bcat22DeliveryCacheDirectoryD1Ev", online_bcat_close},
    {"_ZN2nn4bcat17DeliveryCacheFile5CloseEv", online_bcat_close}, {"_ZN2nn4bcat17DeliveryCacheFileD1Ev", online_bcat_close},
    {"_ZN2nn2pl11BeginVrModeEv", online_pl_BeginVrMode}, {"_ZN2nn2pl9EndVrModeEv", online_pl_EndVrMode},
    {"_ZN2nn4bcat17DeliveryCacheFile4OpenEPKc", online_bcat_File_Open_path},
    {"_ZNK2nn7friends7Profile12GetAccountIdEv", online_fr_Profile_GetAccountId},
};
static void online_register(void) {
    int n = (int)(sizeof online_defs / sizeof online_defs[0]);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        if (!import_data(online_defs[i].name))
            printf("nnonline: \"%s\" is not an import of the game (a typo?)\n", online_defs[i].name);
    register_imports(online_defs, n);
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- self-test */
#define ONLINE_CHECK(cond, what) do { cases++; if (!(cond)) { printf("    online FAILED: %s\n", what); bad++; } } while (0)
static int online_selftest(Ctx *c) {
    int bad = 0, cases = 0;
    /* every name is answered by the handler of this file */
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)(sizeof online_defs / sizeof online_defs[0]); i++)
        if (import_lookup(online_defs[i].name) != online_defs[i].fn) { printf("    online FAILED: %s is answered by another handler\n", online_defs[i].name); bad++; }
    cases++;

    /* nn::account */
    uint64_t a[4], b[4], handle[3] = {1, 0, 0};
    memset(a, 0xee, sizeof a); memset(b, 0xee, sizeof b);
    c->x[0] = P(a); h("_ZN2nn7account12AsyncContextC1Ev")(c);
    ONLINE_CHECK(a[0] == online_acc_vtable() && a[0] && !a[1] && !a[2] && !a[3], "account AsyncContext(): vtable + three zero words");
    c->x[0] = P(a); h("_ZN2nn7account12AsyncContextD1Ev")(c);
    ONLINE_CHECK(a[0] == online_acc_vtable() && !a[3], "account ~AsyncContext without a request");
    c->x[0] = P(handle); h("_ZN2nn7account36EnsureNetworkServiceAccountAvailableERKNS0_10UserHandleE")(c);
    ONLINE_CHECK((uint32_t)c->x[0] == 0x27c && (c->x[0] & 0x1ff) == 124 && ((c->x[0] >> 9) & 0x1fff) == 1, "EnsureNetworkServiceAccountAvailable = 124-0001");
    c->x[0] = P(b); h("_ZN2nn7account12AsyncContextC1Ev")(c);
    c->x[0] = P(b); c->x[1] = P(handle); h("_ZN2nn7account44EnsureNetworkServiceAccountIdTokenCacheAsyncEPNS0_12AsyncContextERKNS0_10UserHandleE")(c);
    ONLINE_CHECK((uint32_t)c->x[0] == 0x767c && ((c->x[0] >> 9) & 0x1fff) == 59 && !b[3], "EnsureNetworkServiceAccountIdTokenCacheAsync = 124-0059, context untouched");
    {
        uint8_t avail = 0xee;
        uint64_t id = 0xeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeull;
        c->x[0] = P(&avail); c->x[1] = P(handle); h("_ZN2nn7account32IsNetworkServiceAccountAvailableEPbRKNS0_10UserHandleE")(c);
        ONLINE_CHECK(c->x[0] == 0 && avail == 0, "IsNetworkServiceAccountAvailable = success, false");
        c->x[0] = P(&id); c->x[1] = P(handle); h("_ZN2nn7account26GetNetworkServiceAccountIdEPNS0_23NetworkServiceAccountIdERKNS0_10UserHandleE")(c);
        uint32_t r = (uint32_t)c->x[0], desc = (r >> 9) & 0x1fff;
        ONLINE_CHECK((r & 0x1ff) == 124 && desc >= 200 && desc < 270 && id == 0xeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeull, "GetNetworkServiceAccountId: a result of the SDK's 'unavailable' range, id untouched");
    }
    uint64_t uid[2] = {1, 0};
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)(sizeof online_defs / sizeof online_defs[0]); i++) {
        ImportFn f = online_defs[i].fn;
        if (f != online_acc_EnsureAvailable && f != online_acc_EnsureIdTokenCacheAsync && f != online_acc_nsa_unavailable) continue;
        c->x[0] = P(uid); c->x[1] = P(uid); c->x[2] = P(uid); c->x[3] = 0;
        f(c);
        if ((uint32_t)c->x[0] == 0x3e87a) { printf("    online FAILED: %s still answers 0x3e87a\n", online_defs[i].name); bad++; }
    }
    cases++;

    /* nn::friends */
    uint8_t ctx[0x40], ev[0x40];
    memset(ctx, 0xee, sizeof ctx);
    c->x[0] = P(ctx); h("_ZN2nn7friends12AsyncContextC1Ev")(c);
    ONLINE_CHECK(rd64(P(ctx) + 0x20) == 0, "friends AsyncContext(): no request");
    c->x[0] = P(ctx); h("_ZNK2nn7friends12AsyncContext9GetResultEv")(c);
    ONLINE_CHECK((uint32_t)c->x[0] == 0xe79, "friends AsyncContext::GetResult without a request = 121-0007");
    c->x[0] = P(ctx); c->x[1] = P(ev); h("_ZN2nn7friends12AsyncContext14GetSystemEventEPNS_2os11SystemEventE")(c);
    ONLINE_CHECK((uint32_t)c->x[0] == 0xe79, "friends AsyncContext::GetSystemEvent without a request = 121-0007");
    c->x[0] = P(ctx); h("_ZN2nn7friends12AsyncContextD1Ev")(c);

    /* nn::bcat */
    uint64_t dir = 0xeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeull, file = 0xeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeull;
    char dname[32];
    int was_mounted = g_bcat_mounted, count = 77;
    c->x[0] = P(&dir); h("_ZN2nn4bcat22DeliveryCacheDirectoryC1Ev")(c);
    c->x[0] = P(&file); h("_ZN2nn4bcat17DeliveryCacheFileC1Ev")(c);
    ONLINE_CHECK(dir == 0 && file == 0, "bcat constructors: closed objects");
    memset(dname, 0, sizeof dname);
    strcpy(dname, "bad name");
    c->x[0] = P(&dir); c->x[1] = P(dname); h("_ZN2nn4bcat22DeliveryCacheDirectory4OpenERKNS0_13DirectoryNameE")(c);
    ONLINE_CHECK((uint32_t)c->x[0] == 0x27a, "Directory::Open with an invalid name = 122-0001");
    strcpy(dname, "spirits");
    if (!was_mounted) {
        c->x[0] = P(&dir); c->x[1] = P(dname); h("_ZN2nn4bcat22DeliveryCacheDirectory4OpenERKNS0_13DirectoryNameE")(c);
        ONLINE_CHECK((uint32_t)c->x[0] == 0xa7a, "Directory::Open without a mounted storage = 122-0005");
        h("_ZN2nn4bcat25MountDeliveryCacheStorageEv")(c);
    }
    c->x[0] = P(&dir); c->x[1] = P(dname); h("_ZN2nn4bcat22DeliveryCacheDirectory4OpenERKNS0_13DirectoryNameE")(c);
    ONLINE_CHECK((uint32_t)c->x[0] == 0x47a && dir == 0, "Directory::Open in an empty delivery cache = 122-0002, still closed");
    c->x[0] = P(&dir); c->x[1] = P(&count); c->x[2] = 0; c->x[3] = 4; h("_ZN2nn4bcat22DeliveryCacheDirectory4ReadEPiPNS0_27DeliveryCacheDirectoryEntryEi")(c);
    ONLINE_CHECK((uint32_t)c->x[0] == 0xe7a && count == 77, "Directory::Read when not open = 122-0007, count untouched");
    static const struct { const char *name; int ok; } fn[] = {{"a.bin", 1}, {"A_9.msbt", 1}, {"", 0}, {"end.", 0}, {"sp ace", 0}, {"dash-x", 0},
                                                              {"0123456789012345678901234567890", 1}, {"01234567890123456789012345678901", 0}};
    int names_ok = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)(sizeof fn / sizeof fn[0]); i++) {
        char buf[40];
        memset(buf, 0, sizeof buf);
        memcpy(buf, fn[i].name, strlen(fn[i].name));
        if (online_bcat_file_ok(P(buf)) != fn[i].ok) names_ok = 0;
    }
    ONLINE_CHECK(names_ok, "FileName rule of sdk 0xc1b60 (8 names)");
    c->x[0] = P(&file); h("_ZN2nn4bcat17DeliveryCacheFile5CloseEv")(c);
    c->x[0] = P(&dir); h("_ZN2nn4bcat22DeliveryCacheDirectoryD1Ev")(c);
    c->x[0] = P(&file); h("_ZN2nn4bcat17DeliveryCacheFileD1Ev")(c);
    ONLINE_CHECK(dir == 0 && file == 0, "Close / destructors of closed objects do nothing");
    if (!was_mounted) h("_ZN2nn4bcat27UnmountDeliveryCacheStorageEv")(c);

    /* nn::pl */
    c->x[0] = 0; h("_ZN2nn4pctl27CheckStereoVisionPermissionEb")(c);
    int permitted = (int)(c->x[0] & 1);
    h("_ZN2nn2pl11BeginVrModeEv")(c);
    ONLINE_CHECK(permitted ? (c->x[0] == 0 && g_vr_mode == 1) : ((uint32_t)c->x[0] == 0xd08e && g_vr_mode == 0), "BeginVrMode follows CheckStereoVisionPermission (0xd08e when refused)");
    h("_ZN2nn2pl9EndVrModeEv")(c);
    ONLINE_CHECK(g_vr_mode == 0, "EndVrMode clears the flag");

    printf("  online: account AsyncContext + network service account answers, friends AsyncContext, bcat directory / file,\n"
           "       pl VR mode: %d cases: %s\n", cases, bad ? "FAILED" : "ok");
    return bad;
}
```

`runtime/services/nnpl.c`:

```c
/* nn::pl: the console's shared fonts, read from plain TrueType / OpenType files on the PC.
 *
 * The game draws with them in one place met so far: the map screen's legend and travel-guide pages (the Standard font;
 * 189 glyphs, 61 characters, when the map first opens; the other types draw nothing in English). For each type, in
 * this order:
 *   1. the console's own font, from your dump: %SMO_FONTS% or ..\sysdata\fonts (setup's import step puts it there);
 *   2. a free font you put in the repository's deps\fonts (Noto Sans, Noto Sans SC / TC / KR, .ttf or .otf);
 *   3. Windows' own font for that script, which every Windows PC has, so the game always starts.
 * The log line says which file each type got. The Nintendo extension fonts (button icons and symbols) have no free
 * equivalent: their fallback is the Standard one's.
 *
 * SharedFontType: 0 Standard, 1 ChineseSimple, 2 ChineseSimpleExtension, 3 ChineseTraditional,
 *                 4 Korean, 5 NintendoExtension (6: its second file). SharedFontLoadState: 0 Loading, 1 Loaded. */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <windows.h>
#include "runtime.h"
#include "hostrt.h"

#define A0 (c->x[0])
#define RET(v) (c->x[0] = (uint64_t)(v))
#define FONT_TYPES 7

static const char *const console_files[FONT_TYPES] = {
    "nintendo_udsg-r_std_003.ttf", "nintendo_udsg-r_org_zh-cn_003.ttf", "nintendo_udsg-r_ext_zh-cn_003.ttf",
    "nintendo_udjxh-db_zh-tw_003.ttf", "nintendo_udsg-r_ko_003.ttf", "nintendo_ext_003.ttf", "nintendo_ext2_003.ttf",
};
/* free fonts in deps\fonts, by script: a few spellings each (static or variable builds, .ttf or .otf) */
static const char *const free_files[FONT_TYPES][4] = {
    {"NotoSans-Regular.ttf", "NotoSans-Regular.otf", "NotoSans[wdth,wght].ttf", NULL},
    {"NotoSansSC-Regular.ttf", "NotoSansSC-Regular.otf", "NotoSansSC[wght].ttf", NULL},
    {"NotoSansSC-Regular.ttf", "NotoSansSC-Regular.otf", "NotoSansSC[wght].ttf", NULL},
    {"NotoSansTC-Regular.ttf", "NotoSansTC-Regular.otf", "NotoSansTC[wght].ttf", NULL},
    {"NotoSansKR-Regular.ttf", "NotoSansKR-Regular.otf", "NotoSansKR[wght].ttf", NULL},
    {"NotoSans-Regular.ttf", "NotoSans-Regular.otf", "NotoSans[wdth,wght].ttf", NULL},
    {"NotoSans-Regular.ttf", "NotoSans-Regular.otf", "NotoSans[wdth,wght].ttf", NULL},
};
/* Windows' own, in %WINDIR%\Fonts: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, Microsoft JhengHei, Malgun Gothic */
static const char *const windows_files[FONT_TYPES] = {"segoeui.ttf", "msyh.ttc", "msyh.ttc", "msjh.ttc", "malgun.ttf", "segoeui.ttf", "segoeui.ttf"};
static struct { void *data; size_t size; int tried; } g_fonts[FONT_TYPES];
static CRITICAL_SECTION g_lock;

static int read_font(unsigned type, const char *path) {
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "rb");
    if (!f) return 0;
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);
    long size = ftell(f);
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);
    void *data = size > 0 ? _aligned_malloc((size_t)size + 16, 4096) : NULL;
    int ok = data && fread(data, 1, (size_t)size, f) == (size_t)size;
    fclose(f);
    if (!ok) { _aligned_free(data); return 0; }
    g_fonts[type].data = data;
    g_fonts[type].size = (size_t)size;
    return 1;
}

static void load_font(unsigned type) {
    if (type >= FONT_TYPES) return;
    EnterCriticalSection(&g_lock);
    if (!g_fonts[type].tried) {
        g_fonts[type].tried = 1;
        char path[MAX_PATH] = "";
        const char *dir = getenv("SMO_FONTS"), *from = "the console's (your dump)";
        snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s\\%s", dir ? dir : "..\\sysdata\\fonts", console_files[type]);
        int ok = read_font(type, path);
        for (int k = 0; !ok && free_files[type][k]; k++) {
            snprintf(path, sizeof path, "..\\..\\deps\\fonts\\%s", free_files[type][k]);
            if ((ok = read_font(type, path))) from = "a free font (deps\\fonts)";
        }
        if (!ok) {
            char windir[MAX_PATH] = "C:\\Windows";
            GetWindowsDirectoryA(windir, sizeof windir);
            snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s\\Fonts\\%s", windir, windows_files[type]);
            if ((ok = read_font(type, path))) from = "Windows' own (no dumped or free font found)";
        }
        printf("nn::pl: shared font %u %s (%s, %zu bytes)%s%s\n", type, ok ? "loaded" : "NOT FOUND", path, g_fonts[type].size,
               ok ? ": " : "", ok ? from : "");
        if (!ok) {
            printf("nn::pl: no font for shared font type %u (not in your dump, deps\\fonts or %%WINDIR%%\\Fonts): stopping\n", type);
            fflush(stdout);
            report_and_exit(7);
        }
    }
    LeaveCriticalSection(&g_lock);
}

static void pl_GetSharedFontLoadState(Ctx *c) { load_font((unsigned)A0); RET(1); }
static void pl_GetSharedFontAddress(Ctx *c) { unsigned t = (unsigned)A0; load_font(t); RET(t < FONT_TYPES ? (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)g_fonts[t].data : 0); }
static void pl_GetSharedFontSize(Ctx *c) { unsigned t = (unsigned)A0; load_font(t); RET(t < FONT_TYPES ? g_fonts[t].size : 0); }
static void nothing(Ctx *c) { (void)c; }

static const ImportDef pl_imports[] = {
    {"_ZN2nn2pl22GetSharedFontLoadStateENS0_14SharedFontTypeE", pl_GetSharedFontLoadState},
    {"_ZN2nn2pl20GetSharedFontAddressENS0_14SharedFontTypeE", pl_GetSharedFontAddress},
    {"_ZN2nn2pl17GetSharedFontSizeENS0_14SharedFontTypeE", pl_GetSharedFontSize},
    {"_ZN2nn2pl11BeginVrModeEv", nothing}, {"_ZN2nn2pl9EndVrModeEv", nothing},
};

void register_pl_imports(void) {
    InitializeCriticalSection(&g_lock);
    register_imports(pl_imports, (int)(sizeof pl_imports / sizeof pl_imports[0]));
}
```

`runtime/services/nnservices.c`:

```c
/* The service families: registration, a few SDK functions of their own (image, the lifted C library and allocators),
 * and the self-test of all of them.
 *
 *   sdklift_rt.c / sdklift_gen.c   code lifted out of the real SDK module (pure functions, exact behaviour)
 *   nnapplet.c   library applets: nn::web offline pages, nn::swkbd; nn::nfp; nn::oe volume
 *   nnnet.c      nn::ssl C API, nn::socket leftovers, nn::bcat, nn::friends, nn::account, glslc
 *   nnfsdir.c    nn::fs directory functions
 *
 * SMO_SDK_SELFTEST=1: run the tests below right after registration and exit (exit code = failures).
 * SMO_DUMP_UNREG2=<file>: names of SDK imports (nn..., glslc...) still without a handler after this
 * file's registrations. */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <windows.h>
#include "sdklift.h"

void register_nnapplet_imports(void);
void register_nnnet_imports(void);
void register_nnfsdir_imports(void);
int nnapplet_selftest(Ctx *c);
int nnnet_selftest(Ctx *c);
int nnfsdir_selftest(Ctx *c);
int nnfs_selftest(Ctx *c);
int bcat_selftest(Ctx *c);
int nnhid_selftest(Ctx *c);
int nvn_sdk_selftest(Ctx *c);
int nntime_selftest(Ctx *c);
void nnnet_register_final(void);

#define P(v) ((uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(v))
#include "sdktest_data.h"

static ImportFn handler(const char *name) {
    ImportFn f = import_lookup(name);
    if (!f) { printf("  no handler registered for %s\n", name); report_and_exit(3); }
    return f;
}

/* ---- nn::image */
#define IMG(n) "_ZN2nn5image" n
static int jpeg_decode(Ctx *c, const uint8_t *data, size_t size, uint8_t **pixels, int *w, int *h, const char *label) {
    uint8_t *dec = calloc(1, 0x200);
    memset(dec + 0x100, 0x77, 0x100);
    c->x[0] = P(dec); handler(IMG("11JpegDecoderC1Ev"))(c);
    c->x[0] = P(dec); c->x[1] = P(data); c->x[2] = size; handler(IMG("11JpegDecoder12SetImageDataEPKvm"))(c);
    c->x[0] = P(dec); handler(IMG("11JpegDecoder7AnalyzeEv"))(c);
    int status = (int)c->x[0];
    if (status) { printf("  jpeg: %s: Analyze status %d\n", label, status); free(dec); return 1; }
    c->x[0] = P(dec); handler("_ZNK2nn5image11JpegDecoder20GetAnalyzedDimensionEv")(c);
    *w = (int)(uint32_t)c->x[0]; *h = (int)(c->x[0] >> 32);
    c->x[0] = P(dec); handler("_ZNK2nn5image11JpegDecoder25GetAnalyzedWorkBufferSizeEv")(c);
    size_t work_size = (size_t)c->x[0];
    if (*w <= 0 || *h <= 0 || *w > 4096 || *h > 4096 || work_size > (64u << 20)) { printf("  jpeg: %s: implausible analysis %dx%d work %zu\n", label, *w, *h, work_size); free(dec); return 1; }
    uint8_t *work = malloc(work_size + 64);
    size_t pix_size = (size_t)*w * (size_t)*h * 4;
    *pixels = malloc(pix_size + 64);
    memset(*pixels + pix_size, 0x3c, 64);
    memset(work + work_size, 0x3c, 64);
    c->x[0] = P(dec); c->x[1] = P(*pixels); c->x[2] = pix_size; c->x[3] = 1; c->x[4] = P(work); c->x[5] = work_size;
    handler(IMG("11JpegDecoder6DecodeEPvmiS2_m"))(c);
    status = (int)c->x[0];
    int bad = status != 0;
    if (status) printf("  jpeg: %s: Decode status %d\n", label, status);
    for (int k = 0; k < 64; k++) if ((*pixels)[pix_size + k] != 0x3c || work[work_size + k] != 0x3c) { printf("  jpeg: %s: wrote past a buffer\n", label); bad = 1; break; }
    for (int k = 0; k < 0x100; k++) if (dec[0x100 + k] != 0x77) { printf("  jpeg: %s: decoder object larger than 0x100\n", label); bad = 1; break; }
    c->x[0] = P(dec); handler(IMG("11JpegDecoderD1Ev"))(c);
    free(work); free(dec);
    return bad;
}
static int jpeg_selftest(Ctx *c) {
    int bad = 0, n = (int)(sizeof jvecs / sizeof jvecs[0]);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        uint8_t *px = NULL;
        int w = 0, h = 0;
        if (jpeg_decode(c, jvecs[i].data, jvecs[i].size, &px, &w, &h, jvecs[i].name)) { bad++; continue; }
        int maxd = 0, alpha_ok = 1;
        long long sum = 0;
        if (w != jvecs[i].width || h != jvecs[i].height) { printf("  jpeg: %s: %dx%d, expected %dx%d\n", jvecs[i].name, w, h, jvecs[i].width, jvecs[i].height); bad++; free(px); continue; }
        for (int k = 0; k < w * h; k++) {
            for (int ch = 0; ch < 3; ch++) { int dlt = abs((int)px[k * 4 + ch] - (int)jvecs[i].rgb[k * 3 + ch]); if (dlt > maxd) maxd = dlt; sum += dlt; }
            if (px[k * 4 + 3] != 0xff) alpha_ok = 0;
        }
        /* Pillow (libjpeg-turbo) smooths subsampled chroma ("fancy upsampling"); the SDK's decoder replicates it.
         * Full-resolution chroma (4:4:4) has no such step and must agree to the last bit. */
        int subsampled = strcmp(jvecs[i].name, "j444") != 0;
        int ok = maxd <= (subsampled ? 16 : 0) && alpha_ok;
        printf("  jpeg: decode %s %dx%d vs Pillow: max channel difference %d, mean %.3f, alpha %s: %s\n", jvecs[i].name, w, h, maxd,
               (double)sum / (w * h * 3), alpha_ok ? "0xff" : "NOT 0xff", ok ? "ok" : "FAILED");
        bad += !ok;
        free(px);
    }
    /* corrupt data must give an error status, not a crash (libjpeg's error exit goes through setjmp/longjmp) */
    {
        uint8_t *copy = malloc(jvecs[0].size), *px = NULL;
        int w, h;
        memcpy(copy, jvecs[0].data, jvecs[0].size);
        for (unsigned k = jvecs[0].size / 2; k < jvecs[0].size / 2 + 40 && k < jvecs[0].size; k++) copy[k] = 0xff;
        copy[jvecs[0].size / 2 + 41] = 0xd9;
        int r = jpeg_decode(c, copy, jvecs[0].size / 2 + 42, &px, &w, &h, "truncated (expected to fail)");
        printf("  jpeg: truncated/corrupt stream handled without crash: %s\n", r ? "error status returned" : "decoded (libjpeg tolerated it)");
        free(copy); free(px);
    }
    /* encode -> decode round trip: 40x24 RGBA gradient, quality 95, both pixel formats' default sampling */
    {
        int w = 40, h = 24;
        uint8_t *src = malloc((size_t)w * h * 4), *enc = calloc(1, 0x200), *jpg = malloc(1 << 16);
        for (int y = 0; y < h; y++) for (int x = 0; x < w; x++) {
            uint8_t *p = src + (y * w + x) * 4;
            p[0] = (uint8_t)(x * 255 / (w - 1)); p[1] = (uint8_t)(y * 255 / (h - 1)); p[2] = (uint8_t)((x + y) * 255 / (w + h - 2)); p[3] = 0xff;
        }
        uint32_t dim[2] = {(uint32_t)w, (uint32_t)h};
        uint64_t out_size = 0;
        memset(enc + 0x100, 0x77, 0x100);
        c->x[0] = P(enc); handler(IMG("11JpegEncoderC1Ev"))(c);
        c->x[0] = P(enc); c->x[1] = P(src); c->x[2] = 0; c->x[3] = P(dim); c->x[4] = 1;
        handler(IMG("11JpegEncoder12SetPixelDataEPKvNS0_11PixelFormatERKNS0_9DimensionEi"))(c);
        c->x[0] = P(enc); c->x[1] = 95; handler(IMG("11JpegEncoder10SetQualityEi"))(c);
        c->x[0] = P(enc); handler(IMG("11JpegEncoder7AnalyzeEv"))(c);
        int status = (int)c->x[0];
        c->x[0] = P(enc); handler("_ZNK2nn5image11JpegEncoder25GetAnalyzedWorkBufferSizeEv")(c);
        size_t work_size = (size_t)c->x[0];
        uint8_t *work = malloc(work_size + 64);
        memset(jpg, 0x3c, 1 << 16);
        if (!status && work_size < (64u << 20)) {
            c->x[0] = P(enc); c->x[1] = P(&out_size); c->x[2] = P(jpg); c->x[3] = (1 << 16) - 64; c->x[4] = P(work); c->x[5] = work_size; c->x[6] = 0;
            handler(IMG("11JpegEncoder6EncodeEPmPvmS3_mPNS0_11ExifBuilderE"))(c);
            status = (int)c->x[0];
        }
        int ok = status == 0 && out_size > 100 && out_size < (1 << 16) - 64 && jpg[0] == 0xff && jpg[1] == 0xd8 && jpg[out_size - 2] == 0xff && jpg[out_size - 1] == 0xd9;
        for (int k = 0; k < 64; k++) if (jpg[(1 << 16) - 64 + k] != 0x3c) ok = 0;
        for (int k = 0; k < 0x100; k++) if (enc[0x100 + k] != 0x77) ok = 0;
        printf("  jpeg: encode 40x24 RGBA32 q95: status %d, %llu bytes, SOI/EOI %s\n", status, (unsigned long long)out_size, ok ? "ok" : "FAILED");
        if (ok) {
            uint8_t *px = NULL;
            int dw = 0, dh = 0, maxd = 0;
            if (jpeg_decode(c, jpg, (size_t)out_size, &px, &dw, &dh, "round trip") || dw != w || dh != h) ok = 0;
            else for (int k = 0; k < w * h * 4; k++) { int dlt = abs((int)px[k] - (int)src[k]); if (dlt > maxd) maxd = dlt; }
            if (ok && maxd > 24) ok = 0;
            printf("  jpeg: round trip decode %dx%d: max channel difference %d: %s\n", dw, dh, maxd, ok ? "ok" : "FAILED");
            free(px);
        }
        bad += !ok;
        c->x[0] = P(enc); handler(IMG("11JpegEncoderD1Ev"))(c);
        free(work); free(src); free(enc); free(jpg);
    }
    return bad;
}

/* SMO_DUMP_UNREG2 */
static void dump_unregistered(void) {
    const char *path = getenv("SMO_DUMP_UNREG2");
    if (!path || !path[0]) return;
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "w");
    if (!f) return;
    for (int i = 0; i < dyn_sym_count; i++) {
        const char *n = dyn_syms[i].name;
        if (dyn_syms[i].defined || !n[0] || import_lookup(n)) continue;
        if (strncmp(n, "_ZN2nn", 6) && strncmp(n, "_ZNK2nn", 7) && strncmp(n, "nn", 2) && strncmp(n, "glslc", 5)) continue;
        int is_data = 0;
        for (int k = 0; k < sdk_data_count; k++) if (strcmp(sdk_data[k].name, n) == 0) is_data = 1;
        if (!is_data) fprintf(f, "%s\n", n);
    }
    fclose(f);
}

/* ---- C library / libm / small SDK classes that run as lifted sdk.elf code (sdklift_install.h): each is called
 * through the handler the game gets and compared with an independent reference (the host C library, a closed
 * formula, a published test vector). Math: musl and the Microsoft CRT are not bit-identical, so the test only
 * demands agreement within 4 ulp and prints how many results differ in the last bits (that number is what the
 * game no longer sees with the lifted code). */
#include <math.h>
static float callf1(Ctx *c, ImportFn f, float a) { memset(&c->v[0], 0, 16); c->v[0].f[0] = a; f(c); return c->v[0].f[0]; }
static float callf2(Ctx *c, ImportFn f, float a, float b) { memset(&c->v[0], 0, 32); c->v[0].f[0] = a; c->v[1].f[0] = b; f(c); return c->v[0].f[0]; }
static double calld2(Ctx *c, ImportFn f, double a, double b) { memset(&c->v[0], 0, 32); c->v[0].df[0] = a; c->v[1].df[0] = b; f(c); return c->v[0].df[0]; }
static long long ulp_f(float a, float b) {
    int32_t x, y;
    if (a != a && b != b) return 0;
    if (a != a || b != b) return 1 << 30;
    memcpy(&x, &a, 4); memcpy(&y, &b, 4);
    if (x < 0) x = (int32_t)0x80000000 - x;
    if (y < 0) y = (int32_t)0x80000000 - y;
    return llabs((long long)x - (long long)y);
}
static long long ulp_d(double a, double b) {
    int64_t x, y;
    if (a != a && b != b) return 0;
    if (a != a || b != b) return 1 << 30;
    memcpy(&x, &a, 8); memcpy(&y, &b, 8);
    if (x < 0) x = (int64_t)0x8000000000000000ull - x;
    if (y < 0) y = (int64_t)0x8000000000000000ull - y;
    long long d = (long long)(x - y);
    return d < 0 ? -d : d;
}
static void selftest_cmp_int(Ctx *c) { int a = (int)rd32(c->x[0]), b = (int)rd32(c->x[1]); c->x[0] = (uint64_t)(int64_t)((a > b) - (a < b)); }
static int libc_selftest(Ctx *c) {
    int bad = 0;
    static const struct { const char *name; float (*ref)(float); float lo, hi; } f1[] = {
        {"sinf", sinf, -20, 20}, {"cosf", cosf, -20, 20}, {"tanf", tanf, -1.5f, 1.5f}, {"asinf", asinf, -1, 1}, {"acosf", acosf, -1, 1},
        {"atanf", atanf, -50, 50}, {"expf", expf, -20, 20}, {"exp2f", exp2f, -30, 30}, {"logf", logf, 1e-6f, 1e6f},
        {"log10f", log10f, 1e-6f, 1e6f}, {"sqrtf", sqrtf, 0, 1e6f},
    };
    static const struct { const char *name; float (*ref)(float, float); float lo, hi; } f2[] = {
        {"atan2f", atan2f, -10, 10}, {"powf", powf, 0.01f, 12}, {"fmodf", fmodf, -100, 100},
    };
    static const struct { const char *name; double (*ref)(double, double); double lo, hi; } d2[] = { {"pow", pow, 0.01, 12} };
    enum { N = 4000 };
    for (unsigned k = 0; k < sizeof f1 / sizeof f1[0]; k++) {
        ImportFn f = handler(f1[k].name);
        long long worst = 0; int differ = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
            float x = f1[k].lo + (f1[k].hi - f1[k].lo) * (float)i / N;
            long long u = ulp_f(callf1(c, f, x), f1[k].ref(x));
            if (u) differ++;
            if (u > worst) worst = u;
        }
        printf("  libm: %-7s %d of %d results differ from the host CRT in the last bits (largest %lld ulp): %s\n", f1[k].name, differ, N + 1, worst, worst <= 4 ? "ok" : "FAILED");
        bad += worst > 4;
    }
    for (unsigned k = 0; k < sizeof f2 / sizeof f2[0]; k++) {
        ImportFn f = handler(f2[k].name);
        long long worst = 0; int differ = 0, n = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 60; i++) for (int j = 0; j <= 60; j++, n++) {
            float x = f2[k].lo + (f2[k].hi - f2[k].lo) * (float)i / 60, y = f2[k].lo + (f2[k].hi - f2[k].lo) * (float)j / 61 + 0.0131f;
            if (!strcmp(f2[k].name, "powf")) y = (y - 6) * 1.5f;
            long long u = ulp_f(callf2(c, f, x, y), f2[k].ref(x, y));
            if (u) differ++;
            if (u > worst) worst = u;
        }
        printf("  libm: %-7s %d of %d results differ from the host CRT in the last bits (largest %lld ulp): %s\n", f2[k].name, differ, n, worst, worst <= 4 ? "ok" : "FAILED");
        bad += worst > 4;
    }
    for (unsigned k = 0; k < sizeof d2 / sizeof d2[0]; k++) {
        ImportFn f = handler(d2[k].name);
        long long worst = 0; int differ = 0, n = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 60; i++) for (int j = 0; j <= 60; j++, n++) {
            double x = d2[k].lo + (d2[k].hi - d2[k].lo) * (double)i / 60, y = d2[k].lo + (d2[k].hi - d2[k].lo) * (double)j / 61 + 0.0131;
            if (!strcmp(d2[k].name, "pow")) y = (y - 6) * 1.5;
            long long u = ulp_d(calld2(c, f, x, y), d2[k].ref(x, y));
            if (u) differ++;
            if (u > worst) worst = u;
        }
        printf("  libm: %-7s %d of %d results differ from the host CRT in the last bits (largest %lld ulp): %s\n", d2[k].name, differ, n, worst, worst <= 4 ? "ok" : "FAILED");
        bad += worst > 4;
    }
    {   /* strings and memory against the host C library */
        static char a[64] = "the quick brown fox", b[64], m[64];
        int ok = 1;
        c->x[0] = P(a); handler("strlen")(c); ok &= c->x[0] == strlen(a);
        c->x[0] = P(b); c->x[1] = P(a); handler("strcpy")(c); ok &= !strcmp(a, b);
        c->x[0] = P(a); c->x[1] = P("the quick brown fo"); handler("strcmp")(c); ok &= (int)c->x[0] > 0;
        c->x[0] = P(a); c->x[1] = P("brown"); handler("strstr")(c); ok &= c->x[0] == P(a + 10);
        c->x[0] = P(a); c->x[1] = 'q'; handler("strchr")(c); ok &= c->x[0] == P(a + 4);
        for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++) m[i] = (char)i;
        c->x[0] = P(m + 3); c->x[1] = P(m); c->x[2] = 40; handler("memmove")(c);
        for (int i = 0; i < 40; i++) ok &= m[3 + i] == (char)i;
        c->x[0] = P(m); c->x[1] = 0x5a; c->x[2] = 64; handler("memset")(c);
        for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++) ok &= m[i] == 0x5a;
        c->x[0] = P(b); c->x[1] = P(a); c->x[2] = 20; handler("memcmp")(c); ok &= (int)c->x[0] == 0;
        c->x[0] = P("  -1234xyz"); handler("atoi")(c); ok &= (int)c->x[0] == -1234;
        c->x[0] = P("-0x1f"); c->x[1] = 0; c->x[2] = 0; handler("strtol")(c); ok &= (int64_t)c->x[0] == -31;
        c->x[0] = 'Q'; handler("tolower")(c); ok &= (int)c->x[0] == 'q';
        printf("  libc: strlen strcpy strcmp strstr strchr memmove memset memcmp atoi strtol tolower: %s\n", ok ? "ok" : "FAILED");
        bad += !ok;
    }
    {   /* snprintf with integer, string and floating-point arguments (AArch64 variadic call: x3.., v0..) */
        char out[128], ref[128];
        memset(&c->v[0], 0, 32);
        c->x[0] = P(out); c->x[1] = sizeof out; c->x[2] = P("%d|%5.2f|%s|%x|%lld|%e|%g"); c->x[3] = (uint64_t)(int64_t)-42; c->x[4] = P("str"); c->x[5] = 0xbeef;
        c->x[6] = (uint64_t)-1234567890123ll; c->v[0].df[0] = 3.14159; c->v[1].df[0] = 12345.678; c->v[2].df[0] = 0.0001;
        handler("snprintf")(c);
        snprintf(ref, sizeof ref, "%d|%5.2f|%s|%x|%lld|%e|%g", -42, 3.14159, "str", 0xbeef, -1234567890123ll, 12345.678, 0.0001);
        int ok = !strcmp(out, ref) && (int)c->x[0] == (int)strlen(ref);
        printf("  libc: snprintf \"%s\": %s\n", out, ok ? "ok" : "FAILED");
        bad += !ok;
    }
    {   /* qsort with a guest callback, errno location, tick conversion, calendar, MD5, frame heap */
        int v[9] = {5, -3, 9, 0, 7, 7, -8, 2, 1}, ok = 1;
        c->x[0] = P(v); c->x[1] = 9; c->x[2] = 4; c->x[3] = hostfn_address("audit self-test comparator", selftest_cmp_int);
        handler("qsort")(c);
        for (int i = 1; i < 9; i++) ok &= v[i - 1] <= v[i];
        printf("  libc: qsort through a guest callback: %s\n", ok ? "ok" : "FAILED");
        bad += !ok;
        handler("__errno_location")(c);
        ok = c->x[0] == c->tpidr + 0x1d8;
        printf("  libc: errno lives in the thread's own block (thread pointer + 0x1d8): %s\n", ok ? "ok" : "FAILED");
        bad += !ok;
        c->x[0] = 19200000ull * 3; handler("_ZN2nn2os17ConvertToTimeSpanENS0_4TickE")(c); ok = c->x[0] == 3000000000ull;
        c->x[0] = 2500000000ull; handler("_ZN2nn2os13ConvertToTickENS_8TimeSpanE")(c); ok &= c->x[0] == 48000000ull;
        c->x[0] = 0x7fffffffffull; handler("_ZN2nn2os17ConvertToTimeSpanENS0_4TickE")(c); ok &= c->x[0] == (uint64_t)(((unsigned __int128)0x7fffffffffull * 1000000000ull) / 19200000ull);
        printf("  nn::os: tick <-> time span conversions are exact integers: %s\n", ok ? "ok" : "FAILED");
        bad += !ok;
        /* CalendarTime { u16 year, u8 month, day, hour, minute, second }: 2023-11-14 22:13:20 UTC = posix 1700000000 */
        uint64_t cal = 2023 | 11ull << 16 | 14ull << 24 | 22ull << 32 | 13ull << 40 | 20ull << 48;
        c->x[0] = P(&cal); handler("_ZN2nn4time18ToPosixTimeFromUtcERKNS0_12CalendarTimeE")(c); ok = (int64_t)c->x[0] == 1700000000;
        printf("  nn::time: ToPosixTimeFromUtc(2023-11-14 22:13:20) = 1700000000: %s\n", ok ? "ok" : "FAILED");
        bad += !ok;
        uint8_t *md5 = calloc(1, 0x400), digest[16];
        static const uint8_t md5_abc[16] = {0x90, 0x01, 0x50, 0x98, 0x3c, 0xd2, 0x4f, 0xb0, 0xd6, 0x96, 0x3f, 0x7d, 0x28, 0xe1, 0x7f, 0x72};
        c->x[0] = P(md5); handler("_ZN2nn6crypto6detail7Md5Impl10InitializeEv")(c);
        c->x[0] = P(md5); c->x[1] = P("abc"); c->x[2] = 3; handler("_ZN2nn6crypto6detail7Md5Impl6UpdateEPKvm")(c);
        c->x[0] = P(md5); c->x[1] = P(digest); c->x[2] = 16; handler("_ZN2nn6crypto6detail7Md5Impl7GetHashEPvm")(c);
        ok = !memcmp(digest, md5_abc, 16);
        printf("  nn::crypto: MD5(\"abc\") = RFC 1321 test vector: %s\n", ok ? "ok" : "FAILED");
        bad += !ok;
        free(md5);
        uint8_t *region = _aligned_malloc(0x4000, 0x1000);
        c->x[0] = P(region); c->x[1] = 0x4000; c->x[2] = 0; handler("_ZN2nn4lmem15CreateFrameHeapEPvmi")(c);
        uint64_t heap = c->x[0], p1, p2;
        c->x[0] = heap; c->x[1] = 0x100; c->x[2] = 16; handler("_ZN2nn4lmem21AllocateFromFrameHeapEPNS0_6detail8HeapHeadEmi")(c); p1 = c->x[0];
        c->x[0] = heap; c->x[1] = 0x100; c->x[2] = 64; handler("_ZN2nn4lmem21AllocateFromFrameHeapEPNS0_6detail8HeapHeadEmi")(c); p2 = c->x[0];
        ok = heap && p1 >= P(region) && p2 >= p1 + 0x100 && p2 + 0x100 <= P(region) + 0x4000 && !(p1 & 15) && !(p2 & 63);
        c->x[0] = heap; c->x[1] = 0x8000; c->x[2] = 16; handler("_ZN2nn4lmem21AllocateFromFrameHeapEPNS0_6detail8HeapHeadEmi")(c); ok &= c->x[0] == 0;
        c->x[0] = heap; handler("_ZN2nn4lmem16DestroyFrameHeapEPNS0_6detail8HeapHeadE")(c);
        printf("  nn::lmem: frame heap inside the caller's region, aligned blocks, too-large request refused: %s\n", ok ? "ok" : "FAILED");
        bad += !ok;
        _aligned_free(region);
    }
    return bad;
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- under the lifted nn::mem::StandardAllocator
 * (sdklift_roots.txt `cut` lines). The allocator itself (nlib nmalloc, 86 functions) is the SDK's code; these are the
 * functions below it that end in kernel calls or in musl's per-thread data.
 *   pthread_once            musl: control word 0 = not run, 1 = running, 2 = done; the routine runs exactly once
 *   pthread_key_*           on the host's nn::os TLS slots (the console's musl does the same through __nnmusl_AllocateTlsSlot)
 *   nn::os::AllocateMemoryBlock / FreeMemoryBlock   [sdk 0x3326b0 / 0x3326f0] pages of the memory heap; failure = 0x1003
 *                           ([sdk 0x3355d8] os OutOfMemory). Host: committed pages from Windows.
 *   nn::os::SetMemoryPermission   [sdk 0x339730] accepts 0 (none), 1 (read), 3 (read-write) -> VirtualProtect
 *   nn::os::SetMemoryAttribute    cache attribute of a mapping (svc 3): no counterpart for ordinary host pages
 *   nn::os::IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled   [sdk 0x336af0] kernel GetInfo(16): true for a 64-bit application
 * The game gives its StandardAllocator a buffer (trace: Initialize(this, buffer, 0x100000) from 0x71036f8780), so the
 * memory-block functions are only reached by the self-test's buffer-less allocator. */
static void pt_once(Ctx *c) {
    volatile LONG *ctl = (volatile LONG *)(uintptr_t)c->x[0];
    uint64_t fn = c->x[1];
    for (;;) {
        LONG v = InterlockedCompareExchange(ctl, 1, 0);
        if (v == 2) break;
        if (v == 0) { call_guest(c, fn); InterlockedExchange(ctl, 2); break; }
        SwitchToThread();
    }
    c->x[0] = 0;
}
static void pt_key_create(Ctx *c) { uint64_t key = c->x[0]; handler("_ZN2nn2os15AllocateTlsSlotEPNS0_7TlsSlotEPFvmE")(c); (void)key; c->x[0] = 0; }
static void pt_getspecific(Ctx *c) { c->x[0] &= 0xffffffffu; handler("_ZN2nn2os11GetTlsValueENS0_7TlsSlotE")(c); }
static void pt_setspecific(Ctx *c) { c->x[0] &= 0xffffffffu; handler("_ZN2nn2os11SetTlsValueENS0_7TlsSlotEm")(c); c->x[0] = 0; }
static void os_AllocateMemoryBlock(Ctx *c) {
    void *p = VirtualAlloc(NULL, (SIZE_T)c->x[1], MEM_RESERVE | MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE);
    if (p) wr64(c->x[0], P(p));
    c->x[0] = p ? 0 : 0x1003;
}
static void os_FreeMemoryBlock(Ctx *c) { VirtualFree((void *)(uintptr_t)c->x[0], 0, MEM_RELEASE); }
static void os_SetMemoryPermission(Ctx *c) {
    DWORD old, prot = (uint32_t)c->x[2] == 3 ? PAGE_READWRITE : (uint32_t)c->x[2] == 1 ? PAGE_READONLY : PAGE_NOACCESS;
    if ((uint32_t)c->x[2] != 0 && (uint32_t)c->x[2] != 1 && (uint32_t)c->x[2] != 3) guest_trap("nn::os::SetMemoryPermission: invalid permission", c->x[30] - 4);
    if (!VirtualProtect((void *)(uintptr_t)c->x[0], (SIZE_T)c->x[1], prot, &old)) guest_trap("nn::os::SetMemoryPermission: VirtualProtect failed", c->x[0]);
}
static void os_SetMemoryAttribute(Ctx *c) { (void)c; }
static void os_FreeAddressRegion2(Ctx *c) { VirtualFree((void *)(uintptr_t)c->x[0], 0, MEM_RELEASE); c->x[0] = 0; }
static void os_IsVammEnabled(Ctx *c) { c->x[0] = 1; }
static void install_mem_overrides(void) {
    sdk_host_override("pthread_once", pt_once);
    sdk_host_override("pthread_key_create", pt_key_create);
    sdk_host_override("pthread_getspecific", pt_getspecific);
    sdk_host_override("pthread_setspecific", pt_setspecific);
    sdk_host_override("_ZN2nn2os19AllocateMemoryBlockEPmm", os_AllocateMemoryBlock);
    sdk_host_override("_ZN2nn2os15FreeMemoryBlockEmm", os_FreeMemoryBlock);
    sdk_host_override("_ZN2nn2os19SetMemoryPermissionEmmNS0_16MemoryPermissionE", os_SetMemoryPermission);
    sdk_host_override("_ZN2nn2os18SetMemoryAttributeEmmNS0_15MemoryAttributeE", os_SetMemoryAttribute);
    sdk_host_override("_ZN2nn2os17FreeAddressRegionEm", os_FreeAddressRegion2);
    sdk_host_override("_ZN2nn2os29IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabledEv", os_IsVammEnabled);
}

/* ---- nn::mem::NumberLineAllocator and StandardAllocator: the lifted SDK classes, driven like the game drives them */
static void st_alloc_cb(Ctx *c) { c->x[0] = P(_aligned_malloc((size_t)c->x[0], 16)); }      /* void *(*)(size_t, void *) */
static void st_free_cb(Ctx *c) { _aligned_free((void *)(uintptr_t)c->x[0]); }               /* void (*)(void *, void *) */
static int mem_selftest(Ctx *c) {
    int bad = 0;
    #define MEMCHECK(cond, text) do { if (!(cond)) { printf("  FAIL mem: %s\n", text); bad++; } } while (0)
    ImportFn nla_init = sdk_lifted("_ZN2nn3mem19NumberLineAllocator10InitializeEPFPvmS2_ES2_PFvS2_S2_ES2_b"), nla_add = sdk_lifted("_ZN2nn3mem19NumberLineAllocator8AddRangeEii"),
             nla_alloc = sdk_lifted("_ZN2nn3mem19NumberLineAllocator8AllocateEPii"), nla_free = sdk_lifted("_ZN2nn3mem19NumberLineAllocator4FreeEi");
    if (!nla_init || !nla_add || !nla_alloc || !nla_free) { printf("  FAIL mem: NumberLineAllocator is not lifted\n"); return 1; }
    uint64_t *obj = _aligned_malloc(0x40, 16);
    int32_t *ids = _aligned_malloc(64, 16);
    memset(obj, 0, 0x40);
    c->x[0] = P(obj); c->x[1] = hostfn_address("selftest alloc callback", st_alloc_cb); c->x[2] = 0; c->x[3] = hostfn_address("selftest free callback", st_free_cb); c->x[4] = 0; c->x[5] = 0;
    nla_init(c);
    MEMCHECK(obj[0] != 0, "NumberLineAllocator::Initialize left the object empty");
    c->x[0] = P(obj); c->x[1] = 0x100; c->x[2] = 0x400; nla_add(c);
    int ok_add = (int)(c->x[0] & 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) { c->x[0] = P(obj); c->x[1] = P(&ids[i]); c->x[2] = 16 << i; nla_alloc(c); MEMCHECK(c->x[0] & 1, "NumberLineAllocator::Allocate failed"); }
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) MEMCHECK(ids[i] >= ids[j] + (16 << j) || ids[j] >= ids[i] + (16 << i), "NumberLineAllocator: ranges overlap");
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) MEMCHECK(ids[i] >= 0x100 && ids[i] + (16 << i) <= 0x100 + 0x400 + 0x100, "NumberLineAllocator: id outside the added range");
    int first = ids[0];
    c->x[0] = P(obj); c->x[1] = (uint64_t)ids[0]; nla_free(c);
    c->x[0] = P(obj); c->x[1] = P(&ids[4]); c->x[2] = 16; nla_alloc(c);
    printf("  NumberLineAllocator (lifted): AddRange(0x100, 0x400) -> %d; Allocate 16/32/64/128 -> %d %d %d %d; Free(%d) + Allocate(16) -> %d\n", ok_add, first, ids[1], ids[2], ids[3], first, ids[4]);
    c->x[0] = P(obj); c->x[1] = P(&ids[5]); c->x[2] = 0x1000; nla_alloc(c);
    MEMCHECK(!(c->x[0] & 1), "NumberLineAllocator: a request larger than the range succeeded");

    ImportFn sa_ctor = sdk_lifted("_ZN2nn3mem17StandardAllocatorC1Ev"), sa_init = sdk_lifted("_ZN2nn3mem17StandardAllocator10InitializeEPvm"), sa_alloc = sdk_lifted("_ZN2nn3mem17StandardAllocator8AllocateEmm"),
             sa_free = sdk_lifted("_ZN2nn3mem17StandardAllocator4FreeEPv"), sa_total = sdk_lifted("_ZNK2nn3mem17StandardAllocator16GetTotalFreeSizeEv"),
             sa_realloc = sdk_lifted("_ZN2nn3mem17StandardAllocator10ReallocateEPvm"), sa_fin = sdk_lifted("_ZN2nn3mem17StandardAllocator8FinalizeEv");
    if (!sa_ctor || !sa_init || !sa_alloc || !sa_free || !sa_total || !sa_realloc || !sa_fin) { printf("  FAIL mem: StandardAllocator is not lifted\n"); return bad + 1; }
    for (int mode = 0; mode < 2; mode++) {                       /* 0: on a buffer, as the game does; 1: buffer-less (virtual address memory) */
        uint8_t *sa = _aligned_malloc(0x400, 16), *buf = mode ? NULL : VirtualAlloc(NULL, 0x100000, MEM_RESERVE | MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE);
        memset(sa, 0, 0x400);
        c->x[0] = P(sa); sa_ctor(c);
        c->x[0] = P(sa); c->x[1] = P(buf); c->x[2] = 0x100000; sa_init(c);
        MEMCHECK(sa[0] == 1, "StandardAllocator::Initialize did not mark the object initialised");
        uint64_t free0 = 0, free1 = 0, free2 = 0;               /* GetTotalFreeSize of a buffer-less allocator asks the kernel (trap, sdklift_roots.txt) */
        if (!mode) { c->x[0] = P(sa); sa_total(c); free0 = c->x[0]; }
        c->x[0] = P(sa); c->x[1] = 0x1f0; c->x[2] = 0x40; sa_alloc(c); uint64_t p1 = c->x[0];
        c->x[0] = P(sa); c->x[1] = 0x5007; c->x[2] = 0x40; sa_alloc(c); uint64_t p2 = c->x[0];
        MEMCHECK(p1 && p2 && !(p1 & 0x3f) && !(p2 & 0x3f), "StandardAllocator::Allocate: null or misaligned block");
        if (!mode) MEMCHECK(p1 >= P(buf) && p2 + 0x5007 <= P(buf) + 0x100000 && (p2 >= p1 + 0x1f0 || p1 >= p2 + 0x5007), "StandardAllocator: block outside the buffer or overlapping");
        if (p1 && p2) { memset((void *)(uintptr_t)p1, 0xa5, 0x1f0); memset((void *)(uintptr_t)p2, 0x5a, 0x5007); }
        if (!mode) { c->x[0] = P(sa); sa_total(c); free1 = c->x[0]; }
        c->x[0] = P(sa); c->x[1] = p1; c->x[2] = 0x3000; sa_realloc(c); uint64_t p3 = c->x[0];
        MEMCHECK(p3 && *(uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)p3 == 0xa5 && *(uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)(p3 + 0x1ef) == 0xa5, "StandardAllocator::Reallocate lost the contents");
        c->x[0] = P(sa); c->x[1] = p3; sa_free(c);
        c->x[0] = P(sa); c->x[1] = p2; sa_free(c);
        if (!mode) { c->x[0] = P(sa); sa_total(c); free2 = c->x[0]; }
        if (!mode) MEMCHECK(free1 < free0 && free2 > free1 && free2 <= free0, "StandardAllocator::GetTotalFreeSize does not follow the allocations");   /* one management page stays in use */
        printf("  StandardAllocator (lifted, %s): free %llu -> %llu after 2 blocks -> %llu after freeing them\n", mode ? "no buffer" : "1 MiB buffer",
               (unsigned long long)free0, (unsigned long long)free1, (unsigned long long)free2);
        c->x[0] = P(sa); sa_fin(c);
        MEMCHECK(sa[0] == 0, "StandardAllocator::Finalize left the object initialised");
    }
    #undef MEMCHECK
    return bad;
}

static void selftest(void) {
    Ctx *c = _aligned_malloc(sizeof *c, 16);
    uint8_t *stack = VirtualAlloc(NULL, 8 << 20, MEM_RESERVE | MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE);
    memset(c, 0, sizeof *c);
    c->x[31] = P(stack + (8 << 20) - 0x1000);
    c->tpidr = P(VirtualAlloc(NULL, 0x10000, MEM_RESERVE | MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE));   /* the thread's own block: lifted libc keeps errno there */
    int bad = 0;
    printf("SDK self-test (lifted sdk.elf code + offline service answers)\n");
    if (!sdk_image_ready()) { printf("  sdk.elf is not loaded: nothing can be tested\n"); fflush(stdout); ExitProcess(99); }
    int missing = sdk_missing_host_callees(stdout);
    printf("  sdklift: %d functions lifted, %d host callees, %d without a handler\n", sdk_fn_count, sdk_host_name_count, missing);
    bad += missing;
    bad += libc_selftest(c);
    bad += mem_selftest(c);
    bad += jpeg_selftest(c);
    bad += nnnet_selftest(c);
    bad += nnapplet_selftest(c);
    bad += nnfsdir_selftest(c);
    bad += nnfs_selftest(c);
    bad += bcat_selftest(c);
    bad += nnhid_selftest(c);
    bad += nvn_sdk_selftest(c);
    bad += nntime_selftest(c);
    { int image_protect_selftest(Ctx *c); bad += image_protect_selftest(c); }  /* nnmisc.c: image protection */
    printf("SDK self-test: %d failure(s)\n", bad);
    fflush(stdout);
    ExitProcess((UINT)bad);
}

/* Imports whose host re-implementation is replaced by the real code lifted from sdk.elf (the list:
 * build/gen/sdklift_install.h, written by tools/lifter/sdklift.py). Debug aids: SMO_LIFT_INSTALL=0 keeps every host handler;
 * SMO_LIFT_SKIP=<text>[,<text>...] keeps the host handler of the names containing one of the texts. */
#include "sdklift_install.h"
static void install_lifted(void) {
    int n = (int)(sizeof sdk_install_names / sizeof sdk_install_names[0]), ok = 0, skipped = 0;
    const char *off = getenv("SMO_LIFT_INSTALL"), *skip = getenv("SMO_LIFT_SKIP");
    if (!sdk_image_ready() || (off && atoi(off) == 0)) return;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int skip_this = 0;
        if (!sdk_install_names[i]) continue;       /* the generated list may be empty (a single NULL entry) */
        if (skip && skip[0]) {
            char buf[1024];
            snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, "%s", skip);
            for (char *t = strtok(buf, ","); t; t = strtok(NULL, ",")) if (strstr(sdk_install_names[i], t)) skip_this = 1;
        }
        if (skip_this) { skipped++; continue; }
        if (sdk_install(sdk_install_names[i])) ok++;
        else printf("sdklift: %s is in sdklift_install.h but was not lifted or is not an import\n", sdk_install_names[i]);
    }
    printf("sdklift: %d host re-implementations replaced by the real SDK code (%d kept by SMO_LIFT_SKIP)\n", ok, skipped);
}

void register_service_imports(void) {
    register_sdklift_imports();
    register_nnapplet_imports();
    register_nnnet_imports();
    register_nnfsdir_imports();
    install_mem_overrides();
    install_lifted();
    nnnet_register_final();
    dump_unregistered();
    if (getenv("SMO_SDK_SELFTEST")) selftest();
}
```

`runtime/services/nnsocket.inc`:

```inc
/* Included by nnnet.c: nn::nifm leftovers, nn::socket / nnsocket* (bsd + resolver) on
 * Winsock, nn::ssl / nnssl*, nn::nsd::ResolveEx.
 *
 * Sources: [sdk] = Super Smash Bros. Ultimate 13.0.4's SDK module, where ssbu-recomp read these functions (addresses quoted),
 * [suyu] = the suyu emulator's src/core (file named).
 * Console state modelled: no network connection (the nifm network request is never accepted), one local user.
 *
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------ nn::nifm
 * [sdk 0x3218f0] detail::GetGeneralServicePointer and [sdk 0x321990] GetNetworkConnectionPointer return 0xca6e
 *     (module 110, description 101) while the library is not initialised (byte .bss 0xcc9910 != 1).
 * [sdk 0x322900] GetCurrentPrimaryIpAddress(in_addr *): null pointer -> abort; IGeneralService command at vtable
 *     +0x70 (GetCurrentIpAddress); 4 bytes copied out on success.
 * [sdk 0x323620] GetCurrentProxySetting(ProxySetting *): GetCurrentNetworkProfile ([sdk 0x322e60], command +0x38),
 *     converted by [sdk 0x324950] (plain copies), then 0xaa bytes at +0xe2 of the converted profile are copied out.
 *     The module's answers are the reference's ([suyu] hle/service/nifm/nifm.cpp) for a host that is not connected:
 *     GetCurrentIpAddress = success, 0.0.0.0; GetCurrentNetworkProfile = success, a zero profile (so the proxy
 *     setting is 0xaa zero bytes: proxy disabled).
 *
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------ nn::socket (bsd:u) and the resolver (sfdnsres)
 * [sdk] every nn::socket::X is a jump to nn::socket::detail::X and every nnsocketX a jump to nn::socket::X
 *     (0x36ac.. / 0x36b5.., 4 bytes each; Fcntl copies its one variadic int, 0x36afa0 / 0x36b6a0).
 * [sdk 0x36f8f0 / 0x36f5d0] Initialize(pool, poolSize, allocatorPoolSize, concurrency): aborts when already
 *     initialised, pool null or not page aligned, sizes not page aligned, allocator pool < 0x1000, pool <= allocator
 *     pool, concurrency not 1..14; pool < 0xa0000 -> Result 0x21b (module 27, description 1); else registers with
 *     bsd:u (works without a connection), enables the resolver, 0.
 * [sdk 0x36fa60 / 0x36fac0] errno IS the C library's errno (__errno_location); SetLastErrno does nothing and
 *     GetLastErrno gives 22 while the library is not initialised.
 * [sdk 0x374b80 ...] every bsd call aborts when the library is not initialised; the module returns (value, errno)
 *     and the SDK stores errno when the value is negative. SDK-side argument checks, before the module is asked:
 *       Recv / Send / RecvFrom / SendTo  size 0 -> 0; buffer null -> -1 EINVAL(22); size >= 4 GiB -> -1 EFAULT(14)
 *       RecvFrom with no address / null or zero length -> Recv; SendTo with no address / zero length -> Send
 *       Bind / Connect   address null -> -1 EINVAL
 *       Accept           address null with *length != 0 -> -1 EINVAL
 *       GetSockName / GetPeerName / GetSockOpt   pointer null or *length 0 -> -1 EINVAL;  SetSockOpt value null -> EINVAL
 *       Poll             fds null with count != 0 -> -1 EINVAL; count >= 2^29 -> -1 EFAULT
 * The module: a real socket layer on Winsock, following [suyu] hle/service/sockets/bsd.cpp + internal_network/
 *     network.cpp (128 descriptors from 0, AF_INET only, O_NONBLOCK 0x800 with F_GETFL 3 / F_SETFL 4, MSG_PEEK 2,
 *     MSG_DONTWAIT 0x80, SOL_SOCKET 0xffff with the BSD option numbers, BSD sockaddr_in {len, family, port, addr},
 *     pollfd {int fd; short events, revents} with POLLIN 1 PRI 2 OUT 4 ERR 8 HUP 0x10 NVAL 0x20 RDNORM 0x40 RDBAND
 *     0x80 WRBAND 0x100). errno numbers are the SDK's own C library's ([sdk] table 0x9f0bb5 + texts 0xaa8204:
 *     9 EBADF, 11 EAGAIN, 22 EINVAL, 24 EMFILE, 32 EPIPE, 88 ENOTSOCK, 90 EMSGSIZE, 92 ENOPROTOOPT, 93, 94, 95,
 *     97 EAFNOSUPPORT, 98 EADDRINUSE, 99 EADDRNOTAVAIL, 100 ENETDOWN, 101 ENETUNREACH, 103, 104, 105, 106 EISCONN,
 *     107 ENOTCONN, 108, 110 ETIMEDOUT, 111 ECONNREFUSED, 113 EHOSTUNREACH, 114 EALREADY, 115 EINPROGRESS).
 *     No connection: only the loopback network 127.0.0.0/8 exists. Connect / SendTo to any other address fail with
 *     ENETUNREACH (what a host without a network gives: Winsock WSAENETUNREACH, [suyu] network.cpp -> NETUNREACH);
 *     Bind to an address other than 0.0.0.0 / 127.x fails with EADDRNOTAVAIL; a socket bound to 0.0.0.0 is bound to
 *     the loopback interface on the PC (nothing is ever opened towards the PC's real network) and GetSockName still
 *     reports 0.0.0.0. NOT VERIFIED on a console: the exact errno of the bsd module for an unreachable network, the
 *     descriptor numbering and limit, sin_len of returned addresses (16 here), Fcntl commands other than 3 / 4
 *     (EINVAL here), options outside SOL_SOCKET / TCP_NODELAY (accepted without effect, as the reference does).
 * Resolver: [sdk 0x37fb40] GetAddrInfo: not initialised -> 11 (EAI_SYSTEM); node and service null -> 8; result
 *     pointer null -> 11 + errno 22; then the service; on any failure the result pointer is null.
 *     [sdk 0x37ef80] GetHostByName(name, options, count): not initialised -> null + errno 22; name null -> null,
 *     h_errno 1, errno 22. [sdk 0x37e760 / 0x37eb30] ResolverGetOption / SetOption:
 *     the keys 0x11171..0x11176 (type 0x67, size 8) live in the SDK's own table .data 0xc0cd28 (read / written in
 *     the mapped SDK image); 0x11170 / 0x11177 -> EINVAL; key 10001 gives a random cancel handle; anything else is
 *     the module's: Get -> -1 ([suyu] sfdnsres.cpp has no such command), Set -> 0 ([suyu] ResolverSetOptionRequest).
 *     [sdk 0x36cc00] result layout: addrinfo {flags, family, socktype, protocol, addrlen, canonname @0x18, addr @0x20,
 *     next @0x28};
 *     [sdk 0x36d890] hostent {name, aliases, addrtype @0x10, length @0x14, addr_list @0x18}.
 *     The module ([suyu] sfdnsres.cpp, "verified on console" tables there): a name that needs DNS cannot be resolved
 *     without a network: EAI_AGAIN (2), h_errno TRY_AGAIN (2), errno 0. A numeric IPv4 address needs no DNS and is
 *     converted (Winsock getaddrinfo with AI_NUMERICHOST, AF_INET). NOT VERIFIED: a console's answer for "localhost".
 *     Results are allocated on the host heap, not in the pool given to Initialize.
 *
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------ nn::ssl
 * [sdk 0x386720] Initialize: use count (.bss 0xcd10a8) is incremented on EVERY call; a call that finds it non-zero
 *     returns 0x1927b (module 123, description 201). Without a session the calls below return 0xca7b (123-101).
 * [sdk 0x3832f0] Context::Create(version): no session -> 0xca7b; the object is 8 bytes: the address of an 8-byte
 *     chunk that holds the service object, with its four 16-bit pieces in reverse order. [sdk 0x3836d0] GetContextId
 *     = those 8 bytes; null out -> 0xe27b (123-113). [sdk 0x3833f0] Destroy: 0xca7b / 0xdc7b (invalid context,
 *     123-110) / 0xd67b (123-107) while connections exist. [sdk 0x3836f0] ImportServerPki(outId, data, size, format):
 *     0xca7b; null id or data -> 0xe27b; invalid context -> 0xdc7b.
 * [sdk 0x383c70 / 0x383ca0 / 0x383dd0] Connection {chunk @0, context id @8, socket @0x10 (-1), certificate buffer
 *     @0x18 + size @0x20, last Result @0x24}: Create: 0xca7b, null context -> 0xe27b, bad context -> 0xdc7b;
 *     Destroy: 0xca7b, 0xda7b (invalid connection, 123-109), closes the socket @0x10 when it is >= 0.
 *     SetSocketDescriptor / SetHostName (null -> 0xe27b) / SetVerifyOption / SetIoMode / SetSessionCacheMode /
 *     SetOption / DoHandshake / Read / Write (null -> 0xe27b, size 0 -> 0xe07b) / Pending (null -> 0xe27b) /
 *     GetVerifyCertError (null -> 0xe27b) / GetConnectionId: 0xca7b, then 0xda7b, then the module.
 * [sdk 0x385d30 ...] the nnssl* C functions return 0xe27b for a null object and call the C++ function.
 * The module ([suyu] hle/service/ssl/ssl.cpp): CreateContext, CreateConnection, ImportServerPki (id 0),
 *     SetHostName, SetVerifyOption, SetSessionCacheMode, SetOption succeed; SetSocketDescriptor duplicates the
 *     descriptor (unknown descriptor -> 0xd47b, 123-106) and hands back -1, or the duplicate when the option
 *     DoNotCloseSocket (0) is set; SetIoMode without a socket -> 0xce7b (123-103), else it sets the socket's
 *     blocking mode; DoHandshake without a socket -> 0xce7b; Pending -> 0.
 *     OPEN: DoHandshake with a socket, Read, Write and GetVerifyCertError need a TLS implementation on a connected
 *     socket (only a loopback peer can exist here); those paths stop with a message instead of inventing a Result.
 *
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------ nn::nsd
 * [sdk 0x3287a0 -> 0x3290f0] ResolveEx(Fqdn *out, const Fqdn &in): the nsd service command at +0x58; only the
 *     command's own Result is returned. [suyu] hle/service/sockets/nsd.cpp: the name is returned unchanged (0x100
 *     bytes), success. NOT VERIFIED: the real module substitutes the environment identifier in names that contain '%'.
 */

#define RETI(v) (c->x[0] = (uint64_t)(int64_t)(v))
#define M8(a) (*(uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)(a))
#define M16(a) (*(uint16_t *)(uintptr_t)(a))
#define M32(a) (*(uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)(a))
#define M64(a) (*(uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(a))
#define A4 (c->x[4])
#define A5 (c->x[5])

static void sock_call(Ctx *c, const char *name, uint64_t x0) {
    ImportFn f = import_lookup(name);
    if (!f) { printf("nnnet: no handler for %s\n", name); guest_trap("nnnet: missing handler", c->x[30] - 4); }
    c->x[0] = x0;
    f(c);
}

/* ================================================================== nn::nifm */
static int g_nifm_init;
static ImportFn g_nifm_initialize_prev;
static void nifm_Initialize(Ctx *c) {                    /* the existing handler, plus the "initialised" flag of [sdk] 0xcc9910 */
    if (g_nifm_initialize_prev) g_nifm_initialize_prev(c); else RET(0);
    if ((uint32_t)c->x[0] == 0) g_nifm_init = 1;
}
#define NIFM_NOT_INITIALIZED 0xca6eu
static void nifm_GetCurrentPrimaryIpAddress(Ctx *c) {
    if (!A0) guest_trap("nn::nifm::GetCurrentPrimaryIpAddress: null pointer ([sdk 0x322998] abort)", c->x[30] - 4);
    if (!g_nifm_init) { RET(NIFM_NOT_INITIALIZED); return; }
    M32(A0) = 0;
    RET(0);
}
static void nifm_GetCurrentProxySetting(Ctx *c) {
    if (!g_nifm_init) { RET(NIFM_NOT_INITIALIZED); return; }
    memset((void *)(uintptr_t)A0, 0, 0xaa);
    RET(0);
}

/* ================================================================== nn::socket on Winsock */
#define SO_MAX_FD 128
#define SO_O_NONBLOCK 0x800
typedef struct { SOCKET s; LONG refs; int type; int bound_any; } SoObj;
static struct { SoObj *o; int flags; } g_so_fd[SO_MAX_FD];
static SRWLOCK g_so_lock = SRWLOCK_INIT;
static int g_so_init, g_so_wsa;
static __declspec(thread) int t_so_herrno;

static int *so_errno_ptr(Ctx *c) {
    uint64_t keep = c->x[0];
    sock_call(c, "__errno_location", 0);
    int *p = (int *)(uintptr_t)c->x[0];
    c->x[0] = keep;
    return p;
}
static void so_set_errno(Ctx *c, int e) { if (g_so_init) *so_errno_ptr(c) = e; }
static void so_fail(Ctx *c, int e) { so_set_errno(c, e); RETI(-1); }
static void so_need_init(Ctx *c, const char *what) {
    if (!g_so_init) {
        printf("\n%s called before nn::socket::Initialize: the SDK aborts here.\n", what);
        guest_trap("nn::socket call before Initialize (SDK abort)", c->x[30] - 4);
    }
}
static int so_wsa_errno(int e, int sending) {
    switch (e) {
    case 0: return 0;
    case WSAEINTR: return 4;
    case WSAEBADF: case WSAENOTSOCK: return e == WSAEBADF ? 9 : 88;
    case WSAEACCES: return 13;
    case WSAEFAULT: return 14;
    case WSAEINVAL: return 22;
    case WSAEMFILE: return 24;
    case WSAEWOULDBLOCK: return 11;
    case WSAEINPROGRESS: return 115;
    case WSAEALREADY: return 114;
    case WSAEDESTADDRREQ: return 89;
    case WSAEMSGSIZE: return 90;
    case WSAEPROTOTYPE: return 91;
    case WSAENOPROTOOPT: return 92;
    case WSAEPROTONOSUPPORT: return 93;
    case WSAESOCKTNOSUPPORT: return 94;
    case WSAEOPNOTSUPP: return 95;
    case WSAEPFNOSUPPORT: return 96;
    case WSAEAFNOSUPPORT: return 97;
    case WSAEADDRINUSE: return 98;
    case WSAEADDRNOTAVAIL: return 99;
    case WSAENETDOWN: return 100;
    case WSAENETUNREACH: return 101;
    case WSAENETRESET: return 102;
    case WSAECONNABORTED: return sending ? 32 : 103;      /* [suyu] network.cpp: Winsock reports a broken pipe on send this way */
    case WSAECONNRESET: return 104;
    case WSAENOBUFS: return 105;
    case WSAEISCONN: return 106;
    case WSAENOTCONN: return 107;
    case WSAESHUTDOWN: return sending ? 32 : 108;
    case WSAETIMEDOUT: return 110;
    case WSAECONNREFUSED: return 111;
    case WSAEHOSTDOWN: return 112;
    case WSAEHOSTUNREACH: return 113;
    default: return 5;                                    /* EIO */
    }
}
static SoObj *so_get(int fd, int *flags) {
    SoObj *o = NULL;
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_so_lock);
    if (fd >= 0 && fd < SO_MAX_FD && g_so_fd[fd].o) { o = g_so_fd[fd].o; o->refs++; if (flags) *flags = g_so_fd[fd].flags; }
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_so_lock);
    return o;
}
static void so_put(SoObj *o) {
    int last;
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_so_lock);
    last = --o->refs == 0;
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_so_lock);
    if (last) { closesocket(o->s); free(o); }
}
static int so_install(SoObj *o, int flags) {             /* lowest free descriptor, or -1 */
    int fd = -1;
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_so_lock);
    for (int i = 0; i < SO_MAX_FD && fd < 0; i++) if (!g_so_fd[i].o) fd = i;
    if (fd >= 0) { g_so_fd[fd].o = o; g_so_fd[fd].flags = flags; o->refs++; }
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_so_lock);
    return fd;
}
static int so_remove(int fd) {
    SoObj *o = NULL;
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_so_lock);
    if (fd >= 0 && fd < SO_MAX_FD) { o = g_so_fd[fd].o; g_so_fd[fd].o = NULL; g_so_fd[fd].flags = 0; }
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_so_lock);
    if (!o) return 0;
    so_put(o);
    return 1;
}
static int so_dup(int fd) {                               /* bsd DuplicateSocket: a second descriptor for the same socket */
    int flags = 0, nfd;
    SoObj *o = so_get(fd, &flags);
    if (!o) return -1;
    nfd = so_install(o, flags);
    so_put(o);
    return nfd;
}
static void so_nonblock(SoObj *o, int on) { u_long v = on ? 1 : 0; ioctlsocket(o->s, FIONBIO, &v); }
static int so_is_loopback(uint32_t be_addr) { return (be_addr & 0xff) == 127; }      /* first byte in memory */
static int so_addr_in(uint64_t p, struct sockaddr_in *out) {                          /* guest BSD sockaddr_in -> host; 0 when not AF_INET */
    memset(out, 0, sizeof *out);
    if (M8(p + 1) != 2) return 0;
    out->sin_family = AF_INET;
    out->sin_port = M16(p + 2);
    out->sin_addr.S_un.S_addr = M32(p + 4);
    return 1;
}
static uint32_t so_addr_out(uint64_t p, uint32_t cap, const struct sockaddr_in *in) { /* returns the length the module reports */
    uint8_t b[16] = {0};
    b[0] = 16; b[1] = 2;
    memcpy(b + 2, &in->sin_port, 2);
    memcpy(b + 4, &in->sin_addr, 4);
    if (p && cap) memcpy((void *)(uintptr_t)p, b, cap < 16 ? cap : 16);
    return 16;
}

static void socket_Initialize(Ctx *c) {                   /* (void *pool, size_t poolSize, size_t allocatorPoolSize, int concurrency) -> Result */
    uint64_t pool = A0, size = A1, alloc = A2;
    int conc = (int)A3;
    if (g_so_init || !pool || (unsigned)(conc - 1) >= 14 || size <= alloc || (pool & 0xfff) || (size & 0xfff) || (alloc & 0xfff) || alloc <= 0xfff)
        guest_trap("nn::socket::Initialize: [sdk 0x36f89c] abort (already initialised or bad arguments)", c->x[30] - 4);
    if (size < 0xa0000) { RET(0x21bu); return; }
    if (!g_so_wsa) { WSADATA d; if (WSAStartup(MAKEWORD(2, 2), &d) == 0) g_so_wsa = 1; }
    g_so_init = 1;
    RET(0);
}
static void socket_GetLastErrno2(Ctx *c) { if (!g_so_init) RETI(22); else RETI(*so_errno_ptr(c)); }
static void socket_SetLastErrno2(Ctx *c) { int e = (int)A0; so_set_errno(c, e); }

static void socket_Socket(Ctx *c) {                       /* (domain, type, protocol) */
    int domain = (int)(A0 & 0xff), type = (int)A1, protocol = (int)A2;
    so_need_init(c, "nn::socket::Socket");
    if (domain != 2) { so_fail(c, 97); return; }
    SOCKET s = socket(AF_INET, type, protocol);
    if (s == INVALID_SOCKET) { so_fail(c, so_wsa_errno(WSAGetLastError(), 0)); return; }
    SoObj *o = calloc(1, sizeof *o);
    o->s = s; o->type = type;
    int fd = so_install(o, 0);
    if (fd < 0) { closesocket(s); free(o); so_fail(c, 24); return; }
    RETI(fd);
}
static void socket_Close(Ctx *c) {
    so_need_init(c, "nn::socket::Close");
    if (!so_remove((int)A0)) { so_fail(c, 9); return; }
    RETI(0);
}
static void so_bind(Ctx *c, int len_check) {              /* (fd, const sockaddr *, len) */
    so_need_init(c, "nn::socket::Bind");
    if (!A1 || (len_check && !(uint32_t)A2)) { so_fail(c, 22); return; }
    SoObj *o = so_get((int)A0, NULL);
    if (!o) { so_fail(c, 9); return; }
    struct sockaddr_in a;
    int e = 0;
    if (!so_addr_in(A1, &a)) e = 97;
    else if (a.sin_addr.S_un.S_addr != 0 && !so_is_loopback(a.sin_addr.S_un.S_addr)) e = 99;
    else {
        int any = a.sin_addr.S_un.S_addr == 0;
        if (any) a.sin_addr.S_un.S_addr = htonl(INADDR_LOOPBACK);
        if (bind(o->s, (struct sockaddr *)&a, sizeof a) != 0) e = so_wsa_errno(WSAGetLastError(), 0);
        else o->bound_any = any;
    }
    so_put(o);
    if (e) so_fail(c, e); else RETI(0);
}
static void socket_Bind(Ctx *c) { so_bind(c, 0); }
static void socket_Connect(Ctx *c) {                      /* (fd, const sockaddr *, len) */
    so_need_init(c, "nn::socket::Connect");
    if (!A1) { so_fail(c, 22); return; }
    int flags = 0, e = 0;
    SoObj *o = so_get((int)A0, &flags);
    if (!o) { so_fail(c, 9); return; }
    struct sockaddr_in a;
    if (!so_addr_in(A1, &a)) e = 97;
    else if (!so_is_loopback(a.sin_addr.S_un.S_addr)) e = 101;                        /* no network: nothing but loopback is reachable */
    else if (connect(o->s, (struct sockaddr *)&a, sizeof a) != 0) {
        int w = WSAGetLastError();
        e = w == WSAEWOULDBLOCK ? 115 : w == WSAEISCONN ? 0 : so_wsa_errno(w, 0);     /* [suyu] ConnectImpl: "already connected" is success */
    }
    so_put(o);
    if (e) so_fail(c, e); else RETI(0);
}

}
static void socket_Shutdown(Ctx *c) {
    so_need_init(c, "nn::socket::Shutdown");

    if (!o) { so_fail(c, 9); return; }

    so_put(o);
    if (e) so_fail(c, e); else RETI(0);
}
static void socket_Accept(Ctx *c) {                       /* (fd, sockaddr *, socklen_t *) */
    uint64_t addr = A1, lenp = A2;
    so_need_init(c, "nn::socket::Accept");
    if (!addr && lenp && M32(lenp)) { so_fail(c, 22); return; }
    uint32_t cap = addr && lenp ? M32(lenp) : 0;
    int flags = 0;
    SoObj *o = so_get((int)A0, &flags);
    if (!o) { so_fail(c, 9); return; }
    struct sockaddr_in a;
    int alen = sizeof a;
    memset(&a, 0, sizeof a);
    SOCKET s = accept(o->s, (struct sockaddr *)&a, &alen);
    int e = s == INVALID_SOCKET ? so_wsa_errno(WSAGetLastError(), 0) : 0, type = o->type;
    so_put(o);
    if (e) { so_fail(c, e); return; }
    SoObj *n = calloc(1, sizeof *n);
    n->s = s; n->type = type;
    so_nonblock(n, 0);                                    /* a new descriptor starts blocking */
    int fd = so_install(n, 0);
    if (fd < 0) { closesocket(s); free(n); so_fail(c, 24); return; }
    uint32_t out = so_addr_out(addr, cap, &a);
    if (lenp) M32(lenp) = cap ? out : 0;
    RETI(fd);
}
static void so_name(Ctx *c, int peer) {                   /* (fd, sockaddr *, socklen_t *) */
    uint64_t addr = A1, lenp = A2;
    so_need_init(c, peer ? "nn::socket::GetPeerName" : "nn::socket::GetSockName");
    if (!addr || !lenp || !M32(lenp)) { so_fail(c, 22); return; }
    SoObj *o = so_get((int)A0, NULL);
    if (!o) { so_fail(c, 9); return; }
    struct sockaddr_in a;
    int alen = sizeof a;
    memset(&a, 0, sizeof a);
    int e = (peer ? getpeername(o->s, (struct sockaddr *)&a, &alen) : getsockname(o->s, (struct sockaddr *)&a, &alen)) != 0 ? so_wsa_errno(WSAGetLastError(), 0) : 0;
    if (!e && !peer && o->bound_any) a.sin_addr.S_un.S_addr = 0;
    if (e == 22 && !peer) { e = 0; a.sin_family = AF_INET; }                         /* Winsock refuses an unbound socket; BSD reports 0.0.0.0:0 */
    so_put(o);
    if (e) { so_fail(c, e); return; }
    M32(lenp) = so_addr_out(addr, M32(lenp), &a);
    RETI(0);
}
static void socket_GetSockName(Ctx *c) { so_name(c, 0); }
static void socket_GetPeerName(Ctx *c) { so_name(c, 1); }
static int so_host_flags(int f) { return (f & 2 ? MSG_PEEK : 0) | (f & 1 ? MSG_OOB : 0) | (f & 0x40 ? MSG_WAITALL : 0); }
static void so_recv(Ctx *c, uint64_t addr, uint64_t lenp) {   /* (fd, buf, size, flags [, sockaddr *, socklen_t *]) */
    uint64_t buf = A1, size = A2;
    int gf = (int)A3, flags = 0;
    so_need_init(c, "nn::socket::Recv");
    if (!size) { RETI(0); return; }
    if (!buf) { so_fail(c, 22); return; }
    if (size >> 32) { so_fail(c, 14); return; }
    SoObj *o = so_get((int)A0, &flags);
    if (!o) { so_fail(c, 9); return; }
    int temp = (gf & 0x80) && !(flags & SO_O_NONBLOCK), n, e = 0;
    struct sockaddr_in a;
    int alen = sizeof a;
    memset(&a, 0, sizeof a);
    if (temp) so_nonblock(o, 1);
    if (addr) n = recvfrom(o->s, (char *)(uintptr_t)buf, (int)(size > 0x7fffffff ? 0x7fffffff : size), so_host_flags(gf), (struct sockaddr *)&a, &alen);
    else n = recv(o->s, (char *)(uintptr_t)buf, (int)(size > 0x7fffffff ? 0x7fffffff : size), so_host_flags(gf));
    if (n < 0) {
        int w = WSAGetLastError();
        if (w == WSAEMSGSIZE) n = (int)size;              /* datagram longer than the buffer: BSD truncates silently */
        else e = so_wsa_errno(w, 0);
    }
    if (temp) so_nonblock(o, 0);
    int stream = o->type == SOCK_STREAM;
    so_put(o);
    if (e) { so_fail(c, e); return; }
    if (addr && lenp) M32(lenp) = stream ? 0 : so_addr_out(addr, M32(lenp), &a);     /* [suyu] RecvFromImpl: no address for a stream socket */
    RETI(n);
}
static void socket_Recv(Ctx *c) { so_recv(c, 0, 0); }
static void socket_RecvFrom(Ctx *c) { if (!A4 || !A5 || !M32(A5)) so_recv(c, 0, 0); else so_recv(c, A4, A5); }
static void so_send(Ctx *c, uint64_t addr) {              /* (fd, buf, size, flags [, const sockaddr *, len]) */
    uint64_t buf = A1, size = A2;
    int gf = (int)A3, flags = 0;
    so_need_init(c, "nn::socket::Send");
    if (!size) { RETI(0); return; }
    if (!buf) { so_fail(c, 22); return; }
    if (size >> 32) { so_fail(c, 14); return; }
    SoObj *o = so_get((int)A0, &flags);
    if (!o) { so_fail(c, 9); return; }
    int temp = (gf & 0x80) && !(flags & SO_O_NONBLOCK), n = -1, e = 0;
    struct sockaddr_in a;
    if (addr && !so_addr_in(addr, &a)) e = 97;
    else if (addr && !so_is_loopback(a.sin_addr.S_un.S_addr)) e = 101;                 /* no network */
    else {
        if (temp) so_nonblock(o, 1);
        if (addr) n = sendto(o->s, (const char *)(uintptr_t)buf, (int)(size > 0x7fffffff ? 0x7fffffff : size), so_host_flags(gf) & MSG_OOB, (struct sockaddr *)&a, sizeof a);
        else n = send(o->s, (const char *)(uintptr_t)buf, (int)(size > 0x7fffffff ? 0x7fffffff : size), so_host_flags(gf) & MSG_OOB);
        if (n < 0) e = so_wsa_errno(WSAGetLastError(), 1);
        if (temp) so_nonblock(o, 0);
    }
    so_put(o);
    if (e) so_fail(c, e); else RETI(n);
}
static void socket_Send(Ctx *c) { so_send(c, 0); }
static void socket_SendTo(Ctx *c) { if (!A4 || !(uint32_t)A5) so_send(c, 0); else so_send(c, A4); }
static void socket_Fcntl(Ctx *c) {                        /* (fd, cmd, int) */
    int cmd = (int)A1, arg = (int)A2, fd = (int)A0, flags = 0;
    so_need_init(c, "nn::socket::Fcntl");
    SoObj *o = so_get(fd, &flags);
    if (!o) { so_fail(c, 9); return; }
    if (cmd == 3) RETI(flags);
    else if (cmd == 4) {
        so_nonblock(o, (arg & SO_O_NONBLOCK) != 0);
        AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_so_lock);
        if (g_so_fd[fd].o == o) g_so_fd[fd].flags = arg;
        ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_so_lock);
        RETI(0);
    } else so_fail(c, 22);
    so_put(o);
}
static void socket_Poll(Ctx *c) {                         /* (pollfd *, nfds, timeout ms) */
    uint64_t fds = A0, n = A1;
    int timeout = (int)A2;
    so_need_init(c, "nn::socket::Poll");
    if (!fds && n) { so_fail(c, 22); return; }
    if (n >> 29) { so_fail(c, 14); return; }
    if ((int64_t)n <= 0) { so_set_errno(c, 0); RETI(-1); return; }                    /* [suyu] PollImpl: no entries -> -1 with errno 0 */
    if (timeout < -1) { so_fail(c, 22); return; }
    WSAPOLLFD *h = calloc((size_t)n, sizeof *h);
    SoObj **objs = calloc((size_t)n, sizeof *objs);
    int ready = 0, hn = 0, r = 0, e = 0;
    for (uint64_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int fd = (int)M32(fds + i * 8);
        uint16_t ev = M16(fds + i * 8 + 4);
        M16(fds + i * 8 + 6) = 0;
        if (fd < 0) continue;                             /* a negative descriptor is ignored */
        objs[i] = so_get(fd, NULL);
        if (!objs[i]) { M16(fds + i * 8 + 6) = 0x20; ready++; continue; }
        h[hn].fd = objs[i]->s;
        h[hn].events = (SHORT)((ev & 0x41 ? POLLRDNORM : 0) | (ev & 0x82 ? POLLRDBAND : 0) | (ev & 0x4 ? POLLWRNORM : 0));
        hn++;
    }
    if (hn) {
        r = WSAPoll(h, (ULONG)hn, ready ? 0 : timeout);
        if (r < 0) e = so_wsa_errno(WSAGetLastError(), 0);
    } else if (!ready && timeout) Sleep(timeout < 0 ? INFINITE : (DWORD)timeout);
    hn = 0;
    for (uint64_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (!objs[i]) continue;
        if (!e) {
            SHORT rv = h[hn].revents;
            uint16_t ev = M16(fds + i * 8 + 4), out = 0;
            if (rv & POLLRDNORM) out |= (uint16_t)(ev & 0x41 ? ev & 0x41 : 1);
            if (rv & POLLRDBAND) out |= (uint16_t)(ev & 0x82 ? ev & 0x82 : 2);
            if (rv & POLLWRNORM) out |= 4;
            if (rv & POLLERR) out |= 8;
            if (rv & POLLHUP) out |= 0x10;
            if (rv & POLLNVAL) out |= 0x20;
            M16(fds + i * 8 + 6) = out;
            if (out) ready++;
        }
        hn++;
        so_put(objs[i]);
    }
    free(h); free(objs);
    if (e) so_fail(c, e); else RETI(ready);
}
static void socket_GetSockOpt(Ctx *c) {                   /* (fd, level, name, void *, socklen_t *) */
    uint64_t val = A3, lenp = A4;
    int level = (int)A1, name = (int)A2;
    so_need_init(c, "nn::socket::GetSockOpt");
    if (!val || !lenp || !M32(lenp)) { so_fail(c, 22); return; }
    SoObj *o = so_get((int)A0, NULL);
    if (!o) { so_fail(c, 9); return; }
    int e = 0;
    uint32_t cap = M32(lenp);
    if (level == 0xffff || (level == 6 && name == 1)) {
        char tmp[64];
        int tl = sizeof tmp;
        if (name == 0x800 && level == 0xffff) { memset(tmp, 0, 4); tl = 4; }          /* SO_NOSIGPIPE: there are no signals */
        else if (getsockopt(o->s, level == 0xffff ? SOL_SOCKET : IPPROTO_TCP, name, tmp, &tl) != 0) e = so_wsa_errno(WSAGetLastError(), 0);
        if (!e) {
            uint8_t out[16] = {0};
            uint32_t ol = 4;
            if (level == 0xffff && name == 0x1007) { int v = so_wsa_errno(*(int *)tmp, 0); memcpy(out, &v, 4); }
            else if (level == 0xffff && name == 0x80) { LINGER *l = (LINGER *)tmp; int v[2] = {l->l_onoff, l->l_linger}; memcpy(out, v, 8); ol = 8; }
            else if (level == 0xffff && (name == 0x1005 || name == 0x1006)) { DWORD ms = *(DWORD *)tmp; int64_t tv[2] = {ms / 1000, (ms % 1000) * 1000}; memcpy(out, tv, 16); ol = 16; }
            else { int v = tl >= 4 ? *(int *)tmp : (tl >= 1 ? tmp[0] != 0 : 0); memcpy(out, &v, 4); }
            if (ol > cap) ol = cap;
            memcpy((void *)(uintptr_t)val, out, ol);
            M32(lenp) = ol;
        }
    }                                                     /* other levels: [suyu] GetSockOptImpl answers success without data */
    so_put(o);
    if (e) so_fail(c, e); else RETI(0);
}
static void socket_SetSockOpt(Ctx *c) {                   /* (fd, level, name, const void *, len) */
    uint64_t val = A3;
    uint32_t len = (uint32_t)A4;
    int level = (int)A1, name = (int)A2;
    so_need_init(c, "nn::socket::SetSockOpt");
    if (!val) { so_fail(c, 22); return; }
    SoObj *o = so_get((int)A0, NULL);
    if (!o) { so_fail(c, 9); return; }
    int e = 0, r = 0;
    if (level == 0xffff && name == 0x80) {
        if (len < 8) e = 22;
        else { LINGER l; l.l_onoff = (u_short)(M32(val) != 0); l.l_linger = (u_short)M32(val + 4); r = setsockopt(o->s, SOL_SOCKET, SO_LINGER, (char *)&l, sizeof l); }
    } else if (level == 0xffff && (name == 0x1005 || name == 0x1006)) {
        DWORD ms = len >= 16 ? (DWORD)(M64(val) * 1000 + M64(val + 8) / 1000) : len >= 4 ? M32(val) : 0;
        if (len < 4) e = 22; else r = setsockopt(o->s, SOL_SOCKET, name, (char *)&ms, sizeof ms);
    } else if (level == 0xffff && name == 0x800) r = 0;   /* SO_NOSIGPIPE */
    else if (level == 0xffff || (level == 6 && name == 1)) {
        if (len < 4) e = 22;
        else { int v = (int)M32(val); r = setsockopt(o->s, level == 0xffff ? SOL_SOCKET : IPPROTO_TCP, name, (char *)&v, sizeof v); }
    }                                                     /* other levels: [suyu] SetSockOptImpl accepts and ignores */
    if (!e && r != 0) e = so_wsa_errno(WSAGetLastError(), 0);
    so_put(o);
    if (e) so_fail(c, e); else RETI(0);
}
```
