```inc
static int so_resolver_enabled(void) { return g_so_init; }
static uint64_t so_option_table(void) { return sdk_image_ready() ? SDK_BASE + 0xc0cd28 : 0; }
static const char *const g_gai_text[] = {
    "Success", "Address family for hostname not supported", "Temporary failure in name resolution", "Invalid value for ai_flags",
    "Non-recoverable failure in name resolution", "ai_family not supported", "Memory allocation failure",
    "No address associated with hostname", "hostname nor servname provided, or not known", "servname not supported for ai_socktype",
    "ai_socktype not supported", "System error returned in errno", "Invalid value for hints", "Resolved protocol is unknown",
    "Argument buffer overflow"};
static int so_gai_from_host(int w) {
    switch (w) {
    case 0: return 0;
    case WSATRY_AGAIN: return 2;
    case WSAEINVAL: return 3;
    case WSANO_RECOVERY: return 4;
    case WSAEAFNOSUPPORT: return 5;
    case WSA_NOT_ENOUGH_MEMORY: return 6;
    case WSAHOST_NOT_FOUND: return 8;
    case WSATYPE_NOT_FOUND: return 9;
    case WSAESOCKTNOSUPPORT: return 10;
    default: return 15;                                   /* [suyu] GetAddrInfoError::OTHER */
    }
}
static int so_is_numeric_host(const char *s) { struct in_addr a; return s && InetPtonA(AF_INET, s, &a) == 1; }
/* (node, service, hints, out). nn_layout: nn::socket::AddrInfo instead of struct addrinfo */
static void so_getaddrinfo(Ctx *c, int nn_layout) {
    const char *node = (const char *)(uintptr_t)A0, *service = (const char *)(uintptr_t)A1;
    uint64_t hints = A2, out = A3;
    if (!so_resolver_enabled()) { RETI(11); return; }
    if (!node && !service) { RETI(8); return; }
    if (!out) { so_set_errno(c, 22); RETI(11); return; }
    M64(out) = 0;
    if (node && !so_is_numeric_host(node)) {              /* needs DNS: no network. [suyu] sfdnsres.cpp: EAI_AGAIN, TRY_AGAIN, errno 0 */
        t_so_herrno = 2; so_set_errno(c, 0); RETI(2); return;
    }
    struct addrinfo h, *res = NULL;
    memset(&h, 0, sizeof h);
    h.ai_family = AF_INET;
    h.ai_flags = AI_NUMERICHOST | (hints && (M32(hints) & 1) ? AI_PASSIVE : 0);
    if (hints) { h.ai_socktype = (int)M32(hints + 8); h.ai_protocol = (int)M32(hints + 0xc); }
    int w = getaddrinfo(node, service, &h, &res), g = so_gai_from_host(w);
    if (g) {
        t_so_herrno = g == 2 ? 2 : g == 9 ? 0 : 1;        /* [suyu] GetAddrInfoErrorToNetDbError / ...ToErrno */
        so_set_errno(c, g == 9 ? 22 : 0);
        RETI(g); return;
    }
    uint64_t first = 0, prev = 0;
    for (struct addrinfo *p = res; p; p = p->ai_next) {
        if (p->ai_family != AF_INET) continue;
        uint64_t ai = P(calloc(1, 0x30)), sa = P(calloc(1, 16)), name = P(calloc(1, 1));
        struct sockaddr_in *in = (struct sockaddr_in *)p->ai_addr;
        if (nn_layout) M8(ai + 4) = 2; else M32(ai + 4) = 2;
        M32(ai + 8) = (uint32_t)p->ai_socktype; M32(ai + 0xc) = (uint32_t)p->ai_protocol; M32(ai + 0x10) = 16;
        so_addr_out(sa, 16, in);
        M8(sa) = 0;                                       /* [sdk 0x36e7e0] the deserialiser does not set sin_len */
        M64(ai + (nn_layout ? 0x18 : 0x20)) = sa;
        M64(ai + (nn_layout ? 0x20 : 0x18)) = name;
        if (prev) M64(prev + 0x28) = ai; else first = ai;
        prev = ai;
    }
    freeaddrinfo(res);
    if (!first) { t_so_herrno = 1; so_set_errno(c, 0); RETI(8); return; }
    t_so_herrno = 0; so_set_errno(c, 0);
    M64(out) = first;
    RETI(0);
}

static void socket_GetHostByNameWithOptions(Ctx *c) {     /* (const char *name, const ResolverOption *, size_t count) -> hostent * */

static void so_ResolverGetOption(Ctx *c) {                /* (ResolverOption *out, key) -> int; ResolverOption {u32 key, u32 type, u64 size, value} */
    uint64_t opt = A0, table = so_option_table();
    uint32_t key = (uint32_t)A1;
    if (!opt) { RETI(-1); return; }
    if ((key >> 3) == 0x222e) {
        if (key == 0x11177 || key == 0x11170 || !table) { *so_errno_ptr(c) = 22; RETI(-1); return; }
        M32(opt) = key; M32(opt + 4) = 0x67; M64(opt + 8) = 8; M64(opt + 0x10) = M64(table + (uint64_t)(key - 0x11171) * 8);
        RETI(0); return;
    }
    if (key == 0x2711) {                                  /* [sdk 0x382d50] CreateRandomId */
        uint32_t id = 0;
        HCRYPTPROV prov = 0;
        if (CryptAcquireContextA(&prov, NULL, NULL, PROV_RSA_FULL, CRYPT_VERIFYCONTEXT)) { CryptGenRandom(prov, 4, (BYTE *)&id); CryptReleaseContext(prov, 0); }
        M32(opt + 0x10) = id; M64(opt + 8) = 4;
        RETI(0); return;
    }
    if (!so_resolver_enabled()) so_set_errno(c, 22);
    RETI(-1);
}
static void so_ResolverSetOption(Ctx *c) {                /* (const ResolverOption &) -> int */
    uint64_t opt = A0, table = so_option_table();
    uint32_t idx = M32(opt) - 0x11171u;
    if (idx <= 5 && M32(opt + 4) == 0x67 && M64(opt + 8) == 8 && table) { M64(table + (uint64_t)idx * 8) = M64(opt + 0x10); RETI(0); return; }
    if (!so_resolver_enabled()) { so_set_errno(c, 22); RETI(-1); return; }
    RETI(0);
}

#define SSL_NOT_INIT 0xca7bu
#define SSL_BAD_CONTEXT 0xdc7bu
#define SSL_BAD_CONNECTION 0xda7bu
#define SSL_BAD_POINTER 0xe27bu
typedef struct SslCtx { uint32_t magic; int connections; } SslCtx;
typedef struct SslConn { uint32_t magic; SslCtx *ctx; int fd; int keep_socket; } SslConn;      /* fd: the module's duplicate, -1 = none */
#define SSL_CTX_MAGIC 0x43584c53u
#define SSL_CONN_MAGIC 0x4e434c53u
static uint64_t g_ssl_count;                              /* [sdk] .bss 0xcd10a8 */
static int g_ssl_session;
static uint64_t ssl_scramble(uint64_t p) { return (p >> 48) | ((p >> 16) & 0xffff0000ull) | ((p << 16) & 0xffff00000000ull) | (p << 48); }
static void *ssl_chunk_object(uint64_t scrambled) {       /* the service object behind a context / connection value, or NULL */
    uint64_t chunk = ssl_scramble(scrambled);
    return chunk ? (void *)(uintptr_t)M64(chunk) : NULL;
}
static void nnssl_Initialize(Ctx *c) {
    int first = g_ssl_count == 0;
    g_ssl_count++;
    if (!first || g_ssl_session) { RET(0x1927bu); return; }
    g_ssl_session = 1;
    RET(0);
}
static void ssl_Context_Create(Ctx *c) {                  /* (this, SslVersion) */
    uint64_t self = A0;
    if (!g_ssl_session) { RET(SSL_NOT_INIT); return; }
    uint64_t *chunk = calloc(1, 8);
    SslCtx *x = calloc(1, sizeof *x);
    x->magic = SSL_CTX_MAGIC;
    *chunk = P(x);
    M64(self) = ssl_scramble(P(chunk));
    RET(0);
}
static SslCtx *ssl_ctx(uint64_t value) { SslCtx *x = ssl_chunk_object(value); return x && x->magic == SSL_CTX_MAGIC ? x : NULL; }
static SslConn *ssl_conn(uint64_t value) { SslConn *x = ssl_chunk_object(value); return x && x->magic == SSL_CONN_MAGIC ? x : NULL; }
static void ssl_Context_ImportServerPki(Ctx *c) {         /* (this, uint64_t *outId, const char *data, uint32_t size, format) */

    if (!ssl_ctx(M64(A0))) { RET(SSL_BAD_CONTEXT); return; }
    M64(A1) = 0;
    RET(0);
}
static void nnssl_ContextDestroy(Ctx *c) {
    uint64_t self = A0;
    if (!self) { RET(SSL_BAD_POINTER); return; }
    if (!g_ssl_session) { RET(SSL_NOT_INIT); return; }
    SslCtx *x = ssl_ctx(M64(self));
    if (!x) { RET(SSL_BAD_CONTEXT); return; }
    if (x->connections) { RET(0xd67bu); return; }
    free((void *)(uintptr_t)ssl_scramble(M64(self)));
    x->magic = 0; free(x);
    M64(self) = 0;
    RET(0);
}
static void nnssl_ContextGetContextId(Ctx *c) {

static void nnssl_ConnectionCreate(Ctx *c) {              /* (connection, context) */
    uint64_t self = A0, ctx = A1;
    if (!self || !ctx) { RET(SSL_BAD_POINTER); return; }
    M64(self) = 0; M64(self + 8) = 0; M32(self + 0x10) = 0xffffffffu;                 /* [sdk 0x383c70] constructor */
    if (!g_ssl_session) { RET(SSL_NOT_INIT); return; }
    SslCtx *x = ssl_ctx(M64(ctx));
    if (!x) { RET(SSL_BAD_CONTEXT); return; }
    uint64_t *chunk = calloc(1, 8);
    SslConn *n = calloc(1, sizeof *n);
    n->magic = SSL_CONN_MAGIC; n->ctx = x; n->fd = -1;
    x->connections++;
    *chunk = P(n);
    M64(self) = ssl_scramble(P(chunk));
    M64(self + 8) = M64(ctx);
    RET(0);
}
/* common front of every Connection call: null object, not initialised, invalid connection */
static SslConn *ssl_conn_enter(Ctx *c, uint64_t self) {
    if (!self) { RET(SSL_BAD_POINTER); return NULL; }
    if (!g_ssl_session) { RET(SSL_NOT_INIT); return NULL; }
    SslConn *n = ssl_conn(M64(self));
    if (!n) RET(SSL_BAD_CONNECTION);
    return n;
}
static void nnssl_ConnectionDestroy(Ctx *c) {
    uint64_t self = A0;
    SslConn *n = ssl_conn_enter(c, self);
    if (!n) return;
    if ((int32_t)M32(self + 0x10) >= 0) { so_remove((int)M32(self + 0x10)); M32(self + 0x10) = 0xffffffffu; }   /* [sdk 0x383e58] nn::socket::Close */
    if (n->fd >= 0 && n->fd != (int)M32(self + 0x10)) so_remove(n->fd);              /* the module closes its duplicate */
    n->ctx->connections--;
    free((void *)(uintptr_t)ssl_scramble(M64(self)));
    n->magic = 0; free(n);
    M64(self) = 0;
    RET(0);
}
static void nnssl_ConnectionSetSocketDescriptor(Ctx *c) { /* (connection, fd) */

    RET(0);
}

static void ssl_needs_tls(Ctx *c, const char *what) {
    printf("\n%s on an nn::ssl connection needs a TLS session over a connected socket. The runtime has no TLS implementation\n"
           "(without a network only a loopback peer could be connected at all).\n", what);
    guest_trap("nn::ssl: TLS is not implemented", c->x[30] - 4);
}
static void nnssl_ConnectionDoHandshake(Ctx *c) {         /* (connection, uint32_t *outCertSize, uint32_t *outCertCount) */

    }
    RET(0xce7bu);                                         /* [suyu] ResultNoSocket */
}

/* ================================================================== self-test */
static uint64_t sock_h1(Ctx *c, const char *name, uint64_t a0, uint64_t a1, uint64_t a2, uint64_t a3, uint64_t a4, uint64_t a5) {
    c->x[0] = a0; c->x[1] = a1; c->x[2] = a2; c->x[3] = a3; c->x[4] = a4; c->x[5] = a5;
    h(name)(c);
    return c->x[0];
}
#define H(name, ...) sock_h6(c, name, (uint64_t[6]){__VA_ARGS__})
static uint64_t sock_h6(Ctx *c, const char *name, const uint64_t *a) { return sock_h1(c, name, a[0], a[1], a[2], a[3], a[4], a[5]); }
static int sock_errno(Ctx *c) { return (int)H(SOK("12GetLastErrnoEv"), 0); }
static void sock_sa(uint8_t *sa, uint8_t a, uint8_t b, uint8_t cc, uint8_t d, uint16_t port) {
    memset(sa, 0, 16); sa[0] = 16; sa[1] = 2; sa[2] = (uint8_t)(port >> 8); sa[3] = (uint8_t)port; sa[4] = a; sa[5] = b; sa[6] = cc; sa[7] = d;
}
#define SOCK_CHECK(text) do { printf("  %s: %s\n", text, ok ? "ok" : "FAILED"); bad += !ok; cases++; } while (0)
static int sock_selftest(Ctx *c) {
    int bad = 0, ok, cases = 0;
    /* ---- nifm */
    uint32_t ip[5] = {0xeeeeeeee, 0xeeeeeeee, 0xeeeeeeee, 0xeeeeeeee, 0xeeeeeeee};
    uint8_t proxy[0xb0];
    int was = g_nifm_init;
    g_nifm_init = 0;
    ok = H("_ZN2nn4nifm26GetCurrentPrimaryIpAddressEP7in_addr", P(ip)) == 0xca6e && ip[0] == 0xeeeeeeee;
    ok = ok && H("_ZN2nn4nifm22GetCurrentProxySettingEPNS0_12ProxySettingE", P(proxy)) == 0xca6e;
    SOCK_CHECK("nifm: before Initialize 0xca6e (110-101), nothing written");
    ok = H("_ZN2nn4nifm10InitializeEv", 0) == 0 && g_nifm_init == 1;
    ok = ok && H("_ZN2nn4nifm26GetCurrentPrimaryIpAddressEP7in_addr", P(ip)) == 0 && ip[0] == 0;
    memset(proxy, 0xee, sizeof proxy);
    ok = ok && H("_ZN2nn4nifm22GetCurrentProxySettingEPNS0_12ProxySettingE", P(proxy)) == 0 && proxy[0] == 0 && proxy[0xa9] == 0 && proxy[0xaa] == 0xee;
    SOCK_CHECK("nifm: no connection: address 0.0.0.0, proxy setting 0xaa zero bytes");
    g_nifm_init = was;
    /* ---- sockets */
    uint8_t *pool = VirtualAlloc(NULL, 0x100000, MEM_RESERVE | MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE);
    uint8_t sa[16], sb[16], buf[64];
    uint32_t len;
    ok = (int)H(SOK("12GetLastErrnoEv"), 0) == 22;
    uint64_t list = 0x1234;
    ok = ok && (int)H(SOK("11GetAddrInfoEPKcS2_PK8addrinfoPPS3_"), P("127.0.0.1"), 0, 0, P(&list)) == 11 && list == 0x1234;
    ok = ok && H("nnsocketGetHostByNameWithOptions", P("127.0.0.1"), 0, 0) == 0;
    SOCK_CHECK("socket: before Initialize: GetLastErrno 22, GetAddrInfo 11, GetHostByName null");
    ok = H(SOK("10InitializeEPvmmi"), P(pool), 0x90000, 0x20000, 4) == 0x21b && !g_so_init;
    ok = ok && H(SOK("10InitializeEPvmmi"), P(pool), 0x100000, 0x20000, 4) == 0 && g_so_init;
    SOCK_CHECK("socket: Initialize: pool below 0xa0000 -> 0x21b, then success");
    int u1 = (int)H(SOK("6SocketEiii"), 2, 2, 0), u2 = (int)H("nnsocketSocket", 2, 2, 17);
    ok = u1 == 0 && u2 == 1;
    ok = ok && (int)H(SOK("6SocketEiii"), 10, 1, 0) == -1 && sock_errno(c) == 97;
    SOCK_CHECK("socket: two UDP sockets get descriptors 0 and 1; AF_INET6 refused with EAFNOSUPPORT");
    sock_sa(sa, 127, 0, 0, 1, 0);
    ok = (int)H(SOK("4BindEiPK8sockaddrj"), u1, P(sa), 16) == 0;
    len = 16; memset(sb, 0xee, 16);
    ok = ok && (int)H(SOK("11GetSockNameEiP8sockaddrPj"), u1, P(sb), P(&len)) == 0 && len == 16 && sb[1] == 2 && sb[4] == 127 && sb[7] == 1 && (sb[2] | sb[3]);
    uint16_t port = (uint16_t)(sb[2] << 8 | sb[3]);
    sock_sa(sa, 10, 1, 2, 3, 4000);
    ok = ok && (int)H(SOK("4BindEiPK8sockaddrj"), u2, P(sa), 16) == -1 && sock_errno(c) == 99;
    ok = ok && (int)H(SOK("4BindEiPK8sockaddrj"), u2, 0, 16) == -1 && sock_errno(c) == 22;
    len = 0;
    ok = ok && (int)H("nnsocketGetSockName", u1, P(sb), P(&len)) == -1 && sock_errno(c) == 22;
    SOCK_CHECK("socket: Bind 127.0.0.1:0 + GetSockName (port assigned); Bind 10.1.2.3 -> EADDRNOTAVAIL; null / zero length -> EINVAL");
```

`scripts/run.py`:

```py
"""Run the built game for a while and summarise what happened.

    python scripts/run.py <name> [--seconds 30] [--exe smo_test.exe] [--env NAME=VALUE ...] [--full]
    python scripts/run.py <name> --exe smo_native.exe --seconds 0 [--userdata <folder>]      play: window, sound, no time limit
                          [--seq <file.seq>] [--userdata <folder>]

Copies build/bin/smo_native.exe (+ its .map) to the test name (only smo_native.exe / smo_user.exe open a visible window
and play sound; SMO_SHOW=1 shows a test exe), runs it from build/bin with the converted dump's main.elf and the time
limit, writes everything to build/run/<name>.log, then prints: the boot phases reached, the unimplemented imports
(name and call count), the strict check line (do-nothing handlers), frames presented, and a crash with its host frames named from the
linker map. --full prints the whole log instead.

--seq plays an input sequence file (SMO_SEQ, runtime/input/nnhid.c; one or more steps per line, '#' starts a comment), e.g.
tests/cap_kingdom.seq. --userdata gives the game its own save folder (SMO_USERDATA; created if missing): a new, empty
folder starts a new game, a copy of an earlier run's folder continues from there. Without it saves go to build/userdata.

A test copy first waits for one of SMO_MAX_GAMES places on this PC (default: one per 12 GB of memory, 2 on a 32 GB PC;
0 = no limit): a game in a stage takes 4-7 GB, and more test games than fit make the PC page, which slows every game
and can make graphics memory allocations fail. smo_native.exe and smo_user.exe never wait.
"""
import argparse
import ctypes
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from ctypes import wintypes

REPO = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(REPO, 'tools', 'lifter'))
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(REPO, 'tools'))
import mapaddr  # noqa: E402

PLAYED = ('smo_native.exe', 'smo_user.exe')     # the copies a person plays: a window, sound, no waiting for a place


class _MemoryStatus(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('dwLength', wintypes.DWORD), ('dwMemoryLoad', wintypes.DWORD)] + [
        (n, ctypes.c_ulonglong) for n in ('total_phys', 'avail_phys', 'total_page', 'avail_page', 'total_virtual',
                                          'avail_virtual', 'avail_extended')]


def max_games():
    """SMO_MAX_GAMES, or one test game per 12 GB of the PC's memory (at least one)."""
    if os.environ.get('SMO_MAX_GAMES'):
        return max(int(os.environ['SMO_MAX_GAMES']), 0)
    m = _MemoryStatus()
    m.dwLength = ctypes.sizeof(m)
    ctypes.windll.kernel32.GlobalMemoryStatusEx(ctypes.byref(m))
    return max(int(m.total_phys / 2**30 / 12), 1)


def take_place(exe_name, poll=2.0, name='Local\\smo_test_game_%d'):
    """Waits until fewer than max_games() test games run on this PC and takes a place: the named mutex
    Local\\smo_test_game_<k>, held by this thread until release_place (a launcher that dies frees its place: the mutex
    is abandoned). Returns the mutex handle, or None for the played copies and with no limit."""
    n = max_games()
    if exe_name.lower() in PLAYED or n == 0:
        return None
    k32 = ctypes.WinDLL('kernel32', use_last_error=True)
    k32.CreateMutexW.restype = wintypes.HANDLE
    k32.CreateMutexW.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, wintypes.BOOL, wintypes.LPCWSTR]
    k32.WaitForSingleObject.restype = wintypes.DWORD
    k32.WaitForSingleObject.argtypes = [wintypes.HANDLE, wintypes.DWORD]
    k32.CloseHandle.argtypes = [wintypes.HANDLE]
    waited = None
    while True:
        for k in range(n):
            h = k32.CreateMutexW(None, False, name % k)
            if not h:
                continue
            if k32.WaitForSingleObject(h, 0) in (0, 0x80):          # WAIT_OBJECT_0, WAIT_ABANDONED (its launcher died)
                if waited:
                    print('run.py: place %d of %d free after %.0f s' % (k, n, time.time() - waited))
                return h
            k32.CloseHandle(h)
        if waited is None:
            waited = time.time()
            print('run.py: %d test games are running (SMO_MAX_GAMES=%d): waiting for one to end' % (n, n))
            sys.stdout.flush()
        time.sleep(poll)


def release_place(h):
    if h:
        ctypes.windll.kernel32.ReleaseMutex(wintypes.HANDLE(h))
        ctypes.windll.kernel32.CloseHandle(wintypes.HANDLE(h))


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument('name')
    ap.add_argument('--seconds', type=int, default=30)
    ap.add_argument('--exe', default='smo_test.exe')
    ap.add_argument('--env', action='append', default=[])
    ap.add_argument('--full', action='store_true')
    ap.add_argument('--seq', help='input sequence file (SMO_SEQ)')
    ap.add_argument('--userdata', help='save folder for this run (SMO_USERDATA)')
    ap.add_argument('--timeout', type=int, help='seconds after which a game still running is killed (default --seconds + 120; '
                                                'a run of several stages, SMO_STAGE_LIST, has the time limit per stage)')
    a = ap.parse_args()
    import target as T
    BIN, RUN = T.build('bin'), T.build('run')
    os.makedirs(RUN, exist_ok=True)
    os.makedirs(T.build('userdata'), exist_ok=True)
    if a.seq:
        steps = [line.split('#', 1)[0].strip() for line in open(a.seq, encoding='utf-8')]
        a.env.append('SMO_SEQ=' + ' '.join(s for s in steps if s))
    if a.userdata:
        os.makedirs(a.userdata, exist_ok=True)
        a.env.append('SMO_USERDATA=' + os.path.abspath(a.userdata))
    src = os.path.join(BIN, 'smo_native.exe')
    exe = os.path.join(BIN, a.exe)
    place = take_place(a.exe)
    try:
        if a.exe != 'smo_native.exe':
            shutil.copy2(src, exe)
            shutil.copy2(src[:-4] + '.map', exe[:-4] + '.map')
        env = dict(os.environ)
        for kv in a.env:
            k, v = kv.split('=', 1)
            env[k] = v
        log = os.path.join(RUN, a.name + '.log')
        with open(log, 'w', encoding='utf-8', errors='replace') as f:
            try:
                r = subprocess.run([exe, os.path.relpath(T.elf('main'), BIN), str(max(a.seconds, 0))], cwd=BIN, stdout=f,
                                   stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, env=env,      # 0: no time limit, until the window is closed
                                   timeout=a.timeout or (a.seconds + 120 if a.seconds > 0 else None))
                code = r.returncode
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                code = 'timeout (killed)'
    finally:
        release_place(place)
    text = open(log, encoding='utf-8', errors='replace').read()
    if a.full:
        print(text)
        return
    lines = text.split('\n')
    print('log: %s   exit code: %s   lines: %d' % (log, code, len(lines)))
    for l in lines:
        if l.startswith(('[phase', 'strict check', 'display: ', 'nnMain returned', 'still running', 'GUEST TRAP', 'UNTRANSLATED',
                         'STRICT', 'memory heap', 'imports reached', 'main thread: last')) or 'frames presented' in l:
            print('  ' + l[:220])
    if 'unimplemented imports reached:' in text:
        part = text.split('unimplemented imports reached:', 1)[1].split('\n\n', 1)[0]
        print('unimplemented imports reached (calls, name):')
        for l in part.strip('\n').split('\n'):
            if l.strip():
                print('  ' + l.strip())
    m = re.search(r'HOST EXCEPTION.*?(?=\nimports reached|\Z)', text, re.S)
    if m:
        block = m.group(0)
        print('\n'.join('  ' + l for l in block.split('\n')[:4]))
        base, syms = mapaddr.load(exe[:-4] + '.map')
        for mod, off in re.findall(r'^\s+(\S+?)\+0x([0-9a-f]+)$', block, re.M):
            name = ''
            if mod.lower() == a.exe.lower():
                addr = base + int(off, 16)
                best = None
                for s in syms:
                    if s[0] <= addr:
                        best = s
                    else:
                        break
                name = '%s+0x%x' % (best[1], addr - best[0]) if best else '?'
            print('    %s+0x%s %s' % (mod, off, name))
        for l in block.split('\n'):
            if l.strip().startswith('f_') or 'last guest function' in l:
                print('  ' + l.strip())


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

```

`scripts/setup.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""One entry point: from a fresh clone and your own dump to a runnable native build of the game.

    python scripts/setup.py --dump <folder> [--jobs N]

The game is Super Mario Odyssey 1.4.1. <folder> is your decrypted dump of it (docs/building.md: what to dump with
nxdumptool and how to lay it out): the program's ExeFS with the update, the base game's main, the RomFS with the update
applied and the update's control.nacp; the Help pages and the console's shared fonts are optional. No keys and no
firmware are read: the files are already decrypted by your console. Where the files go: tools/target.py.

Nothing of the game is stored in the repository: every step derives its files from the dump into <repo>/build (ignored
by git). Steps run in this order and are resumable: a step whose output exists is skipped (--redo <step> repeats it,
--from <step> repeats it and everything after it); compile, tables and link always run, and only rebuild what changed.

    deps       check Python packages, clang, the Vulkan SDK, SDL3 and the WebView2 SDK
    import     your dump -> build/dump (modules as ELF, versions); RomFS and Help read in place  (tools/extract/extract.py)
    functions  every function of each module, with exact boundaries                            (tools/extract/functions.py)
    lift       AArch64 -> C for every function -> build/lift/main                              (tools/lifter/recomp.py)
    compile    the lifted C -> objects (clang -O1, incremental)                                (tools/lifter/build_main.py)
    tables     generated headers and tables                                     (tools/lifter/gen_tables.py, gen_sdktest.py)
    sdk        the system-library functions that are lifted too                                 (tools/lifter/sdklift.py)
    link       host runtime + game library -> build/bin/smo_native.exe                          (tools/lifter/build_exe.py)
    check      differential test against Unicorn and link check (only with --only check or --check; minutes)

Other commands:  --status (what is done)   --steps (list)   --only <step>
Tool locations: LLVM_ROOT (clang 9, default C:/llvm-9.0.0), VULKAN_HEADERS (default the Vulkan SDK's Include folder),
SDL3_ROOT (default deps/SDL3-*), WEBVIEW2_ROOT (default deps/webview2-*). Then start the game with scripts/run.py.
"""
import argparse
import glob
import importlib
import os
import subprocess
import sys

REPO = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(REPO, 'tools'))
import target as T  # noqa: E402

BUILD = T.BUILD
PY = sys.executable


def tool(*parts):
    return os.path.join(REPO, 'tools', *parts)


def exists(*parts):
    return os.path.exists(os.path.join(BUILD, *parts))


def check_deps(a):
    ok = True
    for mod, pip in (('lz4', 'lz4'), ('capstone', 'capstone'), ('unicorn', 'unicorn'), ('numpy', 'numpy'), ('PIL', 'Pillow')):
        try:
            importlib.import_module(mod)
        except ImportError:
            print('  missing Python package %s (pip install %s)' % (mod, pip))
            ok = False
    clang = os.path.join(os.environ.get('LLVM_ROOT', 'C:/llvm-9.0.0'), 'bin', 'clang.exe')
    vkh = os.environ.get('VULKAN_HEADERS') or next(iter(sorted(glob.glob('C:/VulkanSDK/*/Include'))), '')
    sdl = os.environ.get('SDL3_ROOT') or next(iter(sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(REPO, 'deps', 'SDL3-*')))), '')
    wv2 = os.environ.get('WEBVIEW2_ROOT') or next(iter(sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(REPO, 'deps', 'webview2-*')))[-1:]), '')
    wv2 = os.path.join(wv2, 'build', 'native', 'include', 'WebView2.h') if wv2 else ''
    for what, path in (('clang 9 (LLVM_ROOT)', clang), ('Vulkan SDK headers (VULKAN_HEADERS)', vkh), ('SDL3 (SDL3_ROOT or deps/SDL3-*)', sdl),
                       ('WebView2 SDK (WEBVIEW2_ROOT)', wv2)):
        found = bool(path) and os.path.exists(path)
        print('  %-38s %s' % (what, path if found else 'NOT FOUND'))
        ok &= found
    if a.dump and not os.path.isdir(a.dump):
        print('  dump folder %s does not exist' % a.dump)
        ok = False
    return ok


def need_dump(a):
    if not a.dump:
        raise SystemExit('this step reads your dump: give --dump <folder of your decrypted dump> (docs/building.md)')
    return ['--dump', a.dump]


# name, what it makes (for --status; in the build folder), done test (None: always runs), commands
STEPS = [
    ('deps', 'tools found', None, None),
    ('import', 'dump, romfs', lambda: os.path.exists(T.elf('main')) and exists('romfs'),
     lambda a: [[PY, tool('extract', 'extract.py')] + need_dump(a)]),
    ('functions', 'functions', lambda: exists('functions', 'main_functions.tsv'),
     lambda a: [[PY, tool('extract', 'functions.py')]]),
    ('lift', 'lift/main', lambda: exists('lift', 'main', 'table.c'),
     lambda a: [[PY, tool('lifter', 'recomp.py'), 'full']]),
    ('compile', 'obj/main', None, lambda a: [[PY, tool('lifter', 'build_main.py'), str(a.jobs)]]),
    ('tables', 'gen', None,
     lambda a: [[PY, tool('lifter', 'gen_tables.py')], [PY, tool('lifter', 'gen_sdktest.py')]]),
    ('sdk', 'gen/sdklift_gen.c', lambda: exists('gen', 'sdklift_report.txt'),
     lambda a: [[PY, tool('lifter', 'sdklift.py'), 'gen']]),
    ('link', 'bin/smo_native.exe', None, lambda a: [[PY, tool('lifter', 'build_exe.py')]]),
    ('check', 'difftest + linkcheck', None,
     lambda a: [[PY, tool('lifter', 'difftest.py'), 'all'], [PY, tool('lifter', 'linkcheck.py')]]),
]
NAMES = [s[0] for s in STEPS]


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.split('\n')[0])
    ap.add_argument('--dump', help='folder of your decrypted dump (docs/building.md)')
    ap.add_argument('--jobs', type=int, default=max(1, (os.cpu_count() or 2) - 2))
    ap.add_argument('--status', action='store_true')
    ap.add_argument('--steps', action='store_true')
    ap.add_argument('--only', choices=NAMES)
    ap.add_argument('--redo', choices=NAMES)
    ap.add_argument('--from', dest='from_step', choices=NAMES)
    ap.add_argument('--check', action='store_true', help='also run the check step at the end')
    a = ap.parse_args()

    if a.steps:
        print('\n'.join(NAMES))
        return
    if a.status:
        print('Super Mario Odyssey %s: %s' % (T.VERSION, os.path.relpath(BUILD, REPO)))
        for name, made, done, _ in STEPS:
            state = 'runs every time (incremental)' if done is None else ('done' if done() else 'to do')
            print('  %-10s %-28s %s' % (name, made, state if name not in ('deps', 'check') else 'on demand'))
        return

    if a.only:
        todo = [a.only]
    else:
        todo = [n for n in NAMES if n != 'check' or a.check]
    first = NAMES.index(a.from_step) if a.from_step else None
    for name, made, done, cmds in STEPS:
        if name not in todo:
            continue
        forced = a.only == name or a.redo == name or (first is not None and NAMES.index(name) >= first)
        if name == 'deps':
            print('[deps]')
            if not check_deps(a):
                raise SystemExit('some tools are missing (see docs/building.md)')
            continue
        if done is not None and done() and not forced:
            print('[%s] done (%s)' % (name, made))
        else:
            for cmd in cmds(a):
                print('[%s] %s' % (name, ' '.join(os.path.relpath(c, REPO) if c.startswith(REPO) else c for c in cmd[1:])), flush=True)
                r = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=REPO)
                if r.returncode != 0:
                    raise SystemExit('[%s] failed (exit code %d); fix the cause and run setup again, it resumes here' % (name, r.returncode))
    if 'link' in todo:
        print('\nBuilt: %s. Start the game with: python scripts/run.py <run name> --seconds 300'
              % os.path.relpath(T.build('bin', 'smo_native.exe'), REPO))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

`tests/bntx_layout_check.py`:

```py
"""Check the runtime's texture layout (runtime/gfx/tex_decode.c tex_layout) against every texture SMO ships.

    python tests/bntx_layout_check.py [--limit N] [--show 12]

Reference: the BNTX texture containers in the RomFS (inside Yaz0-compressed SARC / BFRES archives, found by their
"BNTX" header). Each texture record (BRTI) holds what Nintendo's tools computed with NVN's layout rules: image size,
alignment, block height (texture layout word, bits 0..2) and the offset of every mip level. For each texture the same
parameters go through tex_layout and every field is compared. Formats are mapped only where the block size is certain
(R8, RG8, RGB565, RGBA8, BGRA8, BC1..BC7, all ASTC footprints); other formats are counted as unmapped, not guessed.
Needs build/test/layout_probe.dll (built here with clang from tests/layout_probe.c + runtime/gfx/tex_decode.c).
"""
import argparse
import collections
import ctypes
import os
import struct
import subprocess
import sys

REPO = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(REPO, 'tools'))
import target as T  # noqa: E402
ROMFS = T.build('romfs')
OUT = os.path.join(REPO, 'build', 'test')
CLANG = os.path.join(os.environ.get('LLVM_ROOT', 'C:/llvm-9.0.0'), 'bin', 'clang.exe')

# BNTX surface type (high byte of the format word) -> a NVN format with the same block size and footprint
NVN_FOR_TYPE = {0x02: 0x01, 0x07: 0x3C, 0x09: 0x0D, 0x0B: 0x25, 0x0C: 0x25,
                0x1A: 0x42, 0x1B: 0x43, 0x1C: 0x44, 0x1D: 0x49, 0x1E: 0x4B, 0x1F: 0x4F, 0x20: 0x4D}
NVN_FOR_TYPE.update({0x2D + i: 0x79 + i for i in range(14)})             # ASTC 4x4 .. 12x12


class ProbeOut(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('size', ctypes.c_int64), ('data_size', ctypes.c_int64), ('alignment', ctypes.c_int64),
                ('layer_stride', ctypes.c_int64), ('bh_log2', ctypes.c_int32), ('bd_log2', ctypes.c_int32),
                ('levels', ctypes.c_int32), ('unknown_format', ctypes.c_int32), ('lvl_offset', ctypes.c_int64 * 16)]


def build_probe():
    os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
    dll = os.path.join(OUT, 'layout_probe.dll')
    srcs = [os.path.join(REPO, 'tests', 'layout_probe.c'), T.runtime('gfx', 'tex_decode.c')]
    if not os.path.exists(dll) or os.path.getmtime(dll) < max(os.path.getmtime(s) for s in srcs):
        r = subprocess.run([CLANG, '-shared', '-O2', '-w'] + T.runtime_includes() + srcs + ['-o', dll],
                           capture_output=True, text=True)
        if r.returncode:
            raise SystemExit(r.stdout + r.stderr)
    lib = ctypes.CDLL(dll)
    lib.yaz0_decompress.restype = ctypes.c_int64
    lib.yaz0_decompress.argtypes = [ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_int64, ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_int64]
    lib.probe_layout.argtypes = [ctypes.c_int] * 7 + [ctypes.POINTER(ProbeOut)]
    return lib


def textures(blob):
    """Yield (name, BRTI fields) for every BNTX found in blob."""
    pos = 0
    while True:
        b = blob.find(b'BNTX\x00\x00\x00\x00', pos)
        if b < 0:
            return
        pos = b + 8
        if blob[b + 0x20:b + 0x24] != b'NX  ':
            continue
        count = struct.unpack_from('<I', blob, b + 0x24)[0]
        info_arr = struct.unpack_from('<Q', blob, b + 0x28)[0]
        if count > 100000 or b + info_arr + 8 * count > len(blob):
            continue
        for i in range(count):
            t = b + struct.unpack_from('<Q', blob, b + info_arr + 8 * i)[0]
            if blob[t:t + 4] != b'BRTI':
                continue
            (flags, dim, tile, swz, mips, samples, fmt, access, w, h, d, arr, layout, layout2) = \
                struct.unpack_from('<BBHHHIIIIIIIII', blob, t + 0x10)
            image_size, align, comp, ttype = struct.unpack_from('<IIII', blob, t + 0x50)
            name_off, _, ptrs = struct.unpack_from('<QQQ', blob, t + 0x60)
            name = ''
            if 0 < name_off < len(blob) - b:
                n = struct.unpack_from('<H', blob, b + name_off)[0]
                name = blob[b + name_off + 2:b + name_off + 2 + n].decode('utf8', 'replace')
            offs = list(struct.unpack_from('<%dQ' % mips, blob, b + ptrs)) if 0 < ptrs < len(blob) - b and mips <= 16 else []
            yield name, dict(dim=dim, tile=tile, mips=mips, samples=samples, fmt=fmt, w=w, h=h, d=d, arr=arr,
                             bh=layout & 7, size=image_size, align=align, ttype=ttype, offs=offs)


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument('--limit', type=int, default=0, help='stop after this many archives (0 = all)')
    ap.add_argument('--show', type=int, default=12)
    a = ap.parse_args()
    lib = build_probe()
    cap = 256 << 20
    buf = ctypes.create_string_buffer(cap)
    stats = collections.Counter()
    bad = collections.defaultdict(list)
    unmapped = collections.Counter()
    archives = []
    for root, _, files in os.walk(ROMFS):
        for f in files:
            if f.endswith('.szs'):
                archives.append(os.path.join(root, f))
    archives.sort()
    if a.limit:
        archives = archives[:a.limit]
    for k, path in enumerate(archives):
        src = open(path, 'rb').read()
        n = lib.yaz0_decompress(src, len(src), buf, cap)
        if n < 0:
            stats['archives not decodable'] += 1
            continue
        stats['archives'] += 1
        blob = buf.raw[:n]
        for name, t in textures(blob):
            stats['textures'] += 1
            typ = t['fmt'] >> 8
            if typ not in NVN_FOR_TYPE:
                unmapped['0x%04x' % t['fmt']] += 1
                continue
            if t['tile'] != 0:
                stats['not block-linear (tile mode %d), skipped' % t['tile']] += 1
                continue
            target = {1: 0, 2: 1, 3: 2}.get(t['dim'], 1)
            depth = t['d']
            if t['arr'] > 1:
                target, depth = (4, t['arr']) if target == 1 else (3, t['arr'])
            o = ProbeOut()
            lib.probe_layout(target, NVN_FOR_TYPE[typ], t['w'], t['h'], depth, t['mips'], 0, ctypes.byref(o))
            stats['compared'] += 1
            where = '%s:%s %dx%dx%d arr %d mips %d fmt 0x%04x' % (os.path.relpath(path, ROMFS), name, t['w'], t['h'], t['d'], t['arr'], t['mips'], t['fmt'])
            # The BRTI alignment field is NOT compared: it is 512 for every texture regardless of block height (5,442 of
            # 5,442 sampled, block heights 1..16 GOBs), i.e. the container's data alignment, not NVN's storage alignment.
            # Ours (512 << block height log2) is always a multiple of it, which is what the container requires.
            stats['alignment: ours a multiple of the BNTX field' if o.alignment % max(t['align'], 1) == 0
                  else 'alignment: ours NOT a multiple of the BNTX field'] += 1
            checks = [('size', o.data_size, t['size']), ('block height', o.bh_log2, t['bh'])]
            if len(t['offs']) == t['mips'] and t['offs']:
                rel = [x - t['offs'][0] for x in t['offs']]
                checks.append(('mip offsets', [o.lvl_offset[i] for i in range(min(t['mips'], o.levels))], rel[:o.levels]))
            ok_all = True
            for what, got, want in checks:
                if got == want:
                    stats[what + ' equal'] += 1
                else:
                    ok_all = False
                    stats[what + ' DIFFERENT'] += 1
                    if len(bad[what]) < a.show:
                        bad[what].append('%s: ours %s, BNTX %s' % (where, got, want))
            stats['all fields equal' if ok_all else 'some field different'] += 1
        if (k + 1) % 500 == 0:
            print('  %d/%d archives, %d textures' % (k + 1, len(archives), stats['textures']), flush=True)
    for key in sorted(stats):
        print('%-48s %d' % (key, stats[key]))
    if unmapped:
        print('unmapped formats (not compared):', ', '.join('%s x%d' % kv for kv in unmapped.most_common()))
    for what, lines in bad.items():
        print('examples, %s:' % what)
        for l in lines:
            print('  ' + l)
    sys.exit(0 if stats['some field different'] == 0 and stats['compared'] > 0 else 1)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

```

`tests/check_all_shaders.py`:

```py
"""Every shader stage of the game through the translator, offline: no need to play to the places that use them.

    python tests/check_all_shaders.py [--folders ShaderData,EffectData,SystemData,LayoutData] [--list]

1. Takes every NVN shader stage out of the game's shader containers in build/romfs (agl .sharcb, g3d .bfsha, the effect
   .ptcl, inside the SARC archives of the folders given; raw .bin shader files there, such as the primitive drawer's) and
   out of main.elf / sdk.elf, and writes the distinct ones to
   build/shaders_all/*.mxs (derived from the game: under build/, ignored by git).
   A graphics stage is a code section (magic 0x12345678, program header at +0x30, instructions, constant data); its
   length comes from its own instructions (every program ends with a branch to itself). A compute stage has no header:
   it is found through its control section (magic 0x98761234; +0x6f8 code bytes, +0x6fc / +0x700 constant data size and
   offset, +0x714 NVN stage, +0x748 work group, +0x754 shared and local bytes). Programs that cannot be delimited are
   reported, not guessed (see stages_of).
2. Builds build/bin/mx_all.exe (tests/mx_all.c + runtime/gfx/mx_translate.c, clang 9) and runs it from build/bin on them:
   translation with the Vulkan back end's settings and compilation to SPIR-V with the renderer's compiler.
Exit status 0 when every stage translates and compiles.
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import os
import struct
import subprocess
import sys

REPO = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(REPO, 'tools'))
import target as T  # noqa: E402
ROM = T.build('romfs')
OUT = T.build('shaders_all')
BIN = T.build('bin')
CLANG = os.path.join(os.environ.get('LLVM_ROOT', 'C:/llvm-9.0.0'), 'bin', 'clang.exe')
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(REPO, 'tools', 'dev'))
from sarc import yaz0  # noqa: E402

CTL, CODE = 0x98761234, 0x12345678


def sarc_files(d):
    e = '<' if d[6:8] == b'\xff\xfe' else '>'
    hdr, = struct.unpack_from(e + 'H', d, 4)
    data_off, = struct.unpack_from(e + 'I', d, 0xc)
    nodes, = struct.unpack_from(e + 'H', d, hdr + 6)
    names = hdr + 0xc + nodes * 0x10 + 8
    for i in range(nodes):
        _, attr, beg, end = struct.unpack_from(e + 'IIII', d, hdr + 0xc + i * 0x10)
        name = ''
        if attr & 0x01000000:
            o = names + (attr & 0xffff) * 4
            name = d[o:d.index(b'\0', o)].decode('utf-8', 'replace')
        yield name, d[data_off + beg:data_off + end]


BRA_M, BRA_V = 0xfff0000000000000, 0xe240000000000000
SPH_TO_MX = {1: 0, 5: 1, 4: 2, 2: 3, 3: 4}            # program header type -> MX_* stage


EXIT_M, EXIT_V = 0xfff0000000000000, 0xe300000000000000


def program_end(blob, start, limit, fallback=False):
    """Bytes from `start` (the first instruction group) to the end of the group holding the program's last instruction:
    the compiler ends a program with a branch to itself (BRA with offset -8), which appears nowhere else. Small programs
    may end with EXIT alone: with `fallback`, when there is no such branch before `limit` (the next code section), the
    group of the last EXIT is the end. None when neither is found."""
    q, last_exit = start, None
    while q + 32 <= limit:
        for k in (1, 2, 3):                            # word 0 of each group of four is scheduling information
            w, = struct.unpack_from('<Q', blob, q + 8 * k)
            if w & BRA_M == BRA_V and (w >> 20) & 0xffffff == 0xfffff8:
                return q + 32 - start
            if w & EXIT_M == EXIT_V:
                last_exit = q + 32 - start
        q += 32
    return last_exit if fallback else None


def stages_of(blob):
    """(stage, code bytes, constant data, work group, shared, local) of every program in a container, and the number that
    could not be delimited. Graphics: every code section (magic 0x12345678 at a 0x100 boundary, zero header words, the
    program header at +0x30), its length from its own instructions, its constant data the bytes from the next 0x100
    boundary after it to the next section (at most 64 KB; only jump tables are read from it at translation). Compute
    sections have no magic: in an agl archive (magic "BAHS") they follow each other from the code region (header word 7)
    in the order of their control sections (+0x714 stage 5), each checked to end within the size its control gives; in
    a BNSH container (nn::gfx) through the record, inside that container, that holds the control's and the code's
    offsets."""
    n4 = len(blob) // 4
    words = struct.unpack_from('<%dI' % n4, blob)
    codes = [i * 4 for i, w in enumerate(words) if w == CODE and (i * 4) % 0x100 == 0 and not any(words[i + 1:i + 12])]
    out, bad = [], 0
    for j, x in enumerate(codes):
        sph, = struct.unpack_from('<I', blob, x + 0x30)
        t = (sph >> 10) & 15
        limit = codes[j + 1] if j + 1 < len(codes) else len(blob)
        end = program_end(blob, x + 0x30 + 0x50, limit, fallback=True) if t in SPH_TO_MX else None
        if end is None:
            bad += 1
            continue
        code_len = 0x50 + end
        cstart = x + ((0x30 + code_len + 0xff) & ~0xff)
        out.append((SPH_TO_MX[t], blob[x + 0x30:x + 0x30 + code_len], blob[cstart:min(limit, cstart + 0x10000)], (0, 0, 0), 0, 0))
    if blob[:4] == b'BAHS':
        region, = struct.unpack_from('<I', blob, 0x1c)
        for c in [i * 4 for i, w in enumerate(words) if w == CTL]:
            if c < 0x60 or c + 0x760 > len(blob) or struct.unpack_from('<I', blob, c + 0x714)[0] != 5:
                continue
            # the stage's record holds its code offset (from the code region, header word 7) 0x60 bytes before the control
            # section; programs follow each other without padding, and a small one may end with EXIT alone
            pos = region + struct.unpack_from('<I', blob, c - 0x60)[0]
            size, cbsize, cboff = struct.unpack_from('<III', blob, c + 0x6f8)
            end = program_end(blob, pos, min(len(blob), pos + size), fallback=True) if pos + 32 <= len(blob) else None
            if not size or end is None or end > size:
                bad += 1
                continue
            out.append((5, blob[pos:pos + size], blob[pos + cboff:pos + cboff + cbsize], struct.unpack_from('<3I', blob, c + 0x748),
                        *struct.unpack_from('<2I', blob, c + 0x754)))
    else:
        starts = []
        i = blob.find(b'BNSH')
        while i >= 0:
            starts.append(i)
            i = blob.find(b'BNSH', i + 4)
        for c in [i * 4 for i, w in enumerate(words) if w == CTL and i * 4 + 0x760 <= len(blob) and words[i + 0x714 // 4] == 5]:
            # BNSH (nn::gfx): offsets are from the container's start, and a stage's control offset is stored as a u64 with
            # its code offset right after it; a compute code section starts with its first instruction group. The record
            # and the code lie inside the container (file size at +0x1c), and only there are they looked for: the same
            # eight bytes can occur elsewhere in the blob (an effect archive of the 1.4.1 update has them in data
            # outside the container, beside "code" that is data and ends with a stray EXIT).
            b = max((s for s in starts if s < c), default=None)
            size, cbsize, cboff = struct.unpack_from('<III', blob, c + 0x6f8)
            got = None
            if b is not None:
                bend = min(len(blob), b + struct.unpack_from('<I', blob, b + 0x1c)[0])
                pat = struct.pack('<Q', c - b)
                p = blob.find(pat, b, bend)
                while p >= 0 and got is None:
                    if p % 8 == 0 and p + 16 <= bend:
                        x = b + struct.unpack_from('<Q', blob, p + 8)[0]
                        end = program_end(blob, x, min(len(blob), x + size + 0x100), fallback=True) if x + 32 <= bend else None
                        if end is not None and end <= size + 0x20 and x + size <= bend:
                            got = x
                    p = blob.find(pat, p + 1, bend)
            if got is None:
                bad += 1
                continue
            out.append((5, blob[got:got + size], blob[got + cboff:got + cboff + cbsize], struct.unpack_from('<3I', blob, c + 0x748),
                        *struct.unpack_from('<2I', blob, c + 0x754)))
    return out, bad


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument('--folders', default='ShaderData,EffectData,SystemData,LayoutData')
    ap.add_argument('--list', action='store_true')
    ap.add_argument('--extract-only', action='store_true', help='write the stage files and the report, do not translate')
    a = ap.parse_args()
    os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
    for n in os.listdir(OUT):
        if n.endswith('.mxs'):
            os.remove(os.path.join(OUT, n))
    seen, written, total, unpaired_all = set(), 0, 0, 0
    report = []

    def take(label, blob):
        nonlocal written, total, unpaired_all
        st, unpaired = stages_of(blob)
        if not st and not unpaired:
            return
        total += len(st)
        unpaired_all += unpaired
        new = 0
        for stage, code, cdata, local, smem, lmem in st:
            key = hashlib.sha1(bytes([stage]) + code + b'|' + cdata).digest()
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            new += 1
            written += 1
            with open(os.path.join(OUT, '%05d_%d.mxs' % (written, stage)), 'wb') as f:
                f.write(struct.pack('<4s8I', b'MXS1', stage, len(code), len(cdata), local[0], local[1], local[2], smem, lmem))
                f.write(code)
                f.write(cdata)
        report.append('%-60s %5d stages (%d new), %d not delimited' % (label[:60], len(st), new, unpaired))

    for folder in a.folders.split(','):
        base = os.path.join(ROM, folder)
        for root, _, files in os.walk(base):
            for n in sorted(files):
                path = os.path.join(root, n)
                if n.endswith('.bin'):                         # raw shader files (SystemData/primitive_drawer_nvn_shader.bin)
                    d = open(path, 'rb').read()
                    if struct.pack('<I', CTL) in d:
                        take(os.path.relpath(path, ROM), d)
                    continue
                if not n.endswith('.szs'):
                    continue
                d = yaz0(open(path, 'rb').read())
                if d[:4] != b'SARC':
                    continue
                todo = [(os.path.relpath(path, ROM), d)]
                while todo:                                    # archives inside archives (SystemData/AglResource.szs)
                    label, arc = todo.pop()
                    for name, data in sarc_files(arc):
                        inner = yaz0(data) if data[:4] == b'Yaz0' else data
                        if inner[:4] == b'SARC':
                            todo.append((label + ':' + name, inner))
                        elif struct.pack('<I', CTL) in inner:
                            take(label + ':' + name, inner)
    for mod in ('main', 'sdk'):
        p = T.elf(mod)
        if os.path.exists(p):
            take(mod + '.elf', open(p, 'rb').read())
    for line in report:
        print(line)
    print('stages found: %d, distinct: %d, not delimited: %d -> %s' % (total, written, unpaired_all, OUT))
    if a.extract_only:
        sys.exit(1 if unpaired_all else 0)
    exe = os.path.join(BIN, 'mx_all.exe')
    r = subprocess.run([CLANG, '-O1', '-w'] + T.runtime_includes() + [os.path.join(REPO, 'tests', 'mx_all.c'),
                        T.runtime('gfx', 'mx_translate.c'), '-o', exe], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if r.returncode:
        print((r.stdout + r.stderr)[-3000:])
        sys.exit('check_all_shaders: build of mx_all.exe failed')
    r = subprocess.run([exe, OUT] + (['--list'] if a.list else []), cwd=BIN)
    sys.exit(1 if r.returncode or unpaired_all else 0)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

```

`tests/check_fast_paths.py`:

```py
"""Check two fast paths of the runtime against the plain code they replaced, on random input.

    python tests/check_fast_paths.py

- index_max (runtime/gfx/nvn_vk_draw.c): the largest index of an index range, 16 bytes at a time (SSE2), against a loop
  over every index; 8-, 16- and 32-bit indices, primitive restart on and off.
- The live-list cell index (runtime/gfx/nvn_gl.c): job_list_overwrite looks only at the lists in the 64 KB chunks of
  command memory a new recording covers; checked against a walk over every live list (the same lists must end), and
  no dropped list may stay in the index.

The functions are copied out of the runtime sources into build/tmp/fast_paths_extract.h, so the code under test is the
runtime's own; tests/fast_paths.c holds the reference code and the random cases. Built with clang 9 at -O1, as the
runtime is. Exit status 0 when everything matches.
"""
import os
import subprocess
import sys

REPO = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
RT = os.path.join(REPO, 'runtime', 'gfx')
TMP = os.path.join(REPO, 'build', 'tmp')
CLANG = os.path.join(os.environ.get('LLVM_ROOT', 'C:/llvm-9.0.0'), 'bin', 'clang.exe')


def cut(text, start, end, what):
    i = text.find(start)
    j = text.find(end, i + 1) if i >= 0 else -1
    if i < 0 or j < 0:
        sys.exit('check_fast_paths: %s not found in the runtime sources (did the code move?)' % what)
    return text[i:j]


def main():
    gl = open(os.path.join(RT, 'nvn_gl.c'), encoding='utf-8').read()
    vk = open(os.path.join(RT, 'nvn_vk_draw.c'), encoding='utf-8').read()
    parts = [
        '/* generated by tests/check_fast_paths.py from runtime/gfx/nvn_gl.c and runtime/gfx/nvn_vk_draw.c: do not edit */\n',
        cut(gl, 'typedef struct { uint8_t *data; size_t len;', '\n', 'the List record') + '\n',
        'static List *g_lists;\n'
        'static int g_list_count, *g_live, g_live_n;\n'
        'static LONG64 g_list_reuse_drops, g_list_reuse_events, g_imax_scans;\n'
        'static SRWLOCK g_list_lock = SRWLOCK_INIT;\n'
        'static struct { uint32_t gen; int restart; } R;\n'
        'static uint8_t *g_mem;\n'
        '#define P(a) ((void *)(g_mem + (a)))\n',
        cut(gl, '#define CELL_SHIFT', '\nstatic CmdBuf *cb_get', 'the cell index') + '\n',
        cut(gl, 'typedef struct { uint64_t seg[4][3]; int nseg; LONG64 seq; } Overwrite;', 'static int list_lru_cmp',
            'job_list_overwrite') + '\n',
        cut(vk, 'static uint32_t index_max(uint64_t addr, int count, unsigned t) {', '/* maxv: the highest vertex',
            'index_max') + '\n',
    ]
    os.makedirs(TMP, exist_ok=True)
    with open(os.path.join(TMP, 'fast_paths_extract.h'), 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(''.join(parts))
    exe = os.path.join(TMP, 'fast_paths.exe')
    r = subprocess.run([CLANG, '-O1', '-w', '-I', TMP, os.path.join(REPO, 'tests', 'fast_paths.c'), '-o', exe],
                       capture_output=True, text=True)
    if r.returncode:
        print((r.stdout + r.stderr)[-4000:])
        sys.exit('check_fast_paths: build failed')
    r = subprocess.run([exe])
    print('PASS' if r.returncode == 0 else 'FAIL')
    sys.exit(r.returncode)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

`tests/check_game_places.py`:

```py
"""Checks scripts/run.py's limit on test games running at once on this PC (take_place / release_place).

    python tests/check_game_places.py

No game is started: threads take places under mutex names of this check's own (the real places stay free). With two
places: A and B take them; C and D wait; C gets A's place when A releases it, D gets B's when B's thread ends without
releasing it (an abandoned mutex: a launcher that died); smo_native.exe and SMO_MAX_GAMES=0 never wait. Exit code =
number of failed checks."""
import os
import sys
import threading
import time

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))), 'scripts'))
import run as R  # noqa: E402

NAME = 'Local\\smo_check_game_places_%d_%%d' % os.getpid()
POLL = 0.05
fails = 0


def check(ok, what):
    global fails
    fails += not ok
    print('%s %s' % ('ok  ' if ok else 'FAIL', what))


os.environ['SMO_MAX_GAMES'] = '2'
t0 = time.time()
got = {}
b_may_end = threading.Event()


def holder(tag, hold, release=True):
    h = R.take_place('smo_check.exe', POLL, NAME)
    got[tag] = time.time() - t0
    if hold:
        time.sleep(hold)
    else:
        b_may_end.wait()
    if release:
        R.release_place(h)
    # without release: the thread ends owning the mutex, which abandons it


def waiter(tag):
    h = R.take_place('smo_check.exe', POLL, NAME)
    got[tag] = time.time() - t0
    time.sleep(0.5)
    R.release_place(h)


a = threading.Thread(target=holder, args=('A', 1.0))
b = threading.Thread(target=holder, args=('B', None, False))
a.start()
b.start()
time.sleep(0.3)
check('A' in got and 'B' in got and max(got['A'], got['B']) < 0.3, 'A and B take the two places at once (%s)' % got)
h = R.take_place('smo_native.exe', POLL, NAME)
check(h is None, 'smo_native.exe does not wait and takes no place')
c = threading.Thread(target=waiter, args=('C',))
c.start()
time.sleep(0.3)
d = threading.Thread(target=waiter, args=('D',))
d.start()
time.sleep(0.3)
check('C' not in got and 'D' not in got, 'C and D wait while both places are taken')
c.join(5)
d.join(5)
tc, td = got.get('C', -1), got.get('D', -1)
check(min(tc, td) >= 0.95, 'C and D get a place only once A releases its own at 1.0 s (C %.2f s, D %.2f s)' % (tc, td))
check(abs(tc - td) >= 0.45, 'one after the other, as B still holds the other place (C %.2f s, D %.2f s)' % (tc, td))
# abandoned: B still holds a place; take the other, then a waiter must get B's when B's thread ends without releasing
h1 = R.take_place('smo_check.exe', POLL, NAME)
e_got = {}


def e_waiter():
    h = R.take_place('smo_check.exe', POLL, NAME)
    e_got['E'] = time.time()
    R.release_place(h)


e = threading.Thread(target=e_waiter)
e.start()
time.sleep(0.3)
check('E' not in e_got, 'E waits while B and this thread hold both places')
t_end = time.time()
b_may_end.set()
b.join(5)
e.join(5)
check('E' in e_got and e_got['E'] >= t_end, 'E gets the place of B, whose thread ended without releasing it (abandoned)')
R.release_place(h1)
os.environ['SMO_MAX_GAMES'] = '0'
check(R.take_place('smo_check.exe', POLL, NAME) is None, 'SMO_MAX_GAMES=0: no limit, no place taken')
del os.environ['SMO_MAX_GAMES']
n = R.max_games()
check(n >= 1, 'default limit from the PC\'s memory: %d' % n)
print('%d failed' % fails)
sys.exit(fails)

```

`tests/fast_paths.c`:

```c
/* The random cases of tests/check_fast_paths.py: the runtime's index_max and live-list cell index (copied into
 * fast_paths_extract.h by that script) against the plain code they replaced. Prints the counts; exit status 0 when
 * nothing differs. */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <windows.h>
#include <emmintrin.h>
#include "fast_paths_extract.h"

static uint64_t rng = 88172645463325252ull;
static uint64_t rnd(void) { rng ^= rng << 13; rng ^= rng >> 7; rng ^= rng << 17; return rng; }

/* index_max as it was: one index at a time */
static uint32_t index_max_ref(uint64_t addr, int count, unsigned t) {
    const uint8_t *src = P(addr);
    uint32_t mx = 0;
    if (t == 0) { for (int k = 0; k < count; k++) { uint32_t v = src[k]; if (v > mx && !(R.restart && v == 0xFFu)) mx = v; } }
    else if (t == 1) { const uint16_t *p16 = (const uint16_t *)src; for (int k = 0; k < count; k++) { uint32_t v = p16[k]; if (v > mx && !(R.restart && v == 0xFFFFu)) mx = v; } }
    else { const uint32_t *p32 = (const uint32_t *)src; for (int k = 0; k < count; k++) { uint32_t v = p32[k]; if (v > mx && !(R.restart && v == 0xFFFFFFFFu)) mx = v; } }
    return mx;
}
/* job_list_overwrite as it was: every live list, on a copy of the finalized flags */
static void overwrite_ref(int *fin, const Overwrite *w) {
    for (int k = 0; k < g_live_n; k++) {
        List *l = &g_lists[g_live[k]];
        if (!l->data || fin[g_live[k]] || l->seq >= w->seq) continue;
        int hit = 0;
        for (int p = 0; p < l->nblk && p < 4 && !hit; p++)
            for (int j = 0; j < w->nseg && j < 4 && !hit; j++)
                hit = l->blk[p][0] == w->seg[j][0] && l->blk[p][1] < w->seg[j][2] && w->seg[j][1] < l->blk[p][2];
        if (hit) fin[g_live[k]] = 2;
    }
}
/* a piece of command memory: one of three pools, up to 8 MB in (often at or next to a chunk boundary); empty, short or
 * long; now and then wider than CELL_SPAN chunks */
static void rand_piece(uint64_t *p, int wide) {
    static const uint64_t pools[3] = {0x1000, 0x2000, 0x3000};
    p[0] = pools[rnd() % 3];
    uint64_t lo = rnd() % (8u << 20), len = rnd() % 5 == 0 ? 0 : rnd() % (rnd() % 4 == 0 ? 300000 : 3000);
    if (rnd() % 3 == 0) lo = (lo | (((uint64_t)1 << CELL_SHIFT) - 1)) + rnd() % 3;      /* a boundary - 1, the boundary, + 1 */
    if (rnd() % 3 == 0) len = (((lo + len) | (((uint64_t)1 << CELL_SHIFT) - 1)) + rnd() % 3) - lo;
    if (wide) len = (uint64_t)(CELL_SPAN + 1 + rnd() % 50) << CELL_SHIFT;
    p[1] = lo; p[2] = lo + len;
}
/* The index against the live lists: every entry must be a piece of a live list over that chunk (or a wide piece in
 * g_wide), and as many entries as the live lists' pieces cover. Returns the number of wrong entries plus the difference. */
static long long index_check(void) {
    long long wrong = 0, have = 0, want = 0;
    for (int c = 0; c < g_cells_cap; c++) {
        Cell *e = &g_cells[c];
        for (int m = 0; e->used && m < e->n; m++) {
            List *l = &g_lists[e->ix[m]];
            int ok = 0;
            for (int p = 0; l->data && p < l->nblk && p < 4 && !ok; p++) {
                uint64_t c0, c1;
                cell_span(l->blk[p], &c0, &c1);
                ok = l->blk[p][0] == e->pool && c1 - c0 < CELL_SPAN && e->chunk >= c0 && e->chunk <= c1;
            }
            wrong += !ok; have++;
        }
    }
    for (int m = 0; m < g_wide_n; m++) {
        List *l = &g_lists[g_wide[m]];
        int ok = 0;
        for (int p = 0; l->data && p < l->nblk && p < 4 && !ok; p++) { uint64_t c0, c1; cell_span(l->blk[p], &c0, &c1); ok = c1 - c0 >= CELL_SPAN; }
        wrong += !ok; have++;
    }
    for (int k = 0; k < g_live_n; k++) {
        List *l = &g_lists[g_live[k]];
        for (int p = 0; p < l->nblk && p < 4; p++) { uint64_t c0, c1; cell_span(l->blk[p], &c0, &c1); want += c1 - c0 >= CELL_SPAN ? 1 : (long long)(c1 - c0 + 1); }
    }
    return wrong + (have > want ? have - want : want - have);
}

int main(void) {
    /* 1. index_max: random ranges, alignments and value patterns */
    size_t memsz = 1 << 20;
    g_mem = malloc(memsz + 64);
    long long cases = 0, bad = 0;
    for (int it = 0; it < 200000; it++) {
        unsigned t = (unsigned)(rnd() % 3);
        int count = (int)(rnd() % (rnd() % 8 == 0 ? 5000 : 70));
        uint64_t addr = (rnd() % (memsz - ((size_t)count << t) - 16)) & ~(((uint64_t)1 << t) - 1);
        int mode = (int)(rnd() % 4);           /* small values, any, near the top, with restart values */
        for (int k = 0; k < (count << t) + 16; k++) {
            uint8_t b = (uint8_t)rnd();
            if (mode == 0) b &= 0x0f;
            if (mode == 2) b |= 0xf0;
            if (mode == 3 && rnd() % 4 == 0) b = 0xff;
            g_mem[addr + k] = b;
        }
        R.restart = (int)(rnd() % 2); R.gen++;
        uint32_t a = index_max(addr, count, t), b = index_max_ref(addr, count, t);
        cases++;
        if (a != b && bad++ < 10) printf("index_max: type %u, %d indices, restart %d: %u, one at a time %u\n", t, count, R.restart, a, b);
    }
    printf("index_max: %lld ranges, %lld differ\n", cases, bad);

    /* 2. the cell index: lists registered, overwritten and dropped at random */
    int cap = 20000;
    g_lists = calloc((size_t)cap, sizeof *g_lists); g_live = malloc(sizeof *g_live * (size_t)cap);
    int *fin = calloc((size_t)cap, sizeof *fin), *freel = malloc(sizeof *freel * (size_t)cap), nfree = 0;
    LONG64 seq = 0, ov = 0, ended = 0, diff = 0, stale = 0;
    for (int it = 0; it < 300000; it++) {
        if (it % 10000 == 9999) stale += index_check();
        int op = (int)(rnd() % 10);
        if (op < 5 && (g_list_count < cap || nfree)) {           /* a new list (as list_register) */
            int i = nfree ? freel[--nfree] : g_list_count++;
            List *l = &g_lists[i];
            memset(l->blk, 0, sizeof l->blk);
            l->data = (uint8_t *)1; l->finalized = 0; l->seq = ++seq;
            l->nblk = (int)(rnd() % 6);                           /* 5: more pieces than are kept */
            for (int p = 0; p < 4; p++) rand_piece(l->blk[p], rnd() % 2000 == 0);
            list_cells(i, 1);
            l->live_pos = g_live_n; g_live[g_live_n++] = i;
        } else if (op < 8) {                                      /* a recording over command memory */
            Overwrite w;
            w.nseg = 1 + (int)(rnd() % 4); w.seq = seq + 1 - (LONG64)(rnd() % 3);
            for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) rand_piece(w.seg[j], rnd() % 3000 == 0);
            for (int k = 0; k < g_live_n; k++) { fin[g_live[k]] = g_lists[g_live[k]].finalized; ended -= fin[g_live[k]] != 0; }
            overwrite_ref(fin, &w);
            job_list_overwrite(&w);
            ov++;
            for (int k = 0; k < g_live_n; k++) {
                int i = g_live[k];
                ended += g_lists[i].finalized != 0;
                if (fin[i] != g_lists[i].finalized && diff++ < 10) printf("overwrite %lld: list %d finalized %d, by the walk over every list %d\n", (long long)ov, i, g_lists[i].finalized, fin[i]);
            }
        } else if (g_live_n) {                                    /* a list dropped (as list_drop) */
            int k = (int)(rnd() % g_live_n), i = g_live[k];
            list_cells(i, 0);
            int last = g_live[--g_live_n];
            g_live[g_lists[i].live_pos] = last; g_lists[last].live_pos = g_lists[i].live_pos; g_lists[i].live_pos = -1;
            g_lists[i].data = NULL; freel[nfree++] = i;
        }
    }
    stale += index_check();
    printf("overwrites: %lld (%lld lists ended by them), %lld lists differ; index entries wrong or missing in 31 checks: %lld (%d cells, %d wide entries, %d live lists)\n",
           (long long)ov, (long long)ended, (long long)diff, (long long)stale, g_cells_used, g_wide_n, g_live_n);
    return bad || diff || stale;
}
```

`tests/layout_probe.c`:

```c
/* layout_probe.dll: the runtime's texture layout (runtime/gfx/tex_decode.c, unchanged) and a Yaz0 decoder, behind a flat C
 * interface for tests/bntx_layout_check.py. Test code only; not part of the game build. */
#include <stdint.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "tex_decode.h"

typedef struct {
    int64_t size, data_size, alignment, layer_stride;
    int32_t bh_log2, bd_log2, levels, unknown_format;
    int64_t lvl_offset[TEX_MAX_LEVELS];
} ProbeOut;

__declspec(dllexport) int probe_layout(int target, int format, int w, int h, int d, int levels, int flags, ProbeOut *o) {
    TexLayout L;
    int r = tex_layout(&L, target, format, w, h, d, levels, flags, 0, -1);
    memset(o, 0, sizeof *o);
    o->size = (int64_t)L.size; o->data_size = (int64_t)L.data_size; o->alignment = (int64_t)L.alignment;
    o->layer_stride = (int64_t)L.layer_stride; o->bh_log2 = L.bh_log2; o->bd_log2 = L.bd_log2; o->levels = L.levels;
    o->unknown_format = r != 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < L.levels && i < TEX_MAX_LEVELS; i++) o->lvl_offset[i] = (int64_t)L.lvl_offset[i];
    return r;
}

/* Yaz0 -> dst. Returns the decompressed size, or -1 on a malformed stream. */
__declspec(dllexport) int64_t yaz0_decompress(const uint8_t *src, int64_t n, uint8_t *dst, int64_t cap) {
    if (n < 16 || memcmp(src, "Yaz0", 4)) return -1;
    int64_t size = ((int64_t)src[4] << 24) | (src[5] << 16) | (src[6] << 8) | src[7];
    if (size > cap) return -1;
    int64_t s = 16, o = 0;
    while (o < size) {
        if (s >= n) return -1;
        uint8_t code = src[s++];
        for (int bit = 7; bit >= 0 && o < size; bit--) {
            if (code & (1 << bit)) { if (s >= n) return -1; dst[o++] = src[s++]; }
            else {
                if (s + 1 >= n) return -1;
                int b1 = src[s++], b2 = src[s++];
                int64_t dist = (((b1 & 0xf) << 8) | b2) + 1, len = b1 >> 4;
                if (len == 0) { if (s >= n) return -1; len = src[s++] + 0x12; } else len += 2;
                if (dist > o) return -1;
                for (int64_t k = 0; k < len && o < size; k++, o++) dst[o] = dst[o - dist];
            }
        }
    }
    return size;
}
```

`tests/mx_all.c`:

```c
/* mx_all.c - every shader stage of the game through the translator, offline (tests/check_all_shaders.py).
 *
 * Reads the stage files tests/check_all_shaders.py writes (build\shaders_all\*.mxs: one NVN stage each, taken out of the
 * game's shader containers), runs mx_translate on each with the Vulkan back end's settings (target 1), compiles the text
 * to SPIR-V with the renderer's own compiler (smo_glslang.dll, so run from build\bin), and counts: translated and
 * compiled, not translated (by instruction or feature), refused by the compiler. Prints the first stages of each kind of
 * failure and a summary; exit status = failures.
 *
 *   mx_all.exe <folder of .mxs> [--list]       (--list: one line per stage)
 *
 * Stage file (little endian): "MXS1", u32 stage (0 vertex, 1 fragment, 2 geometry, 3 tess control, 4 tess evaluation,
 * 5 compute), u32 code bytes, u32 constant data bytes, u32 work group x, y, z, u32 shared bytes, u32 local bytes, the
 * code (a graphics stage: program header + instructions; compute: instructions), the constant data (constant buffer 1).
 * A geometry stage is translated and compiled for each input primitive class a draw can give it (points, lines,
 * triangles) and counts as good when all three are. Tessellation stages are counted, not translated: the renderer has
 * none (the game has none either). */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <windows.h>
#include "mx_translate.h"

typedef int (*GlslFn)(int, const char *, uint32_t **, size_t *, char *, size_t);
typedef void (*FreeFn)(uint32_t *);

typedef struct { char what[80]; int count; char first[3][MAX_PATH]; } Fail;
static Fail g_fail[256];
static int g_nfail;
static void note(const char *what, const char *file) {
    int i;
    for (i = 0; i < g_nfail && strcmp(g_fail[i].what, what); i++) {}
    if (i == g_nfail) { if (g_nfail == 256) i = 255; else { g_nfail++; snprintf(g_fail[i].what, sizeof g_fail[i].what, "%s", what); } }
    if (g_fail[i].count < 3) snprintf(g_fail[i].first[g_fail[i].count], MAX_PATH, "%s", file);
    g_fail[i].count++;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    if (argc < 2) { printf("usage: mx_all.exe <folder of .mxs> [--list]\n"); return 2; }
    int list = argc > 2 && !strcmp(argv[2], "--list");
    setvbuf(stdout, NULL, _IONBF, 0);                  /* a stage that crashes the translator: its name is out already */
    HMODULE m = LoadLibraryA("smo_glslang.dll");
    GlslFn glsl = m ? (GlslFn)GetProcAddress(m, "smo_glsl_to_spirv") : NULL;
    FreeFn spv_free = m ? (FreeFn)GetProcAddress(m, "smo_spirv_free") : NULL;
    if (!glsl || !spv_free) { printf("smo_glslang.dll not found (run from build\\bin)\n"); return 2; }
    char pat[MAX_PATH];
    snprintf(pat, sizeof pat, "%s\\*.mxs", argv[1]);
    WIN32_FIND_DATAA fd;
    HANDLE h = FindFirstFileA(pat, &fd);
    if (h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) { printf("no .mxs files in %s\n", argv[1]); return 2; }
    int total = 0, ok = 0, by_stage[6] = {0}, ok_stage[6] = {0}, skipped = 0;
    do {
        char path[MAX_PATH];
        snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s\\%s", argv[1], fd.cFileName);
        FILE *f = fopen(path, "rb");
        if (!f) continue;
        uint32_t hd[9];
        uint8_t *code = NULL, *cdata = NULL;
        int good = fread(hd, 4, 9, f) == 9 && hd[0] == 0x3153584d && hd[1] < 6 && hd[2] && hd[2] < (64u << 20) && hd[3] < (16u << 20);
        if (good) {
            code = malloc(hd[2]); cdata = hd[3] ? malloc(hd[3]) : NULL;
            good = code && fread(code, 1, hd[2], f) == hd[2] && (!hd[3] || (cdata && fread(cdata, 1, hd[3], f) == hd[3]));
        }
        fclose(f);
        if (!good) { note("unreadable stage file", fd.cFileName); free(code); free(cdata); total++; continue; }
        int stage = (int)hd[1];
        total++; by_stage[stage]++;
        if (stage == 3 || stage == 4) { skipped++; note("tessellation stage (the renderer has none)", fd.cFileName); free(code); free(cdata); continue; }
        /* a geometry stage takes the draw's input primitive: translated and compiled for points, lines and triangles */
        int good_all = 1, variants = stage == 2 ? 3 : 1;
        if (list) printf("%s: ", fd.cFileName);
        for (int var = 0; var < variants && good_all; var++) {
            MxIn in;
            MxOut out;
            memset(&in, 0, sizeof in); memset(&out, 0, sizeof out);
            in.stage = stage; in.code = code; in.code_len = (int)hd[2]; in.cdata = cdata; in.cdata_size = hd[3];
            in.target = 1; in.binding_base = 40; in.ssbo_base = 60; in.tex_base = 40; in.image_base = 72; in.wmask_binding = 78;
            in.local_size[0] = hd[4]; in.local_size[1] = hd[5]; in.local_size[2] = hd[6]; in.smem_bytes = hd[7]; in.lmem_bytes = hd[8];
            in.gs_in_prim = var;
            char what[80];
            if (!mx_translate(&in, &out) || !out.glsl) {
                snprintf(what, sizeof what, "not translated: %s", out.op[0] ? out.op : out.why);
                note(what, fd.cFileName);
                if (list) printf("NOT TRANSLATED (%s) ", out.why);
                good_all = 0;
            } else {
                uint32_t *words = NULL;
                size_t count = 0;
                char log[400];
                if (!glsl(stage, out.glsl, &words, &count, log, sizeof log)) {
                    char *nl = strchr(log, '\n');
                    if (nl) *nl = 0;
                    snprintf(what, sizeof what, "compiler: %.60s", log[0] ? log : "(no message)");
                    note(what, fd.cFileName);
                    if (list) printf("COMPILER (%s) ", log);
                    good_all = 0;
                } else if (list) printf("ok (%d instructions, %zu SPIR-V words) ", out.insns, count);
                if (words) spv_free(words);
                free(out.glsl);
            }
        }
        if (good_all) { ok++; ok_stage[stage]++; }
        if (list) printf("\n");
        free(code); free(cdata);
    } while (FindNextFileA(h, &fd));
    FindClose(h);
    static const char *names[6] = {"vertex", "fragment", "geometry", "tess control", "tess evaluation", "compute"};
    printf("stages: %d (", total);
    for (int s = 0; s < 6; s++) if (by_stage[s]) printf("%s%s %d of %d ok", s ? ", " : "", names[s], ok_stage[s], by_stage[s]);
    printf(")\ntranslated and compiled: %d of %d; failures: %d kind(s)\n", ok, total, g_nfail);
    for (int i = 0; i < g_nfail; i++) {
        printf("  %5d  %s   e.g. %s%s%s%s%s\n", g_fail[i].count, g_fail[i].what, g_fail[i].first[0], g_fail[i].count > 1 ? ", " : "", g_fail[i].count > 1 ? g_fail[i].first[1] : "",
               g_fail[i].count > 2 ? ", " : "", g_fail[i].count > 2 ? g_fail[i].first[2] : "");
    }
    return total - ok;
}
```

`tests/mx_equiv.c`:

```c
/* mx_equiv.c - equivalence test of the shader translator's two control-flow forms.
 *
 * For every fragment stage dumped by the renderer (vk_prog_<n>_1.bin: program header + Maxwell code; SMO_VK_DUMP_MINBYTES=0
 * with an empty SMO_VK_CACHE dumps every stage it translates), mx_translate is run twice: structured (plan_structured:
 * guarded blocks + loops) and with SMO_MX_NOSTRUCT=1 (the pc switch). When the two texts differ, both are turned into
 * COMPUTE shaders (GL_NV_compute_shader_derivatives keeps implicit-LOD sampling and derivatives working: quads of 2x2):
 * inputs (in_attr*) come from a buffer of random values, gl_FragCoord is the invocation's pixel, every discard and
 * output is recorded. Both run on the GPU over 64x64 invocations with the same random constant buffers and textures;
 * discards must match exactly and outputs within 1e-4 (relative): the two forms are compiled separately, and the
 * driver may contract a multiply-add differently in each.
 * Not tested (counted): stages with images or storage buffers, multisample textures, a text glslang refuses.
 *
 *   build: python tests/build_mx_equiv.py      run: build\bin\mx_equiv.exe <folder of .bin> [max shaders]
 */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <windows.h>
#include <vulkan/vulkan.h>
#include "mx_translate.h"

typedef int (*GlslFn)(int, const char *, uint32_t **, size_t *, char *, size_t);
typedef void (*FreeFn)(uint32_t *);
static GlslFn g_glsl;
static FreeFn g_free;

#define W 64
#define H 64
#define NINV (W * H)
#define IN_STRIDE 128                              /* uints per invocation: 32 attributes x 4 */
#define OUT_STRIDE 40                              /* 8 outputs x 4, depth, discard flag, sample mask */

static VkInstance g_inst;
static VkPhysicalDevice g_gpu;
static VkDevice g_dev;
static VkQueue g_q;
static uint32_t g_qf;
static VkCommandPool g_pool;
static VkPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties g_mp;
static uint32_t g_seed = 12345;
static uint32_t rnd(void) { g_seed ^= g_seed << 13; g_seed ^= g_seed >> 17; g_seed ^= g_seed << 5; return g_seed; }
static float rndf(float lo, float hi) { return lo + (hi - lo) * (float)(rnd() & 0xffffff) / 16777216.0f; }
#define VKC(x) do { VkResult r_ = (x); if (r_ != VK_SUCCESS) { printf("%s failed: %d\n", #x, r_); exit(2); } } while (0)

typedef struct { VkBuffer b; VkDeviceMemory m; void *map; VkDeviceSize size; } Buf;
static uint32_t mem_type(uint32_t bits, VkFlags want) {
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < g_mp.memoryTypeCount; i++) if ((bits >> i & 1) && (g_mp.memoryTypes[i].propertyFlags & want) == want) return i;
    printf("no memory type\n"); exit(2);
}
static Buf buf_new(VkDeviceSize size) {
    Buf b; memset(&b, 0, sizeof b); b.size = size;
    VkBufferCreateInfo ci = {VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO}; ci.size = size; ci.usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_STORAGE_BUFFER_BIT | VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT;
    VKC(vkCreateBuffer(g_dev, &ci, NULL, &b.b));
    VkMemoryRequirements mr; vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements(g_dev, b.b, &mr);
    VkMemoryAllocateInfo ai = {VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO}; ai.allocationSize = mr.size; ai.memoryTypeIndex = mem_type(mr.memoryTypeBits, VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT | VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_COHERENT_BIT);
    VKC(vkAllocateMemory(g_dev, &ai, NULL, &b.m)); VKC(vkBindBufferMemory(g_dev, b.b, b.m, 0)); VKC(vkMapMemory(g_dev, b.m, 0, size, 0, &b.map));
    return b;
}
static void buf_free(Buf *b) { vkDestroyBuffer(g_dev, b->b, NULL); vkFreeMemory(g_dev, b->m, NULL); }

/* one-time submit helper */
static VkCommandBuffer cmd_begin(void) {
    VkCommandBufferAllocateInfo ai = {VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_ALLOCATE_INFO}; ai.commandPool = g_pool; ai.level = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_LEVEL_PRIMARY; ai.commandBufferCount = 1;
    VkCommandBuffer c; VKC(vkAllocateCommandBuffers(g_dev, &ai, &c));
    VkCommandBufferBeginInfo bi = {VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_BEGIN_INFO}; bi.flags = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_USAGE_ONE_TIME_SUBMIT_BIT;
    VKC(vkBeginCommandBuffer(c, &bi)); return c;
}
static void cmd_end(VkCommandBuffer c) {
    VKC(vkEndCommandBuffer(c));
    VkSubmitInfo si = {VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SUBMIT_INFO}; si.commandBufferCount = 1; si.pCommandBuffers = &c;
    VKC(vkQueueSubmit(g_q, 1, &si, VK_NULL_HANDLE)); VKC(vkQueueWaitIdle(g_q));
    vkFreeCommandBuffers(g_dev, g_pool, 1, &c);
}

/* textures: one image per sampler type, random contents, one level */
typedef struct { VkImage img; VkDeviceMemory m; VkImageView view; VkSampler smp; int ok; } Tex;
static Tex make_tex(const char *type, int shadow) {
    Tex t; memset(&t, 0, sizeof t);
    int is_u = type[0] == 'u', is_i = type[0] == 'i';
    const char *base = type + (is_u || is_i) + 7;                /* after "sampler" */
    VkImageType it = VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D; VkImageViewType vt = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D; uint32_t w = 32, h = 32, d = 1, layers = 1; VkImageCreateFlags fl = 0;
    if (!strncmp(base, "1DArray", 7)) { it = VK_IMAGE_TYPE_1D; vt = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_1D_ARRAY; h = 1; layers = 4; }
    else if (!strncmp(base, "1D", 2)) { it = VK_IMAGE_TYPE_1D; vt = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_1D; h = 1; }
    else if (!strncmp(base, "2DMS", 4)) return t;
    else if (!strncmp(base, "2DArray", 7)) { vt = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D_ARRAY; layers = 4; }
    else if (!strncmp(base, "2D", 2)) vt = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D;
    else if (!strncmp(base, "3D", 2)) { it = VK_IMAGE_TYPE_3D; vt = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_3D; d = 8; }
    else if (!strncmp(base, "CubeArray", 9)) { vt = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_CUBE_ARRAY; layers = 12; fl = VK_IMAGE_CREATE_CUBE_COMPATIBLE_BIT; }
    else if (!strncmp(base, "Cube", 4)) { vt = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_CUBE; layers = 6; fl = VK_IMAGE_CREATE_CUBE_COMPATIBLE_BIT; }
    else return t;
    VkFormat f = shadow ? VK_FORMAT_D32_SFLOAT : is_u ? VK_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_UINT : is_i ? VK_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_SINT : VK_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_SFLOAT;
    VkImageAspectFlags asp = shadow ? VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_DEPTH_BIT : VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT;
    VkImageCreateInfo ci = {VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_CREATE_INFO}; ci.flags = fl; ci.imageType = it; ci.format = f; ci.extent.width = w; ci.extent.height = h; ci.extent.depth = d;
```
