```py
            return 'v_f3e(%s, %s, %s, %d, %s, %d, %d);' % (V(rd), V(rn), V(bits(w, 20, 16)), idx, op, sz, n)
        immh, immhb, opc = bits(w, 22, 19), bits(w, 22, 16), bits(w, 15, 11)
        if immh == 0:
            raise Unimpl('simd-imm')
        es = immh.bit_length() - 1
        if opc == 0x14 and not scalar and es < 3:
            return 'v_shll(%s, %s, %d, %d, %d, %d);' % (V(rd), V(rn), immhb - (8 << es), es, u, q)
        if opc == 0x0a and not u:
            return 'v_shift(%s, %s, %d, %d, 0, %d);' % (V(rd), V(rn), immhb - (8 << es), es, icount(es))
        if opc == 0:
            return 'v_shift(%s, %s, %d, %d, %d, %d);' % (V(rd), V(rn), (16 << es) - immhb, es, 2 if u else 1, icount(es))
        # SMO addition (audio DSP in the SDK): saturating narrowing shifts. es = DESTINATION element size; the shift is
        # 2 * esize - immh:immb. U=0 0x12/0x13 SQSHRN/SQRSHRN, U=1 0x12/0x13 UQSHRN/UQRSHRN, U=1 0x10/0x11 SQSHRUN/SQRSHRUN.
        if opc in (0x12, 0x13) or (u and opc in (0x10, 0x11)):
            if es > 2:
                raise Unimpl('simd-shift')
            src_signed = 0 if (u and opc in (0x12, 0x13)) else 1
            dst_signed = 0 if u else 1
            if scalar:                                   # the scalar forms (7.3.2 SDK): one element
                return 'v_qshrn_s(%s, %s, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d);' % (V(rd), V(rn), (16 << es) - immhb, es, opc & 1, src_signed, dst_signed)
            return 'v_qshrn(%s, %s, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %d);' % (V(rd), V(rn), (16 << es) - immhb, es, opc & 1, src_signed, dst_signed, q)
        raise Unimpl('simd-shift')


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- program level
class Env:
    def __init__(self):
        self.starts = None
        self.wanted = collections.OrderedDict()
        self.overrides = {}
        self.plt_cache = {}
        self.plt_slot = {}
        self.plt_syms = None
        self.full = False

    def load_plt(self):
        self.plt_syms = {}
        self.plt_info = {}
        for i in range(PLTRELSZ // 24):
            off, info, _ = struct.unpack_from('<QQq', IMG, FILE_OFF + JMPREL + i * 24)
            name_off = struct.unpack_from('<I', IMG, FILE_OFF + SYMTAB + (info >> 32) * 24)[0]
            s = FILE_OFF + STRTAB + name_off
            slot = BASE + off if off < BASE else off
            self.plt_syms[slot] = IMG[s:IMG.index(b'\0', s)].decode('latin-1')
            shndx, value = struct.unpack_from('<HQ', IMG, FILE_OFF + SYMTAB + (info >> 32) * 24 + 6)
            self.plt_info[slot] = (info >> 32, shndx, value)

    def plt_symbol(self, target):
        """If target is a PLT stub, return the imported symbol name."""
        if target in self.plt_cache:
            return self.plt_cache[target]
        name = None
        if target + 16 <= BASE + TEXT_SIZE:
            w0, w1, w2, w3 = (word(target + i) for i in (0, 4, 8, 12))
            if (w0 & 0x9f00001f) == 0x90000010 and (w1 & 0xffc003ff) == 0xf9400211 and w3 == 0xd61f0220:
                if self.plt_syms is None:
                    self.load_plt()
                page = (target & ~0xfff) + (sext((bits(w0, 23, 5) << 2) | bits(w0, 30, 29), 21) << 12)
                name = self.plt_syms.get(page + bits(w1, 21, 10) * 8)
                if name is not None:
                    self.plt_slot[target] = page + bits(w1, 21, 10) * 8
        self.plt_cache[target] = name
        return name

    def plt_entry(self, target):
        """(symbol index, section index, value) when target is a PLT stub, else None."""
        if self.plt_symbol(target) is None:
            return None
        return self.plt_info[self.plt_slot[target]]

    def call(self, target):
        if target in self.overrides:
            return 'h_%s(c);' % self.overrides[target]
        if self.full:
            self.wanted.setdefault(target, None)
            return 'f_%x(c);' % target
        name = self.plt_symbol(target)
        if name:
            self.imports.add(name)
            return 'imp_%s(c);' % mangle(name)
        self.wanted.setdefault(target, None)
        return 'f_%x(c);' % target

    def compute_starts(self):
        """Function entries and exact ends from the function list (module-relative hex in the TSV)."""
        self.ends = {}
        with open(FUNCS, encoding='utf-8') as f:
            next(f)
            for line in f:
                t = line.split('\t')
                self.ends[BASE + int(t[0], 16)] = BASE + int(t[1], 16)
        self.starts = sorted(self.ends)
        return self.starts

    def compute_starts_heuristic(self):
        """ssbu-recomp's discovery (BL targets + code pointers in data + ADRP/ADD + exports), kept for comparison."""
        starts = set()
        text = IMG[FILE_OFF:FILE_OFF + TEXT_SIZE]
        for i, (w,) in enumerate(struct.iter_unpack('<I', text)):
            if (w & 0xfc000000) == 0x94000000:
                starts.add(BASE + i * 4 + sext(w & 0x3ffffff, 26) * 4)
        for i in range(RELASZ // 24):
            off, info, addend = struct.unpack_from('<QQq', IMG, FILE_OFF + RELA + i * 24)
            if info == 0x403 and 0 <= addend < TEXT_SIZE and addend % 4 == 0:
                starts.add(BASE + addend)
        # code addresses materialised in registers (callbacks, thread entry points): ADRP+ADD pairs and ADR
        page = {}
        for i, (w,) in enumerate(struct.iter_unpack('<I', text)):
            if (w & 0x9f000000) == 0x90000000:                       # adrp
                imm = sext((((w >> 5) & 0x7ffff) << 2) | ((w >> 29) & 3), 21)
                page[w & 31] = (i, ((i * 4) & ~0xfff) + (imm << 12))
            elif (w & 0xffc00000) == 0x91000000:                     # add xd, xn, #imm12
                hit = page.get((w >> 5) & 31)
                if hit and i - hit[0] <= 8:
                    target = hit[1] + ((w >> 10) & 0xfff)
                    if 0 <= target < TEXT_SIZE and target % 4 == 0:
                        starts.add(BASE + target)
            elif (w & 0x9f000000) == 0x10000000:                     # adr
                imm = sext((((w >> 5) & 0x7ffff) << 2) | ((w >> 29) & 3), 21)
                target = i * 4 + imm
                if 0 <= target < TEXT_SIZE and target % 4 == 0:
                    starts.add(BASE + target)
        # functions other modules call by name: exported FUNC symbols
        for i in range((STRTAB - SYMTAB) // 24):
            _, info, _, shndx, value, _ = struct.unpack_from('<IBBHQQ', IMG, FILE_OFF + SYMTAB + i * 24)
            if shndx and (info & 0xf) == 2 and value % 4 == 0:
                starts.add(BASE + value)
        self.starts = sorted(a for a in starts if BASE <= a < BASE + TEXT_SIZE)
        return self.starts

    def extent(self, entry):
        if getattr(self, 'ends', None) and entry in self.ends:
            return self.ends[entry]
        import bisect
        i = bisect.bisect_right(self.starts, entry)
        return self.starts[i] if i < len(self.starts) else BASE + TEXT_SIZE


def mangle(name):
    return ''.join(ch if ch.isalnum() else '_' for ch in name)


def lift_function(env, entry):
    if env.full:
        plt = env.plt_entry(entry)
        if plt:
            sym, shndx, value = plt
            if shndx:                                    # symbol defined inside this module
                env.wanted.setdefault(BASE + value, None)
                return 'void f_%x(Ctx *c) { f_%x(c); }' % (entry, BASE + value), 0, []
            return 'void f_%x(Ctx *c) { host_import(c, %d); }' % (entry, sym), 0, []
    end = env.extent(entry)
    fn = Fn(entry, end, env)
    lines, bad = [], []
    pc = entry
    while pc < end:
        w = word(pc)
        try:
            stmt = fn.lift(w, pc)
        except Unimpl as e:
            stmt = 'guest_unimpl(0x%xULL, 0x%08xU, "%s");' % (pc, w, e)
            bad.append((pc, w, str(e)))
        lines.append((pc, stmt))
        pc += 4
    out = ['void f_%x(Ctx *c) {' % entry, '  c->fn = 0x%xULL;' % entry]   # for crash reports
    if fn.has_br:
        out.append('  uint64_t jt = 0;')
    for pc, stmt in lines:
        out.append('L_%x: %s' % (pc, stmt))
    ends_open = not lines[-1][1].startswith(('return;', 'goto', '{ jt', '{ f_', '{ imp_', '{ h_'))
    listed = getattr(env, 'ends', None)
    if ends_open and end < BASE + TEXT_SIZE and (not listed or end in listed):
        out.append('  f_%x(c); return;' % end)           # falls through into the next listed function
    elif ends_open:
        out.append('  guest_trap("fell off the end of a function", 0x%xULL); return;' % end)
    else:
        out.append('  return;')
    if fn.has_br:
        out.append('L_dispatch: switch (jt) {')
        out.extend('  case 0x%xULL: goto L_%x;' % (pc, pc) for pc, _ in lines)
        out.append('  default: call_indirect(c, jt); return; }')
    out.append('}')
    if lines and ends_open and end < BASE + TEXT_SIZE and (not listed or end in listed):
        env.wanted.setdefault(end, None)
    return '\n'.join(out), len(lines), bad


def cmd_lift(out_path, roots, overrides):
    env = Env()
    env.imports = set()
    env.overrides = overrides
    env.compute_starts()
    for r in roots:
        env.wanted.setdefault(r, None)
        if r not in env.starts:
            import bisect
            bisect.insort(env.starts, r)
    bodies, done, total, allbad = [], [], 0, []
    while True:
        todo = [a for a in env.wanted if a not in done]
        if not todo:
            break
        for a in todo:
            body, n, bad = lift_function(env, a)
            bodies.append(body)
            done.append(a)
            total += n
            allbad += bad
    with open(out_path, 'w') as f:
        f.write('/* generated by recomp.py -- do not edit */\n#include "runtime.h"\n\n')
        for name in sorted(env.imports):
            f.write('void imp_%s(Ctx *c);\n' % mangle(name))
        for name in sorted(set(overrides.values())):
            f.write('void h_%s(Ctx *c);\n' % name)
        for a in done:
            f.write('void f_%x(Ctx *c);\n' % a)
        f.write('\n' + '\n\n'.join(bodies) + '\n\n')
        f.write('void call_indirect(Ctx *c, uint64_t a) {\n  switch (a) {\n')
        for a in done:
            f.write('  case 0x%xULL: f_%x(c); return;\n' % (a, a))
        for a, name in overrides.items():
            f.write('  case 0x%xULL: h_%s(c); return;\n' % (a, name))
        f.write('  default: guest_trap("indirect call to a function that was not lifted", a);\n  }\n}\n')
    print('functions lifted: %d   instructions: %d   not translated: %d' % (len(done), total, len(allbad)))
    print('imports used:', ', '.join(sorted(env.imports)))
    reasons = collections.Counter(r for _, _, r in allbad)
    for r, n in reasons.most_common(15):
        ex = next('%x:%08x' % (pc, w) for pc, w, rr in allbad if rr == r)
        print('  unimplemented %-14s %5d   e.g. %s' % (r, n, ex))


_worker_env = None


def _worker_init(starts):
    global _worker_env
    _worker_env = Env()
    _worker_env.imports = set()
    _worker_env.full = True
    _worker_env.starts = starts


def _worker_lift(entries):
    env = _worker_env
    env.wanted = collections.OrderedDict()
    out, total, bad = [], 0, 0
    for a in entries:
        body, n, b = lift_function(env, a)
        out.append(body)
        total += n
        bad += len(b)
    return entries[0], '\n\n'.join(out), total, bad, list(env.wanted)


def cmd_full(outdir, jobs, chunk_insns=12000):
    """Lift every function of the binary into <outdir>/c_NNNN.c plus funcs.h, table.c, imports.c."""
    import multiprocessing
    import os
    import time
    t0 = time.time()
    env = Env()
    env.imports = set()
    env.full = True
    starts = env.compute_starts()
    print('function entries: %d  (%.0fs)' % (len(starts), time.time() - t0))
    os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
    known = set(starts)
    pending = list(starts)
    files, all_funcs = [], []
    total = bad = 0
    round_no = 0
    with multiprocessing.Pool(jobs, _worker_init, (starts,)) as pool:
        while pending:
            pending.sort()
            chunks, cur, size = [], [], 0
            for i, a in enumerate(pending):
                cur.append(a)
                size += (env.extent(a) - a) // 4
                if size >= chunk_insns:
                    chunks.append(cur)
                    cur, size = [], 0
            if cur:
                chunks.append(cur)
            new = set()
            for first, text, n, b, wanted in pool.imap_unordered(_worker_lift, chunks):
                name = 'c_%x.c' % (first - BASE)
                path = os.path.join(outdir, name)
                content = '/* generated by recomp.py -- do not edit */\n#include "runtime.h"\n#include "funcs.h"\n\n' + text + '\n'
                if not os.path.exists(path) or open(path).read() != content:
                    open(path, 'w').write(content)
                files.append(name)
                total += n
                bad += b
                new.update(w for w in wanted if w not in known)
            all_funcs += pending
            round_no += 1
            print('round %d: %d functions, %d files so far, %d extra targets  (%.0fs)'
                  % (round_no, len(pending), len(files), len(new), time.time() - t0))
            known |= new
            pending = [a for a in new if BASE <= a < BASE + TEXT_SIZE]
            outside = [a for a in new if not (BASE <= a < BASE + TEXT_SIZE)]
            if outside:
                print('  branch targets outside .text (ignored):', ', '.join('%x' % a for a in outside[:8]))
            all_funcs += []
    all_funcs = sorted(set(all_funcs))
    with open(os.path.join(outdir, 'funcs.h'), 'w') as f:
        f.write('/* generated by recomp.py -- do not edit */\n')
        f.writelines('void f_%x(Ctx *c);\n' % a for a in all_funcs)
    with open(os.path.join(outdir, 'table.c'), 'w') as f:
        f.write('/* generated by recomp.py -- do not edit */\n#include "runtime.h"\n#include "funcs.h"\n\n')
        f.write('const FnEntry fn_table[] = {\n')
        f.writelines('  { 0x%xULL, f_%x },\n' % (a, a) for a in all_funcs)
        f.write('};\nconst int fn_table_count = %d;\n' % len(all_funcs))
    # every dynamic symbol by index: name, and whether this module defines it
    nsym = (STRTAB - SYMTAB) // 24
    with open(os.path.join(outdir, 'imports.c'), 'w') as f:
        f.write('/* generated by recomp.py -- do not edit */\n#include "runtime.h"\n\nconst DynSym dyn_syms[] = {\n')
        for i in range(nsym):
            name_off, info, other, shndx, value, size = struct.unpack_from('<IBBHQQ', IMG, FILE_OFF + SYMTAB + i * 24)
            p = FILE_OFF + STRTAB + name_off
            name = IMG[p:IMG.index(b'\0', p)].decode('latin-1')
            f.write('  { "%s", 0x%xULL, %d },\n' % (name, value, 1 if shndx else 0))
        f.write('};\nconst int dyn_sym_count = %d;\n' % nsym)
    stale = set(n for n in os.listdir(outdir) if n.startswith('c_') and n.endswith('.c')) - set(files)
    for n in stale:
        os.remove(os.path.join(outdir, n))
    print('functions: %d   files: %d   instructions: %d   not translated: %d   (%.0fs)'
          % (len(all_funcs), len(files), total, bad, time.time() - t0))


BUCKET = 0xC000          # one output file per 48 KB of guest code: file contents stay stable across runs


def _worker_scan(entries):
    """Discovery pass: lift without keeping the text, report statistics and new branch targets."""
    env = _worker_env
    env.wanted = collections.OrderedDict()
    total = bad = 0
    for a in entries:
        _, n, b = lift_function(env, a)
        total += n
        bad += len(b)
    return total, bad, list(env.wanted)


def _worker_write(job):
    outdir, name, entries = job
    import os
    env = _worker_env
    env.wanted = collections.OrderedDict()
    text = '\n\n'.join(lift_function(env, a)[0] for a in entries)
    content = '/* generated by recomp.py -- do not edit */\n#include "runtime.h"\n#include "funcs.h"\n\n' + text + '\n'
    path = os.path.join(outdir, name)
    if os.path.exists(path):
        with open(path) as f:
            if f.read() == content:
                return name, False
    with open(path, 'w') as f:
        f.write(content)
    return name, True


def cmd_full2(outdir, jobs):
    """Lift every function of the binary into <outdir>/c_<bucket>.c plus funcs.h, table.c, imports.c."""
    import multiprocessing
    import os
    import time
    t0 = time.time()
    env = Env()
    env.imports = set()
    env.full = True
    starts = env.compute_starts()
    print('function entries: %d  (%.0fs)' % (len(starts), time.time() - t0))
    os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
    known = set(starts)
    pending = list(starts)
    all_funcs = []
    total = bad = 0
    with multiprocessing.Pool(jobs, _worker_init, (starts,)) as pool:
        while pending:
            pending.sort()
            parts = [pending[i:i + 400] for i in range(0, len(pending), 400)]
            new = set()
            for n, b, wanted in pool.imap_unordered(_worker_scan, parts):
                total += n
                bad += b
                new.update(w for w in wanted if w not in known and BASE <= w < BASE + TEXT_SIZE)
            all_funcs += pending
            print('discovery: %d functions, %d extra branch targets  (%.0fs)' % (len(pending), len(new), time.time() - t0))
            known |= new
            pending = list(new)
        all_funcs.sort()
        buckets = collections.OrderedDict()
        for a in all_funcs:
            buckets.setdefault((a - BASE) // BUCKET, []).append(a)
        jobs_list = [(outdir, 'c_%04x.c' % b, entries) for b, entries in buckets.items()]
        changed = 0
        files = []
        for name, was_changed in pool.imap_unordered(_worker_write, jobs_list):
            files.append(name)
            changed += was_changed
    with open(os.path.join(outdir, 'funcs.h'), 'w') as f:
        f.write('/* generated by recomp.py -- do not edit */\n')
        f.writelines('void f_%x(Ctx *c);\n' % a for a in all_funcs)
    with open(os.path.join(outdir, 'table.c'), 'w') as f:
        f.write('/* generated by recomp.py -- do not edit */\n#include "runtime.h"\n#include "funcs.h"\n\n')
        f.write('const FnEntry fn_table[] = {\n')
        f.writelines('  { 0x%xULL, f_%x },\n' % (a, a) for a in all_funcs)
        f.write('};\nconst int fn_table_count = %d;\n' % len(all_funcs))
    nsym = (STRTAB - SYMTAB) // 24
    with open(os.path.join(outdir, 'imports.c'), 'w') as f:
        f.write('/* generated by recomp.py -- do not edit */\n#include "runtime.h"\n\nconst DynSym dyn_syms[] = {\n')
        for i in range(nsym):
            name_off, info, other, shndx, value, size = struct.unpack_from('<IBBHQQ', IMG, FILE_OFF + SYMTAB + i * 24)
            p = FILE_OFF + STRTAB + name_off
            name = IMG[p:IMG.index(b'\0', p)].decode('latin-1')
            f.write('  { "%s", 0x%xULL, %d },\n' % (name, value, 1 if shndx else 0))
        f.write('};\nconst int dyn_sym_count = %d;\n' % nsym)
    keep = set(files) | {'table.c', 'imports.c'}
    for n in os.listdir(outdir):
        if n.endswith('.c') and n not in keep:
            os.remove(os.path.join(outdir, n))
    print('functions: %d   files: %d (%d rewritten)   instructions: %d   not translated: %d   (%.0fs)'
          % (len(all_funcs), len(files), changed, total, bad, time.time() - t0))


def cmd_cover():
    env = Env()
    env.imports = set()
    starts = env.compute_starts()
    fn = Fn(BASE, BASE + TEXT_SIZE, env)
    ok = bad = 0
    reasons = collections.Counter()
    cache = {}
    text = IMG[FILE_OFF:FILE_OFF + TEXT_SIZE]
    for i, (w,) in enumerate(struct.iter_unpack('<I', text)):
        r = cache.get(w)
        if r is None:
            try:
                fn.lift(w, BASE + 0x1000000)
                r = ''
            except Unimpl as e:
                r = str(e)
            except Exception as e:                       # decoder bug: count as unimplemented
                r = 'error'
            if len(cache) < 4000000:
                cache[w] = r
        if r:
            bad += 1
            reasons[r] += 1
        else:
            ok += 1
    total = ok + bad
    print('function entries (BL targets + code pointers in data): %d' % len(starts))
    print('instruction words: %d   translated: %d (%.2f%%)   not translated: %d (%.2f%%)'
          % (total, ok, 100.0 * ok / total, bad, 100.0 * bad / total))
    for r, n in reasons.most_common(20):
        print('  %-14s %9d  %.2f%%' % (r, n, 100.0 * n / total))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    if sys.argv[1] == 'cover':
        cmd_cover()
    elif sys.argv[1] == 'full':
        cmd_full2(sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else _T.build('lift', 'main'),
                  int(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv) > 3 else 16)
    else:
        ov = {}
        for item in sys.argv[4:]:
            a, name = item.split('=')
            ov[int(a, 16)] = name
        cmd_lift(sys.argv[2], [int(a, 16) for a in sys.argv[3].split(',')], ov)

```

`tools/lifter/sdklift.py`:

```py
"""Lift selected functions of the game's own SDK module (build/dump/update/elf/sdk.elf, NintendoSDK 7.3.2) to C.

Adapted from ssbu-recomp tools/lifter/sdklift.py (GPL-3.0-or-later). The instruction translation is recomp.py's (the same
class Fn the main lift and the Unicorn differential test use); this file decides WHICH functions are lifted and how a
call out of lifted code is bound:
  * another SDK function of the closure          -> lifted too, called directly
  * an exported SDK function the GAME imports    -> the HOST handler of that name ("cut"): nn::os, malloc, ...
    (unless the rules say `lift <name>`)
  * a name under `trap`, or a function that does not return (abort, assertion failure, terminate, throw helpers)
                                                 -> a trap that names it
Roots are computed when this runs, not stored: every function the game imports from the SDK whose name matches a
`family` rule and that sdk.elf defines, plus `root <name>` lines. Rules: tools/lifter/sdklift_rules.txt.

    python tools/lifter/sdklift.py gen        -> build/gen/sdklift_gen.c, sdklift_install.h, build/gen/sdklift_report.txt
    python tools/lifter/sdklift.py closure <name substring>   size of one root's closure (nothing written)
"""
import bisect
import collections
import os
import re
import struct
import sys

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
REPO = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(HERE))
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(REPO, 'tools'))
import target as T                                   # noqa: E402
SDK_BASE = 0x7500000000
os.environ['RECOMP_ELF'] = T.elf('sdk')
os.environ['RECOMP_FUNCS'] = T.build('functions', 'sdk_functions.tsv')
os.environ['RECOMP_BASE'] = hex(SDK_BASE)
sys.path.insert(0, HERE)
import recomp as R                                   # noqa: E402  (reads the three variables above at import)

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(REPO, 'tools', 'extract'))
import functions as F                                # noqa: E402

GEN = T.build('gen')
MOD = F.Module(R.ELF)
NSYM = MOD.sec['.dynsym'][1] // 24

syms, by_addr, obj_syms = {}, collections.defaultdict(list), {}
for name, typ, bind, shndx, value, size in MOD.symbols():
    if shndx and name:
        syms[name] = (value, size, typ)
        if typ == 2:
            by_addr[SDK_BASE + value].append(name)
        elif typ == 1 and size:
            obj_syms[name] = (value, size, typ)

# data slots holding a function address after relocation (GOT entries, method tables): slot -> target
CODE_SLOTS = {}
for off, info, addend in MOD.relocs():
    typ, sym = info & 0xffffffff, info >> 32
    if typ == 0x403 and 0 <= addend < R.TEXT_SIZE and addend % 4 == 0:
        CODE_SLOTS[SDK_BASE + off] = SDK_BASE + addend
    elif typ in (0x101, 0x401):                       # ABS64 / GLOB_DAT to a function the sdk defines (exported methods in vtables)
        _o = 0x1000 + MOD.dt[6] + sym * 24
        _info, _shndx, _value = MOD.d[_o + 4], struct.unpack_from('<H', MOD.d, _o + 6)[0], struct.unpack_from('<Q', MOD.d, _o + 8)[0]
        if _shndx and (_info & 0xf) == 2:
            CODE_SLOTS[SDK_BASE + off] = SDK_BASE + _value + (addend if typ == 0x101 else 0)

GAME_IMPORTS = set(l.strip() for l in open(os.path.join(GEN, 'imports_all.txt')) if l.strip())
THROW_HELPER = re.compile(r'^_ZNKSt3__12[01]__(basic_string|vector_base)_commonILb1EE20__throw_(length_error|out_of_range)Ev$')
NORETURN = re.compile(r'Abort|UnexpectedDefault|OnAssertionFailure|__assert_fail|^abort$|__cxa_throw|__cxa_pure_virtual|_Unwind_Resume|__throw_|terminate|^exit$|^_Exit$')


class Rules:
    def __init__(self):
        self.families, self.rootall, self.roots, self.cut, self.trap, self.lift = [], [], [], set(), set(), set()
        self.ctors, self.ctorsdata, self.datafuncs, self.wrap = [], [], [], set()
        p = os.path.join(HERE, 'sdklift_rules.txt')
        for line in open(p):
            line = line.split('#')[0].strip()
            if not line:
                continue
            kind, arg = line.split(None, 1)
            if kind == 'family':
                self.families.append(re.compile(arg))
            elif kind == 'rootall':
                self.rootall.append(re.compile(arg))
            elif kind == 'ctors':
                self.ctors.append(re.compile(arg))
            elif kind == 'ctorsdata':
                self.ctorsdata.append(re.compile(arg))
            elif kind == 'datafuncs':
                self.datafuncs.append(re.compile(arg))
            elif kind == 'root':
                self.roots.append(arg)
            elif kind == 'wrap':
                self.wrap.add(arg)
            elif kind in ('cut', 'trap', 'lift'):
                getattr(self, kind).add(arg)
            else:
                raise SystemExit('sdklift_rules.txt: unknown rule %r' % kind)

    def data_roots(self):
        """Code addresses stored (RELATIVE relocations) inside the sdk's own DATA objects whose symbol matches a
        `datafuncs` rule: method tables (_ZTV...) and data that holds function pointers (SMO: nn::audio::common::
        SupportTags::* hold the revision function CheckFeatureSupported calls)."""
        if not self.datafuncs:
            return []
        objs = sorted((v, s) for n, (v, s, t) in obj_syms.items() if any(r.search(n) for r in self.datafuncs))
        starts = [o[0] for o in objs]
        out = set()
        for slot, target in CODE_SLOTS.items():
            off = slot - SDK_BASE
            i = bisect.bisect_right(starts, off) - 1
            if i >= 0 and off < objs[i][0] + objs[i][1]:
                out.add(target)
        return sorted(out)

    def root_names(self):
        out = [n for n in sorted(GAME_IMPORTS) if any(f.search(n) for f in self.families) and n in syms and syms[n][2] == 2]
        out += [n for n in self.roots if n in syms and n not in out]
        have = set(out)
        out += sorted(n for n, (v, s, t) in syms.items() if t == 2 and n not in have and any(r.search(n) for r in self.rootall))
        return [n for n in out if n not in self.cut]   # a cut name is answered by the host, never lifted


class Env(R.Env):
    def __init__(self, rules, roots):
        R.Env.__init__(self)
        self.rules = rules
        self.imports = set()
        self.host_names, self.host_index = [], {}
        self.root_set = set(roots)
        self.noreturn_stmt = False

    def host(self, name):
        if name not in self.host_index:
            self.host_index[name] = len(self.host_names)
            self.host_names.append(name)
        return 'sdk_host_call(c, %d);' % self.host_index[name]

    def resolve(self, target):
        """Follow PLT stubs. Returns (address, None) or (None, name of a symbol sdk.elf does not define)."""
        for _ in range(4):
            plt = self.plt_entry(target)
            if not plt:
                return target, None
            sym, shndx, value = plt
            if not shndx:
                return None, self.plt_symbol(target)
            target = SDK_BASE + value
        return target, None

    def call(self, target):
        self.noreturn_stmt = False
        addr, imp = self.resolve(target)
        if imp is not None:                          # malloc & co: defined by the game (main), reached through the host
            return self.host(imp)
        names = by_addr.get(addr, [])
        if 'setjmp' in names or '_setjmp' in names:
            return 'SDK_SETJMP(c);'
        if 'longjmp' in names or '_longjmp' in names:
            self.noreturn_stmt = True
            return '{ sdk_longjmp(c); return; }'
        for n in names:
            if THROW_HELPER.search(n) and n in GAME_IMPORTS and n not in self.rules.trap:
                self.noreturn_stmt = True
                return '{ %s return; }' % self.host(n)
        for n in names:
            if NORETURN.search(n) or n in self.rules.trap:
                self.noreturn_stmt = True
                return '{ sdk_trap_call(c, "%s"); return; }' % n
        for n in names:                              # an explicit `cut` / `wrap` rule wins, even over a root
            if n in self.rules.cut or n in self.rules.wrap:
                if n in self.rules.wrap:
                    self.wanted.setdefault(addr, None)   # still lifted: the host wrapper calls it (sdk_lifted)
                return self.host(n)
        if addr not in self.root_set:
            for n in names:
                if (n in GAME_IMPORTS or n in self.rules.cut) and n not in self.rules.lift:
                    return self.host(n)
        self.wanted.setdefault(addr, None)
        return 'f_%x(c);' % addr


TAILS = ('return;', 'goto', '{ jt', '{ f_', '{ sdk_host_call', '{ sdk_trap_call', '{ sdk_longjmp', 'guest_trap')


CODE_SLOT_KEYS = None
TABLE_WINDOW = 0           # 0x400 was tried: 2,847 functions lifted and 0x17af30 still missing


def table_code_pointers(data_addr):
    """Code pointers stored (RELATIVE relocations) in [data_addr, data_addr + TABLE_WINDOW): a table of function
    pointers whose address the code materialises and reads later (SMO: nn::audio::common::CheckFeatureSupported gets
    its function argument this way). Over-including only lifts functions that may never run."""
    global CODE_SLOT_KEYS
    if CODE_SLOT_KEYS is None:
        CODE_SLOT_KEYS = sorted(CODE_SLOTS)
    i = bisect.bisect_left(CODE_SLOT_KEYS, data_addr)
    out = []
    while i < len(CODE_SLOT_KEYS) and CODE_SLOT_KEYS[i] < data_addr + TABLE_WINDOW:
        out.append(CODE_SLOTS[CODE_SLOT_KEYS[i]])
        i += 1
    return out


def scan_code_refs(entry, end, starts_set):
    """Function starts whose address the code [entry, end) materialises (ADRP+ADD, ADR, ADRP+LDR from a code slot), and
    the code pointers of data tables it materialises (table_code_pointers)."""
    page, found = {}, []
    for pc in range(entry, end, 4):
        w = R.word(pc)
        if (w & 0x9f000000) == 0x90000000:
            imm = R.sext((((w >> 5) & 0x7ffff) << 2) | ((w >> 29) & 3), 21)
            page[w & 31] = (pc, (pc & ~0xfff) + (imm << 12))
        elif (w & 0xffc00000) == 0x91000000:
            hit = page.get((w >> 5) & 31)
            if hit and pc - hit[0] <= 32:
                a = hit[1] + ((w >> 10) & 0xfff)
                found.append(a)
                if not SDK_BASE <= a < SDK_BASE + R.TEXT_SIZE:          # a data address: a table of code pointers?
                    found.extend(table_code_pointers(a))
        elif (w & 0x9f000000) == 0x10000000:
            found.append(pc + R.sext((((w >> 5) & 0x7ffff) << 2) | ((w >> 29) & 3), 21))
        elif (w & 0xffc00000) == 0xf9400000:
            hit = page.get((w >> 5) & 31)
            if hit and pc - hit[0] <= 32:
                t = CODE_SLOTS.get(hit[1] + ((w >> 10) & 0xfff) * 8)
                if t is not None:
                    found.append(t)
    return [t for t in found if t in starts_set and not entry <= t < end]


def lift_function(env, entry):
    end = env.extent(entry)
    fn = R.Fn(entry, end, env)
    lines, bad = [], []
    last_noreturn = False
    for pc in range(entry, end, 4):
        w = R.word(pc)
        env.noreturn_stmt = False
        try:
            stmt = fn.lift(w, pc)
        except R.Unimpl as e:
            stmt = 'guest_unimpl(0x%xULL, 0x%08xU, "%s");' % (pc, w, e)
            bad.append((pc, w, str(e)))
        last_noreturn = env.noreturn_stmt
        lines.append((pc, stmt))
    out = ['static void f_%x(Ctx *c) {' % entry, '  c->fn = 0x%xULL;' % entry]
    if fn.has_br:
        out.append('  uint64_t jt = 0;')
    out += ['L_%x: %s' % (pc, s) for pc, s in lines]
    lastw = R.word(end - 4)
    falls = not lines[-1][1].startswith(TAILS) and not last_noreturn
    if (lastw & 0xfc000000) == 0x14000000 or lastw == 0xd65f03c0 or (lastw & 0xfffffc1f) == 0xd61f0000:
        falls = False
    if falls and end in env.ends:
        env.wanted.setdefault(end, None)
        out.append('  f_%x(c); return;' % end)
    elif falls:
        out.append('  guest_trap("fell off the end of an SDK function", 0x%xULL); return;' % end)
    else:
        out.append('  return;')
    if fn.has_br:
        out.append('L_dispatch: switch (jt) {')
        out += ['  case 0x%xULL: goto L_%x;' % (pc, pc) for pc, _ in lines]
        out.append('  default: call_indirect(c, jt); return; }')
    out.append('}')
    for t in scan_code_refs(entry, end, env.starts_set):
        env.wanted.setdefault(t, None)
    return '\n'.join(out), len(lines), bad, any('guest_svc' in s for _, s in lines)


def data_addresses(start, end):
    """Addresses in the sdk's data segment (.data / .bss) that the code in [start, end) computes with ADRP + ADD."""
    data_start = SDK_BASE + MOD.sec['.data'][0]
    page, out = {}, set()
    for pc in range(start, end, 4):
        w = R.word(pc)
        if (w & 0x9f000000) == 0x90000000:                                  # adrp
            imm = ((w >> 29) & 3) | (((w >> 5) & 0x7ffff) << 2)
            page[w & 31] = (pc & ~0xfff) + (R.sext(imm, 21) << 12)
        elif (w & 0xffc00000) == 0x91000000 and (w >> 5) & 31 in page:      # add xd, xn, #imm12
            a = page[(w >> 5) & 31] + ((w >> 10) & 0xfff)
            if a >= data_start:
                out.add(a)
    return out


def selected_ctors(rules):
    """SDK static constructors (.init_array, in order) that directly call (BL / B, through PLT stubs) a function whose
    name matches a `ctors` rule, or that compute the address of a data object which a function matching a `ctorsdata`
    rule also computes (the constructor sets up a global those functions use): on a console the SDK module runs them
    before the game starts."""
    if not (rules.ctors or rules.ctorsdata) or 25 not in MOD.dt:
        return []
    rel = {off: add for off, info, add in MOD.relocs() if (info & 0xffffffff) == 0x403}
    entries = [rel.get(MOD.dt[25] + 8 * k, 0) for k in range(MOD.dt[27] // 8)]
    env = Env(rules, [])
    env.compute_starts()
    used = set()
    if rules.ctorsdata:
        for s, e in env.ends.items():
            if any(c.search(n) for n in by_addr.get(s, []) for c in rules.ctorsdata):
                used |= data_addresses(s, e)
    out = []
    for k, e in enumerate(entries):
        a = SDK_BASE + e
        if a not in env.ends:
            continue
        hit = bool(used & data_addresses(a, env.ends[a]))
        for pc in range(a, env.ends[a], 4):
            w = R.word(pc)
            if (w & 0x7c000000) == 0x14000000:
                t, imp = env.resolve(pc + R.sext(w & 0x3ffffff, 26) * 4)
                if t is not None and any(c.search(n) for n in by_addr.get(t, []) for c in rules.ctors):
                    hit = True
        if hit:
            out.append((k, a))
    return out


def closure(rules, root_names, limit=10 ** 9, extra_roots=()):
    roots = [SDK_BASE + syms[n][0] for n in root_names] + list(extra_roots)
    env = Env(rules, roots)
    env.compute_starts()
    env.starts_set = set(env.starts)
    for r in roots:
        env.wanted.setdefault(r, None)
    bodies, done, total, allbad, svc = [], [], 0, [], []
    seen = set()
    while True:
        todo = [a for a in env.wanted if a not in seen]
        if not todo or total > limit:
            break
        for a in todo:
            if a not in env.ends:
                seen.add(a)
                allbad.append((a, 0, 'not a listed function start'))
                continue
            body, n, bad, has_svc = lift_function(env, a)
            bodies.append(body)
            done.append(a)
            seen.add(a)
            total += n
            allbad += bad
            if has_svc:
                svc.append(a)
    return env, bodies, done, total, allbad, svc


def label(a):
    return by_addr.get(a, ['sub_%x' % (a - SDK_BASE)])[0]


def write_if_changed(path, text):
    if not os.path.exists(path) or open(path, encoding='utf-8').read() != text:
        with open(path, 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n') as f:
            f.write(text)


def main():
    rules = Rules()
    if sys.argv[1] == 'closure':
        for n in [n for n in syms if sys.argv[2] in n and syms[n][2] == 2][:20]:
            env, bodies, done, total, bad, svc = closure(rules, [n], 200000)
            print('%-90s fns %5d insns %7d bad %d svc %d host %d' % (n[:90], len(done), total, len(bad), len(svc), len(env.host_names)))
        return
    root_names = rules.root_names()
    ctors = selected_ctors(rules)
    droots = rules.data_roots()
    env, bodies, done, total, bad, svc = closure(rules, root_names, extra_roots=[a for _, a in ctors] + droots)
    print('code pointers in matching data objects (datafuncs): %d' % len(droots))
    lines = ['/* generated by tools/lifter/sdklift.py from the dump\'s sdk.elf -- do not edit */',
             '#include "runtime.h"', '#include "sdklift.h"', '',
             'static void sdk_call_indirect(Ctx *c, uint64_t a);', '#define call_indirect sdk_call_indirect']
    lines += ['static void f_%x(Ctx *c);' % a for a in done]
    lines += ['', '\n\n'.join(bodies), '', '#undef call_indirect', 'const char *const sdk_host_names[] = {']
    lines += ['  "%s",' % n for n in env.host_names] + ['  0};', 'const int sdk_host_name_count = %d;' % len(env.host_names),
                                                       'const SdkFn sdk_fns[] = {']
    lines += ['  {0x%xULL, f_%x, "%s"},' % (a, a, label(a)) for a in sorted(done)]
    lines += ['};', 'const int sdk_fn_count = %d;' % len(done),
              '/* SDK static constructors to run before the game starts (`ctors` rules; .init_array order and index) */',
              'const uint64_t sdk_ctors[] = {' + ''.join(' 0x%xULL, /* [%d] */' % (a, k) for k, a in ctors) + ' 0 };',
              'const int sdk_ctor_count = %d;' % len(ctors),
              'static void sdk_call_indirect(Ctx *c, uint64_t a) { sdk_dispatch(c, a); }', '']
    write_if_changed(os.path.join(GEN, 'sdklift_gen.c'), '\n'.join(lines))
    # imports whose handler becomes the lifted SDK code (nnservices.c install_lifted)
    install = [n for n in root_names if n in GAME_IMPORTS]
    write_if_changed(os.path.join(GEN, 'sdklift_install.h'),
                     '/* generated by tools/lifter/sdklift.py: imports answered by the lifted SDK code */\n'
                     'static const char *const sdk_install_names[] = {\n' + ''.join('  "%s",\n' % n for n in install) + '  0 };\n')
    with open(os.path.join(GEN, 'sdklift_report.txt'), 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write('roots %d, lifted %d functions, %d instructions, untranslated %d, functions with svc %d\nhost calls:\n'
                % (len(root_names), len(done), total, len(bad), len(svc)))
        f.writelines('  %s%s\n' % (n, '' if n in GAME_IMPORTS else '   (NOT a game import: no host handler by default)') for n in env.host_names)
        f.write('functions with svc:\n')
        f.writelines('  %x %s\n' % (a - SDK_BASE, label(a)) for a in svc)
        f.write('untranslated:\n')
        f.writelines('  %x %08x %s\n' % (pc - SDK_BASE if pc else 0, w, why) for pc, w, why in bad)
    print('roots %d   functions lifted %d   instructions %d   untranslated %d   with svc %d   host names %d (not game imports: %d)   static constructors to run: %d %s'
          % (len(root_names), len(done), total, len(bad), len(svc), len(env.host_names),
             sum(1 for n in env.host_names if n not in GAME_IMPORTS), len(ctors), [k for k, _ in ctors]))
    print('report: %s' % os.path.join(GEN, 'sdklift_report.txt'))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

```txt
# Rules for tools/lifter/sdklift.py (SMO). No addresses and no code: only which SDK functions to lift and where to stop.
#   family <regex>   every game import whose name matches and that sdk.elf defines is a root (lifted, then installed as
#                    the import's handler)
#   rootall <regex>  every FUNCTION symbol of sdk.elf that matches is a root (reached through method tables at run
#                    time, which the static closure cannot follow); only game imports are installed as handlers
#   ctors <regex>    SDK static constructors (.init_array) that directly call a function matching: lifted, and run (in
#                    .init_array order) before the game starts, as the console's loader runs the SDK module's
#   ctorsdata <regex> the same for SDK static constructors that set up a global (an address in .data / .bss they
#                    compute) which a function matching also uses
#   datafuncs <regex> every code pointer stored inside sdk DATA objects whose symbol matches (method tables, function
#                    pointer data) is a root
#   root <name>      an extra root
#   cut <name>       calls to it go to the host handler of that name (game imports are cut by default)
#   wrap <name>      lifted, but calls to it go to the host handler of that name (which may call the lifted code)
#   trap <name>      calls to it stop with the name
#   lift <name>      lift the SDK's own code even though the game imports the name

# nn::audio: SMO's sdk contains the whole AudioRenderer (client, nn::audio::server, nn::audio::dsp); see runtime/audio/smo_audio.c
family ^_ZNK?2nn5audio
# the server and DSP side and the sf implementation templates of the audio interfaces (called through method tables)
rootall ^_ZNK?2nn5audio
rootall 5audio6detail1[24]IAudio(Renderer|Device)
rootall 5audio6detail21IAudioRendererManager
rootall ^_ZNK?2nn2sf6detail.*5audio
# code pointers held by audio DATA objects: method tables of the audio classes and the SupportTags (feature checks)
datafuncs ^_ZTVN2nn5audio
datafuncs ^_ZN2nn5audio
datafuncs ^_ZTVN2nn2sf4impl6detail.*5audio
# the in-process renderer manager is a static object built by an SDK static constructor
ctors ^_ZNK?2nn5audio
# the globals of the renderer objects (7.3.2: a mutex and the pool of system events each AudioRendererImpl takes one
# from) are set up by a static constructor that calls only nn::os functions
ctorsdata AudioRendererManagerImpl17AudioRendererImpl

# The renderer manager over IPC: on the console the audio system module runs the same AudioRendererManagerImpl the sdk
# contains; the host answers with the in-process (DFC) manager instead of opening an IPC session.
```

`tools/target.py`:

```py
"""Where the build's files are (used by the tools, scripts and tests).

The game is Super Mario Odyssey 1.4.1: the base game with its 1.4.1 update applied. Everything derived from your dump
goes under build/:
    build/dump/update   the program's modules (ExeFS, ELF conversions) and its control data
    build/dump/base     the base game's executable, read only for its symbols: they name 1.4.1's stripped functions
    build/<the rest>    romfs, manual, functions, lift, obj, gen, bin, run, ... laid out so that the runtime's paths
                        relative to its exe (..\\romfs, ..\\manual, ..\\userdata) work
"""
import os

REPO = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
VERSION = '1.4.1'                                       # the game version this project builds
BUILD = os.path.join(REPO, 'build')
DUMP = os.path.join(BUILD, 'dump', 'update')
BASE_DUMP = os.path.join(BUILD, 'dump', 'base')
RUNTIME = os.path.join(REPO, 'runtime')
# the host runtime's subsystem folders (runtime/<folder>); every one is an include directory of the runtime's code
RUNTIME_DIRS = ['core', 'libc', 'os', 'fs', 'gfx', 'audio', 'input', 'services', 'game']


def runtime(folder, name):
    """A file of the host runtime, e.g. runtime('gfx', 'mx_translate.c')."""
    return os.path.join(RUNTIME, folder, name)


def runtime_includes():
    """clang -I arguments for every runtime folder (the runtime's files include each other by bare name)."""
    return [arg for d in RUNTIME_DIRS for arg in ('-I', os.path.join(RUNTIME, d))]


def build(*parts):
    """A path in the build folder."""
    return os.path.join(BUILD, *parts)


def elf(module):
    """The converted module (main, sdk, subsdk0, rtld) of the program."""
    return os.path.join(DUMP, 'elf', module + '.elf')


def base_elf(module):
    """The converted module of the base game (only its main is used: for its symbols)."""
    return os.path.join(BASE_DUMP, 'elf', module + '.elf')


def dump_version():
    """The display version of the extracted program (from its control data), or None."""
    p = os.path.join(DUMP, 'control.nacp')
    if not os.path.isfile(p):
        return None
    return open(p, 'rb').read()[0x3060:0x3070].split(b'\0')[0].decode('ascii', 'replace')

```
